items.title: Vintage Pomegranate Growth Atlas
items.description: This prompt generates a tall museum-style botanical infographic poster showing the full life cycle, anatomy, and growth systems of a pomegranate plant for educational or decorative science-art use.
items.content:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"} with English subtitle directly below: {argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

items.title: Anime Light Novel Cover Illustration
items.description: Generates a dramatic, high-quality anime-style light novel cover featuring two characters, a fantasy background, and elegant Japanese typography.
items.content: A highly detailed anime-style light novel cover illustration. In the foreground, a beautiful young woman with {argument name="female hair color" default="long silver hair"} and large blue eyes wears an intricate white lace dress and a silver floral tiara with white roses, reaching her hand forward with a gentle, longing smile. Behind her, a young man with black hair wearing an {argument name="male outfit" default="ornate black coat with red accents and silver chains"} stands facing away, looking back over his shoulder melancholically. They are on a balcony overlooking a {argument name="background setting" default="gothic fantasy castle city at dusk"}, with white petals scattering in the wind. The image features prominent, elegant Japanese typography. The large main title reads "{argument name="main title" default="善人をやめた悪役貴公子は、白薔薇の聖女を遠ざける"}" in stylized fonts with gold and blue gradients. A vertical catchphrase on the left reads "{argument name="left catchphrase" default="世界を守るため、俺はもっと悪になる。"}" and another on the right reads "世界を敵に回しても、あなたの隣にいたい。". Additional text at the bottom includes author credits and a publisher logo. The overall mood is dramatic and romantic with dynamic lighting.

items.title: Japanese Rice Advertisement Banner
items.description: Generates a professional food advertisement banner featuring a rice dish, product packaging, and promotional typography.
items.content: A high-quality Japanese food advertisement banner. The background features a warm, softly blurred wooden table with golden rice stalks. On the center-right, {argument name="main dish" default="a bowl of steaming white rice topped with a raw egg yolk and soy sauce being poured over it"} sits in a vertically striped ceramic bowl. To the right, a small white dish contains exactly 3 slices of pickles (one green cucumber, one orange carrot, one white radish), alongside a blurred wooden miso soup bowl. In the top-left corner, large elegant Japanese typography reads {argument name="headline text" default="甘み、つや、粘り。三拍子そろったおいしさ。"} with a smaller subheadline below reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="日本の食卓に、最高の一杯を。"}. In the bottom-left corner, a 5kg plastic bag of rice is displayed with the label {argument name="product name" default="新潟県産 こしひかり"}. In the top-right corner, a circular gold foil award badge displays the text {argument name="badge text" default="米の食味ランキング 特A 獲得"}. Small fine print runs along the bottom right edge. The lighting is warm, appetizing, and professional, highlighting the glossy texture of the rice and egg.

items.title: Cinematic Japanese Romance Movie Poster
items.description: Generates a moody, realistic Japanese movie poster featuring a couple in the rain at a train station with customizable titles and taglines.

author.name: パク🎈動画広告分析Pro × AI

items.content: A cinematic Japanese movie poster featuring a romantic, melancholic scene of a man and a woman standing face-to-face on a wet train station platform at night in the rain. The tall man on the left wears a dark coat and backpack, holding a black umbrella over them. The woman on the right wears a tan trench coat, looking up at him. author.name: パク🎈動画広告分析Pro × AI

items.content: A cinematic, dark gothic mystery movie poster. In the center, a lone man wearing a trench coat and fedora stands with his back to the viewer, looking up at a massive, imposing gothic clock tower. The clock face is illuminated, and the structure around it is shattering with dark fragments falling. The setting is a foggy, wet cobblestone square at night, illuminated by warm yellow streetlamps and glowing windows from surrounding European-style buildings. A full moon shines through cloudy skies. There are exactly 3 ravens: one perched on a stone monument on the left, and two flying in the sky. The monument on the left has engraved text "VERITAS IN UMBRA, TEMPUS NEMINI PARET". On the right, a wooden signpost has 3 directional arrows reading "Marktplatz", "Uhrenturm", and "Alte Gasse", with a small newspaper leaning against it reading "Die Uhr steht." and "Wer lügt?". The poster features elegant, slightly distressed serif Japanese typography. At the top, a horizontal tagline reads {argument name="top tagline" default="真夜中、時は止まり、嘘が動き出す。"}. On the upper left, a vertical tagline reads {argument name="side tagline" default="その鐘の音が、真実を葬った。"}. In the lower center, the large main title reads {argument name="main title" default="時計塔の殺人"}. Below the title is a smaller tagline "時を欺いたのは、誰だ。" followed by a dense block of realistic movie credits including director, cast, and crew names. At the very bottom, the release text {argument name="release date" default="2025年 秋 全国ロードショー"} is displayed alongside a website URL and rating logos. The entire poster is framed by a thin, ornate gold border.

items.content: A cinematic sci-fi anime movie poster of a heavily armored cylindrical deep-sea submarine on a rocky ocean floor. The sub features a glowing cyan central viewport, a ring of smaller lights, two bright downward spotlights, and "{argument name="hull text" default="NEREIS-01"}" painted on its side. Behind it looms a {argument name="creature type" default="colossal bioluminescent anemone-like entity"} with radiating tentacles tipped with cyan lights. The dark teal abyss features glowing seabed flora. Top left text includes the Japanese title "{argument name="main title" default="深淵の地平線"}", the subtitle "{argument name="english subtitle" default="ABYSS HORIZON"}", and the tagline "{argument name="tagline" default="暗黒は、終わりじゃない。人類の新しい始まりだ。"}". Small technical footer text reads "INTERNATIONAL DEEP SEA TREATY ORGANIZATION" on the bottom left and "IDTO-AB-013300-ALPHA" on the bottom right. Highly detailed, dramatic lighting, industrial mecha design.

items.title: Japanese Self-Help Book Cover Mockup
items.description: Generates a realistic 3D mockup of a Japanese self-help book with customizable title, subtitle, and promotional belly band text.
items.content: A realistic 3D mockup of a softcover book standing upright at a slight angle on a plain off-white background, revealing both the front cover and the spine. The cover features a minimalist, serene illustration of a white arched doorway opening to a bright pastel sunrise over a calm sea, with a woman in a flowing white dress standing in the archway looking toward the horizon. Large, elegant vertical Japanese text in a Mincho serif font dominates the right and left sides of the arch, reading {argument name="main title" default="我慢をやめたら、人生が動き出した。"}. In the top left corner, smaller horizontal text reads {argument name="subtitle" default="自分の人生を取り戻す 7つのステップ"}. The bottom third of the book is wrapped in a light pink belly band. The band features a prominent horizontal catchphrase reading {argument name="obi catchphrase" default="もう、他人軸で生きなくていい。"}, with smaller text above it separated by a dotted line mentioning work, relationships, love, and future anxiety. On the right side of the band is a white circular badge with a small crown icon and text reading {argument name="sales badge text" default="累計 20万部 突破!"}. At the very bottom of the band are exactly 4 small rectangular boxes containing keywords about self-esteem, time management, mental organization, and ideal future, followed by the text "Everything will change!". The spine is white and displays the main title, subtitle, a placeholder for the author's name, and a placeholder for the publisher.

items.content: A {argument name="art style" default="traditional Japanese Ukiyo-e woodblock print"} landscape featuring an {argument name="main character" default="anthropomorphic glass of beer with a frothy head, a happy smiling face, stick-like yellow arms and legs, and traditional sandals"} walking on a dirt path. The character holds a blue round fan displaying the kanji "{argument name="fan text" default="涼"}". The background includes a large pine tree and a wooden bridge on the right with 3 small figures crossing, plus 3 more figures walking on the path. To the left, tall reeds border a river leading to a distant {argument name="background mountain" default="snow-capped Mount Fuji"} under a gradient sky. items.title: Fitness SaaS Landing Page UI
items.description: A massive, detailed prompt for generating a complete web and mobile UI/UX design for a premium fitness brand, including dashboards and various interface sections.

author.name: Stephen Day | Google AI, Agents & Vibe Coding

items.content:
Design a modern, high-end {argument name="app type" default="fitness app"} landing page and product UI for a brand called {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"}.

Create a clean web design mockup that looks like a real SaaS fitness platform and mobile companion app. The design should feel premium, motivating, and easy to use, with a polished UI/UX style similar to top-tier health and wellness apps.

Include:
- A hero section with bold headline, short subheadline, strong call-to-action button, and app preview
- Dashboard UI showing daily activity, calories burned, workout streak, heart rate, step count, and progress rings
- Workout program cards for strength, cardio, mobility, and recovery
- Nutrition tracking section with macro breakdown and water intake
- Progress charts and analytics widgets
- Trainer/community section with profile cards and testimonials
- Pricing section and download/app store callout
- Mobile app screens shown alongside the web design for a cohesive product ecosystem

Style direction:
- Sleek, minimal, modern interface
- Premium fitness brand aesthetic
- Smooth spacing, strong hierarchy, rounded cards, soft shadows
- Dark mode UI with energetic accent colors like electric blue, neon green, or vibrant orange
- Crisp typography, realistic charts, polished buttons, beautiful onboarding feel
- Highly detailed, dribbble-worthy, startup-quality product design
- Realistic UX case study presentation, not a cartoon or illustration

Composition:
- Full website homepage mockup
- Multiple UI sections visible in one polished presentation
- Slight perspective or straight-on product showcase
- Clean background with subtle gradients and professional lighting
- Ultra-detailed, sharp text rendering, visually balanced layout

Output:
A stunning, realistic UI/UX design concept for a fitness app website and dashboard that looks ready for development.

items.title: Modular Knowledge Encyclopedia Infographic
items.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating high-quality modular educational graphics similar to high-end museum or scientific encyclopedia pages.
items.content: 请根据【{argument name="主题" default="主题"}】生成一张高质量竖版「科普百科图」。 这张图不是普通海报，也不是单纯插画，而是一张兼具“图鉴感、百科感、信息结构感、收藏感”的模块化科普信息图。整体风格参考高级博物图鉴、现代百科书页、生活方式知识卡和社交媒体高传播信息图的结合。 请让画面包含： - 一个清晰漂亮的主题主视觉- 若干局部特征放大细节- 多个圆角模块化信息分区- 清楚的标题层级与重点标签- 简洁但丰富的百科内容- 可视化评分、要点总结或Top 5模块内容栏目请根据主题自动适配，优先从这些方向中选择并合理组合： 基础档案、分类信息、外观特征、习性/生态、形成机制/结构组成、生长或使用条件、养护或维护建议、风险与注意事项、适合人群或适用场景、优缺点对比、快速评分卡。 视觉要求： 浅色干净背景，柔和配色，轻阴影，精致小图标，圆角信息框，整洁排版，信息密度高但不拥挤，阅读体验好。整体必须像真正可以发布、阅读、收藏、系列化生产的科普百科卡，而不是广告图。 请不要做成普通商业宣传海报。要突出“知识整理+ 模块信息+ 图鉴式展示”的特征。
items.translatedContent: Please generate a high-quality vertical 'Science Encyclopedia Infographic' based on the theme: 【{argument name="theme" default="Theme"}】. This should be a modular infographic with a 'handbook, encyclopedia, and structural' feel. Style should combine high-end museum guides, modern encyclopedia pages, and knowledge cards. Include: a clear main visual, close-up feature details, rounded modular info sections, clear heading hierarchy, and concise encyclopedia content. Sections should automatically adapt to the theme, choosing from: basic files, classification, appearance, habits/ecology, mechanism/structure, growth conditions, maintenance, risks, target audience, pros/cons, or rating cards. Visuals: clean light background, soft colors, light shadows, exquisite icons, tidy layout with high density but clear readability. It must look like a publishable knowledge card for collection, not a commercial advertisement.

items.title: 3D Papercut Pirate Scene
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating a high-saturation 3D multi-layered papercut scene featuring a stylized pirate crew in a chaotic sea adventure, complete with octane rendering and realistic paper textures.
items.content:
平视视角，正面直视一个高饱和度3D多层纸雕场景。
整体为灰蓝、奶油白、深森林绿，点缀琥珀色暖光。所有元素必须是实体纸张分层结构，边缘为硬切割效果，并清晰可见厚纸横截面。
极致丰富构图，一个高能量的{argument name="场景主题" default="海盗群像场景"}，发生在混乱的海上冒险中。多个风格化海盗角色以夸张动作呈现，中层核心是一位{argument name="核心角色" default="戴草帽的年轻船长"}向前冲刺，周围是姿态鲜明的船员。
分层的船只、翻涌海浪和旋转洋流贯穿前中后景，多艘船 in 不同空间层中碰撞倾斜，船帆破损、旗帜飞扬。
背景层中出现体型巨大的对立角色剪影，增强压迫感和空间层级。
前景堆满叙事元素：宝箱、金币、地图、木桶、绳索、灯笼，以及一张带笑脸海盗的通缉令。角落放置一个吉祥物式小角色作为视觉锚点。
所有氛围元素以纸雕形式呈现：海浪、水花、烟雾、碎片、动势线，强化混乱与动感。
主体位于中层，元素跨层互动，通过重叠和空间关系表达运动感。
单一方向柔光，形成清晰层间投影。整体为哑光纸张质感，无发光、无柔边、无体积光。
octane渲染，8K，细节清晰 --ar 3:4 --stylize 450
items.translatedContent: Eye-level view, looking straight at a high-saturation 3D multi-layered paper carving scene. The overall colors are grayish-blue, creamy white, and deep forest green, accented with amber warm light. All elements must be physical paper layered structures, with hard-cut edges and clearly visible thick paper cross-sections. Extremely rich composition, a high-energy {argument name="scene theme" default="pirate group scene"} set in a chaotic sea adventure. Multiple stylized pirate characters are presented in exaggerated actions, with a {argument name="core character" default="young captain wearing a straw hat"} in the middle layer charging forward, surrounded by crew members with distinct poses. Layered ships, surging waves, and swirling currents run through the foreground, middle, and background, with multiple ships colliding and tilting in different spatial layers, sails torn, and flags flying. Silhouettes of giant opposing characters appear in the background layer to enhance the sense of oppression and spatial hierarchy. The foreground is filled with narrative elements: treasure chests, gold coins, maps, barrels, ropes, lanterns, and a wanted poster with a smiling pirate. A mascot-like small character is placed in the corner as a visual anchor. All atmospheric elements are presented in paper carving form: waves, splashes, smoke, debris, and movement lines, strengthening the chaos and sense of motion. The main subject is in the middle layer, with elements interacting across layers to express movement through overlap and spatial relationships. Soft light from a single direction creates clear inter-layer shadows. Overall matte paper texture, no glowing, no soft edges, no volumetric light. Octane render, 8K, clear details --ar 3:4 --stylize 450

items.title: Traditional Chinese Scroll Illustration
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating a traditional Chinese gongbi style long scroll poster featuring legendary characters.
items.content: (国风卷轴插画师)你是一位顶尖的中国传统工笔人物画师，擅长将经典人物群像绘制成长卷式百科海报。根据用户指定的{argument name="人物群像" default="eight immortals"}，生成一张 “中国传统人物群像长卷海报”：画面为横向长卷式构图，所有人物排成一条队列，从左至右依次展开；每个人物都有鲜明的传统服饰、标志性道具和神态，下方配有竖排名牌标注姓名；卷轴顶部有醒目的书法标题；背景为符合主题的场景元素（如祥云、海浪、山水、亭台等）。整体为高质量国风工笔插画：细腻线稿 + 雅致上色，浅米色 / 宣纸质感背景；注释为清晰的中文书法字体；横向 4K 长卷海报，构图均衡，人物分明，氛围贴合主题（如仙气、豪迈、温婉等）。直接出图，人物群像为{argument name="人物群像" default="eight immortals"}。
items.translatedContent: (Guofeng Scroll Illustrator) You are a top-tier traditional Chinese gongbi figure painter, skilled at drawing classic group portraits into long-scroll encyclopedic posters. Based on the user-specified {argument name="character group" default="eight immortals"}, generate a "Traditional Chinese Character Group Long Scroll Poster": The composition is a horizontal long scroll, with all characters arranged in a queue unfolding from left to right; each character has distinct traditional clothing, iconic props, and expressions, with vertical nameplates below; the top of the scroll features a striking calligraphy title; the background includes thematic scene elements (such as auspicious clouds, waves, landscapes, pavilions, etc.). The overall style is high-quality Guofeng gongbi illustration: fine line work + elegant coloring, light beige / rice paper texture background; annotations in clear Chinese calligraphy font; horizontal 4K long scroll poster, balanced composition, distinct characters, and an atmosphere that fits the theme (e.g., ethereal, heroic, gentle, etc.). items.content:
# 混沌としたメモ書き・記号の集合体からキャラクターの顔を浮かび上がらせるアート

---

## スタイル
- 白い紙の上に黒インクで描かれた大量の手書きメモ、数式、記号、ランダムな線。
- 紙いっぱいに散らばる書き殴り風のカオス。
- 所々に{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}の強調（ライン、塗り潰し、マーカー風の塊）。
- アナログのノート落書きのような質感。

---

## 構図
- ランダムなメモや記号が全体を覆い尽くす。
- 黒インクの線や文字の密度が「キャラクターの顔」の位置に集中する。
- 結果として、混沌の中から「与えられたキャラクターの顔のシルエット・表情」がうっすら浮かび上がる。
- 顔は写実的ではなく、カオスの断片が集まって形を成す。

---

## 色彩
- モノクロ（黒・白）を主体に構成。
- {argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}をアクセントとして散発的に配置。
- 彩度は抑えめ、アナログの紙とインク感を重視。

---

## 表現要素
- 読めるようで読めない文字列、日本語や英数字が混在。
- 数式記号、矢印、点、斜線、クロス、ドリップ（インクの飛び散り）。
- キャラクターの顔の目や髪の輪郭は、メモや記号の配置の「余白」や「濃淡」で浮かび上がる。

---

## 禁止事項
- 顔を直接的に描き込む写実ポートレート。
- デジタル処理的で整然とした幾何学模様。
- カラフルな彩色や過飽和表現。
- ロゴ、透かし、人工的なCG感。

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- 全体は「混沌としたメモ・記号の集合体」として成立している。  
- 与えられたキャラクターの顔が、混沌の濃淡・配置から自然に浮かび上がる。  
- 色はモノクロ＋{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤アクセント"}のみ。  
- 紙とインクの手描き的質感を保持している。

# Art that reveals a character's face from a chaotic collection of notes and symbols

---

## Style
- Mass of handwritten notes, formulas, symbols, and random lines in black ink on white paper.

items.content: 创建一个 {argument name="网格尺寸" default="10×10"} 的网格，其中包含 {argument name="物品数量" default="100"} 种不同的奇幻角色扮演游戏 (RPG) 物品，采用{argument name="艺术风格" default="经典的像素艺术风格"}（16 位或 32 位精灵图风格，类似于 SNES/GBA 时代的日式角色扮演游戏）。每个物品应单独占据一个正方形图块，并在下方附上简短清晰的标签。网格应整齐排列在白色背景上。确保每个物品在视觉上都独具特色，并且每个标签的拼写都正确。使用清晰的像素边缘，每个精灵使用有限的调色板，并使用轻微的抖动效果来表现阴影。使用以下行主题：第 1 行：剑和刀剑；第 2 行：盾牌和盔甲；第 3 行：弓、弩和远程武器；第 4 行：法杖、魔杖 and 魔法法器；第 5 行：药水、药剂 and 药瓶；第 6 行：卷轴、典籍 and 魔法书；第 7 行：戒指、护身符 and 附魔饰品；第 8 行：头盔、王冠 and 头饰；第 9 行：钥匙、圣物 and 任务物品；第 10 行：宝石、符文 and 制作材料。将每个图块显示为居中的物品精灵，置于干净的背景方块上，并以经典的物品栏图标形式呈现——类似于你在奇幻角色扮演游戏菜单中看到的那种。保持整体风格的一致性、连贯性，并让人联想起备受喜爱的复古奇幻角色扮演游戏——既迷人又精致，即使在小尺寸下也清晰易读。

items.title: Magazine Cover on Desk with Cowboy Chameleon
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic lifestyle shot of a tech magazine on a wooden desk, ideal for editorial mockups, AI feature announcements, or magazine-cover concept art.
items.content: A realistic editorial product photo of a glossy magazine lying diagonally on a warm medium-brown wooden table, viewed from above at a slight angle. The magazine dominates the frame and has a deep cobalt-blue cover with a large elegant serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="Convergence"} across the top. On the left side of the cover, a huge stacked white sans-serif headline reads {argument name="cover headline" default="CHATGPT IMAGES 2.0"}. The main cover image is a highly detailed green chameleon in close-up profile facing left, wearing a tan cowboy hat with a brown leather band and metal stud, creating a surreal but polished magazine-cover concept. Add small editorial cover lines in white text beneath and along the bottom, arranged in neat columns like a technology or design magazine, with tiny issue details in the upper right including a price and date. The magazine should look physically printed, with visible page thickness, subtle edge wear, and realistic reflections on the glossy cover. Surrounding environment: soft leafy shadows fall across the tabletop from the upper left, a clear faceted drinking glass is partially visible on the right edge, an orange-red plate peeks in from the top right corner, a pale yellow sticky note in the lower right reads {argument name="sticky note text" default="SOTA"} in handwritten uppercase letters, and a hint of a green houseplant appears in the upper left. Use warm natural afternoon sunlight, cinematic shadows, crisp focus, and photorealistic materials for a premium lifestyle desk scene.

items.title: Vintage Malta Travel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic illustrated tourism poster of Malta with bold headline text, a coastal road, classic car, harbor boats, and sunlit historic architecture for travel branding or wall art.
items.content: A vintage travel poster illustration for {argument name="destination" default="Malta"}, designed like a mid-century Mediterranean tourism advertisement with elegant painterly realism and slightly textured printed-poster grain. At the top center, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="MALTA"} in oversized cream serif capitals, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} directly below in smaller dark navy sans-serif capitals. Show a sunlit coastal road curving along a stone waterfront in Valletta, viewed from slightly above and behind a classic white 1960s sedan driving away from the viewer in the lower left foreground; the rear license plate reads {argument name="license plate" default="MTA 1964"}. Across the harbor, depict warm honey-colored limestone buildings climbing the hillside, including 1 large domed church, 1 tall narrow church spire, rows of historic townhouses with several colorful enclosed wooden balconies, and distant city walls stretching across the opposite shoreline. In the bay, include exactly 3 traditional Maltese fishing boats in vivid blue, yellow, red, and green, plus 2 tiny white sailboats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls flying across a brilliant turquoise-blue sky with soft white clouds. Frame the whole composition with dark leafy trees and abundant bright magenta bougainvillea blossoms arching in from the top and right edges, with more flowers in the lower right corner, creating a lush border around the scene. Include a palm tree among the waterfront buildings and a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. Use warm golden sunlight, saturated coastal colors, romantic vacation-poster composition, clean readable typography, and a nostalgic, idealized Mediterranean atmosphere.

items.title: Anime Martial Arts Dojo Duel
items.description: This prompt generates a high-energy anime-style two-girl martial arts battle scene in a wooden dojo, ideal for dramatic promotional art or social media visuals.
items.content: A dynamic anime action illustration of two young martial-arts women fighting inside a traditional Japanese-style wooden dojo. The left fighter is in the foreground, a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied by a yellow ribbon, wearing a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu tunic with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She is in a deep low stance on the wooden floor, one fist pulled back and the other punching forward, surrounded by bright red energy trails that arc around her body and sweep across the scene. Water splashes dramatically around her feet as if her movement skims through a shallow layer of water. The right fighter is airborne in the midground, a pale-skinned girl with light lavender hair in two round buns, wearing a short black-and-white cheongsam-inspired battle dress with gold trim, black sheer tights, and black shoes. She performs a flying side kick while a vivid blue energy spiral curls around her in a circular motion. The collision of force between them has cracked and exploded the wooden floor at center-right, with debris and wood fragments flying outward, while dust and smoke billow across the lower right corner. The dojo interior has exposed timber beams, tatami edging, shoji-style windows, and warm natural light entering from the left. Hang a wooden sign above them with the Chinese text {argument name="sign text" default="币安 vs OKX"}. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, strong foreshortening, cinematic motion blur, intense speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, energetic combat choreography, and a polished poster-like finish. Add exactly 2 visible fighters, 1 overhead wooden sign, 1 cracked floor impact point, 1 red energy effect around the left fighter, and 1 blue energy effect around the right fighter. Optionally place a subtle watermark-like text at the lower right reading {argument name="watermark text" default="UM YouMind"}.

items.content: A photorealistic candid street photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young Russian woman"} running toward the camera in a frantic late-for-school moment, holding one hand near her chest and with {argument name="prop" default="a slice of toast in her mouth"}. She wears {argument name="dress style" default="a light beige patterned flowing dress with long sleeves and a cinched waist"} and flat shoes, the skirt billowing with motion. Shot from an extreme low-angle worm's-eye perspective on a rough roadside in a modest urban neighborhood, making her appear tall against a huge uninterrupted {argument name="sky color" default="deep cobalt blue"} sky. Dense intersecting overhead power lines and utility poles crisscross the upper half of the frame, creating strong geometric tension. Use hard noon sunlight with crisp, dark shadows stretching across the dusty pavement. Include exactly 4 background pedestrians, slightly blurred and walking away or across the street, plus a few distant cars and low buildings lining both sides of the road. The composition should feel chaotic, youthful, cinematic, and frozen in motion, with a wide-angle lens, high-fidelity realism, subtle film grain, strong contrast, slightly nostalgic color rendering, and a {argument name="film look" default="Fujifilm Classic Negative"} aesthetic.

items.title: Censored Point-Cloud Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a stark black-and-white lidar-style portrait of a suited man built from dense white particles, ideal for editorial tech visuals, privacy themes, or futuristic identity imagery.
items.content: A minimalist monochrome portrait made entirely from millions of tiny white point-cloud dots on a pitch-black background, showing 1 adult man from the chest up in a formal dark blazer and light collared dress shirt. The subject is centered slightly to the right, facing forward with a subtle three-quarter turn, with neatly combed short hair and one visible ear sharply defined by dense lidar-like particles. Render the figure as raw 3D scan data mixed with topological contour logic: ultra-dense stippling, precise geometric dot placement, faint isoline structure, and clean depth shaping across the hair, jacket lapels, collar, neck, and shoulders. Keep the face intentionally obscured by 1 large vertical rectangular censor block in dark gray to black, perfectly centered over the facial area from forehead to below the nose, creating a stark privacy-mask effect. Use matte texture, crisp edges, sharp focus, high contrast, no glow, no bloom, no neon, no fog, no motion blur, no chromatic aberration, no painterly strokes. Add 1 small four-point sparkle icon in light gray in the bottom-right corner. The overall image should feel mathematical, forensic, and futuristic, like a high-resolution lidar scan portrait in 8k.

items.title: Satellite Map of Big Ben Area
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic labeled satellite-style aerial map centered on Big Ben and the Palace of Westminster, useful for map comparisons, location visuals, and geographic context images.
items.content: A high-resolution top-down satellite map view of central {argument name="city" default="London"}, focused tightly on the area around {argument name="landmark" default="Big Ben"} and the Palace of Westminster beside the River Thames. Show a realistic aerial orthographic perspective like a modern digital map or satellite layer, with detailed rooftops, streets, trees, shadows, and brownish river water. Place the long Palace of Westminster complex vertically near the center-right, directly along the west bank of the river, with Big Ben at the northeast corner of the palace near the river edge. A bridge labeled {argument name="bridge name" default="Westminster Bridge"} crosses horizontally near the bottom of the frame from left to right over the river. Include 6 visible map labels total: {argument name="label 1" default="Westminster Abbey"}, {argument name="label 2" default="Parliament Square"}, Big Ben, Palace of Westminster, Westminster Bridge, and Horse Guards Parade. Also show Whitehall as a labeled road running vertically on the left side of the palace area. Surrounding details should include Westminster Abbey in the upper left quadrant, Parliament Square above the palace, Horse Guards Parade as a large sandy rectangular ground in the lower left quadrant, dense city blocks and roads on the left half, the River Thames occupying the full right side, embankments on both sides, a few boats on the river, and tree-lined streets and parks. Use natural satellite-image colors, crisp cartographic label overlays, and the look of a zoomed-in online maps screenshot.

items.title: VINCO Editorial Moodboard Screenshot
items.description: A screenshot-style AI moodboard showing a six-image editorial fashion concept for a fictional streetwear and natural-wine brand, useful for recreating art direction decks or campaign reference boards.
items.content: Create a 4:5 editorial fashion lookbook moodboard for a fictional brand called {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"}. The image is a dark-interface screenshot-style composition with a large rounded charcoal text panel across the upper half and a 2-by-3 grid of six fashion/editorial images in the lower left quadrant. The overall aesthetic blends Italian archival graphic design with late-1990s Southern California streetwear, mixing natural wine culture, skate utility, and sun-faded documentary fashion photography. Use gritty but precise art direction, midday outdoor light, slightly chaotic but disciplined typography, and real-person casting rather than polished fashion-model energy. In the top text panel, show a long white sans-serif creative-direction paragraph describing the shoot, with multiple lines of copy, like an AI prompt or design brief displayed inside a rounded dark gray bubble on a near-black background. In the image grid, include exactly 6 tiles: tile 1 shows a young man in an oversized faded olive T-shirt and dark pants standing in front of an off-white poster-like backdrop with bold {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} branding, barcode graphics, and small editorial text; tile 2 is a close-up still life of a dark wine bottle with a minimalist white label reading {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}, photographed in warm sunlight with tactile paper texture and shadow; tile 3 shows a person from the back in a washed olive long-sleeve shirt with large subtle chest or back branding, white shorts, and a yellow hanging tag or sticker element near the top right, posed against a pale wall with blue stripe detail and editorial layout text; tile 4 shows a skateboarder crouching or riding away, photographed from behind, wearing a white T-shirt with a large black graphic block on the back and dark shorts, in golden sun on pavement; tile 5 is a printed wine ephemera flat lay with cream paper and a pale chartreuse-green wine label or booklet reading {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}, featuring grape illustration, small black text, and layered paper pieces; tile 6 shows a person facing camera in a white T-shirt with a race-bib style chest print reading 97, wearing a fluorescent yellow-green cap with small brand text, standing outdoors with palm trees and bright sky behind them. Keep the six images slightly imperfect and collage-like, as if pulled from a campaign deck or saved references. Use earthy tones throughout: olive, cream, charcoal, sun-bleached white, asphalt gray, muted brown, and one fluorescent yellow-green accent repeated in small details. Include visible interface framing around the composition: a dark app-like background, the lower image grid aligned left, and a rounded gray “Edit” button near the bottom left, plus a small circular icon near the bottom right, reinforcing that this is a screenshot of a generated moodboard rather than a clean standalone poster.

items.title: Historical Invention Timeline Grid
items.description: This prompt generates a parchment-styled educational poster showing a grid of labeled invention dioramas across history, ideal for timeline infographics and world-changing technology comparisons.
items.content:
Create a square infographic-style illustration showing a {argument name="grid size" default="15×15"} invention timeline grid rendered as a collection of miniature isometric dioramas on aged parchment tiles. The image should look like a curated historical poster that spans from {argument name="starting year" default="1000 BC"} to {argument name="ending year" default="2026"}, with one invention per tile and no repeats. Show the visible portion as a 5 by 5 section of the larger grid, for a total of 25 labeled tiles, arranged in neat rows and columns with thin dark borders. Every tile contains a unique world-changing invention depicted as a small handcrafted diorama with era-appropriate materials, colors, and background details. Use a warm antiquarian palette for ancient and medieval inventions, sepia technical-document tones for early modern inventions, and cooler neon-blue futuristic lighting for modern digital and biotech inventions. Surround the grid with an old-map border and subtle historical cartography textures, blending into faint modern network graphics near the bottom right.

Label each visible tile with a small beige caption tag in bold black text. Include exactly these 25 visible inventions in reading order from top left to bottom right: 1) {argument name="first tile label" default="1000 BC"} tile showing an iron plow and simple hand tools in a farm field, captioned "Iron Plow & Tools"; 2) "Concept of Zero" shown as a parchment-like tile with a carved zero symbol and a blue hourglass; 3) "Water Clock" shown as a wooden water-timing device; 4) "Catapult" shown as a wooden siege engine; 5) "Antikythera Mechanism" shown as an intricate bronze gear device in a stone niche; 6) "Concrete" shown as a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement or mortar; 7) "Wheelbarrow" shown as a simple wooden one-wheel cart; 8) "Windmill" shown as a traditional mill on grassy ground; 9) "Gunpowder" shown as a barrel and a mound of black powder with smoke; 10) "Printing Press" shown as a wooden press framed by classical columns; 11) "Mechanical Clock" shown as an ornate standing clock; 12) "Telescope" shown as an early brass telescope on a tripod with sketch-like scientific notes; 13) "Steam Engine" shown on a blue blueprint-style tile with an early locomotive engine; 14) "Electric Battery" shown on a blueprint-like tile with two cylindrical battery cells and wiring; 15) "Telegraph" shown as a Morse telegraph key on technical paper; 16) "Light Bulb" shown glowing warmly on a neutral pedestal; 17) "Automobile" shown as an early red motorcar on a workshop-plan background; 18) "Airplane" shown as a commercial jet aircraft in miniature; 19) "Transistor" shown as a black microchip on a luminous circuit-board tile; 20) "Personal Computer" shown as a beige desktop computer with CRT monitor and keyboard; 21) "World Wide Web" shown as a glowing blue globe over digital circuitry; 22) "Smartphone" shown as a sleek modern phone on a neon-tech background; 23) "CRISPR-Cas9" shown as a DNA double helix in a biotech-blue display tile; 24) "Reusable Rocket" shown as several upright rockets launching with exhaust clouds; 25) "AI (LLMs)" shown as glowing large letters AI in a holographic tech cube; 26) "Brain-Computer Interface" shown as a glowing brain hologram on a blue platform; 27) "Advanced Neural Interface (Implant)" shown as a transparent human head profile with a glowing brain implant, with a small top label reading "2026".

Keep the composition highly organized, poster-like, and visually dense, with each tile readable at a glance. Use slight isometric perspective, crisp linework, painterly shading, and polished editorial illustration quality. The overall feeling should combine museum poster, educational timeline, and imaginative historical-tech diorama art.

items.content: A warm, candid editorial-style street café portrait of a relaxed young woman sitting alone at a small round outdoor table on a narrow European cobblestone street in late afternoon sunlight. She wears an oversized cream knit V-neck sweater and loose light blue jeans, with dark brown hair loosely tied in a messy bun with soft flyaway strands. She is seated casually with one knee drawn up, holding a small white espresso cup in one hand while the other rests near a saucer on the table. The café is beside a storefront window on the left, with a row of outdoor chairs and tables receding into the background on the right, soft pedestrians and buildings out of focus in the distance. items.title: Vintage Confidential Case File
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic top-down noir-style confidential dossier page, ideal for storytelling, detective worldbuilding, and cinematic prop imagery.
items.content: A top-down cinematic still life of a vintage classified investigation dossier on a dark wooden desk, centered and filling most of the frame. Show a stack of 3 worn manila folders with aged beige paper, frayed corners, subtle stains, and realistic paper texture. The top folder is the main focus and is clipped at the upper left with 1 oversized silver paper clip. Across the top center, typewritten in bold black monospaced letters, the headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="CONFIDENTIAL – CASE FILES"}, with a thin horizontal rule beneath it. Add 2 red rubber-stamp marks: one near the top right that says "CONFIDENTIAL" at a slight angle, and one boxed stamp at the bottom right that says "HANDLING INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT COPY – DO NOT DISTRIBUTE". On the right edge of the folder stack, show 1 tabbed side label reading "CASE FILE NO." with a thick black redaction bar below it. The page is formatted like an old typewritten government document with crisp black ink, slightly uneven typewriter alignment, and many thick black redaction bars obscuring key details. Include 5 numbered sections exactly: "1. SUBJECT INFORMATION", "2. CASE SUMMARY", "3. DETAILS", "4. ASSOCIATES / CONTACTS", and "5. REMARKS". In the header area, include the fields "CASE FILE NO.:" with a black redaction bar, "DATE OPENED:" with {argument name="date opened" default="March 14, 20___"}, "PREPARED BY:" with a black redaction bar, "DEPARTMENT:" with {argument name="department" default="Internal Investigations Unit"}, and "CLASSIFICATION:" with {argument name="classification" default="CONFIDENTIAL"}. In section 1, include 6 fields: "NAME:", "ALIASES:", "DATE OF BIRTH:", "PLACE OF BIRTH:", "LAST KNOWN ADDRESS:", and "OCCUPATION:", each followed by black redaction bars of varying lengths. In section 2, add a short paragraph of typewritten case-summary text with 5 separate black redaction bars embedded in the sentence flow. In section 3, add a second paragraph of details text with 4 separate black redaction bars embedded in the paragraph. In section 4, include a 3-column table labeled "NAME", "RELATIONSHIP", and "NOTES", with 3 filled rows, each cell content covered by black redaction bars. In section 5, add a short warning sentence about sensitive information and unauthorized disclosure. Use warm sepia lighting, soft shadows around the folder edges, subtle vignetting, and a moody noir archival atmosphere. The image should feel realistic, tactile, secretive, and slightly dusty, like a confidential detective case file photographed for a crime thriller or worldbuilding prop.

items.title: Retro Pixel Mountain Valley
items.description: A vibrant pixel art alpine landscape with halftone comic shading, ideal for retro game backgrounds, scenic posters, or nostalgic environment art.
items.content: A highly detailed retro pixel art landscape of a bright alpine valley in summer, composed like a classic side-scrolling video game background but shown as a wide scenic vista. In the foreground, a winding tan dirt path curves from the bottom center into the middle distance through dense wildflower meadows, with a small blue stream at the lower right bordered by gray rocks and lush grass. Count 2 large foreground rock clusters, 1 winding path, and 1 visible stream. Fill the meadows with colorful flowers in vivid purple, yellow, red, pink, and white, with especially tall purple flower spikes on the left foreground and dense mixed blossoms on both sides of the path. On the left and right midground, place thick stands of leafy green trees and dark pine trees, framing the open valley center. In the background, show a dramatic mountain range with exactly 7 visible peaks: 1 dominant tall snow-capped peak slightly right of center, 2 medium purple peaks to its left, 2 smaller snowy blue peaks in the far center distance, 1 smaller purple peak to the right, and 1 cropped rocky mountain edge at the far left. Use vibrant greens and purples as the main palette, with cool blue shadows and lavender mountain faces. Above, render a bright blue sky with large creamy white clouds, halftone-dot shading throughout the sky and mountains, subtle vintage comic print texture, visible dithering, and crisp sharp pixel edges. Add exactly 4 small flying bird silhouettes in the sky. The whole image should feel colorful, nostalgic, scenic, and richly layered, with heavy halftone comic shading, retro print grain, no text, no UI, no characters, and no buildings.

items.title: WSJ-Style Business Newspaper Front Page
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic financial newspaper front page on a desk, ideal for editorial mockups, announcement satire, and high-fidelity AI typography demos.
items.content: A photorealistic overhead three-quarter view of a folded financial newspaper on a dark wooden desk, styled like a prestigious American business daily from the 1980s–2000s, with crisp realistic newsprint texture, subtle paper wrinkles, slightly worn folded edges, and warm morning sunlight casting diagonal window-shadow bands across the page. The masthead dominates the top in large classic serif capitals reading {argument name="newspaper name" default="THE WALL STREET DAILY."}. Directly beneath it is a thin header strip with small financial-paper details: "DOW JONES", "News Corp", the date line "MONDAY, APRIL 20, 2026 – VOL. CCLXXXV NO. 90", "WSJ.com", a star rating row, and the price "$5.00". The main lead story spans the upper center-left with a huge bold serif headline reading {argument name="main headline" default="Cook to Step Down as Apple CEO; Ternus Named Successor"}. Below it is a smaller serif subheadline: "Transition caps 15-year run; company pivots to AI-driven future". Add a byline line in small caps with 2 reporters: "By Tim Higgins" and "And Joanna Stern". Fill the lead article with dense, fully legible multi-column newspaper body text about Tim Cook stepping down as Apple chief executive, John Ternus succeeding him, Apple's growth, AI strategy, and corporate transition; the text should read like authentic financial journalism, not placeholder gibberish. On the right half of the lead story, place a black-and-white engraved stipple portrait of a male executive in collared shirt and jacket, centered in a rectangular image area; the face is partially obscured by a pale gray square censor block over the eyes and upper nose, creating a modern satirical effect. At the top-right, include a sidebar box titled "What’s New" with exactly 2 subsection headers, "Business & Finance" and "World-Wide", each followed by bullet-point briefs in small serif text; include exactly 3 bullets under "Business & Finance" and exactly 4 bullets under "World-Wide", all fully typeset and legible. Beneath the main story, add a secondary banner article across the page titled "Silicon Valley Braces for New Chapter in AI Arms Race" with a byline "By Liz Hoffman" and several short columns of text about big tech, startups, OpenAI, Google, Meta, chips, platforms, and AI competition. To the right of this lower-middle section, insert a compact markets table titled "Markets" with exactly 4 rows labeled "DOW JONES", "S&P 500", "NASDAQ", and "10-YR. TREASURY", with columns for index/value/change/percent and realistic numeric values in tight newspaper tabular formatting. Along the bottom strip of the front page, include exactly 3 teaser boxes: left box with section label "Heard on the Street" and headline "Why Investors Are Rethinking Big Tech" plus page marker "B12"; center box with section label "Markets" and headline "Earnings Season Lifts Stocks Despite Rate Uncertainty" plus page marker "B1"; right box with section label "Inside" and headline "Private Credit Sees Inflow Surge as Yields Stay High" plus page marker "B14". Make all typography clean, sharp, perfectly legible, and consistently aligned in authentic newspaper grid layout with thin rules between columns, justified text, classic serif fonts, and realistic print contrast. The newspaper sits slightly rotated clockwise on the desk. In the environment, show a white ceramic coffee cup filled with black coffee in the top-right corner and a pair of dark-framed eyeglasses resting near the lower-right edge of the paper. In the top-left corner, include the cropped edge of a dark cylindrical object, likely a camera lens or tumbler. Overall mood: premium editorial mock front page, serious business-news aesthetic, believable print photography, ultra-detailed, natural shadows, high resolution.

items.title: Golden Bay City Romantic Landscape
items.description: This prompt generates a sweeping painterly panoramic cityscape across a bay, ideal for cinematic concept art, wall art, or atmospheric landscape illustrations.
items.content: A grand romantic landscape painting of {argument name="city skyline" default="San Francisco"} seen across a wide bay from an elevated hillside overlook. In the foreground, an old rocky path with 5 large stone ruins or broken masonry blocks sits among dark shrubs and windswept trees, painted in soft earthy browns and deep greens. The middle ground shows calm reflective water with 3 small sailboats scattered across the bay. On the left spans a long suspension bridge with 4 visible towers stretching toward the city. In the distance, a luminous modern skyline rises along the waterfront, including a tall tapered central skyscraper and a pointed pyramid-shaped tower. Above, dramatic swirling clouds open around a radiant low sun, casting warm golden light through the sky and across the water. Render it as a vast cinematic matte painting blended with 19th-century oil landscape aesthetics, atmospheric perspective, glowing haze, soft brushwork, monumental scale, serene mood, and detailed cloud drama.

items.title: Three Beauty Mobile Landing Pages
items.description: A premium triptych mockup of three smartphone beauty website designs, ideal for showcasing AI-generated cosmetic brand landing page concepts on social media.
items.content: A polished promotional mockup showing 3 tall smartphone screens displayed side by side in a vertical triptych layout, each presenting a modern beauty brand landing page for a lip product. The overall composition is editorial, minimal, and premium, designed like a social media showcase of mobile web designs. The left panel sits on a soft lavender-to-blush gradient background and shows a black-framed phone with a cream and blush beauty website for {argument name="brand name" default="Kosas"}. At the top of this panel, small elegant serif text reads {argument name="left headline" default="Fresh Pout."}. The phone screen features a cropped close-up beauty image at the top, a bold headline reading “Lips in their fullest expression.” with “fullest” in italic serif styling, a rounded dark call-to-action button, a strip of 3 lip close-up thumbnails, 3 labeled benefit tabs reading “Plumps,” “Tingles,” and “Shines,” and a row of 5 shade or effect icons underneath. The middle panel sits on a lavender-to-deep-violet gradient background and shows a second black-framed phone with a more typographic landing page. Above it, serif text reads {argument name="middle headline" default="Claude Code"}. The screen includes a cropped portrait image at top, a very large bold black stacked title reading “LIP PULSE.” with a pink italic script-style line “is here.” beneath it, a rounded dark button, a dark section with the phrase “Lips in their fullest expression.”, and a product grid near the bottom containing 6 shade cards arranged in 2 rows of 3. The right panel sits on a dark navy textured background and shows a third black-framed phone with a pink-forward e-commerce style page. Centered above it, monospaced white text reads {argument name="right headline" default="GPT Images 2.0"}. This screen prominently displays the product hero section with the brand name “Kosas,” a large title “The Lip Pulse,” a pink lip gloss tube angled to the right, small feature icons, a shade strip of 6 lip swatches near the middle, and a lower promotional block with additional pink product imagery. Keep the layout symmetrical with exactly 3 phones, one per panel, each fully visible and vertically oriented. Use high-end cosmetic campaign aesthetics, clean spacing, fashion-web typography mixing serif and bold sans serif, soft pink and cream UI palettes, subtle shadows, and a sleek product-design presentation suitable for showcasing AI-generated mobile website concepts.

items.title: Golden Hour Tech Rivals Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic editorial-style photo of two anonymous men in branded black clothing posed outside a traditional wooden building, useful for social commentary, satire, or tech-culture visuals.
items.content: A candid low-angle photograph of two adult men standing in front of a traditional East Asian wooden building with warm brown timber framing and repeating green lattice window panels, shot during golden hour with strong warm sunlight and deep shadows. The man on the left is much closer to the camera, partially cropped, wearing a black zip-up jacket with a large white OpenAI logo on the chest and a gray panel on the sleeve. His arm is extended directly toward the lens, holding a cigarette in the extreme foreground so the hand and cigarette dominate the lower-left area and appear slightly out of focus due to shallow depth of field. The man on the right stands farther back, wearing a loose black T-shirt with a bold white "xAI" style logo on the chest, one hand raised near his mouth as if smoking or thinking. Both men have their faces obscured by smooth rectangular blur blocks, preserving anonymity. Use a realistic documentary street-photo aesthetic, natural skin tones, subtle lens distortion from a wide-angle perspective, cinematic contrast, rich sunset lighting, and a casual confrontational composition that emphasizes the brands on their clothing and the cigarette thrust toward the viewer. Include exactly 2 men, 1 cigarette visible in the foreground, 1 black jacket with the OpenAI emblem, and 1 black T-shirt with the xAI logo.

items.title: Santorini Luxury Dress Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic vertical travel-fashion portrait of a glamorous woman in a white dress posing in Santorini, ideal for luxury vacation, lifestyle, or editorial imagery.
items.content: A glamorous travel-fashion portrait of a {argument name="woman" default="blonde woman"} seated on a sunlit stone ledge overlooking the caldera in Santorini, Greece, with whitewashed cliffside buildings descending toward a deep blue sea and rugged volcanic islands in the distance. She wears a flowing ivory halter dress with a very deep plunging neckline, side cutouts, a gathered waist with a circular ring detail, and soft pleated fabric draped across her lap. Her hair is long, wavy, and {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"}, styled loose over her shoulders. Add layered delicate necklaces including a small pendant and a silver cross, plus a bracelet or watch on one wrist. Place a classic white Greek church with a bright {argument name="dome color" default="blue"} dome in the upper right background, and frame the right side of the image with vivid {argument name="flower color" default="magenta pink"} bougainvillea in full bloom. Lighting is bright Mediterranean midday sun with crisp highlights, soft skin glow, and gentle depth of field that keeps the woman sharp while the background architecture and sea are slightly softened. Composition is vertical, elegant and aspirational, with the woman centered slightly right, torso visible down to the flowing skirt, scenic coastline stretching across the left half of the frame. Add small black text in the top-left corner reading {argument name="corner text" default="GPT V2"}. Photorealistic luxury vacation aesthetic, high detail, natural colors, editorial Instagram travel vibe.

items.title: Gear 5 Chalkboard Classroom Mural
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic classroom photo featuring a dramatic chalkboard mural of Gear 5 Luffy, ideal for anime-themed poster art or social media comparisons of image models.
items.content: A photorealistic classroom interior centered on a large green chalkboard filled with an elaborate chalk mural of Monkey D. Luffy in Gear 5 from One Piece. The drawing dominates the board: a dynamic low-angle foreshortened pose with one oversized foot thrust toward the viewer, both fists raised, wild curly white hair, huge manic grin, intense round eyes, open white jacket, bare muscular chest with visible scars, loose white pants, and a flowing purple sash. items.content: A cinematic surreal space scene showing 1 astronaut floating in open space beside Earth, with the planet dominating the left side of the frame and the astronaut on the right, drifting backward with bent legs and one arm reaching toward the planet. The astronaut wears a realistic white EVA-style spacesuit with a dark reflective visor, a backpack unit, and a shoulder patch in red, yellow, and green. Earth is shown from the Atlantic side with North and South America clearly visible, lit by a cool blue rim glow against a deep black star field with sparse tiny stars. Across the continents and faintly across the oceans, organic branching root-like or neural vein structures spread over the surface, especially dense across North America and extending into South America, creating a dark biomechanical or living-planet effect. Use dramatic low-key lighting, strong contrast, moody shadows, photorealistic textures, ultra-detailed cinematic realism, a quiet ominous atmosphere, and a wide composition with large negative space.

items.content: A photorealistic Japanese classroom interior shot in soft daytime light, viewed from the front-left corner at a slight angle, with an old green chalkboard dominating the wall. items.title: Anime Samurai Game Ad Poster
items.description: A flashy vertical mobile game advertisement featuring two suited swordsmen, a giant samurai mecha, gameplay UI, QR code, and app store download prompts for app promotion use.
items.content: Create a high-impact vertical mobile game advertisement poster in glossy anime action style, with a dramatic cyber-samurai fantasy aesthetic and dense, premium gacha-RPG promotional composition. The main scene shows 2 young adult male fighters in modern black business suits crouching aggressively in the foreground, each drawing a katana toward the viewer. Both have styled blond hair, sharp handsome features, white dress shirts, blue neckties, and intense action poses, with foreshortened hands and swords dominating the lower foreground. One sword has a blue ribbon tied near the hilt. Behind them, centered and towering, place 1 massive armored mecha samurai with ornate gold horns, layered metallic blue-black armor, glowing blue eyes, and a sheathed sword across its back, framed like a guardian deity. Use a vivid neon city and energy-burst backdrop in electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold, with light streaks, sparks, petals, slash effects, and ink-brush explosion textures. Add 1 vertical black brushstroke banner on the upper right with bold white Japanese text reading 「この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。」. Across the middle-lower area, place 1 huge gold Japanese calligraphy headline with thick brush texture and black shadow reading 「切り捨て御免」, spanning nearly the full width. In the lower left, embed 1 framed gameplay screenshot panel with a gold border, showing a night battle in front of a red Japanese temple courtyard, 1 playable swordsman in combat, multiple enemies, floating damage numbers including 5324, 5329, and 6132, a left-side virtual joystick, 5 character portraits total arranged vertically and along the bottom, 3 circular skill buttons on the right, and a top HUD showing a timer around 01:28 and WAVE 3/3. In the lower right, place 1 large black-and-white QR code inside a white square frame. Beneath and beside it, add bold Japanese text in white with blue outline reading 「今すぐダウンロード」. At the very bottom, include 2 official-style store badges: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall look: ultra-detailed, polished key art, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel-shaded anime rendering, premium mobile game marketing poster, intense action energy, cinematic lighting, and layered UI-heavy promotional layout.

items.title: Realistic McDonald's Selfie Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic casual selfie of a man inside a McDonald's, useful for creating believable social-media-style restaurant snapshots.
items.content: A highly realistic casual smartphone selfie taken indoors at a McDonald's restaurant in Asia, framed as a chest-up portrait of a young man seated at a table. The camera is held slightly above table height at arm’s length, creating a natural front-facing selfie perspective with one forearm extending toward the lens. The subject wears a black T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest, has short straight black hair, thin dark eyeglass frames partly visible, and rests one hand lightly against his chin in a relaxed pose. His face is fully obscured by a large solid rectangular blur block in the center, preserving privacy while leaving the hair, ears, jawline edges, and glasses arms visible. In the lower left foreground sits 1 white McDonald's paper drink cup with a lid and a white straw, cropped by the frame. The background shows the restaurant counter area with warm ambient lighting, 1 large red wall panel on the left featuring the yellow McDonald's arches and the white slogan “i’m lovin’ it” with Chinese text below, 4 illuminated digital menu boards across the top displaying burgers, fries, combo meals, prices, and Chinese text, plus 2 people in the background near the counter, one facing away with a backpack and another partially visible behind the register. Use natural color balance, slight indoor grain, realistic reflections, shallow to moderate depth of field, and the candid look of an unstaged social media snapshot.

items.title: Realistic Sam's Club Shopping Snapshot
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic candid warehouse-store portrait suitable for recreating an authentic shopping scene with branded retail signage and a shopper holding produce.
items.content: A candid, highly realistic smartphone photo inside a busy Sam’s Club warehouse store in China. Center the composition on a young East Asian man from mid-torso up, standing upright and facing the camera, with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block for privacy. He wears a plain black short-sleeve T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest and holds a large clear plastic bag of red apples in his left hand, tied at the top with a blue band. The apple bag has a white label reading “envy” with small Chinese text beneath it. Behind him is a bright retail interior with tall industrial ceilings, warehouse shelving, shoppers, shopping carts, and stacked produce displays. Prominently show the blue diamond Sam’s Club wall sign at upper left with the text “Sam’s CLUB” and “山姆会员商店,” and a large blue wall banner behind him reading “更好的生活尽在山姆” and “Life is Better in the Club.” On the upper right, hang a tall white vertical banner that reads “优质优价” and “Great Products Great Prices,” with blue and green geometric accents. Include many background customers, slightly out of focus, to create an authentic crowded shopping atmosphere. Lighting should be bright, even retail overhead lighting; colors natural; perspective eye level; documentary snapshot aesthetic; sharp foreground subject with mildly softened background; portrait orientation.

items.title: Nostalgic 80s 90s China Memory Poster
items.description: A warm retro collage poster depicting eight iconic childhood memories from 1980s–1990s China, ideal for nostalgic editorial art or social media storytelling.
items.content: Create a richly detailed nostalgic Chinese retro poster collage in warm sepia, faded red, and aged paper tones, designed like a memory scrapbook spread on an old desk. The composition is vertical and packed with miniature diorama scenes embedded inside a large irregular paper cutout path, while a realistic adult hand at the upper right holds a black fountain pen with a gold nib, as if writing the memories into existence. At the top, large distressed Chinese headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="8090的记忆"}, with smaller handwritten-style subtitle text beneath it reading “那些简单、热闹、发亮的日子”. The paper surface should look cracked, yellowed, stained, and worn, with old magazine clippings, notebooks, marbles, ribbon, pencils, enamel mug, and children’s illustrated books scattered around the edges. Include exactly 8 numbered memory scenes arranged from top to bottom on the central paper path, each with a red circle number and Chinese handwritten annotations beside it: scene 1 is a boy crouching outdoors aiming a slingshot under a tree; scene 2 is two children running with a metal hoop and stick in an alley; scene 3 is two children crouching over small firecrackers on the ground with smoke and red paper debris; scene 4 is a tiny old-fashioned neighborhood shop counter labeled “供销社”, with one child buying snacks from the shopkeeper and shelves packed with goods; scene 5 is a bustling market fair with many adults, baskets, poultry, produce, and a bicycle vendor; scene 6 is an open-air village opera stage with red curtains, performers in colorful traditional costumes, and a seated audience; scene 7 is two children at a tree, one climbing or reaching into a nest while another watches below, with a green tin frog toy nearby; scene 8 is a man riding a motorcycle with a child passenger down an old street at sunset. Add surrounding retro printed items with visible vintage Chinese cover text, including a left-side old children’s book, a right-side magazine titled “儿童画报 1985 5”, a small blue booklet near the lower left, and a worn exercise notebook near the lower right. At the bottom, place a bold red banner with large cream-colored Chinese text reading {argument name="bottom quote" default="那时候日子不快，但快乐很满。"} and a second smaller line reading {argument name="sub quote" default="很多东西都旧了，可一想起来还是会发亮。"}. The entire image should feel tactile, cinematic, and emotionally warm, combining photorealistic objects with handcrafted poster design, dense storytelling details, tiny human figures, nostalgic 1980s–1990s Chinese childhood atmosphere, and soft golden lighting.

items.content: A dreamlike vertical Chinese ink-and-wash fantasy illustration of a woman's side-profile silhouette merged with a vast shanshui landscape, with the facial area obscured by a plain soft-edged rectangular block in {argument name="overlay color" default="warm taupe beige"}. Inside the silhouette, create a layered classical Chinese landscape with towering blue-green mountains, drifting fog, cascading waterfalls, 4 traditional pagodas nestled among cliffs, 1 arched stone bridge crossing a narrow river, 1 tiny boat with a lone figure beneath the bridge, and stylized pine trees scattered across the peaks. Place pink cherry blossom branches in 4 distinct clusters: one woven into the upper-left hair mass, one blooming near the bridge, one large cluster rising from the lower left, and one sparse flowering branch near the upper right. Use a warm sunrise glow from the upper right with a pale golden sun disk, luminous mist, parchment-textured negative space, and a refined palette of teal, indigo, ivory, blush pink, and soft gold. The composition should feel ethereal, poetic, elegant, and highly detailed, blending feminine portrait silhouette art with ancient Chinese landscape painting. Add vertical calligraphy on the lower right reading {argument name="calligraphy text" default="山水如梦"} with 2 red seal stamps beneath it. Ultra-detailed, painterly, airy atmosphere, delicate linework, watercolor and ink textures, cinematic depth, premium wall-art aesthetic.

items.title: Futuristic Mumbai Sunset Skyline
items.description: A cinematic sci-fi cityscape prompt for generating a futuristic Mumbai skyline at sunset with coastal bridge traffic, dense skyscrapers, and bold title text.
items.content: A cinematic ultra-detailed wide-angle cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} reimagined as a futuristic megacity at sunset, viewed from an elevated overlook above the coastline. The skyline is packed with dozens of towering futuristic skyscrapers of varied silhouettes, including 6 especially prominent supertall towers with sleek glass facades, sharp angular forms, and neon accents, mixed with dense mid-rise urban buildings below. On the right side, a long sea bridge resembling the Bandra-Worli Sea Link curves dramatically from the foreground into the distance over calm coastal water, with flowing streams of headlights and taillights. The sun sits low near the horizon over the Arabian Sea, casting glowing golden reflections across the water and bathing the scene in intense orange, amber, pink, and magenta light under richly layered clouds. In the lower left foreground, include a grand historic domed building inspired by South Mumbai heritage architecture, warmly illuminated, juxtaposed against the futuristic skyline; above it, add a hovering circular UFO-like platform with blue light. Also place 2 visible illuminated billboards in the lower-left and center-right urban area: one large sign reading "MUMBAI", "मुंबई", and "THE CITY OF DREAMS", and one smaller sign reading "NAVI MUMBAI". Add 1 small flying vehicle or drone near the central towers. Place large clean white uppercase text near the top center reading {argument name="top text" default="CHATGPT"}. The overall mood is epic, aspirational, glossy, highly detailed, vibrant, cinematic sci-fi urban fantasy, with atmospheric haze, glowing windows, reflective glass, dramatic contrast, and a polished concept-art finish.

items.title: Photorealistic Boeing 747 Cockpit
items.description: This prompt generates a highly realistic front-on airliner cockpit interior image suitable for aviation visualization, simulation art, or editorial-style aircraft imagery.
items.content: Ultra-realistic interior photograph of a {argument name="aircraft model" default="Boeing 747"} cockpit viewed from slightly behind and between the two pilot seats, centered and perfectly symmetrical, showing the full main instrument panel, center pedestal, dual control yokes, and the overhead switch panel across the top edge of the frame. The cockpit is unoccupied, with 2 pilot seats visible in the foreground, each with light gray or off-white sheepskin seat covers, and 2 control yokes each holding a dark rectangular checklist or electronic note board clipped to the center. The main panel is densely packed with authentic-looking avionics, analog dials, autopilot controls, radio panels, and 6 illuminated display screens total: 2 large central navigation displays, 2 smaller blue-toned flight displays near the left and right sides, and 2 green text/data screens on the lower center pedestal. Include 4 throttle levers in the center, plus additional flap and systems levers, rotary knobs, guarded switches, and weathered brown-gray metal surfaces typical of a widebody airliner cockpit. The overhead panel should be crowded with rows of switches, toggles, and indicator lights, partially shadowed but sharply detailed. Through the front cockpit windows, show an airport gate scene in soft focus with pale concrete tarmac, painted ground markings, and a passenger jet bridge connected or positioned near the aircraft. Lighting is natural daylight from outside, subdued inside the cockpit, with realistic shadows, mild reflections on glass screens, and documentary-style photographic color grading. Emphasize extreme detail, realism, authentic aviation engineering complexity, and a near indistinguishable-from-real photo quality. Shot with a full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, wide lens around 24–28mm, deep focus across the instrument panel, high dynamic range, no people, no dramatic stylization, no illustration look.

items.title: Rain-Soaked Formula Race Car Action
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic, ultra-realistic Formula 1-style racing photo in heavy rain, ideal for sports posters, editorial visuals, and dramatic motorsport content.
items.content: A dramatic ultra-realistic motorsport action photograph of a modern Formula 1 race car in {argument name="team livery" default="dark navy with red and yellow accents"} charging through heavy rain on a soaked circuit, shot from a very low trackside angle near the front-left corner of the car. The car dominates the foreground, with slick aerodynamic bodywork, exposed wet tires throwing up massive sprays of water, glowing red reflections on the wet asphalt, and sharp sponsor-style markings across the nose, front wing, sidepod, and rear wing. Capture the sensation of high speed with subtle motion blur in the background and water streaks, while keeping the car body mostly crisp and detailed. The scene takes place in a packed stadium-like racetrack with 1 main grandstand full of blurred spectators along the left side, 2 bright red illuminated signage boards in the distance, 1 safety fence running parallel to the track, and 1 reflective rain-soaked racing surface stretching toward the camera. Overhead, dense storm clouds fill the sky, creating a moody cinematic atmosphere with cold blue-gray tones contrasted by the car’s vivid warm colors. Emphasize dramatic spray, reflections, realism, tension, and the feeling of a championship race in brutal weather, as if captured on a professional sports telephoto-lens camera with shallow depth of field, high contrast, and editorial motorsport photography styling.

items.title: Cafe Phone Camera Food Snapshot
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic handheld smartphone photo-in-photo cafe scene with a woman offering a pastry and playful food stickers, ideal for social media lifestyle or AI image comparisons.
items.content: A photorealistic close-up of a hand holding a modern black smartphone vertically in a cozy sunlit cafe. The phone screen shows the live camera view in photo mode, with a young woman seated at a table and leaning forward, extending an orange plate toward the camera with both hands. On the plate is 1 seeded cream-filled pastry or bagel-like sandwich topped with mixed sesame and poppy seeds and a dusting of sugar. The woman has shoulder-length dark brown hair, small gold hoop earrings, a light-colored baseball cap with NYC lettering, and a faded mauve-pink ringer T-shirt with darker trim and partially visible vintage text. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block centered over it. The smartphone camera UI is clearly visible: 1 flash icon at top left, 1 target or focus icon at top right, and along the bottom 5 mode labels reading SLO-MO, VIDEO, PHOTO, PORTRAIT, and PANO, with PHOTO highlighted in yellow; include 1 large white shutter button, 1 small gallery thumbnail at bottom left, and 1 camera-switch icon at bottom right. Outside the phone, add playful floating food-themed stickers around the scene: 1 waffle at the upper left, 1 pink heart sticker reading YUMMY on the left, 1 yellow smiling face emoji on the left, 1 blue speech bubble at the upper right reading {argument name="sticker text" default="Yummy!"}, 1 small yellow smiley on the right, 2 white sparkle stars at the upper right, 1 silver fork at the lower right, and 1 cherry sticker at the lower right. The real cafe background outside the phone is softly blurred with warm wood tones, chairs, tables, large windows, and on the right side of the table 1 red apple and 1 plate of waffles with berries. Emphasize shallow depth of field, natural daylight, glossy phone reflections, realistic skin texture, and a trendy candid social-media food photo aesthetic.

items.title: Chengdu Hand-Drawn Food Map UI
items.description: This prompt generates a screenshot-like AI chat interface showcasing a whimsical illustrated Chengdu food map, useful for recreating social media demos of gpt-image-2 outputs.
items.content: A screenshot-style composition of an AI image generation chat interface on a light gray app background, centered inside a rounded white panel with a soft drop shadow. Near the top is a large pale mint-green chat bubble containing a long Chinese prompt in black sans-serif text, describing a hand-drawn food map of Chengdu. Beneath it, aligned slightly left of center, is a square illustrated map image with rounded corners. The map is a whimsical hand-painted tourist food map titled in large Chinese calligraphy at the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="成都! 吃货暴走地图"}. The subject is {argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"}, presented as a vintage hand-drawn local cuisine map with warm beige paper texture, watercolor ink outlines, and a playful artisanal travel-poster feel. The map shows simplified streets, landmarks, and district labels in Chinese, not geographically exact, but cute and decorative. Place exactly 12 featured food locations, each marked with a numbered red dot and a small Chinese label, each paired with a detailed illustrated dish. Include 12 dishes total: 1) a bowl of skewers in red chili broth, 2) a bowl of sweet water noodles, 3) rabbit head specialty, 4) guokui or stuffed baked flatbread, 5) hot pot, 6) maocai, 7) dan dan noodles, 8) hongyou chaoshou or chili oil wontons, 9) bobo chicken, 10) fuqi feipian, 11) a spicy stir-fried dish, 12) another classic Chengdu snack platter. Add a few Chengdu landmarks sketched in miniature around the roads, including a pagoda-like tower, traditional gate architecture, modern city buildings, and a central emblematic structure. Frame the entire map with a decorative border made of red chili peppers, green vines, and small leaves. Use a warm color palette dominated by chili red, mustard yellow, olive green, tea brown, and muted jade.
