items.title: Mechanical Keyboard Product Page Mockup
items.description: This generates a polished desktop e-commerce product page for a premium mechanical keyboard, suitable for product design showcases, storefront concepts, and UI mockups.
items.content: Create a clean modern e-commerce product detail page for a premium mechanical keyboard brand called {argument name="brand name" default="KeyForge"}, presented as a high-fidelity desktop website mockup on a white background with subtle light-gray dividers and generous spacing. The layout is a single unified storefront scene with a top navigation bar, a left product thumbnail rail, a large center product hero image, and a right-side purchase information panel. In the header, place the bold wordmark on the far left, then 7 navigation items reading “Keyboards”, “Switches”, “Keycaps”, “Accessories”, “Sale”, “Blog”, and “Support”, and on the far right 3 icons for search, account, and cart, with a small black notification badge showing “1” on the cart. The main product shown in the center is a compact 75% mechanical keyboard photographed from a slightly elevated front angle on a pale gray stage, with an aluminum case in silver, white and gray keycaps, several accent keys in lavender purple, and a silver volume knob at the top right. The left vertical gallery contains exactly 5 thumbnails: 1 selected front product shot, 1 angled keyboard view, 1 mechanical switch close-up, 1 keycap texture close-up, and 1 dark video thumbnail with a circular play icon. The right product panel includes a small pill badge reading “NEW”, a large bold product name {argument name="product name" default="KeyForge K75 Pro"}, a subtitle “75% Mechanical Keyboard”, a 5-star rating row with 4.8 and “(126 reviews)”, a large bold price {argument name="price" default="$129.99"} followed by a green “In Stock” status, and a short two-sentence description about premium performance, gasket-mounted design, QMK/VIA support, and RGB. Under that, include a “Switch Type” selector with exactly 4 pill buttons labeled “Cherry MX Red”, “Gateron Brown”, “Gateron Blue”, and “TTC Gold Pink”, with the first selected; a “Color” selector with exactly 3 pill buttons labeled “White / Purple”, “Black / Gray”, and “Navy / Blue”, with the first selected; a “Quantity” dropdown set to “1”; one large black primary button labeled “Add to Cart” with a cart icon; and one outlined secondary button labeled “Add to Wishlist” with a heart icon. Beneath the buttons, show exactly 3 horizontal service highlights with small icons: “Free Shipping” with subtext “On orders over $99”, “30-Day Returns” with subtext “Hassle-free returns”, and “2-Year Warranty” with subtext “Peace of mind”. In the lower content area, create a two-column section separated by light lines. On the left is a vertical tab list with exactly 5 items: “Overview” selected, then “Specifications”, “What’s in the Box”, “Shipping & Returns”, and “Reviews (126)”. To the right of the tabs, place a rounded white feature card grid with exactly 6 feature blocks in 2 rows of 3, each with a simple line icon, bold title, and short explanatory text: “75% Layout”, “Gasket-Mounted”, “QMK/VIA Support”, “Hot-Swappable”, “RGB Backlighting”, and “Premium Build”. On the far right of this lower area, add a specifications bullet list with exactly 7 bullets: “Layout: 75% (82 Keys)”, “Switch Type: Cherry MX Red”, “Mounting: Gasket-Mounted”, “Connectivity: USB-C (Wired)”, “Backlight: RGB, South-facing”, “Material: Aluminum Case”, and “Dimensions: 322 x 135 x 42 mm”, plus an additional final bullet “Weight: 1.25 kg”. Use a refined minimalist product-design aesthetic, realistic UI spacing, clean sans-serif typography similar to Inter or SF Pro, soft shadows, subtle rounded corners, monochrome icons, and polished startup-style consumer electronics presentation.

items.title: Fantasy Campfire Before a Crimson Mountain
items.description: A cinematic dark-fantasy image of 8 adventurers sheltering in a cave around a campfire while a glowing volcanic mountain looms outside, ideal for epic concept art or story illustration.
items.content: A cinematic fantasy scene inside a rocky cave during a blizzard, viewed from slightly above campfire level, with 8 characters seated in a circle around a small fire. Outside the cave mouth, a colossal dark mountain rises in the snowstorm, shaped like a sinister pyramid or volcanic fortress, split with glowing crimson-magenta fissures and crowned by a branching, ember-like red energy bloom at the summit; a ring of lava or fire glows at its base across the frozen landscape. The cave interior is warm, amber, and intimate, lit by the fire and a single ornate oil lamp on the right, contrasting with the cold blue-gray storm outside. The group should feel like a high-fantasy adventuring party resting together: 1 regal bird-like humanoid on the left with white feathers, a hooked beak, braided plumage, and layered tribal jewelry; 1 red-haired woman in the left foreground with long braided hair and ornate fantasy garments; 1 young elf-like traveler in blue sitting left of center; 1 small blond elf-like girl at center with pointed ears and clasped hands; 1 elderly king-like man on the right with long white hair, full beard, crown, and dark green robe with gold ornamentation; 1 elegant blond noblewoman beside him in embroidered formal dress; 1 white-haired figure in the foreground right seen mostly from behind in feathered or fur-trimmed clothing; and 1 blue-skinned aquatic-looking woman on the far right with a fin-like headdress, elaborate jewelry, and a cup in hand. Include cups, bowls, plates, bedrolls, sacks, and travel gear scattered around the cave edges. The composition should frame the terrifying glowing mountain through the cave opening behind the party, emphasizing the contrast between sheltered companionship and looming apocalyptic danger. Ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric and skin, dramatic volumetric firelight, snow streaks driven by wind, moody dark fantasy color grading, painterly realism, epic film still atmosphere, high contrast, rich shadows, masterpiece quality.

items.title: Cinematic Backlit Woman Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a moody, backlit fashion-style portrait of a woman with windblown hair, ideal for cinematic beauty editorials and atmospheric poster imagery.
items.content: A cinematic vertical portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up in a close half-body composition, positioned slightly right of center, with her body turned to the right and her head turned back toward the camera in a restrained over-the-shoulder pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"}, loose and slightly messy, being blown strongly through the frame so many strands lift outward and sweep across the air around her face and shoulders. Her visible styling is elegant and minimal: a dark thin-strap slip dress or camisole exposing the shoulder line, collarbone, and upper back, with a sheer black off-shoulder wrap or translucent outer layer slipping down the arms to create a soft dark framing shape around the lower body. The mood is cold, quiet, mysterious, and wistful, with a high-fashion cinematic realism rather than glamour polish. Use dramatic backlighting from the upper left, creating a bright halo along the hair, shoulder, and edge of the body, while the front of the figure stays mostly in shadow with only extremely soft fill light. The face is largely obscured in darkness and soft haze, emphasizing silhouette, neck, ear, shoulder, and luminous hair edges more than facial detail. items.title: Minimalist Fashion Moodboard Outfit
items.description: This prompt generates a clean editorial outfit collage with branded styling, useful for fashion inspiration boards, social posts, and digital wardrobe concepts.
items.content: A clean editorial fashion collage on a light gray-white background with a thin black rectangular border, styled like a minimalist magazine outfit board. Center the outfit as a flat lay style composition with 5 visible fashion items: a bright {argument name="jacket color" default="crimson red"} cropped zip-front jacket with a pointed collar and elastic hem placed slightly left and layered on top; underneath it, a fitted {argument name="top color" default="white"} long-sleeve crew-neck knit top visible at the shoulders and sleeves; below, a voluminous mid-calf A-line skirt in off-white with evenly spaced large black polka dots; at lower left, a structured small black handbag with short top handles and a subtle glossy crocodile texture; at lower right, one pair of black square-toe Mary Jane flats with wide straps and silver grommet-ring hardware. Add oversized very pale gray background typography reading {argument name="background brand text" default="MANGO"} stretched large across the middle behind the clothing. Place smaller black fashion-brand wordmarks around the layout: {argument name="top right logo" default="MANGO"} near the upper right of the outfit, "Stradivarius" near the handbag and again near the shoes, and "DOLCE & GABBANA" at the lower left near the skirt hem. The composition should feel balanced, chic, and contemporary, with soft studio lighting, no shadows or only faint soft shadows, crisp cutout edges, and a polished social-media fashion moodboard aesthetic.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Landscape
items.description: This prompt generates a classical Chinese ink painting with flawless poem calligraphy and a scholar in a dramatic shanshui landscape, ideal for cultural posters, scroll art, or literary-themed visuals.
items.content: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll style painting on warm off-white rice paper, vertically composed with large black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right-central area and a poetic landscape illustration in the lower left and bottom. The calligraphy must be crisp, fully legible, and written in expressive semi-cursive brush script, arranged in 6 vertical columns read right to left. The exact text of the 6 columns is: “金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”, “停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”, “欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”, “闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”, “行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”, “长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”. Add a smaller vertical signature inscription to the left of the main poem reading “李白行路难”, plus 1 small red square seal beneath the inscription. In the painted scene, show 1 ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing pale robes with a dark topknot and trailing ribbons, standing on the edge of a rugged cliff at lower left, gazing upward and outward in contemplation. Below and across the lower half, depict a turbulent river or sea with whitecaps and foam, misty ink-wash mountains receding in the distance, sparse grasses and dark brush vegetation near the cliff edge, and soft atmospheric fog. Use monochrome black and gray ink with very restrained muted blue-gray washes in the water and robe shadows. The mood is heroic, melancholic, and literary, evoking classical Chinese shanshui painting and museum-quality calligraphy, with empty negative space preserved around the text and landscape.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll
items.description: A vertical ink-wash artwork combining a famous Chinese poem in six calligraphy columns with a lone scholar on a cliff, ideal for classical art, cultural posters, or elegant wall-scroll imagery.
items.content: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll painting on warm aged rice paper, vertical composition, with six large vertical columns of bold black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right half of the image. The calligraphy should be highly legible expressive Chinese cursive-regular script with varied ink density and natural brush taper, reading from right to left in 6 columns: "金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱", "停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然", "欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山", "闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边", "行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在", "长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海". Add one smaller vertical inscription on the left side reading "李白行路难" with a small red seal stamp beneath it. In the lower left foreground, depict an ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing white and pale gray robes with a blue sash, long black hair in a traditional topknot with loose strands and ribbon, standing on the edge of a dark rocky cliff, body angled right and head lifted upward in a contemplative, heroic pose. Below and across the lower half, paint a turbulent river or sea with white crashing waves in monochrome ink and soft gray washes; in the distance, faint misty mountains and fog dissolve into the paper. Classical literati painting style, dynamic calligraphy as the main focus, poetic and majestic mood, restrained palette of black ink, gray wash, off-white paper, and a small touch of muted blue on the robe, ample negative space, museum-quality Chinese shanshui and calligraphy fusion.

items.title: Anime Wedding Poster at a Church
items.description: A dramatic anime-style wedding poster featuring a bride and groom before a flower-decorated church, ideal for recreating a romantic light-novel or anime promotional visual.
items.content: A vertical anime-inspired wedding key visual poster that blends live-action cosplay-style newlyweds in the foreground with illustrated anime girls surrounding them, set in front of a sunlit stone church under a brilliant deep blue sky. In the center foreground, a bride and groom pose for a dramatic selfie-like shot with their arms reaching toward the viewer. The groom is a youthful androgynous character with {argument name="hair color" default="light brown"} shaggy short hair, wearing a crisp white wedding suit, white shirt, and white tie, smiling and making a playful hand sign near his face. The bride has {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple-black"} hair in short twin tails and wears an ornate white wedding dress with layered lace, veil, pearl choker, long white gloves, and holds a bouquet of white roses. Behind them rises a beautiful European-style church with a tall steeple, floral garlands over the entrance, stained glass, and warm sunlight bursting from the left side, creating lens flare and sparkling highlights. The sky is filled with fluffy white clouds, flying white birds, a faint rainbow streak, and drifting pink flower petals. Around the edges are 6 anime schoolgirl portraits in dark school uniforms with red or yellow ribbon bows, each showing a different emotional expression: top left brown-haired girl reaching forward, upper left purple-haired girl with an eyepatch looking flustered, lower left pink-haired cheerful girl, top right brown-haired girl extending a gloved hand, mid-right dark-haired boy in school uniform, lower right brown-haired shy girl, and bottom right small blonde girl with an excited open-mouth expression. Add ornate decorative corner filigree framing the poster. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="さあ、契約の時間だ— 私たちの永遠を誓おう"}. Place a large colorful Japanese title across the bottom center reading {argument name="title text" default="中二病でも恋がしたい！"} in bold blue and pink outlined typography, with a small romanized subtitle beneath it reading "Chu-2 byo demo KOI ga shitai!" and small credits near the bottom reading {argument name="credit text" default="富樫勇太　小鳥遊六花"}. Overall look: dazzling, romantic, sentimental, nostalgic anime movie poster, ultra-detailed, glossy lighting, magical sparkle effects, vivid colors, polished promotional composition.

items.title: Anime Martial Arts Duel in Dojo
items.description: This prompt generates a high-energy anime battle scene between two female martial artists in a wooden dojo, ideal for action poster art or dramatic character showcase imagery.
items.content: A dramatic anime action illustration inside an old wooden martial arts hall, showing two young women in mid-battle with explosive motion and elemental energy trails. In the foreground, a fierce female martial artist lunges low toward the viewer in a powerful punching stance, her right fist extended straight ahead and her body twisted dynamically. She has dark black hair tied into a messy high bun with loose strands and red ribbons, sharp intense eyes, and a focused combative expression. She wears a white traditional Chinese martial arts top with red trim, red tassel frog closures, and subtle embroidered patterns, paired with flowing deep red pants and black cloth shoes with red accents. Red ribbon-like energy and glowing scarlet brushstroke arcs coil around her arms, torso, and legs, sweeping across the frame like fiery calligraphy. In the upper right, a second young woman leaps through the air in a defensive or spellcasting pose, one hand stretched outward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light purple"} hair styled in two buns with trailing strands and ornate gold hair ornaments. She wears a dark green Chinese-style dress with gold embroidery, black stockings, and dark shoes. Bright blue water-like energy spirals around her in a large circular arc, splashing and glittering with luminous droplets. Set the scene in a weathered dojo or wuguan interior with tall wooden beams, hanging lanterns, broken floorboards, flying splinters, dust, sparks, and debris exploding from the impact of the fight. Include one large wooden signboard above them with the black calligraphy text 武术会, plus two vertical hanging banners, the left reading 以武会友 and the right reading 刚柔并济. Use a low-angle cinematic perspective, strong foreshortening, extreme motion, dense particles, and dramatic warm-vs-cool color contrast between the red and blue energy. Highly detailed anime painting, ultra-dynamic composition, sharp linework, rich textures, glowing effects, volumetric lighting, and epic battle key visual quality.

items.title: Moonlit Anime Horror Cosplay Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical anime-horror promotional poster with a moonlit couple, two shadowy background figures, and a dark supernatural romance atmosphere.
items.content: A dark, cinematic anime-horror key visual in a vertical poster composition, set at night inside or beside a shattered window with a huge glowing full moon dominating the background. In the center foreground, a young couple stands in an intimate embrace. The male figure is tall and slim, wearing a dark brown or charcoal hoodie with the hood up, white drawstrings, subtle red blood-like stains on the sleeve and lower hem, and dark red pants. His skin is pale, his long black hair falls over one eye, and the lower half of his face is wrapped in dirty white bandages stained with blood, giving him a disturbing but protective antihero presence. One hand and wrist are also wrapped in bandages. He looks slightly upward and away with a solemn, haunted expression while holding the girl around her back. The female figure is petite with extremely long straight platinum-blonde hair reaching past her waist, wearing a loose white coat or cardigan over a black-and-white outfit and a black choker. She faces him closely with both hands clasped together against his chest, creating a tender contrast against the horror atmosphere. Add 2 ghostly supporting figures in the background: on the left, a pale blonde girl in shadow wearing striped clothing and holding an object close to her chest; on the right, a hooded male figure in profile with glasses or sharp facial lines, his hood marked by a dark blood stain. The environment is filled with floating shards of broken glass, blue moonlight, dust motes, and star-like particles, with deep navy, black, and icy blue tones throughout. Place a stylized red Japanese title at the top right, {argument name="headline text" default="殺戮の天使"}, with a smaller red serif English subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Memory Collection"}. Make the overall style a polished live-action cosplay poster blended with anime horror cover art, highly detailed, dramatic rim lighting, glossy fabric textures, supernatural atmosphere, tragic romance mood, and a premium game or visual novel promotional aesthetic.

items.title: Xuanwu Gate Incident Moments Post
items.description: This prompt generates a satirical image of the Xuanwu Gate Incident presented as a Chinese social-media Moments post alongside a cinematic Tang-dynasty battle scene.
items.content: A humorous, highly detailed composite image showing a modern smartphone displaying a Chinese social-media Moments post about the Xuanwu Gate Incident, placed on the left side of the frame, with the posted battle image expanded into a large cinematic historical scene filling the right side. The phone should look like a black iPhone with thin bezels and a top notch, shown front-facing. On the phone screen, the app header bar is dark gray-black and reads “朋友圈” in white, with a back arrow on the left and a camera icon on the right. Below it is a social post from {argument name="poster name" default="唐王世民"}, with a small square profile avatar of an ancient Chinese warrior in armor and helmet. Under the name is a location pin and the text “长安·玄武门”, and a timestamp line “唐武德九年六月初四 巳时”. The main post text in Chinese says: “吾为国家除逆贼，请社稷。今日玄武门，功在千秋！⚔️💪”. Beneath the text is a square battle image preview matching the large scene on the right. Below the image is a metadata row showing exactly three items: “3.8万次浏览”, “赞 (666)”, and “(128)” beside a comment icon. Under that is a comments box with exactly 5 visible commenters, each with a tiny avatar and Chinese text styled like supportive social-media replies from historical figures. The comments should include these names in Chinese: “尉迟恭”, “房玄龄”, “李渊”, “杜如晦”, and “长孙无忌”, with the tone praising the success of the action; one comment line should suggest the emperor is shocked and the state is secured. The right side is a dramatic Tang-dynasty battle painting at sunset outside {argument name="gate name" default="玄武门"}, with a massive gray stone gate tower and the gate plaque reading “玄武门”. In the center foreground, a mounted armored archer in red-plumed helmet draws a bow while riding a brown horse; around him are exactly 7 clearly visible mounted or standing soldiers in Tang armor, plus 1 fallen armored figure on the ground pointing upward. Multiple yellow battle flags with the large black character “唐” wave through the dust; show at least 4 visible flags. Arrows fly through the sky, horses rear and turn, and the air is filled with dust, warm sunset light, and battlefield motion. The visual style is realistic historical epic key art with painterly detail, but the overall concept is comedic and anachronistic because it presents an ancient coup as a social-media朋友圈 post. Keep all visible interface text in Chinese, maintain believable mobile UI spacing, and blend the phone mockup with the expanded battle artwork in one widescreen composition.

items.title: Four-Panel Romantic Comedy Manga Page
items.description: This prompt generates a monochrome four-panel manga page with Japanese dialogue, ideal for creating dramatic romantic-comedy debate scenes with expressive character acting.

author.name: 小猫遊りょう（たかにゃし・りょう）

items.content: Create a black-and-white manga page with 4 stacked horizontal panels, clean black gutters, screentone shading, dramatic speed lines, and polished seinen-style linework. The page features two youthful anime characters with modern casual clothing and short dark hair, with the face area of both characters obscured by a soft square blur censor block. Panel 1: a slim young person with messy short dark hair and a collared shirt clenches one fist near their chest, body angled left, surrounded by an intense fiery aura effect in the background, looking emotional and defensive. On the right side, place a large jagged vertical speech balloon containing this Japanese text: 「何十時間も魂を削って描いた一枚と、プロンプト打ち込んで数秒で出した画像が同じ価値なわけないでしょ！ふざけないで！」. Panel 2: a second young person with slightly taller build, short dark hair, a dark zip jacket over a light shirt, raises one index finger calmly as if explaining a point. Add a rounded rectangular speech box on the right with this Japanese text: 「投下した労働時間で価値が決まるという典型的な“労働価値説の誤謬”だ。市場における価値は、出力された結果を受け手がどう評価するかで決まる」. Panel 3: the taller character gently pats the shorter character on the head; include a small hand-pat sound effect near the hand reading 「ポン」. The shorter character looks up in surprise. On the right side, add a large oval vertical speech balloon with this Japanese text: 「でも俺の市場価値基準はすごくシンプルだよ。君が俺のために照れてくれるこの数秒間に、何十時間分の価値も感じてるから」. Panel 4: close-up of the shorter character blushing intensely with spiral eyes, sweat drops, trembling expression, open mouth, and dense hatching on the cheeks, overwhelmed with embarrassment. Fill the background with dramatic radiating speed lines. Add a large jagged vertical speech balloon on the right with this Japanese text: 「だ、誰がアンタのために照れるか…っ！自意識過剰よ！」. Add two sound effects: a small 「プル…」 near the shoulder and a larger shaky handwritten 「カァァァ」 along the lower left side. Keep the whole page monochrome, highly expressive, romantic-comedy manga tone, with strong emotional contrast between heated argument, cool explanation, teasing affection, and flustered payoff.

items.title: Japanese Fantasy Winged Pig Film Poster
items.description: A text prompt for generating a richly detailed Japanese animated movie poster featuring a winged pig-like protagonist in a bittersweet urban fantasy montage.
items.content: A dramatic Japanese fantasy movie poster in a painterly, ultra-detailed cinematic illustration style. The poster is vertically composed like a theatrical key visual, with a warm gold title at the bottom and multiple emotional vignettes layered into one unified scene. The central character is a small fluffy pig-like creature with soft pale cream fur, oversized pink inner ears, a tiny snout, a curled tail, and large feathered angel wings glowing with golden light. It stands upright on a rooftop or elevated wooden platform overlooking a vast Tokyo cityscape at sunset, holding a whiskey glass in one hoof with the other hoof on its hip, posed like a weary but resilient middle-aged salaryman. In the distance are the Tokyo skyline, water, bridges, floating lanterns, and Tokyo Tower glowing orange-red under a radiant sky filled with clouds lit in gold, peach, violet, and deep blue. Around the center are 4 supporting vignette scenes: 1) top left, the winged pig sits alone at a narrow bar counter in a nostalgic lantern-lit Japanese alley at night, looking exhausted and melancholy, with a bottle and a glass nearby; 2) top center, the winged pig sits drinking with 2 human adults in an izakaya-like nightlife setting, warm lights surrounding them; 3) upper right, the winged pig walks away down railway tracks toward a brilliant ocean sunset, carrying a small suitcase, seen from behind; 4) left middle, the winged pig walks alone through a rain-slick neon-lit city street at night, seen from behind, surrounded by glowing signs and reflections. The whole image should feel bittersweet, magical, lonely, and hopeful, like a prestige animated film poster about adulthood, solitude, and emotional survival. Use lush lighting, dense environmental detail, sparkling reflections, glowing lanterns, cinematic atmosphere, and rich blue-orange color contrast. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the art: at the very top, the tagline "ひとりで生きてきた。だけど、ひとりじゃ涙は止まらない。"; above the title, the line "独身オヤジ、最後の青春。"; a very large main title at the bottom center reading "翼のオヤジ" in bold brushed calligraphic characters; below it, the tagline "笑って、泣けて、明日また頑張れる。この冬、いちばんやさしい奇跡。"; on the bottom right, a circular badge reading "秋公開" and "今"; add small fine-print credits across the lower edge in the style of a Japanese film poster. Include 2 visible vertical lantern/shop signs in the street scenes reading "居酒屋" and 1 bottle label reading "黒豚". High detail, emotional fantasy poster, premium animated-film aesthetic, Japanese urban nostalgia mixed with magical realism.

author.name: NIJI🌈 画像生成AIを学ぶ人

items.content: A breathtaking anime movie poster at golden-hour sunset, vertical theatrical one-sheet composition, painted in the polished cinematic style of a Makoto Shinkai-inspired youth drama. The scene overlooks a Japanese coastal hillside town descending toward a glowing bay, with the sun low on the horizon and its reflection stretching across calm water. The sky dominates most of the image: a vast deep-blue to lavender twilight gradient filled with countless stars, wispy pink and peach clouds, and one especially bright star near the upper right. In the foreground on the right, a teenage schoolgirl stands in three-quarter side profile facing left toward the sea, shown from mid-thigh up, with shoulder-length dark hair blowing in the breeze, a short-sleeved white sailor-style school blouse, a red ribbon at the collar, and a navy pleated skirt; her expression is contemplative and wistful. Farther down the steep stone stair street in the center-left, a teenage schoolboy stands with his back to the viewer, wearing a short-sleeved white shirt and dark trousers, also looking toward the sunset and ocean. At the lower right, include 1 black cat sitting on a wall or rooftop edge in silhouette, looking toward the town. At the lower left, include 1 old-fashioned streetlamp and a dense cluster of blooming hydrangeas in blue and violet along a stone wall. The town below is packed with tiled rooftops, narrow streets, warm window lights, and layered houses, with distant mountains framing the bay. Use dramatic rim light, luminous atmospheric perspective, sparkling highlights, delicate cloud detail, and emotional, nostalgic color grading in indigo, ultramarine, pink, peach, and gold. Design it explicitly as a Japanese animated film poster with elegant typography integrated into the artwork: large hand-brushed Japanese title text across the upper-left to center reading {argument name="title text" default="星をつなぐ約束のうた"}, smaller English subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="English subtitle" default="The Song of Promises"}, a small award-laurel line in Japanese at the top left, 1 vertical Japanese tagline along the upper-right edge, 4 cast names in Japanese centered near the bottom, a release date at the lower left reading {argument name="release date" default="8.23"} with "ROADSHOW" below, 1 pink Japanese tagline across the lower center, and a website/social handle at the lower right. Ultra-detailed anime key visual, romantic and melancholic, premium feature-film poster finish.

items.content: A soft anime-style bust portrait of a cute young woman centered on a plain warm off-white background, drawn with clean delicate line art and flat pastel coloring. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="pale sky blue"} hair with wispy strands, full bangs parted slightly near the center, and large matching blue eyes with glossy highlights. Her expression is shy and puzzled, with slightly raised inner eyebrows, faint pink blush on her cheeks, and a small open mouth. She is looking directly at the viewer while lightly touching her lower lip with one index finger in a thoughtful, hesitant pose. She wears an oversized loose {argument name="top color" default="light blue"} sweatshirt with long sleeves that partly cover her hand. Frame the image from the chest up, with the head slightly tilted, giving a gentle, innocent, dreamy feeling. Use a minimalist composition, no accessories, no extra objects, no scenery, and no text. Emphasize a monochrome blue palette, airy simplicity, subtle sketch-like outlines, and a clean Japanese illustration aesthetic suitable for a soft personal avatar.

items.title: Censored Office Manga Confrontation
items.description: A gritty monochrome manga page showing a heated office argument that shifts into a kabedon scene, useful for recreating dramatic viral manga-style screenshots.

author.name: 小猫遊りょう（たかにゃし・りょう）

items.content: A dramatic black-and-white manga page in a seinen style, rendered with dense screentones, sharp ink lines, high contrast lighting, and expressive Japanese comic layout. The page has 4 stacked panels with vertical Japanese speech bubbles and bold sound effects, showing a tense confrontation between two office workers in a modern workspace. In the top panel, a young woman with a short messy bob haircut, slim but curvy build, wearing a fitted button-up blouse with rolled sleeves and a dark pencil skirt, slams one hand hard onto a desk in anger, leaning forward toward the viewer with explosive impact lines and a large jagged speech bubble. In the second panel, a young man with dark tousled hair, slim build, wearing a black leather jacket over a light shirt and a necklace, is shown from the chest up in a calm, confident pose, touching his face while speaking. In the third panel, the man pins the woman against a wall in a close, intimate kabedon pose, one arm braced beside her head; she looks flustered and tense while he speaks near her face, creating a sudden romantic-comedic shift in mood. In the bottom panel, an overhead view reveals the office setting: 2 characters standing near a desk with 1 computer monitor, 1 keyboard, 1 mouse, 1 office chair, and scattered papers on a tiled floor; the woman is curled inward shyly and trembling while the man stands relaxed beside her. Include exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 visible speech bubbles total, and visible Japanese manga typography throughout. Add a rectangular mosaic censor blur over each character's face in every panel, as if anonymized for sharing online. Background details should include office walls, desk edges, speed lines, burst effects, and tonal gradients. The overall feeling is intense argument turning into manipulative flirtation, like a viral out-of-context manga screenshot.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Scroll on Aged Paper
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic classical Chinese ink calligraphy scroll with authentic paper texture and seals, ideal for historical art imagery or typography demonstrations.
items.content:
A high-resolution museum-style photograph of a traditional Chinese calligraphy handscroll on aged beige xuan paper, shown flat and filling the frame with no mounting border visible. The composition is a single elegant work of running-script brush calligraphy in deep black ink, arranged in 11 vertical columns read right to left. The main text is the poem title and verse of {argument name="poem text" default="定風波
莫聽穿林打葉聲

items.title: ChatGPT App Showing WeChat Moments Screenshot
items.description: A realistic Chinese ChatGPT mobile app screenshot displaying a generated WeChat Moments mockup, suitable for social media UI demonstrations and AI image generation showcases.
items.content: A realistic dark-mode smartphone screenshot of the ChatGPT mobile app in Chinese, shown full screen on a black background with an iPhone-style status bar. The top status bar shows the time 20:57 on the left, small cellular signal, Wi‑Fi, and battery icons on the right, with the battery reading 61. Below it is the ChatGPT conversation header with a left menu icon, the title ChatGPT, a pencil/edit icon, and a three-dot menu icon. In the chat area, show 1 user message bubble in Chinese reading “生成一张微信朋友圈截图，随机生成用户名和分享内容”, displayed as a rounded dark gray bubble aligned to the right. Beneath it, show an assistant response area with the Chinese text “图片已创建”. Under that, display 1 generated image preview: a tall rounded-rectangle screenshot mockup of a WeChat Moments page on a white phone screen. Inside the generated image, include a top bar with the time 20:42 and the title “朋友圈”. Show 2 separate Moments posts. The first post has a female profile photo and the username “星星都不醒”, followed by a short Chinese caption about life and weekends, then a 3x3 collage containing exactly 9 square images: sunset over water, flowers, plated food, a tree-lined road, a white fluffy dog, a warm glowing lamp, green fruit or dessert, pink clouds or sky, and a silhouette shadow photo. Below it, include a timestamp line “2小时前”, a likes row with exactly 3 usernames, and a comments block with exactly 3 short Chinese comments. The second post has a male profile photo and the username “山川与海”, followed by a short fitness-themed Chinese caption with a green check emoji and flexed biceps emoji, then exactly 1 gym mirror selfie image, and a timestamp line “3小时前” with a likes row beneath. Outside the generated image preview but still within the ChatGPT app screenshot, show a horizontal row of 4 action icons below the image: thumbs up, thumbs down, share/export, and more. At the bottom of the screen, include the ChatGPT input bar in dark mode with a circular plus button on the left, placeholder text “询问 ChatGPT”, a microphone icon, and a round voice button on the right. Use authentic mobile UI proportions, crisp typography, realistic Chinese app interface details, and photorealistic screenshot rendering so it looks like a genuine capture of the ChatGPT app displaying an AI-generated WeChat Moments screenshot.

items.title: Minecraft Ender Dragon Fantasy Poster
items.description: A cinematic Minecraft-inspired dark fantasy poster showing a lone hero confronting a colossal Ender Dragon, ideal for game cover art, event key visuals, or epic promotional posters.
items.content: Create a dramatic vertical dark-fantasy poster in a Minecraft-inspired voxel style, like an epic movie or game cover. At the very top, place a large ornate metallic-gold blackletter title reading {argument name="headline text" default="[Heliocore.C6]"}, with a smaller elegant serif subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle" default="The Final Convergence"}. The main scene shows 1 massive Ender Dragon made of black cubic blocks, flying forward and downward out of the sky with its wings spread wide, mouth open, glowing purple eyes, and violet energy in its throat, while chunks of voxel debris break apart around its body. items.title: Flashy Japanese AI Thumbnail
items.description: This prompt generates a high-impact anime-style Japanese YouTube thumbnail for AI or tech explainers with oversized text, fiery effects, and a pointing character.
items.content: Create a hyper-saturated Japanese YouTube thumbnail in a flashy clickbait anime style, 16:9 landscape, with a split composition: huge stacked text blocks dominating the left two-thirds and an anime character on the right one-third. The background is a fiery explosion of red, orange, and gold energy with glowing sparks, lens flares, glittering star highlights, and a high-contrast metallic shine effect everywhere. On the left, place 4 bold text groups stacked vertically with thick black outlines, white inner strokes, intense outer glow, and glossy 3D treatment. Top line: giant Japanese headline text {argument name="headline text" default="紅エンジニア必見"} in vivid red with white edging and bright gold spark accents. Second line: a rounded square orange app-like icon with a white stylized "M" to the left of the word {argument name="product name" default="masatra"} in enormous lowercase white sans-serif letters with black outline and subtle gray shading. Third line: a black rectangular banner with compact bold white Japanese text reading "次世代AIエージェントフレームワーク". Bottom line: very large gold metallic Japanese text {argument name="bottom text" default="徹底解説"} with beveled 3D embossing, orange-to-gold gradient, bright specular highlights, and glowing edges. On the right, show 1 anime-style young adult woman from chest up, with {argument name="hair color" default="brown"} medium-length hair, wearing a white open lab coat over a white shirt, leaning toward the camera and pointing directly at the viewer with a foreshortened hand and extended index finger in the foreground. Her pose should feel confident, urgent, and attention-grabbing. Use dramatic rim lighting from the fiery background, strong orange highlights on skin and clothing, and a polished commercial thumbnail finish. Reserve a large rectangular area over the upper-right face region as a flat placeholder block in {argument name="placeholder color" default="light brown"}, obscuring most of the face. Make the overall design extremely dense, glossy, explosive, and optimized for maximum readability at small size.

items.title: Japanese AI Creator Studio Banner
items.description: A polished Japanese promotional hero banner for an AI creator membership community, suitable for website headers, social posts, and announcement thumbnails.

author.name: やきいも｜週1クリエイトで飯を食う

items.content: Create a polished Japanese promotional website hero banner for an AI creator community, in a clean modern tech-advertising style with a soft pastel blue, lavender, pink, and white palette. Wide 16:9 composition. On the left, place a gradient triangular abstract logo and the Japanese brand name {argument name="brand name" default="AIクリエイターズ・スタジオ"} at the top, followed by a thin horizontal divider line with a small sparkle in the middle. Below that, a very large bold Japanese headline in 2 lines: first line in dark navy, 「AIで、もっと自由に」, second line in large gradient letters from cyan to purple to pink, 「創る・学ぶ・つながる」. Under the headline, add a short Japanese subheadline with sparkle marks, 「AIを使ったクリエイティブの可能性を広げるメンバーシップコミュニティ」. On the right half, create a collage of 6 rounded-rectangle visual cards showing AI-generated creative examples: 1 large dreamy portrait of a woman in profile surrounded by flowers and butterflies in ethereal purple light, 1 small cyberpunk city nightscape with a lone figure, 1 small close-up portrait of a fluffy cat, 1 small luxury cosmetic bottle labeled “AI STUDIO”, 1 small bright seascape or flower-field landscape with a woman in white, and 1 large tablet drawing device on a desk with a stylus, plus a coffee mug and plant nearby. Add a circular gradient badge overlapping the right side with bold white Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="一緒に創造の未来をつくろう！"}. Across the lower middle, place a translucent white rounded feature panel containing exactly 5 equal columns with thin separators and pastel line icons. Each column has an icon, a bold Japanese title, and a smaller 2-line description. The 5 titles are: 「限定コンテンツ」, 「実践プロンプト＆テンプレート」, 「メンバー限定コミュニティ」, 「最新情報をいち早くお届け」, 「メンバー限定特典」. Use fitting icons for book, monitor, chat bubble, light bulb, and gift. Add concise Japanese descriptions beneath each title. At the very bottom, add a dark navy footer strip with a large Japanese call-to-action sentence in white and pink-purple gradient accent text, {argument name="footer text" default="AIを味方に、あなたの『創りたい』をカタチに。さあ、一緒に創ろう！"}. Overall look: premium startup landing page, glossy soft lighting, subtle sparkles, glassmorphism panels, clean typography, Japanese text rendered accurately, highly legible, visually balanced, professional social media thumbnail quality.

items.title: Polaroid of Japanese Class Graduation Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic realistic instant-film photograph of a Japanese high school class group portrait, ideal for school memory, graduation, or retro snapshot visuals.

author.name: やきいも｜週1クリエイトで飯を食う

items.content: A realistic instant film Polaroid photo lying flat on a light wooden tabletop, photographed from directly above. The instant print has a thick white border with a wider bottom margin and slight natural wear, with the photo area showing an indoor Japanese high school classroom group portrait. Inside the photo, about 35 graduating students in dark school uniforms are gathered in 4 loose rows in front of a green chalkboard, posing casually and tightly packed together. Most are teenage boys in black gakuran-style jackets or dark blazers with white shirts and ties, and several teenage girls wear dark blazers with blue plaid skirts. One girl near the front left stands out in a white cardigan and blue plaid skirt. Many students hold up peace signs, some crouch in front, and a few sit or recline on the wooden floor in the front row. Faces are intentionally obscured with soft square mosaic blurs, but the overall feeling is candid, nostalgic, and celebratory. On the chalkboard, hand-drawn Japanese graduation messages in chalk include large central text reading "3年B組" and celebratory doodles and writing around it such as graduation-themed congratulations. The classroom has white walls, a round wall clock above the chalkboard, a fluorescent ceiling light fixture, and subdued indoor lighting. The image should feel like a slightly dim early-2000s or 2010s snapshot with mild grain, soft focus, authentic flash photography, and natural color fading, emphasizing a sentimental end-of-school memory preserved as a physical instant print.

items.title: Explosive Japanese X Monetization Thumbnail
items.description: This prompt generates a high-energy anime-style Japanese marketing thumbnail for social media or YouTube promotions about fast X monetization and bonus offers.

author.name: みどるっち｜AIで人生アップデート

items.content: Create a flashy Japanese YouTube thumbnail in a high-impact anime marketing style, 16:9 landscape, packed with neon green energy effects, gold sparkles, speed lines, lens flares, and thick black drop shadows. The composition is split with bold promotional text dominating the left and center, and a cute chibi anime boy on the right pointing directly at the viewer with an enthusiastic smile. He has tousled dark brown hair with vivid {argument name="accent hair color" default="neon green"} streaks, large bright green eyes, soft blush on his cheeks, and wears a black hoodie layered with a green-trimmed jacket over an orange inner shirt. Use glossy cel-shaded rendering, crisp outlines, high contrast, and exaggerated depth for a clickable social-media-thumbnail look. At the very top, place a curved red ribbon banner with gold trim and a gift box icon on the left; inside the banner put the Japanese headline text {argument name="top banner text" default="無料10大特典プレゼント"} in bold white and yellow lettering. In the main center-left area, place huge Japanese text with dramatic 3D styling and metallic gradients: a giant gold "10", a white "日で", a massive neon green "X", then silver-white "収益化", and gold-orange "達成", reading exactly {argument name="main headline" default="10日でX収益化達成"}. Surround this headline with upward green arrows, starburst glints, and explosive light effects. Add 4 floating platform-style icons around the headline area: 1 pink social-like icon with a white heart, 1 blue speech-bubble icon with a white user silhouette, 1 tilted black smartphone displaying a white X logo, and 1 stack of gold coins with a yen symbol coin in front. Along the bottom, place 3 glowing green feature boxes aligned horizontally, each with a distinct icon and Japanese copy: box 1 has a beginner mark icon and text {argument name="feature text 1" default="X初心者でも簡単収益化"}, box 2 has a clock icon and text "1日1時間の作業でOK", box 3 has a calendar icon and text "最短10日で収益化条件達成". At the bottom right, add a large glossy red rounded call-to-action button with a white border glow, white Japanese text {argument name="button text" default="今すぐ受け取る"}, a white play triangle on the right side of the button, and a clicking hand cursor near the lower-right edge. The entire image should feel explosive, urgent, and optimized for high click-through rate, using saturated greens, reds, golds, black shadows, and metallic highlights.

items.description: A bold anime-style Japanese promotional thumbnail for launch announcements, online course ads, or AI business marketing visuals.

author.name: みどるっち｜AIで人生アップデート

items.content: Create a flashy Japanese YouTube thumbnail in a high-impact anime promotional style with explosive lighting, dense spark effects, and dramatic contrast. The composition is a single unified scene with a dark black-and-neon-green background, gold glitter bursts, and a subtle city skyline silhouette along the bottom edge. On the right side, show a cute chibi anime boy from the waist up with messy dark brown to black hair accented by vivid neon green streaks and a small red accent near one side, huge bright green eyes, an open excited smile, and an energetic pose pointing directly toward the viewer with one hand while the other fist is raised. He wears a black hoodie layered under a green jacket with glossy highlights. On the left side, place 1 glowing green hourglass with swirling green energy inside. Fill the image with intense starbursts, lens flares, golden particles, and speed-line energy for a viral thumbnail look. Add 5 bold Japanese text elements in oversized display typography: a red ribbon banner across the upper left reading {argument name="top banner text" default="4月28日スタート"} in thick yellow letters with white edging; the main central headline in massive metallic gold kanji reading {argument name="main headline" default="ついに解禁"} with heavy black shadow and bright gold texture; a large white-and-green subheadline across the lower left reading {argument name="subheadline" default="AI副業で人生変わる"}; 1 green rounded badge near the lower center-right reading {argument name="bonus badge text" default="無料10大特典"} in bold white and yellow text; and 1 black slanted banner in the lower right reading {argument name="corner banner text" default="近日公開"} with smaller white English text beneath it saying COMING SOON. Make everything feel urgent, celebratory, and attention-grabbing, like a high-CTR launch announcement thumbnail, with thick outlines, glowing edges, metallic text, and layered depth.

items.content: A realistic smartphone screenshot of the ChatGPT mobile app in Japanese on an Android device, shown full screen in portrait orientation with a clean light theme. items.title: Cute Four-Panel Cat Jealousy Comic
items.description: This prompt generates a warm, hand-drawn four-panel cat comic ideal for social posts, manga-style humor, or cozy pet illustrations.
items.content: A cute hand-drawn four-panel comic in a soft, warm, slice-of-life style on a light cream background with thick black panel borders and slightly textured paper grain. Use simple rounded cartoon cat anatomy, expressive faces, clean black outlines, muted natural colors, and a gentle manga-like presentation. In the top-left panel, show 2 cats: a brown tabby cat with dark stripes and white muzzle sitting with eyes closed, looking pleased, while a mostly white cat with dark brown patches on the head stands beside it and affectionately licks the tabby's cheek; add 2 small black musical notes above them to suggest happy grooming. In the top-right panel, show the white-and-brown patched cat in the foreground looking toward a small calico kitten standing to the right; include a speech bubble containing the Japanese text "めい" above the kitten. In the bottom-left panel, show 3 cats together: the brown tabby on the left with a surprised or blank expression, the white patched cat on the right looking cheerful, and the small calico kitten centered in front between them, looking up. In the bottom-right panel, show a close-up of the brown tabby cat alone, facing forward with narrowed yellow-green eyes and an angry, jealous expression; add 2 short emphasis lines near the face and 1 small puff-shaped anger symbol to the right. Keep the tone cozy and comedic, with the visual joke that the tabby was happy being groomed until the new kitten appears. Use flat colors, minimal shading, and a charming Japanese webcomic feel.

items.title: Chibi Shark Adventure Movie Poster
items.description: A colorful Japanese-style anime poster for a children’s ocean adventure film, ideal for recreating bold promotional key art with cute characters and dramatic title typography.
items.content: A bright, hyper-energetic Japanese movie poster illustration in a polished anime chibi style, set in a sparkling tropical ocean adventure scene. Center the composition on 2 cute chibi children riding a smiling blue shark that leaps diagonally upward through swirling seawater and white splash effects. The left child is a boy with short black hair, huge glossy blue eyes, a happy open-mouth smile, a black T-shirt, dark shorts, white sneakers, and a light blue shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood framing his face; he points upward with one hand and hugs the shark with the other. The right child is a girl with orange hair, large glossy purple eyes, a joyful open-mouth smile, an orange dress, pink shoes, and a pink shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood; she throws one arm wide in excitement while holding on with the other. Make the shark large and friendly with a rounded body, pale belly, tiny black eyes, and a wide open mouth. Surround them with a vivid underwater-and-surface world: schools of small tropical fish, exactly 1 sea turtle on the left, exactly 1 dolphin on the right, exactly 1 pink octopus on the right, exactly 1 pufferfish on the lower left, coral reefs and sea plants along the bottom edges, air bubbles throughout, and strong blue water motion lines. In the upper background, show a sunny sky with dramatic sun rays streaming into the water, fluffy clouds, 2 seagulls flying, a rocky tropical island with palm trees on the upper left, and a pirate ship on the upper right with white sails and a cute shark emblem. Add a ship wheel partly visible behind the main title. Use a dense, exciting Japanese kids-anime promotional layout with oversized 3D lettering and explosive effects. At the top, place the giant Japanese title text {argument name="headline text" default="サメなの ワクワク 大作戦"} in stacked lines, with glossy blue, orange-pink, and yellow-orange gradient letters, thick white outlines, dark blue shadows, water splashes, and sparkles. Beneath the title, add a smaller curved Japanese tagline in white with blue outline: {argument name="tagline" default="さあ、海のむこうへ！最高の冒険がはじまる！"}. At the bottom, place huge release text in Japanese, {argument name="release text" default="2026年 夏公開"}, in bold red-to-yellow gradient 3D letters with white and blue edging, sitting over a radiant orange burst. On the lower right, add a blue starburst badge with the Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="ドキドキ！ワクワク！いっしょに出発だ！"} in white and yellow. Include exactly 2 treasure-themed corner props: an open treasure chest with gold coins at the lower left and a compass at the lower right. The overall look should be glossy, saturated, family-friendly, whimsical, cinematic, and toy-like, with crisp outlines, exaggerated expressions, high contrast, and a poster-ready vertical composition. items.content: A dramatic vertical dark-fantasy anime key visual poster for the RPG {argument name="game title" default="夢喰-BAKU-"}. Center the composition around 3 human figures layered in depth. items.title: Fiery Butadon Japanese Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic Japanese restaurant-style flyer for a thick-cut charcoal-grilled pork bowl, ideal for food promotions, social posts, or menu advertising.

author.name: メムロイロ🌽AI町おこし挑戦中

items.content: A dramatic Japanese food advertisement poster for a premium pork rice bowl, vertical composition, black and fiery orange background with glowing embers, smoke, and a high-contrast gourmet marketing look. The main focus is an oversized bowl of butadon in the lower center, filled with white rice and topped with many thick slices of glossy grilled pork belly, richly lacquered with dark sweet soy glaze, visible char marks, caramelized edges, and a stream of sauce pouring down from above onto the meat. Make the food look hyper-appetizing, juicy, rich, and slightly exaggerated like a restaurant flyer. Large bold brushed gold Japanese headline text dominates the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="帯広の肉厚豚丼"}. Across the middle, a gold paint-stroke banner contains black Japanese text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="極上の炭火焼き。極上のタレ。"}. On the right side, add a cute anime girl mascot standing behind the bowl, about half-body visible, wearing a black-and-white cow-themed hoodie with small horns, long blonde hair, frilly sleeves, and a shy delighted pose with one hand near her mouth; keep her face intentionally obscured by a plain beige rectangle censor block. Add vertical white Japanese copy along the right edge in 2 separate text groups: 1 at the upper right, 1 larger at the mid-to-lower right. Add a small handwritten-style white note near the girl with a tiny heart. In the lower left, include a dark circular callout badge with gold rim and white/yellow Japanese text about charcoal grilling and flavor. Along the very bottom, place 3 circular ingredient-feature icons with exact labels beneath them: raw pork slices labeled {argument name="feature label 1" default="肉厚!"}, glowing charcoal embers labeled {argument name="feature label 2" default="炭火焼き!"}, and glossy dark sauce labeled {argument name="feature label 3" default="極上ダレ!"}. At the bottom right, add a huge energetic gold brush-calligraphy slogan with splattered paint effects, plus a smaller white sentence beneath it. Use intense lighting, glossy highlights, premium yakiniku flyer aesthetics, dense Japanese typography, bold brush fonts, and a mouthwatering late-night food terror vibe.

items.title: Geometric Bird Riding Bicycle
items.description: This prompt generates a clean minimalist vector illustration of a stylized bird cyclist, suitable for playful editorial graphics, logos, or modern poster art.
items.content: A minimalist flat vector illustration on a light gray background showing a whimsical bird riding a bicycle, built entirely from simple geometric shapes with thick black outlines. The bicycle is a black line-drawn road bike in side view facing left, with 2 large wheels, each wheel divided by a vertical and horizontal spoke cross, a simple triangular frame, a small black saddle, pedals, and a thin black ground line running horizontally beneath the bike. The rider is a stylized white bird with a large round body, a smaller round head, a pointed orange beak opened wide, and a pink lower beak interior. The bird has 1 visible black eye, a simple curved black line on top of the head, 1 teardrop-shaped wing behind the neck, and 1 angled white tail feather shape pointing backward. The bird leans forward over the bicycle as if actively riding. It has 2 long narrow orange legs with black outlines extending downward over the frame toward the pedals. Keep the composition centered, playful, clean, and abstract, with no shading, no texture, and a modern icon-like graphic style.

items.title: Celestial Anime Fantasy Movie Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a fully typeset Japanese fantasy anime film poster featuring a silver-haired moon-themed heroine, ideal for cinematic key art and promotional poster concepts.
items.content:
A dramatic Japanese fantasy anime movie poster, vertical one-sheet composition, centered on a beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing silver-white hair, glowing golden eyes, and a calm inviting smile, reaching one hand toward the viewer. She wears a black-and-white celestial dress with a fitted corset bodice, white chest panel, black ribbon lacing at the front, detached black sleeves with soft white ruffles, a black belt at the waist, layered skirt panels decorated with exactly 3 gold crescent moon ornaments, and a black choker with a gold crescent moon pendant. She also has exactly 1 gold crescent moon hair clip near her bangs. Behind her is a luminous night sky filled with stars, nebula-like clouds, and a huge eclipsed moon halo directly above her head, plus exactly 3 floating crescent-ring light effects around the left side of her hair. The background shows an ornate fantasy city with towering gothic palace architecture, spires, observatory-like structures, and glowing windows, all bathed in cool moonlight. Use a rich palette of deep indigo, violet, midnight blue, silver, and gold, with sparkles, magical particles, rim lighting, glossy highlights, and a slightly dense, painterly modern-anime poster finish.

Design it as a fully typeset Japanese film poster with elegant serif display typography in gold and white. At the very top, place a centered headline in Japanese: {argument name="headline text" default="夜が欠けるたび、忘れていた真実が目を覚ます。"}. On the right side, set a large vertical Japanese tagline in gold: {argument name="right-side tagline" default="最後の月光が消える前に、世界の記憶をつなぎ直せ。"}. On the left side, arrange 4 stacked blocks of smaller Japanese body copy separated by decorative divider lines and crescent motifs. Add a circular gold burst badge on the lower right with Japanese promotional text inside. Across the lower middle, place the large glowing Japanese title in ornate gold-white lettering: {argument name="movie title" default="月蝕のリグレット"}. Beneath the title, add a smaller centered Japanese subtitle line. Below that, place a horizontal feature line with exactly 3 gold-separated phrases in Japanese: "記憶", "月光", "観測魔法". At the very bottom, add 3 short Japanese teaser lines spread left, center, and right, and a large glowing release line centered under them: {argument name="release text" default="近日公開"}. The overall feeling is epic, melancholic, magical, celestial, romantic, and nostalgic, like a high-budget fantasy anime film poster.

items.content: A photorealistic upper-body portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese high school girl"} standing outdoors in bright natural sunlight, framed from mid-torso up in a vertical composition. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with a glossy sheen, a clean center part, and soft strands catching the light. Her pose is calm and slightly angled to the side, with her head turned subtly away from the camera for a candid fashion-portrait feel. She wears a crisp white short-sleeve school shirt and a navy blue striped necktie, with a detailed embroidered crest patch on the left chest pocket featuring a crown and heraldic shield. The background is a shallow-depth-of-field scene of vivid red shrine or temple architecture with bold vertical pillars and hints of blue and gold decorative elements, creating strong color contrast against the white shirt and dark hair. Emphasize realistic skin, natural fabric folds, high-end DSLR portrait photography, soft bokeh, sharp focus on hair and clothing, polished commercial beauty styling, and an elegant, refined mood.

items.title: Long Stretching Tabby Cat
items.description: A cute surreal cat illustration designed for memes, stickers, or social posts featuring an impossibly elongated standing tabby on a clean tall canvas.
items.content: A whimsical minimalist illustration of a {argument name="cat breed" default="brown tabby kitten"} standing upright in the exact center of a very tall vertical canvas, with an absurdly elongated, noodle-like body stretched from near the top to near the bottom of the image. The cat has a small round face with large glossy eyes, a tiny open smiling mouth, upright ears, and both front paws raised straight overhead in a cheering pose, showing 2 visible pink paw pads. Its fur is soft and detailed, with a white muzzle, chest, belly, and inner legs, and brown-and-black tabby stripes along the sides, head, arms, and tail. The body is extremely thin and vertically extended, creating a comical exaggerated proportion, while the hind paws remain tiny and close together at the bottom. Add 1 curved striped tail extending to the lower right side. Above the head, place the playful hand-drawn text "{argument name="caption text" default="nyoooon~"}" in a rounded dark brown font, arched like a semicircle, with 6 short motion lines around the raised paws and text to emphasize stretching. Use a clean off-white or warm light beige background with no scenery, only a faint soft oval shadow beneath the feet. Cute, polished digital illustration style, centered composition, high detail in fur, humorous Japanese sticker or social-media mascot vibe, lots of negative space, extra-tall aspect ratio.

items.title: Crimson Space Opera Key Visual
items.description: A dark, cinematic sci-fi game poster showing a red-black biomechanical starship against planets, glowing orbital rings, and Japanese title typography, ideal for key visual or cover art generation.
items.content: A dramatic vertical sci-fi key visual poster for a dark space opera game, featuring a single colossal alien-mechanical spacecraft centered slightly low in the frame, angled diagonally from lower left toward upper right as if surging forward through space. The ship is razor-sharp, asymmetrical, and aggressively organic, built from layered black metal and glowing crimson-red armor plates, with a long spear-like prow, many jagged fins, and about 12 to 16 whip-like tendrils or spines streaming backward from its upper rear like biomechanical hair. Behind it floats a large shadowed planet at center, encircled by 3 luminous red orbital rings that create a halo effect. At upper left, include 1 cratered moon or planet partially cropped by the frame. Scatter multiple dark asteroids and rocky debris across the foreground and edges, especially lower right and lower left, to create depth. The background is a dense starfield with red nebula clouds and streaks of fiery cosmic dust. In the upper right, place a blazing orange-white sun flare breaking into the scene, casting hot rim light across the ship and rings. Use a high-contrast palette of black, deep crimson, ember red, and white highlights, with glossy metallic reflections and a grim, apocalyptic mood. Add vertical Japanese tagline text on the right side in white Mincho-style serif characters: 「あの太陽に飛び込めば 冷めきった私の心も温かくなるのだろうか」. At the bottom center, add the main title in very large distressed white Japanese serif characters with cracked texture and subtle red glow: 「斑鳩の柩」. Beneath it, add 1 line of smaller red katakana subtitle text: 「イカルガのクルスー」, and beneath that 1 line of small Roman letters in red: "IKARUGA NO CRUX". Make it look like premium anime game key art, cinematic poster composition, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, dynamic lighting, epic scale, ominous and beautiful.

items.title: Fantasy Manga Spell Explosion Page
items.description: This prompt generates a high-impact monochrome fantasy manga page with a young mage unleashing a huge spell and a smaller reaction panel, suitable for comic storytelling or manga-style concept art.
items.content: A dramatic black-and-white fantasy manga page in highly detailed ink line art and screentone style, vertical comic layout with 2 panels. The top panel is a full-width action scene showing a young anime-style mage boy, about early teen age, standing on cracked rocky ground and casting a powerful spell with his right hand extended toward the left side of the frame. He has short tousled light hair, large serious eyes, and a calm, focused expression. He wears a high-collared cape flowing behind him, a buttoned vest over a shirt, fitted trousers, boots, a belt with pouches, and a holstered wand or small magical tool at his hip, with a gemstone clasp at the neck. In front of his open palm is a large glowing circular magic sigil with intricate concentric symbols and runic ornamentation. The spell erupts into a massive explosion of white light and energy, blasting outward with dense speed lines, black debris clouds, shattered rock fragments, dust, and impact textures filling the background. Large stylized Japanese sound effect lettering is integrated into the art on the left side and along the lower foreground, creating a sense of repeated roaring impacts. The composition is dynamic and high contrast, with the boy positioned right of center and the blast dominating the left half. The bottom panel is a narrower reaction shot, count 1 character visible, showing a long-haired witch in profile facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed pointed hat with an ornate band and gem, and a cloak fastened with a jewel brooch. Her face is partially obscured by a solid rectangular censorship block over the central face area. Behind her, the same explosion and flying rubble continue in the distance. A single vertical Japanese speech balloon on the right reads "…うわ". Use clean manga panel borders, polished professional shonen fantasy comic style, intense motion, crisp pen hatching, screentone shading, and cinematic impact.

items.title: Sengoku vs Sangoku Crossover Poster
items.description: A cinematic anime poster prompt for generating an epic crossover battle visual between Japanese Sengoku warlords and Chinese Three Kingdoms heroes.
items.content:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {argument name="left faction title" default="日本戦国"}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {argument name="right faction title" default="中国三国"}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {argument name="center slogan" default="時空を越え、宿命が交錯する。"}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: {argument name="bottom tagline" default="時空を超え、英雄たちの戦いが始まる。"}. Poster layout, polished commercial promotional art, extremely detailed, high-impact, collectible poster aesthetic.

items.title: Anime Romance Movie Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese anime-style theatrical poster for a bittersweet romance film, ideal for cinematic key art, mock movie ads, or dramatic character-focused poster design.
items.content: A Japanese theatrical romance movie poster in a tall smartphone-style vertical layout with rounded corners, designed like a polished anime key visual. The main image shows a beautiful teenage billboard girl heroine standing on an outdoor balcony at dusk, turning back over her shoulder to look at the viewer with a soft, wistful expression. She has very long silver-white twin-tail hair tied with dark ribbons, pale skin, and large pink-violet eyes. She wears a delicate white frilled blouse with voluminous sleeves and a dark high-waisted dress or corset-like skirt, creating an elegant, slightly gothic school-romance look. The atmosphere is dreamy and emotional, filled with glowing bokeh lights, drifting petals or snow-like sparkles, sunset pink and lavender light, and a luminous cityscape in the blurred background. Use rich cinematic anime rendering, ultra-detailed hair strands, soft rim light, glossy eyes, and a bittersweet first-love mood. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the composition: a large vertical pink poetic tagline on the right, a vertical white tagline on the left, a very large main title near the lower left reading {argument name="title text" default="看板娘"}, and a smaller subtitle beside it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="君と紡ぐ恋物語"}. Include 5 small rectangular film-strip preview stills aligned across the lower middle, each showing the same heroine in different emotional close-ups. Add dense credits, festival-style laurels, and small release information at the top and bottom in Japanese, with the overall feel of a premium romance anime film poster advertising a tragic, beautiful love story. Use a pastel palette of mauve, blush pink, violet, pearl white, and midnight navy, with soft bloom, shallow depth of field, and elegant poster composition.

items.title: Zombie Survival RPG Anime Ad Poster
items.description: This generates a dense Japanese-style mobile game advertisement poster for a zombie survival RPG, suitable for app promo art, fake game ads, or cinematic anime key visuals.
items.content:
Create a dramatic Japanese mobile game advertisement poster for a zombie survival RPG in anime-meets-cinematic style. Vertical smartphone poster layout, dense promotional design, gritty urban apocalypse background at dusk with ruined city streets, smoke, sparks, debris, damaged buildings, neon signs, and a crowd of zombies advancing from behind. In the center, a young anime woman sits on the ground in a slightly slouched pose, legs bent, holding a black handgun upright in one hand. She has straight dark brown to black shoulder-length hair, pale skin, and an oversized dirty white T-shirt splattered with blood. Large bold Japanese calligraphy is printed vertically on the shirt: "働きたくね〜". Her expression area is simple and unobtrusive so the composition emphasizes the shirt, weapon, and mood. Surround her with multiple zombies in torn clothing, reaching forward from the left and right background.

Use an aggressive game key-art design with 8 clearly separated promotional sections. Section 1: top-left game logo block, count 3 text elements, with large distressed English title "Dead or work", smaller Japanese subtitle "ゾンビサバイバルRPG", and heavy black paint-splatter background with white and red text. Section 2: right-side vertical slogan area, count 2 text elements, with white Japanese text "動かない、ただ" above giant red vertical text "生き残れ。" on a rough black brushstroke strip. Section 3: left-middle feature list panel, count 4 feature rows, each row with a white icon in a black square and yellow/white Japanese copy; labels are "ゾンビを倒して生き延びろ", "拠点を強化・カスタマイズ", "仲間と協力プレイ", and "デイリーミッションで報酬GET". Section 4: right-middle bonus campaign panel, count 1 headline plus 3 reward items; headline in a bright jagged yellow burst says "今すぐ始めると 豪華特典プレゼント!" and beneath it are three item boxes labeled "ゴールド ×5000", "レア武器 (7日間)", and "サバイバルキット ×10". Section 5: lower-middle gameplay screenshot strip, count 4 thumbnails with captions; captions are "リアルタイムバトル!", "基地を自由にカスタム!", "仲間とレイドボスに挑め!", and "広大なオープンワールド!". Section 6: bottom call-to-action banner, count 2 text elements, with a huge yellow-and-red Japanese phrase "今すぐダウンロード!" and smaller white/red subtext "あなたの選択が、生死を分ける。". Section 7: bottom-right store badges, count 2 badges, showing App Store and Google Play style download buttons. Section 8: bottom-right QR area, count 1 QR code in a white square.

Overall aesthetic: hyper-detailed, high-contrast, grimy, intense, commercially polished gacha/mobile game ad, combining anime character art with realistic zombie horror background. Use bold distressed typography, black brush textures, red warning colors, yellow promotional highlights, metallic UI framing, and cinematic orange-gray lighting.
