items.title: 108 Chibi Fantasy Mandala
items.description: A highly detailed wide fantasy poster showing exactly 108 unique chibi mythical creatures arranged in concentric mandala rings, ideal for decorative key art or showcase illustrations.
items.content:
A gigantic ultra-detailed fantasy mandala poster featuring exactly 108 distinct chibi characters arranged in concentric circular rings around a radiant central emblem. The composition is perfectly symmetrical overall and fills a wide horizontal canvas like an ornate collectible mural. In the center, place a glowing golden core with 9 chibi animal-fantasy mascots clustered in a circular medallion, each with oversized heads, tiny bodies, expressive eyes, and luxurious costume details. Surround this center with multiple evenly spaced concentric rings containing the remaining 99 characters, each character occupying its own wedge-like segment and designed as a unique elemental or mythical variation. Include fox-like, rabbit-like, cat-like, wolf-like, lion-like, bird-like, dragon-like, deer-like, and hybrid beast characters, all rendered in a cute super-deformed style but with epic high-fantasy armor, robes, crowns, feathers, horns, gems, capes, staffs, and magical accessories. Make every character visually distinct through color, silhouette, species traits, and elemental theme, while preserving a unified painterly anime-fantasy aesthetic.

Use a rich palette dominated by luminous gold, ivory, cream, violet, indigo, sapphire, and soft amber, with accents of crimson, icy cyan, emerald, and sunset orange. Give the image the feel of a sacred celestial chart or zodiac wheel, with each circular band separated by elegant gilded borders and arc dividers. Add glowing magical energy, sparkles, halos, swirling fire, mist, snow, clouds, water splashes, lightning curls, floral motifs, and celestial particles around many of the characters. Around the outer perimeter, place several larger decorative guardian illustrations integrated into the border: a bright sun medallion at the upper left, a white phoenix-like bird in a circular panel at the upper right, a floral or starburst medallion at the lower right, and a fiery character cluster in a circular panel at the lower left, plus additional large elemental beast figures embedded along the left and right edges. Frame the entire artwork with an elaborate antique ornamental border inspired by illuminated manuscripts and fantasy tarot designs, using filigree, corner medallions, geometric trim, and arcane motifs.

The rendering should be extremely dense and crisp, like a 4k fantasy illustration meant for a poster print, with tiny readable character silhouettes across the whole image, intricate linework, soft watercolor-textured shading, glowing highlights, and a polished collectible-card-game concept art finish. Emphasize abundance, harmony, and radial order: exactly 108 chibi figures total, arranged as a majestic mandala of mythical elemental mascots.

Bottom center item: 1 silver blister pack containing exactly 8 pale yellow round tablets arranged in 2 rows of 4. Printed along the foil edge: "幻覚抑制錠5mg" repeated. items.title: Japanese Izakaya Highball Poster
items.description: This generates a photorealistic Japanese izakaya promotional poster featuring a woman holding a highball, bold pricing text, and four featured dishes for restaurant advertising or nightlife-themed visuals.
items.content: A photorealistic Japanese izakaya advertisement poster in a warm, cinematic night-time mood, designed like a street-front restaurant flyer. The composition is vertical and densely layered. On the right side, a young Japanese woman with long straight dark brown to black hair, wearing a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sweater, stands from the waist up and holds a large frosty glass mug of golden highball with visible ice cubes in her right hand near chest level. Her pose is relaxed and inviting, looking toward the camera, with a soft nightlife ambiance. The background is a narrow traditional izakaya exterior or interior alley scene filled with warm orange lantern light, shallow depth of field, hanging wooden menu plaques with handwritten Japanese calligraphy, and a nostalgic bustling-after-work atmosphere. In the upper left, a large weathered dark wooden signboard dominates the design, with bold white brushstroke kanji reading 蓮華食堂, small hiragana above it reading れんげしょくどう, and a red brush-painted banner beneath reading 大衆居酒屋. Below that on the left-center, place a large cream-colored paper or painted panel featuring the drink special in oversized calligraphic typography: ハイボール above a huge red 198円, with small black（税込） beside the price, the numerals painted in energetic brush style. Along the far right edge, add vertical white Japanese text reading 今日も一日、おかれさまです。 Near the lower right over the woman’s torso, place a red circular stamp-like badge with white handwritten text arranged diagonally and vertically: 旨い！安い！居心地◎. Across the bottom foreground, show exactly 4 plated menu items lined up side by side on rustic ceramic dishes: 1) two glazed grilled chicken skewers with char marks, labeled 焼き鳥 盛り合わせ and priced 580円; 2) a sashimi assortment with slices of tuna, salmon, white fish, shiso leaves and wasabi, labeled お刺身 盛り合わせ and priced 780円; 3) a plate of fried chicken karaage pieces with a lemon wedge, labeled 若鶏の唐揚げ and priced 480円; 4) sliced rolled dashi omelet topped with chopped green onion and served with grated daikon, labeled 出汁巻き玉子 and priced 380円. At the bottom left, include a glowing red paper lantern graphic with black vertical text 居酒屋. Across the bottom center on a dark band, add large bold white brush lettering reading でかい！うまい！安い！ and below it smaller white text reading みんなの憩いの場、蓮華食堂へようこそ！ Add a decorative red lotus-like emblem near the top sign and another matching emblem in the bottom right corner. Use rich amber highlights, strong contrast, glossy food styling, realistic skin and drink textures, commercial poster polish, and a nostalgic Showa-inspired izakaya promotion aesthetic.

items.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Anatomy Poster
items.description: A realistic smartphone chat-app screenshot showing a Japanese prompt and the resulting dense medical-style anatomical infographic, ideal for recreating viral AI image demo posts.

author.name: マシモGPT🤖@ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/GrokなどLLMをこねくり回す人

items.content: A smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in portrait orientation, showing a clean white iOS-style screen with a top bar containing a hamburger menu on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a small chevron, and two icons on the right for compose and more options. Near the top is a rounded light-gray user message bubble in Japanese reading “Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。” Below it, faint gray system text reads “Thought for 5s” and “画像が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen displays the generated image as a detailed medical textbook-style anatomical poster. The poster shows a realistic three-quarter back view of an adult woman from head to upper thighs, with her head turned slightly left and her dark brown hair tied into a messy bun. Her skin and outer tissues are removed across most of the body to reveal musculature, nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous structures, rendered in extremely detailed vintage medical illustration style on a warm cream paper background. A rectangular cutout obscures the center of the face from forehead to jaw, creating a censored blank block over the facial area. Fine glowing network lines and nodes are overlaid through the exposed brain and body to visualize the attention mechanism as if it were an anatomical system. Surrounding the figure are 6 numbered explanatory panels and 2 additional text blocks, all densely filled with Japanese and English bilingual labels, formulas, arrows, and diagrams. The main poster title at upper left is “アテンション機構の解剖学的構造” with the English subtitle “The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”. At the top right is a flowchart labeled “Overall Flow of Attention” containing 5 connected boxes describing the process from input to output. Down the left side are 3 stacked explanatory sections with equations and mapping tables. Down the right side are 3 more numbered sections, each with technical notes and a small chart or matrix; the visible mini-diagrams include 1 purple heatmap matrix, 1 blue bar chart, and 1 multicolored cube graphic. Along the bottom edge are 5 small brain inset illustrations with captions showing stages of information flow. The overall aesthetic should feel like a highly polished AI-generated screenshot documenting a surreal scientific illustration request, with crisp UI, lots of tiny readable labels, and a convincing fusion of transformer attention diagrams and classical anatomical plate design.

items.title: Goth Anime Girl at Playground Bar
items.description: This prompt generates a bold, high-contrast anime fashion illustration of a black-haired goth girl biting a playground bar, ideal for stylized character art and eye-catching social media visuals.
items.content: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a pale goth girl in a colorful urban playground, shown in a close medium shot as she leans forward and bites a horizontal metal bar with a mischievous, slightly defiant expression. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} hair with blunt bangs, vivid red eyes, and a delicate face with a small mouth partly pressed against the bar. Her hair is decorated with 3 geometric hair clips on the right side: 1 red triangle clip, 1 blue angular clip, and 1 small gold ring clip. She wears multiple ear piercings including several studs and dangling industrial-style earrings. Her outfit is a black techwear-goth ensemble with 5 visible key pieces: 1 cropped black jacket with red and blue accent stripes, 1 black choker, 1 strappy black top or dress with front buckles, 1 wide black belt with metal hardware, and 1 hanging waist chain. Her sleeves are long and oversized, with white stripe details on one forearm. Both hands grip the bar, one near her mouth and one farther to the side, creating an intimate confrontational pose. The setting is a playground with bright primary-colored equipment: blue posts, red connectors, yellow and red climbing bars, and a patterned rubber floor made of bold geometric blocks in blue, red, yellow, white, and black. In the background are dark green trees and a dramatic graphic sky with large flat shapes in red, orange, blue, black, and white, plus circular sun-like dots, giving the whole scene a posterized pop-art look. Include 1 vertical warning sticker on the left blue post with Japanese text and a small caution icon. Use crisp cel shading, sharp linework, slight glitchy texture accents, ultra-saturated colors, high contrast, a moody cyber-goth fashion vibe, and a dynamic composition centered on the girl's intense gaze and the metal bar.

items.title: Japanese Jungle Theme Park Parody Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic satirical Japanese poster for a tropical dinosaur theme park, ideal for showcasing dense typography, ad design, and photorealistic scene composition.

author.name: AIに振り回されるおじちゃん

items.content: A hyper-detailed vertical Japanese theme park advertisement poster set in a lush tropical jungle under a vivid blue sky with scattered clouds and strong golden sunlight flaring from the upper right. The style is cinematic, photorealistic, dramatic, and slightly absurdist, like a premium satirical travel ad. At the top, huge three-dimensional stone-textured gold Japanese headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="ジャンキリア沖縄"}, with a smaller white Japanese tagline underneath that reads "— やんばるの大自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク —". In the center foreground, a giant modern smartphone stands upright, slightly tilted, dominating the composition like a monument. Its screen shows a lottery waiting-ticket interface with a safari silhouette header and large bold Japanese text "整理券抽選中", a dotted loading circle, smaller text "結果発表まで30分", and a tiny note "※この画面を閉じずにお待ちください". The phone status bar shows 10:00. To the left midground, a roaring Tyrannosaurus rex emerges from dense jungle foliage behind a huge aged concrete sign with oversized red Japanese text "待ち時間 180分". To the right midground, an ornate extravagant gold entrance gate to a premium area rises above the trees, with a black signboard reading "プレミアムパス入口" and a red-carpeted queue lane beyond it. A long crowded line of park visitors stretches from the foreground deep into the background along rope barriers; the visitors wear summer vacation clothing, hats, towels, backpacks, handheld fans, water bottles, and parasols, showing exhaustion, heat, and anticipation. In the lower left foreground, 3 stacked rustic wooden signboards are visible: the top board says "駐車場 2,000円" with a parking icon, the middle board says "アプリ必須 ダウンロードしてね!" with a smartphone icon, and the bottom board says "当選者だけが冒険へ" with a dinosaur silhouette. Along the right side, large vertical white brush-style Japanese copy reads {argument name="side slogan" default="待つこと、それが冒険だ。"}. Near the lower right are 3 circular gold icon callouts with short Japanese promotional lines: 1 dinosaur icon with "抽選に選ばれし者だけが、恐竜に会える。", 1 smartphone battery icon with "スマホの充電が尽きる前に、夢は始まる。", and 1 VIP icon with "プレミアムな近道も、ご用意しました。". At the very bottom center, include a small black strip with white Japanese disclaimer text: "このポスターは架空のパロディ広告です". The jungle should be dense and glossy with large tropical leaves framing the foreground, warm rim lighting, high contrast, and a polished blockbuster-poster composition. Keep all Japanese typography crisp, clean, and perfectly legible.

items.title: Low-Angle Anime Bunny Girls in Ruins
items.description: This prompt generates a tilted low-angle anime poster of two bunny-suited girls against a ruined cathedral background, useful for recreating stylized character-and-background compositions with dramatic perspective.
items.content: A dynamic anime-style low-angle illustration of two young women in rabbit-themed bodysuits, viewed from below as if the camera is tilted upward and they are looking slightly down toward the viewer. The left girl has {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair in short twin pigtails with curled ends, large red bunny ears, and a glossy bright red high-cut bodysuit with puff sleeves, long opera gloves, a sweetheart-shaped chest panel, and 4 round silver button-like discs on the front. The right girl has long straight brown hair, pale bunny ears, and a glossy white and pale pink version of the same bodysuit design, also with puff sleeves, long gloves, sweetheart chest panel, and 4 round silver discs. Both have slim builds, long legs, expressive wide anime eyes, and mildly surprised, curious expressions as they glance toward each other and slightly toward the viewer. Their hands hang loosely at their sides, almost touching in the center. Place them in front of a vast ruined cathedral or decayed grand stone building with broken arches, skeletal metal framework, shattered windows, and crumbling debris, rendered as a soft-painted anime background. Use a dramatic Dutch angle and strong perspective so the architecture leans with the camera tilt and the characters feel towering and close to the lens. Bright blue sky with large white clouds behind the ruins. Clean cel shading on the characters, painterly detailed background, crisp line art, vibrant but slightly weathered color palette, cinematic composition. Add 3 text elements in the upper right area as graphic design overlay: small uppercase text "ARINKO AGENTS", large bold Japanese text "平和島", and a large white handwritten signature-like script overlapping the background.

items.title: Sunset Catgirl School Rooftop Anime
items.description: A cinematic anime-style rooftop portrait of a cat-eared schoolgirl at sunset, ideal for nostalgic key visuals, character art, or social media showcase images.
items.content: A high-quality anime illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="cat-eared schoolgirl"} leaning forward over a metal school rooftop railing at sunset, shown from a slightly low, close three-quarter angle. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with soft highlights, large reflective gray-brown eyes, round thin-rim glasses, and 2 fluffy cat ears emerging from her hair. Her expression is quiet, wistful, and slightly shy, with parted lips and a gentle downward gaze toward the viewer. She wears a Japanese sailor school uniform with a soft {argument name="uniform color" default="pink"} long-sleeve top, a gray sailor collar with white stripes, a vivid red neckerchief bow, and a plaid skirt partially visible, with 2 dark backpack straps over her shoulders. The scene is drenched in dramatic golden-hour backlighting, with intense warm rim light along her hair, ears, shoulders, and sleeves, glowing sun flare from the lower left, and a richly painted sky full of orange and peach clouds. In the background, show a 2-story Japanese school building with a red-tiled roof and glowing windows lit by the sunset. Emphasize nostalgic early-2000s high-end anime key visual quality, delicate linework, luminous eyes, detailed hair strands, cinematic composition, soft depth of field, vibrant warm color grading, polished shading, and an emotional serene atmosphere.

items.title: Beginner Coin Collecting Manga Page
items.description: A polished one-page anime manga introduces coin collecting to beginners, useful for educational social posts, explainer comics, or hobby-themed promotional art.

items.title: Steampunk Vintage Video Platform UI
items.description: A detailed steampunk streaming-site mockup styled like a Victorian brass machine interface, ideal for retro-futurist web concepts and text-heavy UI showcases.
items.content:
A highly detailed full-page steampunk video streaming website interface themed around the Victorian electrical age, designed like an antique brass-and-iron machine panel with dark bronze metal textures, rivets, pipes, gears, ornate filigree, glowing Edison bulbs, and sepia-toned imagery. At the top left, place a modern white logo reading "Pollo" with a small pink-red rounded badge containing "AI", and directly below it the text "GPT Image 2" in white, overlaid on the vintage interface. Center the header with a large embossed brass title reading "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}" on a dark metal plaque, and a smaller engraved tagline underneath reading "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar with exactly 5 items: a home icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", and "ENTERTAINMENT", plus a search field on the right containing the placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." and a square search button. In the upper right corner, include a round analog gauge or clock built into the frame.

Use a three-column vintage web layout. In the left sidebar, create a panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 circular channel emblems stacked vertically, each with a name, subscriber count, and a "SUBSCRIBE" button: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". The emblems should look heraldic and industrial, with aged metallic borders.

In the main content area, feature a large video player showing a dramatic sepia debate scene between two late-19th-century inventors in suits, facing each other across a table with electrical apparatus, a glowing bulb, and lightning on a chalkboard behind them reading "AC vs. DC". The left figure points accusingly; the right figure gestures back. Keep both faces obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video control bar with a play button, progress bar, volume icon, timecode "08:47 / 22:31", settings icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, place the large serif video title "{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, show the channel row with a small circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", and metadata "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this row, add a brass button reading "LIKE 5.8K".

Below the featured video, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video cards in one row. Card 1: a sepia thumbnail of a man holding up a glowing light bulb, face obscured by a blur block, duration label "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", and metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: a sepia thumbnail of a Wardenclyffe-style tower crackling with electricity, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", and metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: a sepia thumbnail of an early automobile on a city street, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", and metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the cards, center a brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom, add a metal footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." Surround the whole composition with decorative mechanical borders, exposed pipes, pressure gauges, cogs, corner ornaments, and warm amber lighting. The overall style should blend a YouTube-like video platform layout with a luxurious Victorian steampunk machine aesthetic, using dark brass, copper, blackened steel, parchment beige, and sepia photography, with crisp readable typography and a polished cinematic UI mockup look.

items.title: Korean Sports Drink Celebrity Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a flashy Korean-style hydration drink poster with a celebrity-like spokesperson, oversized product bottle, and bold promotional typography for commercial advertising use.
items.content: A bold Korean beverage advertisement poster in a glossy commercial photography style, featuring {argument name="spokesperson" default="Donald Trump lookalike"} in a dark navy business suit, white dress shirt, and vivid blue tie, standing front-facing against a saturated bright-blue sky with a few soft white clouds and a faint modern city skyline including a tall skyscraper resembling the Empire State Building on the right. He is holding a cold plastic bottle of {argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"} dramatically toward the camera in his left hand, with extreme foreshortening so the bottle appears large in the foreground and the person is slightly behind it. The bottle is clear with condensation, a white cap, visible water inside, and a deep blue label reading “POCARI SWEAT” in large white letters with smaller text above saying “ION SUPPLY DRINK.” Add energetic frozen water splashes and droplets around the bottle, hand, and lower foreground to emphasize freshness and hydration. Place the brand logo in the upper left corner: “POCARI SWEAT” in white with the curved underline mark. Across the top, add huge distressed white Korean headline text, slightly angled and filling most of the upper half: {argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? 이걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"}. In the lower right over the suit, add a bold italic quotation in white and blue Korean text: {argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"}. In the bottom left, include exactly 3 circular benefit icons stacked vertically with short Korean labels: a water drop icon with “수분 보충”, a lightning bolt icon with “전해질 보충”, and a running figure icon with “빠른 흡수”. Use a high-contrast, patriotic blue-and-white color palette, dramatic ad lighting, sharp focus on the bottle and hand, slightly softer focus on the face and background, and an overall energetic premium campaign-poster look.

items.title: Vintage Korean Gimbap Recipe Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed retro-style Korean infographic poster for gimbap, suitable for food marketing, menu art, or culturally themed recipe illustrations.
items.content: Create a vintage Korean food poster infographic on aged beige parchment paper with worn texture, darkened edges, subtle stains, and an ornate traditional frame in muted green. The design is a single vertically stacked poster with 4 clearly separated sections and all text rendered sharply in Korean and English calligraphy. At the top, place a large ribbon banner with bold black Korean brush lettering reading "정통 한국 김밥" and a smaller ribbon subtitle reading "Traditional Korean Gimbap". In the upper-left corner, include a small modern badge that says "Pollo AI" and "GPT Image 2". The centerpiece of the top section is a large blue-and-white porcelain platter piled with exactly 12 sliced gimbap pieces, each showing white rice, yellow egg, orange carrot, green spinach, and dark seaweed wrapping, illustrated in a hand-drawn ink-and-watercolor style. items.title: Korean Rice Drink Parody Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a humorous, high-impact parody beverage advertisement poster featuring a famous politician-like spokesperson promoting a Korean canned rice drink.
items.content:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Donald Trump-like older male politician"} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.

items.title: Retro ChatGPT Space Poster
items.description: A realistic street photo of a weathered mid-century sci-fi poster promoting ChatGPT Images 2.0, ideal for retro tech editorial art or social media visuals.
items.content: A retro-futurist propaganda-style poster pasted on a rough white plaster wall, photographed straight-on in natural light. The poster is slightly wrinkled, creased, and weathered with worn corners and subtle tears, giving it the look of an old screen-printed street poster. Use a mid-century space-race aesthetic from the 1950s–1960s, with a limited palette of deep navy blue, faded cream, muted teal, and bold red-orange. The poster has 5 visible text elements: the large cream headline {argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT"} at the upper left in bold condensed sans-serif, the large red-orange subheadline {argument name="subheadline text" default="Images 2.0"} directly below it, the vertical red text {argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} printed on the rocket body, and the small cream tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"} along the bottom red band, plus a small cream star icon to the left of the tagline. Composition: a tall white-and-black rocket launches from the lower right edge with red exhaust flames and billowing cream smoke; the rocket is near-vertical and dominates the right third of the poster. A small detached space capsule floats to the left of the rocket, angled diagonally. A thin cream orbital path curves in a large loop across the upper half of the poster, passing behind and around the rocket. The lower left shows the curved horizon of Earth in muted teal and cream, cropped by the frame. The background is a dark navy star field with exactly 3 visible celestial accents: 1 small cream planet or moon near the top center-left, 1 bright star near the upper right, and 1 smaller star near the middle-left. Add a solid red-orange horizontal band across the bottom of the poster. Emphasize vintage print texture, paper folds, faded ink, and nostalgic sci-fi optimism. The final image should look like a realistic photo of a pasted old space-age poster rather than a clean digital graphic.

items.title: Realistic X Profile Page Mockup
items.description: A photorealistic desktop X-style profile interface in French, useful for showcasing AI-generated social media UI screenshots and product comparison demos.
items.content: Create a highly realistic dark-mode social media interface mockup that closely resembles the desktop X/Twitter layout in French, shown as a full-browser screenshot with three vertical columns on a black background and subtle dark gray separators. The left sidebar contains exactly 11 navigation items stacked vertically with white icons and labels: “Accueil”, “Explorer”, “Notifications” with a small blue badge showing 3, “Messages”, “Grok”, “Signets”, “Communautés”, “Premium”, “Organisations certifiées”, “Profil”, and “Plus”. At the top of this sidebar place the white X logo, near the lower-middle add a large rounded white button labeled “Poster”, and at the bottom show a compact logged-in account block for Martin Dubois with handle @martindubois and a small circular avatar. The center column is the main profile page for {argument name="profile name" default="Martin Dubois"}, with a top bar showing a back arrow, the name “Martin Dubois” and a blue verification badge, and underneath the text “1 248 posts”. Below that, include a wide panoramic cover photo of dramatic cloudy alpine mountains above a forest lake. Overlapping the bottom-left of the banner, place a circular profile picture of a young man in dark clothing, face slightly obscured or blurred, with a pale background and a thin border. On the right side of the profile header place three small circular action buttons and one prominent rounded light button labeled “Éditer le profil”. Under the avatar show the display name Martin Dubois with a blue verification badge, the handle @martindubois, and a one-line bio in French: “Créateur de contenu • Passionné de tech, de design et de productivité.” Then add a metadata row with exactly 4 items: location “Lyon, France”, website “martindubois.com”, and “A rejoint X en janvier 2021”, followed by a follower row reading “320 abonnements” and “12,4 k abonnés”. Add a horizontal tab bar with exactly 5 tabs: “Posts”, “Réponses”, “Tweets marquants”, “Médias”, and “J’aime”, with “Posts” active and underlined in blue. Beneath the tabs, show a feed containing exactly 3 visible posts by Martin Dubois. Post 1 is pinned, indicated by “Épinglé”, dated “12 mai”, with the French text “10 leçons que j’ai apprises en construisant mon projet pendant 2 ans” followed by an emoji, and an engagement row with 5 values: 24 replies, 142 reposts, 1 k likes, 85 k views, and a bookmark/share area. Post 2 is dated “2h” with the French text “Le meilleur moment pour commencer était hier. Le deuxième meilleur moment, c’est maintenant.” and engagement values 12 replies, 37 reposts, 256 likes, and 8 k views. Post 3 is dated “1j” with the French text “Un week-end à Chamonix, toujours ressourçant” followed by a mountain emoji, and includes a large embedded image of snowy mountain peaks under soft daylight. Use circular avatars at the left of each post and thin separators between posts. The right sidebar starts with a rounded search field containing the placeholder “Chercher”. Below it, include a card titled “Vous pourriez aimer” with exactly 3 suggested profiles, each with avatar, display name, handle, blue verification badge, and a white rounded “Suivre” button: “Théo Catarino” @theocatarino, “Aurélie Martinez” @aurel_martinez, and “Ulrich Rozier” @ulrichrozier. Add a “Voir plus” link at the bottom of that card. Under it, create a trends card titled “Tendances : France” listing exactly 4 trends in ranked order with category and post counts: 1. “#RolandGarros” with “32,1 k posts”, 2. “#FêteDesMères” with “18,4 k posts”, 3. “Mbappé” with “45,2 k posts”, 4. “#LundiMotivation” with “12,3 k posts”. Add a “Voir plus” link below the trend list. At the very bottom place a compact footer with multiple small gray legal links and “© 2024 X Corp.”. The entire image should look almost indistinguishable from a real desktop screenshot: crisp typography, authentic spacing, realistic UI proportions, subtle rounded cards, white and gray text on near-black surfaces, blue accent color, polished anti-aliased icons, and a clean modern product-design aesthetic.

items.content: A highly realistic smartphone app screenshot mockup of a social media interface almost identical to X/Twitter, shown on an iPhone-style full-screen display with rounded corners against a dark blue-black background. The status bar at the top shows the time 9:41 on the left and cellular, Wi‑Fi, and battery icons on the right. The screen displays a French-language profile page for {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"}, with a large cover photo of the Eiffel Tower and the Seine at sunset under a dramatic orange-blue sky. A circular profile photo overlaps the lower-left of the header, partially obscuring the face. A back arrow button appears in a dark translucent circle at top left, and a three-dot menu button in a matching circle at top right. Show follower stats in French: "1 245 Abonnements" and "32,8 k Abonnés". Post 1 is by {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} with blue verified badge and the French caption {argument name="post caption" default="Balade matinale le long des quais de la Seine ☀️ #Paris #Promenade"}, followed by a 4-image collage in one row: 1) Eiffel Tower by the river at golden hour, 2) a Paris riverside walkway with a bridge and autumn trees, 3) a cozy terrace café with Eiffel Tower view, 4) a coffee cup beside an open notebook overlooking water. Below it, show engagement icons and counts: reply 258, repost 642, like 3,1 k. Post 2 is from verified news account "Le Monde" with handle "@LeMonde", black circular avatar with white monogram, and French text: "Dernières infos : Le nouveau gouvernement français a été annoncé 📰 Tous les details ici ↓" followed by a blue link "lemonde.fr/article123"; below it show counts 187, 512, and 2,7 k. At the bottom, include an iOS-style navigation bar with exactly 5 elements: home icon, search icon, notifications bell with a red badge showing 4, messages envelope with a red badge showing 4, and a large floating blue compose button with a white quill/feather icon. Add the thin black iPhone home indicator centered at the very bottom. items.title: Night Forest Thriller Cover
items.description: A dark graphic-novel cover showing four travelers blocked in a snowy forest at night beneath a mysterious blue beam, ideal for thriller or survival fiction.
items.content: A moody graphic-novel style book cover illustration set in a snowy conifer forest at night, painted in deep blue tones with cinematic contrast. In the foreground, show exactly 4 human figures standing behind a low striped road barrier: 3 adults and 1 small child. The central adult is a tall broad-shouldered man in a dark winter jacket, holding the sleeping or limp child in his arms; the child wears a puffy {argument name="child coat color" default="purple"} snowsuit. To his left stands a teenage or young adult male with a backpack beside a dark parked SUV partially visible at the edge of the frame. To his right stands an adult woman in a dark hooded winter jacket, holding a flashlight that casts a warm cone of light onto the snow and the barrier. All faces should be mostly in shadow, unreadable, emphasizing mystery and danger. Place exactly 2 man-made warning elements in the foreground: 1 red-and-white striped gate blocking the path and 1 weathered warning sign on a wooden post showing a deer silhouette inside a red prohibition circle and slash. In the midground and background, fill the scene with tall black pine trees, a narrow snow-covered road or clearing, and a dead animal shape lying partly buried in the snow on the right side. In the far distance, show a rugged snow-streaked mountain under a star-filled sky. From behind the mountain, a single narrow vertical blue beam of light rises straight into the sky, acting as the focal point. Composition should be vertical, dramatic, and poster-like, suitable for a thriller or survival graphic novel cover for {argument name="book title" default="La Réserve"}. Style: detailed Franco-Belgian / realistic comic-book painting, inked outlines, textured brushwork, cold nocturnal atmosphere, subtle rim lighting, high contrast, ominous and suspenseful.

items.content: A dark, cinematic graphic-novel style book cover illustration set in a snowy mountain forest at night, with a cold blue palette and dramatic vertical composition. In the foreground, 4 human figures stand behind a red-and-white striped barrier gate blocking a forest road. The first is an adult man in a heavy dark winter jacket, carrying 1 sleeping young girl in his arms; the girl wears a padded pink snowsuit and pale winter boots, her head resting on his shoulder. Beside him stands 1 adult woman in a fur-trimmed winter parka, holding a flashlight angled downward so its warm beam cuts across the snow. Next to her stands 1 teenage boy or young man in a dark hooded winter coat, looking into the forest. On the right foreground, place 1 weathered warning sign mounted on a wooden post, showing a black pedestrian silhouette inside a red prohibition circle and diagonal slash. In the left midground, partially hidden by trees, include 1 dark off-road SUV parked on the snowy roadside. In the right midground, on the ground among the trees, place 1 dead deer with visible antlers. In the distant background between the trunks, include 2 faint, eerie humanoid silhouettes standing still in the forest. Towering pine trees frame the scene on both sides, with steep snow-dusted mountain peaks rising in the background under a clear star-filled sky. From high in the sky near the center-right, a single brilliant vertical beam of pale blue-white light descends from above into the forest, illuminating mist and suggesting a mysterious anomaly. The mood is tense, forbidden, supernatural, and survival-driven, as if for the cover of a thriller or science-fiction graphic novel titled {argument name="title text" default="La Réserve"}. items.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Video Platform UI
items.description: A detailed antique-industrial streaming website mockup for creating retro steampunk interfaces, parody platforms, or stylized historical-tech landing pages.
items.content:
A highly detailed full-screen steampunk video-streaming website interface in a dark bronze, brass, and sepia color palette, designed like an antique Victorian industrial dashboard. The page is framed by ornate metal borders, rivets, pipes, gears, pressure gauges, and glowing Edison bulbs, with rich engraved textures and warm low-key lighting. At the top left, a modern white and red brand mark reads "Pollo AI" with smaller white text "GPT Image 2" beneath it, overlaid on the interface. Centered across the top is a large embossed brass title plaque reading "ElectroVid" with a smaller engraved tagline below, "THE FUTURE IN MOTION". A horizontal navigation bar sits under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search field showing placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." followed by a search icon. On the upper right, include 1 round vintage gauge dial built into the metal frame.

The main content area is split into 2 columns. The left sidebar is a framed panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 stacked channel cards, each with a circular emblem, a channel name, subscriber count, and a brass subscribe button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". Card 1: emblem with an eagle seal, channel name "THE PATENT OFFICE", subscriber text "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 2: emblem with a royal crest, channel name "THE ROYAL SOCIETY", subscriber text "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 3: blue circular GE-style logo, channel name "GENERAL ELECTRIC", subscriber text "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS".

The large central featured video panel has an ornate metal frame and shows a sepia historical scene of two famous inventors in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning illustrations. Their faces are obscured by 2 soft rectangular blur blocks, one over each face. Add an old-film, archival-photo look. Along the bottom of the video frame, show a player control bar with exactly 7 visible UI elements: play icon, volume icon, red progress bar, timestamp "08:47 / 22:31", settings gear, small rectangle screen icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the video, show the title "The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate". Below that, display channel metadata with a small circular avatar, channel name "The Electrical Age", and stats text "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this metadata row, place a brass like button labeled "LIKE" with count "5.8K".

Below, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" above exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row. Card 1: title "My New Incandescent Bulb", thumbnail of a man holding a glowing bulb with his face obscured by 1 blur block, duration label "10:12", creator "Thomas Edison", stats "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", thumbnail of a dramatic Tesla tower under lightning, duration "15:36", creator "Nikola Tesla", stats "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: title "The Automobile Revolution", thumbnail of an early automobile with driver in a city street, duration "12:08", creator "Henry Ford", stats "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the thumbnails, add a centered brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom center, include a footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.". Add additional decorative machinery in the corners and edges, including exposed pipes, cogs, filigree, and 1 more round gauge near the bottom right. The whole composition should feel like a believable antique YouTube homepage reimagined as a Victorian steampunk invention, with crisp readable typography, symmetrical layout, parchment panels, embossed brass UI components, and cinematic sepia contrast.

On the paper, a short French poem is handwritten neatly in elegant cursive with vivid {argument name="ink color" default="blue"} ink. The title at the top center reads {argument name="poem title" default="Pigeon"}. Beneath it are exactly 4 lines of handwriting, centered and evenly spaced: {argument name="poem line 1" default="Oiseau à la grise robe,"}, {argument name="poem line 2" default="Dans l'enfer des villes"}, "À mon regard tu te dérobes", and "Tu es vraiment le plus agile." Keep the handwriting graceful, legible, and natural, like careful fountain-pen calligraphy by hand rather than typography. Soft warm indoor lighting, subtle shadows along the paper edges, visible paper grain, and a simple uncluttered composition focused entirely on the handwritten poem.

items.title: Found-Footage Office Horror Snapshot
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic flash-photo horror scene of two women in a dark security office with a sinister rabbit animatronic lurking in the doorway, ideal for analog-style thriller or mascot-horror imagery.
items.content: A gritty found-footage horror photo taken inside a dim, cramped security office at night, shot with a direct on-camera flash and slight film grain. In the foreground are exactly 2 young women, both partially cropped by the frame and both with their faces heavily blurred into rectangular smudges for privacy. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a black top, turned slightly away from camera. The woman on the right has long platinum blonde hair, a low-cut black top, and is holding a black flashlight angled upward in her right hand. Between them in the lower center foreground is 1 small black metal desk fan with visible circular grill. The background reveals a narrow open doorway centered in the image, leading into almost complete darkness. Standing deep inside that doorway is a terrifying rabbit animatronic silhouette with glowing eyes, long upright ears, a huge toothy grin, and faintly visible metallic body details, barely illuminated so it emerges from the shadows. The office walls are off-white and worn, with a black-and-white checker stripe and a thin red stripe running horizontally across the room. On the left wall is 1 colorful “CELEBRATE!” poster featuring animatronic characters, plus 1 smaller character drawing sheet pinned nearby, and 1 black walkie-talkie standing upright on a surface. Near the doorway is 1 silver desk lamp. On the right side are 2 sheets of paper clipped to the wall and a gray filing cabinet in shadow. The door is ajar with the handle visible. Composition should feel like a candid party snapshot turning into a horror scene, with harsh flash-lit foreground subjects, deep black shadows, analog noise, muted colors, unsettling realism, and the hidden monster in the center background as the main scare.

items.description: This prompt generates a realistic 360-degree tiny-planet drone view of Canakkale's waterfront landmarks, ideal for travel imagery and city-poster visuals.
items.content: A dramatic ultra-wide aerial tiny-planet photograph of {argument name="city name" default="Canakkale"}, Turkey, rendered as a full 360-degree stereographic projection so the city and waterfront form a compact spherical world surrounded by a swirling ring of blue sky and white clouds. The viewpoint is high above the shoreline in bright daytime with crisp summer light, realistic colors, and strong photographic detail. Place the large hillside sign reading {argument name="landmark sign text" default="Canakkale"} prominently across the center of the miniature planet. On the left-upper side of the sphere, show a tall pale stone clock tower with a small red Turkish flag at the top, surrounded by dense urban blocks with red-tiled roofs and mid-rise buildings. On the right side, include a vivid blue harbor with 2 white passenger ferries docked along the waterfront and a long curving coastline extending into the distance. In the lower-right quadrant, feature the monumental dark wooden Trojan horse statue on a circular plaza. In the lower-left quadrant, include the large rectangular concrete memorial structure set within green parkland. Cover the planet with winding pedestrian paths, lawns, trees, and landscaped gardens, with city streets and waterfront promenades visible around the edges. Use a highly realistic drone-photo look, deep depth of field, sharp textures, slightly exaggerated fisheye distortion from the tiny-planet projection, and a majestic travel-poster composition emphasizing the contrast between the green park, historic landmarks, and sparkling sea.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Cliffside Outpost
items.description: This prompt generates a moody dark-fantasy landscape painting of a ruined encampment on a cliff, ideal for worldbuilding art, RPG settings, or ominous book-cover style scenes.
items.content: A dark fantasy matte painting of a bleak hilltop encampment overlooking a vast cursed wasteland at dusk. In the left foreground, a ragged hanging banner reads "The Pale Lodge Outpost" in large black hand-painted letters, attached to wooden poles and weathered by wind. Beside it stands a tall carved totem post topped with a black raven and draped with bones, skulls, and tattered ornaments. The camp itself contains 4 visible canvas tents: 2 large central tents, 1 medium tent on the left, and 1 smaller tent on the right, all in dirty beige fabric with black occult sigils painted on them, held by ropes, spikes, and crooked poles. Around the tents are 5 hooded human figures in dark robes, standing still like sentries or cultists. Near the center-left is a small campfire casting a faint orange glow. In the right foreground sit 2 brass-and-iron astronomical or ritual instruments on stone pedestals, resembling armillary spheres or astrolabes. The ground is uneven black rock at the edge of a cliff, with scattered stakes, lanterns, banners, and ritual posts. Beyond the outpost stretches a desolate valley of ash-colored plains, winding pale waterways, jagged rock spires, and distant mountain silhouettes. On the horizon, slightly right of center, a sinister dark castle rises from a lone hill. The sky is filled with enormous turbulent storm clouds, with 3 flying creatures or birds silhouetted in the distance and a break in the clouds casting cold, sickly light across the landscape. Use a grim, painterly, highly detailed style with muted sepia, charcoal, umber, and gray tones, dramatic atmospheric perspective, cinematic composition, and the mood of a foreboding fantasy frontier outpost at the edge of a dead world.

items.title: Vintage Kyoto Travel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a retro-style Kyoto tourism poster, ideal for travel art prints, editorial covers, or destination-themed wall decor.
items.content: A vintage travel poster for {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}, Japan, designed in a nostalgic mid-century tourism style with a faded paper texture, softly worn edges, and warm sun-aged colors. Use a vertical poster layout with rounded corners and a cream border. At the top, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"} in oversized elegant red serif letters, with “JAPAN” centered below in dark blue serif type and thin decorative divider lines. Add an italic tagline beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}. The main image should show a dramatic low-angle view of a traditional five-story Japanese pagoda in vivid vermilion red with dark wooden eaves and black railings, standing on a stone base with a wooden walkway in the foreground. Surround the pagoda with green wooded hills, a bright blue sky, and soft cream-colored clouds. On the left side, include a vertical red label with white Japanese characters reading “京都、日本”. Also add a blooming cherry blossom branch entering from the left, with clusters of pale pink flowers. In the upper right corner, include a postage stamp featuring a pagoda silhouette in muted red tones, partially overlapped by a circular postal cancellation mark reading “KYOTO JAPAN” with the kanji “京都” in the center and a few wavy postmark lines extending rightward. At the bottom, add a centered vintage footer slogan in serif capitals reading {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}. The overall look should feel romantic, collectible, slightly distressed, and like a classic Japanese tourism print from the 1950s or 1960s.

items.title: Revenge Action Movie Poster
items.description: A dramatic Hollywood-style revenge thriller poster with a gun-wielding protagonist, burning city chaos, bold title typography, and theatrical billing text for promotional key art.
items.content: A gritty, high-contrast cinematic action movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout for a revenge thriller titled {argument name="movie title" default="DEADLINE VENGEANCE"}. The composition is dominated by a large foreground figure of a tough middle-aged man with short dark hair, rugged stubble, and a black leather or tactical jacket, aiming a semi-automatic handgun directly at the viewer from the left side of the frame with strong foreshortening so the gun appears oversized and close to camera. His face is partially obscured in shadow for a mysterious, menacing look. Behind him is a dark modern city skyline at night under stormy clouds, with 1 helicopter in the upper right sky and 1 massive fireball explosion on the right side near the buildings, sending smoke, sparks, and debris into the air. Across the very top, small red uppercase text reads {argument name="top tagline" default="REVENGE IS HIS MISSION"}. On the left-center area, add a stacked white uppercase tagline in 4 lines: {argument name="left tagline" default="THE PAST TOOK EVERYTHING. HE'LL TAKE EVERYTHING BACK."}, styled as 2 short blocks separated by thin red accent lines. Place the main title huge across the lower middle, with 2 words: the first word in enormous distressed metallic-white block letters, and the second word in slightly smaller bold red uppercase letters. In the bottom third, show 1 lone male figure from behind standing in the middle of a wet reflective street, holding a pistol, facing the burning city. Surround him with 4 police vehicles total, 2 on the left and 2 on the right, with flashing lights, plus 2 additional helicopters in the distant sky near the horizon, making 3 helicopters total in the full poster. Include flames along both lower corners, wreckage, smoke, embers, and silhouettes of several armed figures in the distance. At the bottom center, add red uppercase release text {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"} with smaller white text underneath reading {argument name="format line" default="EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX"}. Add a dense strip of tiny fake production credits and a film rating box at the very bottom. Color palette: black, charcoal, steel gray, orange fire, and deep crimson. Style: polished Hollywood blockbuster key art, dramatic rim lighting, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, intense contrast, anamorphic action lighting, smoky atmosphere, explosive urban chaos, premium theatrical poster design.

items.title: Solar System Ice Cream Cones
items.description: This prompt generates a whimsical photorealistic lineup of 8 planet-themed ice cream cones, ideal for surreal food art, creative ad visuals, or social media concept imagery.
items.content: A whimsical, photorealistic product-style food photograph of 8 ice cream cones lined up in a straight row on a matte black rectangular stand, each scoop designed to look like a different planet of the solar system. The scene is shot at eye level with a shallow depth of field and creamy urban bokeh in the background, suggesting an outdoor city street or café setting in soft daylight. From left to right, show exactly 8 cones: a gray speckled Mercury scoop, a yellow-brown swirling Venus scoop, a blue-and-green Earth scoop with white cloud patterns and a small blue drip, a deep red Mars scoop with darker marbling and red melted drips, a striped Jupiter scoop with its Great Red Spot visible, a pale tan Saturn scoop with a thin ring encircling it, a light icy blue Uranus scoop with a blue drip, and a vivid cobalt-blue Neptune scoop with glossy texture and blue dripping melt. Use crisp waffle cones, realistic melting details, glossy frozen surfaces, careful studio-quality lighting, and a centered symmetrical composition. Keep the planets highly recognizable but rendered as believable ice cream, with the black stand spanning the width of the frame and the background softly blurred.

From left to right, show exactly 8 cones: a gray speckled Mercury scoop, a yellow-brown swirling Venus scoop, a blue-and-green Earth scoop with white cloud patterns and a small blue drip, a deep red Mars scoop with darker marbling and red melted drips, a striped Jupiter scoop with its Great Red Spot visible, a pale tan Saturn scoop with a thin ring encircling it, a light icy blue Uranus scoop with a blue drip, and a vivid cobalt-blue Neptune scoop with glossy texture and blue dripping melt. Use crisp waffle cones, realistic melting details, glossy frozen surfaces, careful studio-quality lighting, and a centered symmetrical composition. Keep the planets highly recognizable but rendered as believable ice cream, with the black stand spanning the width of the frame and the background softly blurred.

items.title: Surreal Octopus Burger Fine Dining Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic surreal-horror restaurant snapshot of an octopus-like burger plated at a candlelit fine-dining table, ideal for bizarre food art or uncanny culinary imagery.
items.content: A dark, moody fine-dining restaurant scene photographed with direct flash and a slightly unsettling surreal-horror tone. Center the composition on a plated gourmet sandwich that looks like a realistic octopus used as the filling: a glossy golden-brown sesame burger bun on top of a fleshy pink-purple octopus body with detailed veins, pores, suction cups, wrinkled skin, and several visible tentacles protruding from the sides and front. The creature should appear cooked yet disturbingly lifelike, with one bulbous eye-like form visible on the left side and clustered holes and texture on the right side, creating an uncanny bio-organic appearance. The sandwich sits on a large round white ceramic plate with a pool of yellow butter-like or oily sauce spreading beneath it and a few small reddish droplets mixed into the sauce. In the foreground-left background place a small white dish holding a pat of butter. On the dining table include exactly 6 visible drinking glasses: 2 large red wine glasses, 3 tall white-wine or champagne-style stem glasses, and 1 dark beer glass at the right edge. In the back center place 1 small lit candle in a gold-toned holder and 1 small clear vase with white flowers. Use a white tablecloth, very dim ambient lighting, warm candle glow, strong camera flash reflections on the glassware, shallow casual snapshot framing, and a bizarre upscale restaurant presentation that feels grotesque, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, and intentionally shocking.

items.title: Owl-Shaped Nebula in Deep Space
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic cosmic scene of a nebula naturally resembling an owl, ideal for surreal astronomy art and dramatic sci-fi visuals.
items.content: A majestic deep-space scene of an owl-shaped nebula floating in a black starfield, centered composition, the cosmic gas and dust naturally forming the clear face of an owl. Two large glowing circular eyes with bright electric-blue star cores, a narrow pointed beak of amber light between them, and two long upward-sweeping ear tufts made of burnt-orange and golden-brown nebula pillars. The body is formed from layered translucent clouds of warm copper, sepia, ivory, and cool smoky blue, with soft luminous edges and intricate filament textures. Surround the figure with many sharp stars of varying sizes, including several bright blue-white stars with subtle diffraction spikes. items.title: Surreal Archer With Birds and Animals
items.description: This prompt generates a dreamlike cinematic fashion-style portrait of a masked archer surrounded by birds and animals, useful for surreal editorial or fine-art image creation.
items.content: A surreal cinematic outdoor portrait of a masked archer standing in a dry field under a deep clear blue sky, framed from about the knees up in a wide horizontal composition. The central figure is a woman-like person in a vintage prairie-style dress and matching headscarf, aiming a simple wooden longbow toward the left side of the frame with an arrow drawn back to the cheek. Her face is fully obscured by a soft rectangular blur or blocky censorship patch, creating an uncanny anonymous effect. The dress is sage green with long puffed sleeves, a gathered waist tied with a sash, and a tiny repeating red-and-white floral dot pattern. A red cloth or scarf is wrapped around the lower face and neck beneath the green head covering. Surrounding her are 12 animals total: 8 white birds flying across the sky at different distances, 2 larger white birds standing on the ground at the right side, 1 deer head entering from the lower left foreground, and 1 sheep or goat head entering from the lower right foreground. Add 1 red-headed crane-like bird at the far right edge, visible in profile. The image should feel dreamlike, strange, and symbolic rather than realistic, with crisp midday sunlight, rich saturated colors, soft film grain, and a slightly vintage editorial-photography look. Use low-angle perspective, dynamic diagonal lines from the bow and arrow, and layered animal placement to create tension and motion. Dry grasses appear at the bottom edge, but the background is mostly open sky. Highly detailed fabric folds, natural bird wing positions, and a balanced surreal composition.

items.title: Apple macOS Redesign Promo Mockup
items.description: A sleek Apple-style macOS desktop hero image for keynote slides, product marketing, or UI concept presentations.
items.content: A polished Apple-style macOS promotional desktop mockup shown as a full-screen screenshot, with a soft pastel dawn wallpaper of layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. Centered near the top is a large minimalist headline reading "macOS" with the subheadline "Redesigned." and a smaller line below that says "More clarity. More focus. More you." The top system menu bar is visible across the full width: Apple logo, Finder, File, Edit, View, Go, Window, Help on the left; Wi‑Fi, battery, search, colorful user icon, and the date/time "Mon Jun 10  9:41 AM" on the right. On the left side, stack 4 translucent rounded widgets vertically: a weather widget for "Sonoma, CA" showing "65°", "Sunny", high/low "H:72°  L:55°", and 6 hourly temperatures from 10 AM to 3 PM; an "Up Next" widget with 2 calendar items, "Design Review" and "Lunch with Sophie" with times; a "Focus" widget showing "Do Not Disturb" and "On Until 10:00 AM"; and a "Notes" widget with the note "Website redesign" and time "3:30 PM". In the middle-left foreground, place a Finder window with rounded corners and a light frosted interface, titled "iCloud Drive". Include a left sidebar with 10 items total: Favorites with 6 items "AirDrop", "Recents", "Applications", "Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"; iCloud with 2 items "iCloud Drive" and "Shared"; and Locations with 1 item "Macintosh HD". In the main Finder area show 8 file items arranged in a grid: 4 folders on the top row labeled "Work", "Personal", "Projects", "Presentations", and 4 documents on the bottom row labeled "Brand Guidelines.pdf", "Project Brief.docx", "Research.png", "Moodboard.key". Add standard macOS traffic-light window buttons and small view/search controls in the title bar. On the right side, overlap a Mail app window with a three-column layout. The left mail list column is titled "Inbox" and shows "1237 messages" plus 5 visible senders/messages: "Antonio Manriquez" with subject "Design updates", "Jenny Court" with "Re: Team lunch", "Heather Lee" with "Q3 Planning", "Nisha Kumar" with "Re: Feedback", and "Simon Pickford" with "Offsite ideas". The reading pane shows the selected message from Antonio Manriquez to You with subject "Design updates" and body text about attached mockups for a new feature, plus a file attachment card labeled "Mockups.zip" and "12.4 MB". Use clean SF Pro-style typography, subtle shadows, translucent glassmorphism panels, soft ambient lighting, and a premium Apple keynote aesthetic. At the bottom center, include a glossy translucent macOS Dock with 15 icons: Finder, Launchpad, Safari, Messages, Mail, Calendar showing "JUN 10", Photos, Notes, Reminders, TV, Music, News, App Store, Settings, and Trash. Composition should feel balanced, airy, realistic, and highly refined, like an official Apple macOS redesign announcement image.

items.title: Holographic Kamen Rider Decade SSR Card
items.description: This prompt generates a premium holographic tokusatsu trading card featuring Kamen Rider Decade in a dramatic battle scene, ideal for collectible card art, poster designs, or gacha-style character promos.
items.content: A hyper-detailed premium collectible trading card illustration of {argument name="hero name" default="Kamen Rider Decade"} in the center foreground, posed in a ruined futuristic city battlefield under a dramatic cosmic night sky. The armored hero wears a glossy magenta, black, and white suit with a segmented helmet and large luminous green compound eyes, facing the viewer in a powerful stance. One arm is thrust forward toward the camera, holding up a character card between black gloved fingers so the card is clearly visible in forced perspective; the other hand gives a confident thumbs-up. The belt device is prominent at the waist. Surrounding the hero are exactly 8 secondary figures and monsters scattered through the rubble and midair battle scene: 1 blue-and-red armored rider crouching in the bottom left foreground, 1 red-and-gold armored rider on the right midground, 2 small rider figures in the distant center background, 2 flying figures in the upper background, and 2 monstrous enemy creatures on the right side, one mid-right and one bottom-right. The environment is dense with collapsed buildings, broken concrete, sparks, smoke, debris, and cinematic action lighting. Render the whole image as a luxurious holographic SSR card with an ornate prismatic foil border, glittering rainbow refractions, metallic gold filigree framing, and layered collectible-card UI. At the top center, large embossed title text reads {argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER DECADE"}, with smaller text above reading "MASKED RIDER". In the top right is a large metallic badge reading {argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"} with 5 gold stars beneath it. In the top left and bottom right are 2 circular magenta crest icons. In the lower center is a gold cursive signature reading {argument name="signature text" default="NickZág"}. Along the bottom frame are 4 labeled UI sections: left panel "CARD TYPE" over "CHARACTER", center nameplate "KAMEN RIDER DECADE" with Japanese subtitle "仮面ライダーディケイド", a barcode panel beneath, and right panel "RARITY" over "SSR". Add tiny footer text under the barcode reading {argument name="footer text" default="DECADE COMPLETE 21"}. Style: ultra-detailed tokusatsu hero art, cinematic photoreal armor textures, dramatic depth, explosive action composition, premium gacha card design, holographic foil print effects, sharp focus on the main hero and card, highly polished game-card promotional artwork.

In the center, place the grand main sect complex labeled "玄天剑宗", built on the tallest luminous mountain with white-blue crystal light, ascending pagodas, terraces, and celestial aura; nearby add the smaller label "宗门大殿". Surrounding it, include exactly 9 additional labeled locations distributed across the panorama: on the far left a purple-toned cliff region labeled "问剑崖" with the smaller annotation "弟子历练之地"; left-center a blue misty cultivation platform island labeled "悟道峰" with the smaller annotation "弟子悟道之地"; upper left a solemn hall cluster labeled "藏经阁" with the smaller annotation "典藏无上功法"; upper right a jagged icy mountain sword formation labeled "剑冢" with the smaller annotation "历代剑修终寝之地"; right-center a bright ceremonial complex labeled "演武场" with the smaller annotation "磨砺弟子心性"; lower right-center an alchemy pavilion area labeled "炼丹房" with the smaller annotation "炼丹疗法"; far right a pink flowering valley sanctuary labeled "百花谷" with the smaller annotation "入神绮艳秘境"; bottom right an outer compound labeled "外门" with the smaller annotation "新弟子居所". Add one title inscription in the upper left corner reading "玄天剑宗" in large gold calligraphy, with a smaller poetic line beneath it and a small red seal stamp. Use an elegant painted concept-art style, monumental scale, pale gold and icy blue highlights, soft volumetric fog, dramatic storm-clearing sky, ethereal lighting, and finely rendered Chinese ink-and-digital matte painting aesthetics. No characters in the foreground, no modern elements, just an expansive legendary sect environment designed like a promotional world-building illustration.

items.title: Moonlit Celestial Kimono Dancer
items.description: A luminous fantasy anime portrait of an elegant kimono-clad woman dancing with iridescent magical ribbons under a snowy full moon, ideal for character art or decorative poster imagery.
items.content: A breathtaking fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a celestial shrine maiden"} in a snowy winter night landscape, shown in a graceful full-body dancing pose beside a reflective lake. She has extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="rose pink"} hair, partially seen from the back and side, with an elaborate gold floral hair ornament and dangling chains. Her face is mostly obscured by the angle. She wears a richly layered, ornate Japanese court kimono inspired by a jūnihitoe, with voluminous sleeves and many overlapping panels in crimson, white, purple, green, gold, and soft pink, decorated with floral brocade, embroidered blossoms, metallic trim, and shimmering patterns. Both arms are raised elegantly as she appears to guide 2 huge arcs of translucent iridescent silk or magical ribbon that spiral around her body in a luminous loop, catching rainbow highlights like soap-film aurora light. The ribbons glow with prismatic reflections and tiny sparkles, framing her against the sky. The setting is a moonlit lakeshore covered in fresh snow, with bare winter trees on the right, a small traditional pavilion or shrine structure across the water on the left, and the bright full moon high in a deep indigo sky filled with dense stars and softly falling snow. The water mirrors the moonlight and glittering particles. Emphasize cinematic lighting, ethereal atmosphere, ultra-detailed fabric textures, dynamic flowing motion, magical sparkle effects, elegant composition, and a dreamlike celestial mood. Highly polished anime key visual, vertical composition, intricate detail, luminous highlights, no text, no watermark.

items.title: Futuristic Photonics Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic French-style science magazine cover centered on a glowing photonic chip, ideal for editorial mockups, tech news covers, and speculative science publication designs.
items.content: A hyper-detailed French popular science magazine cover in the style of a bold mainstream newsstand publication, full-page vertical layout, dramatic glossy print design, black background with intense neon lighting and saturated red, blue, purple, green, and orange highlights. At the very top, a wide red masthead bar with the magazine title {argument name="magazine title" default="SCIENCE & VIE"} in huge white serif capital letters with subtle beveling and metallic shine; small issue details on the upper right in tiny white text. On the upper left, a bright yellow and black special tag reading {argument name="special tag" default="SPÉCIAL PHOTONIQUE"} with a red arrow motif. The main headline dominates most of the upper half in gigantic white block capitals with a red glow and slight 3D shadow: {argument name="main headline" default="LA PHOTONIQUE RÉVOLUTIONNE TOUT !"}. Beneath it, 3 short cover lines in smaller white text with selected words highlighted in yellow, discussing ultrafast light-speed chips, a French record computer called Lucy, and light trapped for millions of cycles for energy-efficient AI. Centerpiece image: a futuristic square photonic processor chip floating in space at a slight perspective tilt, extremely detailed circuitry, metallic screws at the corners, glowing traces, and a bright cyan-blue core display labeled {argument name="chip name" default="Lucy"}; the chip emits intersecting beams and flowing fiber-optic light trails in electric blue, magenta, orange, and violet that radiate outward across the page. Background behind the chip shows 2 luminous server-wall corridors, red on the left and green on the right, fading into darkness, suggesting a high-tech datacenter. At the bottom, the curved horizon of Earth from space with a soft blue atmospheric glow and scattered city lights. Add 4 side callout boxes total: 2 stacked on the left and 2 stacked on the right, each with yellow headers and white body text, using a magazine cover typography hierarchy. Left box 1 header: "EXCLUSIF", featuring Lucy as the most powerful French photonic quantum computer in the world, with several short bullet lines and a yellow emphasis on "12 qubits". Left box 2 header: "RECORD MONDIAL", about light trapped for millions of cycles in a chip, with yellow emphasis on "millions de cycles". Right box 1 header area in yellow, with a bold red percentage "+300 %" and text about the French gem Soitec rising thanks to photonic AI and saving datacenters during the energy crisis. Right box 2 header: "ENQUÊTE", about the end of power-hungry GPUs, with yellow-highlighted numeric claims such as 100 times cheaper and 1,000 times faster. Near the lower center, tiny white image-credit text. A thick black bottom banner spans the page with a red square containing a white plus symbol on the left, and a large dossier teaser in white and red text: {argument name="bottom feature text" default="DOSSIER COMPLET Photonique & IA : les 10 avancées qui vont transformer votre quotidien"}. Along the very bottom, add 3 small circular red icon blurbs with short white captions about seismic optical fibers, a new generation of LiDAR and AR, and European sovereignty in progress. Lower right corner includes a white barcode box and a short block of white text about the issue being on sale. Overall look: sensational, prestigious, futuristic, glossy, information-dense, sharp editorial typography, dramatic science-news cover, cinematic lighting, high contrast, photorealistic 3D chip illustration mixed with premium magazine graphic design.

items.title: WWII D-Day Cinematic Poster
items.description: A dark, photoreal war movie poster showing four WWII soldiers above a beach landing scene, ideal for generating dramatic historical film key art.
items.content: A gritty cinematic World War II movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, designed like a modern prestige war film advertisement. At the top, two centered tagline lines in condensed uppercase text read {argument name="top tagline" default="COURAGE. BROTHERHOOD. SACRIFICE."} and {argument name="second tagline" default="VICTORY COMES AT A PRICE."}. The main composition features 4 American WWII soldiers in the foreground wearing dark olive uniforms and large netted M1 helmets: 1 dominant central soldier shown from the chest up, facing forward, flanked by 3 slightly smaller soldiers receding behind him, one on the left and 2 on the right. Their faces are shadowed, dirty, battle-worn, and dramatic, with intense low-key lighting and smoky backlight. Behind them, a stormy war-torn sky filled with heavy smoke columns, sparks, embers, and 2 aircraft groups: 1 group of 3 planes on the upper left and 1 group of 5 planes on the upper right. In the middle, a small centered line of text says {argument name="based on text" default="INSPIRED BY TRUE EVENTS"}. Below it, an enormous distressed title in bold block letters reads {argument name="movie title" default="D-DAY"}, with a star used as the separator between the two D letters. Under the title, a red condensed date line reads {argument name="date text" default="JUNE 6, 1944"}. The lower half shows the D-Day beach landing from the viewpoint inside an open landing craft, with 2 dark metal ramp walls framing the left and right edges. In the surf, exactly 8 soldiers are wading toward shore with rifles and packs, surrounded by Czech hedgehog beach obstacles, rough water, smoke, distant fires, and an embattled coastline under bombardment. At the very bottom is a dense strip of tiny production credits, and beneath that a bold red release line reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}, followed by a smaller white line, "HONOR THEIR SACRIFICE.". Color palette is charcoal gray, steel blue, muddy brown, and fire orange with red accent typography. Ultra-detailed, photoreal, high contrast, moody, epic, historical, dramatic theatrical poster design, realistic film grain, volumetric smoke, distressed textures, symmetrical composition, premium blockbuster key art.

items.title: Cosmic Ink Dragon Roar
items.description: A high-contrast fantasy illustration prompt for generating a fierce close-up dragon portrait with galaxy energy effects and expressive ink-splatter styling.
items.content: A dramatic vertical close-up of a roaring cosmic dragon head in side profile, painted in a violent ink-splatter and brushstroke style on a stark white background. The creature has a long sharp horn, angular armored facial plates, a glowing white-green eye, and a huge open mouth lined with jagged teeth. Inside the mouth and throat, instead of flesh, there is a swirling galaxy-like void of luminous {argument name="energy color" default="violet"} and magenta nebula light, with sparkling stars and dust erupting outward like cosmic fire. The dragon’s body is mostly black and deep indigo with glossy highlights, accented by iridescent emerald reflections along the neck and scales. Use expressive high-contrast sumi-e-inspired strokes, splattered paint textures, torn abstract edges, and explosive particle effects concentrated around the eye, mouth, and upper head. Composition should fill the frame with the head tilted upward in a feral scream, cropped tightly for maximum intensity, with no environment and no extra subjects, just raw abstract energy, ink, and celestial debris.
