items.title: Gritty Evangelion Unit-01 Poster
items.description: This generates a distressed anime-mecha poster featuring a screaming purple biomechanical unit, blueprint overlays, warning graphics, and a small seated pilot figure for collectible print or cover-art use.
items.content: A gritty vertical anime-mecha poster in distressed screen-print style, inspired by retro military dossiers and Evangelion key art. The main subject is a massive close-up side profile of {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"}, dominating the right two-thirds of the composition, facing left with its jaws open in a feral scream. The head is angular and biomechanical, with deep purple armor, olive-green accent plates, black metal inner structures, a single long horn projecting diagonally upward to the left, sharp teeth, and a narrow glowing eye. The surface is scratched, chipped, weathered, and inked with heavy comic-style linework. Behind it is a dark navy blueprint background filled with 8 visible technical diagram clusters, white schematic lines, anatomical overlays, cross-sections, labels, measurement marks, and interface graphics. A violent red paint slash explodes diagonally across the upper center and left side, with additional red drips running downward from the mecha’s mouth area. In the lower left corner, 1 small human figure sits hunched on a gray equipment crate: a teenage boy in a short-sleeve white school shirt, dark pants, and white sneakers, elbows on knees, looking down at a glowing handheld device, conveying isolation and anxiety. Add layered poster typography and warning graphics throughout the border: a torn yellow caution sign in the upper right with Japanese warning text and “CAUTION NERV ONLY”; a tall left sidebar with “01”, barcode-like blocks, hazard icons, and red-black labels; large distressed white kanji vertically stacked over the mecha torso; the word {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"} in spaced red capitals beneath the kanji; a small black label reading “PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”; a bottom-right NERV logo; and footer text such as classified file markings and top secret stamps. Include 6 clearly readable English technical labels in the blueprint area: “TEST TYPE”, “BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”, “AT FIELD”, “MAGI SYSTEM”, “INTERNAL”, and “CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”. Add Japanese dossier text blocks as authentic graphic texture. The palette is limited to dark indigo, black, crimson red, purple, olive green, dirty beige, and off-white. High contrast, torn-paper collage details, halftone texture, ink splatter, cracked paint, and worn print edges. Cinematic, oppressive, chaotic, collectible poster design, ultra-detailed, sharp, textured, no clean modern polish.

items.title: Dark Manga Monster Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a high-contrast psychological horror anime poster with a small frightened boy trapped beneath a giant skeletal biomechanical monster, ideal for dramatic cover art or dark character-themed visuals.
items.content: A dark monochrome manga-style horror illustration on a pure black background, in a tall vertical poster composition. Centered at the bottom is a small lonely teenage boy with messy short dark hair, sitting on the ground with his knees pulled to his chest and his arms wrapped around them, head slightly bowed, conveying fear, isolation, and helplessness. Towering over him is a gigantic biomechanical demon or armored monster head descending from above, with a long angular skull-like face, sharp chin, narrow hollow eye sockets, layered helmet-like plates, and a jagged open mouth. Surrounding the boy are exactly 2 enormous skeletal clawed hands, one on the left and one on the right, framing him like a cage; each hand has long segmented metallic fingers ending in sharp pointed tips, bent inward menacingly. Render everything in rough scratchy white ink linework and heavy crosshatching against deep black, with intense high-contrast seinen manga energy. Add vivid neon purple paint-like liquid in splashes and long dripping streaks from the monster’s face, the hands, and the ground, pooling around the boy for the only strong color accent. On the upper right side, add vertical Japanese text reading 逃げちゃダメだ, and beneath it in small white English text: EGO BORDER: ACTIVE. The mood is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, like a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental collapse.

items.content: A bright, chaotic theatrical comedy movie poster in a polished Hollywood one-sheet style, vertical composition, with a retro yellow Mini Cooper speeding straight toward the viewer down a sunny palm-lined city street. The car is packed with exactly 5 vacationing friends: 2 visible in the front seats, 2 partially visible squeezed in the back, and 1 man sprawled on the roof luggage, pointing dramatically forward with a wild grin. Everyone wears colorful casual vacation clothes, including tropical prints, relaxed shirts, and sun hats. The scene feels loud, reckless, and fun. On the roof are stacked suitcases and travel bags. A police car with flashing lights chases from the rear right background. On the left side, a crooked wooden signpost has exactly 3 signs reading "BEACH", "MOUNTAINS", and "WHAT COULD GO WRONG?". A squawking seagull perches on top of the signpost. On the right side, a giant roadside donut shop sign reads "DONUT" and a folded paper map flies through the air. The street is full of motion blur, dust, debris, and tire energy, with a saturated blue sky and fluffy clouds above. THEY SAW." in dark navy, and "THEY MESSED EVERYTHING UP." in red. Add tiny legal credits along the very bottom edge and small production logos in the corners, including "GOOD TIME FILMS" on the lower left and "NO PLAN ALL FUN" on the lower right. items.content: A dark epic sci-fi movie poster for {argument name="film title" default="EMPIRE OF THE VOID"}, in a highly cinematic photorealistic space-opera style. Centered composition with a tall alien emperor standing behind a massive circular command table, viewed from slightly below to make the figure feel imposing and godlike. The emperor wears ornate black and gunmetal biomechanical armor with sharp layered pauldrons, engraved metallic filigree, a long dark cloak, and a regal elongated helmet-crown. The face is mostly obscured in shadow, giving a mysterious, intimidating presence. One large clawed hand rests prominently on the glowing table in the foreground. The command table displays a luminous spiral galaxy hologram in blue-violet tones, with concentric interface rings and subtle cosmic light. The setting is the bridge of a colossal starship or throne room, with two curved panoramic windows framing outer space. Outside the windows are 8 visible spacecraft total: 4 on the left side and 4 on the right side, including several large battleships and smaller escort vessels. A huge planet fills much of the left background, while the right background shows a purple-blue nebula and starfield. Two secondary alien officers are seated in the mid-background, 1 on the left and 1 on the right, each at glowing futuristic control consoles. The color palette is deep black, steel gray, indigo, violet, and cold blue, with dramatic rim lighting, glossy metallic reflections, and dense atmospheric shadows. The layout should feel like a premium blockbuster poster: a centered top tagline in small uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline" default="INTELLIGENCE. DOMINION. DESTINY. items.title: Ancient Scroll Scholar Riding Dragon
items.description: This prompt generates a classical Chinese scroll-style fantasy portrait of a robed scholar on a dragon with calligraphy and subtle modern AI symbols, ideal for poster art or stylized editorial imagery.
items.content: An ancient Chinese ink-and-wash style portrait on aged tan parchment, composed like a classical hanging scroll. A scholarly East Asian man in flowing gray-blue robes sits side-saddle atop a long serpentine Chinese dragon emerging through swirling clouds. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in parchment-brown tones. He has short dark curly hair and wears layered traditional robes with ornate patterned trim, a dark sash belt, and two modern OpenAI knot emblems worked into the costume: one printed on the chest and one on a round hand fan he holds upright in his right hand. His left hand rests near the dragon's mane as if holding the creature steady. The dragon is large and detailed, with blue-green scales, a pale underbelly, reddish-brown mane and fin accents, antler-like horns, whiskers, bared teeth, and a fierce expressive face in the lower left foreground, while its body coils upward to the upper right. Surround the figures with mist, stylized clouds, and steep craggy mountain peaks fading into the background. Add a vertical column of black Chinese calligraphy at the upper left and 3 red seal stamps near the lower part of the inscription area. The palette is muted, dusty, and antique: parchment beige, faded teal, moss green, smoky gray, sepia, and rust. Overall feeling: mythical, scholarly, dignified, slightly surreal, blending classical Chinese scroll painting with subtle modern AI iconography. Highly detailed brushwork, weathered paper texture, elegant composition, no border, full-frame vertical artwork.

items.title: Surreal Skull and Tree of Consciousness
items.description: A richly detailed surreal fantasy artwork of a skull topped by a glass sphere containing a glowing golden tree and contemplative figure, ideal for concept art about consciousness, mortality, and dreamlike symbolism.
items.content: A surreal, ultra-detailed fantasy illustration of a large weathered human skull rising from dark water, centered in the frame, with the top of the skull opened like a pedestal supporting a giant transparent glass sphere. Inside the sphere stands an intricate luminous tree made of twisting golden branches and roots, with exactly 1 main trunk, dozens of tiny warm glowing orbs embedded among the branches, and many metallic bronze leaves. The roots spread across the base inside the globe and wrap around a small ladder built into the trunk. At the lower left inside the globe, depict exactly 1 translucent seated human figure in a contemplative pose, knees drawn up, head resting on one hand, holding a small glowing flower or crystalline bloom in the other hand. On the lower right inside the globe, include exactly 1 miniature architectural tower-like structure made of delicate gold framework. Surrounding the sphere and background are ornate branch networks with hanging crystal ornaments, faceted gemstones, suspended droplets, circular glass forms, and metallic leaves, all arranged symmetrically but organically. The skull is highly realistic with deep eye sockets, detailed teeth, cracked bone texture, and fine copper-like tubes and circuitry extending from both sides near the temples. In the skull’s right eye socket, show exactly 1 glowing mechanical orrery-like light structure. Place the whole composition in a dreamlike seascape at dusk with calm reflective water, distant rock spires, soft clouds, and a blue-to-gold sky. Use cinematic lighting, high contrast, sharp focus, mystical atmosphere, luxurious gold and bronze filigree, crystal transparency, and a color palette of deep teal, midnight blue, ivory bone, warm amber, and metallic gold. Make it feel like symbolic metacognition, consciousness contained within mortality, blending dark surrealism, baroque ornament, and ethereal sci-fi fantasy.

items.title: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision
items.description: This prompt generates a faux-classical Chinese scroll painting that satirically portrays Google DeepMind as a philosophical vision in an ancient mythic setting.
items.content: A sepia-toned ancient Chinese scroll painting reimagined as a visionary propaganda-style scene. In the center stands a scholarly robed figure styled like an imperial sage or philosopher, wearing flowing blue-gray hanfu with ornate trim, addressing a crowd of exactly 8 followers seen mostly from behind in the foreground. The sage’s face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur, and 3 members of the crowd also have blurred rectangular faces. The central figure raises one hand in a teaching gesture and holds a glowing geometric polyhedron crystal in the other hand. Behind him is a monumental hanging banner or framed plaque displaying the Google DeepMind logo and the words “Google DeepMind.” The background is a richly detailed traditional shanshui landscape with layered mountains, mist, trees, rocky formations, and a pagoda temple on the right. Along the upper right side, include vertical Chinese calligraphy text headed by “德米斯願景圖,” followed by several elegant columns of classical-style writing, plus a smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps. Use aged paper texture, muted brown ink, faded mineral pigments, fine linework, and the composition of a historic Chinese hanging scroll or literati painting, but with subtle anachronistic modern-AI symbolism. The overall mood is solemn, mythic, intellectual, and satirical, blending traditional East Asian art with corporate AI iconography.

items.title: Ancient Scholar AI Safety Poster
items.description: This generates a parchment-style classical Chinese scholar poster with Claude branding and AI safety symbolism, suitable for editorial art, concept posters, or cultural-tech visual essays.
items.content:
A refined sepia-toned illustration in the style of an ancient Chinese scholarly portrait fused with modern AI branding, on aged parchment paper with visible grain and ink-wash texture. Centered is a half-body portrait of a curly-haired male scholar inspired by Democritus, seated behind a wooden desk and wearing layered traditional robes in muted blue-gray and brown with intricate trim. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular block in a brown skin-tone color, creating an anonymized or redacted look. He holds 1 calligraphy brush upright in his right hand, while his left hand rests on the table. In the upper center-right, place the Claude logo with a rust-orange sunburst emblem and the word “Claude” in dark serif lettering. On the upper left, add a large vertical title in Chinese, “德米斯圖”, with 1 vertical column of smaller Chinese calligraphy text beside it reading: “以語言為媒，理解為舟，助人洞見，推動協作，造福人類，安全可信，通往更美好的未來。” Add a smaller vertical signature line on the far left reading “甲辰春寫” with 2 red seal stamps below it. The background shows a classical Chinese landscape painting with distant mountains, a small pavilion on a cliff, mist, and dense bamboo leaves framing the upper right and right edge, plus dark pine branches on the lower left.

The wooden desk fills the lower third and contains exactly 8 distinct object groups: 1 brush pot holding 4 brushes on the left, 1 stack of 4 stitched books with Chinese titles on the spines reading “人工智慧概論”, “機器學習原理”, “負責任的 AI”, and “對齊與價值觀”, 1 ink stone or ink dish near the center-left, 1 central parchment diagram sheet, 1 small dark cube seal near the bottom left with Chinese characters on two visible faces, 1 framed placard on the right, 1 rolled scroll at the bottom right, and 1 tabletop surface with visible wood grain. The central parchment diagram should show a circular node labeled “AI 安全 Safety” connected to 6 surrounding nodes labeled “準確”, “可靠”, “有益”, “透明”, “對齊”, and “隱私”, with delicate cloud motifs around the diagram. The framed placard on the right should read “AI 安全原則” as a header and list 4 bullet points in Chinese: “減少災難性風險”, “尊重人類價值觀”, “確保系統可控”, and “促進長遠福祉”. The rolled scroll at the bottom right should display the phrase “以謹慎之心 創造未來”.

Use a balanced composition, scholarly calm mood, highly detailed ink linework, subtle watercolor shading, antique museum-print aesthetics, and a restrained palette of parchment tan, ink brown, faded blue, and muted charcoal. The overall feeling should be an intellectual tribute poster blending classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI safety themes.

items.title: Classical Chinese Scholar with XAI Motif
items.description: This prompt generates a faux-ancient Chinese scroll painting that blends a robed scholar portrait with XAI branding, a rocket launch, and scholarly scientific symbolism.
items.content: A refined Chinese ink-painting style portrait on aged parchment, composed like a classical literati hanging scroll with muted sepia, tan, charcoal, and faded indigo tones. In the center stands a scholarly male figure in flowing dark blue-black Hanfu robes with intricate gold-patterned trim and wide cream inner sleeves, posed front-facing with a dignified stance. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blurred block, while his hair is dark, wavy, and neatly styled. He holds a stitched traditional-style book against his chest with a vertical cover inscription that includes the large Latin letters "XAI" and 4 Chinese text columns beneath it. His other hand rests on an ornate armillary sphere set on a carved pedestal at the lower left. Behind him is a monumental shanshui landscape of 1 mountain range, layered mist, rocky peaks, and drifting clouds, rendered with fine brushwork in an old master style. In the upper right sky area, place 1 bold modern "XAI" logo with the stylized emblem above the letters, and to the far right include 1 slender rocket launching upward beside a launch tower, with smoke billowing into the clouds, blending futuristic aerospace imagery into the classical scene. On the upper left, add 1 vertical column group of Chinese calligraphy title text in black ink, plus 1 smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps beneath it. The overall effect should fuse ancient Chinese scholar portraiture with space-age technology and AI symbolism, highly detailed, elegant, balanced, and slightly satirical, with the texture of antique paper and the composition of a museum-quality scroll painting.

items.title: Surreal Lunar Horse Rider
items.description: A photoreal black-and-white surreal scene of a horse riding an astronaut on the moon, ideal for absurdist fine-art or retro space photography prompts.
items.content: A surreal black-and-white photograph of a {argument name="horse color" default="white"} horse riding an astronaut on the moon. The astronaut in a bulky {argument name="spacesuit color" default="white"} EVA suit is on all fours on the dusty lunar surface, acting like a mount, while the horse sits upright on the astronaut’s back in a humanlike riding posture with its front legs raised and bent as if holding balance. The horse wears a saddle and bridle with reins draped down toward the astronaut. The astronaut’s helmet has a dark reflective visor, and the figure is facing slightly right with hands and knees pressed into the regolith. The landscape is a barren moon terrain with scattered rocks and gentle low hills, under a completely black sky with no stars visible. Strong directional lighting creates crisp shadows and high contrast, mimicking documentary Apollo-era lunar photography. Center the paired subjects in a medium-wide composition, realistic textures, deadpan absurdity, photorealistic detail, vintage monochrome film look.

items.title: Visit Malaysia 2026 Travel Poster
items.description: A premium vertical tourism poster showcasing Malaysia’s landmarks, culture, and tropical beauty, ideal for destination marketing and campaign visuals.
items.content: A luxurious tourism poster for {argument name="destination" default="Malaysia"}, designed as a vertical fine-art travel advertisement on a clean ivory-white textured background with subtle embossed ornamental patterns. The composition is built around one long flowing red-and-gold batik silk ribbon that sweeps diagonally and spirals through the page, forming an elegant S-curve and visually containing a dreamlike collage of landmarks, culture, and nature. At the top left, warm golden sunrise light pours over misty tropical mountains and rainforest with a waterfall, dense palms, and a large rhinoceros hornbill perched beside hibiscus flowers and white tropical blossoms. In the upper center, a detailed Kuala Lumpur skyline rises from mist, dominated by the Petronas Twin Towers, with the KL Tower and several modern skyscrapers visible. Near the upper right floats 1 colorful traditional wau kite with floral patterns against open white space. In the middle left, include 1 grand mosque with multiple domes and minarets set among palms and haze. In the middle center-right, include the historic Sultan Abdul Samad Building with its copper domes and clocktower. In the lower middle left, include 1 elevated red-and-silver urban train crossing through the city. In the lower center, show 1 ornate Chinatown gate labeled Jalan Petaling, decorated with red lanterns and bustling pedestrians. In the lower right-middle, depict the Batu Caves area with 1 towering golden Murugan statue and 1 steep rainbow staircase climbing into limestone cliffs, surrounded by crowds. At the lower right, nestle 1 landscaped city park with a turquoise lake and fountains. Purple orchids and tropical flowers are woven into the ribbon and foreground in several places. At the very bottom right, show 1 small traditional dancer in red and gold attire twirling the trailing end of the ribbon. The collage should feel luminous, hyper-detailed, majestic, and celebratory, blending photorealistic architecture with painterly fantasy travel-poster styling, soft clouds, atmospheric haze, and glowing highlights. Add elegant poster typography in the lower left: the main headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"}, a smaller location line reads {argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"}, a blue script tourism slogan reads {argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"}, and below that a small refined subheading reads {argument name="subheading" default="Where Diversity Converges\nKuala Lumpur, City of Wonders\nThe Heart of Asia"}. Use a premium color palette of gold, crimson, ivory, emerald, sky blue, and tropical greens, with polished editorial composition and high-end destination-branding aesthetics.

items.title: Epic Senna vs Prost Gladiator Poster
items.description: A dramatic vintage-style motorsport poster depicting Senna and Prost as mythic gladiator rivals, ideal for recreating cinematic tribute art or high-impact F1 legend posters.
items.content: An epic cinematic poster in a dark golden bronze palette, styled like a mythic gladiator movie poster merged with vintage Formula 1 iconography. Two legendary rival drivers face away from each other in mirrored side-profile bust portraits at the top half of the image, one on the left inspired by Ayrton Senna and one on the right inspired by Alain Prost, both depicted as heroic Roman gladiators with weathered bronze armor, dramatic shoulder plates, and racing colors draped as cloaks. The left figure wears green, yellow, and blue accents, and the right figure wears blue, white, and red accents. Their faces are mostly in shadow, lit by intense backlight through storm clouds, creating a solemn, monumental mood. Behind each driver hangs 1 vertical banner, for a total of 2 banners: the left banner is dark green with a large gold S, the text "SENNA", "#12", and a cursive signature; the right banner is dark blue with a large gold P, the text "PROST", "#1", and a cursive signature. Centered near the top, in elegant serif French text, place the line "DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE." with a small gold Formula 1 emblem and laurel motif below it. In the central sky, add 2 stacked lines of French text reading "RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE." and "LÉGENDES POUR TOUJOURS." The main title dominates the middle in huge metallic serif lettering: "{argument name="headline text" default="SENNA vs PROST"}", with a sword-like vertical separator for "vs". Beneath it, a subtitle in French reads "LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1". The lower half shows a colossal Roman colosseum packed with spectators, flags, arches, dust, smoke, and dramatic perspective lines converging on the center. At the exact center of the arena stands 1 large victory banner with the words "VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR" in gold. In the foreground, place 2 front-facing late-1980s Formula 1 cars charging toward the viewer on a dirt-covered arena floor, throwing dust. The left car is associated with Senna and features red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 12 on the nose, with the driver wearing a yellow helmet. The right car is associated with Prost and features matching red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 1 on the nose, with the driver wearing a white helmet. At the very bottom, add the line "1988. 1989. 1990." and below it "L’HISTOIRE S’ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H." Include a small ornamental laurel decoration under the final line. Use hyper-detailed textures, dramatic storm clouds, god rays, flying dust, intense contrast, symmetrical composition, ultra-polished poster design, heroic scale, and a timeless legendary atmosphere.

items.title: Storm Wizard Casting Lightning
items.description: A cinematic photorealistic fantasy prompt for generating a dramatic wizard portrait with storm lighting and crackling magical energy.
items.content: A dramatic dark-fantasy portrait of an elderly wizard standing in a stormy wasteland under a black, cloud-choked sky. He wears a tall, weathered pointed hat with a brown leather band and a tiny metal clasp, and a heavy dark blue-gray robe with wide sleeves. His face is mostly hidden in shadow beneath the hat brim, with long strands of glowing {argument name="accent hair color" default="electric blue"} hair peeking out at the sides and a very long flowing silver-white beard reaching down his chest. The wizard thrusts his left hand toward the camera in a powerful forced-perspective pose, fingers spread, conjuring a bright orb of blue-white magical energy in his palm with crackling lightning arcs wrapping around the hand and sleeve. In his right arm he clutches a large ancient leather spellbook with worn corners, metal fittings, embossed arcane markings on the cover, and a few pages visible. The background shows a barren dark landscape and exactly 1 prominent lightning bolt striking on the right side of the frame. Cinematic high-contrast lighting, hyper-detailed skin and fabric texture, moody photorealism, sharp focus on the hand and beard, intense fantasy atmosphere, centered composition, square crop.

items.content: A photorealistic, cinematic vertical portrait of a medieval or fantasy woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long copper-red hair"}, shown from the chest up, gently embracing a large white ram. items.title: Spanish Sports Newspaper Front Page
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic dramatic Spanish sports newspaper cover, useful for editorial mockups, media design concepts, or football news visualizations.
items.content: A realistic Spanish sports newspaper front page in the style of a major daily broadsheet, clean white background with strong red and black typography, editorial print layout, high-resolution scanned-paper look. At the very top, an oversized red masthead reading {argument name="newspaper name" default="MARCA"} spans nearly the full width, with a small black price in the upper-right corner reading {argument name="price" default="2,50€"}. Beneath the masthead, a thin line of small black publication details includes a Tuesday date, website, year, and issue number. The dominant main headline on the left takes up most of the page in gigantic bold condensed black uppercase letters over two lines: {argument name="main headline" default="ARBELOA, DESTITUIDO"}. Below it, a red subheadline in bold sentence case says that Real Madrid dismisses the coach after 100 days on the bench and seeks a replacement until the end of the season. A smaller black explanatory line underneath mentions the decision following Champions League elimination and loss of the LaLiga lead. The main photo occupies the lower-left majority of the cover: a suited football coach standing in a stadium with blue seats, one hand touching his forehead in a stressed or disappointed gesture, wearing a dark navy suit, white shirt, and dark tie, with the Bernabéu environment visible and a pitch-side barrier reading Real Madrid C. F. Along the bottom of the main image, a small caption line notes that the coach leaves the Bernabéu after learning the decision. At the very bottom left and center are 2 narrow columns of small black article text in Spanish newspaper style. To the right side, a vertical sidebar contains 2 stacked secondary stories separated by red divider lines. The top sidebar story has a red section label reading NBA PLAYOFFS, a bold black headline saying the Lakers force game seven, a rectangular action photo of 2 basketball players with a Lakers player in a purple number 77 jersey going up with the ball against a Nuggets defender, and a short caption below mentioning Doncic scoring 42 points in Denver. The lower sidebar story has a red section label reading TENIS · MUTUA MADRID OPEN, a bold black headline about Alcaraz dominating at the Caja Mágica, and a rectangular tennis photo of a player in light purple kit hitting a forehand against a bright blue backdrop. Near the bottom center-right, include a pull-quote box marked by large red quotation marks and bold black text reading {argument name="pull quote" default="Agradezco al club la oportunidad de mi vida"}. Overall composition should feel like an authentic dramatic sports front page: sharp print typography, rigid newspaper grid, realistic photojournalism, heavy black headline blocks, red accents, and a contemporary Spanish press design.

items.description: This prompt generates a realistic parody sports newspaper cover in Spanish, ideal for humorous football transfer mockups and tabloid-style editorial images.
items.content: A satirical Spanish sports newspaper front page designed like a tabloid cover, full-frame and perfectly frontal, on slightly aged off-white newsprint with subtle paper texture, faint stains, and narrow black border lines. The masthead is a huge red SPORT logo across the top on a bright yellow banner. In the upper right, include 1 small interview promo box with a headshot of a footballer and the text block in Spanish: “ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”. Under the masthead, add a yellow strip with bold black text “EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL” and a small red lightning bolt. The main headline dominates the page in gigantic black condensed uppercase letters over 2 lines: “LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”. Beneath it, add the subheadline in italic black Spanish text: “El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”. The main photo occupies the left-center and lower-middle of the page: a young footballer seen mostly from the back wearing a Barcelona home jersey in blue and garnet stripes, with the name “LAMILE” and the number “10” in large yellow lettering, standing in a celebratory stadium scene with confetti, bright lights, blurred fans, and people around him. He is holding or presenting a large bingo card board with the word “BINGO” at the top and “BINGO!” at the bottom. On the right side, create a vertical sidebar with 4 stacked content blocks: first, a photo of a calamari sandwich on a plate with the caption “El motivo del fichaje”; second, a red info box listing 3 humorous transfer facts in yellow and white text, exactly “EDAD: muy joven”, “FICHAJE: 4 cartones”, and “CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís”; third, a quotes column with 3 stacked mini-items, each with a small portrait and Spanish caption: “XAVI: ‘No me lo esperaba, pero respeto’”, “LAPORTA: ‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”, and “EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”; fourth, a small motorsport teaser at the bottom with a driver image and the text “FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”. Along the bottom strip, include 3 small teaser panels: 1 woman footballer holding a trophy with the text “CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”, 1 basketball panel with two Barça players and the text “BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”, and the Formula 1 teaser panel already integrated at the right edge. Add tiny newspaper metadata below the masthead on the left in Spanish, including issue number, date, and price, such as “Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”. The overall style should be hyper-realistic printed newspaper cover photography and editorial layout, with authentic magazine typography, strong black headlines, saturated sports-photo colors, comedic transfer-rumor parody tone, and seamless believable print design.

items.title: Agritech magazine cover from app screenshot
items.description: This prompt turns a mobile app screenshot into a realistic Spanish-language agricultural magazine cover, useful for product marketing, launch visuals, and editorial-style mockups.
items.content: Using the provided reference image of the mobile app screen, transform it into a premium editorial magazine cover mockup about agricultural innovation. Keep the app UI recognizable on the phone display, but place it in a realistic lifestyle context: a vineyard worker in the foreground holding a smartphone that shows the app, with vineyard rows, mountains, and a few workers in the background under natural daylight. Design the full page as a Spanish-language magazine cover with a refined agricultural-business aesthetic in green, cream, and earthy tones. Add a large masthead at the top reading “REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”, a thin top strapline with 3 items separated by vertical bars: “Especial Viñas de Chile”, “Innovación agrícola”, and “Abril 2026”, plus a subtitle line beneath the masthead: “Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”. On the left, add a green section tag reading “TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA” and a bold stacked main cover headline: “La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”, followed by a short deck about Kimün replacing the traditional notebook and giving real-time control to vineyards and agricultural businesses. Add a circular callout badge mentioning a special feature about Kimün as an intelligent field notebook with AI. Include 2 bottom teaser photos: one close-up of the worker holding the phone in the vineyard with page label “p.18” and a caption about field diagnosis and cellphone alerts, and one small group scene with 3 people reviewing the app together with page label “p.24” and a caption about connected field teams, voice, records, and instant costs. On the right column, add 3 article teasers with icons and page numbers: one about the end of paper and the new era of the intelligent field notebook (p.30), one about more efficient vineyards through better data-driven decisions (p.36), and one about water management 4.0 and smarter, more profitable irrigation (p.42). Add a footer strip with 5 category labels: “AGRICULTURA”, “FRUTALES”, “VIÑAS”, “GANADERÍA”, “SUSTENTABILIDAD”, plus a barcode and a small price. Make it look like a polished real magazine cover photo shoot and editorial layout, not a flat app screenshot.

items.description: This prompt generates an elegant minimalist cover for a classical religious or philosophical book, ideal for literary editions and devotional publishing.
items.content: A minimalist classical book cover in vertical format on a warm ivory or parchment background. At the top center, set the title in elegant large dark navy serif type across 2 lines: {argument name="title text" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}. Beneath it, centered with generous spacing, place a small gold phi symbol. In the upper-middle area, draw a delicate thin-line gold illustration of a fortified circular heavenly city with exactly 8 visible outer towers or gate structures, crenelated walls, and compact classical buildings inside, including a central dome. From the bottom center of this city, extend a soft vertical gold beam of light downward. In the lower-middle area, create thin dark navy line art of earthly classical ruins: the Roman Colosseum on the left, a large Greek or Roman temple with a triangular pediment and a long row of columns on the right, a broken fallen column in front, a small stone block near it, and an arched ruin structure spanning the lower left. Keep the composition symmetrical and airy, with lots of empty space, refined editorial balance, and subtle contrast between gold heavenly imagery and dark navy earthly architecture. At the bottom center, place the author name in matching dark navy serif type: {argument name="author name" default="San Agustín de Hipona"}. Clean premium literary design, sacred philosophy aesthetic, no extra text, no texture-heavy effects, no photographic elements.

items.title: Classical Cover for The City of God
items.description: This prompt generates a refined literary book cover with celestial gold line art above Roman ruins, ideal for classic theology, philosophy, or historical works.
items.content: A minimalist, elegant vintage book cover design on warm ivory textured paper for {argument name="book title" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}. Center the title near the top in large classical serif typography, dark navy blue, with refined spacing and a literary feel. Directly below it, place 1 small eight-point star in gold. In the upper middle, illustrate a heavenly walled city floating on clouds, drawn as delicate gold line art: a symmetrical sacred city with 1 central domed cathedral, many clustered towers, spires, walls, and gates, surrounded by soft clouds, with radiant sunburst lines spreading outward behind it. From the central gate of the celestial city, send down 1 vertical column of thin golden light beams toward the lower half of the cover. In the bottom third, depict an earthly ancient Roman landscape in fine blue-gray ink line art: 5 main architectural ruins and monuments arranged horizontally, including a long arcade on the left, a classical temple with columns near left-center, a domed building in the middle, a bell tower and surrounding ruins near right-center, and a colosseum-like ruin on the far right, plus a broken fallen column drum in the right foreground and sparse shrubs and ground texture. Keep the composition airy, symmetrical, and contemplative, with abundant negative space between heaven and earth. Place the author name {argument name="author name" default="SAN AGUSTÍN DE HIPONA"} centered at the bottom in spaced small caps serif, dark navy blue. Use only 3 visible text elements total: the title, the author name, and no subtitle. Palette limited to ivory, gold, and dark navy blue, with precise engraved linework and a sacred, timeless, classical theological mood.

items.title: Premium Futuristic AI Workspace
items.description: A cinematic concept image of a luxury AI-powered command desk with holographic interfaces, ideal for illustrating next-generation software, creative tools, or tech product marketing.
items.content: A cinematic futuristic control-room workspace in a dark premium tech aesthetic, viewed from behind a single person seated at a sleek desk, centered in the foreground, facing a wall of floating transparent holographic interface panels. The scene is illuminated by electric blue and cyan light on a nearly black background, with a brilliant glowing AI core or neural sphere at the center of the composition slightly above the desk line, radiating dozens of branching luminous data streams that connect to every screen like a digital nervous system. The person is a silhouetted professional wearing dark clothing in a modern office chair, framed symmetrically to emphasize scale and immersion. On the desk are 3 main desktop monitors filled with code and technical dashboards, 1 open laptop on the left, 1 slim task lamp on the right, 1 coffee mug, and a few minimal office accessories. Surrounding the figure are exactly 10 large floating UI windows: 1 left vertical profile/navigation panel with a circular avatar and the name {argument name="character name" default="ALEXANDER"}, plus menu items; 1 upper-left project information card titled {argument name="project name" default="PROJECT CHRONOS"}; 1 top-center code editor window titled "CODE SYNTHESIS" showing dense programming text; 1 upper-center-right assistant panel titled "AI ASSISTANT" with a glowing waveform and short chat text; 1 upper-right data window titled "DATA STREAM"; 1 mid-left media generation panel titled "GENERATING VISUAL ASSET" showing a dramatic sci-fi landscape with tall rock spires and multiple thumbnail previews beneath; 1 small central progress card titled "EXECUTING WORKFLOW" with progress bars; 1 mid-right world map analytics panel titled "GLOBAL NETWORK" with glowing connection points; 1 lower-left engineering render panel titled "3D MODEL RENDER" displaying a futuristic mechanical engine or spacecraft component; 1 lower-right dashboard titled "SYSTEM MONITOR" with circular percentage charts and graphs. Also include exactly 2 smaller side panels: 1 lower-left voice panel titled "VOICE INTERFACE" with waveform visualization, and 1 right-side narrow panel titled "ACTIVITY LOG" with status entries. Add several tiny floating micro-cards and image thumbnails scattered between the main windows, connected by light trails, to suggest multitasking AI orchestration. The interface design should feel ultra-polished, glassmorphic, transparent, edge-lit, and premium, with thin neon borders, subtle grid lines, small icons, and high-end sci-fi UI typography. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, deep depth, crisp detail, volumetric glow, reflective surfaces, and a balanced symmetrical layout centered on the radiant AI nexus. The overall mood is visionary, luxurious, and intelligent, like {argument name="headline text" default="the future of creative AI interfaces"} made real, combining software engineering, generative design, global connectivity, and autonomous workflow management in one immersive scene.

items.title: Minimal Studio Seated Fashion Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic vertical studio-style portrait of a seated woman in a coordinated brown outfit, useful for fashion editorials, lookbooks, and soft minimalist portrait imagery.
items.content: A realistic indoor fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman seated on a simple black folding chair, framed from head to upper thighs in a vertical composition. She has dark brown to nearly black hair parted in the center and tied back into a low ponytail, with a few soft loose strands near the ears, and small delicate earrings. Her face is intentionally obscured and featureless, with no visible eyes, nose, or mouth detail. She wears a fitted ribbed zip-front crop top in {argument name="top color" default="deep chocolate brown"}, with a collar, three-quarter sleeves, and the zipper partially open to create a deep neckline, paired with high-waisted straight-leg pants in a matching {argument name="pants color" default="brown"}. Her body is angled slightly toward the camera with relaxed shoulders, hands resting together between her knees, conveying a calm casual studio pose. The background is a soft off-white draped fabric curtain with gentle folds, lit by diffused natural window light for a clean, minimalist studio look. Emphasize realistic skin texture, soft shadows, neutral warm tones, shallow depth of field, and polished high-end fashion photography styling.

items.content: Create a vertical printable educational worksheet in Brazilian Portuguese, clean white background, playful classroom design, centered composition, bold rounded typography, bright kid-friendly colors. At the very top, a large navy-blue headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="DOMINÓ DA MULTIPLICAÇÃO"}, with small yellow decorative rays on both sides. Below it, a purple ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="CONECTE A CONTA AO RESULTADO!"}. The main area shows 40 domino-style tiles arranged in a 4-column by 10-row grid, evenly spaced. Each tile is a horizontal rounded rectangle with a thin colorful outline, white fill, a vertical divider at the center, and a small black dot on the divider. The left half contains either a number result or the word "INÍCIO" on the first tile, and the right half contains a multiplication expression. Use alternating border colors across the grid such as purple, green, blue, orange, pink, and yellow. At the bottom, add a large rounded dashed purple box spanning most of the width. Inside the left side of this box, place the section title "COMO JOGAR:" in bold purple uppercase, followed by 5 bullet points in black: "Coloque a peça “INÍCIO” na mesa.", "Os jogadores, na sua vez, devem encaixar uma peça cuja conta seja igual ao número da ponta livre.", "Se não tiver peça para jogar, compre do monte.", and "Vence quem ficar sem peças!". On the right side of the same box, add the title "EXEMPLO DE INÍCIO:" in purple uppercase and show 4 small domino tiles in sequence plus ellipsis: "INÍCIO | 1 × 1", then "1 | 1 × 2", then "2 | 1 × 3", then "3 | 1 × 4", followed by "...". Keep the overall style crisp, vector-like, printable, friendly for elementary math practice, with balanced spacing and highly legible text.

items.title: Multiplication Domino Classroom Activity
items.description: A realistic classroom photo showing children using a colorful multiplication domino board game, ideal for educational materials, school promotions, or math activity visuals.
items.content: A realistic documentary-style photo of an elementary school classroom during a math activity, with about 10 children seated around grouped wooden desks, wearing green and blue school uniforms, actively playing a colorful multiplication domino game. The camera is at child eye level, slightly angled downward toward the main table in the foreground. Center the scene on one square educational board game labeled in Portuguese, with the title "DOMINÓ DA MULTIPLICAÇÃO" on the lower edge and "TREINANDO AS TABUADAS" in the center, surrounded by a border of brightly colored domino-style multiplication tiles. Show 4 children clearly engaged around this main board: one child placing a yellow tile onto the board, one child holding a stack of multicolored tiles, one child watching from the left, and one child in a blue sleeve at the bottom edge arranging pieces. Include 2 shallow wooden boxes labeled "JOGO DE DOMINÓ," one near the center-left and one at the bottom-right, each containing colorful rectangular domino pieces. Scatter school materials naturally on the desks: 3 pencils, 2 worksheets, 1 water bottle, pencil cases, notebooks, and extra game tiles. In the background, show the rest of the classroom softly out of focus with additional students at desks, a bookshelf, a corkboard filled with children’s drawings, and a large multiplication chart poster on the left wall reading "TABUADA DE MULTIPLICAÇÃO." Bright natural daylight enters from tall windows on the right, giving the room a warm, lively, authentic school atmosphere. The educational board and tiles should use vivid classroom colors like yellow, blue, pink, green, and orange. Faces should be unobtrusive or de-emphasized, with the focus on hands-on learning, collaboration, and the multiplication domino activity. Vertical composition, highly realistic photography, candid classroom moment, sharp foreground details, soft depth of field in the background.

items.title: Fashion Portrait With Python
items.description: A sleek editorial-style studio image of a woman in a black dress crouching while a large python is draped around her shoulders, suitable for fashion, glamour, or dramatic animal portrait concepts.
items.content: A high-fashion studio portrait of a glamorous woman crouching low in a squat pose against a seamless light gray background, wearing a black long-sleeve deep-plunge mini dress and black pointed high heels. She has long, voluminous wavy dark brown hair, medium tan skin, dark red manicured nails, and large gold hoop earrings. A single large python with brown, tan, and black patterned scales is draped around her shoulders like a living stole, with its thick body looping down both sides of her torso and its head hanging at the center between her knees near her hands. The composition is centered and symmetrical, shot full body in a vertical frame, with clean editorial lighting, sharp detail on skin, fabric, and snake scales, minimal shadows, luxury fashion photography style, confident sensual pose, plain uncluttered background.

items.title: Historical WWII Photo Colorization
items.description: This prompt restores a black-and-white wartime reference photo into a realistic, historically accurate colorized image for archival, editorial, or educational use.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, colorize the original black-and-white WWII paratrooper photo into a realistic, historically accurate color restoration. Preserve the exact composition, pose, gear, weapon, cropped face block, background, and photographic framing. Add natural period-appropriate colors: khaki/tan uniform and jump gear, olive drab pack, brown leather boots and straps, wood-toned rifle stock, dark metal gun body, muted earth tones for the dirt road and building, green trees, and a soft pale blue sky. Make the 82nd Airborne shoulder patch historically correct with 1 visible patch in red, white, and blue. Keep the result looking like a faithful documentary-era restoration rather than a modern stylized repaint.

items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical anime action poster of a blindfolded white-haired sorcerer with explosive blue energy and a bold manga speech bubble, ideal for stylized character art or fandom-inspired visuals.
items.content: A high-impact shonen manga anime illustration of a powerful white-haired sorcerer in a dramatic low-angle full-body pose, laughing with his head thrown back and mouth wide open, wearing a sleek black high-collar uniform and a black blindfold over his eyes. His left hand is thrust toward the viewer making a two-finger peace sign, with strong foreshortening that makes the hand large in the foreground, while his right arm hangs lower at his side. Surround him with explosive {argument name="energy color" default="electric blue"} supernatural energy, violent brushstroke-like aura trails, flying debris, sparks, and swirling curved streaks cutting across the frame. On the right side, add 1 large jagged white manga speech bubble with thick black outline containing the text {argument name="speech bubble text" default="LUDDITES ALWAYS LOSE!"} in huge distressed black uppercase letters. Vertical composition, dynamic action poster framing, confident triumphant attitude, modern dark fantasy anime aesthetic.

His face is partially obscured by a rectangular blur/censor block centered over the eyes and nose area, while his spiky silver-white hair fans outward dramatically above a dark blindfold or visor. items.title: Leonardo Painting the Mona Lisa
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic historical scene of Leonardo da Vinci painting the Mona Lisa from a live model, ideal for dramatic fine-art and Renaissance-themed visuals.
items.content: A cinematic Renaissance art studio interior lit by soft warm window light, showing an elderly Leonardo da Vinci-like painter in left profile, seated at an easel and painting the Mona Lisa from a live model. The painter has long gray hair, a full gray beard, and wears a dark period cap and heavy dark robe. In the center foreground stands a large canvas on a wooden easel displaying the Mona Lisa composition, while on the right a live female sitter poses in the same iconic posture with folded hands, wearing a dark Renaissance dress and veil-like drapery. The mood is intimate, quiet, and painterly, with rich brown and amber tones, dramatic chiaroscuro, aged plaster walls, a leaded-glass window on the left, and a wooden table in the back holding brushes and studies. Include 2 portrait sketches pinned or propped in the background behind the model. In the lower right foreground, show a cluttered painter’s worktable with 1 paint palette, multiple small paint dabs, several brushes in a cup, and a few shallow bowls. Compose the scene as a realistic historical photograph of the moment the masterpiece is being created, medium-wide shot, slightly over-the-shoulder from behind the artist, extremely detailed textures, old master atmosphere, soft focus falloff, no modern objects.

items.title: Cute Bunny Hiragana Poster
items.description: A whimsical Japanese hiragana learning chart with 40 bunny-illustrated cells, ideal for classroom decor, children's materials, or playful presentation covers.
items.content: Create a cute Japanese preschool hiragana poster in a soft watercolor storybook style on warm textured parchment paper. The composition is a vertical educational chart with a whimsical spring border of grass, flowers, mushrooms, butterflies, and tiny chicks, designed like a children's classroom learning sheet. At the top, place a wooden signboard header with colorful rounded Japanese text reading {argument name="headline text" default="うさぎのひらがな表"}, decorated with 2 white bunny mascots, one sitting on the left and one peeking from the right, plus small flowers and leaves around the sign. Below the header, arrange a clean 5-row by 8-column grid for a total of 40 square cells, each cell outlined in thin brown lines on a cream background. In every cell, place one large brightly colored hiragana character near the top and one small kawaii rabbit illustration below it, each rabbit acting out or holding an object associated with the word written underneath. Use a different cheerful color for many of the hiragana characters, including reds, oranges, yellows, greens, blues, and purples, with a hand-painted rounded font. Keep the text and illustrations exactly as follows, left to right by row: row 1 has 8 cells labeled あ, い, う, う, え, え, お, お with the words あめ, いい, いい, うさぎ, えんぴつ, えんぴつ, おやすり, おにぎり; row 2 has 8 cells labeled か, き, く, け, せ, せ, そ, そ with the words きくら, たま, サベツン, ケーキ, せんせい, そう, そう, しょうこう; row 3 has 8 cells labeled た, ち, ち, つ, て, て, と, と with the words たまご, たまご, ちびこ, つと, てんとうむし, てしなを, とうこ, ほしい; row 4 has 8 cells labeled な, に, ぬ, ふ, め, ね, の, ほ with the words まな, ひこうき, みんきう, ふたう, てつ, へびす, ようこ, ほし; row 5 has 8 cells labeled ま, み, む, る, れ, れ, ろ, ん with the words わた, まくら, みかん, むぎぎ, めがみ, もも, ろうた, ん. The bunny illustrations should be varied and adorable: examples include holding an umbrella, cuddling grapes, drawing with a pencil, eating a rice ball, sitting with cherry blossoms, standing under an umbrella, holding fruit, eating cake, dressed as a teacher, holding flowers, sleeping under a blue blanket, carrying eggs, hugging a tomato, holding strawberries, blowing bubbles, wearing a blue cap, holding an orange, sitting with cotton, bathing in a wooden tub, and holding candy. Maintain a gentle pastel palette, soft shading, round faces, rosy cheeks, and subtle ink outlines. The overall feeling should be nostalgic, charming, educational, highly detailed, and perfect for a nursery wall chart or a cute slide cover for a Japanese learning presentation.

items.title: Xiaomi SU7 Exploded View Chat Screenshot
items.description: This generates a dark Chinese app-style screenshot featuring a premium keynote-quality exploded-view infographic of a Xiaomi SU7 electric car, useful for AI demo visuals and tech product presentation mockups.
items.content: A sleek Chinese social-media style screenshot on a dark charcoal black interface, minimalist and premium, with a large rounded rectangular image card placed in the lower left-center and a small rounded chat bubble in the upper right. The overall canvas is mostly empty dark space, giving a clean tech presentation feel. At the top left of the main area, show one line of bold white Chinese text reading: “换成小米汽车，我做一张更像发布会级别的整车爆炸分解图。” In the upper right, include a single gray rounded speech bubble with white Chinese text: “小米汽车的产品拆解图”. Below, display one featured poster-like infographic card with rounded corners and a glossy black background. Inside that card, create a highly polished exploded-view automotive product presentation for a turquoise {argument name="car model" default="Xiaomi SU7"} electric sedan, shown in dramatic three-quarter front view, with the car body separated into many components suspended around the chassis. The hood is open, trunk lid lifted, four side doors detached and floating outward, front bumper and fascia separated, headlights isolated, interior exposed, and major mechanical and structural modules arranged neatly in layers beneath and around the body. The visual style should resemble a premium launch-event keynote slide: cinematic studio lighting, realistic reflections, sharp detail, dark background, subtle blue highlights, and precise technical composition. In the upper left of the infographic card, place large white Chinese title text in three lines: “小米汽车 SU7”, “产品拆解图”, “科技跨越，人车合一”. Add an orange square Xiaomi-style logo in the upper right corner of the card. Surround the car with 14 Chinese callout labels connected by thin white leader lines, identifying visible parts and systems. On the left side, include 6 labels for features such as integrated closed front fascia, LED headlights, front trunk design, high-voltage battery, front motor assembly, front double-wishbone suspension, and Brembo four-piston brake caliper. On the right side, include 8 labels for features such as electric tailgate, through-type taillight, frameless doors, hidden door handles, rear motor assembly, rear motor specs, all-aluminum alloy chassis, five-link rear suspension, and Michelin performance tires. Beneath the exploded car body, clearly show the battery pack, front and rear drive units, suspension subframes, wheel assemblies, braking components, front and rear seats, center console parts, underbody panels, and structural floor elements, all separated and floating in a carefully organized exploded arrangement. At the bottom of the infographic card, add a horizontal information strip divided into 5 columns of small Chinese specification text with headings for vehicle dimensions, power performance, range, intelligent driving, and safety structure. In the lower left of the card, place a bold white Chinese label “编辑”. In the lower center, include a circular down-arrow icon, and in the lower right, a share/export icon. The composition should look like a real screenshot from a Chinese AI chat app showcasing an automatically generated high-end car teardown infographic, with modern UI spacing, crisp typography, and a luxurious black-and-cyan color palette.

items.title: Foreign Clerk in County Phone Shop
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic candid photo of a foreign shop clerk selling phones in a cluttered Chinese mobile phone store, useful for documentary-style social media imagery.
items.content: A realistic documentary-style smartphone photo inside a small county-town mobile phone shop in China, showing a candid sales interaction at the counter. A tall foreign man, about {argument name="shop clerk nationality" default="Russian"}, stands behind a glass display case wearing a black jacket and a blue employee lanyard with badge, holding a smartphone in both hands as if introducing it to a customer. His face is deliberately blurred into a soft rectangular mosaic for privacy. In the foreground, a middle-aged Chinese male customer in a black jacket is seen from behind and slightly to the side, facing the clerk. The store is cramped, brightly lit, and visually cluttered with authentic retail details. Behind them are large smartphone brand posters and lightbox ads, including 2 major phone brand ads: vivo and oppo. There are 4 prominent Chinese promotional signs visible: a red overhead banner about buying phones and carrier service, a blue vertical installment-payment sign mentioning 0 down payment and 0 interest, a blue trade-in subsidy sign mentioning 1000 yuan, and a small counter sign promoting a Xiaomi model with a 6999 price. The glass counter contains multiple display phones, with 4 clearly visible upright demo phones on stands, plus scattered brochures and accessories beneath the glass. Add dense shelves of boxed accessories and hanging decorations in the background, with slightly messy composition, harsh indoor shop lighting, mild lens distortion, and the rough, unpolished realism of a casually taken phone snapshot. The mood should feel mundane, local, and faintly surreal because the foreign clerk appears completely integrated into an ordinary Chinese mobile phone store.

items.title: Two-Era Naval Comparison Poster
items.description: A cinematic Japanese military-style poster comparing a WWII battleship and a modern destroyer, ideal for presentation covers, history visuals, or dramatic concept key art.
items.content: Create a cinematic Japanese naval comparison poster in a highly detailed, photorealistic concept-art style with a warm amber sunset palette, dramatic clouds, glowing backlight, and a premium movie-poster plus technical-reference-sheet layout. The composition is vertically stacked in 2 main zones. In the top hero zone, show 2 large semi-transparent officer portraits facing inward, one on the left in an older imperial-era naval uniform and one on the right in a modern maritime self-defense force style dress uniform, both wearing peaked caps and formal dark coats, with a blazing sunset sky behind them. Centered between them, place a large serif English title reading {argument name="headline text" default="Fog of Two Eras"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it reading ふたつの時代の霧, and 2 lines of Japanese tagline text above the title. Below the title, on the ocean at golden hour, show 2 warships moving forward on slightly converging paths: on the left, a massive World War II-era battleship with many large gun turrets, tower superstructure, weathered dark hull, and white bow spray; on the right, a modern gray guided-missile destroyer with hull number 115 visible on the bow, sleek radar-equipped superstructure, and foamy wake. Add exactly 4 helicopters in the sky, 2 on the left side and 2 on the right side, plus a suspension bridge and distant modern city skyline on the horizon. In the lower reference-sheet zone, split the page into 2 vertical panels, left for the historical ship and right for the modern ship, each panel styled like a parchment-toned military specification board with dark blue and dark red header bars, fine dividing lines, inset image boxes, and Japanese labels. The left panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the battleship, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 5 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails in a row, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character turnaround views of a male naval officer, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. The right panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the modern destroyer, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 6 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails arranged around the ship references, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character lineup views including a central female officer in white cap and dark uniform, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. Use visible Japanese headers and labels throughout, including a left historical title area and a right title area naming the ship as 護衛艦 あさつ (DDG-115). Make the whole image feel like a museum exhibition poster, military design sheet, and prestige historical sci-fi drama key art combined, with ultra-sharp detail, realistic metal textures, ocean reflections, aged paper panels, symmetrical balance, and polished editorial typography.

items.title: Boxing Impact Chat Screenshot
items.description: A photorealistic dark-mode chat screenshot featuring a dramatic boxing impact image, suitable for recreating viral social-media-style AI image demos.
items.content: A realistic smartphone screenshot of a dark-mode chat interface in Chinese, minimalist and modern, with a charcoal black background and lots of empty space. Near the upper right is a single rounded dark-gray message bubble containing the white Chinese text {argument name="message text" default="拳击手被击中的瞬间"}. Below and to the left is one large embedded photo with rounded corners, occupying most of the lower-left half of the screen. The embedded photo shows the exact instant in a professional boxing match when one boxer lands a hard straight punch flush on the other boxer’s face. Two shirtless male boxers with muscular, sweaty bodies are inside a ring under arena lights. The boxer on the right is seen mostly from the back and side, extending his right arm fully across the frame; his back and shoulder muscles are sharply defined, and he has short dark hair and tattooed arms. He wears a white boxing glove with blue trim, and the glove is smashing into the left boxer’s face. The boxer on the left is recoiling from the impact, his head snapping sideways, with a spray of sweat and water droplets exploding outward around his head. He has a heavily tattooed left arm and chest, a black glove raised near his torso, and black trunks with large gold letters reading VICTOR across the waistband area. The ring ropes are red and white, with visible branding including PBC, and the dark blurred arena background includes bright signage reading RODRIGUEZ VS. The action photo should feel like a frozen high-speed sports photograph, dramatic, crisp, and photorealistic. Over both fighters’ faces are 2 rectangular mosaic-blur censor blocks, one on each face. Add small mobile UI overlay details on the image: the Chinese word 编辑 in white at the bottom-left corner of the photo and a circular share/upload icon at the bottom-right corner. Overall composition should look exactly like a casually shared AI-generated image shown inside a messaging app screenshot, clean, believable, and highly realistic.

items.title: Exploded Chicken Mushroom Stew Ad
items.description: A high-contrast vertical food poster showing an exploded ingredient layout and bilingual labels for a rich chicken, mushroom, potato, carrot, and vermicelli stew.
items.content: Create a dramatic vertical food advertisement on a pure black background, styled like a premium ingredient breakdown poster for a hearty Chinese chicken mushroom vermicelli stew. Use a clean top-to-bottom exploded composition with floating ingredients suspended in midair above the finished dish, each group clearly separated and lit with glossy commercial food-photography lighting. At the top, show a cluster of mixed brown shiitake and other savory mushrooms. Below that, show 2 grouped aromatics: a pile of red goji berries and a small bundle of green scallions with 2 thick ginger slices. items.title: Anime Martial Arts Energy Clash
items.description: This prompt generates a high-impact anime fight scene between two female martial artists in a traditional dojo, ideal for action posters, splash art, or cinematic fantasy illustrations.
items.content: A dramatic anime action illustration inside a traditional wooden martial arts hall, captured at a low angle with intense cinematic perspective. In the foreground, a fierce young female martial artist with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair in a messy high bun tied with red ribbons lunges forward in a deep fighting stance, one fist thrust toward the viewer. She wears a white Chinese-style kung fu top with red trim and tassel frog closures, wide red pants, and black martial arts shoes with red accents. Her expression is focused, aggressive, and determined, with sharp red-tinted eyes. Red energy ribbons and paint-like light trails spiral around her body and punch, scattering sparks and embers. In the upper right, a second young female fighter leaps through the air, partially turned sideways, wearing a dark green qipao-inspired combat dress with ornate gold embroidery, black stockings, and heeled shoes. Her {argument name="second character hair color" default="lavender"} hair is styled in two buns with loose curls and decorative hair ornaments. She casts a martial arts gesture with one hand extended, surrounded by a sweeping arc of luminous blue water-like energy that curves around her body in a near-complete ring. The two elemental forces, red and blue, contrast sharply and imply an imminent clash. The environment is a weathered dojo interior with broken wooden floorboards exploding upward, dust, splinters, and motion debris frozen midair. Warm shafts of light stream through the wooden structure and windows, mixing with glowing particles. Large hanging calligraphy signs are visible, including a central wooden plaque reading {argument name="main sign text" default="武術会"}, with additional vertical banners bearing black Chinese characters on aged paper. Highly detailed anime illustration, dynamic foreshortening, extreme motion, layered effects, rich textures, dramatic rim lighting, fiery warm highlights against cool blue energy, polished concept art quality, vertical composition.

items.title: Premium Blueberry Product Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Chinese-style e-commerce advertisement for packaged blueberries, suitable for supermarket branding, product listings, and promotional posters.
items.content: A premium e-commerce poster for fresh blueberries in a clean Chinese product-advertising style. Show a clear plastic clamshell box of blueberries as the main subject, placed diagonally from lower center to right side on folded blue fabric, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The package must remain realistic and consistent: a transparent square container with rounded corners, filled with dark blue blueberries, with a large irregular rounded label on top in white, pale blue, and deep blue, featuring one oversized blueberry illustration in the center and elegant Chinese branding. Make the fruit inside look larger, plumper, fresher, and covered with subtle moisture droplets, while keeping the overall blueberry arrangement believable. The background is an airy icy-blue tabletop with soft cloudy texture, cool daylight, and scattered loose blueberries around the package. Add a few blurred green leaves entering from the top right and bottom right edges for a fresh natural feeling. In the upper-right corner, include 1 small inset image showing the original product package from above on a warm brown surface, like a reference thumbnail. On the left side, create Chinese promotional typography with a large dark blue calligraphy headline {argument name="headline text" default="决茗新"}, followed by 2 smaller lines of copy: {argument name="subheadline text" default="新鲜蓝莓 自然之选"} and {argument name="tagline text" default="每一颗都是自然的礼物"}. Below that, place 3 vertically stacked feature icons with short Chinese captions: a leaf icon for natural ripeness, a fruit icon for juicy fullness, and a heart icon for rich nutrition. Near the bottom left, add large white brush-style Chinese text {argument name="product name" default="蓝莓"}, a secondary line {argument name="benefit text" default="膳食纤维+花青素"}, and a small net weight line reading 125克. Use cool blue color grading, crisp commercial lighting, sparkling highlights on the plastic lid, premium supermarket packaging aesthetics, high detail, realistic product photography blended with polished graphic design.

items.title: Minimal Pelican Riding Bicycle
items.description: This prompt generates a sparse geometric vector illustration of a pelican on a bicycle, useful for testing simple shape composition or creating a playful abstract icon-style image.
items.content: A minimalist vector-style illustration on a flat light gray background showing a pelican riding a bicycle, drawn from simple geometric shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines. The composition is wide and centered, with the bicycle occupying the lower two-thirds of the image and the bird’s head floating slightly above and forward of the handlebars in a deliberately abstract, diagram-like way. The bicycle is a simple black road-bike silhouette in side view with exactly 2 large wheels, each with a thick outer rim and exactly 4 visible spoke lines forming a cross, a straight horizontal ground line beneath both wheels, a triangular frame, a short black saddle, and simplified crank and pedal details near the rear of the frame. The pelican is constructed from clean abstract pieces: a white rounded head with a small black circular eye, a long open beak pointing left made of 2 parts with an upper orange triangular section and a lower pale pink pouch section, a short dark curve on top of the head, a small separate white oval neck/body connector, a larger white rounded body positioned over the bike, and a single white wing-like shape angled upward over the back. Add exactly 2 orange leg shapes, long narrow rectangles leaning downward from the body toward the bicycle frame, suggesting the bird is pedaling. Keep the forms intentionally sparse and slightly surreal, like a logo test or simple code-editor doodle, with no shading, no gradients, no textures, no text, and lots of negative space.

items.title: Washington Crossing Style Winter Boat Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a dark, cinematic historical winter river-crossing image in the style of an 18th-century military tableau, ideal for editorial art or dramatic history-themed visuals.
items.content: A cinematic historical scene at dusk on a freezing river crossing in winter, showing a crowded wooden rowboat packed with exactly 11 colonial-era soldiers and boatmen pushing through dark icy water filled with floating chunks of ice. In the center stands 1 commanding figure, upright and resolute, wearing a dark navy or black heavy cloak draped over a light tan military uniform and a black tricorne hat, evoking an 18th-century general. Around him are 10 other men seated or crouched low in the boat, dressed in weathered Revolutionary War-era clothing: dark coats, wool caps, cloaks, scarves, leather straps, and tricorne hats, with several gripping long wooden oars and one visible musket angled upward behind the central figure. The mood is grim, cold, and heroic, with wet clothing, snow dusting, pale breathy atmosphere, and a stormy blue-gray sky. The river is wide and partially frozen, with a dark tree-lined shoreline in the distance and a few tiny warm lights glowing on the far bank. Composition is frontal and tightly framed from just above the bow of the boat, making the viewer feel inside the freezing crossing. Use low-key lighting, muted desaturated colors, deep shadows, damp textures, realism, dramatic historical painting energy blended with cinematic photorealism, ultra-detailed fabric, wood grain, ice, and mist.

items.title: Japanese Builder Website Hero Mockup
items.description: This generates a sleek presentation mockup of a Japanese construction company homepage first view with a green theme, one notice item, and a consultation photo for web design concept showcases.
items.content: A polished presentation-style mockup on a dark charcoal background showing a Japanese homebuilder website first view concept. In the upper right, place a large white rounded speech bubble with 4 Japanese bullet lines in clean sans-serif text: 「工務店のwebサイトのファーストビューを作成してください。」, 「- 緑ベース」, 「- お知らせを1件表示」, 「- FV画像は、机を囲んで業者とお客様が話しているところ」, 「- CTAボタン設置」. In the lower left, show a realistic desktop website hero section inside a large rounded browser-like frame with a muted forest-green theme and elegant lifestyle branding for a Japanese construction company. The top navigation bar includes a small house logo at far left, the company name in Japanese, 5 navigation links across the top, and 1 rounded white contact button on the right. The hero area is split visually into 2 major zones: on the left, a green textured panel with layered organic leaf patterns, small introductory copy, a large white Japanese headline in multiple lines, a short paragraph of smaller Japanese body text, and 1 white rounded CTA button; on the right, a warm natural-light photo of exactly 2 people seated across a wooden table in discussion, with papers and a small architectural house model visible, indoor plants and window light in the background. The entire website card has soft shadows, premium editorial spacing, and rounded bottom corners. Along the bottom of the website mockup, include a narrow light-gray notice bar showing exactly 1 announcement item with a small green tag, a date, Japanese notice text, and a subtle link on the right. Add a semi-transparent gray circular badge overlapping the bottom-left corner of the website card containing the Japanese text 「編集」. In the bottom-right corner of the website card, add a small circular share/upload icon. Overall style: high-end Japanese web design concept, realistic UI mockup, refined typography, green natural-material branding, minimal and elegant composition.

items.title: Giant Robot Meets Woman on Balcony
items.description: A photorealistic cinematic prompt for creating an emotional dystopian scene of a lone woman facing a colossal weathered robot above a ruined city.
items.content: A cinematic ultra-detailed dystopian sci-fi scene showing a colossal humanoid robot leaning in toward a lone woman standing on a small rusted balcony attached to a crumbling concrete high-rise. The composition is wide and dramatic: the woman is positioned on the far left, tiny in scale, while the robot dominates the entire right side of the frame. The giant machine has a weathered white-gray metal shell covered in scratches, grime, rust streaks, exposed joints, cables, pistons, and circular mechanical assemblies, with one glowing icy-blue eye. Its massive open hand is extended gently toward the woman, palm up, as if offering help or inviting trust. The woman appears to be a young adult with dark hair tied back, wearing a muted green hooded jacket and dark pants, standing upright and looking up at the robot without fear. Behind them is a dense, worn urban skyline of low rooftops and distant modern skyscrapers fading into haze, under a heavy overcast sky with thick gray storm clouds. The mood is melancholic, intimate, and awe-inspiring, blending post-apocalyptic realism with emotional scale contrast. Use photorealistic rendering, cinematic lighting, desaturated colors, sharp industrial textures, atmospheric perspective, dramatic cloud detail, and a sense of quiet connection between human and machine.

items.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Ad Design Grids
items.description: This generates a realistic dark-mode mobile chat screenshot showing two Japanese AI prompts and two 2x2 grids of polished ad design variations, useful for illustrating generative design capabilities.
items.content: A dark-mode mobile chat interface screenshot showing two separate Japanese prompt-and-result exchanges about AI-generated ad design. The background is nearly black.
