In the top-right panel, show an energetic outdoor ad with 4 children running under a blue sky, bold Japanese headline text, teal and yellow graphic accents, and a yellow circular callout. In the bottom-left panel, show a modern kindergarten campus building with a grassy yard and children playing, with a large white speech-bubble-shaped text area on the left and muted green-beige abstract shapes. In the bottom-right panel, show an illustrated large green tree with children and parents underneath, sky-blue background, warm family-friendly Japanese copy, and soft rounded decorative shapes. Add 1 small gray circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left corner of this preview and 1 small semi-transparent circular upload/share icon at the lower-right corner. Under this first preview, include 4 small interface icons in a row: copy, thumbs up, thumbs down, and more options. Lower on the screen, show the second right-aligned light-gray chat bubble with this Japanese text: 「日本語の健康食品の広告画像を、トンマナ違いで4種類並べて画像生成して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9」. Beneath it is a second rounded rectangular generated image preview showing a 2x2 grid of health food advertisement variations. In the top-left panel, show a clean wellness ad in white and pale green with a woman touching her neck, Japanese headline text about inner balance, several circular benefit icons, and price text. In the top-right panel, show a dramatic black-and-gold supplement ad with a dark pouch package, glowing gold particles, luxury serif-style Japanese text, and a bold red-orange price tag reading 980円. In the bottom-left panel, show a soft pink beauty supplement ad with translucent floral or crystalline textures, pastel packaging, delicate Japanese copy, circular info badges, and feminine cosmetic styling. In the bottom-right panel, show a natural green juice ad with a tall glass of green smoothie, fresh vegetables in the background, a green-and-white product box, clean Japanese health copy, and a circular yellow callout. Add 1 small gray circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left of this second preview and 1 small semi-transparent circular upload/share icon at the lower-right. The overall image should feel like a realistic smartphone app screenshot of an AI image-generation chat, with generous spacing between the 2 conversations, rounded corners, crisp Japanese typography, and a premium contemporary UI.

items.content: A clean, flat digital top-down chessboard centered in the frame, shown as a square 8x8 board with algebraic coordinates visible on all four sides: letters a through h along the top and bottom, and numbers 8 through 1 along the left and right. Use a dark charcoal outer background and border, with alternating light beige and muted taupe-gray squares. items.title: Neon Lip Balm Launch Ad
items.description: A vibrant futuristic beauty advertisement poster for a glowing lip balm, ideal for social media campaigns, product launches, and editable Canva-style promo designs.
items.content: Create a glossy, hyper-saturated social media ad poster for a futuristic beauty product launch, designed like a Canva marketing graphic. The composition is a single widescreen promotional banner centered on a cyan-to-purple gradient background, with rounded corners and a vivid neon pink color palette. Inside the banner, show a young woman from the chest up in a glowing sci-fi tunnel made of concentric pink and white light rings. Her face is obscured by a soft square blur block, but her hair is styled in two small buns, and she wears hoop earrings, layered chain necklaces, a metallic silver top, and an iridescent pink holographic jacket. She extends one hand toward the camera holding a clear lip balm tube close to the lens, creating strong foreground perspective. The tube label reads “GLOW MODE Lip Balm.” At the top center, large neon headline text reads “GLOW MODE” with a script subtitle “Lip Balm,” and below it a smaller line reads “JUICY SHINE. HYDRATING CARE. ZERO STICKINESS.” In the upper left corner, add a handwritten neon note reading “NEW!” In the upper right corner, place an orange rounded sticker with white text reading “gpt-image-2,” plus a small orange pointer tab beneath it. On the right side of the banner, include 2 circular callout badges: a pink starburst badge that says “ONLY $14.99” and a black glowing circular badge that says “VIRAL ON TikTok 2M+ views.” At the lower right, show 2 product display elements: one upright open lip balm tube with wand applicator beside it, and one whole sliced peach plus one cut mango half with green leaves, all sitting on a glossy reflective surface with pink light swirls. Along the lower center, add 3 feature icons with labels: a droplet icon labeled “HYALURONIC HYDRATION,” a fruit icon labeled “PEACH MANGO SCENT,” and a bunny icon labeled “100% VEGAN & CRUELTY-FREE.” In the lower left inside the banner, add a vertical stack of 3 social buttons with platform icons and handles: TikTok with “#GlowMode,” Instagram with “@LunaBeatty,” and Snapchat with “@LunaGlow.” Beneath them place 1 glowing QR code card, and next to it handwritten script text reading “Shop Now!” with an arrow pointing toward the QR code. Outside the banner at the bottom left, place a tilted teal rounded label reading “Canva AI,” with a small teal paper-plane style accent nearby. Add glossy reflections, lens flares, bloom, neon rim lighting, sparkles, and polished ad-design styling throughout, with crisp commercial product photography mixed with futuristic graphic design.

items.title: Three Floral Chickens Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a cute surreal studio image of three chickens made entirely of flowers, ideal for whimsical art prints, social media visuals, or decorative concept imagery.
items.content: A whimsical studio portrait of 3 full-body chickens standing side by side against a clean light gray seamless background, centered with soft diffused lighting and subtle shadows beneath their feet. Each chicken is sculpted entirely from layered flower petals and blossoms while keeping realistic chicken anatomy, skinny scaly legs, clawed feet, beaks, wattles, and combs. The left chicken is cream and ivory colored, fluffy and rounded, decorated with pale white blossoms and tiny sprigs of baby's breath, with oversized round googly eyes and a surprised, innocent expression. The center chicken is dusty pink and blush colored, built from dense overlapping petals and medium flower heads, with a long drooping pink comb falling over one eye, a stern intense expression, and floral detailing around the neck and body. The right chicken is vivid orange, amber, and golden yellow, made of marigold-like petals and warm autumn flowers, with narrowed sleepy eyes, a tall red-orange comb, and a grumpy unimpressed expression. Emphasize intricate botanical texture, handcrafted floral sculpture realism, playful character design, high detail, sharp focus, symmetrical lineup composition, and a cute surreal fine-art aesthetic.

items.title: Censored Research Paper Office Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic office announcement-style portrait of a man holding a technical paper in front of visible company branding, useful for tech news, parody announcements, or corporate editorial imagery.
items.content: A realistic corporate office photo of a young man seated indoors, holding up a printed research paper toward the camera with both hands. His face is fully obscured by a solid rectangular censor block in a medium tan color. He has short dark brown hair and wears a plain dark charcoal crewneck sweater. The paper is a white letter-size document in portrait orientation, clearly visible and centered in front of his torso. The document title reads “DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems”. Below it are the author lines “DFlash Research Team” and “DFlash Inc.” The page shows 4 visible text sections: “Abstract”, “1. Introduction”, “2. DFlash Technology Overview”, and “2.1 Dual Charge-Trapping Architecture”, set in a formal academic paper layout with dense black serif text. In the background, place a softly blurred modern office lobby with warm ambient lighting, beige walls, glass partitions, a sofa, indoor plants, and the black OpenAI logo and wordmark mounted on the wall at upper left. The composition is a medium shot, straight-on, with the subject slightly right of center so the OpenAI logo remains visible. Shallow depth of field, soft natural office lighting, polished photorealistic style, subtle warm color grading, high detail in the hands, paper, sweater texture, and interior environment. Keep the overall image clean, believable, and like a candid press or announcement photo. Use {argument name="document title" default="DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems"} for the paper title, {argument name="company logo text" default="OpenAI"} for the wall branding, {argument name="sweater color" default="dark charcoal"} for the subject’s clothing, and {argument name="censor block color" default="medium tan"} for the face covering.

items.title: Moody Coastal Road Trip Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic candid seaside roadside portrait with a parked vintage sedan, ideal for nostalgic travel photography and lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A cinematic candid photo of a {argument name="person" default="young woman"} standing in a wet coastal roadside turnout on an overcast day, viewed from behind and slightly to the side as she turns her head back toward the camera. She has dark messy hair tied in a loose bun with windblown strands, and her face is softly obscured and indistinct. She wears 2 visible clothing pieces: a worn tan-brown canvas jacket and medium-blue jeans. Her posture is relaxed with one hand near or in a pocket. The setting is a moody ocean cliff highway overlook with dark rocky mountains running along the left side, pale gray sea stretching into the distance on the right, and a cloudy washed-out sky. Include 1 parked light-colored late-1980s or early-1990s sedan on the right edge of the frame, rear end facing the viewer, and 1 large rock barrier near the overlook. The asphalt is dark and damp with faint parking lines, suggesting recent rain. Use natural light, muted cool tones, slight film grain, soft focus, shallow haze, and a nostalgic 35mm road-trip photography aesthetic.

items.title: Surreal Patio Portrait with Crow and Dog
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic, slightly uncanny portrait of a seated person holding a small dog while a black bird perches on their head, ideal for editorial-style surreal photography.
items.content: A slightly surreal but photorealistic portrait of a seated person in a quiet courtyard or patio, centered in frame, wearing a fitted white long-sleeve turtleneck top with delicate pink floral prints and a printed illustration of a girl on the chest, paired with loose cream floral pants. The person sits on a simple white metal chair and holds a small fluffy poodle-like dog in their lap; the dog has curly off-white fur and distinctly dyed orange ears. Perched on top of the person’s dark hair bun is a black crow or raven, facing left, calm and balanced as if it naturally belongs there. The subject’s pose is still, direct, and formal, creating an odd deadpan family-portrait feeling. Set the scene against a textured off-white stucco wall with exactly 4 notable decorative background elements: 1 brown sun-shaped wall ornament in the upper left, 1 small wall-mounted planter shelf with a small bird figurine and trailing flowers on the left, 1 tall arched window or mural on the right showing a bright blue sky with soft white clouds, and 1 white pedestal planter at lower right filled with long green leaves and exactly 2 pink flamingo ornaments. Include a bit of stone edging and dark greenery at lower left and a brown tiled floor. Lighting is soft natural daylight, slightly overcast, with muted colors, shallow depth of field, and a vintage editorial photography look. Composition should be vertical, full seated figure, straight-on, balanced, and quietly uncanny. Customize the main figure as {argument name="person" default="a middle-aged woman"}, the bird as {argument name="bird type" default="black crow"}, the dog breed as {argument name="dog type" default="small poodle mix"}, the dog ear color as {argument name="dog ear color" default="orange"}, and the outfit palette as {argument name="outfit colors" default="white and faded pink florals"}.

items.title: Early 2000s Computer Lab With ChatGPT
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic candid classroom photo of students using ChatGPT on CRT computers, ideal for editorial or social-media visuals about AI in everyday education.
items.content: A candid documentary-style photo of a {argument name="setting" default="high school computer lab classroom"} filled with exactly 10 students seated at rows of bulky off-white CRT desktop computers, viewed from the back-left corner of the room at a slight wide angle. The scene should feel like an early-2000s snapshot taken on a consumer digital camera with direct flash, soft grain, slightly warm indoor fluorescent lighting, and a timestamp in the bottom-right corner reading {argument name="timestamp" default="02 18 04"}. In the foreground left, a student in a navy track jacket with white sleeve stripes points at a CRT monitor; in the center foreground, another student with short spiky hair wears an oversized gray sweatshirt and sits facing away from the camera; on the right foreground, a blonde student with a ponytail wears a light blue long-sleeve top with dark horizontal arm stripes and types at a keyboard; far right, another student with curly dark hair sits at a workstation. Several other students occupy the middle and back rows, all facing their screens. items.content: Create a clean Japanese corporate training banner in a wide horizontal web-header format with a white background and deep navy blue branding. The layout is a single unified promotional banner for an AI programming course. On the left, place a small headline in bold Japanese text reading "AIを使いこなす開発者へ" above a very large dominant title reading "{argument name="main title" default="ClaudeCode研修"}" in heavy sans-serif dark navy lettering, with "ClaudeCode" especially large and the final Japanese word attached on the right in the same style. Beneath the title, add a long horizontal blue gradient bar from medium blue to very light blue containing white bold Japanese text: "{argument name="subheadline text" default="AI時代の開発を、あなたの武器に。"}". Along the bottom left, arrange exactly 3 circular navy icon badges in a horizontal row, each with a short two-line caption in Japanese to the right of the icon. Badge 1 shows a code symbol </> and the text "Claude Codeの 基本から実践まで". Badge 2 shows a light bulb and the text "業務効率を高める AI活用スキル". Badge 3 shows an upward bar chart and the text "すぐに使える 実践的な内容". On the right half, place a confident Japanese businessman from the waist up with arms crossed, wearing a dark navy suit, white shirt, and blue striped tie, facing forward; his face is intentionally soft-focused or anonymized. Behind him, add layered geometric navy and blue diagonal shapes sweeping in from the top right and bottom right, plus a dark blue tech-themed panel with faint code lines and a glowing curly-braces symbol {}. Use a polished B2B seminar advertisement style, crisp typography, strong negative space, subtle gradients, high contrast, and a professional AI/engineering training atmosphere.

items.title: Countryball Strait of Hormuz Standoff
items.description: A humorous geopolitical meme illustration showing USA and Iran countryballs confronting each other in the narrow Strait of Hormuz, ideal for editorial satire or social media commentary.
items.content: A detailed satirical countryball meme illustration of the {argument name="waterway name" default="Strait of Hormuz"} as a very narrow sea passage between two steep rocky cliffs, painted in a polished digital cartoon style with dramatic shading and textured stone. In the center foreground, exactly 2 countryballs block each other in the tight channel so that only one can pass. On the left is a USA countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the American flag, wearing a dark navy baseball cap labeled "USA" in large white letters. On the right is an Iran countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the Iranian flag and emblem, wearing a green-and-white headband tied on the side; the headband contains Korean text that reads "저항은 우리의 권리". Above each ball is exactly 1 white speech bubble with thick black outline, for a total of 2 speech bubbles, and both say {argument name="speech text" default="길!"} in large bold Korean lettering, as if neither side will yield. Show the two balls facing each other nose-to-nose in a standoff in the bottleneck. On the left cliff, include exactly 1 wooden sign reading in Korean and English: "호르무즈 해협" and "Strait of Hormuz". On the right cliff, include exactly 1 warning sign with Persian text at the top and a red warning triangle below, indicating that only one person can pass. In the left bottom corner, place exactly 1 black oil barrel labeled "OIL" with dark spilled oil pooling around it. In the right bottom corner, place exactly 1 black naval mine with Persian writing on it, attached to a chain. In the background beyond the narrow passage, show open sea with exactly 3 distant ships, including at least 1 larger tanker and faint dark smoke rising into the sky. Use a tense but humorous geopolitical meme tone, centered composition, eye-level view, soft daylight, slightly muted realistic colors, crisp outlines, and high readability for all text.

items.title: Countryball Hormuz Strait Standoff
items.description: This prompt generates a satirical countryball meme showing the US and Iran blocking each other at the Strait of Hormuz, useful for editorial humor or geopolitical social media posts.
items.content: A humorous political meme illustration in a simple countryball cartoon style, showing the current situation at the {argument name="location label" default="호르무즈 해협"} as a narrow chokepoint. Use a wide landscape composition with bright flat colors, thick black outlines, and a clean hand-drawn infographic-like look. In the foreground, place 2 countryballs standing shoulder to shoulder on an extremely narrow sandy land bridge with rocks along both sides, making it obvious that only one can pass at a time. On the left is a {argument name="left country" default="United States"} countryball painted with the American flag, wearing black sunglasses and a brown cowboy hat, facing the other ball with a stubborn attitude. On the right is an {argument name="right country" default="Iran"} countryball painted with the Iranian flag, wearing a dark turban-like hat, with angry slanted eyes, also refusing to move. Add 2 large white speech bubbles, one beside each countryball, and put the same bold Korean word in both bubbles: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}. In the midground and background, show a busy blue sea crowded with 9 ships total: 2 gray US warships on the far left, 1 Chinese submarine with a red Chinese flag, 4 oil tankers lined up in the center-left and center carrying different national flags, and 2 gray military ships near the narrow passage with small American flags. At the top right, include a large Iranian flag overlay along the coastline. Draw beige landmasses around the waterway to resemble a simplified map view of the Strait of Hormuz. At the bottom center, add a bold caption in Korean and English on the sand: {argument name="bottom caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"}. The mood should be satirical, tense, and meme-like, but visually cute and readable.

items.title: Moody Censored Indoor Selfie Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic stylish selfie of a young man in a dark open-collar shirt by a window, useful for creating believable social-media portrait photos.
items.content: A realistic indoor selfie-style portrait of a young East Asian man from the chest up, seated near a large modern window in a high-rise apartment or hotel room during soft daylight. He has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, thick and slightly tousled with a center part and soft volume over the forehead and sides. His build appears slim, with a long neck and smooth light skin. He wears a {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} button-up shirt made of matte cotton or poplin, slightly oversized, with the top several buttons undone to create a deep open collar and relaxed, casual styling. The camera is held close in a natural selfie angle, portrait orientation, framing the shoulders, chest, neck, and head. His face is fully obscured by a large centered rectangular blur or mosaic censor block, while the ears, jawline edges, neck, and hair remain visible. The mood is understated, moody, and elegant, with muted neutral colors, soft window light from the right side, gentle shadows, and a candid social-media selfie feeling. Background details include 1 beige wall section on the left, 1 small dark wall control panel, 1 vertical metallic trim or lamp edge, and 2 tall dark-framed window panels on the right with a faint out-of-focus city skyline outside. Photorealistic smartphone photo, clean modern interior, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, subtle contrast, no smile visible because of the censor block, minimal editing, stylish and believable personal selfie.

items.title: Turn Food Photo Into Japanese Poster
items.description: This prompt converts a reference meal photo into a polished Japanese restaurant advertisement poster, useful for menu promos and social media food marketing.
items.content: Using the provided reference image of the udon meal, turn it into a clean, print-ready Japanese restaurant promotional poster while keeping the food photo itself as the main hero image. Expand the composition vertically into a portrait flyer layout, add a light icy-blue seasonal background with subtle watercolor texture and faint wave motifs, and overlay decorative green maple leaves for an early-summer feel. Add 5 text elements in Japanese: a blue circular badge at the upper left reading "初夏のおすすめ", a large bold brush-calligraphy headline across the top in 2 lines reading "とり天" and "ざるうどん", a small red vertical seal near the headline reading "自慢のとり天", a tall translucent blue vertical copy block at the upper right reading "ひんやり、つるり。さっぱり、満たされる。", and a price block at the lower right reading "980円 税込" with a blue brushstroke banner below that says "大盛り無料！". Add a short 4-line Japanese body copy paragraph at the lower left describing the dish in a menu-poster style. Preserve the original meal arrangement and realistic photography, but enhance it slightly for advertising: brighter, more appetizing, crisp, and high contrast. Make the overall design look like a polished restaurant poster created from a casual food photo.

items.title: Pastel Anime Promo Poster
items.description: A colorful Japanese anime announcement poster featuring a white-haired mascot girl with multiple comedic inset scenes, ideal for recreating TV-series key visuals or parody promotional art.
items.content: Create a bright pastel anime promotional poster for a fictional slice-of-life comedy series. The composition is a single-page Japanese key visual with one central heroine surrounded by 5 inset moments and blocks of Japanese promotional text, like an anime announcement poster. The main character is {argument name="character name" default="もち子さん"}, a cute anime girl with short white hair fading slightly to silver, large vivid blue eyes, soft blush, and twin low ponytails tied near the shoulders. She wears an oversized black hood shaped like floppy dog ears, round silver goggles resting on top of her head, a black choker with a metallic round ornament, a futuristic white-and-black cropped sleeveless top with dark trim and a small emblem on the chest, detached black arm sleeves, very short white shorts with black edging, a thigh strap on one leg, and a small side pouch on her hip. Her body proportions are youthful anime stylization with a slim, petite build and slightly exaggerated chest, rendered in polished modern moe character design. In the center she stands full body, smiling gently and holding a pen in one hand as if she is about to make a mistake while writing, facing the viewer in a confident but sweet pose. Around her place 5 supporting vignette images of the same character: 1) upper left, a chibi-style scene of her outside with both hands thrown forward, crying dramatically with a huge open mouth; 2) lower left, a comic scene of her collapsed face-down on a desk or floor with scattered papers, exhausted and flustered; 3) upper right, a bust shot where she holds up a paper sign with Japanese writing, looking apologetic; 4) lower right, a cheerful half-body portrait with closed smiling eyes and one fist raised in encouragement; 5) a small background portrait in the top-right area behind text, used like a character callout. Include exactly 2 small white mascot creatures near the bottom center, both round and mochi-like with tiny dot eyes and tiny mouths, one larger and one smaller, floating or standing beside the heroine. Use a soft spring palette with pink, sky blue, mint green, peach, cream, and white, with scattered cherry blossom petals and rounded graphic shapes in the background. The background should feel airy and celebratory, with subtle outdoor scenery blur and decorative swooshes, stars, and bubbles. Fill the poster with Japanese typography in a playful commercial-anime style: a large multicolored title at top left, small header text above it, a red seasonal broadcast announcement, a pink "あらすじ" synopsis box on the left with several lines of body text, a blue explanatory box at bottom left, vertical and angled exclamatory phrases around the character, and a pink production-credit block at bottom right. Add a prominent character name banner in the upper right. Keep all text looking like authentic printed Japanese promotional copy, using rounded colorful fonts for the title and clean magazine-style fonts for the smaller text. Overall mood: adorable, comedic, slightly chaotic, professionally designed anime key art for a new TV series announcement in 16:9 landscape format.

Remove all blueprint elements, including the exploded view, dimension lines, labels, tables, notes, and title block. Show only the assembled product centered in frame, front-facing, isolated against a minimal light gray background with a white surface, soft diffused lighting, subtle realistic shadows, and glossy premium materials. Make it look like a contemporary industrial design catalog or e-commerce product photograph.

items.title: Cinematic Wednesday Anime Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic Japanese film-poster illustration of a schoolgirl in a sunlit classroom, ideal for cinematic anime key art or social media poster visuals.
items.content: A Japanese movie-poster style anime illustration, vertical theatrical one-sheet composition, showing a teenage schoolgirl seated alone in a classroom at golden hour. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, long and slightly wavy, gathered into a loose side braid draped over her right shoulder, with soft bangs and warm rim light along the top of her head and hair edges. She wears a cream or light beige sailor-style school uniform with navy trim and a dark blue ribbon bow at the chest. Her pose is quiet and introspective: sitting at a school desk, leaning her cheek into one hand, shoulders slightly curved, looking off to the side with a tired but calm midweek expression. The scene is lit by strong late-afternoon sunlight pouring in from a tall classroom window on the right, creating glowing highlights, dust motes in the air, soft haze, and a nostalgic cinematic mood. In the dimmer left background, include a green classroom chalkboard and 2 small chalkboard erasers or chalk accessories resting on the tray. Use painterly anime realism with rich filmic contrast, delicate facial rendering, textured brushwork, subtle grain, and dramatic poster lighting. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the artwork: on the left side, large vertical white brush lettering reading "真ん中" with smaller handwritten-style vertical text above reading "やっと、"; across the lower middle, large pink calligraphic title text reading "水曜日" diagonally; on the upper right, a vertical tagline reading "週のまんなかで、わっと深呼吸ができる。" Near the lower right, include 3 stacked gold laurel award emblems with small Japanese text inside each. Along the bottom center, add 2 lines of small Japanese tagline text, then a credits block in small Japanese film-poster typography. In the bottom right corner, place a large release date reading {argument name="release date" default="5.29"} with "ROADSHOW" beneath it. Overall feeling: soft, melancholic, reassuring, like an understated coming-of-age film poster about an ordinary Wednesday becoming quietly special.

items.description: A cinematic photoreal selfie of a man and a female alien on Mars, useful for futuristic social posts, sci-fi announcements, or playful space-tech visuals.
items.content: A photorealistic selfie on the surface of Mars, framed at arm’s length in a casual slightly wide-angle smartphone perspective. In the foreground are 2 subjects standing close together from chest-up: a human man on the left wearing a black crewneck shirt with a clear white OpenAI logo on the chest, and a tall elegant female alien on the right with shimmering blue-green metallic skin, elongated ears, subtle facial ridges, and a sleek biomechanical-looking outfit with bronze and silver tones, a deep neckline, fine ornamental seams, and layered necklaces with a prominent blue gemstone pendant. The man has short dark messy hair and his left arm extends toward the camera as if taking the selfie. The alien leans in close beside him, both posed like a friendly commemorative snapshot. The background is a red rocky Martian desert with scattered stones, low hills, and a dusty orange sunset sky. On the far left stands a roadside-style sign with 2 lines of text reading {argument name="sign headline" default="MARS"} and {argument name="sign subtext" default="WELCOME HOME"}. On the far right in the distance is 1 large retro-futuristic white rocket standing upright on landing legs, with visible vertical text reading {argument name="rocket text" default="SPACEX"}. Warm orange lighting, cinematic realism, detailed textures, subtle atmospheric haze, social-media-announcement vibe, high detail, natural depth of field.

items.content: A luminous anime-style summer portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese high school girl"} shown from the chest up in side profile, standing outdoors under an intense blue sky with bright white clouds. She has a short wet bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="dark navy black"}, large sparkling blue-violet eyes, soft blush on her cheeks, and a calm, slightly distant expression. items.title: Otter Scientist Presentation Slide
items.description: A photorealistic comedic conference scene showing an otter in a lab coat presenting a polished benchmark slide about AI-generated otter images, ideal for satire, social posts, or editorial-style AI demos.
items.content: A photorealistic humorous academic presentation in a conference room: an anthropomorphic otter scientist stands at the left side of the frame wearing a crisp white lab coat and holding a thin pointing stick toward a large presentation board on an easel. The otter is upright like a human, with realistic brown fur, dark paws, and a professional posture. The lab coat has a stitched name tag reading "Dr. Otter" and a smaller line reading "Aquatic Systems Lab," plus two pens in the chest pocket. The otter’s face is partially censored by a square blur block. Behind the otter is a whiteboard with faint handwritten notes and doodles, including "WiFi > Fish," "H2O," "Hydration," a fish sketch, and a wifi symbol. The main focus is a large clean presentation slide with sharp readable text and polished corporate-academic layout. At the top, a bold title reads "{argument name="headline text" default="Ethan Mollick’s Otter Test"}" and beneath it a subtitle reads "Prompt: \"{argument name="prompt text" default="An otter sitting on an airplane seat using in-flight wifi on a laptop"}\"". Below that is a boxed section titled "Sample AI-Generated Images" containing exactly 4 side-by-side sample images of a realistic otter seated in an airplane seat using a laptop or tablet, each framed like model outputs, with one showing a large wifi symbol above the seat. Beneath the images is a section labeled "Performance Results (Pass = otter, airplane seat, in-flight wifi, laptop/tablet)" with exactly 5 score boxes: "DALL·E 3" with no visible numeric score, "GPT-4o" with "4/4" and "100%", "Midjourney v6" with "3/4" and "75%", "Stable Diffusion XL" with "2/4" and "50%", and "SD 1.5" with "0/4" and "0%". On the right side is a large highlighted box reading "Average Score" and "{argument name="average score" default="70%"}" in large blue type. At the bottom of the slide is a "Key Findings" box with exactly 3 bullet points: "Modern models understand complex, specific prompts surprisingly well.", "Otters + airplanes + wifi = a reliable benchmark.", and "Further research is otter-ly necessary." A small simple cartoon otter doodle appears in the lower-right corner of the slide. The room is warmly lit with wood-paneled walls, shallow depth of field, and a few blurred audience members in the foreground, including a laptop at the bottom edge showing an otter image on its screen and a glass pitcher on a table. Style: ultra-realistic editorial photography, deadpan scientific satire, believable conference presentation, high detail, natural indoor lighting, professional lens compression, readable slide typography, polished yet absurd.

items.title: Split-Screen Time Travel Scene
items.description: A complex prompt designed to generate a seamless horizontal split-screen image blending historical and modern eras within a single scene.
items.content: A horizontal split-screen cinematic shot of {argument name="scene" default="Times Square, New York"}, seamlessly blending two different eras: {argument name="first era" default="1920s"} on the left and {argument name="second era" default="present day"} on the right (default: about 100 years ago vs. present day). On the left side: show era-appropriate architecture, interior or environment design, materials, vehicles, and props that clearly belong to that historical period. People wear authentic clothing from the era, including hairstyles, accessories, and typical items in their hands. The overall mood feels nostalgic and historically accurate. On the right side: show the same scene in the modern era, with updated architecture or renovated structures, contemporary materials (glass, steel, LED screens, modern furniture), modern vehicles or equipment, and current technology. People wear contemporary fashion that matches today’s style in this setting. In the center: the two eras merge and overlap organically, without a hard dividing line. Elements from both eras visually interact: people from different times look at each other, walk through each other’s space, or seem surprised by the other era’s technology and objects. Architecture and environment smoothly morph from old to new. Make sure the scene is not just a simple left/right comparison but a dynamic time-travel interaction. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, wide angle, highly detailed textures, rich sense of time-travel storytelling. Aspect Ratio: 4:3

items.title: Detailed multilingual Chinese manga prompt
items.description: A very complex prompt for generating a full-page manga featuring specific characters, vertical layouts, and precise multilingual text rendering in Chinese and English.
items.content:
Generate a full color Chinese-text manga about this {argument name="character" default="OpenAI 研究科学家, 陈博远"} (first picture), who works on improving the text rendering capability of ChatGPT Image 2 model for the upcoming release. (in the background there is boba tea and a banana taped to the wall with a single slice of duct tape). The model can render insanely small Chinese text when he tried generating some detailed and beautiful multilingual infographics handdrawn-style poster about his hometown, {argument name="location" default="无锡"} on his computer screen. His hard work pays off and the team was impressed by the absurdly good quality of multilingual text performance of his model, seeing all the languages it can write. When he takes a break with one hand holding his phone, he received a translated text message from Sam Altman on his phone (avatar attached as second picture), asking him to take a look at the rendered multilingual text in an image he just generated to congrat the team, since Sam only knows English. However, make it funny by let Boyuan outrage (typical manga style) at the end by seeing Sam's generated image contains a "稳稳地接住你" phrase at the central location in an otherwise perfectly rendered image that's used to congrat the team, because this sentence has been memed as an unnatural but funny Chinese sentence GPT likes to use on Chinese internet. Boyuan should rage "天呐! 它又学会了接住!" (with teammates as tiny heads on the side, sweating and saying in Chinese"we are working hard to fix it！"). At the very bottom of the manga, add a tiny line of footnote (very tiny)in Chinese that "note: the entire manga, including this footnote and picture in picture, are all generated with gpt image 2 at once without editing or multiple steps。"

Additional Instructions: Use vertical 1440x2560 image layout, with first row about this researcher working hard, second row about his result on {argument name="location" default="无锡"} with multiple languages, third row shows the team excitement, fourth row split into left and right where left shows he takes a break and the phone received a message, right panel shows Sam's text message, and fifth row shows Sam's picture and 陈博远's reaction. No narration except for the first row. Avoid Chinese map. All characters should be in manga style. The banana background should only appear in the first panel and the tape should be a single slice of tape, not a cross tape. The banana and tape decoration should be small as a insignificant easter egg for people to find. OpenAI logo shall only appear on 陈博远's cloth, not elsewhere. No mugs in the scene since we already have the boba. Sam should only appear in the text message panel. The entire manga should be appear as a professional photo of a physical page in a manga book. In the lower right most corner of the poster there is a small “极小中文也清晰可读：” with a paragraph of much smaller Chinese that begins with “（此处为极小字号测试）无锡是作者的故乡，所以做了这幅海报，中文总算是修好了。很多年没回家了，好想吃大闸蟹啊！” (ultra small).

items.title: Dual Exposure Sports Graphic
items.description: A sophisticated prompt for creating a mixed-media sports tribute poster using silhouette containers, photo-mosaic grids, and tactile textures like halftone dots and film grain.
items.content:
{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. 
Act as a high-end sports graphic designer creating a conceptual tribute poster. The style is a complex "dual exposure photo-grid composite" with mixed-media textures.
CENTRAL STRUCTURE (THE VESSEL):
The central focus is a large-scale, high-contrast black and white portrait silhouette of {argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. This main portrait acts as the container.
THE GRID FILL & TEXTURES (MIXED MEDIA):
The interior of the silhouette is populated by a dense "photo mosaic grid" of action shots from the person's career.
CRITICAL TEXTURE INSTRUCTION: Do not just paste flat photos. Apply artistic textures to various grid cells to create a tactile, collage feel. Use effects like:
Halftone Dots: Comic-book style raster patterns on some cells.
Fabric/Embroidery: Subtle thread or canvas textures suggesting a jersey or patch.
Film Grain: Heavy noise on specific high-contrast action shots.
COLOR STRATEGY:
The base is Monochrome B&W. Use selective color overlays (relevant to the team/flag) ONLY on specific grid cells to create a rhythm.
TYPOGRAPHY & BRANDING (STRICT MICRO-SCALING):
Top Left (The Name): Write "{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}" strictly using the font {argument name="font family" default="Inter Semibold"}.
Kerning: Tight negative kerning (-4%).
Size: SMALL and discreet. It must occupy MAXIMUM 20% of the canvas width. Do NOT make it large or loud.
Top Right (The Symbol): Place the primary logo (Team/Brand/Flag).
Size: VERY SMALL. It must occupy MAXIMUM 10% of the canvas width.
COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND:
Background: Off-white or light grey with a visible high-quality paper or concrete texture. It should not be flat digital white.
Alignment: Center the figure perfectly. Maintain wide negative space around the object.

items.title: Sunset Motocross Action Portrait
items.description: A comprehensive action photography prompt for a motocross rider during golden hour, specifying camera settings, color grading, and dynamic environmental details like dust and lighting.
items.content:
A cinematic high resolution action portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man riding a modern motocross dirt bike"} across {argument name="setting" default="rough rocky terrain during golden hour sunset"}. He is leaning aggressively forward while turning, showing focus and intensity on his face. He has messy windswept dark hair, light stubble, sharp jawline, athletic build, wearing a fitted black compression t shirt, dark cargo pants, black motocross gloves with orange details, and black racing boots with orange accents.
The bike is a sleek matte black and gray off road dirt bike with detailed suspension, rugged knobby tires, visible engine parts, realistic mud splashes, spinning wheels, and dust flying from the rear tire. The rider is captured mid motion with dynamic energy and speed.
Background features a warm desert landscape with distant mountains softly blurred in the horizon. Huge clouds of dust rise behind the bike, illuminated by the sunlight. Sky has a smooth gradient from deep teal blue at the top to glowing orange near the horizon. Strong sunlight creates dramatic rim lighting around the rider and bike, with rich shadows and warm highlights.
Foreground has textured gravel, dirt, scattered stones, motion debris, sharp ground detail. Shot from a low angle for a heroic powerful perspective. Shallow depth of field keeps the rider sharp while background remains creamy and cinematic.
Color grading is {argument name="color grade" default="teal and orange"}, high contrast, realistic skin tones, crisp details, ultra sharp focus, premium editorial sports photography style, cinematic storytelling, adventure aesthetic, volumetric dust lighting, HDR quality, 8k, realistic textures, natural reflections, professional lens compression, intense atmosphere.
Camera settings: low angle tracking shot, 85mm lens, f/2.8, fast shutter speed, ISO 100, high clarity, subject centered composition.

items.title: Visual Polyglot Magazine Collage
items.description: A complex collage prompt for a magazine page that blends various scientific, artistic, and technical diagrams to celebrate visual culture.
items.content: I am creating a magazine page with the theme of "visual polyglot". The title in the center of the image should be "{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}". Create a piece of art celebrating visual creations, not limited to beautiful photographs but also across the full breadth of human visual culture and natural visual elements. There should be curated collage representing the diverse distribution: scientific diagrams, the periodic table, the solar system, medieval manuscript pages, botanical illustrations, anatomical drawings, old maps, climate charts, engineering schematics, transit signage, multilingual text, comic panels, UI screenshots, a camera photo, a butterfly specimen, pie charts, architectural blueprints, and façade drawings. The text frames the model as fluent across languages, notation systems, interfaces, cultural forms, and visual conventions—able to move from utility to beauty, from document understanding to artistic generation. Also feature artistic elements like pixel art, styles, history, sculpture, nature, photography, paintings, and all art forms. These are just examples, I need you to actively think about other elements / styles that may fit in a good design that's not limited to these concepts. The overall effect is that of a premium research announcement or museum-style manifesto: elegant, ambitious, and designed to argue that image intelligence should be trained on the whole visual world, not just polished aesthetics. Use an unstructured, creative and artistic layout, such as but not limited to fan out, avoid grid-like layouts. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. Don't add any content text beside the "Create Everything at Once" title. Text as part of the art is okay. Avoid a beige tint of the overall style, since we want vibrant elements to be vibrant.

items.title: Tang Dynasty Aesthetic CG Illustration
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating an elegant Eastern beauty in a traditional Tang Dynasty style with cinematic lighting.
items.content:
{argument name="风格" default="国风CG插画"}，唐风美学，{argument name="人物设定" default="古代绝美女子"}，半身近景特写，画面重心聚焦面部与上半身，高级人像构图，电影级镜头语言与空间透视

人物设定：
东亚古典美人，冷白通透肌肤，细腻真实皮肤质感，柔润微光；
五官精致立体但自然不过度夸张，狭长凤眼，眼尾微挑，眼神含情带羞、微醺朦胧，长睫毛投下细微阴影；
唇色如胭脂晕染，微启唇，神态柔美而富有情绪张力，呈现“含蓄东方美”

造型设计：
粉色系华丽唐风服饰，轻柔贴合身体曲线，层次丰富但不过度堆叠；
适度低领设计，强调锁骨与颈肩线条，视觉引导自然不过分直白；
头戴精工凤冠（金属、珍珠、宝石、流苏），材质真实反光，随动作轻微摆动

动态与姿态：
身体微侧或轻旋转姿态，颈部延展，肩线舒展，手部形成柔性引导线，增强画面韵律与女性柔美张力

光影系统：
电影级布光
主光：暖金侧前方光聚焦面部与肌肤高光
辅光：冷色环境光塑造体积与空间
边缘光勾勒发丝与肩颈轮廓
高光控制不过曝，阴影保留细节，面部光影柔和过渡

画面风格：
超写实CG人像融合东方写意气韵，轻微朦胧美学

氛围与质感：
梦幻、含蓄、东方审美的高级氛围；
背景虚化，弱化环境强化人物；
轻微胶片颗粒+ 柔焦辉光，增强情绪与质感

色彩体系：
主色：胭脂粉、鎏金
辅色：冷青蓝灰
整体低饱和高质感，避免艳俗

镜头参数：
85mm portrait lens, f1.4–f2, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing

画质：
ultra detailed, 8K–16K, extreme detail, high resolution, cinematic lighting

比例：
{argument name="比例" default="9:16"}
items.translatedContent:
{argument name="style" default="Chinese style CG illustration"}, Tang Dynasty aesthetics, {argument name="character description" default="exquisite ancient woman"}, half-body close-up shot, focus on face and upper body, high-end portrait composition, cinematic camera language and spatial perspective.

Character Setting:
East Asian classical beauty, cold white transparent skin, fine and real skin texture, soft shimmer; exquisite and three-dimensional facial features but natural and not exaggerated, narrow phoenix eyes, slightly tilted eye corners, affectionate and shy eyes, slightly tipsy and hazy, long eyelashes casting subtle shadows; lip color like rouge, slightly parted lips, soft and emotional tension, presenting 'subtle Oriental beauty'.

Styling Design:
Pink-toned gorgeous Tang-style clothing, softly fitting the body curves, rich layers but not over-stacked; moderate low-neck design emphasizing collarbone and neck-shoulder lines, natural visual guidance; exquisite phoenix crown (metal, pearls, gems, tassels), realistic material reflection, moving slightly with action.

Dynamics and Pose:
Slightly side-turned or lightly rotating posture, neck extension, shoulder lines stretched, hands forming soft guide lines, enhancing picture rhythm and feminine soft tension.

Lighting System:
Cinematic lighting. Key light: warm gold front-side light focusing on face and skin highlights. Fill light: cold ambient light shaping volume and space. Rim light outlining hair and neck silhouette. Highlights controlled without overexposure, shadows retaining details, soft transition of facial light and shadow.

Art Style:
Ultra-realistic CG portrait merged with Oriental freehand charm, slight hazy aesthetics.

Atmosphere and Texture:
Dreamy, subtle, high-end atmosphere of Oriental aesthetics; blurred background to weaken environment and strengthen character; slight film grain + soft focus glow to enhance emotion and texture.

Color System:
Main colors: rouge pink, gold. Auxiliary colors: cold blue-gray. Overall low saturation and high quality, avoiding gaudiness.

Lens parameters:
85mm portrait lens, f1.4–f2, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing.

Quality:
ultra detailed, 8K–16K, extreme detail, high resolution, cinematic lighting.

Aspect Ratio:
{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

items.title: Packaging Design Proposal Board Prompt
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating professional hand-drawn style product packaging design proposals and conceptual mood boards.
items.content:
请为【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】生成一张“手绘包装提案板风格”的产品介绍海报。 

如果我提供了产品图片，请以该图片为主要参考，保留产品的核心外观特征、包装形态、颜色、材质、品牌识别和整体气质，并优先沿用产品图中的主色调与配色关系进行设计。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】自动生成符合该产品定位的产品外观与包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质，自动搭配自然合理的主色、辅助色和背景色。

海报整体风格要求：
这不是普通电商详情页，也不是单纯棚拍海报，而是一张融合“产品成品图 + 包装设计草图 + 品牌概念开发过程”的创意提案板。整体呈现为高审美、高完成度的品牌设计展示图，像设计师正在展示一个包装概念方案。

画面要求：
- 竖版构图
- 使用统一且有品牌感的主色调背景，背景颜色根据产品本身自然决定，不固定为某一种颜色
- 配色应与产品属性协调：如果有参考图，优先继承参考图的主色和品牌色；如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的色彩方案
- 画面中央放置一个最完整、最吸睛的产品主视觉，具有真实质感、立体光影和商业成品效果
- 产品周围加入多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部造型探索、手持展示小稿、包装展开思路、品牌字样排版试验
- 加入自然随性的黑色或深色手绘线稿、箭头、圈画、符号、手写中文批注，让画面具有强烈“设计过程感”和“创意提案感”
- 成品图要相对精致真实，草图部分要相对随性灵动，形成“完成品 + 设计草图”的对比
- 版式看起来松弛自由，但整体要有秩序、有节奏、有视觉中心，体现高级平面设计感
- 可以适度加入与产品相关的小图形、小符号或趣味元素，增强品牌记忆点
- 最终效果应具有品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力

配色原则：
- 不要固定黄色背景
- 要根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费感受和品牌气质自动选择主色调
- 背景色、产品色、文字色、草图线稿色应彼此协调
- 可以使用高饱和单色背景，也可以使用柔和统一色系背景，只要整体有品牌感和视觉冲击力
- 色彩应自然服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主

风格关键词：
包装设计提案板、品牌概念开发、手绘草图、设计过程感、moodboard、创意评审稿、产品成品渲染、视觉实验、商业设计海报

请特别注意：
- 如果有参考产品图，优先遵循参考图，不要偏离产品本身
- 如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的产品外观、包装和配色方案，并保持整体风格统一
- 画面重点是“产品介绍 + 创意设计过程展示”
- 不要做成普通电商详情页，不要做成促销海报，不要过度整齐呆板，不要缺少草图和手写批注，不要廉价感，不要低幼卡通感
items.translatedContent:
Please generate a "hand-drawn packaging proposal board style" product introduction poster for {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}.

If I provide a product image, please use it as the main reference, retaining the core visual characteristics, packaging form, colors, materials, brand identity, and overall temperament of the product. Prioritize the main color tone and color relationships from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate a product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}, and automatically match natural and reasonable main, auxiliary, and background colors based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.

Overall poster style requirements:
This is not a standard e-commerce detail page or a simple studio-shot poster, but a creative proposal board that integrates "product finished image + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation is a high-aesthetic, high-completion brand design display image, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept proposal.

Visual requirements:
- Vertical composition
- Use a unified background with a brand feel; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself and not fixed to any one color.
- Color schemes should coordinate with product attributes: if there is a reference image, prioritize inheriting its main and brand colors; if not, automatically generate a reasonable color scheme based on the product name.
- Place the most complete and eye-catching product main visual in the center, with realistic textures, 3D lighting, and commercial finish effects.
- Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, local form explorations, hand-held display drafts, packaging unfolding ideas, and brand lettering layout experiments.
- Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn line art, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative proposal."
- The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch parts should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between the "finished product + design sketches."
- The layout should look relaxed and free, but overall it must have order, rhythm, and a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design feel.
- Small graphics, symbols, or interesting elements related to the product can be added appropriately to enhance brand memory points.
- The final effect should have a sense of branding, creativity, process, and visual impact.

Color principles:
- Do not fix a yellow background.
- Automatically select the main color tone based on product type, material, use, consumer experience, and brand temperament.
- The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line art color should coordinate with each other.
- High-saturation monochromatic backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image has a brand feel and visual impact.
- Colors should naturally serve the product rather than overshadow it.

Style keywords:
Packaging design proposal board, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, moodboard, creative review draft, product finished rendering, visual experimentation, commercial design poster.

Special notes:
- If there is a reference product image, prioritize following it and do not deviate from the product itself.
- If there is no reference image, automatically generate reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color schemes based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency.
- The focus of the image is "product introduction + creative design process display."
- Do not make it look like a common e-commerce detail page, a promotional poster, or overly neat and stiff; do not lack sketches and handwritten annotations; avoid a cheap feel or an immature cartoon style.

items.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
items.description: A prompt for creating an artistic infographic card in a 9:16 aspect ratio with a hand-drawn style and paper texture.
items.content:
创作一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，比例为9:16竖版。卡片主题鲜明，背景为带有纸质肌理的米色或米白色，整体设计体现质朴、亲切的手绘美感。

卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。

卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。

主题是：“{argument name="主题内容" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}”
items.translatedContent:
Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. The card has a clear theme and the background is beige or off-white with a paper texture. The overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

The top of the card features a large brush cursive font in alternating red and black with sharp contrast to highlight the title and attract visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each using short, concise Chinese phrases to express core points. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive, being both legible and artistic.

The card is dotted with simple, fun hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, to enhance visual appeal and trigger thought and resonance in the reader. The overall layout pays attention to visual balance, reserving enough white space to ensure the image is concise, clear, and easy to read and understand.

The theme is: "{argument name="theme content" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest. Keep setting up your stall every day, keep doing it, and there will definitely be results, because 99% of people can't stick to it."}"

items.title: Food Lifecycle Infographic Prompt
items.description: A detailed scientific infographic prompt designed for Little Red Book style, visualizing the maturation and decay of food items through time-slices.
items.content:
以“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面中必须是“一个完整的单体食物”（如一个土豆 / 一把香蕉 / 一头大蒜），
通过横向切片的方式，表现同一个食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而不是多个不同食物拼接。

食物主体保持结构连续、形状一致，只是在不同切片区域呈现不同成熟度（像时间被切开）。

画面为竖版3:4比例，主体居中横向展开，被均匀分割为4-6段：

从左到右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每一段体现真实变化：

颜色变化（青→黄→黑等）
质地变化（饱满→软化→皱缩→腐坏）
特征变化（发芽、出水、霉变等）

每个阶段配文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特点
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高真实感摄影风格
清晰分割线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用⚠️✔️等标识

画面顶部标题：“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”

关键要求：必须表现为“同一个食物随时间变化的切片”，而不是多个独立个体拼接
items.translatedContent:
An educational infographic themed "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}."

The image must feature "a single complete food item" (such as a potato / a bunch of bananas / a head of garlic), using horizontal slicing to show the changes of the same food at different time stages, rather than a collage of multiple different items.

The main food body maintains structural continuity and consistent shape, presenting different levels of maturity in different slice areas (like time being sliced open).

The image is in vertical 3:4 ratio, with the main subject centered and horizontally expanded, evenly divided into 4-6 segments:

From left to right: Immature → Mature → Overripe → Spoiled

Each segment reflects real changes:

Color changes (green → yellow → black, etc.)
Texture changes (plump → softened → shriveled → decayed)
Feature changes (sprouting, weeping, mold, etc.)

Each stage is accompanied by text descriptions:

Stage name
Appearance characteristics
Internal changes (sugar/starch/moisture changes)
Consumption suggestions (recommended/suitable for cooking/inedible)

Design style:

Minimalist light background (beige)
Highly realistic photography style
Clear dividing lines (sense of time slicing)
Chinese educational layout, Little Red Book style
Appropriate use of icons like ⚠️✔️

Title at the top: "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}"

Key requirement: It must be presented as "slices of the same food item changing over time," not a collage of independent individuals.

items.title: Hand-drawn Travel Journal Illustration
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating a child-like, hand-drawn travel journal illustration with customizable city names, landmarks, and routes.
items.content:
请绘制一张色彩鲜艳、竖版（9:16）手绘风格的《{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行手账插画》，画风仿佛由一位充满好奇心的孩子用蜡笔创作，整体使用柔和温暖的浅色背景（如浅黄色），搭配红色、蓝色、绿色等明亮色调，营造温馨、童趣、满满旅行气息的氛围。

一、主画面：手账式旅行路线

在插画中央绘制一条“蜿蜒曲折的旅行路线”，路线用箭头 + 虚线连接多个地点，由 {argument name="天数" default="1"} 日行程自动生成推荐景点：

示例格式（自动替换为{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}相关）：

- “第 1 站：{景点 1 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 2 站：{景点 2 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 3 站：{景点 3 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- …
- “最终站：{当地招牌美食/纪念品 + 温馨结束语}”

> 旅程站点数量随天数自动生成：
> 若用户未输入天数，则按默认 1 日 / 精华线路生成。

---

二、周围趣味元素（全部根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围加入大量充满童趣的小元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色：
  “拿着当地特色小吃的小朋友”、
  “背着旅行包的冒险小孩”等。

- 当地标志性建筑的童趣 Q 版手绘：
  如 “{城市地标1}”、“{城市地标2}”、“{城市地标3}”。

- 有趣的提示牌：
  “小心迷路！”、“注意人流！”、“前方好吃的！”（可根据城市语境调整）。

- 贴纸式小标语：
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行记忆已解锁！”
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}美食大冒险！”
  “下一站去哪儿？”

- 当地美食的可爱小图标：
  如 “{城市美食1}”、“{城市美食2}”、“{城市美食3}”。

- 感叹句（保持童真风）：
  “原来{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}这么好玩！”
  “我要再来一次！”

---

三、整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩鲜艳、构图饱满但温暖
- 强调旅行的欢乐与探索感
- 所有文字采用可爱的手写字体
- 让整个画面像一本童趣满满的旅行手账页面
items.translatedContent:
Please draw a brightly colored, vertical (9:16) hand-drawn style "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Journal Illustration." The style should look as if it were created with crayons by a curious child. Use a soft and warm light-colored background (such as light yellow), paired with bright tones like red, blue, and green, to create a cozy, child-like, and travel-inspired atmosphere.

I. Main Image: Journal-style Travel Route

Draw a "winding travel route" in the center of the illustration, connecting multiple locations with arrows and dashed lines. Recommended attractions will be automatically generated based on a {argument name="number of days" default="1"}-day itinerary:

Example format (automatically replaced with {argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} related content):

- "Stop 1: {Attraction 1 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 2: {Attraction 2 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 3: {Attraction 3 recommendation + short fun description}"
- ...
- "Final Stop: {Local signature food/souvenir + warm closing statement}"

> The number of travel stops is automatically generated based on the number of days. If no days are input, a 1-day/highlights route will be generated by default.

II. Fun Surrounding Elements (Automatically replaced based on the city)

Add plenty of child-like elements around the route, such as:

- Cute travel characters: "A child holding local snacks," "An adventurous kid wearing a backpack," etc.
- Child-like Q-version hand-drawings of local landmarks: such as "{landmark 1}," "{landmark 2}," "{landmark 3}."
- Fun signboards: "Watch out for getting lost!", "Mind the crowds!", "Good food ahead!" (Adjusted according to city context).
- Sticker-style slogans: "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Memories Unlocked!", "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Food Adventure!", "Where to next?"
- Cute small icons of local delicacies: such as "{food 1}," "{food 2}," "{food 3}."
- Exclamations (maintaining a child-like tone): "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} is so much fun!", "I want to go again!"

III. Overall Style Requirements

- Hand-drawn crayon style / children's travel log style
- Bright colors, full but warm composition
- Emphasis on the joy and exploration of travel
- All text uses cute handwritten fonts
- Make the entire image look like a travel journal page full of child-like wonder.

items.title: Nostalgic 2003 Family Apartment Photo
items.description: A prompt for generating realistic, grainy, and slightly blurry indoor family photos mimicking the look of early 2000s digital cameras.
items.content: A candid, unprocessed indoor photograph taken with an early 2000s consumer digital camera or cheap film camera. The image features a {argument name="family description" default="cheerful Chinese family of three"} in their {argument name="living room description" default="modest Beijing apartment living room"} circa {argument name="year" default="2003"}. A mother, father, and young daughter (around 6) are captured in a cluttered, genuine setting. The mother is looking up, surprised and smiling, while the father is trying to fix an old VCR player, and the daughter is playing with a colorful toy car on the patterned rug. The shot is clearly spontaneous, taken with poor, natural window light from the right. The composition is off-center, slightly blurry and grainy with muted, washed-out colors and a yellowish tint. In the background, there's a bulky beige TV showing static, a wall calendar from 2003, cluttered shelves with VHS tapes, framed family pictures, a cloth sofa, and maybe a small plant. The perspective is from eye level but feels handheld and shaky. The focus is soft, and the depth of field is shallow, emphasizing the natural moment. Shot with an old Nikon Coolpix or Canon PowerShot, visible digital noise and a time-stamp in a corner. The shot captures a slice of mundane, everyday life, with the daughter's messy hair and toys scattered, creating an authentic, memory-like feel.

items.content: 请创作一幅{argument name="人物角色" default="东方幻想人物"}使用{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}的东方幻想人物概念插画。整体风格融合国风仙侠、神话圣像感与电影级CG概念原画质感，画面具有强烈的东方幻想美学、高级审美与史诗感。人物为主视觉核心，气质空灵、神圣、优雅、清冷或威严，根据{argument name="人物角色" default="东方幻想人物"}自动匹配最合适的神态、服饰、发型、配饰与身份设定。如果{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}是乐器，则人物呈现演奏、拨弦、吹奏、执乐而立等充满仪式感与流动感的姿态，强调音乐能量、灵气流动、音波化作光纹、云气、星辉或法阵。如果{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}是武器，则人物呈现持械、蓄势、对峙、施法或战斗前一瞬的姿态，强调力量感、压迫感、气场与能量汇聚。构图以人物居中或偏中心为主，整体平衡、庄严、具有海报级主视觉效果；人物背后可带有月轮、法环、神性光晕、古老纹阵或圣像式圆形结构。服装采用东方幻想风格，材质轻盈华美，带轻纱、飘带、层叠衣摆、金属饰件、玉饰或冠饰，发丝与布料在风中流动，形成强烈的动态美感。背景根据角色气质自动匹配为星空神域、云海天界、月下圣境、竹林仙山、冰雪秘境、幽夜神坛、古风遗迹等东方幻想场景，环境带有薄雾、流光、粒子、神秘能量与空间纵深。色彩以统一且高级的主色调控制画面，可根据角色和道具自动选择冰蓝、月白、青绿、幽紫、赤金、墨黑、银灰等配色，并用少量淡金或冷光进行神性点缀。整体要求：唯美、梦幻、空灵、神秘、超脱、神圣、精致，具有电影级光影、体积光、空气感、超细节CG插画质感，避免俗艳、避免廉价古风写真感、避免网红脸、避免杂乱背景、避免塑料质感。
items.translatedContent: Please create an Eastern fantasy character concept illustration featuring {argument name="character role" default="an Eastern fantasy character"} using {argument name="weapon" default="a musical instrument or weapon"}. The overall style blends traditional Chinese Xianxia, mythological iconography, and movie-level CG concept art texture. The image has a strong Eastern fantasy aesthetic, high-level beauty, and an epic feel. The character is the core visual focus, with an ethereal, sacred, elegant, cold, or majestic temperament. Automatically match the most appropriate expression, clothing, hairstyle, accessories, and identity setting based on the {argument name="character role" default="character"}. If the {argument name="weapon" default="item"} is a musical instrument, the character should be in a ritualistic and fluid posture such as playing, plucking, blowing, or standing with the instrument, emphasizing musical energy, spiritual flow, and sound waves turning into light patterns, clouds, starlight, or magic circles. If the {argument name="weapon" default="item"} is a weapon, the character should be in a posture of holding the weapon, gathering momentum, confronting, casting spells, or the moment before battle, emphasizing the sense of power, pressure, aura, and energy convergence. The composition is mainly centered or off-center, balanced, solemn, and has a poster-level main visual effect; the character's back can have a moon wheel, a halo, divine light, an ancient array, or an icon-style circular structure. The clothing adopts an Eastern fantasy style with light and beautiful materials, including gauze, ribbons, layered hems, metal ornaments, jade ornaments, or crowns. Hair and fabric flow in the wind, creating a strong sense of dynamic beauty. The background is automatically matched to the character's temperament as Eastern fantasy scenes such as starry sky divine realm, cloud sea heaven, moonlit sacred land, bamboo forest fairy mountain, ice and snow secret realm, quiet night altar, ancient ruins, etc., with environment carrying mist, flowing light, particles, mysterious energy, and spatial depth. The color uses a unified and high-level main tone to control the screen. It can automatically choose ice blue, moon white, green, purple, red gold, ink black, silver gray and other color schemes according to the character and props, and use a small amount of light gold or cold light for divine embellishment. Overall requirements: beautiful, dreamy, ethereal, mysterious, detached, sacred, exquisite, with movie-level lighting and shadow, volumetric light, sense of air, ultra-detailed CG illustration texture; avoid vulgarity, avoid cheap ancient style photo sense, avoid internet celebrity faces, avoid cluttered backgrounds, avoid plastic textures.

items.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
items.description: A prompt for creating stylized vertical infographic cards with a paper texture background and Chinese calligraphy headings.
items.content: 创作一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，比例为9:16竖版。卡片主题鲜明，背景为带有纸质肌理的米色或米白色，整体设计体现质朴、亲切的手绘美感。卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。主题是："{argument name="主题" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}"
items.translatedContent: Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical ratio. The card has a clear theme, the background is beige or off-white with paper texture, and the overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic. At the top of the card, a large red and black contrasting brush cursive font highlights the title to attract the visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each expressing core points with short and refined Chinese phrases. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive script, which is both clear and readable and full of artistic atmosphere. Simple and interesting hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, are dotted on the card to enhance visual appeal and trigger readers' thinking and resonance. Pay attention to visual balance in the overall layout, reserve enough blank space to ensure the image is concise and clear, easy to read and understand. The theme is: "{argument name="theme" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest; stick to setting up your stall every day and keep doing it, there will definitely be results because 99% can't persist."} "

items.title: Language Learning Infographic Poster
items.description: A detailed template for creating clean, educational infographics in a grid layout, suitable for vocabulary learning and social media sharing.
items.content:

采用整齐的网格布局（4x5），每个卡片展示一种蔬菜。

- 写实风格的蔬菜图片
- 英文名称（加粗）
- 英式或美式音标（IPA）
- 简短英文描述

极简设计，白色背景，柔和的绿色和浅色系配色，

items.title: Professional Automotive Technical Infographic Prompt
items.description: A massive, detailed prompt for generating high-end automotive technical breakdown posters with 3D perspective views and complex Chinese typography.

items.title: Cinematic Anime Movie Poster Prompt
items.description: A highly detailed, professional-grade prompt for generating Japanese theatrical anime posters, including specific instructions for layout, lighting, and typography.

author.name: いにしえ@AI Director & Creator｜Will Oldgram

items.content:
16:9の劇場版アニメ映画ポスター。夜の森の境界領域。前景中央やや左に、10代後半の日本人少女。黒髪ポニーテール、細身、ダークカラーの実用的な防寒アウトドアジャケット、調査用バックパック。背中側を見せた3/4後ろ姿で肩越しに振り向く。落ち着いた緊張感と強い意志。
右上空の森の上に、白青色に発光する巨大な球状超常現象。無数の発光フィラメントと電気的な輪郭線が絡み合うエネルギー球。内部は霧がかった白光、周囲に微細な青白い粒子光。左奥には噴煙を上げる富士山。中景には日本語警告入りの立入禁止テープ、現実的な災害対応スタッフ、左右に救急車両。軍事感は不要。
地面はぬかるんだ山林で、浅い水流と濡れた地表が発光を反射。左右の高い木々が画面を囲む。空は満天の星、富士山麓には微細な街明かり。神秘と災厄が同時に存在する空気感。
少女、巨大光球、富士山の三角構図。やや低めのシネマティック視点。少女と光球を二大主役として大きく明確に見せる。冷たい夜の青を基調に、主光源は巨大光球の白青発光。木々、地面、水面、少女に強いリムライト。副光源として星明かりと遠方の噴火の微かな橙光。少女の顔は暗すぎず表情が読める。高コントラスト。
最新の日本劇場版アニメの高級感あるキービジュアル。映画ポスター級の完成度。高密度で繊細な背景、精密な光表現、空気遠近感、写実寄りで美しく整理されたアニメ作画。全体トーンはダークネイビー、白青発光、微かな火山の橙。荘厳、不穏、神秘的、ドラマ性が高い。
上部中央に小さめの日本語コピー: "{argument name="ポスターのキャッチコピー" default="それは奇跡ではない。彼岸の彼方へつながる災害だった。"}"
下部中央に大きく、白に近い淡い発光の上品な英字セリフ体タイトル: "{argument name="映画のタイトル" default="Re:Connect Worlds"}"
その直下に小さめの日本語サブタイトル: "{argument name="サブタイトル" default="境界の森"}"
文字は正確で高可読。指定以外の文字、ロゴ、透かしは入れない。余計な人物、モンスター、メカ、不要な派手な粒子やノイズは入れない。
items.translatedContent:
16:9 theatrical anime movie poster. Boundary area of a night forest. In the center-left foreground, a Japanese girl in her late teens. Black hair ponytail, slender, wearing a dark-colored practical winter outdoor jacket and a research backpack. 3/4 rear view showing her back, looking back over her shoulder. Calm tension and strong will.
Above the forest in the upper right, a giant spherical paranormal phenomenon emitting white-blue light. An energy sphere intertwined with countless luminous filaments and electrical outlines. Foggy white light inside, surrounded by fine pale blue particle light. Mt. Fuji emitting plumes of smoke in the far left background. In the middle ground, forbidden entry tape with Japanese warnings, realistic disaster response staff, and emergency vehicles on both sides. No military feel required.
Ground is muddy mountain forest, with shallow water streams and wet ground reflecting the light. Tall trees on the left and right frame the scene. Sky is full of stars, with subtle city lights at the foot of Mt. Fuji. An atmosphere where mystery and disaster coexist.
Triangular composition of the girl, the giant light sphere, and Mt. Fuji. Slightly low cinematic viewpoint. The girl and the light sphere are clearly shown as the two main protagonists. Based on cold night blue, the main light source is the white-blue emission from the giant light sphere. Strong rim light on the trees, ground, water surface, and the girl. Secondary light sources are starlight and the faint orange glow of the distant eruption. The girl's face is not too dark and her expression is readable. High contrast.
High-end key visual for the latest Japanese theatrical anime. Movie poster grade completion. High-density, delicate background, precise light expression, atmospheric perspective, beautifully organized anime drawing leaning towards realism. Overall tone is dark navy, white-blue emission, and faint volcanic orange. Solemn, unsettling, mysterious, and high drama.
Small Japanese copy in the top center: "{argument name="poster slogan" default="It was not a miracle. It was a disaster that connected to the beyond."}"
Large elegant English serif title in bottom center with pale light close to white: "{argument name="movie title" default="Re:Connect Worlds"}"
Directly below it, a small Japanese subtitle: "{argument name="subtitle" default="Forest of Boundaries"}"
Characters are accurate and highly readable. Do not include characters, logos, or watermarks other than specified. Do not include unnecessary people, monsters, mechs, or unnecessary flashy particles or noise.

items.title: Summer McCafé Mountain Road Ad
items.description: A polished vertical fast-food campaign image showing a stylish woman on a red sports car holding iced coffee, ideal for recreating premium summer mobile ads for restaurants or beverage brands.
items.content: Create a premium vertical fast-food lifestyle advertisement in a polished commercial photography style, designed like a summer campaign poster for McDonald's and McCafé. Show a glamorous young woman with softly blurred, unidentifiable facial features sitting confidently on the hood of a sleek red sports car parked on a winding mountain road at golden hour. She has long wavy auburn hair glowing in warm sunset backlight, wears a dark green satin bomber jacket with gold detailing, a white camisole, high-waisted burgundy pants, and black ankle boots with heels. Her pose is relaxed and stylish, one leg bent and one extended forward, while she holds out a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw and visible McDonald's golden arches branding toward the camera. Scatter red roses across the car hood around her, and place 1 McDonald's paper takeout bag on the right side of the hood. Use a dramatic canyon or hillside background with warm sunlight, soft haze, cinematic depth of field, and a luxurious aspirational road-trip mood. Include floating red flower petals in the air. Compose the layout as a high-end ad with the model centered slightly right and large promotional typography on the left. Add exactly 3 large headline lines in the upper left: "SIP.", "SAVOR.", and "{argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER."}" with the first 2 in bold white and the third in bold golden yellow. Below that, add the subheadline: "Refresh your drive with McCafé." with "McCafé" highlighted in yellow. Add exactly 3 circular feature icons stacked vertically on the left with short captions: "PREMIUM McCAFÉ ICED COFFEE", "WORLD FAMOUS FRIES", and "QUALITY YOU CAN TASTE". Place the McDonald's golden arches logo with the text "i'm lovin' it" in the top right. Add a small lower-left tagline reading "Good days start here." with "start here." in yellow. Create a bold yellow bottom banner spanning the width, divided into 3 content areas: left area reads "SUMMER SAVINGS" and "ENJOY EXCLUSIVE OFFERS"; center area includes a McDonald's app icon and the text "DOWNLOAD THE APP FOR DEALS NEAR YOU"; right area reads "FOLLOW US @MCDONALDS" with social icons. Use brand-accurate red and yellow accents, glossy product styling, realistic lighting, sharp editorial retouching, shallow depth of field, luxury commercial ad composition, and mobile-first poster proportions.

items.content: A candid nighttime street portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young woman"} sitting casually on a woven bistro café chair outside a small urban restaurant. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair worn loose and slightly tousled, tan skin, and minimal natural makeup with a soft flash-lit glow. She wears a fitted white tank top layered over a visible black lace bralette and high-waisted relaxed blue jeans, with subtle gold jewelry: 2 thin bracelets on one wrist, 1 delicate necklace with a tiny heart pendant, and 1 slim bracelet on the other wrist. Add a narrow red vertical neon glow in the background, distant streetlights and blurred city bokeh along the left side, and faint gold lettering on the glass door to the right. Include a clear glass bottle on the table edge at the far right. Authentic nightlife mood, stylish but unfiltered, shallow depth of field, realistic proportions, flash photography aesthetic, cinematic urban candid.

items.description: This prompt generates a stark single-subject dark fantasy portrait, useful for creating moody character art, avatars, or emblem-style concept images.
items.content: A minimalist monochrome fantasy portrait on a flat light gray background, centered with lots of empty negative space around the subject. Show a bust-length hooded rogue or medieval assassin facing slightly to the right, rendered as a high-contrast black ink illustration with dense stippling, scratchy engraving-like texture, and dramatic white highlights on the folds of the cloth. The figure wears a deep cowl and heavy hood that completely obscure the head and most of the face, plus a layered scarf wrapped around the neck and a single worn metal shoulder pauldron on the right side with visible rivets, scratches, and a leather strap crossing the chest. Replace the visible face area with a single vertical soft-edged blurred rectangle in gray-black tones, creating an intentional censored or glitched void where the face should be. Keep the composition simple: 1 character, 1 shoulder pauldron, 1 blurred rectangular face block, no additional props, no scenery, no text. items.content: A minimalist monochrome illustration of a traditional Japanese samurai helmet and shoulder armor, shown as a centered bust-length portrait on a plain light gray background. The armor is rendered in black ink engraving style with high contrast, dense stippling, etched linework, and vintage woodcut texture. The kabuto has two tall curved crest horns and layered side guards, with detailed lacing and plate construction visible on the shoulder section. The face area is completely obscured by a centered vertical black rectangle censor bar with slightly soft edges, covering the mask and most of the front of the helmet opening. Keep the composition small and isolated in the middle of the canvas with large negative space around it, no additional objects, no text, no border.
