items.title: Vintage Moda Pier in Istanbul
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic, filtered travel photo of Istanbul's Moda pier building by the water, ideal for cinematic city postcards and Instagram-style architecture imagery.
items.content: A dreamy vintage travel photograph of the historic Moda pier terminal in Istanbul, centered at the end of a stone waterfront jetty, shot in a vertical composition from across calm dark water. The two-story waterfront building has pale beige stone walls, a warm terracotta tiled hip roof, tall arched windows on the ground floor, an open upper veranda with many slim columns, and a visible sign reading "{argument name="pier sign text" default="MODA İSKELESİ"}" on the upper facade. A white ferry is partially visible on the far left behind the pier, and small scattered pedestrians stand along the dock and around the building, giving scale without becoming portrait subjects. The foreground is reflective harbor water with soft ripples and a muted reflection of the building; the pier edge is lined with white railings and rough dark rocks at the base. Above, a wide overcast sky with heavy layered clouds fills nearly half the image. Use a nostalgic Instagram-filter aesthetic with faded colors, warm sepia-beige tones, slight green cast in the shadows, gentle film grain, low contrast, soft haze, subtle vignette, and a lightly weathered analog-photo feel. Architecture-focused, serene, cinematic, realistic, slightly melancholy, like a viral travel postcard of {argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} on a cloudy day.

items.title: Vintage Bosphorus Bridge Ferry Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a moody sepia-toned Istanbul waterfront scene with the Bosphorus bridge, ferries, and a nostalgic retro Instagram-filter aesthetic for travel or atmospheric editorial imagery.
items.content: A dreamy vintage-style photograph of the Bosphorus in {argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} at dusk, shot from water level in a vertical composition. The enormous suspension bridge spans the frame from upper left to upper right, with a tall bridge tower on the far left and delicate strings of warm lights hanging down from the cables, plus a line of tiny orange lights tracing the roadway. Below the bridge, calm dark water fills the foreground. Place 3 visible boats total: 1 medium white passenger ferry centered in the middle distance facing the viewer, 1 long low white ferry farther back near the right side under the bridge, and 1 small boat at the far right edge. On the left shoreline, show an illuminated waterfront with warm yellow lights, a few palm trees, and part of an old building at the extreme left edge. Near the center-left background beneath the bridge, include a pale waterside mosque with 1 dome and 2 slender minarets. Behind everything, add a hazy hillside dense with buildings fading into the distance. Use a nostalgic viral Instagram-filter look: heavy warm sepia and muted olive tones, faded contrast, soft focus, visible film grain, subtle vignette, slight light leaks, low clarity, and an aged analog print texture. The atmosphere should feel moody, romantic, cinematic, and softly blurred, like an old travel memory.

items.title: Elegant Wuxia Swordsman Design Sheet
items.description: Generates a polished fantasy character reference-style illustration of a noble male swordsman with full-body view and zoomed-in costume and weapon details, ideal for concept art presentation.
items.content: Create an elegant high-fantasy character design sheet in a refined wuxia/xianxia style on a clean ivory background with a thin ornate vintage border. The layout is a split showcase with 5 visible panels: 1 large full-body panel on the left, 1 tall upper-right portrait close-up, and 3 stacked/lower detail panels on the right showing armor and weapon craftsmanship. The main subject is a handsome adult male swordsman, {argument name="character name" default="original character"}, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied in a half-up topknot, the rest loose and wind-swept, wearing a small gold earring. His expression is calm, noble, and slightly aloof. He wears luxurious layered robes in {argument name="robe colors" default="white, deep navy blue, and black"}, with wide sleeves, flowing sashes, and highly detailed gold embroidery. Over the shoulders and torso are ornate dark blue and black armor elements with elaborate gold filigree and dragon-like decorative metalwork, plus a jade-green gemstone set into the waist ornament and weapon fittings. In the full-body panel he stands in a poised three-quarter stance holding a long straight jian sword diagonally downward, with the robe hems and ribbons flowing gracefully to suggest motion. The costume should include exactly 6 standout outfit elements: white inner robe, dark blue outer robe panels, black underlayer trousers, wide black-and-gold waist belt, sculpted gold shoulder armor, and black bracers with gold detailing. The right-side close-up portrait emphasizes the layered collar, glossy hair texture, shoulder ornament, and elegant fabric rendering. The 3 detail panels show exactly these focus areas: a gold dragon-like waist armor emblem, a jade-set sword guard or accessory ornament, and a close-up of the ornate gold sword hilt and guard with part of the blade. Overall aesthetic: ultra-detailed concept art, stylish and polished, crisp linework blended with painterly rendering, premium character-sheet presentation, soft neutral studio lighting, subtle shadows, luxurious textures, and a restrained palette of ivory, midnight blue, black, gold, and jade green.

items.title: Spicy Nacho Tornado Ad
items.description: A bold square snack advertisement featuring a tornado of chips and red chilies erupting from a spicy nacho bag, ideal for food marketing and social media promos.
items.content: Create a dramatic square commercial poster for a spicy snack brand, with a fiery red storm atmosphere and high-energy food advertising style. The background is a dark crimson sky filled with glowing clouds, scattered sparks, and visible lightning bolts. In the center, a giant tornado made of swirling transparent wind rings, glossy whole red chili peppers, square corn chips, crumbs, and seasoning particles rises upward from an opened snack bag, forming a powerful vortex. The tornado should feel dynamic and explosive, with chips and chili peppers flying outward in different sizes and depths for a cinematic 3D look. At the bottom center, place a glossy red snack packet standing upright, labeled with the brand logo and product name {argument name="product name" default="Crispy Nachos Chips"}, with a spicy flavor badge reading {argument name="flavor text" default="Spicy Masala"}, a small chili illustration, a corn note near the bottom, and a printed image of square nacho chips on the front. Put a stylized playful logo at the top left reading {argument name="brand name" default="SnaX"} in bold yellow and white script with a red outline, and a clean white platform watermark at the top right reading {argument name="platform text" default="Pollo.ai"}. On the left side, add a huge stacked distressed headline in bold condensed uppercase, with the first word in golden yellow and the remaining three lines in white, reading exactly: {argument name="headline text" default="WARNING! CRUNCH STORM INCOMING"}. Use intense rim lighting, glossy highlights, deep shadows, rich red-orange color grading, and a premium snack advertisement composition that feels spicy, crunchy, chaotic, and irresistible.

items.title: Golden Hour Rooftop Fashion Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a polished, realistic editorial-style portrait of a fashionable woman on a rooftop at sunset, ideal for lifestyle branding, fashion ads, and social media visuals.
items.content: A cinematic golden-hour rooftop portrait of a stylish young woman standing by a balcony railing high above a modern city skyline, photographed vertically with a shallow depth of field. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long wavy hair glowing with warm sunset backlight, and her face is turned slightly away and obscured from view. She wears a black tailored blazer over a fitted white scoop-neck ribbed tank top, paired with high-waisted cream trousers with one hand in her pocket, plus a delicate necklace and a subtle bracelet or watch. The composition is waist-up to upper-thigh framing, elegant and fashion-editorial, with the woman placed prominently in the foreground and soft blurred skyscrapers in the background. Use warm orange sunlight, realistic skin and fabric textures, soft highlights on the hair and shoulders, a luxurious urban atmosphere, and a polished lifestyle photography look as if shot for a premium fashion campaign in {argument name="city setting" default="a modern downtown skyline"} during {argument name="time of day" default="sunset"}.

items.title: Minimal SaaS Ad With Invoice Mockup
items.description: This prompt generates a premium static marketing ad featuring a developer-hours invoice, strong editorial typography, and hand-drawn annotations for SaaS landing pages or paid social creatives.
items.content: Create a minimalist static SaaS ad on a warm off-white background with elegant editorial typography and clean, high-fidelity text rendering. At the top, place a large black serif headline in two lines reading: "{argument name="headline text" default="Your dev team shouldn’t be your analytics team."}" The words “dev team” should appear in italic serif while the rest remains bold high-contrast serif, with generous spacing and a luxury magazine-style layout. Centered below, show a slightly tilted white paper invoice sheet with a soft drop shadow and a subtle vertical fold crease down the middle, as if photographed from above. The invoice uses black monospaced typewriter-style text and reads exactly: “INVOICE — DEV HOURS, OCTOBER” as the header, then 5 line items with hours and prices aligned in columns: “A/B test setup on pricing page   8 hrs   $1,200”, “GTM tag install (3 events)   4 hrs   $600”, “Funnel tracking debug   6 hrs   $900”, “Meta pixel mapping   3 hrs   $450”, and “Attribution reporting build   12 hrs   $1,800”. Under the 5 items, add a dashed divider line, then a bold monospaced “TOTAL” on the lower left and the total price “$4,950” on the lower right. Draw a hand-drawn yellow line striking through the total price. Add 4 doodle-style annotation elements around the invoice: on the left, handwritten yellow text saying “every month??” with a yellow arrow pointing right toward the paper; on the upper right of the paper, a yellow starburst scribble; below the total, a green curved arrow pointing up toward the crossed-out price; and on the lower right, a green hand-drawn circle containing the handwritten words “zero devs,” connected to the green arrow. At the bottom center of the ad, add a smaller black sans-serif body copy in 2 lines reading: “{argument name="body text" default="Marketers ship tests and track revenue themselves.\nNo tickets. No tag manager. One script."}" Keep the composition airy, premium, and conversion-focused, blending modern startup ad design with tactile paper realism and playful marker annotations.

items.title: Editorial SaaS Receipt Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a high-contrast startup advertisement featuring a crumpled receipt, bold editorial typography, and pink handwritten callouts for analytics pricing campaigns.
items.content: Create a bold static SaaS ad on a matte black background with a premium editorial look and highly accurate typography. At the top, place a large stacked serif headline in off-white reading: "Your analytics stack" on the first line, "shouldn’t cost more" on the second line in bright magenta italic serif, and "than your rent." on the third line in off-white serif. Center the composition around a large curled, crumpled receipt made of white thermal paper, angled slightly from upper left to lower right, with visible paper texture, soft shadows, and rolled ends on both the upper right and lower left. On the receipt, show exactly 5 line items in black monospaced or receipt-style text aligned in two columns: "GA4" with "$0", "Hotjar" with "$99", "Optimizely" with "$2,450", "GTM setup (dev hours)" with "$1,800", and "Tag manager debug" with "$400". Highlight the word "Optimizely" with a jagged magenta starburst sticker behind it. Add a dashed divider line below the items, then a bold "TOTAL" label on the lower left of the receipt. On the lower right of the receipt, place a large price reading "{argument name="monthly price" default="$19/mo"}" in heavy black type, circled with 2 hand-drawn magenta marker loops. Add 3 handwritten magenta annotation elements: on the left side, the words "{argument name="left annotation" default="one tool"}" in brush script with an underline and a curved arrow pointing to the receipt; near the bottom center, a curved magenta arrow pointing upward toward the circled price; and at the bottom right, the handwritten tagline "{argument name="tagline text" default="One script. One price."}" with an underline. In the bottom-right corner, add a small block of white sans-serif body copy, right-aligned, reading "{argument name="body copy" default="Analytics, heatmaps, A/B testing, and revenue attribution."}". Use an editorial ad-photography style with crisp text placement, clean hierarchy, high contrast, subtle paper realism, and a limited palette of black, white, and hot pink.

items.title: Minimal Slot Machine Attribution Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a polished static marketing ad with a vintage slot machine metaphor, handwritten annotations, and strong centered typography for analytics or attribution software promotions.
items.content: Create a clean minimalist static ad on an off-white light gray studio background with a centered editorial layout. At the top, place a large luxury-fashion-style serif headline in black reading {argument name="headline text" default="Stop gambling with your ad spend."}, with the word "gambling" set in italic serif for emphasis. In the middle, show a vintage metal slot-machine window viewed straight on, slightly weathered and realistic, with 3 vertical reels inside a rectangular steel housing and a lever with a black knob on the right side. The 3 reels must display, from left to right, "$", "$", and "?". Make the rightmost reel background pale pink while the first 2 reels are aged white. Add a hand-drawn neon-pink annotation style over the image: 1 arrow-and-note on the left pointing to the first reel reading {argument name="left annotation" default="your attribution"}, 1 starburst scribble above the pink question-mark reel, 1 arrow from the question-mark reel to a circled note on the right reading {argument name="right annotation" default="actual revenue"}, and 1 large curved arrow in the lower left pointing toward the body copy area. Below the slot machine, center a short sans-serif paragraph in black reading {argument name="body text" default="See which campaigns drive revenue, not just clicks. items.title: Luxury Leather Fashion Collage Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a moody luxury fashion advertisement with a leather-clad model, handbag, torn material collage layers, and premium brand-editorial styling for social ads or campaign visuals.
items.content: A high-fashion luxury editorial advertisement in a vertical format, featuring a mysterious female model from mid-torso up, centered and slightly turned to the side, wearing an oversized dark olive leather jacket with a high collar and prominent buckle strap detail near the neck. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur, while her dark wavy shoulder-length hair remains visible and voluminous. She carries a slouchy black leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap and a small gold logo near the bottom corner. Place the large serif brand name {argument name="brand text" default="LOEWE"} across the center in elegant white uppercase letters, overlaying the figure. Build the entire composition as a tactile collage made of torn and layered fabric and leather swatches: exactly 8 visible material fragments surrounding and partially overlapping the subject, including beige linen at the top left, olive stitched leather panels on the left, soft beige fabric at the lower left edge, dark brown embossed leather with a monogram motif at the upper right, rocky coastline photography at the right and lower right, a textured taupe stitched textile across the lower center, a dark denim-like fragment at the lower left, and a deep brown leather panel at the bottom right. In the background, reveal a dramatic coastal landscape with rocks, ocean waves, and a moody cloudy sky lit like late afternoon or sunset. Use rich earthy tones, muted olive, dark brown, taupe, black, and warm highlights. The overall look should feel premium, cinematic, moody, artisanal, and minimalist, like a luxury fashion campaign combining leather craftsmanship, collage art direction, and editorial photography.

items.title: Monochrome Tennis Streetwear Moodboard
items.description: This prompt generates a polished four-panel editorial fashion collage with consistent green tones and surreal coffee-cup face graphics, ideal for concept boards, brand campaigns, and AI style exploration.
items.content: A clean editorial fashion concept board on a pale powder-blue background with a minimalist green monochrome palette, combining 4 full-body lifestyle photos of the same youth streetwear tennis-inspired character arranged in a horizontal layout. On the far left, a tall vertical photo panel partially overlaps the background, showing a standing model in an oversized light gray-blue Nike windbreaker, mint green shorts, white crew socks, and white sneakers, holding a white tennis racket at their side and a small mint towel or accessory in the other hand. The character’s head is replaced by a large white doodle coffee-cup face icon with a smiling expression and ruler-like tick marks across the top rim. To the right are 3 rounded-rectangle photo panels, evenly spaced. In panel 1, the model sits in a folding chair reading a magazine and holding a green mug, with a dark Nike duffel bag on the floor and a few scattered cups nearby; the white doodle cup head has 2 steam squiggles rising above it. In panel 2, the model stands beside a pyramid made of approximately 28 stacked green and white paper cups, one arm resting on the top; they wear a soft green Nike T-shirt and shorts set, white socks, and white sneakers; a small white typographic logo in the upper left reads like a cafe or service-court brand mark. The doodle cup head here is a simple smiling cup with a wide rim. In panel 3, the model leans casually with crossed legs, holding a green cup, next to a small wire cart containing green tennis balls and topped with a retro CRT television; they wear a white polo shirt, mint shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. The doodle cup head in this panel has horizontal stripe bands across the top. Keep all faces fully replaced by the graphic cup icons, with no real facial features visible. Use a soft studio setup, flat even lighting, subtle shadows, matte textures, and a highly consistent mint, sage, olive, and white color story. Add thin white horizontal guide lines across the blue background near the top and bottom. Place small gray editorial footer text at the bottom: on the left, “{argument name="left footer text" default="MJ REFERENCE"}”; on the right, “{argument name="right footer text" default="KREA // GPT 2"}”. Overall style: premium streetwear campaign moodboard, playful surreal branding, minimalist graphic design, polished commercial photography, high consistency across all 4 looks.

Outside the rain-speckled windows is a quiet suburban neighborhood with 4 visible environmental cues: wet street pavement, green lawns, leafy trees, and blurred houses under overcast daylight. Lighting is soft diffuse gray daylight coming through the side window and glass roof, with gentle ambient shadows, subtle HDR smartphone clarity, mild exterior highlight overexposure, realistic skin tones, crisp white leather reflections, and distinct raindrops on the roof glass. items.title: Vintage Malta Travel Poster
items.description: A retro-style Mediterranean tourism poster showing Malta’s waterfront road, historic city, fishing boats, and a classic car, ideal for travel art, poster prints, and destination promos.
items.content: A vintage travel poster illustration for {argument name="destination name" default="MALTA"}, with the subtitle {argument name="tagline" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} centered near the top. The composition is a sunlit Mediterranean coastal cityscape viewed from a curving seaside road in the foreground, painted in a richly textured retro poster style with warm cream stone architecture, saturated turquoise-blue sea, and a bright azure sky with soft white clouds. On the left, a hillside of tightly packed historic limestone buildings rises above the waterfront, including colorful enclosed wooden balconies, a large domed church with a reddish terracotta roof, and a slender church spire. In the foreground on the road, place a classic mid-century white sedan seen from the rear three-quarter angle, driving along the curve, with a dark license plate reading {argument name="license plate text" default="MTA 1964"}. A low stone seawall runs along the right edge of the road beside the harbor. In the bay, include exactly 4 boats: 2 colorful Maltese luzzu fishing boats in the near and mid water, plus 2 smaller distant boats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls gliding across the sky above the water. Frame the scene with lush flowering bougainvillea branches in vivid magenta-pink arching across the upper right and lower right corners, and leafy tree branches along the upper left edge; include a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. The distant shoreline across the bay should show a pale sunlit city stretching along the horizon. Use a nostalgic 1950s–1960s tourism poster aesthetic, painterly brushwork, crisp composition, romantic travel mood, and elegant typography with the main title in large cream serif capitals and the subtitle in smaller dark sans-serif capitals.

items.content: Luxury futuristic cosmetic product advertisement poster on a deep midnight-blue background, centered composition, featuring a glowing white spray bottle standing upright on a three-tier transparent crystal pedestal with water droplets and glossy reflections. The bottle is tall, cylindrical, minimalist, and softly backlit with a radiant halo, with visible condensation beads across the surface and an exposed pump top. Behind it, a symmetrical luminous lotus made of exactly 10 translucent petals fans out like a digital aura, each petal shimmering with iridescent blue-violet highlights, delicate circuit-like filaments, and tiny sparkling light nodes, blending botanical elegance with data-network aesthetics. The pedestal looks like stacked glass or ice blocks, wet and reflective, sitting on a slick sparkling surface with scattered blue light particles. At the top, elegant serif typography in large glowing white letters reads {argument name="headline text" default="THE PURITY PROTOCOL"}, with a thin horizontal divider line and a small star-like flare at the center beneath it. Below that, smaller spaced sans-serif text reads {argument name="subheadline text" default="DATA STREAM PURIFIER // 75ML"}. On the bottle, the main brand name reads {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}, and the product name reads {argument name="product label" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, followed by smaller copy: "for risk-free connections" and "pour des connexions sans risque", and at the bottom "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier". Make the overall style ultra-polished, premium, surreal, tech-luxury beauty campaign, with cinematic glow, crisp legible text, high detail, cool blue-white palette, ethereal sparkles, and a sleek balance between skincare advertising and cyber-security metaphor.

items.content: Create a high-end futuristic skincare advertisement poster in icy blue and white tones, vertical 2:3 composition. The scene features a translucent glass female bust in left profile with a low bun hairstyle, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame. Inside the transparent head, neck, and torso is a surreal miniature landscape of blue cliffs, glowing water, and multiple waterfalls, like a frozen digital sanctuary contained within the body. Add tiny suspended bubbles, glossy reflections, misty atmosphere, and soft aurora-like light streaks drifting diagonally across the image. On the right side, place a clean white cylindrical skincare bottle standing upright on a jagged translucent ice pedestal. The bottle label should read {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} and below it {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, with smaller technical cosmetic copy beneath in a minimal editorial layout. Set giant vertical glowing text along the far right edge reading {argument name="side headline" default="DEEP CORE PURITY"}. Add 4 small infographic-style callouts in a sleek tech-beauty design: a top-right droplet icon with the heading “MOISTURE LOCK” and two short lines of tiny supporting text, a mid-right shield icon with the heading “IP PROTECTION” and three short lines of tiny supporting text, a lower-left headline block reading “PURE CONNECTION PURE CONFIDENCE” with 2 short lines of body copy, and a far-left small label reading “DATA STREAM PURIFIER” with a bracket line pointing toward the glass figure. Include a centered solid pale blue rectangular overlay covering part of the face and upper torso, as a flat opaque block. Lighting is ethereal, glossy, and premium, with strong bloom, frosted highlights, soft backlight, and luxury sci-fi cosmetic campaign styling. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic 3D render, clean commercial poster design, minimal yet surreal, polished surfaces, cold luminous atmosphere.

items.content: A futuristic luxury skincare-style advertising poster in a pale icy blue monochrome palette, designed like a high-end tech-beauty campaign. The composition is vertical and airy with soft glowing light, misty gradients, translucent particle effects, and a clean editorial layout. On the left side, a young woman in a flowing white sleeveless dress is shown from the shoulders up in side profile, head tilted back as if inhaling fresh air, with dark windswept hair streaming outward. Her face is obscured by a plain square censor block. Fine luminous network lines and sparkling dots flow from her neck and chest toward the right, suggesting digital cleansing and connectivity. On the right side, a tall matte-white spray bottle floats upright, labeled "SECURE-IP" and "IP ADDRESS CLEANSER," with smaller product copy beneath and a subtle premium cosmetic finish. Behind and around the bottle, branching translucent stems rise like biotech coral or neural fibers, each ending in clear glowing bubbles; several bubbles contain faint tech text such as "DATA PACKET," while nearby micro labels identify features including "OXYGEN FLOW," "DATA PACKETS," "SECURE ROUTING," "RISK FILTER," "PRIVATE CLEAN," and "CONNECTION PURE." In the upper left, small brand text reads "IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY." A large bold uppercase headline dominates the left-center: "{argument name="headline text" default="BREATHE SECURE. GLOW FREE."}" with a smaller subheading below reading "for risk-free connections." Along the bottom is a row of 4 minimalist icon-and-text feature blocks, evenly spaced: 1) shield icon with the heading "CLEANSE YOUR IP" and short supporting copy, 2) wifi icon with the heading "SECURE CONNECTIONS" and short supporting copy, 3) leaf icon with the heading "BREATHE FREELY" and short supporting copy, 4) share/network icon with the heading "GLOW CONFIDENTLY" and short supporting copy. At the lower right, add a paragraph of marketing copy about constant connection and digital cleansing, ending with the tagline "BREATHE. CONNECT. GLOW." At the lower left, include a circular IP logo and the brand line "SECURE-IP" with a small subtitle like "OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE." Overall style: surreal product advertising, premium editorial poster, clean sans-serif typography, soft bloom, translucent glass spheres, elegant sci-fi wellness branding, ultra-detailed, polished, magazine-quality layout.

items.title: Constructivist GPT Image 2.0 Poster
items.description: A retro avant-garde promo poster with torn-paper collage, bold typography, and propaganda-inspired graphic design, ideal for announcing an AI image model or creative campaign.
items.content: A vintage political-propaganda-style poster collage on aged beige paper with a worn, slightly stained texture and torn-paper edges throughout. The composition is a bold vertical poster with a strong constructivist and Soviet-inspired graphic design, using only black, red, blue, yellow, and off-white. At the very top, centered in bold black sans-serif text, place the headline {argument name="headline text" default="Image generation with a point of view"}. In the center, reserve a large vertical rectangular area as the dominant focal block, slightly taller than wide, filled with a plain muted beige-to-taupe gradient like a blank poster insert. Around it, build a torn-paper photomontage from 4 visible collage zones: on the left, a red paper field with a black-and-white cutout of a person in a dark coat seen from behind or in profile, next to fragments of French poster text; at the top behind the central rectangle, a partial black-and-white face or head fragment peeking out; on the right, a blue paper field with a black-and-white Paris-like street scene including 1 tall ornate lamppost, old buildings, 1 car, and 1 walking man; at the bottom center, a yellow torn-paper field with a cropped black-and-white figure holding a newspaper, wearing a striped shirt. Add a vertical strip of black rectangular blocks near the upper right edge of the central rectangle, like cut graphic bars. At the bottom, place the main title in huge heavy condensed typography: {argument name="brand text" default="GPT Image"}, with "GPT" in black and "Image" in bright red. Beneath and to the right, add an enormous {argument name="version text" default="2.0"} in vivid blue. Below the left title area, add a rough horizontal black brushstroke underline. Centered near the bottom, in smaller black text, write {argument name="footer text" default="Coming soon"}. The overall look should feel like mid-20th-century avant-garde poster art, rough torn collage, distressed print, high contrast halftone photography, imperfect paper registration, and bold editorial typography.

items.description: An epic fantasy key-art prompt for generating a heroic armored woman posed with a colossal red dragon in a cinematic mountain setting.
items.content: A cinematic high-fantasy illustration of a gigantic crimson dragon and a regal female dragon knight standing together on a rocky mountain ridge under a bright pale-blue daytime sky. The dragon dominates the frame, coiled behind and around the warrior, with 2 long sweeping golden-brown horns, a dense windswept mane of fiery red and copper hair, layered red scales with metallic sheen, a long snarling snout, sharp exposed teeth, 2 thin whiskers curling outward from the muzzle, and a fierce intelligent eye staring toward the viewer. Its back is lined with a row of sharp dorsal spines, and its massive body curves across the entire background, emphasizing scale and power. In front of the dragon stands {argument name="character name" default="a dragon knight queen"}, a tall armored woman in ornate red, black, and gold battle attire, facing forward in a heroic stance. She has {argument name="hair color" default="red"} hair styled long and flowing, partially tied up, and wears elaborate engraved plate armor with decorated pauldrons, gauntlets, a fitted breastplate, and a long layered gown-like armored skirt with intricate gold filigree. A rich crimson cape drapes behind her and catches the wind. She holds 1 unsheathed sword lowered at her side, while a second blade or dagger is visible at her waist, giving the composition exactly 2 visible weapons. The palette is dominated by scarlet, burgundy, copper, and antique gold, with dramatic sunlight, detailed textures, ultra-fine scales, polished metal, and flowing fabric. Composition is epic and centered, low-angle, full-body warrior in the foreground with the dragon’s head filling the left side and its coiled body arcing across the upper and right background. Style: ultra-detailed fantasy concept art, majestic, heroic, painterly realism, sharp focus, high contrast, volumetric light, premium game key art quality.

Keep all item labels centered below each product in small blue sans-serif text. Along the bottom footer, place “Research & Deployment Co.” on the left, the OpenAI knot logo plus wordmark centered, and “Designed with care.” on the right. Use a balanced editorial layout, lots of whitespace, premium product-ad poster aesthetics, subtle shadows, crisp studio lighting, and a restrained palette of off-white, blue, black, brown, and green.

items.title: Vintage Miami Art Date Comic Page
items.description: This prompt generates a retro five-panel comic page of a couple visiting a Miami art museum, ideal for nostalgic editorial art or storybook-style illustrations.
items.content: A vintage American comic-book page in a faded 1950s romance-adventure style, printed on slightly yellowed paper with visible halftone texture, inked panel borders, and soft weathered colors. The page contains exactly 5 panels arranged in a classic comic layout: 1 wide top panel, 2 middle panels side by side, and 2 bottom panels side by side. In the top panel, show a sunny coastal boulevard in {argument name="city" default="Miami"}, with turquoise water on the left, a sailboat offshore, pastel Art Deco buildings in the distance, tall palm trees, and a pink classic convertible driving along the waterfront. A stylish couple sits in the car, and large dramatic comic title lettering reads “ART IN MIAMI!” with a small caption box at the top saying “MIAMI, SATURDAY AFTERNOON…”. Add two speech balloons: “READY TO SEE SOME ART?” and “ALWAYS!”. In the second panel, an interior car view from behind the couple as they drive down Ocean Drive, showing colorful pastel buildings and palms ahead; the man has dark hair and a blue shirt, the woman wears sunglasses, a pink dress, and a lavender headscarf. Include a caption box reading “WE DROVE DOWN OCEAN DRIVE…” and speech balloons saying “LOOK AT THOSE COLORS…” and “MIAMI FEELS LIKE A PAINTING!”. In the third panel, show the couple approaching the entrance of a modern museum with the visible wall text “MIAMI ART MUSEUM”, glass doors, and people inside; add a caption box reading “THE EXHIBIT WAS AT A MODERN MUSEUM…” and a speech balloon saying “LET’S GO!”. In the fourth panel, place the couple inside a gallery viewing large abstract paintings in bright pastel blocks and shapes, with a small sculpture on a pedestal nearby; add a caption box reading “INSIDE, THE ART SURROUNDED US.” and speech balloons saying “I LOVE HOW BRIGHT AND BOLD IT IS.” and “IT FEELS LIKE MIAMI… VIBRANT AND FREE!”. In the fifth panel, show the couple outside again by the water with the skyline, palm trees, and a sailboat in the background, standing close together in the sun; add a caption box reading “WE STEPPED OUT INTO THE SUN…” and a small closing narration box at the bottom right saying “A BEAUTIFUL DAY.” Include speech balloons saying “THAT WAS PERFECT.” and “ART, SUN, AND MIAMI… CAN’T BEAT IT!”. Use hand-lettered uppercase comic text, black outlines, slightly imperfect vintage printing registration, muted pinks, aquas, sandy beige, and seafoam green, with a nostalgic warm romantic mood.

items.title: 2026 Nine Palaces Flying Star Chart
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Chinese feng shui annual flying star infographic poster for reference, educational content, or social media sharing.
items.content: Create a clean, symmetrical Chinese feng shui infographic poster in a traditional almanac style on a warm light beige background. The main title at the top is large dark red Chinese calligraphy text reading {argument name="headline text" default="2026年九宫飞星图"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath in black reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}. Add a decorative compass rose in the upper left corner labeled with the four cardinal directions in Chinese: 南 at top, 北 at bottom, 东 at left, 西 at right. items.title: Vintage Diner Menu Board Scene
items.description: This prompt transforms a reference photo into a photorealistic retro diner interior centered on a large menu board, useful for editorial, nostalgic Americana, or restaurant-themed visuals.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, replace the train interior scene with a straight-on, documentary-style photograph of a classic American diner counter wall. Remove the person, window reflection, thermos, and book entirely. Keep the image photorealistic and naturally lit, with warm tungsten bulbs across the top and wood-paneled walls. Add a large black letter-board menu with white block letters as the main subject, framed in metal above an open kitchen pass. Include 6 menu sections with these exact headings and items: BREAKFAST with 5 items (TWO EGGS TOAST 4.95, BACON & EGGS 6.50, HAM & EGGS 6.75, OMELET 7.25, BISCUITS & GRAVY 5.50); GRIDDLE with 4 items (SHORT STACK 4.25, PANCAKES 5.25, FRENCH TOAST 5.75, WAFFLE 5.95); SANDWICHES with 5 items (BLT 5.50, TUNA MELT 6.25, GRILLED CHEESE 4.50, CLUB SANDWICH 7.50, HAMBURGER 6.00); SIDES with 5 items (HASH BROWNS 2.50, BACON 2.95, SAUSAGE 2.95, TOAST 1.50, PIE 3.25); DRINKS with 5 items (COFFEE 1.25, TEA 1.25, MILK 1.50, ORANGE JUICE 1.75, SODA 1.50); and a DAILY SPECIAL line reading CHICKEN FRIED STEAK 8.25. Below the menu, show a stainless service opening and countertop with diner details including 2 condiment bottles, 1 napkin dispenser, and 1 shaker in the foreground. Wide horizontal composition, centered, realistic textures, slightly nostalgic roadside-diner mood.

items.description: This prompt converts a casual travel snapshot into a centered professional studio-style headshot for profile, resume, or corporate use.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, turn this candid train photo into a clean professional studio head-and-shoulders portrait of the same person. Keep the same hairstyle, shirt-and-sweater outfit, and overall identity cues, but remove the headphones, train window reflection, table, thermos, book, and all travel context. Reframe the subject so he is centered and facing the camera in a neutral upright pose, cropped from mid-chest upward. Replace the background with a plain muted blue-gray studio backdrop and use soft even portrait lighting for a polished corporate profile photo.

items.title: Sunlit Streetwear Jacket Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic fashion editorial image of a woman modeling an oversized varsity bomber jacket in a warm modern loft, ideal for apparel ads and streetwear product visuals.
items.content: A realistic lifestyle fashion photo of a woman standing indoors in a warm, sunlit modern loft living room, framed from mid-thigh up, facing the camera with her hands tucked into the pockets of an oversized black satin varsity-style bomber jacket. The jacket is the clear focus: glossy black fabric, ribbed collar and hem, snap-button front, slightly puffed sleeves, and large collegiate lettering across the chest that reads {argument name="front text" default="NEW YORK"} in bold orange letters with white outlines. Add a smaller orange-and-white sports patch on the upper sleeve and white block text on the opposite sleeve for an authentic team-jacket feel. Style the model with long, loose, softly wavy balayage hair in {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with caramel highlights"}, minimal jewelry including layered gold necklaces, and light gray sweatpants visible at the bottom of frame. Keep the face intentionally obscured with a centered rectangular blur block for privacy. The setting is a minimalist beige interior with tall industrial windows on the left casting strong morning sunlight and geometric shadows, a cream sofa with a pillow, a low coffee table with 3 stacked books and a dark bowl, pale walls, and a simple wooden side table in the background. Shoot in a high-end editorial e-commerce style with natural golden light, soft shadows, sharp jacket detail, shallow depth of field, neutral warm tones, and a clean premium streetwear aesthetic.

items.content: A cinematic divine portrait of a Jesus-like holy figure from the chest up, centered and facing forward, with the face intentionally obscured by a solid rectangular block in a warm brown skin-tone color. He has shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, a short beard visible below the block, and wears flowing layered white robes with a gold embroidered sash over one shoulder. Behind his head is 1 large glowing circular halo with intricate luminous ring details, surrounded by intense golden backlight and radiant sunbeams bursting through dramatic heavenly clouds. Faint classical temple architecture appears on both sides in the distance, creating a celestial kingdom atmosphere. items.title: Apple-Style CEO Announcement Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic Chinese tech-brand leadership announcement poster styled like a premium Apple campaign, ideal for viral mock ads and speculative corporate visuals.
items.content: A dramatic, ultra-polished Chinese corporate announcement poster in a premium Apple-style keynote aesthetic, vertical 4:5 composition, featuring a confident middle-aged East Asian man from the waist up standing outdoors in front of a futuristic glass-ring campus building at dusk, with a huge glowing white Apple logo behind him on the right side. He wears a minimalist black button-up shirt over a dark undershirt, with a calm, authoritative posture and luxury-brand presentation lighting. The sky is a deep blue-to-gray gradient, and the overall color palette is dark navy, charcoal, silver, and warm soft white. At the very top center, place a small white Apple logo, with a thin horizontal divider line on each side and the Chinese text “Apple 新篇章 由此开启” beneath it in elegant sans-serif. In the top right corner, add large bold red Chinese text: “AI生成”. Across the upper-middle area, add a huge bold white Chinese headline: “{argument name="headline text" default="罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO"}”. Directly below it, add smaller spaced-out white Chinese subheadline text: “用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”. On the left side of the subject’s chest area, place a quotation block with a large opening quotation mark and 2 lines of Chinese body text in dark navy: “{argument name="quote" default="我不是来改变 Apple，而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。"}”, followed by a handwritten-style signature line and the name “罗永浩”. In the lower-middle area, overlay a dark translucent horizontal feature bar containing exactly 4 icon-and-text items, evenly spaced from left to right: 1) a hammer icon with the title “工匠精神” and subtitle “极致产品主义”, 2) a speech bubble icon with the title “用户至上” and subtitle “体验超越期待”, 3) a light bulb icon with the title “创新驱动” and subtitle “重新定义未来”, 4) a heart outline icon with the title “真诚沟通” and subtitle “打造人心的科技”. At the bottom center, add large white English text: “Think Different. Think Again.”, then below it smaller white Chinese text: “现在，交给罗永浩。” and a handwritten signature beneath. The subject should resemble {argument name="character name" default="罗永浩"}, with {argument name="hair style" default="short black hair, neatly combed"} and {argument name="outfit" default="minimalist black button-up shirt"}. Make the image photorealistic but slightly idealized like a premium launch campaign, with cinematic contrast, soft edge glow around the Apple logo, subtle reflections on the glass architecture, elegant typography hierarchy, and a highly believable luxury-tech advertisement finish.

items.title: Nostalgic 2003 Family Living Room Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic early-2000s Chinese family snapshot in a cluttered living room, useful for nostalgic photo recreations and believable AI-made vintage domestic scenes.
items.content: A candid indoor family snapshot styled like an early-2000s home photo from mainland China, shot on a consumer digital camera with slightly soft focus, muted colors, mild noise, and an on-camera date stamp in the bottom right reading {argument name="date stamp" default="2003.12.28"}. The scene shows a modest living room with three people whose faces are intentionally blurred: in the left foreground, an adult woman in a lavender-pink knit sweater sits on the edge of a bed or sofa, turned slightly toward the camera; in the center background, an adult man in dark clothes crouches in front of a wooden TV stand, adjusting a silver DVD or VCD player; in the right foreground, a small girl wearing a light pink sweater and dark pants kneels on a richly patterned red carpet while holding a colorful toy vehicle. Behind them is a bulky silver CRT television displaying gray static noise, covered with a lace cloth on top. The wall behind the TV is filled with lived-in details: a large red Chinese character poster reading “福” above a hanging calendar, several framed family photos, and small pinned pictures. On the far right is a tall black shelving unit with neatly stacked VHS tapes or media cases, books, and a potted plant on top with trailing green leaves. On the far left edge, part of a bed or couch with pale bedding and a red cushion is visible. Add large bold red Chinese text in the top left corner reading {argument name="headline text" default="AI生成"}. Compose it as an unposed, believable family moment with authentic domestic clutter, nostalgic realism, natural room lighting, and the unmistakable look of an old personal photograph.

items.title: Apple-Style Minimal Presentation Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a sleek Apple-inspired presentation title slide with editorial typography and a floating black-glass product object, ideal for keynote covers, pitch decks, and design system presentations.
items.content: Create a premium minimalist keynote-style presentation cover slide in an Apple-inspired industrial design aesthetic. Use a wide 16:9 layout with a deep matte black upper background and a pale concrete-gray lower platform occupying the bottom quarter of the frame. Place a large photorealistic floating rectangular slab in the right-center foreground, resembling a thin black glass device or polished obsidian platform with mirror-like reflections, chamfered chrome-metal edges, and precise industrial finishing. The slab should hover above the light surface and cast a soft elongated shadow directly beneath it. Add a tall vertical gray metallic wall or pillar on the far right edge to frame the composition. Use extremely sparse, high-end art direction, lots of negative space, cinematic studio lighting, subtle gradients, and crisp contrast between black and silver materials. On the left side, set clean white sans-serif typography with a clear hierarchy: a tiny top caption reading "{argument name="system label" default="Apple-inspired presentation system"}", a very large bold headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Clarity At Scale"}", and a medium subtitle reading "{argument name="subtitle text" default="The strongest slides behave like products."}". Below that, include exactly 3 numbered principles in a vertical list with thin separators and refined spacing: "01 | {argument name="principle 1" default="One focal object"}", "02 | Binary light / dark rhythm", and "03 | Blue only for signal". Add a short thin horizontal rule above the list and a tiny blue accent line below the list. Draw a very fine horizontal guide line near the top spanning most of the slide, with the small page number "01" at the upper right. Repeat the small caption "Apple-inspired presentation system" once again at the bottom left on the light surface. Overall look: luxury tech presentation, editorial product-launch slide, ultra-clean Swiss grid, restrained monochrome palette with only one subtle blue accent, photorealistic rendering blended with presentation design.

items.title: Thoughtful Systems Presentation Cover
items.description: A warm editorial slide cover for AI or product design presentations, using parchment textures, serif typography, and terracotta-accented collage cards.
items.content: Create a refined editorial presentation cover slide in a warm, Claude-inspired design system. Use a landscape 16:9 composition with a parchment-paper background, subtle paper grain, soft shadows, and layered torn-paper collage elements. The overall palette should be warm ivory, cream, sand, charcoal, muted black, and terracotta accent. On the left half, place a small top label reading "{argument name="system label" default="Claude-inspired presentation system"}" with a small terracotta dot and a thin horizontal divider line. Below it, set an oversized elegant high-contrast serif headline in black that reads "{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"}", split across two lines and dominating the left side. Under the headline, add a smaller serif subheadline in terracotta reading "{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can still feel precise."}". Beneath that, create a vertical list of exactly 4 design principles, each on its own row with thin divider lines and a small icon at left: 1) a rectangular parchment-sheet icon with the text "Parchment canvas", 2) a serif capital T icon with the text "Serif-led hierarchy", 3) a filled terracotta circle icon with the text "Terracotta for signal", 4) a chain-link icon with the text "Organic diagrams over cold chrome". Add a tiny footer caption at bottom left reading "CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM" in spaced small caps. On the right half, build a layered collage of exactly 3 paper cards: first, a tall off-white art card with a fine border containing the heading "A more considered approach", a short body paragraph about complex problems yielding to clarity, a minimal landscape line drawing with a terracotta sun, and a vertical terracotta botanical branch overlapping the card; second, a dark charcoal rectangular card partially behind it with the lowercase title "thinking process" and an exact 5-step numbered list: "01 Observe", "02 Interpret", "03 Connect", "04 Synthesize", "05 Act with care", plus a delicate circular orbital diagram in dotted lines and terracotta highlight; third, a torn off-white note card in front near the bottom with a hand-drawn overlapping-circles diagram where one crescent-shaped intersection area is shaded in terracotta, alongside a handwritten quote reading "{argument name="quote" default="Clarity emerges when systems are designed with intention."}". Include one extra light beige paper strip tucked beneath the lower cards. Emphasize tactile realism, elegant negative space, print-editorial sophistication, soft natural lighting, and a calm, thoughtful luxury-tech mood.

items.title: Shan Hai Jing Vintage Comic Page
items.description: This prompt transforms a reference antique comic layout into a new retro Chinese mythology page, useful for generating alternate educational storybook spreads with the same structure and print aesthetic.
items.content: Using the provided reference image as a layout and style guide, recreate it as a vintage Chinese mythological illustrated story page instead of the Monkey King page. Keep the aged textbook/comic print look, yellowed paper texture, retro ink-and-watercolor rendering, and boxed multi-panel composition. Replace the original content with a 山海经-themed page. Preserve the vertical title block on the left, but change the main title to {argument name="title text" default="山海经"}. Build a total of 8 content panels: 1 large title/hero panel at the top left featuring a mythic figure and a red sun, 5 medium boxed narrative panels in the middle rows with different ancient myth scenes, and 2 wide horizontal panels across the bottom row. Add dense Chinese explanatory captions under each panel in the same old-print style, with small numbered labels for panels 2 through 8 and a small red seal-like tag near the title. The overall result should feel like an antique Chinese serialized picture-book page from a retro children’s mythology encyclopedia.

items.title: Minimal Anti-Itch Cream Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a clean vertical pharmacy-style poster featuring a Chaplin-like spokesman presenting an anti-itch cream jar with green branding and simple benefit icons.
items.content: A clean minimalist vertical product poster on a soft pale gray background with a subtle green tint, designed like a modern Chinese skincare or medicine advertisement. Show a {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin lookalike"} from the chest up on the left side, wearing a black bowler hat, black suit jacket, white shirt, dark tie, and gray vest, posed formally and holding a bright green plastic jar of {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} with a white lid in both hands at center-left. One hand supports the jar from below while the other points toward it, creating a clear product presentation pose. The face should have a gentle pleasant expression, but keep the composition focused more on wardrobe, hands, and product than facial detail. On the upper right, place a green brand logo and Chinese brand text. Below it, add large elegant green Chinese headline text reading “舒缓 止痒膏” and smaller English subtitle text “ANTI-ITCH CREAM”. To the right of the jar, include a circular botanical graphic with {argument name="herb" default="mint leaves"}, plus exactly 2 green checklist claims in Chinese beneath it. At the bottom, add a curved white panel spanning the width of the poster containing exactly 3 evenly spaced green line icons with Chinese captions: a leaf icon for cooling itch relief, a water droplet icon for moisturizing dry itch, and a shield icon for gentle protection. The product jar label should be yellow-green with Chinese text and small herb illustrations, matching the green branding. Overall style: sparse, neat, commercial poster, lots of negative space, premium pharmacy-ad aesthetic, soft studio lighting, realistic photography mixed with clean graphic layout, green-and-white color palette.

items.title: Minimal Anti-Itch Cream Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a clean minimalist product poster featuring a Chaplin-like vintage figure presenting a large herbal anti-itch cream jar for advertising or social media mockups.
items.content: A minimalist clean poster on a warm light beige studio background with a subtle wall-to-table horizon line, lots of negative space, and soft diffused lighting. Center-right stands a full-body vintage silent-film comedian resembling {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin"}, wearing a black bowler hat, dark worn suit, vest, white shirt, tie, oversized trousers, and old leather shoes, holding a thin curved cane in one hand and smiling gently. His other arm is extended in a presentation gesture toward a large green jar of {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} placed in the foreground at center. The jar has a white screw cap, translucent green body, and a bright yellow-green label with Chinese medicine-style packaging details, including small Chinese characters and the English text {argument name="label text" default="ANTI-ITCH CREAM"}. A realistic human hand rises from below to support the jar from underneath, making the product the visual focal point. Add fresh green mint leaves around the base of the jar and near the character’s feet for a natural herbal cue. Composition should feel like a modern advertising poster: product large and centered, character slightly behind and to the right, clean cutout look, soft shadows, crisp edges, muted neutral palette with the green jar as the main color accent. No headline, no extra layout elements, no clutter, no border. Include a tiny four-point sparkle icon in the lower right corner. Aspect ratio vertical poster, polished commercial photomontage style.

items.title: Luxury Bag Meets Discount Chaos Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a vertically composed fashion-ad poster that contrasts a refined Hermes-style Birkin product shot with explosive Pinduoduo-style subsidy graphics for satirical luxury collaboration visuals.
items.content: A vertical 9:16 luxury-fashion parody advertising poster with a single centered handbag as the hero product, designed as a brutal collision between ultra-premium maison branding and chaotic Chinese e-commerce discount graphics. The top half should feel like an elegant Hermes-style campaign: a warm beige and taupe atelier interior with soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, refined wall paneling, a wooden worktable, and visible artisan tools including exactly 6 workshop elements around the bag: a brush cup with several brushes on the left, a small ceramic vase on the far left, a leather awl or burnishing tool on the table front left, a knife-like leather tool on the table front left edge, an adjustable desk lamp on the right, and a spool of thread on the right. At the top center place a gold luxury logo with a horse-and-carriage icon above the word HERMÈS and PARIS beneath it, followed by one giant serif headline reading BIRKIN in gold. In the center, show one large structured crocodile-embossed Birkin-style handbag in {argument name="bag color" default="warm greige taupe"}, front-facing, highly detailed leather texture, polished gold hardware, upright handles, sitting on the tabletop, photographed like a premium product shot. Across the right-middle of the bag, add one torn-paper rip effect revealing aggressive discount advertising underneath; around the tear add exactly 5 digital glitch accents in neon magenta, green, cyan, black, and white. On the torn area place exactly 3 visible Chinese promo stickers layered diagonally: a small red sticker reading 福利价, a large red sticker reading 百亿补贴, and a black sticker with bright outline reading 亿补贴. The bottom third of the poster should erupt into a loud comic-book and livestream-sale visual explosion with torn-paper separation from the luxury upper half. Use saturated red, yellow, white, black, and cyan with sharp starburst shapes, speed lines, heavy outlines, and flying gold coins. Include exactly 7 bottom promotional text blocks: 1 large central red banner reading 百亿补贴, 1 red rounded rectangle below it with the Pinduoduo logo and the text 拼多多, 2 side banners partially cropped with 拼多多, 2 additional yellow-red 百亿补贴 bursts at the lower left and lower center, and 1 handwritten black calligraphy slogan at the lower right reading 砍一刀. Add one extra handwritten black phrase at the lower left reading 只需9.9元!. The overall composition must feel like an elite fashion campaign violently invaded by cheap viral bargain marketing, with cinematic lighting, strong visual hierarchy, realistic product rendering, premium typography above, explosive discount chaos below, and intentional aesthetic contrast between sophistication and low-cost internet commerce. Make it look like a high-end brand collaboration key visual poster for {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="拼多多 × 爱马仕"} promoting {argument name="promo text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}.

items.title: Luxury x E-commerce Split Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a high-impact vertical campaign poster that collides luxury fashion branding with chaotic discount-platform promotion for a provocative co-branded product ad.
items.content: Create a vertical 9:16 luxury-campaign poster for a fictional crossover product, a disruptive co-branded handbag advertisement between {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} and {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"}. The composition is a violently split, collage-style fashion key visual with a torn-paper seam running vertically down the center, dividing two clashing aesthetics: on the left, refined premium luxury branding in warm Hermes orange, cream paper, and elegant editorial minimalism; on the right, aggressive Chinese e-commerce promotion energy in black and metallic red foil, with loud sale graphics, confetti, ripped stickers, and explosive discount typography. At the top center, place both brands prominently with a large collaboration headline in Chinese, the left logo area styled like a classic luxury house with serif typography and horse-and-carriage emblem, the right logo area in bold red Chinese branding. Below that, add the main headline text in huge Chinese characters: {argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}, and a boxed subheadline: {argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}. The centerpiece is one Birkin-style luxury handbag shown front-facing and large, perfectly centered but visually split in half along the torn seam: the left half is orange pebbled leather with gold hardware, the right half is crinkled metallic silver leather with silver hardware, both halves seamlessly merged into one surreal bag. The bag should include 5 clearly visible accessory/product elements around or on it: 1 orange clochette hanging on the left, 1 metallic silver hanging strap with lock on the right, 1 central turn-lock closure with padlock, 1 orange Hermes-style gift box with dark ribbon at lower left, and 1 beige dust bag with small logo near the bottom left. Behind the bag on the left is a painterly orange brushstroke on textured cream paper; behind the bag on the right is a crushed reflective red metallic wrapper surface with spark-like highlights and falling confetti. On the right half, add 8 aggressive promotional text bursts and stickers layered diagonally like an online shopping festival poster: 1 giant white Chinese slogan "百亿补贴 全网最低", 2 "限时秒杀!!", 3 a torn price sticker reading "补贴价 ¥999?!", 4 "万件疯抢", 5 "百亿补贴 官方直补", 6 "直降到底", 7 a large bottom torn banner repeating "补贴价 ¥999?!", and 8 small text "建议零售价 ¥1000000+". On the left margin, add a slim vertical editorial text column with 4 grouped text blocks in a luxury layout: 1 "限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION", 2 "HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE", 3 "CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE", and 4 "DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY". At the bottom, create a black app-like information bar with 3 feature blocks from left to right: 1 a red brand icon with "拼多多" and a search-bar style pill containing "百亿补贴铂金包", 2 a lightning icon with the text "百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价", and 3 a shield icon with the text "正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息". Add a thin final slogan line across the very bottom in small Chinese text. Use hyper-detailed commercial product photography, premium graphic design, sharp lighting, embossed textures, foil reflections, paper tears, and strong depth. The overall mood must feel like a world-class art director forced a heritage luxury campaign and a chaotic discount-shopping poster to collide in one image, producing extreme visual tension, irony, and high-impact contrast.

items.title: Vintage Beijing Travel Scrapbook Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a warm hand-drawn Beijing travel guide poster in a scrapbook infographic style, ideal for tourism artwork, educational city posters, or social media travel visuals.
items.content:
Create a charming hand-drawn vintage travel scrapbook poster about {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, designed as a Chinese-language illustrated tourist guide page on warm aged paper lying on a wooden tabletop. The composition is a single vertical poster with a slightly worn notebook-page look, soft stains, folded corners, tape marks, stamp-like ink smudges, and a casual collage aesthetic. At the top center, place large bold black Chinese calligraphy for {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, with the English word {argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"} underneath in loose blue brush script. Near the title, add a small red seal stamp and a short Chinese text block on the upper right describing the geographic location of the city in dark blue handwritten-style Chinese characters.

Below the title, include 4 taped polaroid-style travel photos arranged in a slightly uneven row, each with a handwritten English caption on the white border. Photo 1: the Forbidden City at sunset with golden reflections and warm orange light, captioned about warm golden tones. Photo 2: the Great Wall winding across green mountains under a bright sky, captioned about Great Wall of China landscape and green mountains. Photo 3: Beihai Park lake with willow branches, boats, and a white stupa in the background, captioned about a serene lake view. Photo 4: a traditional hutong alley with gray brick walls and hanging red lanterns, captioned about red lanterns and a charming narrow street. Use different decorative tape patterns above the photos.

Arrange the lower two-thirds like an illustrated infographic with colorful doodles and handwritten Chinese headings in red and blue. Include 5 main content sections: a geographic description block at the top right; a “best travel season” section on the left with Chinese text recommending spring and autumn, decorated with a leaf doodle and a small sun icon; a “main attractions and features” section on the left-middle listing exactly 3 items in Chinese with bullet points: Forbidden City, Badaling Great Wall, and Shichahai & hutongs, accompanied by line-art sketches of a palace pavilion, the Great Wall, hutong houses, and a small tricycle; a “must-eat foods” section on the lower left listing exactly 3 foods in Chinese with bullet points: Peking duck, zhajiangmian, and douzhi, alongside cute food illustrations of a roast duck platter, a bowl of noodles with chopsticks, and a surprised face doodle; and a “tips” section near the lower middle with exactly 2 advice lines in Chinese, each with a small icon, one about wearing comfortable shoes because attractions are large, and one about booking tickets in advance because holidays are crowded.

Add a small outline map of China near the center-right with Beijing marked by a red star and a curved arrow pointing to it. Place a traditional stone guardian lion illustration on the right side with a comic-style handwritten Chinese callout bubble saying it is super imposing. Add a highlighted recommendation box with a scalloped red outline containing exactly 2 recommended places in Chinese: Temple of Heaven Park with a note about praying for good harvests, and Nanluoguxiang; decorate this box with 2 architectural illustrations, one of the Temple of Heaven and one of a traditional gate building. At the very bottom, include a bold handwritten Chinese quote line in dark blue with red emphasis marks, plus 3 doodles beside it: a retro camera, the Bird’s Nest stadium with a small red heart, and the CCTV Headquarters building.

Overall style: cozy travel journal infographic, hand-drawn pen-and-watercolor look, slightly naive sketch style, scrapbook collage, cream paper texture, muted red and navy blue palette with soft greens and warm browns, playful but informative layout, highly legible mixed typography, clean composition, nostalgic tourism poster feel.

items.title: Pastel Beach Selfie Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic, softly lit beach selfie portrait with a youthful summer fashion aesthetic, useful for lifestyle, social media, or editorial-style image creation.
items.content: A realistic high-angle beach selfie of a young woman standing on bright white sand under harsh midday sunlight, framed from just above the head to the upper thighs in a vertical smartphone composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair parted in the center and styled into 2 long braided pigtails, one on each side. Her face is mostly obscured by her raised hand shading her eyes from the sun, creating a candid, slightly anonymous look. She is wearing a fitted ribbed deep V-neck cap-sleeve crop top in {argument name="top color" default="pale baby blue"} and low-rise {argument name="bottom color" default="white"} bottoms visible at the waist. Her body is slim with a soft, glamorous fashion-photo look. One arm is extended toward the camera holding the phone for the selfie, while the other hand rests across her forehead to block the sunlight. The lighting is extremely bright and washed with soft pale tones, producing delicate skin highlights, gentle shadows, and a clean airy summer aesthetic. Background is a minimal sandy beach with a faint strip of shoreline and water near the top edge, no other people, no props, no buildings. Style should feel like a polished social-media beach selfie, realistic skin texture, subtle retouching, soft pastel color grading, high detail, natural pose, feminine and youthful summer mood.

items.title: Classical Chinese Poem Scroll Landscape
items.description: A traditional Chinese ink-style artwork featuring a famous poem in calligraphy beside a sunrise river gorge scene, ideal for literary posters, cultural prints, or editorial art.
items.content: A classical Chinese ink-wash painting on warm aged rice paper, combining landscape art and calligraphy in a clean two-part composition. On the left half, leave broad negative space filled with bold black brush-calligraphy showing the poem title {argument name="poem title" default="早发白帝城"}, the poet name {argument name="poet name" default="李白"}, and four large vertical lines of poem text in expressive handwritten script: {argument name="poem text" default="朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。"}. On the right half, paint a serene river gorge at sunrise in the style of a traditional shan shui scroll: a soft orange sun low above misty layered mountains, tall steep cliffs on both sides, faint haze in the distance, and calm reflective water glowing with pale gold light. In the foreground at lower right, place a small wooden river boat with a simple covered cabin and a vertical mast. A solitary ancient Chinese scholar in flowing white hanfu stands on the deck facing the landscape from behind, hair tied in a traditional topknot, long robe and sash slightly trailing in the breeze, creating a contemplative mood. Add a tiny temple pavilion perched high on the top of the right cliff. Use delicate ink outlines, subtle sepia and gray washes, textured paper grain, elegant empty space, and refined literati-painting aesthetics. The overall image should feel poetic, quiet, balanced, and museum-quality, with especially beautiful legible calligraphy integrated into the artwork.

items.title: Blue-Haired Bunny Hood Anime Girl
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style fantasy character portrait with a bunny hood, plush rabbit, and glowing cathedral background, suitable for key art or character splash illustrations.
items.content: A close-up anime fantasy illustration of a cute young girl in a luminous cathedral-like hall, reaching one hand toward the viewer in strong foreshortened perspective as if inviting them forward. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="light blue"} hair spilling from under an oversized glossy green bunny-eared hood, with one ear flopping across the top left and the other hanging down on the right. Her face is mostly obscured by her hair and the hood, creating a mysterious, shy composition. She wears an elaborate frilly outfit in white, green, and pastel pink, with lace trim, ribbons, and a pink bow at the collar. In her other arm she holds 1 plush toy: a white rabbit doll with pink inner ears, a wide open smile, one button X eye, and a small jester-like collar with tiny bells. The background is a grand blue crystal palace interior with tall glowing arches, soft bloom lighting, reflective floors, sparkling particles, and dreamy ethereal atmosphere. Highly polished anime game key art style, vibrant cool tones, soft highlights, delicate linework, glossy fabric textures, cinematic depth, centered composition, portrait cropped at the chest, whimsical and magical mood.

items.title: Chinese Livestream Dorm Selfie UI
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic vertical screenshot of a young female streamer in a dorm room with complete Chinese livestream app overlays, useful for social media mockups or UI realism demos.
items.content: A realistic vertical smartphone screenshot of a Chinese livestream interface showing a young woman streamer seated in a cozy dorm room bedroom, front-facing medium close-up selfie composition from chest to head. Her face is intentionally obscured by a large soft rectangular blur centered over the face. She has dark messy black-brown hair in a loose high bun with wispy strands falling around the cheeks, and a small light-colored butterfly hair clip on the left side. She wears a fitted white scoop-neck long-sleeve top layered over delicate lace trim and a thin necklace with a small pendant. Her right hand supports her chin in a casual cute pose, and the mood is soft, intimate, and everyday. The room behind her is a feminine student dorm interior with a loft bed at upper right, white curtains printed with simple blue cartoon characters and stars, a desk with bottles and small items, a wooden chair draped with a pink towel, shelving on the left with plush toys, cosmetics, and bags, and warm indoor ambient lighting. Add full livestream app UI overlays in Chinese across the image, designed like a real mobile live-broadcast app screenshot. Top status bar: time 21:15 at top left, mobile signal, 5G, and battery 68 at top right. Top creator area: a circular avatar, the streamer name {argument name="streamer name" default="叮当猫"}, a red follow button labeled 关注, and a popularity line reading 10万+本场点赞. Add a small ranking badge reading 小时榜第3名. Near the top center-right, include exactly 3 small circular user avatars. items.content: A highly realistic vertical smartphone screenshot of a Chinese livestream app showing a cozy college dorm room streamer scene. The interface should look like a real iPhone screen capture with status bar at the top, including Chinese carrier text, time 9:16, and battery around 67%. In the upper left, show a circular cartoon avatar and a livestream info badge with the streamer name "叮当猫", age "18岁", and the line "直播中 | 10.2万人在看". She has shoulder-length dark hair and wears large black-and-pink over-ear gaming headphones and a white hoodie with a small cute cat illustration on the chest. She is livestreaming from a tidy, warmly lit dorm bedroom. Behind her is a light-colored loft bed with a safety rail and cream bedding printed with bears and stars, plus a ladder with colorful rungs in orange, green, and blue. Under and beside the loft bed are shelves and a wardrobe area with hanging clothes in pale tones and one bright yellow hoodie. The shelves contain upright books, small plush toys, bottles, and personal items. A ring light is visible on the right edge of the frame. On the desk in front of her, place a smartphone in a clamp stand, a black desktop microphone with a subtle red accent on a mini tripod, open notebooks and papers, stacked textbooks, cosmetics including lipstick and brushes, a clear water bottle, a small black rectangular box, and warm fairy lights scattered across the tabletop. The lighting should feel soft, domestic, and inviting, with realistic indoor shadows and a slight phone-camera look. Overlay exactly 7 floating live chat comments stacked on the lower left in dark translucent rounded boxes with cyan name tags. The comments read, from top to bottom: "弹幕： 主播好可爱！", "弹幕： 叮当猫加油！", "弹幕： 10万+人了！🎉", "弹幕猫： 我也在这个大学", "弹幕： 求同款耳机", "弹幕： 支持主播，爱你💕", "弹幕： 欢迎新人！". At the bottom, include a dark comment input bar with placeholder text "说点什么..." and a row of livestream action icons. On the lower right, add a vertical like area with the label "点赞", a red count bubble showing "9.8万", and a large pink heart button. Overall style: photorealistic Chinese social media livestream screenshot, believable app UI, detailed dorm environment, cute youthful campus streamer aesthetic, natural composition, crisp text rendering, no extra panels.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll
items.description: This prompt generates an antique-style Chinese brush calligraphy artwork with poem text, seals, and a faint ink landscape, suitable for cultural art prints or classical literature visuals.
items.content: A traditional Chinese calligraphy painting on aged tan xuan paper, landscape orientation, styled like an antique literati hanging scroll reproduction. The main composition is a large block of bold black semi-cursive to cursive brush calligraphy arranged in 10 vertical columns, read right to left, featuring the poem title at the top of the rightmost main column as {argument name="poem title" default="雨霖铃"}. The calligraphy should feel elegant, fluid, and expressive, with varied ink density, dry-brush texture, thick and thin stroke transitions, and natural hand-written spacing rather than perfect typesetting. Use the visible poem text as written in the image, including its inaccuracies, with the right-side main columns beginning: “寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。都门帐饮无绪，留恋处，兰舟催发，执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。念去去，千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。多情自古，雷情自古伤离别，更那堪冷冷宵，酒醒倦兼芊？杨柳岸，晓风残月。此去经年良宰，经年，应是良辰好景。便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？” Place a narrower signature column on the far left with 1 vertical inscription reading {argument name="signature text" default="柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》"}. Add 4 red seals total: 1 oval collector-style seal near the upper right margin and 3 square seals stacked vertically near the lower left inscription area. Include a faint monochrome ink-wash landscape in the lower right corner with 1 drooping willow tree and 1 small pavilion by the water, partially faded into the paper. The paper should have warm brown aging, subtle stains, mottling, foxing, worn edges, and a museum-photograph feel. Overall mood is refined, poetic, historical, and scholarly, like a Song-dynasty-inspired calligraphy artwork photographed flat in soft even light.

items.title: Surreal Woman at a Weathered Window
items.description: This prompt generates a square, atmospheric fine-art portrait of a wind-whipped woman at an old window, useful for creating emotional surreal editorial or gallery-style imagery.
items.content: A moody surreal painting of a woman leaning forward through an old window frame, shown from behind and cropped tightly so the composition centers on her wildly windblown {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with copper highlights"} hair streaming left across the image in long tangled strands. Her bare shoulders and upper back are mostly hidden by her hair, and both hands rest on a worn wooden windowsill at the bottom center, with 2 visible fingers on each side gripping the ledge. The face is completely obscured by hair and angle. Behind her is a weathered multi-pane window with 6 rectangular panes in a 3-by-2 grid, painted in cold gray-blue tones with grime, scratches, drips, and distressed edges. Use an expressive mixed-media style combining charcoal, ink, dry brush, scratched lines, and textured oil paint on rough canvas, with sketchy white and black linework layered over muted industrial colors. The mood is introspective, stormy, and haunting, as if wind or emotion is pulling the figure apart. Soft diffused light, subtle contrast, painterly realism fused with abstract expressionism, square composition.
