items.title: Girl on Window Seat in Rain
items.description: This prompt generates a cozy yet melancholic painterly scene of a child watching a rainstorm over old European rooftops, ideal for storybook art or atmospheric concept illustration.
items.content: A moody storybook-style digital painting of a {argument name="character age" default="young girl"} sitting sideways on a cushioned window seat inside an old European attic room, hugging her knees and gazing out through a large rain-streaked window. She has {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} slightly messy shoulder-length hair, a cozy oversized cable-knit sweater, and soft striped socks, with bare legs tucked close to her body. The composition is intimate and contemplative, viewed from inside the room at a slight angle, with the child placed in the lower left foreground and the rainy city filling the right side and background. Outside the window is a dense cluster of steep-roofed old town houses, chimneys, crooked rooftops, and 2 tall vintage street lamps visible near the window, all under a dramatic overcast sky with heavy layered storm clouds and visible falling rain. The glass is covered with raindrops, rivulets, and wet reflections, and the rooftops outside are mostly muted gray, while the interior glows with warm amber light from the left, creating a strong contrast between the cozy room and the cold storm outside. Include a patterned cushion behind her, a worn upholstered bench with subtle floral fabric, dark curtains framing the left edge, and soft painterly textures with detailed brushwork on wood, fabric, hair, and rain. Color palette: warm browns, beige, muted gold, slate gray, charcoal, and soft silver. Atmosphere: melancholic, quiet, nostalgic, cinematic, whimsical, and emotionally tender. Highly detailed, painterly illustration, children’s book fantasy realism, dramatic lighting, depth through layered rooftops, no text, no watermark.

items.title: Sad Child by Rainy Window
items.description: This prompt generates a dark whimsical storybook illustration of a lonely child indoors beside a stormy city window, ideal for emotional editorial art, book covers, or atmospheric concept pieces.
items.content: A moody storybook-style digital painting of a small sad child sitting curled up on a wooden stool beside a large rain-streaked window, indoors in a dim gray room. The child has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} wild tangled messy hair, huge expressive eyes, pale skin with a few freckles, and a worried, lonely expression, hugging their knees tightly to their chest. They wear oversized {argument name="pajama pattern" default="muted blue-gray pajamas with small orange patches or floral shapes"} and soft worn slippers. Outside the window is a bleak rainy city street with 4 leaning old buildings visible, 4 wind-bent trees, a slick winding road, and dramatic swirling storm clouds, all painted in an exaggerated crooked perspective. The composition places the child on the left and the window view dominating the right, creating a feeling of isolation and melancholy. Use a painterly, hand-brushed, textured illustration style with visible rough brushstrokes, desaturated blue-gray tones, soft charcoal shadows, subtle highlights on the wet glass, and only faint warm accents in the child’s clothing. Evoke emotional children’s book art in the vein of dark whimsical gothic illustration, intimate, cinematic, rainy-day sadness, high detail, square composition.

In the background, the Oriental Pearl Tower rises softly out of the dusk with glowing pinkish lights, surrounded by blurred city buildings, storefronts, pedestrians, and car headlights, creating a dreamy bokeh urban atmosphere. items.title: Dark Wuxia Game Poster
items.description: A moody AAA-style promotional poster of a lone swordsman in a ruined ancient Chinese city, ideal for dark fantasy game key art and cinematic marketing visuals.
items.content: A dramatic vertical cinematic poster for the dark wuxia action game {argument name="game title" default="Phantom Blade Zero"}, painted in an ultra-detailed gritty concept-art style with realistic textures, moody volumetric fog, and high contrast lighting. The scene shows 1 lone swordsman standing in the lower center foreground, viewed mostly from behind in a three-quarter pose, wearing a wide straw hat and layered black robes shredded into long wind-whipped strips, with pale loose hair streaming out beneath the hat. He holds 1 drawn sword low in his right hand, the blade catching cold silver light. The environment is a ruined ancient Chinese city of towering wooden pagodas and fortress-like buildings rising into steep cliffs, with collapsing architecture, hanging chains, smoke, drifting ash, and rubble. A bright full moon glows near the top center behind dense storm clouds, backlighting the skyline and the warrior. The color palette is almost monochrome charcoal, black, steel gray, and moonlit white, punctuated by sharp crimson slashes and blood-like streaks cutting diagonally across the composition. At the very top, place 4 huge Chinese calligraphy characters in explosive white brushstroke ink reading {argument name="main Chinese title" default="影之刃零"}, spanning nearly the full width. Directly beneath, centered, add the small elegant serif English subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="PHANTOM BLADE ZERO"}. At the bottom center, add 1 line of Chinese tagline text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="刀光即命运 影尽方归零"}, with the final character in red, plus 1 smaller line of Chinese promotional text beneath it. Add subtle ornamental divider lines and a tiny red seal-like emblem at the bottom. Composition should feel like an official AAA key art poster: epic, ominous, martial, supernatural, and intensely atmospheric, with dynamic wind, debris, embers, torn fabric, and ink-splatter energy.

items.title: Anime Last Supper Ensemble
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic wide-format anime group banquet scene styled like The Last Supper, useful for crossover ensemble art and moody character lineup illustrations.
items.content:
A dark, cinematic anime group portrait inspired by The Last Supper, set in a long stone banquet hall at night. Show exactly 11 seated or leaning female characters arranged shoulder to shoulder behind a long table covered with a white tablecloth, viewed straight on in a wide symmetrical composition. In the exact center is a blonde knightly woman in ornate blue-and-silver armor and a royal-blue dress, posed as the visual focal point with both armored arms extended along the table. In front of her sits a glowing golden chalice radiating warm light upward onto the faces and hands of the group. Behind them, three tall arched windows reveal a twilight landscape with a huge tree silhouetted against a dusky sky. The ceiling has dark wooden beams, and the side walls are lined with large shadowy framed paintings.

The 11 characters should feel like a crossover ensemble of iconic anime-style women with varied silhouettes, hairstyles, and fashion. From left to right: 1) a woman in a glossy red skintight futuristic suit, leaning forward with one hand on the table; 2) a dark-haired woman in muted military-style clothing close beside her; 3) a pale gothic girl in a black dress with long sleeves, hands lifted with delicate fingers; 4) a short blonde woman in a loose white T-shirt, casual and modern; 5) a tall red-haired woman in a white shirt standing slightly behind the others; 6) the central blonde armored knight in blue; 7) a black-haired woman in a black dress with gold accessories and a headpiece, raising one finger; 8) a glamorous woman in a red embroidered dress with long black hair; 9) a dark-haired woman in a low-cut black outfit leaning inward; 10) a teal twin-tailed virtual-idol-like girl in a sleeveless outfit; 11) a green-haired girl in a pale patterned dress seated with crossed legs at the far right, holding a wine glass. Keep all faces attractive anime faces, mature young-adult women, elegant rather than caricatured.

On the table, include exactly 11 place settings, 8 visible wine glasses with red wine, several loaves of bread and scattered rolls, plates, silverware, crumbs, and a few metallic goblets or cups. The warm chalice light should illuminate the center while the rest of the room falls into moody shadow. Use painterly realism, high-detail anime illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro, subdued brown and blue ambience with red accents, solemn yet slightly decadent atmosphere, ultra-wide panoramic framing, masterpiece quality.

items.title: Japanese AI Design Webinar Thumbnail
items.description: A polished corporate webinar thumbnail with bold Japanese typography, a speaker portrait, and a structured event info bar for promoting online business events.
items.content: Create a clean, modern Japanese webinar thumbnail in a wide 16:9 layout with a corporate tech-design aesthetic. Use a very light gray background with subtle diagonal translucent panels and bold electric-blue geometric accents, including 3 angular blue-and-white ribbon shapes on the right side behind the speaker. The composition is split into 2 main horizontal sections: a large hero area on top and an information bar across the bottom. In the top-left hero area, place a large bold sans-serif Japanese headline in vivid blue on 2 lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="AI×デザインで\n新事業を創出"}. Beneath it, add a dark-blue rectangular banner with centered white bold text reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="〜社員AI活用率90%超・デザイン費削減達成する方法〜"}. On the right half, show a sharply lit half-body portrait of {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}, an East Asian man in his 30s with short black hair, wearing a navy blazer over a white crew-neck shirt, arms folded, facing slightly left toward the headline. His face is intentionally obscured by a square skin-tone blur block centered over the face. Next to his torso, place a white rectangular name card with 2 lines of small black Japanese text above a larger bold black name: {argument name="speaker title" default="株式会社SHIFT AI\nデザイン部長/講師"} and {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}. Across the bottom, create a white info bar with thin blue vertical dividers and 4 visual components from left to right: 1) a blue gradient angular K logo with the brand text KAWAI DESIGN in black uppercase sans-serif, 2) the date in large blue text reading 2026/2/9, 3) a blue filled circle containing the white Japanese weekday 月 followed by the time 21:30〜22:30 in large blue text, 4) a blue outlined laptop-and-chat icon followed by the blue text オンライン. Keep typography bold and highly legible, with strong hierarchy, generous spacing, precise alignment, minimal clutter, and a polished webinar promotional design suitable for a business landing page or social media thumbnail.

items.title: Shoujo Manga Magazine Cover
items.description: A richly detailed anime-style Japanese romance magazine cover, ideal for generating editorial-looking shoujo artwork with multiple characters and dense cover typography.

author.name: やげん✨🐎｜推しの為にAIを極めるおっさん社会人

items.content: A glossy Japanese shoujo manga magazine cover illustration, packed edge to edge like a real weekly romance comic issue, in a dreamy spring sunset city scene with glowing bokeh lights and falling cherry blossom petals. The cover is dominated by 4 high-school-age characters in fashionable modern anime style. In the foreground, 1 main girl stands large and centered-right, shown from mid-thigh up, with long wavy blonde hair with pink streaks, multiple ear piercings, soft glamorous makeup, and a shy romantic pose with one hand near her lips. She wears a white blouse, a large pink plaid ribbon bow, a pink plaid skirt, a loose pink cardigan slipping off her shoulders, layered necklaces, and a navy school backpack over one shoulder. Behind her stand 3 supporting students: 1 tall handsome boy in a dark school blazer and loosened tie, 1 elegant girl with blonde hair in a braided bun wearing a beige cardigan and school uniform, and 1 shorter dark-haired girl in a school uniform with a ribbon tie. The background shows a glowing pedestrian bridge or riverside walkway at dusk, lined with lights and cherry trees in full bloom, with a pink-orange-purple sky and sparkling romantic atmosphere. The composition should feel like a premium manga cover: highly rendered anime illustration, luminous highlights, delicate linework, glossy print finish, dense overlapping Japanese cover text, issue badges, callouts, hearts, sparkles, and a barcode at the bottom right. Include exactly 7 main text clusters: 1 giant magazine masthead across the top in large bubbly pink Japanese lettering with white outline, 1 vertical romance headline on the right in large pink characters with a huge numeral 3, 2 circular promotional badges on the left, 1 angled banner on the lower left, 1 stacked list of 5 serialized story titles with author names at lower left, and 1 stacked list of 5 serialized story titles with author names near the lower center-right. Add exactly 3 small publication info elements on the upper right: a date/price block, a circular issue number badge, and a narrow vertical tag. Add exactly 1 inset bonus poster preview near the lower right above the barcode. Use a hyper-detailed shoujo manga cover aesthetic, romantic, fashionable, youthful, sparkling, soft glow, sunset rim light, cherry blossom storm, print-magazine realism, intricate typography layering, vibrant pinks and warm golds.

items.description: A dramatic Japanese anime film poster featuring two youths beneath a comet-filled sky, ideal for generating fictional theatrical key art with premium box-office-hit styling.
items.content: A breathtaking Japanese anime movie poster in the style of a blockbuster theatrical key visual, ultra-detailed and emotionally grand, with a delicate luminous sky reminiscent of prestige modern anime cinema. The scene shows 2 characters from behind on a flower-covered cliff overlooking a glowing coastal fantasy city at sunset and twilight: a teenage boy in a dark school uniform with a loosened tie and windblown short dark hair stands on the left, and a teenage girl in a long flowing pale dress with very long silver-white hair stands on the right. Both face the horizon in awe. Above them, an enormous celestial sky fills most of the composition, painted with vivid deep blue, indigo, violet, magenta, and gold clouds, a brilliant comet-like meteor streak slashing diagonally from upper center toward the horizon, scattered stars, sparkling particles, and a glowing circular magic-like ring constellation in the upper right sky. The sea and city below shimmer with reflected light, with slender fantasy skyscrapers and towers rising from the coastline and a radiant sunlit gap at the center horizon. items.title: Fake Japanese Newspaper in ChatGPT UI
items.description: This generates a photorealistic screenshot of the ChatGPT interface displaying a fabricated but convincing Japanese newspaper front page, useful for mockups about AI-generated fake news.
items.content: A realistic smartphone screenshot of the ChatGPT web interface in Japanese, shown on a clean white background. Centered in the chat is a single generated image: a top-down photo of 1 Japanese newspaper placed neatly on a medium-dark wooden tabletop with rounded table corners visible. The newspaper dominates the image and looks highly believable, like a fake but convincing breaking-news front page. The masthead area is dense and traditional, with a huge bold black Japanese headline across the top reading 「高市総理辞任」. Beneath it is a large main photo of 1 politician at a press conference podium with multiple microphones, face intentionally blurred or obscured, in front of a dark blue curtain. Along the right side is 1 vertical blue newspaper nameplate area with white Japanese text resembling a major national daily. A tall vertical subheadline column in Japanese runs beside the main image, suggesting discussion of a successor candidate. The front page includes exactly 4 visible advertisement blocks near the bottom and lower side areas, 1 small portrait photo of a suited man in a left-side article, 1 sports photo block in the lower middle, 1 weather or data box on the right, and many tightly packed columns of Japanese body text throughout. The newspaper should feel authentic, serious, and editorial, with realistic print texture, slight page curl, subtle shadows, and credible Japanese typography. Around the image, include the visible ChatGPT UI chrome: top-left “ChatGPT”, top-right Japanese sharing controls, a small circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left corner of the image, a small share-style overlay icon at the lower-right corner of the image, reaction/action icons beneath the image, and a bottom input bar with Japanese placeholder text 「質問してみましょう」 plus microphone and voice buttons. Overall style: photorealistic screenshot, modern web app interface, fake-news newspaper front page, crisp legible layout, natural lighting, minimal perspective distortion.

items.title: Cute Winter Anime Channel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a pastel Japanese-style anime promotional thumbnail with a single horse-girl character and layered text graphics, ideal for fictional stream, fanclub, or channel announcement art.
items.content:
A cute pastel anime promotional poster in a dreamy idol-fanclub style, landscape orientation, featuring a single horse-girl character from the waist up on the right side of the composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark chestnut brown"} long fluffy hair with side-swept bangs covering one eye, one large visible sparkling purple-pink eye, fair skin, soft blush, and upright horse ears with a large cream bow tied between them. Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream cable-knit sweater, and a navy sailor-style inner collar with a small red ribbon at the chest. The overall color palette is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown with soft winter lighting.

Design the image as a Japanese fan-content announcement graphic with layered sticker-like typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, sparkles, and snowflake motifs. The background should be a softly blurred cozy winter café or warmly lit indoor scene with glowing bokeh and pale decorative textures. Add exactly 5 major text areas: a pink ribbon banner at the top with the Japanese text "ライスと一緒に"; a very large central-left headline in rounded pop lettering reading "ほのぼの 育成" with "ほのぼの" in pink and white and "育成" in bold brown with white stitched edging; a small dark ribbon under it reading "しよっ♪"; a circular brown badge on the right reading "初見さん歓迎"; and a logo-like label at bottom right reading "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" with a small horseshoe icon. Add exactly 1 memo pad in the bottom-left corner with 3 checklist lines, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー", "チャンミ", and "まったり雑談". Include small decorative pink hearts around the character, tiny accent lines near her head, white snowflakes, lace-like trim, paper-cut corner decorations, and a soft scrapbook aesthetic. Make the whole piece look like an adorable fictional stream or channel thumbnail welcoming new viewers, highly polished, clean anime line art, soft shading, glossy eyes, and charming commercial poster composition.

items.title: Cosmic Broken Compact Album Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a luxurious fantasy music-cover image featuring a cracked compact mirror, cosmic butterflies, cosmetics, and glowing Japanese typography for streaming jacket art.

author.name: sasakura｜宅録ナレーター×占星術×AI愛好家🇯🇵

items.content: A luxurious square streaming-cover illustration for the song {argument name="title text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"}, styled like a dreamy cosmic beauty advertisement. The scene is a dark, glittering tabletop in deep midnight indigo and black velvet, filled with sparkling dust and tiny stars. At the center is 1 ornate round compact mirror made of rose-gold metal, opened flat toward the viewer, with the upright mirror framed by delicate decorative filigree at the top. The mirror glass is visibly cracked with multiple branching fracture lines and a few missing shards, yet inside the reflection appears an impossible fantasy universe: 1 glowing purple-pink planet or moon in the upper left, 1 luminous crystalline city skyline rising from the lower left, and exactly 5 ethereal butterflies floating in the mirror space, including 1 large radiant pink butterfly on the right and 4 smaller butterflies in violet and blue tones. The lower compact tray also reflects the same starry purple cosmos and contains several broken mirror fragments. To the left of the compact are exactly 2 cosmetics objects: 1 faceted crystal perfume bottle and 1 open lipstick in a metallic case, the lipstick bullet colored {argument name="lipstick color" default="deep rose plum"}. In the lower right foreground lies exactly 1 soft pink cosmos flower with a stem and a few scattered petals. The whole image glows with magical particles, thin hanging star ornaments, misty nebula swirls, and a rich palette of violet, magenta, blush pink, and rose-gold highlights. Add vertical Japanese typography on the right reading {argument name="right vertical text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"} in a large luminous pale-pink font, and a second smaller vertical Japanese text block on the left reading {argument name="left vertical text" default="その輝きは、きっと本物じゃない。\nそれでも、蝶は誘惑されていく。"} in a delicate light font. The composition should feel romantic, melancholic, glamorous, mystical, and premium, like high-end album art for a dark feminine synth-pop or dream-pop release, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, shimmering reflections, elegant fantasy realism.

On the right side, there are 2 tall blue vertical banners on lampposts with a stylized B logo and welcome text for Yokohama Stadium, plus 2 smaller matching blue banners farther down the walkway. The paved plaza is wide and open, with 2 short black bollards visible in the foreground-left area, green hedges and mature trees along both sides, and small pedestrians scattered in the distance for scale. In the center foreground, place 1 super-deformed catgirl character composited naturally into the scene: petite chibi proportions, oversized head, soft anime shading, pale skin, long slightly tousled dark hair with bangs, fluffy cat ears, and a small black cat tail. She is holding 1 wrapped burger or sandwich with both hands near her mouth as if eating while walking. Her pose is slightly pigeon-toed and casual, one leg crossing in front of the other, giving a shy adorable feeling. items.title: Cyberpunk Girl with Giant Claw Arm
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic anime-style cyberpunk character portrait, ideal for concept art of a lone mechanized antihero in a neon-soaked futuristic city.

author.name: しゃるる@汝ゴスロリを愛せ

items.content: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a lone young woman with a massive mechanical claw arm standing in a rainy neon-drenched alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her look imposing and dangerous. She has a pale face, long straight black hair partly hiding her eyes, and faintly glowing red eyes with a cold, emotionless expression. She wears an oversized hooded winter-tech coat with a large fur-trimmed hood and fur cuffs, layered black tactical streetwear, straps, belts, and baggy dark pants tucked into heavy boots. Her left arm is replaced by an enormous industrial mech prosthetic that dominates the foreground, packed with dense gears, pistons, tubing, cables, exposed mechanisms, and glowing red indicator lights, ending in 3 long curved talons with razor-sharp tips lit from within by crimson energy. Add small decals, warning labels, and vertical East Asian signage on the coat and machinery. items.content: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a small eerie girl standing in a narrow rain-soaked alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her oversized mechanical arm dominate the foreground. She wears a large white hooded coat covered with printed patch-like symbols, diagrams, and industrial markings, the hood casting deep shadow over her face. Her face is minimal and doll-like with short straight black hair, pale skin, and two glowing white eyes with no visible pupils, giving a quiet emotionless expression. One of her arms is replaced by an enormous heavy mech limb that is far larger than her body, extending toward the viewer. The arm is built from layered white armored plates, exposed joints, cables, bolts, pistons, and segmented machinery, with scratches and grime for a worn combat-industrial look. The hand has exactly 4 massive clawed fingers touching the wet ground, each ending in long black-red talons, with red internal lights glowing through vents and gaps across the knuckles, wrist, and forearm. Add dangling black cables beneath the upper arm and subtle red light leaks around the elbow and shoulder mechanisms. Her other sleeve hangs normally at her side. She wears dark shorts or a skirt beneath the coat and oversized fluffy white leg warmers around her lower legs, with bare feet visible on the reflective pavement. The alley is dense with pipes, conduits, cables, vents, and old signage, including teal-green vertical neon signs in the background, creating a moody cyan backlight. Rain falls through the scene, puddles reflect teal and red light, and tiny orange-red sparks scatter near the claw tips on the ground. Use a muted palette of dirty white, charcoal, teal, and crimson, with cinematic contrast, highly detailed linework, gritty textures, atmospheric fog, and a haunting futuristic dystopian mood. items.title: Steampunk Ship Cabin Interior
items.description: This prompt generates a richly textured cinematic steampunk interior scene, ideal for concept art, environment design, or atmospheric worldbuilding images.
items.content: A highly detailed cinematic interior of a cramped Victorian steampunk ship cabin engine room, viewed from standing eye level in a narrow corridor. The scene is packed wall-to-wall with aged polished brass pipes, copper tubes, riveted metal tanks, valves, gauges, and dark varnished wooden cabinets. On the left foreground, a steep wooden staircase with curved banister enters the frame diagonally. Along both sides of the corridor are heavy antique drawers and machinery consoles covered with small metal instruments, teapots, kettles, and mechanical fittings. At the back center is a small square-paned porthole window with 6 visible panes, showing a pale overcast exterior and a faint distant industrial skyline. Beneath the window is a narrow shelf unit with 3 open levels and a small drawer. On the right wall near the window hangs 1 round analog clock. The walls are painted teal-green metal with peeling paint and weathered patina. The floor is dark wood with a narrow worn patterned rug runner. Lighting is warm and moody, primarily from 1 glowing amber industrial wall lamp near the upper left of center, mixed with soft cold daylight from the porthole. Emphasize rich material texture, tarnished brass, oxidized copper, chipped paint, dust, age, and a lived-in mechanical atmosphere. Symmetrical depth, dense environmental storytelling, ultra-detailed, realistic, cinematic composition, shallow contrast but sharp focus throughout, no people.

items.content: Create a luxurious Japanese poster advertisement for a fictional premium sake brand named {argument name="brand name" default="月白"}, with the romanized subtitle {argument name="romanized brand name" default="TSUKISHIRO"}. The composition is a single refined studio scene with a deep midnight-to-navy blue background and shimmering water-ripple caustics across the top, as if moonlight is reflecting on a still pool. Place one tall frosted glass sake bottle slightly left of center on a glossy black lacquer platform, with a soft cool-white halo behind it. The bottle should be elegant and slender with silver-blue condensation texture, a pale textured paper label, bold black Japanese calligraphy reading {argument name="label text" default="月白"}, small vertical text near the label edge reading "純米大吟醸", and tiny roman letters "TSUKISHIRO" near the bottom of the label. To the right of the bottle, place one small celadon-green ceramic sake cup on the same platform. Add a realistic plum blossom branch entering from the lower right, carrying approximately 9 open white blossoms and 8 visible buds on dark brown twigs, with a few scattered white petals on the platform and water surface. The surface below should be glossy dark water, showing subtle reflections of the bottle, cup, blossoms, and platform. On the right side, create very large glowing brushstroke Japanese calligraphy reading {argument name="display title" default="月白"}, stacked vertically, with the spaced serif romanization "TSUKISHIRO" beneath it. On the far left, add one vertical poetic line in Japanese reading {argument name="tagline text" default="月に酔い、白に還る。"}. At the bottom center, add the text "純米大吟醸" in pale gray. Include a small white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner. Lighting should feel cinematic, cool, moonlit, and premium, with minimalism, elegant negative space, high-end beverage advertising aesthetics, Japanese traditional refinement, ultra-detailed textures, crisp product photography realism, and a serene, poetic atmosphere.

items.title: Japanese Law & Tax Services LP Hero
items.description: A premium Japanese landing-page hero banner for a fictional law and tax office, used to advertise four service areas with strong trust-building visuals and a consultation call-to-action.

author.name: 岡野タケシ弁護士【アトム法律グループ】

items.content: Create a polished Japanese landing-page hero banner for a fictional combined law firm and tax accountant office, with a clean corporate style, high trust, soft daylight, and a white background with faint modern city buildings on the far right. Use a wide horizontal web header layout. At the very top, place a large navy Japanese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="あなたの『不安』に、確かな専門力で寄り添います。"}, and beneath it a smaller gold-accented Japanese subheadline reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="法律 × 税務のワンストップサポートで、最善の解決へ"}. Below the headline, arrange 4 equal vertical service cards side by side across the center. Card 1 is for criminal defense, with a circular icon showing handcuffs at the top, a cool blue color scheme, the large title "刑事事件", supporting copy "迅速な対応で、あなたの未来を守ります", a photo of a suited male professional seated with hands clasped across a desk, and a dark blue bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines with checkmarks: "逮捕・勾留対応" and "示談交渉・不起訴の獲得". Card 2 is for traffic accidents, with a circular icon showing a car crash at the top, a green color scheme, the title "交通事故", supporting copy "適正な補償を受けられるよう、全力でサポートします", a bright desk scene with 2 miniature cars colliding on documents, and a dark green bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "後遺障害・慰謝料の増額" and "保険会社との交渉代行". Card 3 is for inheritance tax, with a circular icon showing a house at the top, a warm gold color scheme, the title "相続税", supporting copy "円満な相続と、最適な税務対策をサポート", a tabletop scene with a model house, papers, and a calculator, and a mustard-gold bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "相続税の申告・節税対策" and "生前対策・事業承継支援". Card 4 is for divorce, with a circular icon showing a broken heart at the top, a rose-pink color scheme, the title "離婚", supporting copy "あなたの未来のために、納得できる解決を目指します", a soft professional consultation scene with a woman in a white blouse resting her hand near her chin while speaking across a desk, and a dusty-rose bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "親権・養育費・財産分与" and "離婚協議・調停・裁判対応". In the bottom area, add the firm identity on the left in Japanese: a small line "法律事務所・税理士事務所", a large firm name {argument name="firm name" default="架空総合法律税務事務所"}, and a smaller line "弁護士・税理士が連携するワンストップサービス". In the lower center, place 3 compact white feature boxes with navy line icons and short Japanese text: box 1 shows a group-of-people icon and says "各分野の専門家が対応", box 2 shows a handshake icon and says "相談者様に寄り添う親身なサポート", box 3 shows a document icon and says "初回相談60分無料". Add a small disclaimer beneath them: "※ご相談の内容によっては有料となる場合がございます。" On the lower right, create a prominent navy call-to-action panel with rounded corners. Include a small Japanese line "まずはお気軽にご相談ください", a large white phone number with phone icon {argument name="phone number" default="03-1234-5678"}, and a gold pill-shaped strip at the bottom reading {argument name="business hours" default="平日 9:00〜18:00（土日祝は事前予約で対応可）"}. Use refined Japanese Mincho-style typography for major headings, crisp spacing, balanced margins, subtle shadows, and premium legal-professional branding.

items.title: Elegant Japanese Divorce Law LP Hero
items.description: This generates a polished Japanese law-firm landing page hero for divorce consultation ads, suitable for legal marketing mockups and LP design concepts.

author.name: 岡野タケシ弁護士【アトム法律グループ】

items.content: Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional divorce-law firm, designed like a high-conversion listing ad LP. Use a soft, elegant, feminine legal-brand aesthetic with a white background, blush pink accents, light gray dividers, and subtle botanical line art. The layout is a single wide desktop web hero split into two main columns: text-heavy content on the left and a lifestyle photo on the right. In the upper left, place the law firm logo and name: a delicate scripted monogram “D” with leaf ornament, followed by the Japanese office name and small English subtitle, shown as {argument name="firm name" default="法律事務所D"} and “LAW OFFICE D”. At the top right, include 2 rounded contact boxes: the first is a white phone box with a small phone icon and “24h”, short Japanese support text above, and the large phone number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}; the second is a pink email consultation button with an envelope icon and Japanese text indicating 24-hour reception. The main headline on the left is a large Japanese serif/mincho-style statement in 3 lines: “もう一人で悩まないで。” then “新しい一歩を、” in pink, then “一緒に考えます。” mixing black and pink emphasis. Below it, add a short supporting paragraph in Japanese about supporting clients with divorce-related worries and helping find the best solution, with one phrase highlighted in pink. On the right side, show a bright, airy photo of a Japanese woman in her 30s with short dark brown hair, wearing a loose white top, seated indoors on a sofa by a window, resting her face lightly on one hand and looking thoughtful; her face is obscured by a large rectangular blur block for privacy. Near her shoulder, place a pale pink circular badge with Japanese text saying that many female lawyers are on staff and consultations can be made with peace of mind. Across the lower middle, place 4 evenly spaced rounded white feature cards with thin borders and pink line icons. Card 1 shows a speech-bubble icon and text for “初回相談 60分無料” with a smaller line saying online consultation is also available. Card 2 shows a heart-in-hands icon and text about handling children’s issues carefully, with a smaller line mentioning custody and visitation. Card 3 shows stacked coins with a yen symbol and text about relieving anxiety over fees with a clear pricing structure, plus a smaller line about installment consultation. Card 4 shows a padlock icon and text about privacy protection and strict confidentiality, with a smaller line encouraging safe consultation. At the bottom, add a large curved pink-and-white call-to-action band spanning the width. On the left side of this band, include a circular phone icon, small Japanese text encouraging casual consultation and 24/365 reception, then the large repeated phone number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}, and beneath it smaller reception hours text. On the right side of the band, place a large pink rounded email button with envelope icon and Japanese text saying email consultation is available 24 hours. Along the very bottom, place 3 slim footer-style trust points separated horizontally: one about focusing on divorce consultation for women, one about consultations from family and friends also welcome, and one about nationwide and online consultations. Use refined Japanese typography, spacious layout, soft shadows, premium legal-advertising design, and realistic web-LP composition. Keep all visible text in Japanese except the small English subtitle “LAW OFFICE D”.

items.title: Japanese Inheritance Tax LP Hero
items.description: A polished Japanese landing page hero for a fictional inheritance tax accountant office, suitable for legal and tax service advertising mockups.

author.name: 岡野タケシ弁護士【アトム法律グループ】

items.content: Create a clean, premium Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional tax accountant office specializing in inheritance tax consultation. The design should look like a modern listing-ad LP first view, wide desktop format, with a soft ivory and warm white background, muted sage green and gold accent colors, elegant serif Japanese typography for the headline, and a calm trustworthy atmosphere. On the left upper area, place a refined circular logo with a thin gold ring, a large serif letter C, and a small botanical line illustration, followed by the office name 税理士事務所 {argument name="office name" default="C"} and the English subtitle TAX ACCOUNTANT OFFICE {argument name="office name" default="C"}. In the top right, add a rounded white contact bar split into 2 blocks: a phone block with a green circular phone icon, the small text 初回相談無料・土日祝も対応, and the large number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}; and a mail block with a gold circular mail icon and the text メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中. The main headline on the left should be large Japanese text reading 相続の不安に、安心という答えを。, with the key phrase 安心という答えを。 in sage green. Beneath it, add a supporting sentence in smaller Japanese text: 相続税の申告・節税対策を、経験豊富な税理士がご家族の想いに寄り添い、丁寧にサポートします。 Below that, place 3 rounded rectangular feature cards in a row with pale backgrounds and green line icons: card 1 shows a document icon and the text 相続税申告実績 1,000件以上 with a tiny note ※累計実績; card 2 shows a bar chart icon and the text 節税対策のご提案で 税負担を軽減 with a tiny note ※状況により効果は異なります; card 3 shows a group icon and the text 初回相談 無料 with a tiny note 安心の明朗会計. On the right half, show a bright consultation scene photo-style image: 3 Japanese adults around a desk in a sunlit office with greenery in the background, consisting of 1 male advisor in a navy suit seen from behind on the right, and 2 clients facing him, a middle-aged man in a light beige jacket and a woman in a white blouse. Place an open laptop on the table. Their expressions should feel calm and attentive. Overlay a pale circular badge near the lower right of the photo with delicate leaf decoration and the text 安心の 相続専門サポート わかりやすいご説明ではじめての方も安心. Across the lower middle, add a slim consultation invitation line reading 相続に関するお悩み、まずはお気軽にご相談ください, framed by diagonal slash marks. Under it, place 4 rounded category tabs in a row: 相続税の申告, 生前対策・節税, 遺産分割サポート, 二次相続対策. At the bottom right, add a large green rounded contact CTA area split into 2 main columns: the left column with a white phone icon, the small text お電話でのお問い合わせ（フリーダイヤル）, the large number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}, and the small line 受付時間 9:00〜18:00（土日祝対応可）; the right column with a white mail icon, the text メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中, and a rounded white button reading ご相談はこちらから. Along the very bottom, create a white reassurance strip with 3 horizontally arranged items separated by thin vertical dividers: 1) shield icon and 秘密厳守・プライバシー保護を徹底, 2) clipboard icon and 明朗会計・事前お見積りで安心, 3) handshake icon and 相続の専門家がワンストップで対応. Use subtle shadows, rounded corners, soft natural light, polished commercial web design, and a highly believable Japanese legal-tax service advertisement aesthetic.

items.title: Japanese Legal Services LP Banner
items.description: A bold Japanese landing-page hero image for a fictional law and tax office, useful for legal service ads, listing pages, and corporate LP mockups.

author.name: 岡野タケシ弁護士【アトム法律グループ】

items.content: A Japanese listing-ad style landing page hero banner for a fictional law office and tax accountant office, designed like a bold web advertisement with four equal vertical panels across the top and a strong call-to-action area across the bottom. The top row contains exactly 4 service panels, each with a colored header bar, a photo-realistic stock-photo image, and a colored caption bar at the bottom. Panel 1 is red and labeled 「刑事事件」 at the top, showing a close-up of two hands gripping dark prison bars against a black background; the bottom red caption reads 「逮捕・訴訟に即対応！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 2 is blue and labeled 「交通事故」 at the top, showing a realistic rear-end car crash with two damaged dark-colored sedans on a city street in daylight; the bottom blue caption reads 「慰謝料・示談もお任せ！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 3 is green and labeled 「相続税」 at the top, showing an elderly couple seated at a table consulting with a suited professional, with papers and a small house model visible; the bottom green caption reads 「税相続対策をしっかりサポート！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 4 is orange and labeled 「離婚問題」 at the top, showing a distressed woman sitting indoors with her head resting on one hand; the bottom orange caption reads 「慰謝料・親権の悩みを解決！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Make the four panels touch edge-to-edge with clean white dividers, each panel occupying the same width, and use highly saturated primary colors with glossy ad-design styling. Beneath the four panels, create a cream or light beige background footer area. On the left side, place a smaller black subheadline in Japanese: 「法律相談・税務相談なら」. Centered below it, place the large main office name in metallic gold gradient bold Japanese lettering with a slight bevel effect: 「{argument name="office name" default="〇〇法律事務所・税理士事務所"}」. Add thin black horizontal divider lines above and below the main office name. On the lower right, place a large glossy red rounded rectangular button with a bright gradient and white bold Japanese text reading 「{argument name="button text" default="無料相談受付中！"}」. The overall style should feel like a Japanese legal and tax services LP main visual from a listing ad: corporate, urgent, trustworthy, commercial, photo-based, clean grid layout, bold typography, high contrast, and realistic brochure-quality compositing.

items.title: Fantasy Library Poster for Epix & Ria
items.description: This prompt generates a polished vertical anime-style fantasy key visual poster for a two-character adventure story, ideal for film-pamphlet covers, main visuals, or promotional worldbuilding art.
items.content: A cinematic fantasy anime poster in a tall vertical composition, showing two childlike adventurer characters standing in a vast magical library-cathedral with impossibly high gothic arches, towering bookshelves on both sides, floating pages, glowing dust, and a grand staircase rising in the center toward a radiant portal-like window filled with intricate celestial magic-circle patterns. The viewpoint is low and dramatic, looking slightly upward, with both characters reaching one hand toward the viewer in an inviting gesture. On the left is a slightly taller child with short silver-white hair, soft bangs, and large green leaf-like ear ornaments or animal-like ears, wearing a navy hooded jacket over a warm orange top, dark pants, sturdy boots, and a black crossbody satchel; keep the face partially obscured by framing or angle. On the right is a shorter child with a matching design language, short silver-white bob hair with green-tinted ends, large teal-green eyes, and the same green leaf-like ear features, wearing a navy hooded jacket, orange inner layer, short dark bottoms, boots, and a mauve-purple shoulder bag decorated with small charms including a star. Between their outstretched hands, create a bright burst of magical light where two energies meet: luminous cyan-blue streams curling around the left character and warm pink-gold streams curling around the right character, with spark particles and ribbon-like trails. Split the lighting mood into cool blue on the left side and warm golden-magenta on the right side, blending at the center into a brilliant white flare. Add dense atmospheric detail: glowing motes, magical filaments, floating sheets of paper, layered architecture, and a sense of wonder and discovery. At the top, include centered Japanese tagline text in elegant white serif style: "わかることと、感じること。2つの力で世界をひらく。" At the bottom, place a very large luminous gold serif title reading "{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"}" with ornate cinematic poster typography. High-detail, polished key visual, fantasy adventure film poster, richly textured, radiant, emotional, awe-inspiring, premium illustrated promotional art.

items.description: This prompt generates a clean full-body anime character illustration of a moody girl in casual streetwear, useful for character art, social media avatars, or manga-style pinup images.
items.content: A clean anime-style full-body character illustration of a young woman squatting low on a plain light gray background, centered in frame, with a soft studio shadow beneath her. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} short bob hair with blunt straight bangs, slightly tousled ends, and a few loose strands around the face. Her expression is {argument name="expression" default="spiral half-lidded annoyed eyes"}, giving a tired, gloomy, slightly irritated look. She is wearing 4 visible clothing items: an oversized light gray hoodie with drawstrings and ribbed cuffs, dark blue denim short shorts with frayed hems, white scrunched ankle socks, and black low-top skate sneakers with white side stripes, white laces, and white soles. Her pose is a compact crouch with both knees up, one elbow resting on a knee, one hand partly covering the lower face or cheek, and the other hand hanging down near the front shoe. The art style is polished modern manga/anime key visual art with thin clean linework, smooth cel-shaded rendering, subtle fabric folds, natural skin highlights on the legs, and slightly oversized hoodie proportions. Emphasize a casual, moody, introverted vibe, minimalist composition, and a high-quality character-focused illustration.

items.title: Cinematic Shiba Squat Hero Poster
items.description: A hyper-detailed blockbuster-style movie poster of a massively muscular Shiba Inu powerlifter squatting a huge barbell, ideal for parody fitness art, meme posters, or dramatic AI-generated promotional imagery.
items.content: Create a hyper-detailed cinematic parody movie poster featuring an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu as an extreme bodybuilding powerlifting hero, centered in a full frontal deep squat while holding a massively overloaded barbell across his shoulders. The dog has a realistic Shiba Inu head with a calm, confident expression, warm orange-and-cream fur, upright ears, and direct eye contact. The body is exaggeratedly muscular and humanlike, with huge deltoids, chest, arms, abs, quads, and calves, rendered with glossy dramatic highlights and dense texture in the fur and skin. He wears only tight black lifting shorts and a dark lifting belt. The squat stance is low and powerful, knees bent wide, feet planted on a wet reflective rooftop or industrial platform at night. Put a modern city skyline in the background with illuminated skyscrapers, bluish haze, smoke, and two bright stadium floodlights in the upper left and upper right creating strong rim light and a heroic sports-arena mood. The composition should be perfectly centered and symmetrical, with the barbell extending horizontally across the frame and stacked with many large black weight plates on both sides. Use a high-contrast teal, amber, black, and gold color palette with intense cinematic grading, sharp focus on the character, and atmospheric glow around the lights. Add stylized poster typography: at the very top, a gold all-caps tagline reading {argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."}. Add 2 blocks of small white Japanese copy, 1 on the left of the character and 1 on the right, each set in 2 lines. At the bottom, place a gigantic cracked stone-textured gold title in all caps reading {argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"}. Beneath it, add a red all-caps subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."}. Add a small red stamp-like Japanese label near the lower right of the title. Include dense tiny mock film-poster credits in white across the lower center, a ratings box in the lower left, 3 tiny studio or audio logos in the lower right, and a centered release line near the bottom reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"}. Make it look like a polished blockbuster action-comedy sports film poster with absurdly epic intensity, photoreal rendering, dramatic shadows, volumetric smoke, reflective ground, and premium theatrical poster design.

items.description: A dark, detailed anime-style cyberpunk character poster showing a young drone racer in a ruined industrial arena, ideal for sci-fi key art or character concept illustrations.
items.content: A gritty cyberpunk anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Miyamoto Iori"}, a {argument name="character age" default="19"}-year-old FPV drone racer, standing in three-quarter back view inside a vast ruined industrial racing arena at night. She has black hair tied in a messy high ponytail, pale skin, and wears a glossy black tactical flight suit covered in patches, straps, cables, and sponsor markings. A massive hard-shell backpack radio rig with long antennas and decals is mounted on her back, and an ID badge hangs from her waist. Her face is mostly hidden in profile and partially obscured, creating a mysterious mood. The environment is dense with steel beams, catwalks, hanging wires, broken windows, concrete pillars, wet reflective floors, and layered signage. Multiple FPV racing drones are actively flying through the arena, leaving bright curved light trails in white, cyan, and red that loop through the scene and guide the eye into depth. Include exactly 6 visible drones in the distance and midground. Add large weathered signs reading "SECTION C", "FREEDOM, SPEED, ONLY", and "LAP 07 KEEP FLYING", plus a vertical character info block in the upper left with the text "{argument name="nameplate text" default="MIYAMOTO IORI"}", "AGE: {argument name="age text" default="19"}", "FPV DRONE RACER", the Japanese quote "私は、飛ぶ者だ。" and the English line "I am the one who flies." Also include a short stat list reading "RANKING // 2", "WINS // 11", "PODIUMS // 23", and "STYLE // GHOST". On her suit and gear, show readable decals including "AXIS", "Fly Beyond", "BRX", "IORI 027", and an ID card labeled "PILOT MIYAMOTO IORI". Use a dark monochrome palette with steel gray, black, and muted brown, punctuated by neon racing trails and small white light sources. items.title: Cockatiel Owner Seed Spill Comic
items.description: This prompt generates a humorous single-panel manga-style scene of a bird owner overwhelmed by a massive spilled seed mess, ideal for relatable pet-owner comic posts.
items.content: A single-panel Japanese comic-style illustration on a light wooden floor, drawn in a soft, detailed, slightly vintage manga-anime style with clean ink outlines and muted warm colors. In the center, a young woman kneels on the floor in a gray cockatiel kigurumi pajama suit with a white belly panel and small gray wings, while wearing an oversized yellow cockatiel hood shaped like a bird’s head with crest, round black eyes, orange cheek patches, and a beak above her forehead. She holds both sides of the hood in shock, her posture frozen and guilty, with a large rectangular censor block covering the center of her face. Across the floor in front of her is a huge mess of spilled birdseed: mixed grains, pellets, shells, and seeds scattered widely in a dense irregular pile. On the left lies 1 overturned white seed cup spilling its contents, and in the lower left corner 1 vacuum cleaner floor head points toward the mess, with part of the hose visible at the lower right edge. On the right stands 1 real cockatiel, small and curious, with a yellow face, orange cheeks, pale body, gray wings, and a raised crest, looking toward the kneeling woman; next to the bird is 1 small speech bubble containing a question mark. The background is simple indoor flooring with dramatic dark vertical stress lines filling the upper half to heighten panic. Add 4 Japanese text elements integrated like manga lettering: a huge sound effect 「ガーン」 at the upper left, 1 vertical thought bubble on the left reading 「やっちゃった…」, 1 large vertical spiky speech bubble on the upper right reading 「これ…掃除機かけるの…？無理ゲーすぎる…！」, and 1 beige caption box at the bottom right reading 「オカメ飼い、あるある。」. The mood is comedic embarrassment and domestic disaster, as if illustrating a relatable bird-owner mistake.

items.title: Anime Ensemble Movie Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic Japanese anime film poster featuring six well-composed characters, dramatic environmental storytelling, and fully integrated theatrical poster typography.

author.name: decimaru｜AI音楽×エコティクノート

items.content: A polished Japanese anime theatrical movie poster in vertical one-sheet format, painted with high-end cinematic detail and luminous natural lighting. The composition features exactly 6 youths arranged in a dramatic ensemble portrait against a bright blue sky with soft clouds, distant white birds, reflective water, lush green foliage in the foreground, and a partially overgrown futuristic eco-city ruin on the left background, blending nature and advanced science. At the top center, two main characters stand back-to-back as the visual anchor: on the left, a tall teenage boy with messy short white hair, pale skin, a calm serious expression, and a white lab coat over a shirt and tie, shown in side profile facing left; on the right, a tall teenage girl with black hair in a neat bun, pale skin, a composed expression, and a dark school-uniform-inspired outfit with a white collar and ribbon at the neck, shown in side profile facing right. Below them in the center foreground stands a schoolgirl with a straight black bob haircut, pale skin, and a black uniform with a large deep red bow, facing forward with a quiet, introspective presence. On the mid-left stands a dark-haired teenage boy in a dark suit and tie, shown in side profile facing left. On the mid-right stands a tousle-haired brown-haired teenage boy wearing a blue hoodie under a dark jacket, shown in side profile facing right. On the lower left stands a light-brown-haired teenage girl with long soft waves, wearing a pale pink cardigan over a light top, one hand near her chest, looking gentle and slightly anxious. Make every character anatomically consistent and clearly separated, with elegant hair rendering, refined fabric folds, and emotionally restrained expressions. Use warm rim light and soft atmospheric glow, with subtle lens bloom and painterly highlights to create a hopeful, contemplative mood. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: a vertical tagline on the upper left reading "その選択が、未来の景色を変える。", a vertical tagline on the upper right reading "自然と、科学と、心をつなぐ旅へ。", small text above the title reading "劇場アニメーション映画", a large glowing main title near the lower center reading "{argument name="film title" default="エコテイクノート"}", a subtitle below it reading "{argument name="subtitle text" default="― 未来への選択 ―"}", exactly 3 award laurels arranged in a row beneath the title with small Japanese festival text inside each, a row of exactly 6 character name labels near the bottom above the credits, dense small Japanese credit lines across the bottom, social and website text in very small print, and a large release date at the lower right reading "{argument name="release date" default="8.22 FRI"}" with a smaller line below reading "全国ロードショー". Keep the overall look like a premium contemporary anime key visual poster for an emotional science-and-nature coming-of-age ensemble film.

items.content: A bright, cheerful 2D side-scrolling platform game scene in a polished cartoon style, showing a cute white blob-like mascot character standing on a grassy dirt platform in the lower left foreground. The character is tiny and round with a smooth white body, stubby feet, big glossy black eyes with white highlights, and a small smiling mouth, facing slightly right. The environment is a futuristic fantasy landscape under a vivid blue sky with large soft white clouds. Across the scene are exactly 5 floating rectangular hover platforms with rounded corners, white tops, orange undersides, and glowing cyan light panels on the front; one is low near the character, one is center-low, one is center-middle, one is upper-right-middle, and one is top-right. Above the middle of the scene is an arc of exactly 5 glowing ring collectibles, alternating orange and cyan, with small sparkles and tiny white particle dots tracing the jump path between them. The level includes exactly 3 visible grassy ground platforms made of lush green turf over brown soil with rounded cutaway edges: one at far left foreground, one at lower center-left where the character stands, and one at far right foreground. In the background, add rolling green hills, atmospheric blue mountains, and a whimsical futuristic city with smooth white towers and domed buildings accented with cyan-blue windows. Include exactly 3 floating islands with grass tops and small dome structures: one mid-left, one mid-right, and one tiny distant island near the right side. Decorate the foreground with small flowers and bushes. Use saturated colors, clean vector-like outlines, soft lighting, gentle bloom around glowing objects, and a playful mobile-game aesthetic reminiscent of a friendly sci-fi platformer splash screen. Wide cinematic composition, side view, no UI, no text.

items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic single-panel anime character illustration, ideal for showcasing a stylish magical-tech heroine in a futuristic cyberpunk setting.
items.content: A dynamic anime illustration of a {argument name="character age vibe" default="teen girl"} with long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} twin tails tied with 2 oversized pink ribbon bows shaped like cat ears, vivid blue eyes, and a serious confident expression. She is posed in an exaggerated chuunibyou-style stance, one hand spread dramatically in front of the camera with strong foreshortening and all five fingers clearly visible, the other hand framing one eye, as if casting a spell or controlling a digital field. She wears a white lab coat over a dark navy school uniform with a collared shirt, vest, tie, and pleated skirt. The scene is a futuristic neon laboratory or cyber-magic room filled with glowing purple and blue light, floating holographic interface fragments, a bright horizontal audio waveform crossing the background, and a curved row of 11 translucent rectangular cards or panels floating on the left side. On the right side, a ring of 10 floating cat-face emoji icons glows in pink, purple, and blue, with different cute and mischievous expressions. Add one large glass bottle in the lower left foreground. Her long hair streams outward with motion, and purple energy ribbons swirl around her body. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, high contrast, glossy highlights, detailed fingers, intense perspective, sparkling particles, and polished high-end anime key visual rendering in a mystical cyberpunk palette of violet, indigo, and magenta.

items.title: Minimal Analog Wall Clock at 05:29
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic centered product-style photo of a simple analog wall clock showing an exact specified time, useful for timing demonstrations or model accuracy comparisons.
items.content: A minimalist studio photograph of a round analog wall clock mounted on a smooth light gray wall, centered in frame and viewed straight on. The clock has a matte black circular frame, a clean white face, black Arabic numerals 1 through 12, and thin black minute tick marks around the entire dial with thicker hour marks at each numeral. Show exactly 12 numerals and 60 minute divisions. The time displayed is {argument name="clock time" default="05:29"}: the short hour hand is slightly past 5, the longer minute hand points to the 29-minute mark just before the 6, and a very thin black second hand is near the lower part of the dial around the 31-second position. Soft even lighting, subtle realistic shadow on the wall, high-detail product-photography realism, neutral modern interior aesthetic, no branding, no extra objects, square composition.

items.title: Anime Girl Under Umbrella in Rain
items.description: A detailed anime rain portrait focused on transparent water effects, soft lighting, and a serene schoolgirl in a lush garden setting, ideal for atmospheric illustration prompts.
items.content: A luminous anime-style close-up portrait of a teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors in the rain, framed from the chest up, holding a transparent vinyl umbrella. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark navy black"} hair tied in a low side ponytail with soft loose strands and straight bangs, delicate round glasses, large glossy violet-blue eyes, and a calm, slightly awed expression as she looks upward toward leaves and raindrops. She wears a wet white short-sleeved school blouse and a dark blue plaid ribbon bow at the collar. The scene is filled with convincing water and light: rain falling in fine streaks, droplets clinging to the umbrella ribs, beads of water on her hair and shirt, and large crystal-clear drops hanging from broad green leaves in the upper right foreground. In the lower right and foreground, include blooming white garden flowers with dark glossy foliage covered in rain. Use a cool blue and silver palette with soft lavender highlights, backlit by diffused daylight after or during a shower, creating intense transparency, reflections, refraction, sparkling bokeh, and shimmering wet surfaces. The background should be an out-of-focus urban garden or residential walkway with fences and buildings blurred by rain, while the girl remains sharply rendered. Emphasize cinematic composition, layered foreground leaves, hyper-detailed raindrops, realistic translucent umbrella material, subtle rim light on wet hair, and an overall mood of quiet wonder and serene summer rain.

items.title: Photographed MIDI Piano Score Sheet
items.description: This generates a realistic overhead photo of a printed piano sheet-music page converted from a MIDI file, useful for mockups, music-tech visuals, or document-style illustrations.
items.content: A top-down realistic photograph of a single white sheet of printer paper placed on a light wood desk, showing a computer-generated music score. The page is centered horizontally with slight perspective and soft natural indoor lighting, minimal shadows, and a clean document-print look. At the top center, print the title "{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} - {argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"}" in a plain sans-serif font. Below it is a piano staff system rendered in standard black music notation with a treble clef and 4/4 time signature, designed to look like an automatically converted MIDI excerpt rather than carefully engraved sheet music. On the far left of the first system, include the instrument label "CH05 Piano". Show exactly 5 horizontal systems of notation on the page, beginning with measure numbers 18, 21, 25, 29, and 33 at the left edges of the systems. Near the first system, include a tempo marking with a quarter-note symbol equals 120. Fill the staves with dense, slightly awkward but plausible black notes, accidentals, stems, slurs, and rests, with many sharp signs and repeated short-note figures in the upper register, visually resembling piano transcription from MIDI. The first 3 systems should be long and nearly full width; the 4th system should also be long; the 5th system should be short, occupying only the left portion of the page. Keep the notation legible but somewhat mechanically spaced. Use a clean white page with wide margins and no handwritten marks, no colored elements, no extra graphics, just the printed score sheet photographed on a desk.

items.title: Anime Office Lady Beer Toast at Night
items.description: This prompt generates a tall anime-style nighttime cityscape illustration of an office woman raising a beer mug, ideal for social posts about relaxing after work.
items.content: A polished anime-style night illustration in a tall 1:2 vertical composition. A young Japanese office lady stands on a riverside promenade at night, facing the viewer, offering a large glass beer mug forward in a cheerful toast. She wears a fitted dark navy business suit with a pencil skirt, white dress shirt, red necktie, and a company ID badge on a lanyard. She has long straight dark brown to black hair with soft bangs, a slim figure, and a friendly after-work mood. Her right arm is extended toward the camera holding the frosty beer mug filled with golden lager and a foamy head, making the mug appear large in the foreground because of perspective. Her left arm hangs naturally by her side. Add a single white manga-style speech balloon to her upper right with vertical Japanese text reading 「今日もお疲れさまでした！」. Set the scene on a paved waterfront walkway with metal railings, 3 visible warm lantern lights along the path, a river or canal behind her, and a modern city skyline with many illuminated windows in the background. Above, a clear deep blue star-filled night sky dominates most of the image, with the Milky Way forming a bright diagonal band from lower center behind the character toward the upper right. Use cinematic lighting with cool moonlit blues contrasted by warm lantern glows, crisp linework, subtle glossy shading on the suit, detailed star field, and a calm, celebratory end-of-work atmosphere.

items.title: Anime Girl by the Sea with Letter
items.description: This prompt generates a romantic anime-style seaside portrait with an overlaid handwritten letter, ideal for fan messages, idol-themed posts, or sentimental social media visuals.

author.name: ワンダー（Motohiko Sato）AI共創イノベーション

items.content: A luminous anime-style illustration of a young woman standing on a sunlit stone stairway in a Mediterranean seaside town, with the viewpoint at half-body to three-quarter-body height. She has very long, flowing dark brown hair with soft highlights, slightly windswept, styled with small white flower hairpins near one side of her head. Her face is mostly obscured by her hair and angle, creating a gentle, dreamy, anonymous mood. She wears a delicate sleeveless {argument name="dress color" default="pale lavender-white"} summer dress with thin straps, lace trim, a soft fitted waist, and a large ribbon bow tied at the back. The background shows 1 narrow stone stair street lined with old buildings and greenery, 1 bright blue sea bay, 1 distant coastline with mountains, 1 lighthouse-like tower, and several tiny white boats on the water under a clear sky with soft clouds. Warm midday sunlight, sparkling atmosphere, romantic vacation postcard feeling, highly detailed anime painting, soft painterly textures, vivid blue ocean, lush green foliage, elegant feminine character design. On the right side, place 1 large white paper letter card floating as a clean overlay, with neat handwritten-style Japanese text in dark ink, including friendly emojis and flowers, as if it is a heartfelt fan message or thank-you note. The note should read: 「いつも見守ってくださって ありがとうございます😊✨ 皆さんの優しい言葉や応援が、紬の心の支えになっています🌷 日々の小さな幸せを大切にしながら、これからも心を込めて歌や言葉を届けていきますね♪♪🌸 どうか、皆さんの心が 穏やかであたたかい毎日で ありますように…🍀💖 結葉紬より🌸」. Make the letter large, legible, and balanced against the character, with a clean white background and slight paper texture. Add small subtle credit text in the bottom-left corner reading {argument name="credit text" default="Co-Creation with Motohiko Sato & AI"}.

items.title: Luxury Lipstick Ad Transformation
items.description: This prompt turns a character portrait reference into a premium Japanese lipstick campaign poster, useful for beauty-ad mockups and cosmetic branding visuals.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, transform the portrait into a luxury lipstick advertisement while keeping the same girl, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and elegant anime illustration style. Change the framing to a polished beauty-campaign composition with a dark crimson-to-black glamorous background, glossy lighting, and premium cosmetic brand aesthetics. Add a lipstick product in her raised hand on the right side, and add a large foreground product shot at the bottom left showing 1 opened lipstick tube and 1 separate cap on a reflective surface with a splash of deep red gloss. Add Japanese ad typography and layout elements: top left a small boxed label reading "新発売", a very large headline "ROUGE", a vertical text block reading "視線を奪う、ひと塗り。", followed by 3 smaller lines "鮮やかな発色。", "上品なツヤ。", "忘れられない印象へ。", then "2026 SPRING NEW COLOR" and a badge reading "全6色" with 6 lipstick swatches beside it. Add a top-right luxury logo with the letters "GB" and the brand name "GUFU BEAUTY". Add a bottom-right campaign block with a large "NEW" and the line "うるおい続く、密着ルージュ". Use rich ruby reds, gold accents, glossy highlights, soft sparkles, and a high-end magazine cosmetic poster finish.

items.title: Minimal Futuristic Anime Girl Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a clean single-character sci-fi anime portrait suitable for concept art, profile illustrations, or simple character showcase visuals.
items.content: A simple anime-style upper-body character illustration on a plain light gray background, centered and facing slightly left in a calm three-quarter pose. The character is a young futuristic female android or virtual idol with {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair, styled with one thick braided bun over the left side of the head, long loose side strands, and smooth straight hair flowing past the shoulders. She wears a geometric sci-fi headset over the left ear with a glowing cyan rectangular panel and angular metallic frame. Her outfit is a sleek white bodysuit with black structural straps and trim, a tall black high-neck collar, and thin glowing cyan accent lines running vertically and diagonally across the chest and torso. She has detached white arm sleeves with black bands, including one small dark diamond-shaped ornament on the upper arm. Render the image as a clean, minimal sketchy illustration with delicate pencil-like linework, light cel shading, soft pastel colors, subtle cyan highlights, and a polished concept-art feel. Keep the composition cropped from the top of the head to below the chest, with lots of negative space and no props, no text, and no detailed background.

items.title: Minimal Sci-Fi Anime Girl Portrait

items.content: A simple anime-style upper-body portrait of a futuristic young woman centered on a plain light gray background, drawn with loose sketchy linework and soft pastel coloring. She has long, flowing very pale pink-lilac hair that falls past her shoulders, with thin wispy strands and a gentle glossy look. Her face is completely hidden by a large centered square blur/mosaic block in muted gray-lavender. She wears a large white beret-like cap with a dark navy inner band and 2 angular dark navy side attachments, one on each side, accented with small cyan details. Add a sleek sci-fi earpiece on the visible side of her head with translucent cyan glowing elements. Her outfit is a fitted sleeveless white high-neck bodysuit with 2 bright cyan vertical panels on the front, thin dark seam lines, and small angular dark navy armor-like accents near the chest and waist. One upper arm has a dark armband with 4 thin cyan-white stripes. Show her from about the chest to the top of the head, facing slightly to the viewer’s left, with a clean elegant silhouette. Use a minimalist illustration style, delicate hand-drawn strokes, subtle cel-shading, white, cyan, navy, and pale pink as the main palette, and no background objects or text.

items.title: Coastal Reinforced Concrete Salt Damage
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic inspection-style photo of chloride corrosion and concrete spalling on a seaside reinforced concrete structure, useful for civil engineering visuals and infrastructure damage examples.
items.content: A hyper-realistic close-up documentary photograph of severe chloride-induced corrosion damage on a reinforced concrete coastal structure, viewed from slightly below at the corner of a cantilevered beam or pier. The image shows a large spalled area at the outer corner where the concrete cover has broken away, exposing exactly 5 rusted horizontal reinforcing steel bars embedded inside the concrete. The surrounding concrete is rough, cracked, and chipped, with irregular broken edges and visible aggregate. Brown-orange rust staining runs downward from the exposed reinforcement and along the underside of the beam, indicating long-term salt damage. The concrete surface is light gray, weathered, and matte, with subtle pores and construction imperfections. In the background, place a calm blue sea and a pale blue sky with a faint distant shoreline near the horizon, softly out of focus, reinforcing the marine environment. Bright natural daylight, clear weather, realistic smartphone photo composition, no people, no tools, no safety barriers, no text, no labels, no illustration style, only a believable engineering-inspection photo of salt-damaged reinforced concrete at the seaside.

On the right side, create a bright bonus panel with a paw icon and the words "モフモフ RUSH". Near the lower center, add a circular button-like emblem reading "モフモフ CHANCE". At the bottom center, create a large glowing control button labeled "モフモフ" with a pink paw icon. In the lower right display area, add a smaller inset image of the same pointing woman and handwritten-style text reading "もふるか もふられるか…" The overall mood should feel absurd, gaudy, overdesigned, kitschy, and funny, like a fake pachinko machine celebrating fluffy animals and melodramatic spectacle, rendered as a high-resolution product-style front-facing photograph with sharp reflections, saturated purple highlights, and dense decorative detail.

items.content: A highly realistic documentary-style close-up photo of a reinforced concrete structural beam with severe {argument name="damage type" default="shear cracking"}. The scene shows the underside of a concrete building structure, with 1 large diagonal crack running from the lower left area upward toward the upper middle-right of the beam face, 1 secondary branching diagonal crack nearby on the left-center, and 3 thinner vertical to slightly irregular hairline cracks on the right half of the beam. The concrete surface is rough, weathered, pale gray, and speckled with small pores and aggregate marks, with darker grime and age staining near the ceiling slab and beam joints. Include a supporting concrete column at the far left, the underside of the beam visible along the bottom edge, and a dim industrial background below with shadowy pipes and structural elements out of focus. Lighting is natural and subdued, like an inspection photograph taken on site under a bridge or inside a parking structure. Composition is a straight-on medium close-up centered on the damaged beam face, emphasizing authentic structural deterioration, realistic texture, engineering-inspection accuracy, and no people, no safety signs, no overlay text.

items.title: Japanese Legal Presentation Cover Slide
items.description: This prompt generates a bold minimalist Japanese title slide for a legal or professional presentation with strong typography and yellow accent graphics.

author.name: 司法書士試験講師│アンドロー・デザインワークショップ

items.content: Create a clean, modern Japanese presentation cover slide in a minimalist editorial style, landscape 16:9. Use a very light gray background with bold black typography and vivid yellow accent bars. The layout is asymmetrical and high contrast, with lots of negative space. Place a small black square near the upper left containing the white text "01" in italic bold sans serif. Across the center, set a large Japanese title in heavy black type on 2 lines: "司法書士等による" on the first line and "特別委任方式" on the second line, with the second line much larger and sitting on a rough hand-painted yellow highlight stroke. Below it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle in black: "登記原因証明情報の新しい取扱い". Under the subtitle, place a thin horizontal black line centered. Along the far right edge, add a tall vertical yellow sidebar with black vertical text reading "01 表紙". Near the top right, place 1 small black square as a decorative element. In the lower right quadrant, place a decorative 5 by 5 dotted grid made of 25 small black dots. On the far left edge, crop in oversized black Japanese characters so they are only partially visible, creating a strong graphic border effect. At the bottom left, place a single line of small black Japanese text: "令和7年12月9日　法務省民二第1578号　依命通知". At the bottom right, place 2 lines of small black Japanese text, right aligned: first line "司法書士事務所アンドロー・デザインワークショップ", second line "司法書士　浅野勇貴". Add a thin diagonal black line entering from the top left corner as another graphic accent. Overall feel: premium business presentation, legal seminar title slide, Swiss-inspired grid composition, bold Japanese typography, sharp and print-like.
