items.title: Japanese Aqua Fashion Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a refined anime-style Japanese beauty and fashion magazine cover, useful for editorial mockups, character branding, and cross-media visual identity.
items.content: A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover illustration in elegant contemporary editorial style, vertical full-page composition. The cover title is a huge teal serif masthead reading "AURA" across the top. In the upper right, include 4 stacked issue details: "6", "June 2025", "No.126", and a small boxed label "アウラ", followed by the price line "特別定価 ¥980". The background is a bright pale blue sky with soft white clouds. Center the portrait of an androgynous, ethereal young model, shown from chest up, wearing a crisp white tailored jacket with subtle gold piping, a white shirt, a vivid aqua-teal vest or tie layer, and a gemstone-like star brooch at the collar. The character has very long, layered, windswept hair in {argument name="hair color" default="icy white with pale aqua tint"}, with glossy strands flowing across the shoulders, and fair luminous skin. The face is largely obscured by a centered rectangular censor block in muted gray-blue to pale pink gradient, covering the eyes, nose, and upper cheeks; the visible lower face shows a soft mouth and refined chin. One hand is raised near the lips in a thoughtful fashion-portrait pose. Use delicate anime-inspired linework, airy lighting, translucent highlights, and luxury beauty-editorial rendering. Add 3 left-column cover blurbs in Japanese with teal headlines and smaller black body text: first, "透明感をまとう 初夏のスキンケア" with 2 smaller lines beneath; second, "好印象をつくる 爽やかカラー術" with 2 smaller lines beneath; third, "プロが教える 美しい髪の条件" with 2 smaller lines beneath. Add a teal circular badge on the right with 4 lines of white text: "Special Interview", "風と光と、", "自分らしさと。", and "ソラが語る 日常と美学". Near the lower center, place a small italic English line "Cover & Special Feature" above the large Japanese main headline "ソラ、という名の透明感。" with the first word in teal and the rest in black. Under that, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese subheadline text. Along the bottom edge, create 3 feature teasers with pale italic English category labels and Japanese copy beneath: left label "Fashion", center label "Beauty", right label "Trend", each with 2 short Japanese lines. Overall mood: serene, luxurious, airy, refreshing early-summer beauty fashion cover with cohesive aqua-and-white color design.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Stage Poster
items.description: A polished Japanese theatrical poster featuring a mysterious black-and-teal-haired star in a luxurious dark fantasy style, ideal for stage drama promotion and character-driven campaign visuals.
items.content: A dramatic vertical Japanese stage-play poster in luxurious dark fantasy anime style, featuring a single androgynous young actor in a half-body portrait against a nighttime city skyline with glowing high-rise windows and soft bokeh lights. The character has long straight hair in deep black with vivid teal-turquoise inner glow and streaks, glossy highlights, and strands flowing across the shoulders. They wear an elegant black high-collared costume with subtle brocade texture, a fitted dark coat, black leather gloves, and a jewel-like diamond-shaped turquoise pendant at the throat set in ornate gold. One gloved hand is raised near the collar in a poised theatrical gesture. The mood is mysterious, romantic, and slightly gothic, with cinematic rim lighting from behind, strong contrast, gold sparkles, and luminous accents in the hair and costume. Use a refined magazine-quality key visual composition with decorative gold filigree corners and a premium theatrical poster layout. Leave space for Japanese typography integrated into the design: at upper right, small text "夜空に輝く、唯一の星。", then "主演俳優" and the actor name "{argument name="character name" default="夜乃 宙"}" with small romanization "SORA YORUNO" beneath; along the left side, a vertical quote reading "この役に、すべてを捧げる。闇さえ、愛に変えてみせよう。"; near center-lower, small text "幻想ロマン・ステージ" above the large glowing gold title "{argument name="title text" default="夜の檻に囚われた光"}" with a small subtitle beneath "—それでも、君を愛した。"; include a dark teal rose motif and thorny circular ornament near the title. At the bottom left, add the date block "2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN" and venue "天穹シアター". At the bottom right, add a bordered ticket box with "チケット一般発売 5.10 SAT 10:00~". Center bottom credits in Japanese: "原作・脚本 霧月 澪", "演出 七海 翼", "音楽 深月 奏". Along the very bottom, add the tagline "—光か、闇か——。愛が、運命を選ぶ。—". Color palette: midnight blue, black, teal, cyan glow, and antique gold. Emphasize polished poster typography, layered depth, elegant fantasy drama branding, and a consistent face and atmosphere suitable for a theatrical promotional campaign.

items.title: Sunny Japanese Cafe Street Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic modern Japanese city sidewalk with a cafe terrace, summer pedestrians, signage, and a cyclist, ideal for editorial urban lifestyle or travel imagery.
items.content: A bright, ultra-realistic summer streetscape in Japan, photographed at pedestrian eye level on a wide, clean urban sidewalk lined with mature green trees casting dappled shadows. The scene shows a modern mixed-use city block on a clear sunny day, with a contemporary cafe or restaurant on the right featuring tall glass windows, dark frames, a stone facade, and a warm wood soffit extending over the terrace. Place 3 large beige patio umbrellas outside the cafe, with wooden tables and chairs beneath them. Show a lively but orderly sidewalk with around 14 pedestrians spread into the distance, most dressed in light summer office-casual clothing in white, beige, navy, and gray. In the center foreground, include 1 person riding a bicycle away from the camera, wearing a short-sleeve white shirt and dark pants with a shoulder bag. On the right foreground, include 2 women walking away, one in a white blouse and long dark floral skirt holding a round hand fan, and one in a white top and light patterned skirt carrying a bag. Add 2 visible standing signs outside the cafe: one vertical banner with large Japanese text "氷" and icy blue graphics, and one sandwich board with Japanese text reading "夏季限定 冷たいドリンク" plus images of 2 cold drinks, one dark iced beverage and one pale lemonade-like drink. On the left side, show a quiet street with a few vehicles in the distance, benches, low concrete planters, and neatly trimmed shrubs. items.description: This prompt generates a realistic bird's-eye cityscape of a contemporary rail station and bus interchange, ideal for urban planning visuals, architecture presentations, or transit-oriented development imagery.
items.content: A high-angle aerial drone photograph of a modern urban transit hub in a dense mixed-use city district, captured in crisp late-afternoon sunlight with realistic architectural detail. The scene centers on a large multi-track rail station running diagonally through the frame, with 6 visible railway tracks, 2 long passenger trains at platforms, and a glass-covered station canopy near the upper middle. A broad pedestrian bridge crosses above the tracks from left to right, connecting plazas on both sides. In the lower middle is a bus interchange with 7 visible buses parked or moving through curved lanes and marked bays. Surround the station with tall contemporary residential towers, mid-rise office buildings, retail frontages, tree-lined streets, bike lanes, sidewalks, parked cars, and small groups of pedestrians. Include one prominent glass office building on the left with rooftop greenery and a visible corporate sign reading {argument name="building sign text" default="innovation"}. Add multiple green roofs and rooftop solar panels, especially on the lower-right building. Composition should feel like a clean, realistic North American transit-oriented development, viewed from an oblique bird's-eye perspective, ultra-detailed, natural colors, sharp focus, professional city-planning photography, no stylization.

items.content: A dynamic anime cyberpunk action illustration of a young female cyborg with {argument name="hair color" default="bright pink"} twin-tail hair, suspended in a vast futuristic neon city shaft filled with glowing circuitry, holographic reflections, and dense sci-fi architecture. She is viewed in an extreme foreshortened perspective, lunging directly toward the camera with one oversized mechanical hand thrust forward, fingers spread and tipped with long glossy claws, while the other cybernetic arm is bent back in attack posture. She has a fierce focused expression, luminous green eyes, small glossy black-and-magenta horn-like head implants, and long flowing hair whipping outward in all directions. Her body is encased in a high-detail reflective chrome-and-magenta cybernetic exosuit with translucent chest plating, segmented armored shoulders, mechanical gauntlets, exposed joint details, armored thighs, and blade-like lower leg armor. Behind her are 2 large radiant energy wings made of pink crystalline electricity and particle streaks, exploding outward symmetrically. The environment is a vertical futuristic corridor or megacity canyon with layered glass panels, glowing signage, metallic frameworks, blue and cyan lights mixed with dominant hot pink illumination, countless spark-like particles, lens glow, and high-density detail. Use a dramatic low-angle composition, centered character, aggressive attack pose, glossy surfaces, intense specular highlights, saturated magenta and cyan palette, cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, ultra-detailed anime rendering, sharp linework, and a sense of speed, power, and overwhelming visual density.

items.title: Japanese Hospital Comedy DVD Cover
items.description: A glossy photorealistic Japanese DVD jacket featuring a hospital body-swap comedy setup, ideal for generating commercial-style movie cover art.

author.name: とうやこう | 憑依TSF好き

items.content: A photorealistic Japanese DVD cover styled like a commercial live-action comedy-thriller release, shot vertically with glossy retail packaging design. The cover shows a hospital room interior with soft beige walls, a bed, curtains on the right, and subtle medical fixtures in the background. In the center foreground, 1 seated young Japanese woman in a loose light-blue hospital gown sits on a bed, looking confused and vulnerable. Around her stand 3 young Japanese female medical staff: 2 nurses in pale pink uniforms with matching nurse caps and ID badges, and 1 doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope. Each of the 3 standing women is holding up a smartphone toward the camera, and each phone screen shows the seated woman’s face or body as if her consciousness has been transferred into their devices, creating a body-jack possession theme. The overall tone is playful, absurd, and slightly eerie, like a Japanese idol movie or hospital comedy DVD jacket. Use a polished magazine-quality layout with bold Japanese typography and colorful pop graphics. At the very top, place a small blue publisher logo on the left reading {argument name="studio name" default="DRILL PRESENTS"} with a heart icon, and a blue DVD VIDEO logo on the top right. Across the top center, add a pink Japanese banner line reading "シリーズ最新作！". Below it, make the main title huge, rounded, glossy, and bubbly in pink and blue Japanese text: {argument name="main title" default="ボディジャック"}. Under the title, add a pink subtitle in Japanese: {argument name="subtitle" default="～私のカラダ、乗っ取られました～"}. Add 3 comic-style speech bubbles near the upper characters: one saying "あなたのカラダ、私たちが使わせてもらうわね", one saying "これで私たちの思い通り♡", and 1 yellow startled reaction near the seated woman that reads "?!". On the left spine area, create a white vertical strip with blue and pink Japanese text repeating the title and subtitle, plus a small pink circle label reading "新作". At the bottom center, place a large flashy Japanese catchphrase in mixed pink, blue, white, and yellow outlined lettering: "人気アイドルのカラダと魂をめぐる、ドタバタ病院コメディ！" with small stars and heart doodles around it. On the lower right, add a blue circular burst with yellow and white Japanese text: "笑って、ドキドキ！悪ノリ注意の病院乗っ取り大作戦♡". Along the bottom edge, include exactly 4 small rectangular preview stills from the film, each bordered like DVD scene thumbnails, showing the same hospital characters in slightly different poses; add short Japanese captions on each thumbnail, including lines similar to "計画はバッチリ！", "え…どういうこと…？", "さあ、始めましょうか♡", and "助けて…私のカラダ…！". In the lower left margin include DVD package metadata in black text such as catalog number "DBJ-002", duration "120min.", "COLOR", and price "¥3,980 (税抜)", plus a small blue-and-pink DRILL logo. Bright retail-ready composition, realistic people, commercial Japanese movie jacket aesthetics, slightly campy, high-resolution, clean print design.

items.title: Japanese Eco-Community Promo Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese-style promotional poster for a sustainability or community project, suitable for flyers, campaign visuals, and nonprofit branding.

author.name: 哲理学作家さとうみつろう　＠新刊3冊発売中

items.content: A polished Japanese promotional poster for a community and sustainability project called {argument name="project name" default="セカイムラ"}, designed like a premium eco-lifestyle campaign flyer. Vertical layout, clean and elegant, with a soft cream paper background and a luminous, aspirational mood. The top half is dominated by a giant translucent globe centered in the composition, glowing with warm sunrise light from the upper right. Inside the globe is a breathtaking aerial landscape of a green mountain valley opening to a calm blue bay or lake, with tiny villages and fields below, cinematic and utopian. Over the globe, place a smaller Japanese slogan line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="世界は1つの村になる。"} and beneath it the large main title in bold dark navy Japanese calligraphic lettering: {argument name="main title text" default="セカイムラ"}. Around the globe, create a collage of exactly 8 candid lifestyle photos fading into the edges: 1) top left, two people in conversation outdoors under trees; 2) upper left-mid, several people working together in a rice paddy; 3) left middle, a circle gathering inside a rustic wooden structure at night; 4) lower left, two portrait-style figures in nature; 5) top right, a group sharing a meal at a long table in warm indoor light; 6) right middle, a person tending plants or crops; 7) right lower-mid, a line of people holding hands on a ridge at sunset; 8) lower right, a close portrait of a person eating or holding food. The photographic style should feel human, communal, slightly idealized, with soft depth of field, natural skin tones, golden-hour highlights, and smooth ad-poster compositing. The bottom half contains 3 evenly spaced feature cards on a light cream background, separated by subtle vertical dividers. Card 1 on the left has the heading "セカイムラ 新月会" in dark blue, a circular photo of a nighttime campfire circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 2 in the center has the heading "セカイムラ 満月会" in warm gold, a circular photo of an indoor evening gathering under string lights, decorative radiating sunburst lines around the circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 3 on the right has the heading "セカイムラ 米部が今の一押し" in green, small rice plant illustrations near the title, a circular photo of a wooden bowl of white rice, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Under these cards, add a centered Japanese statement line in dark blue: {argument name="footer slogan" default="人・自然・文化がつながり、循環する未来を一緒につくる。"}. Beneath that, place 4 small icon-and-text items in a horizontal row, each with a simple thin-line icon and two-line Japanese label: 1) people icon with "つながる 仲間と出会える"; 2) house icon with "まなぶ 暮らしを学べる"; 3) sprout icon with "つくる 未来を共につくる"; 4) globe icon with "ひろがる 世界にひろげる". At the very bottom center, include a circular logo mark followed by the project name in Japanese, and underneath a website URL: {argument name="website URL" default="www.sekaimura.com"}. Add a small QR code at the bottom right with tiny Japanese text indicating details are on the website. Use a refined palette of deep navy, forest green, gold, cream, and sky blue. Overall style: high-end Japanese nonprofit poster, eco-community branding, inspirational, harmonious, photoreal collage with subtle graphic design elements, balanced typography, soft glows, and magazine-quality print finish.

items.title: Fashion Height Comparison of Four Women
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic studio fashion image showing four women of different labeled heights, useful for social media comparison posts or editorial-style visual guides.
items.content: A clean fashion comparison studio photo of 4 adult East Asian women standing side by side against a plain light gray seamless background, full body visible from head to shoes, photographed straight-on with soft diffused lighting and a polished commercial look. Above each woman, centered over her head in black serif text, place height labels reading exactly: 145cm, 155cm, 165cm, 175cm. Emphasize realistic proportional differences in height while keeping all four women slim, elegant, and similarly styled, with long dark brown to black softly wavy hair and neutral expressions. Their faces are obscured by smooth rectangular blur blocks. The women stand very close together in a friendly pose, with subtle arm contact and one woman lightly resting an arm around another. Use a coordinated beige, cream, taupe, and soft blush wardrobe palette with smart casual feminine outfits and matching ivory loafers. Woman 1 under the 145cm label wears a short-sleeve cream ribbed knit top tucked into high-waisted light beige shorts with a fabric belt, plus a small quilted shoulder bag with a chain strap. Woman 2 under the 155cm label wears a white long-sleeve blouse with a bow tie at the collar and a taupe mini skirt with a slight flared hem, carrying a small light beige crossbody handbag. Woman 3 under the 165cm label wears a sleeveless blush-beige ribbed knit top and a simple ivory mini skirt. Woman 4 under the 175cm label wears a draped white V-neck blouse with sleeves rolled to the forearms, high-waisted taupe belted shorts, and a medium taupe shoulder bag. All 4 women wear cream or ivory horsebit loafers. Composition is vertical, centered, minimal, stylish, realistic, like a fashion catalog image comparing female heights.

items.title: First-Person Mirror Bedroom Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic intimate POV mirror selfie scene in a warm minimalist bedroom, useful for lifestyle photography, cinematic domestic visuals, or first-person AI image experiments.

author.name: ウィンピー大友@TSF系AI画像

items.content: A realistic first-person perspective photo in a softly lit minimalist bedroom at night, as if the viewer is standing very close to a standing mirror and looking at their own reflection. In the foreground, strands of long dark hair hang down from the top edge and both sides of the frame, partially obscuring the view, with one hand raised near the left side of the face as if touching the cheek or hair. In the mirror reflection, a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long straight hair is centered, wearing a loose ivory or off-white long-sleeve pajama top with delicate tiny floral texture and oversized sleeves. She poses shyly with both hands tucked under her chin, elbows inward, giving a soft, intimate, slightly bashful mood. Her face is hidden or obscured, creating an anonymous point-of-view self-portrait feeling. The mirror has a simple white frame and sits on a white vanity surface. In the background reflected in the mirror is a neatly arranged warm beige bedroom with 1 unmade bed covered in white bedding, 1 small wooden nightstand or low shelf, 1 glowing table lamp with a square white shade, and 2 tiny decorative objects beside the lamp. On the right side of the vanity are 2 clear skincare or cosmetic bottles and 1 small round white container. Use warm ambient lighting, creamy neutral tones, shallow depth of field, gentle realism, smartphone-photo composition, cozy Japanese apartment aesthetic, candid domestic atmosphere, and subtle imperfections rather than studio polish.

items.title: One Piece Manga Coloring Cover Page
items.description: This prompt generates a colored manga-style One Piece chapter page with logo, chapter heading, credits, and a whimsical garden illustration centered on Robin planting flowers.
items.content: A clean manga-coloring test page styled like an official One Piece chapter cover on a light gray background. At the very top, place the large black-and-white ONE PIECE logo with the skull wearing a yellow straw hat with a red band, integrated rope elements, and the silhouette inside the lettering. Centered beneath it, add the subtitle text {argument name="chapter title" default="Chapter 1177: FURIOUS"} in bold black serif italics. Below that, create one large rectangular full-color illustration framed by a thin black border. The scene shows Nico Robin, a young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and pale skin, seated in a garden with her knees drawn up, planting flowers. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor block. She wears a loose white short-sleeve shirt and black-and-white horizontal striped thigh-high socks, giving a casual, slightly playful look. Around her are 3 small One Piece characters helping or watching: on the left, Tony Tony Chopper in a straw hat and blue overalls holding a small shovel near freshly dug soil; in the right foreground, another small chibi-like Chopper figure wearing a blue cap with round yellow ear covers labeled “MOGO” and pink shorts, turned partly away; near the center-left foreground, a tiny helper with goggles and a hat standing by the flower bed. The garden is whimsical and storybook-like: a huge old tree with a thick twisting trunk fills the left side, a white picket fence runs behind the flower beds, and a crooked cozy cottage with blue scalloped roof tiles, dormer windows, flower boxes, and a round wooden door stands on the right. The sky is bright blue with a few puffy white clouds. In the flower bed, show exactly 3 distinct flower clusters being planted: 1 pink cluster in Robin’s hands, 1 white cluster to the right, and 1 orange cluster farther right, with several dug holes in the brown soil and chopped tree stumps in the foreground. Add a caption strip overlapping the bottom of the illustration with uppercase serif text: {argument name="caption text" default="READER REQUEST: \"ROBIN PLANTING FLOWERS IN A BED DUG UP BY MOLES\" BY MRS. FUJI"}. Beneath the image, center the credit line {argument name="author text" default="By EIICHIRO ODA"} in bold black type, and below it a smaller line reading {argument name="credit line" default="Translation: STEPHEN PAUL • Lettering: VANESSA SATONE"}. Use crisp inked manga linework with vibrant hand-colored fills, slightly textured shading, and an authentic colored manga cover-page aesthetic.

items.description: This prompt generates a fully colored multi-panel manga page with a windy romantic-comedy school-date scene, ideal for manga coloring tests and anime comic illustrations.
items.content: A cleanly colored manga page in a modern romantic-comedy style, presented as a 6-panel comic layout with crisp black panel borders on a white page. The scene takes place outdoors on a bright day with blue sky, soft clouds, leafy green trees, paved walkway, and queue posts with chain barriers. The main subject is a teenage anime girl with a short blond bob haircut, loose windblown strands, large golden-brown eyes, light blush, and a serious slightly embarrassed expression. She wears a floppy dog-ear hat with cream fur and a small blue polka-dot cap detail, a blue school-style cardigan or blazer over a white shirt, and a red patterned necktie, while holding a pink swirled soft-serve ice cream cone. A teenage boy in a dark blue sweater and white collared shirt appears in 3 panels, his face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, also wearing a matching floppy dog-ear hat. The page should have exactly 6 panels: 2 small panels across the top row, 1 large central close-up panel spanning the width, and 3 panels along the bottom row. Top-left panel: the boy faces forward with the girl turning sharply toward him, her hair and hat flaring from motion, outdoor background with a signboard, and hand-drawn manga sound effects in black. Top-right panel: a small chibi-style version of the girl stands near the chain barrier, looking smug and flustered while holding the ice cream, with a speech bubble that says "THAT'S A LOOK OF ACCOMPLISHMENT." and small floating sound-effect text near her head. Center panel: a dramatic close-up portrait of the girl against open sky, hair blowing across her face, one strand crossing her mouth, dog ears visible, staring forward with a calm, stunned look; include a vertical speech bubble on the right with Japanese text and a small English sound effect reading "PLOP". Bottom-left panel: the boy, face blurred, speaking with a speech bubble that says "I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT..." Bottom-middle panel: the girl in side view lifting a hand toward her mouth while holding the pink ice cream in the other hand, with a speech bubble saying "THANKS." Bottom-right panel: the boy reaches toward the girl's mouth or cheek with his hand as if wiping off cream, with a speech bubble that says "YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE." Keep all visible comic text and sound effects integrated into the art, including "WAH!", "FWSH", and the English dialogue. items.title: Colored Shonen Manga Battle Page
items.description: This prompt generates a dynamic fully colored manga action page with four comic panels, ideal for recreating dramatic anime-style battle scenes and manga coloring tests.
items.content: A fully colored shonen manga action page in the style of a high-energy pirate battle comic, presented as a single comic page with 4 visible panels separated by thick white gutters and slightly tilted panel borders. Use bold black ink lines, dense crosshatching, speed lines, cel-style coloring, dramatic foreshortening, and exaggerated impact effects. The scene shows a muscular, towering giant warrior with tan skin, a horned helmet, wild black hair and beard, fur-trimmed black clothing, a wide studded metal belt, and a massive spiked club, battling a swordsman in dark blue clothing and armor-like headgear. Top panel: an extreme close-up of a huge clenched fist thrusting toward the viewer with explosive perspective, the giant shouting “GUNGNIR !!!” in a jagged speech balloon, and another balloon reading “GWOAH !!!”; add large red Japanese sound effects and a small “DOOM!!” impact text. Middle wide panel: the giant swings upward and roars “IKOKU SOVEREIGNTY !!!” while the blue-clad opponent recoils at left; include a speech balloon saying “GAH!” and large purple Japanese sound effects with a small “WHONK!!”. Bottom left narrow panel: a cropped close-up setup panel with two stacked speech balloons reading “THREE SWORD STYLE.” and “RED OGRE…”, with the speaker mostly off-frame and partially obscured. Bottom right large panel: the giant drives a massive wooden spiked club across the frame in a violent horizontal smash, shouting “GIANT TROMMA !!!”; include smaller impact balloons reading “DWUAH !!!” and “THWAM!!”, plus oversized red Japanese sound effects. Backgrounds should be mostly pale sky blue with heavy motion lines and flying debris. Preserve the feel of a professionally colored weekly manga page: saturated reds, blues, purples, tan skin tones, cream fur textures, black shadows, and crisp white speech balloons with hand-lettered comic text.

items.title: Sci-Fi Mech Blueprint Hangar
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic photorealistic scene of engineers studying a giant holographic mech blueprint inside an industrial robotics hangar, ideal for concept art and sci-fi worldbuilding.
items.content: A cinematic ultra-detailed sci-fi mech hangar interior at night, shown in a wide-angle view from slightly above a massive horizontal holographic planning table. The glowing blue tabletop dominates the foreground and center, displaying an intricate engineering blueprint for a humanoid combat robot labeled {argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"}. The blueprint includes exactly 3 large full-body orthographic mech drawings across the table, one front view, one side view, and one rear view, plus many smaller component diagrams for hands, joints, feet, armor segments, and circular mechanical parts, dense technical callouts, graphs, measurement lines, and blocks of Japanese annotation text mixed with alphanumeric labels. Around the table are exactly 5 engineers in light gray industrial jumpsuits studying the design, leaning over the edges and holding rugged tablets; their faces are intentionally indistinct and partially obscured. In the deep background, exactly 1 towering real humanoid mech stands upright in a maintenance gantry, suspended or docked in a cavernous factory bay filled with catwalks, scaffolding, pipes, heavy cables hanging from the ceiling, illuminated control panels, glass partitions, and a few tiny distant workers for scale. Use a cold steel-and-cyan color palette, dramatic volumetric lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, subtle mist, high contrast shadows, and a serious military-industrial mood. The environment should feel dense, realistic, and operational, like a secret advanced robotics facility. Emphasize scale, technical complexity, and the contrast between the flat luminous blueprint and the massive constructed mech behind it. Render in photorealistic concept-art style with crisp linework on the holographic display, cinematic depth, and extreme detail.

items.title: Split-Screen Athleisure Couch Ad
items.description: A polished square product ad showing activewear as both a fitness purchase and a cozy couch outfit, ideal for e-commerce or branded lifestyle marketing.
items.content: Create a clean, square split-screen commercial image for athleisure clothing with polished ad photography and realistic typography. At the top across the full width, place a large bold all-caps white headline in a heavy sans-serif font: {argument name="headline text" default="BOUGHT FOR THE GYM. USED FOR THE COUCH."} The layout is divided vertically into 2 equal panels. In the left panel, show a neatly arranged flat lay of 5 apparel items on a smooth light gray studio background with soft directional lighting and subtle shadows: 1 black hoodie with drawstrings and a small white swoosh-style chest logo, 1 pair of black athletic shorts with a small white logo near the hem, 1 pair of white crew socks with black swoosh-style logos, and 1 pair of black running shoes with white midsoles and white swoosh-style side logos. The clothing should look premium, minimal, and carefully styled like an e-commerce campaign. In the right panel, show a young man wearing the same black hoodie, black shorts, white crew socks, and black running shoes, slouched lazily on a dark charcoal fabric couch in a dim cozy living room, holding a smartphone and looking relaxed and unmotivated. In front of him on a dark coffee table are 6 visible lounge items: 1 open pizza box with a pizza, 1 red soda can, 1 large red bag of nacho cheese tortilla chips, 1 TV remote, 1 blue bowl of chips, and 1 pink-frosted sprinkled donut partly visible at the bottom edge. Add a draped gray blanket on the couch and keep the mood humorous and relatable. At the bottom center, overlay a smaller white caption in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline text" default="Still worth it."} High-end product advertising aesthetic, crisp text rendering, brand-aware lifestyle marketing, realistic materials, balanced composition, subtle contrast between aspirational fitness purchase and actual couch use.

items.title: Pink Idol Anime Lock Screen
items.description: A glittery anime-style smartphone lock screen wallpaper featuring a pink-haired idol girl in five playful poses with notifications, UI elements, and a literal lock-unlocking gag.
items.content: A highly detailed anime-style smartphone lock screen wallpaper in a vertical 9:16 composition, themed entirely in sparkling pink idol aesthetics. The scene features {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}, a cheerful teenage magical-idol girl with very long voluminous {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} twin-tail hair, bright green eyes, fair skin, and a playful expressive face. She wears an ornate frilly stage costume in layered pink, lavender, and white with gold trim, ribbons, heart motifs, lace cuffs, a choker bow, star earrings, and floral heart hair accessories. The background is a dreamy glitter-filled pink haze with bokeh, sparkles, and soft glow effects. Design it as a fake phone lock screen with a large white lock icon near the top center, cellular status icons in the upper right, and the date in Japanese reading 5月22日 木曜日 above a large glowing time display reading {argument name="time display" default="22:22"}. Include 5 visible character depictions of the same girl: 1 large central half-body figure winking and holding one finger to her lips in a teasing pose, 1 upper-left bust portrait laughing with eyes closed, 1 upper-right full or three-quarter body pose joyfully raising a small wand or key-like object, 1 lower-left smaller figure partly obscured by a blurred pink rectangle over the face while reaching outward, and 1 lower-right crouching figure with another blurred pink rectangle over the face while interacting with a large physical lock. Add handwritten Japanese sound-effect style text around the figures, including playful exclamations and notes. Show 2 message notification banners styled like iPhone alerts, both from メッセージ and お兄ちゃん with the text 今どこ〜？, one tilted on the left and one upright on the right. Across the lower middle, place a rounded translucent slider bar with Japanese text スライドでロック解除 and a lock icon. Make the unlocking concept literal by attaching an oversized brass padlock and latch mechanism to the slider, with the lower-right character appearing to unlock it using a key; add nearby handwritten Japanese text suggesting lock removal and a metallic click sound. In the lower left, include 2 circular utility icons, a flashlight and a trash can, plus a comic-style speech bubble reading ポイッ！. Add a camera icon in a dark circular button at the lower right and a thin white home indicator at the very bottom. Render everything with polished glossy anime illustration quality, soft lighting, dense sparkles, layered transparency, and a cute mischievous mood, as if an idol character has taken over and physically prevented the phone from being unlocked.

items.title: Find Kyle in a Seoul Market
items.description: A dense search-and-find style illustration of a lively Seoul market street, ideal for posters, social media showcase images, or editorial travel artwork.
items.content: A richly detailed vertical editorial travel illustration of a bustling Seoul market alley rendered in polished hand-drawn realism with warm cinematic lighting, dense urban storytelling, and highly legible signage. The scene is packed with a large crowd of pedestrians, shoppers, diners, street-food customers, musicians, and commuters in a narrow neighborhood market street, viewed from a slightly elevated eye level so the full alley feels layered and alive. At the top left, a large illustrated poster reads “WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}?” with the subtitle “Can you find Kyle in Seoul?” in bold playful English typography, styled like a search-and-find book cover. The environment should clearly be Seoul, with a visible Namsan tower in the distant skyline, tangled overhead power lines, rooftop seating, stacked low-rise buildings, shop signs in Korean, and a subway entrance sign on the right showing line numbers 4, 2, 4, 4 and the bilingual text “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station.” Include exactly 15 major visible signs or text panels: 1) the “WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}?” poster, 2) “할머니 손칼국수”, 3) a hanging vertical sign “낙원상가 2F”, 4) a small blue street sign, 5) a vertical sign “이름 떡볶이”, 6) the large market arch sign “황진다운시장 영”, 7) a vertical orange sign “커피”, 8) a wall mural map with “남산 가는길”, 9) the subway sign with “출입구 4” and “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station”, 10) the produce sign “경성 야채”, 11) the lower produce sign “신선한 채소”, 12) a handwritten busker sign, 13) the street-food cart sign “호떡·어묵·붕어빵”, 14) the menu board “오늘의 추천 김밥 떡볶이 순대 튀김”, and 15) the delivery box text “빠른 배달”. Populate the alley with exactly 8 vendor or activity zones: 1) a noodle restaurant at left under a red-and-white awning with seated diners, 2) a vegetable stall with stacked produce crates, 3) a busking duo with guitar and percussion, 4) a central street-food cart selling hotteok, fish cake, and bungeoppang, 5) a standing crowd eating snacks and holding cups, 6) a small magic performance table in the lower center with cards and cups, 7) a painter at an easel near the lower left, and 8) a scooter delivery cluster at the lower right. Add exactly 6 notable background accents: 1) rooftop diners on the upper right terrace, 2) a cat lounging on a roof ledge upper left, 3) colorful market umbrellas in the middle distance, 4) stairways and narrow side passages, 5) dense balconies and windows full of plants and people, and 6) the distant tower and skyline. The crowd should feel extremely varied in age and clothing, mostly casual contemporary Korean street fashion in jackets, hoodies, backpacks, skirts, slacks, and sneakers, with a few office workers and students. Hide a single subtly distinct person meant to be the findable target, {argument name="target outfit" default="a young man in a blue hoodie with yellow lettering"}, integrated naturally among the central crowd rather than spotlighted. Use a vibrant but grounded palette of brick red, teal, forest green, cream, mustard, asphalt gray, and sky blue. Emphasize intricate linework, readable Korean text, observational city details, lively human gestures, and the playful feel of a premium “Where’s Waldo?” style Seoul search poster. Aspect ratio 2:3.

items.content: A dreamy kawaii 3D render in a lush flower garden at night, filled with glowing pink neon graphics and soft sparkles. In the center, a small doll-like girl is shown from behind, with long silky blonde hair and a white bow headband, wearing a pastel blue pinafore dress over a pink puff-sleeve blouse with white trim. She gently reaches up to touch the mouth of a large white rabbit character standing in front of her. The rabbit has oversized upright ears, glossy black eyes, rosy cheeks, and a cute plush-like face, and wears a light blue uniform-style jacket with a tiny gold badge over a white body. Surround them with dense greenery, daisies, and abundant pink blossoms in the foreground and background. Across the top, place large glowing Korean neon text reading {argument name="headline text" default="가특하구나~"} in bright pink bubble lettering with a soft halo. Include exactly 7 additional neon or UI-style decorative elements: 1 heart-shaped sign at the upper left with the word {argument name="top sign text" default="CUTE"}, 1 neon star sign on a white cabinet at the upper right, 1 glowing heart outline near the rabbit on the right, 1 retro pink computer-style floating window on the left with tiny toolbar details and a central heart graphic containing the text {argument name="window text" default="you're so precious"}, 1 large glowing heart outline at the bottom left, 1 pink handheld virtual pet device at the bottom right showing a tiny bunny sprite, and 1 small glowing crystal heart near the device. Add soft bloom, glossy highlights, magical glitter particles, pink rim lighting, shallow depth of field, toy-photography styling, and a nostalgic cute internet aesthetic with pastel pink and blue as the dominant palette.

items.title: Colorized Soccer Manga Page
items.description: This generates a dramatic full-color sports manga page with a tilted stadium soccer scene, inset close-up panels, and bold dialogue, ideal for manga coloring tests or anime-style comic art.
items.content: A full-color manga page in the style of a dramatic sports manga, showing an intense soccer match inside a huge domed stadium packed with a blue-and-white crowd. Use sharp ink lines, dense crosshatching, screentone texture, dynamic speed lines, and vivid anime coloring as if a black-and-white manga page has been professionally colorized. The composition is a single page with 3 panels: 1 large main panel covering most of the page, plus 2 narrow diagonal inset panels stacked along the left side. In the main panel, show a steeply tilted wide-angle view of the penalty area and goal from an elevated sideline perspective, with the green grass stretched by perspective and filled with directional hatching. Count 6 visible players in the main panel: 4 blue-uniform players and 2 white-uniform players, plus 1 goalkeeper in yellow at the goal. The most prominent player is seen from behind in the lower center-right wearing a blue jersey with “HUGO” and the number 9, running toward the play with one arm extended. Near him on the lower right edge, show another player in a white jersey labeled “ISAGI” with the number 11, also running forward. In the midground, show 4 more field players contesting the ball: 3 in blue and 1 in white, with one white-uniform player diving or lunging horizontally from the right toward the center. The goal stands near the top center-left, with the yellow goalkeeper bracing in front of the net. Add 3 speech bubbles in the main panel, large white manga balloons with hand-lettered uppercase English text: “BUT I WANT TO WIN THE WORLD CUP...”, “...AS THE SECOND-BEST AND AS A MID-FIELDER.”, and “...THE WORLD RECORD FOR MOST TIMES WINNING THE WORLD CUP...”. In the left-side inset area, create 2 diagonal panels. The upper inset panel shows a close-up of a dark-haired character in blue, partly obscured by a soft rectangular blur over the center of the face and torso area, with a small speech bubble that says, “YOICHI ISAGI, DID YOU KNOW...”. The lower inset panel shows a close-up of a reddish-haired character with a wide blue eye, sweat on the face, and a pale blue background, looking surprised or stunned. Maintain bold black panel borders, dramatic foreshortening, and a high-energy tournament atmosphere. Use a blue, green, white, and yellow palette with strong contrast and authentic manga-page coloring aesthetics.

items.title: Cyberpunk Creative Cloud Ad Poster
items.description: A neon cyberpunk promotional poster for Adobe Creative Cloud, ideal for recreating bold tech advertising graphics with multiple app panels and futuristic branding.
items.content: Create a high-energy futuristic cyberpunk advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Adobe"} {argument name="product name" default="Creative Cloud"}, in a wide 16:9 format, set against a dense neon-lit nighttime megacity with glowing skyscrapers, holographic billboards, wet reflective streets, and a dark purple-blue-black atmosphere. Use an intense synthwave palette of electric magenta, cyan, violet, hot pink, and blue, with glowing edges, digital glitches, scanlines, light streaks, particle sparks, and HUD-style interface accents. At the upper left, place the Adobe logo and the word {argument name="brand name" default="Adobe"} in red, followed by a huge bold techno headline reading {argument name="product name" default="Creative Cloud"} in luminous white and cyan with magenta glow, and beneath it a smaller tagline in all caps: {argument name="tagline" default="7 APPS. ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES."}. Below that, add a short marketing paragraph in compact futuristic type: “POWER YOUR CREATIVITY WITH INDUSTRY-LEADING TOOLS FOR EVERY IDEA AND EVERY CREATOR.” On the upper right, feature a giant glowing rounded-square app icon containing the Adobe Creative Cloud symbol, rendered like a radiant neon hologram with cosmic texture and orange-pink-blue energy inside. Next to it, add a vertical Japanese neon sign reading “創造する、無限の力”. Across the lower middle, display exactly 7 illuminated app cards in a single horizontal row, each as a distinct glowing panel with beveled sci-fi borders, internal circuitry details, and matching neon color accents. Card 1: “Ps”, label “PHOTOSHOP”, subtitle “PHOTO EDITING”, with a simple landscape/image icon, in cyan-blue. Card 2: “Ai”, label “ILLUSTRATOR”, subtitle “VECTOR GRAPHICS”, with a pen-nib/vector icon, in orange-gold. Card 3: “Pr”, label “PREMIERE PRO”, subtitle “VIDEO EDITING”, with a film frame and play button icon, in purple-magenta. Card 4: “Ae”, label “AFTER EFFECTS”, subtitle “MOTION GRAPHICS”, with stacked layered-shapes icon, in violet. Card 5: “Id”, label “INDESIGN”, subtitle “LAYOUT & PUBLISHING”, with a text-layout icon, in pink-red. Card 6: “Lr”, label “LIGHTROOM”, subtitle “PHOTO MANAGEMENT”, with a landscape/photo icon, in cyan-teal. Card 7: “Xd”, label “XD”, subtitle “UI/UX DESIGN”, with a wireframe/app-window icon, in hot pink. Along the very bottom, add a glowing horizontal footer bar with exactly 5 feature blocks separated by thin neon dividers: 1) cloud icon with “SEAMLESS INTEGRATION”, 2) people icon with “BUILT FOR COLLABORATION”, 3) sync/cloud-arrow icon with “SYNC ACROSS DEVICES”, 4) graduation cap icon with “LEARN & GROW WITH CREATIVE CLOUD”, 5) a bold closing slogan at the far right reading {argument name="closing slogan" default="MAKE IT. CREATIVE CLOUD."}. Overall style: premium cinematic tech ad, ultra-detailed, razor-sharp, symmetrical promotional layout, glossy reflections, dramatic contrast, retro-futurist game UI aesthetics, polished commercial poster design.

items.title: Dark Comedy Insect Spray Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic product advertisement featuring a dominant bug spray can and a fallen superhero parody in a messy living room, ideal for bold ecommerce or campaign creatives.
items.content: A darkly comedic, cinematic product advertisement staged in a messy modern living room at night. In the background, a person in a full {argument name="superhero costume" default="Spider-Man-inspired red and blue suit"} lies face-down and motionless on a wooden floor, one arm stretched toward the camera, posed like a defeated superhero after a battle. The room is dim and moody with a gray couch in soft focus, pillows and blankets tossed around, and scattered white popcorn across the floor. In the left foreground, show 1 open pizza box cropped into frame. In the right foreground, place 1 large upright can of {argument name="product name" default="Raid"} insect spray as the hero object, sharply focused, oversized in perspective, with a black cap and a purple label facing camera. Make the product feel dominant, clean, and commercial, with dramatic rim lighting and glossy reflections. Add 2 lines of bold white uppercase ad copy: at the top, very large condensed sans-serif text reading {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."}; at the bottom center, smaller bold text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."}. Include 2 visible insect illustrations on the can label, and keep the overall tone like a high-end shock-value commercial campaign: realistic photography, shallow depth of field, strong contrast, gritty floor texture, subdued gray-blue interior lighting, and a composition that makes the spray can the clear focal point while the fallen hero tells the joke in the background.

items.title: Darkly Comic Bug Spray Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic product advertisement with bug spray in sharp focus, a fallen spider-themed superhero, and bold copy for edgy Shopify or campaign marketing visuals.
items.content: Create a gritty, darkly comedic advertising image for a bug spray product in a realistic cinematic photo style. The scene is a messy sunlit living room with a wooden floor, soft warm afternoon light coming from tall windows on the left, shallow depth of field, and a low camera angle near floor level. In the foreground on the right, place a sharply focused aerosol can of {argument name="product brand" default="Raid"} bug spray standing upright, large in frame, label facing camera. The can is red and black with bold yellow branding, and the visible label reads "Raid", "ANT & ROACH", and "KILLS BUGS DEAD". In the midground and stretching toward the left side of the room, show 1 exhausted fallen superhero in a red-and-blue spider-themed suit, lying face-down and sprawled across the floor as if defeated, one gloved hand reaching toward the camera. Scatter exactly 6 visible dead bugs across the floor around the can and superhero. The room should include 4 background furniture elements: a sofa on the far left, a small side table, a wooden cabinet at the back, and a second storage unit on the right, all slightly out of focus. Add a bold oversized distressed white uppercase headline across the top that reads {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."} and a smaller bold white tagline centered at the bottom that reads {argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."}. Emphasize strong product focus, ironic shock-value humor, realistic textures, dramatic shadows, commercial ad composition, and polished premium campaign photography for e-commerce or social media marketing.

items.title: Dust-Drawn Symbol on Car Hood
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic close-up photo of a dusty car hood with a large hand-drawn emblem, useful for automotive, environmental, or symbolic visual storytelling.
items.content: A photorealistic close-up of the hood of a dark blue or black car parked outdoors, covered in a thick layer of beige-brown dust and pollen. In the center of the hood, a large clean emblem-like shape has been finger-drawn through the dust, revealing the glossy paint underneath. The symbol is a circular logo with 8 segmented bars around a raised circular center: 1 wide curved segment across the top, 3 horizontal bar segments on the left side, 3 horizontal bar segments on the right side, and 1 wide angled segment across the bottom. A realistic adult human hand with dirty fingernails rests on the lower right area of the hood, as if it has just finished drawing the symbol. Show streaks, smudges, and finger-trace texture in the dust around the edges of the design. Include part of the windshield and 1 windshield wiper at the top left, with soft reflections of trees in the glass and paint. Background is a slightly blurred parking lot with sunlit pavement, curb, and 3 tree trunks. Warm late-afternoon natural lighting, shallow depth of field, high-detail automotive surface reflections, candid documentary-style composition, vertical smartphone photo framing.

items.title: Sleeping Calico on White Appliance
items.description: A warm, realistic pet photo of a fluffy calico cat napping on a sleek white device, ideal for cozy lifestyle or home-interior imagery.
items.content: A cozy indoor lifestyle photo of a fluffy long-haired calico cat sleeping with its eyes closed and its chin gently resting on top of a glossy white cylindrical appliance shaped like a rounded tube, viewed from the front at table height. The cat has a thick tricolor coat with orange, black, and white fur, a white muzzle, pink nose, large pointed ears, and a very soft, plush appearance. Its body is draped behind and around the appliance on a long matte-black tabletop with natural light wood edges, creating a centered composition with the appliance in the foreground and the cat filling the upper half of the frame. The appliance has a circular front opening with a metallic inner ring and a small oval control window near the bottom. The setting is a warm, sunlit modern home interior with a window directly behind the subject, soft daylight coming in, a pale wall, warm wooden floor, and 1 small potted plant on the windowsill at the top right. Shallow depth of field, gentle warm color grading, realistic fur detail, natural reflections on the appliance, calm sleepy mood, high-resolution candid pet photography.

items.title: Anime Maid Thriller Movie Poster
items.description: A high-impact anime film poster showing two back-to-back maids in a neon blue-and-pink mystery setting, ideal for theatrical key visuals and dramatic promotional art.
items.content: A dramatic anime theatrical movie poster in a tall vertical composition, centered on 2 young women in classic black-and-white maid uniforms standing back-to-back and facing opposite directions. The left maid has a short silver bob haircut with straight bangs and a white maid headband; the right maid has a short vivid pink bob haircut with straight bangs and a matching white maid headband. Both wear fitted black dresses with puff sleeves, white aprons with ruffled trim, white collars and cuffs, and black ribbon accents at the neck. Their poses are confident and tense, with one hand lowered at their sides, suggesting mystery and rivalry. Place them large in the foreground, filling most of the poster height. Behind them, create a split-color night sky: deep electric blue on the left and saturated magenta-pink on the right, blending at the center. In the upper left, show a bright full moon and a small helicopter with a searchlight. Along the horizon and lower sides, include a glowing city skyline, blue-lit on the left and pink-lit on the right. In the center background, place a gothic mansion or castle with pointed towers at the end of a path, illuminated with warm lights. In front of the mansion, show 2 smaller full-body figures of the same maids from behind, walking toward the building side by side. Add 4 supporting characters around the lower edges: 1 dark-haired man in a suit at bottom left, 1 older stern man in a suit at lower right-center, 1 young woman with long dark hair at bottom right, and the 2 small maid figures in the center distance, for a total of 6 visible human figures in the poster. Scatter bright pink flower petals across the image as if blown by the wind. Use intense cinematic lighting, glossy anime rendering, high contrast, sharp linework, glowing rim light, and a suspenseful psychological thriller mood. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on both sides, a large stylized title at the bottom center reading {argument name="title text" default="Re:maid"}, smaller Japanese subtitle text beneath it, and release text at the lower left reading {argument name="release date text" default="7.25 [FRI] ROADSHOW"}. Add a final Japanese tagline line along the bottom. Overall style: premium anime key visual, mystery thriller, neon blue and hot pink dual-color palette, polished poster typography, highly detailed background, dynamic petals, and theatrical film-poster finish.

items.title: Ornamental Kimono Girl with Cats
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed vertical anime poster of a kimono-clad girl surrounded by flowers, ornaments, birds, butterflies, and four cats, ideal for elegant character art or decorative key visuals.
items.content: A highly detailed anime illustration of a seated young woman in an elegant Japanese-inspired fantasy kimono composition, centered on a clean warm off-white background. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black with deep blue-violet undertones"} hair with blunt bangs and very long flowing side lengths, with red and blue ribbon strands woven through the hair. Her eyes are large and luminous {argument name="eye color" default="crimson red"}, and her expression is calm, soft, and slightly wistful. She wears an ornate floral hairpiece on the right side of her head made of 4 major blossoms in red, white, pale blue, and blue, with dangling gold ornaments and tassels. Her outfit is a richly patterned kimono in {argument name="kimono colors" default="red, black, pale blue, cream, and touches of purple"}, covered in cherry blossoms, stylized flowers, butterflies, cords, bows, and hanging tassel decorations. The sleeves are oversized and flowing, with visible red cord knots and floral appliqué details. She sits in a graceful curled pose with one hand near her face, bare legs prominently visible, wearing white tabi-like socks and elaborate red-and-black platform sandals with bows. Surrounding her are exactly 4 cats: 1 black cat sitting on a branch at left looking upward, and 3 white cats placed around her lower left, mid-right, and lower center-right. Include exactly 2 birds: 1 blue bird perched on the left branch and 1 small red-and-blue bird nestled among flowers at the lower right. Include exactly 3 butterflies: 2 near the upper left and 1 near the lower center by her legs. Frame the composition with plum blossom branches, hanging Japanese ornaments, tassels, diamond charms, and long fabric streamers. Add a large circular decorative motif behind her upper body and a tall vertical banner-like ornament on the right side. The overall palette should balance vermilion red, black, ivory, pale cyan, sky blue, and lavender. Style is polished 2D anime key visual, ultra-clean linework, delicate textile patterning, flat decorative shapes mixed with subtle shading, elegant negative space, highly ornamental but harmonized composition, whimsical and refined, vertical full-body character poster.

items.content: A clean, minimalist anime illustration of a melancholic young woman in three-quarter profile, seated and resting her cheek against one hand. Her face is small and delicate, with a tiny beauty mark under one eye and subtle lashes. She wears a dark oversized layered outfit in deep navy and charcoal: a high-neck black top under a loose draped jacket or kimono-like outer layer, with faint gold line accents and tiny eye motifs worked into the fabric. Her accessories are occult-inspired and elegant: multiple ear piercings, one long dangling earring shaped like an eye with a teardrop pendant, a thin necklace with a small eye charm, and several rings including an eye ring on the hand touching her face. Add a dark bottle silhouette and a few muted blue-gray leaves on the left side as secondary decor. Use a restrained palette of navy, black, cream, gray-blue, and touches of muted gold. The composition should feel quiet, gothic, feminine, and introspective, with flat graphic shapes, crisp linework, little shading, and a modern decorative poster aesthetic.

His face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. The lighting is moody and warm, with reflections from tall windows and a premium executive atmosphere. On this dark left page, place large elegant serif headline text in English reading {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}, stacked in two lines near the upper left in muted gold. At the top, place a large Japanese headline in black, aligned upper center-right, with two short Japanese body text blocks beneath it; on the upper far right include a small photo of exactly 4 stacked hardcover books and a glass vase near a bright window with greenery. Across the middle, add a centered section title in Japanese for five benefits, followed by exactly 5 numbered columns labeled 1 through 5, each with a short Japanese heading and several lines of smaller explanatory Japanese text. Beneath that, add another centered Japanese section title for workflow, followed by exactly 4 step blocks laid out horizontally: STEP 01 with a speech bubble icon, STEP 02 with a pencil icon, STEP 03 with an open book icon, STEP 04 with a megaphone icon. Along the bottom of the right page, place exactly 3 rectangular photos side by side: a city-view office meeting table scene, a close-up of a hand writing with a pen, and a stack of books near an open book. The face is entirely obscured by a large smooth rectangular censor block in the center, covering from forehead to chin and most of the cheeks, with a subtle gradient of warm tan to muted blue-gray. Only the outer features remain visible: a close-cropped buzz cut with tight dark speckled hair texture on top, 2 visible ears, and the lower rounded chin and jaw. The head wears colorful eyeglass temples wrapping around the sides only, with no visible front lenses because the center is blocked; the left temple is pale cream with a tiny red-and-gold decorative mark, and the right temple is bright red-orange. items.title: Surreal Cowboy Fashion Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a stylized surreal western fashion portrait with anonymous censoring, pink horses, layered pearls, and red sports cars for editorial or concept-art use.
items.content: A surreal fashion portrait of a mysterious cowboy figure centered in the frame, shot from the chest up against a vivid cobalt-blue daytime sky with a few soft white clouds. The person’s face is completely obscured by a tall vertical rectangular blur block running from the forehead past the nose and mouth, creating an anonymous censored identity effect. They wear a glittery red cowboy hat with a pale white crown, a black scarf or bandana wrapped around the neck and lower face, and a bold red western-style jacket or shirt covered in white horse illustrations and floral-patterned motifs. Layer the neck and chest with heavy maximalist jewelry: 1 oversized long pearl strand hanging low, at least 4 shorter pearl necklaces stacked at the collar, and 1 ornate gold statement necklace with coin-like dangling elements. Place 2 pale pink horse heads behind the figure’s shoulders, one on the left and one on the right, facing slightly outward like surreal companions or sculptural props. In the lower background, include 2 red sports cars partially visible, one on each side, blending into a red desert-like horizon. Use a dreamy retro-futurist western aesthetic with glossy textures, soft focus, slight chromatic aberration, and a lo-fi editorial look. Symmetrical composition, centered subject, saturated colors, strange luxurious mood, high-fashion surrealism, cinematic portrait photography.

items.title: Dark Gothic Ritual in Cathedral
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic dark-fantasy ritual scene with a gothic woman, candles, sigils, and cathedral architecture, ideal for dramatic horror or occult-themed concept art.
items.content: A cinematic dark fantasy scene inside a vast gothic cathedral at night, centered on a mysterious woman in a floor-length black ceremonial gown standing in the middle of a glowing occult circle. The composition is perfectly symmetrical and frontal, with the woman placed dead center beneath a huge rose window and a bright full moon visible through the stained glass. She wears an ornate, form-fitting {argument name="dress color" default="black"} gown with lace, embroidered filigree, semi-sheer sleeves, a corseted bodice, and a long flowing train spreading across the stone floor. Her pose is regal and ritualistic, arms slightly extended at her sides with open hands, as if summoning smoke or dark magic. Her face is obscured and indistinct, with dark updo hair and a high gothic collar or headpiece. Around her feet is a large circular sigil inscribed in glowing {argument name="sigil glow color" default="amber-gold"} lines, with intricate symbols and concentric rings. Place exactly 30 black candles of varying heights around the circle and foreground, all lit, with warm flames casting low orange highlights. Fill the air with drifting smoke and mist, especially around her hands, the lower floor, and the side aisles. The cathedral interior is towering, shadowy, and highly detailed, with ribbed vaults, pointed arches, weathered stone, elaborate carvings, and deep blue-black darkness. On the left and right sides, include exactly 2 massive gargoyle or demon statues perched on ornate pedestals, one per side, leaning inward protectively or menacingly. Behind the woman, a raised altar and clusters of additional candles recede into darkness. Lighting is moody and high-contrast, dominated by cold moonlight from above and warm candlelight from below, creating metallic highlights on the dress and architecture. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, dramatic volumetric fog, gothic horror atmosphere, occult elegance, epic scale, sharp textures, realistic shadows, and a haunting, majestic mood.

items.title: Gothic Sorceress in Ruined Cathedral
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic dark-fantasy portrait of a spellcasting woman in a ruined gothic cathedral, ideal for horror, occult, or gothic book-cover style artwork.
items.content: A dark gothic fantasy scene inside a vast abandoned cathedral, vertical full-body composition. In the exact center stands a mysterious sorceress in an elegant Victorian-inspired black gown with a fitted corset bodice, intricate silver embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, long draping lace panels from the arms, black gloves, and a long trailing skirt. Her hair is styled in a neat dark updo with a subtle ornamental hairpiece, and she wears delicate jewelry. She holds an open spellbook in one hand and raises the other hand in a poised spellcasting gesture. Surround her with low-lying mist and curling smoke. The cathedral interior is immense and decayed, with towering pointed arches, ribbed vaulted ceilings, cracked stone floors, broken tombs or altars on both sides, and thick twisted roots spreading across the ground and wrapping around the stone structures. Place exactly 2 large gargoyle statues perched symmetrically on elevated side structures, one on the left and one on the right, looming over the scene. Add many black candles with warm orange flames scattered across the foreground and midground, creating ritual ambience. In the background, show tall stained-glass windows with cold bluish daylight streaming through them in dramatic god rays, contrasting with the candlelight. Mood is haunting, arcane, cinematic, solemn, and highly detailed, with realistic textures, deep shadows, volumetric lighting, atmospheric haze, dark blue-gray color palette, and ultra-detailed gothic architecture.

items.title: Retro Fast-Food Brand Board
items.description: This prompt turns a reference food photo into a complete restaurant branding presentation board for showcasing logo, palette, typography, photography style, and brand applications.
items.content: Using REFERENCE_0 as the hero food photo, transform it into a polished one-page restaurant branding board for a fried chicken and waffle-fries concept named {argument name="brand name" default="Can Dende"}. Keep the yellow-table food photography as the visual anchor, but redesign the output as a clean square brand guideline sheet on a warm off-white background with a cheerful, retro, hand-drawn fast-casual identity. Add a large logo area in the upper left with bold vintage red lettering, a small illustrated fried-food mascot above it, and the tagline “FRIED CHICKEN & RUFFLES”. Build the page as a structured multi-panel layout with 9 sections: 1) logo/hero area, 2) brand story text block, 3) top-right hero photo crop from the reference, 4) color palette showing exactly 5 swatches with hex labels, 5) typography section with a large display sample of the brand name plus 3 text styles labeled header, subhead, and body, 6) patterns and textures section with exactly 4 playful assets: a yellow wavy stripe pattern, a red checker pattern, a handwritten phrase, and a small doodle heart, 7) iconography section with exactly 5 simple icons: chicken, bottle, fries, smiley face, and heart, 8) photography style section with a 2x2 grid of exactly 4 food-photo crops derived from the reference and matching close-up shots, plus a short bullet list of photography guidelines, and 9) brand applications section with exactly 5 mockups labeled signage, takeout packaging, menu design, social media, and staff apparel. Include a circular badge near the hero photo that says {argument name="badge text" default="CRISPY GOOD MOOD"}. Use the palette {argument name="primary palette" default="yellow, tomato red, deep navy, leaf green, soft pink"}. Add a bottom banner with 2 sections titled “VOICE & VIBE” and a short brand summary paragraph. items.title: Cinematic Samurai Agency Landing Page
items.description: This generates a high-end dark web landing page hero for a creative studio, ideal for showcasing bold branding, web design, or agency concept work.
items.content: A cinematic dark landing page mockup for a Japanese-inspired creative agency called {argument name="studio name" default="AKAI STUDIO"}, shown inside a modern desktop browser window. The page uses a dramatic black-to-deep-red gradient background with a moody sunset glow, scattered small white dust or ash particles, and a widescreen hero layout. On the right side, place a full-body samurai seen from behind, standing on jagged black rocks near a calm shoreline, wearing dark layered armor and a horned helmet, holding a katana at his side, with a long torn crimson cape blowing strongly to the right. On the left side, create bold oversized white condensed sans-serif headline text in Spanish reading {argument name="headline text" default="DISEÑO BRUTAL"}, split across two stacked lines. Above it, add a small eyebrow line with a tiny red vertical accent: {argument name="eyebrow text" default="DISEÑO QUE DEJA HUELLA"}. Below the headline, add large Japanese characters followed by STUDIO: {argument name="subheadline text" default="赤い侍 STUDIO"}. Beneath that, place a short supporting paragraph in small uppercase white text: {argument name="body text" default="BRANDING, WEB DESIGN Y EXPERIENCIAS DIGITALES PARA MARCAS QUE QUIEREN DESTACAR."}. Add two call-to-action buttons below the copy: a filled light button labeled "VER PROYECTOS" and an outlined dark button labeled "CONTACTAR". Across the top navigation bar, include exactly 4 centered menu items in uppercase: "INICIO", "SERVICIOS", "PROYECTOS", "CONTACTO", with "INICIO" marked as active using a small red underline. Put a boxed top-right button labeled {argument name="top button text" default="HABLEMOS"}. In the top-left of the site header, add a logo block with a small red square containing the kanji "赤", the brand name "AKAI STUDIO", and a tiny Japanese subtitle beneath it. The overall style should feel like high-end brutalist web design meets cinematic game key art: ultra-polished UI mockup, sharp typography, strong contrast, luxury agency aesthetic, minimal but powerful composition, black, white, and crimson palette, subtle grain, realistic lighting, premium presentation.

items.content: A dynamic manga-style action illustration of a single androgynous young woman shot from a dramatic low angle, as if the viewer is beneath her while she drops or steps forward through an explosive burst of ink and debris. She has a short platinum-blonde bob haircut with long side-swept bangs partly covering one side of her face, pale skin, and a cool, rebellious streetwear aesthetic. Her face is obscured by a simple light-gray rectangular censor block. She wears 5 main clothing items: an oversized black hooded jacket with bright cyan geometric markings on the sleeve and inner lining, a fitted white tank top, loose black cargo-style pants with straps and zipper details, a black belt with a hanging cyan tag, and chunky white-and-black sneakers with small cyan accents. Add extra accessory details including dangling straps, buckles, and street-tech trims. Her pose is relaxed but dominant, one knee raised toward the viewer, torso leaning back slightly, one hand tucked into a pocket, jacket flaring outward in motion. The composition should feel aggressive and kinetic, with a monochrome palette of black, white, and gray, punctuated by vivid electric cyan paint slashes. Fill the background with explosive abstract brushwork, ink splatter, speed lines, torn black shards, and chaotic manga energy radiating outward from behind her. High contrast, gritty texture, rough inked linework, painterly splashes, urban dystopian anime key visual, extremely detailed fabric folds, stylish editorial framing, wide cinematic composition.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Wizard Podcast Poster
items.description: A photorealistic parody fantasy poster showing two Gandalf-like wizards with staffs, headphones, and a podcast microphone, ideal for meme posters, social media promos, or comedic album-cover art.
items.content: A dramatic dark fantasy studio poster of two wizard-like figures posed like a parody heavy-metal album cover. In the foreground, a stocky older wizard sits or leans toward the camera, wearing a glossy black hooded robe, large over-ear studio headphones, and a long thick white beard spilling over his chest. He grips a tall black staff in his left hand; the staff has an elongated spearhead-shaped ornate top with open lattice details. A large black podcast microphone on a boom or stand is positioned directly in front of him at mouth level, with a visible sticker that reads "CARAJO" on the microphone body. Behind him stands a second older wizard in a luminous white robe with gold trim and a rope belt, also with long white hair and a long white beard. He holds a tall white staff with a matching ornate spearhead top in his right hand and extends his left hand toward the viewer in a commanding spell-casting gesture, fingers spread. Behind the standing wizard’s head is a bright electric-blue glowing circular halo made of runes, creating a magical summoning-ring effect. The background is pure black, with high-contrast cinematic lighting: cool blue rim light from behind and warm highlights on the hands, robes, and staffs. The composition is vertical, tightly framed, with the black-robed wizard occupying the lower center and the white-robed wizard towering behind him. At the bottom center, add the title {argument name="title text" default="GORDALF"} in huge metallic stone-textured gothic block letters, like a fantasy metal logo, and place 1 small occult-style emblem centered underneath the word. Photorealistic cosplay portrait, ultra-detailed fabrics, theatrical fantasy realism, poster design, sharp focus, moody epic atmosphere.

items.title: LEGO Plaza de España at Sunset
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic LEGO-style architectural scene of Plaza de España in Seville, ideal for travel-themed concept art, social media visuals, or playful photoreal landmark renders.
items.content: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO interpretation of {argument name="landmark" default="Plaza de España, Seville"}, shown as a grand golden-hour architectural scene from canal level. The image is vertical and cinematic, with the viewer looking straight down a narrow curved canal toward an ornate Spanish Renaissance Revival palace facade built entirely from LEGO bricks. The warm terracotta building fills the upper half of the frame, with multiple towers, arched colonnades, balconies, decorative cornices, and intricate brick-built ornamentation. A small Spanish flag flies from the central tower. In the foreground, a LEGO rowboat with 2 minifigures is seen from behind, drifting along the canal; one has reddish-brown hair and the other light brown hair, both rowing with long brown oars. In the mid-distance, there is a second small rowboat with 2 minifigures under or near an elegant arched bridge. Count 2 boats total and 4 rowing passengers total. Along the right-side promenade, count 4 visible standing minifigures placed at intervals beside the tiled railing. The canal is lined with detailed blue, white, and yellow ceramic-style LEGO mosaic balustrades and brick parapets, with black vintage street lamps; count 7 visible lamp posts total. On the left edge, include 2 rounded pink flowering shrubs in planters. The bridge crossing the canal has ornate blue-and-white LEGO tile patterns and a graceful single arch. The water should look realistic yet made from small glossy LEGO-like tiles, with dark teal reflections of the building and sky. Lighting is soft sunset light with a glowing amber sky, scattered clouds, long highlights, and rich warm shadows. Emphasize realism, fine texture, playful scale illusion, and the convincing blend of real architectural grandeur with unmistakable LEGO construction.

items.title: LEGO Alhambra Courtyard at Sunset
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic, highly detailed LEGO-style recreation of the Alhambra courtyard with tourists, reflective water, and warm sunset realism for travel art or architectural showcase imagery.
items.content: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO diorama of {argument name="landmark" default="the Alhambra in Granada"}, shown as an ornate Moorish courtyard at golden-hour sunset. The scene is built entirely from LEGO bricks and minifigure parts, with warm amber light, cinematic depth, and rich texture. Center the composition on a long narrow reflective water channel leading toward 1 small round fountain in the middle distance and a grand horseshoe arch beyond it. Surround the courtyard with intricate tan stone-like LEGO walls, carved-looking geometric relief patterns, slender columns, tiled archways, and terracotta rooflines made from densely layered reddish-brown pieces. In the background, include 2 main towers and several additional palace structures rising behind the courtyard, plus 6 tall dark green cypress trees silhouetted against a glowing orange sky. Add blue, green, and white mosaic-style tile details around the central arch and lower walls. Populate the courtyard with exactly 9 LEGO tourists and visitors: 1 traveler in a tan hat and light outfit, 1 visitor in a blue jacket beside them, 1 person with a green backpack at the left foreground, 1 photographer holding a camera in the left foreground, 1 kneeling visitor examining the garden at the right edge of the water channel, 2 standing visitors chatting in the right midground, and 2 seated visitors on a tiled bench in the right foreground. Frame the water channel with low manicured hedges and small pink flowers. Use a low eye-level perspective from the start of the reflecting pool, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the central courtyard, glossy water reflections, realistic LEGO stud texture, and a mood that feels majestic, playful, and museum-quality.
