items.content: A highly detailed anime illustration in the style of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, presented as a dramatic vintage manga character sheet poster for {argument name="character name" default="OpenAI"} personified as a glamorous female stand master. The layout is a single page with 6 distinct sections framed by ornate art nouveau borders and manga panel lines. Main section on the left: a full-body fashion portrait of the character in a confident contrapposto pose, wearing a tailored white suit with emerald green and black accents, gold trim, a long cape lined in teal, fitted vest, corset-like torso panel, high-waisted pants, heeled shoes, gloves, chain accessories, circular hair ornaments, earrings, and multiple OpenAI logo emblems integrated into the outfit. The belt buckle reads GPT, the pant leg has vertical text reading “SAFETY ★ ALIGNMENT ★ BENEFIT,” and the jacket sleeve shows the OpenAI name and logo. Her hair is silver-white, styled in elaborate curled twin buns and long ringlets, with glossy emerald accessories and JoJo-inspired luxury fashion detailing. Top left section: a cream parchment title panel with the OpenAI logo and the large text “OpenAI”, plus 3 text blocks reading “STAND NAME: GPT-∞”, “[dʒi: pi: ti: mu: geni ti]”, and “STAND MASTER: OPENAI”, followed by an italic Spanish quote: “La curiosidad es el prompt, el conocimiento es la respuesta, y la humanidad… es el contexto.” Top right section: a close-up portrait panel of the same woman from the shoulders up, turned partly away with one hand raised elegantly, against a dark purple manga background with 4 large stylized purple sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with smaller English translation beneath it: “Mi propósito es extender el potencial de la humanidad.” and “(My purpose is to extend humanity’s potential.)” Center-right section: a stand ability information box titled “STAND ABILITY: [INFINITE CONTEXT]” with Spanish descriptive text beneath: “Permite analizar, conectar y generar conocimiento ilimitado a partir de cualquier información existente.” Lower center-right section: a humanoid robotic stand in a dynamic reaching pose, feminine and sleek, with a glossy black faceplate displaying the OpenAI knot logo, white biomechanical armor, emerald glowing seams, gold accents, and several floating holographic rings and data panels orbiting around it. The rings contain readable words including “DATA”, “CREATIVITY”, “REASONING”, and a distorted futuristic label similar to “RETRIEVAL/AGENT”. The background is cosmic and starry with dramatic energy effects. Bottom right section: a smaller rear three-quarter portrait panel of the woman looking over her shoulder with a confident smile and one finger near her chin, again over a purple manga background with 3 large stylized sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with two lines: “¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES?” and “MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN.” Bottom left section: a circular JoJo-style stat chart with 6 labeled attributes in Spanish, showing “POTENCIAL ∞”, “VELOCIDAD A”, “ALCANCE ∞”, “DURABILIDAD B”, “PRECISIÓN A”, and “POTENCIA A”. Under it, include a small cream biography box titled “OPENAI” with Spanish text: “Fundada: 2015 (San Francisco, EE. UU.)” and “Misión: Asegurar que la inteligencia artificial general beneficie a toda la humanidad.” Use a richly inked manga print aesthetic, detailed crosshatching, cel shading, aged paper texture, elegant cream margins, deep emerald, ivory, black, and gold palette, exaggerated JoJo fashion anatomy, sharp linework, dramatic comic-book composition, and luxurious supernatural sci-fi energy.

items.title: 360 AI Art Gallery Panorama
items.description: A photorealistic immersive 360-degree museum panorama showing a futuristic AI-themed exhibition, ideal for VR scenes, virtual tours, or concept visualization.
items.content: An ultra-wide 360-degree equirectangular panoramic view of a futuristic contemporary art gallery exhibition about artificial intelligence, designed for immersive VR viewing. The scene is inside a vast dark-ceilinged museum hall with exposed rigging, many small spotlights, polished reflective concrete floors, and curved white exhibition walls wrapping continuously across the panorama. The environment is filled with {argument name="visitor count" default="about 25"} adult visitors in smart casual and business attire, standing in small conversational groups and scattered around the room, with subtle face blur or indistinct facial detail. At the exact center of the panorama is a circular installation platform containing a tall translucent holographic human figure made of white glowing particles and vertical strands of light, suspended beneath a large circular ceiling ring. On the left side, show a white robotic arm sculpture on a round pedestal in front of a giant wall artwork depicting a luminous side-profile human head composed of particles and constellation-like dots. Across the walls, include 6 visible AI-themed artworks total: 1 giant particle head mural, 3 framed cosmic nebula or galaxy images, 1 large monochrome abstract painting, and 1 tall colorful starfield-like digital piece in the far right background. On the right foreground, place a large transparent cube installation containing a swirling spiral galaxy projection in blue, violet, and white. Also include 2 small white service robots near the center-right area of the floor. Lighting is cinematic and cool-toned, with blue, purple, and white glows from the installations contrasting against the dark ceiling and neutral gallery architecture. The mood is sleek, high-end, intellectual, and techno-cultural, like an AI biennale or premium digital art fair. Render photorealistically with crisp architectural detail, realistic reflections, natural human scale, and full seamless 360 panorama distortion appropriate for an equirectangular image.

items.title: Elf Sniper Team in Forest Ambush
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic fantasy-combat image of 2 camouflaged elf scouts in a forest, ideal for cinematic concept art, game key art, or tabletop RPG visuals.
items.content: A cinematic ultra-realistic fantasy military scene in a dense woodland forest at ground level, showing 2 elf snipers concealed in camouflage while scouting a target. In the foreground, one elf with long pale-blond hair and clearly pointed ears lies prone behind a modern precision sniper rifle, aiming through a mounted scope. The rifle is long and tactical, fitted with a large suppressor, scope, and a deployed bipod planted in the mossy forest floor. The elf wears full modern woodland camouflage, tactical gloves, and a leaf-covered ghillie hood and shoulder covering that blends into the undergrowth. Behind and slightly to the right, a second elf crouches low, also with pointed ears and long light hair, wearing matching camouflage and a leafy ghillie cloak, holding binoculars to their eyes while observing. Add tactical chest gear and pouches on the rear scout. Set the scene in a shadowy temperate forest with tall thin trees, tangled branches, moss, roots, and scattered leaves, lit by soft early-morning natural sunlight filtering through the trees from the right side. Use muted green, brown, and gray tones, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, dramatic focus on the rifle and the two camouflaged elves, immersive war-photography composition, tense stealth atmosphere, and high-detail photorealism.

items.title: Hidden-Object Madrid Plaza Puzzle
items.description: This prompt generates a busy illustrated search-and-find poster of Puerta del Sol in Madrid, ideal for hidden-object games, social posts, or travel-themed puzzle art.
items.content: A highly detailed, colorful illustrated hidden-object poster set in Madrid’s Puerta del Sol on a bright sunny day, rendered like a lively hand-drawn travel puzzle with crisp ink outlines, textured watercolor-gouache shading, and a slightly whimsical caricature style. The composition is packed edge to edge with a huge crowd in the plaza, viewed from a slightly elevated eye level, with the Real Casa de Correos clock building dominating the right background, the Tío Pepe rooftop sign in the left background, the red diamond Sol metro sign on the left, the bear and strawberry tree statue near the center, historic facades, blue sky, and soft clouds. At the top left, include a torn notebook-paper sign pinned over the scene with large Spanish text: {argument name="headline text" default="¿Dónde está \"El Hombre del Puro\"?"} and a second line {argument name="subheadline text" default="Encuéntralo en Madrid"}. Next to it, add a pinned small portrait photo of the target man: a middle-aged man in a dark fedora and dark coat holding a cigar near his mouth, styled like a reference snapshot. Fill the square with exactly 1 metro entrance sign, 1 lottery kiosk labeled “Loterías y Apuestas del Estado,” 1 domed souvenir kiosk with postcard display and a sign reading “¡HOLA! DESDE MADRID,” 1 churros stand with a chalkboard reading “CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE,” 1 hat display stall on the lower right, 1 guitarist, 2 flamenco dancers in red dresses, 1 street cleaner in a bright orange-and-green uniform with text on the back reading “MADRID LIMPIO ENTRE TODOS,” 1 bicyclist, 2 dogs, 1 child holding a red teddy-bear balloon, many pigeons scattered across the foreground, children playing with soap bubbles, tourists with backpacks and maps, families, street onlookers, and performers. The crowd should feel dense and bustling, with dozens of distinct figures in varied summer clothing and natural poses, creating a challenging search scene. Emphasize Spanish local color, playful observational details, warm oranges and sunlit stone grays, and the feeling of a classic “Where’s Waldo?” style city-search illustration centered on finding {argument name="target character" default="El Hombre del Puro"} somewhere among the crowd in {argument name="city" default="Madrid"}.

items.title: Indie Mind City Isometric Tech District
items.description: This prompt generates a dense isometric retro-futurist city scene full of humorous AI and programmer references, ideal for editorial art, posters, or social media visuals about indie AI culture.
items.content: A dense isometric steampunk-cyberpunk city illustration at dusk, designed like a whimsical indie tech district called {argument name="city name" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}. The scene is a single sprawling urban plaza packed with narrow brick buildings, rooftop antennas, cables, pipes, neon signs, market stalls, tiny pedestrians, and playful programmer humor. In the center background, a plaza labeled “PLAZA DEL PROMPT” surrounds a sculptural fountain with pale blue water, with benches and people gathered around it. To the left background, a tall building with a giant sign reading “BARRIO CÓDIGO ABIERTO” is covered in balconies, windows, hanging laundry, air conditioners, plants, and street activity. To the right background, another block bears a large sign “CALLEJÓN DE LOS AGENTES,” with stacked storefront signs including “Codex Barbería cortes exactos,” “Gemini Lavandería,” “Claude’s Coffee,” and “Dr. Llama.” Further right, a heavy industrial factory zone with smokestacks, cranes, ducts, crates, and catwalks displays 3 large signs: “ZONA INDUSTRIAL,” “FÁBRICA DE TOKENS,” and “LLM.” A cloud of floating letters and symbols rises above the chimneys like generated text smoke. In the foreground center, a tall clocktower-like corner building has a vertical neon sign reading “INDIE MIND,” a large round clock on the facade, warm lit windows, and a small stone animal sculpture at its base. To the right foreground, a lively market district glows with string lights and a bright neon sign “MERCADO NOCTURNO,” with 3 visible stall signs: “Memoria usada barata,” “Embeddings frescos del día,” and “Se cambian vectores.” Nearby are 3 more joke signs: “HARD HAT: prompt injection zone,” “HACKATHON: entra y sal con un bug,” and a food stand labeled “STACK OVERFLOW NOODLES.” To the left foreground, an older mixed-use building is filled with signs and visual jokes, including a huge rooftop billboard with 2 cats on top and the title {argument name="main billboard text" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}, plus a small version label “v1.0.0.” On that same block, include these visible signs: “FORGE & CAFE,” “git push cafe +$2,” “Tienda de MERGE CONFLICTS abierto 24/7,” “Se reparan linters,” “NO rm -rf aquí,” “Ralph was here,” “npm install vv,” “sudo make me sandwich,” “WORKTREE,” “SE VENDE GPU USADA,” “MUSEO DEL MERGE CONFLICT,” “NOTARÍA DE COMMITS FIRMADOS,” “PSICÓLOGO PARA SENIOR DEVS 50m 80,” “GATO PERDIDO responde a localhost,” and a poster board reading “HOY: charla sobre agentic coding entrada libre” and “REUNIÓN DE AA^AI REUNIDOS DE LOS AGI.” Near the center-left plaza, add a sandwich-board style sign labeled “PROMPTS USADOS” with 3 lines beneath it, and small plaza signs that read “HELLO WORLD,” “Tailscale,” “OpenRouter,” and “Deepseek.” The streets are cobblestone and crowded with exact small story details: 1 yellow tram labeled “LÍNEA MAIN,” 1 small blue car, 1 bicycle cart, 1 delivery scooter, outdoor café tables, chess players, pedestrians, crates, potted plants, striped awnings, laundry lines, glowing windows, rooftop cats, and a white llama standing near the agent alley. Use a warm muted palette of dusty teal, rust, amber, tan, and faded neon pink and cyan. Render it as an ultra-detailed editorial illustration with clean isometric perspective, intricate linework, soft atmospheric lighting, tiny readable signage, cozy urban clutter, and humorous handcrafted worldbuilding.

items.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Homepage
items.description: A detailed Victorian-industrial video platform homepage mockup with ornate text, dense UI elements, and sepia scientific media, ideal for showcasing GPT Image 2 text rendering.
items.content: Create a full-page steampunk video platform homepage mockup in a dark antique bronze, brass, and sepia palette, styled like a Victorian industrial version of YouTube. The interface should be vertically oriented like a poster or website screenshot, richly decorated with gears, pipes, engraved metal borders, filigree, gauges, screws, and glowing Edison bulbs. At the top left, place a modern overlay logo reading "Pollo AI" with smaller text "GPT Image 2" beneath it. Center the main site title in large ornate serif lettering: "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}", with a smaller engraved tagline below: "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search box on the right showing the placeholder "Search ElectroVid..." and a search icon. On the left sidebar, add a section titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 vertically stacked channel cards with circular emblems and subscribe buttons: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". Each card should have an ornate vintage badge logo and a rectangular button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". In the main content area, place one large featured video player with a sepia still image of two late-19th-century inventors in suits arguing in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning motifs; one man points while the other gestures back, and a light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Intentionally obscure both faces with soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video progress bar, playback controls, and timestamp "08:47 / 22:31". Beneath the player, show the video title "{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, include a channel row with a circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", metadata "142K views • 3 days ago", and on the right a like button reading "LIKE" with count "5.8K". Under this, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video thumbnails in one row. Thumbnail 1: a sepia portrait of Thomas Edison holding a glowing bulb, face obscured with a blur block, duration "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Thumbnail 2: a dramatic sepia image of the Wardenclyffe Tower under lightning, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Thumbnail 3: a sepia photo of an early automobile with Henry Ford seated in it, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Below the thumbnails, add a centered metal button labeled "VIEW ALL VIDEOS". At the bottom footer, include the text "© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}" on one line and "All rights reserved." on the next. Add decorative pressure gauges in the upper right and lower right corners, plus exposed pipes and a large gear in the lower left. Make the whole design highly detailed, symmetrical, tactile, and cinematic, with engraved textures, aged paper panels, brass highlights, soft warm bulb glow, and crisp, legible typography integrated into the antique UI.

items.title: Boca Juniors Welcome Poster
items.description: A high-impact football signing announcement poster for social media, ideal for presenting a star player joining Boca Juniors.
items.content: A dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster in Boca Juniors colors, designed like a polished social media graphic. Show a half-body portrait of {argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"} wearing the modern Boca Juniors home jersey, dark royal blue with a wide gold chest band, gold shoulder stripes, Adidas logo on the right chest, CABJ crest on the left chest, and “betsson” sponsor across the yellow band. The player is centered slightly to the right, cropped from upper torso to top of head, with short dark hair and athletic build, turning his head slightly to his left while pointing with his right index finger directly at the club crest on his chest. Do not show facial details clearly; keep the face obscured or out of focus. Use a deep blue textured stadium-themed background with glowing highlights and subtle grunge overlays. In the lower left background, include La Bombonera stadium facade with visible signage reading “LA BOMBONERA” and “CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS.” Add small floating gold confetti particles throughout the scene for celebratory energy. Place a large CABJ shield logo in the upper right. Typography must be bold and poster-like: at the top left in small gold uppercase text, “BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”; below it a small gold star; then a huge stacked headline on the left with “BIENVENIDO” in tall white condensed uppercase and “DYBALA” in oversized gold condensed uppercase. Below the name, add smaller white uppercase text reading “PAULO DYBALA,” flanked by thin gold lines and a small gold star. At the bottom, place a thin gold horizontal line across the width and centered gold uppercase text reading “| JUGADOR DE BOCA |” with a gold star beneath it. Use high contrast, glossy sports-poster lighting, rich navy and gold color grading, sharp fabric detail, and an elite club announcement aesthetic.

items.title: Satirical Expensive Supplements Cartoon
items.description: This prompt generates a square Spanish-language editorial cartoon mocking commission-driven doctors and overpriced ineffective supplements for social media posts or health-awareness content.
items.content: A clean, square editorial cartoon in flat vector style with soft shading and bold outlines, on a light gray background. The scene is a satirical medical office consultation about overpriced supplements that do not work. At the top left, a huge three-line Spanish headline in bold sans-serif reads: “Suplementos” in dark teal, “costosos” in orange, and “que no funcionan” in dark teal, with a small orange sparkle accent and an orange underline swoosh beneath the headline. At the top right, add a social handle and website in dark teal: “@elnutridice” and “elnutridice.com”. Along the far left edge, place a vertical orange credit line that reads “Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, show a wooden desk covered with large stacks of green cash, with many loose bills flying through the air around the characters. On the right, a smug male doctor in a white lab coat over teal scrubs sits behind the desk, holding a thick stack of money in one hand and gesturing casually with the other. His face is deliberately blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. On his coat, a badge or patch reads “SALUD Y COMISIONES”. In front of him on the desk is a dark teal nameplate with a dollar symbol and the Spanish text “TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO”. Behind him on the wall, include a framed certificate that reads “CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”, plus a small shelf with 3 visible items: 2 teal binders and 1 small potted plant. On the left, a female patient with long dark brown hair and a teal long-sleeve shirt sits facing the doctor, one hand raised in frustration. Her face is also blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. Add a speech bubble above her saying: “Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” Add a speech bubble above the doctor saying: “A mí sí me sirvió.” On the lower left corner of the desk, place a supplement bottle labeled “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM” with an orange price mark “$$$$”. Next to it, place a clipboard with a prescription sheet showing a large “Rx” and the text “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”. Also include 2 small potted plants total in the image: 1 on the floor or lower left beside the desk and 1 on the rear shelf. Use a humorous, critical, social-media infographic tone, balanced composition, crisp typography, high readability, and polished modern vector illustration aesthetics.

items.title: Mirassol FC Signing Announcement Poster
items.description: A dramatic vertical football transfer poster for Mirassol FC, ideal for club announcements, athlete promo art, and social media sports graphics.
items.content: Create a dramatic Brazilian football club signing announcement poster in a vertical 2:3 layout, with a gritty high-contrast sports-marketing aesthetic in yellow, dark green, black, and gold. The main subject is a muscular tattooed male footballer wearing a bright yellow Mirassol FC home jersey, shown as a large centered half-body portrait from chest up, facing forward with a serious intimidating expression. He has a shaved head, visible neck and arm tattoos, and a broad athletic build. The jersey has dark green trim on the collar and sleeves, the Mirassol crest with two stars on the chest, the ATHLETA logo on the opposite chest, a large green sponsor wordmark reading “Poty” across the torso, shoulder brand marks, and a circular sleeve sponsor patch. Behind him, place a dramatic waving Mirassol flag in dark green and yellow on the upper right with a large club crest and two stars, glowing stadium lights, smoky golden particles, and a night stadium crowd background. On the left side, stack large bold condensed text in Portuguese: “BEM-VINDO AO” above an oversized yellow “MIRASOL”, then the player name split across 2 lines as “ALEX” and “POATAN” in huge white letters, with a handwritten yellow signature-style “Poatan” beneath. Below that, add a 4-line motivational block in uppercase white text with the final line highlighted in yellow: “DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA.” On the right side, add a vertical info panel with 3 icon-and-word traits, each in yellow with matching symbols: target icon with “FOCO”, fist icon with “DISCIPLINA”, and helmet icon with “GARRA”, then below them a bold yellow callout: “AGORA É PELO LEÃO!”. Include 2 smaller secondary player images at the bottom: 1 on the lower left, a cropped front three-quarter pose kissing the club badge on the jersey; and 1 on the lower center-right, a back view with both arms raised and index fingers pointing upward. On the back-view jersey, show the sponsor text “DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA” across the upper back, the name “POATAN”, and the number “10” in large green numerals. Add a black-and-gold bottom strip containing 4 values separated evenly with icons: lion head and “MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO”, shield and “FORÇA E HONRA”, star and “HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”, soccer ball and “PAIXÃO PELO JOGO”. Beneath that, place a yellow banner with the slogan “NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO.” and at the very bottom a handwritten white phrase “FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!” followed by the hashtag “#POATANÉLEÃO”. Use cinematic rim lighting, intense contrast, metallic golden glow, textured smoke, and premium club-announcement poster design.

items.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Homepage
items.description: This prompt generates an ornate Victorian-industrial streaming site mockup, ideal for retro-futuristic UI concepts, posters, or social media visuals about improved text rendering.
items.content: A richly detailed steampunk-inspired vintage video platform homepage shown as a full-screen web interface mockup in dark brass, aged bronze, black iron, and sepia tones, designed like a Victorian industrial machine with ornate filigree, pipes, rivets, gears, gauges, and glowing Edison bulbs built into the frame. The top left shows a modern overlay logo reading Pollo AI and GPT Image 2. Centered across the top is a large engraved metal site title, {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}, with a smaller plaque subtitle reading {argument name="tagline text" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}. A navigation bar directly beneath contains 6 visible items: a home icon button, TRENDING, INNOVATIONS, DOCUMENTARIES, ENTERTAINMENT, and a search box on the right with placeholder text similar to Search ElectroVid.... On the upper right corner of the frame there is 1 round analog clock gauge. On the left sidebar, a framed section titled Popular Channels contains exactly 3 channel cards stacked vertically, each with a circular emblem, subscriber count, and a SUBSCRIBE button: The Patent Office with 27.4K subscribers, The Royal Society with 18.7K subscribers, and General Electric with 35.1K subscribers. The main content area features 1 large central video player with a sepia historical scene of two men in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked AC vs. DC with lightning-like chalk effects; one man points while the other gestures with open hands, and a glowing light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Add a realistic video player UI with a play button, timeline with partial red progress, volume icon, elapsed and total time reading 08:47 / 22:31, settings icon, theater icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, show the featured video title as {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}, with channel metadata below: The Electrical Age, 142K views, 3 days ago, plus a small circular profile portrait and a brass LIKE button showing 5.8K. Below that, a section header reading LATEST VIDEOS contains exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row: 1) My New Incandescent Bulb, showing a man holding a lit bulb, duration 10:12, channel Thomas Edison, 89K views, 5 days ago; 2) The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower, showing a Tesla tower under electrical arcs, duration 15:36, channel Nikola Tesla, 120K views, 1 week ago; 3) The Automobile Revolution, showing an early vintage car with a driver on a city street, duration 12:08, channel Henry Ford, 110K views, 1 week ago. Centered below the thumbnails is a brass button reading VIEW ALL VIDEOS. At the bottom center, add a footer plaque reading © 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved. Decorate the outer border with additional pipes, cogs, mechanical joints, embossed corners, and 1 more circular pressure gauge near the bottom right. Use symmetrical, highly polished antique UI design, cinematic warm lighting, realistic texture, impeccable serif typography, dense ornamental craftsmanship, and a believable fusion of modern streaming layout with 19th-century industrial aesthetics.

items.title: Helicopter Selfie Over Moscow
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic travel selfie inside a helicopter with a thumbs-up passenger and an aerial view of the Kremlin and Saint Basil's Cathedral, ideal for tourism or lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A realistic smartphone-style travel photo taken inside a helicopter cabin, showing a seated passenger on the left side of the frame and a sweeping aerial view of Moscow through a large window on the right. The person is wearing a black zip-up athletic jacket with a small white swoosh logo, a seatbelt across the chest, a metallic wristwatch, and large black aviation headphones with a microphone boom. Their face is obscured by a rectangular blur block, and they are giving a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera. The helicopter interior is dark, with black leather seating and beige cabin trim framing the window. Outside the window, capture an overcast daytime panorama of central Moscow from above, with the Kremlin walls and towers clearly visible, the colorful onion domes of Saint Basil's Cathedral in the lower right, a broad cityscape stretching into the distance, and a cluster of modern skyscrapers on the far right horizon. Use natural diffused light, realistic urban detail, mild atmospheric haze, and the candid composition of a tourist selfie shot from a helicopter ride, wide-angle but not distorted.

The dog is centered in the frame, looking slightly upward with a calm, noble, almost heroic expression. Behind the dog is a long dark wooden bar counter on the right and a wall densely lined with many glass liquor bottles and hanging glasses, creating a cluttered authentic tavern atmosphere. On the left side, show a small wooden table, 2 wooden chairs, a dark doorway, worn walls, exposed beams, and 2 visible bare hanging light bulbs. Use warm amber indoor lighting, rich brown and golden tones, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, documentary-style realism, sharp focus on the dog, softly blurred background, wide cinematic composition, and a humorous but dignified mood. The image should feel like a Brazilian countryside bar portrait of a dog dressed like a regional folk hero.

items.description: This prompt generates a dense isometric festival-style illustration of a vibrant Latin American tech conference plaza, ideal for event branding, startup community posters, or social media showcase art.
items.content: Create a highly detailed, colorful isometric festival poster illustration of a bustling Latin American technology fair in an open urban plaza, packed with dozens of people networking, coding, presenting, eating, recording media, and attending talks. The overall style should feel like a premium editorial cityscape poster: vibrant, dense, optimistic, playful, and full of readable signage, with crisp linework, painterly textures, warm sunlight, and a celebratory startup-community atmosphere. The main headline on the large stage at upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}, with a subheading in Spanish reading "Aprender para transformar". On the stage, show a live conference with blue lighting, a presenter, and a seated audience; include 4 vertical icon panels on the stage area labeled "Educación", "Tecnología", "Innovación", and "Futuro", plus 3 glowing topic icons on the back wall labeled "Código", "Comunidad", and "Impacto". Build the plaza as a dense multi-zone event map with exactly 24 clearly labeled signs or booths distributed across the scene: "Keep Coding Keep Growing", "YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA", "Remote Work Zone", "ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE", "STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE", "DESIGN THINKING", "HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS", "Café con código", "AREPAS CON TODO", "Hechas con código y ♥", "Inspiración", "Networking", "Aprendizaje", "Café", "Baños", "SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA", "AI LAB", "DATA PEOPLE", "DEVS QUE IMPACTAN", "MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY", "PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS", "FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO", "FOUNDER MODE", and "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE". In the center of the plaza, place a circular fountain with a large green geometric logo sculpture as the visual anchor. Surround it with tables, laptops, whiteboards, crowds, planters, and benches. Include a colorful hillside neighborhood in the background with mountains, palm trees, power lines, and exactly 2 red cable cars crossing the sky; also add exactly 1 small drone flying overhead. On the upper right building, place a large brand sign reading {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} and a green billboard that says "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER". Populate the lower and middle foreground with many micro-scenes: a podcast booth labeled "PODCAST ON AIR", a neon "LIVE STREAM" corner, a startup workspace with people using laptops, a hackathon judging table, a founder pitch area, a fintech board with charts, and a coffee stand with espresso equipment and menu boards. Add 6 animal or mascot details across the scene: 1 orange cat lounging near the left worktables, 1 capybara at the lower left, 1 multicolor llama piñata in the lower center-left, 1 yellow rubber duck near the center-bottom, 1 small green robot near the bottom center-right, and 1 tiny turtle near the bottom beside a coin. Also place exactly 4 vehicle elements: 2 green scooters at the lower left, 1 decorated taco truck at the lower right with the sign "TACOS AL PASTOR", and 1 wheelchair user moving through the crowd. Include extra props that reinforce tech culture: whiteboards with sticky notes, a board titled "Traction" with an upward graph and bullet points "Users", "Revenue", "Retention", "Love", a board titled "CAP TABLE" with percentage rows, a Bitcoin-style coin on the ground, microphones, cameras, cables, monitors, smartphones, and branded green merchandise. Clothing should be modern casual startup attire with hoodies, jackets, backpacks, jeans, sneakers, and conference badges, featuring a diverse mix of ages and Latin American identities. Use rich greens, teals, oranges, purples, and warm neutrals, with lush plants and vines integrated into architecture. items.description: A satirical AAA-style fantasy raid encounter image depicting Tim Cook as a giant MMO boss with a full World of Warcraft-inspired interface, useful for parody game key art and meme concept generation.
items.content: Create a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading-screen-style illustration with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk in front of the glass cube Apple Store, with the glowing white Apple logo centered on the building facade. In the middle of the plaza stands a giant raid boss version of {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, labeled as "The Architect," wearing a fitted black turtleneck, dark pants, and sneakers, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and posing calmly with the other hand open. His face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-production, like a World of Warcraft raid encounter screen mixed with corporate tech parody. Around him, exactly 20 fantasy raiders in a semicircle battle formation face inward toward the boss, with varied races and silhouettes including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and orc-like and human-like characters. Several are casting bright spells in orange fire, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Include exactly 3 small robotic adds near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with squat industrial bodies and Apple logos on their fronts. Also include 2 active encounter mechanic bubbles: one blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" on the right side of the boss, and one purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" farther right with a humanoid enemy trapped inside. Build the image as a complete raid UI composition. Top left: a large expansion-style title reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP" with subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: a vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing exactly 20 player names in numbered rows from 1 to 20 with colored health bars. Top center: a boss portrait frame with the boss name {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, subtitle "The Architect," and a red health bar at 100%. Top right: a large encounter guide panel titled "ENCOUNTER: {argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"THE ARCHITECT\"" containing exactly 3 phases. Phase 1 title: "SUPPLY CHAIN DOMINANCE (100% – 70%)" with 3 abilities: "Logistics Surge – Summons waves of Supplier Adds.", "Margin Shield – Reduces incoming damage by 40% for 10 sec.", and "Quarterly Pressure – Stacking debuff, explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2 title: "ECOSYSTEM LOCK-IN (70% – 30%)" with 3 abilities: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, puzzle to return.", "Subscription Drain – Raid-wide damage over time.", and "Device Sync – Stack in correct formations to avoid spikes." Phase 3 title: "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)" with 3 abilities: "Surprise Launch – Massive AoE burst every 20 sec.", "Reality Distortion Field – Reverses controls briefly.", and "Enrage: Market Collapse – Boss enrages at 3:00." items.description: Generates a vertical utopian sci-fi city street scene with pedestrians, glass towers, a flying vehicle, and a heavy layer of multicolored image-noise artifacts for demonstrating visual quality issues.
items.content: A bright daytime futuristic city street viewed from pedestrian level, looking upward through a canyon of tall sleek skyscrapers with blue-tinted glass facades, rounded balconies, layered terraces, and elegant sci-fi architecture. The scene shows a bustling urban promenade with about 12 visible pedestrians in the foreground and midground, casually dressed and walking away from the viewer, including one central figure in a gray jacket. At the upper left, include 1 small hovering flying vehicle or drone-like air taxi. The buildings are highly reflective and polished, with integrated greenery: trees along the walkway and planted terrace edges. The sky is clear blue with soft sunlight, giving the image a clean optimistic utopian mood. Across the entire image, add a conspicuous artifact layer of dense multicolored sparkling dots and specks, like a noisy pixel grid or glittering digital contamination scattered uniformly over the architecture, people, sky, and street. Use a painterly semi-realistic style with soft focus, luminous highlights, vertical composition, and cinematic depth.

items.title: Rainforest Clearing with Speckle Artifacts
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic tropical jungle clearing scene with dramatic sunlight and intentional grid-like speckle artifacts, suitable for illustrating image quality issues in AI-generated nature photography.
items.content: An ultra-detailed wide-angle rainforest clearing photographed from a very low ground-level perspective, with the camera almost at the edge of a shallow muddy puddle. Dense tropical jungle vegetation forms a circular wall around the clearing, with tangled vines, broad wet leaves, shrubs, and tree trunks heavily covered in greenery. The foreground is slick with brown water, leaf litter, and reflective puddles, including a fallen branch stretching diagonally across the lower right area and a rounded mossy rock on the lower left. The center opens into a patch of low green plants, while the background rises into thick jungle canopy. Bright midday sunlight breaks through the treetops in the upper right, creating strong rays, haze, glowing highlights, and high contrast against a partly cloudy blue-and-white sky visible through the canopy. Use a dramatic fisheye or ultra-wide lens effect with subtle barrel distortion, immersive environmental scale, rich saturated greens, wet textures, realistic natural lighting, crisp foliage detail, and a photorealistic documentary nature-photography look. Include a faint, unnatural grid-like speckle noise artifact pattern across the image, especially visible in darker foliage and muddy ground, as if from an image-generation quality bug.

In the left foreground, a stylish woman with dark curly hair sits in three-quarter view, her face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, holding a lit cigarette near her lips. She wears a sheer black lace high-neck dress with intricate floral embroidery, dangling earrings, and a glamorous noir aesthetic. The ground around her is wet, icy, and littered with trash, with glossy black garbage bags piled on the right foreground and scattered debris across the frozen shoreline. The central subject is a waist-up portrait of {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} reimagined as an FC Barcelona icon, facing slightly to the right, with long wavy silver-gray hair, a long flowing beard, aged features, and a calm legendary presence. Dress him in a classic FC Barcelona home jersey with deep red and navy vertical stripes, visible Nike swoosh on the left side, and the FCB crest on the chest. Use moody rim lighting and painterly highlights around the hair and shoulders so the figure feels monumental and almost divine. Set the background as an abstract brush-texture composition in Barcelona colors, dark indigo, crimson, burgundy, and muted gold, with 3 major graphic elements behind the portrait: a large faded FC Barcelona crest near the top center, a vertical block of handwritten Bengali manuscript text on the left side, and a large gold handwritten signature-style script running vertically on the right. At the top left, place 5 lines of elegant serif text: the first line reads "RABINDRANATH", the second much larger line reads "TAGORE", the third line reads "1861-1941", the fourth line is the quote "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high...", and the fifth line is a cursive signature reading "Rabindranath Tagore". In the middle-lower area, add 5 centered text lines in a refined poster layout: "MORE THAN A POET.", then a large gold handwritten line reading "A timeless spirit.", then "A {argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} FOREVER.", then a thin horizontal red-and-blue accent line, and then a small centered FCB crest beneath it. At the bottom, show a wide view of Camp Nou at dusk with glowing stadium lights and a dramatic sunset horizon, packed stands, and a giant crowd mosaic reading exactly {argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}. In the foreground place 1 football centered on the wet reflective pitch with the Barcelona crest visible on the ball. The entire image should feel like a luxury fan-made heritage poster, ultra-detailed, painterly, emotional, reverential, high contrast, textured, epic, and suitable for a premium social media football graphic or wall poster. Use a tall 2:3 poster composition with layered depth, subtle sparks, paint streaks, and gold accents. Optionally replace the visible club identity with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} while preserving the same elite tribute-poster aesthetic.

items.title: Summer Coffee Ice Cream Collab Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a bright Chinese-style co-branded beverage advertisement poster for retail promotions, social media campaigns, or menu launch visuals.
items.content: A bright, cheerful summer co-branded beverage poster in a clean Chinese commercial advertising style, showing a collaboration between {argument name="brand one" default="蜜雪冰城"} and {argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"}. Vertical poster layout with a soft blue sky background, sunlit greenery, and an outdoor cafe atmosphere. At the top, place both brand logos side by side with a large bold Chinese headline in playful hand-drawn display lettering: {argument name="headline text" default="雪王遇见星朋友"}. Beneath it, add a green ribbon banner with Chinese subheadline text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="米雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}, and a smaller line reading "甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍". Include 2 circular stamp-style graphics: one on the left reading "联名限定", and one on the upper right like a postmark with Chinese text around a small drink icon. In the center foreground on a wooden outdoor table, display 2 iced drinks: on the left, a tall clear cup of vivid green matcha slush topped with a tall swirl of vanilla soft serve and green matcha drizzle, with visible ice texture and a cute snowman mascot logo on the cup; on the right, a tall clear Starbucks-style iced latte with milk and green matcha swirls at the bottom, topped with whipped cream and dark cookie crumbs, with the green siren logo on the cup. In front of the drinks, place 1 cute white snowman mascot figurine with a tiny crown, round body, rosy cheeks, red cape, and a happy wink, sitting and holding a small takeaway coffee cup. Add 2 vertical product name tags beside the drinks: left tag "雪顶抹茶星冰乐", right tag "抹茶雪王奥利奥". On the right midground, place 1 small black chalkboard sign on a wooden easel reading "ICE CREAM & COFFEE" with chalk drawings of an ice cream cone and a takeaway cup. In the lower left, create a torn-paper price block showing a combo offer with large red numbers "¥19.9", green supporting text, and a small green badge reading "立省 ¥6". In the lower center-right, add a "联名周边" area displaying exactly 4 merchandise items: 1 cup sleeve, 1 character keychain or acrylic charm, 1 round badge, and 1 small sticker or token, all using the snowman mascot and coffee collaboration theme. Use warm sunlight, glossy drink photography, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh trees, high contrast product retouching, crisp packaging details, and an upbeat youthful retail-promo aesthetic. Include scattered doodle hearts and playful decorative accents around the typography. Keep all visible text in Chinese except the Starbucks wordmark and the chalkboard text.

items.title: UFC-Style Women's Fight Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished MMA pay-per-view poster featuring two female fighters in a dramatic head-to-head event promotion layout.
items.content: A dramatic UFC fight-poster style sports promotion for {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"}, designed as a high-contrast vertical matchup graphic with two female MMA fighters facing inward in orthodox guard poses. The left fighter is a fit blonde woman with shoulder-length messy beach-wave hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly right. The right fighter is a fit dark-haired woman with long straight black hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly left, with a large detailed black-and-gray tattoo sleeve on her right arm and script tattoo text on the inner upper arm. Both fighters are sweaty, intensely lit, and centered close together with fists raised near chest height. Use a split background: fiery orange sparks and smoke on the left, icy blue-white sparks and haze on the right, with a dark black center seam. At the top center, place a black rectangular logo box with gold trim containing the gold text {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}. Beneath it, in stacked condensed white uppercase type, add the tagline: "TWO ICONS. ONE OCTAGON." Along the far left edge, place the surname "SWEENEY" vertically in large distressed gold letters; along the far right edge, place the surname "FOXX" vertically in large distressed silver-gray letters. In the center, overlay huge distressed white condensed sans-serif typography with the matchup names stacked exactly as {argument name="left fighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} above a small gold "VS" and {argument name="right fighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"}. Below that, add a small gold subtitle reading "BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT". At the bottom center, show a small realistic UFC octagon cage seen from a slightly elevated front angle, embedded into the poster. In front of the cage, place a black date card with gold trim containing stacked gold text: "JUNE 14", "SATURDAY", "10PM ET / 7PM PT". Below the card, add white text "LIVE ON" and the ESPN+ logo. Bottom left, add small gold and white ticket text reading "TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25" with the Ticketmaster logo beneath. Bottom right, add the Rogers Arena logo and white text "ROGERS ARENA" with gold text "VANCOUVER, BC" below. Use a glossy premium combat-sports poster finish, cinematic rim lighting, gritty texture overlays, metallic typography, and intense face-off composition.

items.title: Flash Mirror Selfie in Retro Bathroom
items.description: A realistic fashion-lifestyle mirror selfie prompt for generating candid disposable-camera style portraits in a small vintage bathroom.
items.content: A candid flash mirror selfie in a small retro bathroom, shot vertically with a realistic early-2000s disposable-camera aesthetic. A young woman with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur stands in front of a slightly dirty mirror, holding a smartphone with a bright direct flash that creates a strong starburst flare at the center-right of the image. She has dark brown hair with lighter blonde highlights, styled in a messy claw-clip updo with loose strands around the face, and wears small hoop earrings plus 2 layered silver necklaces. Her outfit is a fitted white baby tee with faded pink collegiate-style text reading "NANTUCKET" in reverse from the mirror, and loose heather gray sweatpants with white socks; one knee is raised casually on the sink counter, giving the pose a relaxed, intimate snapshot feel. The phone case is covered with cute stickers and a round grip featuring a pink cartoon bear or bunny motif. The bathroom has pale pink wall tiles on the lower half, off-white upper walls, a sink counter cluttered with 7 visible toiletry and beauty items total: 4 bottles on the left side of the sink, 1 black hairbrush on the sink edge, and 2 perfume or cosmetic bottles along the bottom ledge of the mirror. A beige towel hangs in the background, and the mirror frame is metal with visible smudges and dust specks catching the flash. Include the subject’s shadow cast dramatically on the left wall and mirror, soft ambient greenish indoor light mixed with harsh flash, subtle film grain, natural skin texture, slight lens distortion, and an authentic unpolished lifestyle-photo mood.

items.title: Anime Heroine Promo Poster
items.description: A high-end Japanese-style anime key visual poster featuring a silver-haired swordswoman, fantasy sci-fi city backdrop, and full promotional text layout for a game, anime, or light novel campaign.
items.content:
A polished anime-style vertical key visual poster for a futuristic fantasy action series. Center the composition on a full-body young heroine in a confident three-quarter back pose, looking over her shoulder, with her face partially obscured by angle and hair. She has long flowing silver-white hair blowing dramatically in the wind, pale skin, and cool violet accents. Her outfit is a sleek black, white, and purple combat uniform: black cropped jacket with white hood and cape-like layered back panels, fitted bodice, short pleated skirt, utility belt and straps, black gloves, thigh strap on one leg, and subtle star-emblem details. In her right hand she holds a large angular sci-fi sword with glowing purple energy lines. The background is a bright blue daytime sky with soft clouds, several white birds, and an elegant white city of tall cathedral-like spires and bridges, creating a grand utopian futuristic kingdom atmosphere. Use strong wind effects in the hair, ribbons, coat tails, and fabric. Add smooth linework and smooth coloring, clean anime rendering, high-detail cel shading, crisp lighting, glossy highlights, and a premium game-promo illustration finish.

Design it as a complete Japanese promotional poster layout. On the upper left, place a large bold vertical headline in Japanese reading "未来を、自分の手で。" with the middle phrase in purple and the rest in black, over a pale decorative emblem. Beneath it, add a short Japanese blurb in smaller text. On the right side, place a tall dark vertical sidebar with white Japanese text reading "信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。". On the lower left, include 3 tilted rectangular inset images stacked diagonally: 1 close-up portrait of the heroine's face, 1 action shot of her fighting with the glowing sword, and 1 wide cityscape view. Below those in a dark character info panel, show the character name "ルシア" with the romanized name "Lucia" and a small emblem, followed by 7 profile lines in Japanese: "CV：悠木 碧", "年齢：17歳", "所属：黎明騎士団（不屈の翼）", "武器：双刃剣（レプリカント）", "誕生日：4月12日", "身長：165cm", "好きなもの：静かな場所、星空", and a final dislike line. At the bottom center, place the large series logo text "黎明のリベリオン" with the English subtitle "REIMEI NO REBELLION" beneath it, and below that the release line "2025年、始動。". Color palette: white, black, deep indigo, electric violet, and sky blue. Overall mood: heroic, elegant, aspirational, premium anime game or light novel promotional poster.

items.title: Pastel Anime Fantasy Poster with Heroine
items.description: This prompt generates a polished vertical Japanese anime fantasy promotional poster with one magical heroine, integrated title typography, character callouts, and inset expression portraits for game, novel, or anime key art.
items.content: A vertical Japanese anime fantasy game or light-novel promotional poster in a soft pastel lavender, white, and gold palette, featuring a single heroic teenage girl as the main subject in a grand celestial city. She stands in a dynamic three-quarter full-body pose, slightly turned left, holding an ornate staff in her left hand, with her right arm extended behind her as if caught in wind. Her face is obscured by a flat pale square censor block centered over the head, but the visible design suggests a delicate anime heroine with very long flowing silver-lilac hair, side bangs, loose strands, and star-shaped hair ornaments with dark indigo ribbon bows. She wears an elaborate magical-girl style dress: off-shoulder white bodice with navy and violet trim, gold star motifs, layered asymmetrical skirt in white, periwinkle, violet, and deep indigo, a very large dark blue waist bow with a gold star jewel, detached flowing sleeves, gold chains with tiny star charms draped at the hip, white thigh-high stockings, and a blue star-shaped garter ornament on one thigh. Her staff is tall and elegant, dark shaft with gold frame elements and a suspended faceted blue crystal near the top, decorated with bows and star accents. The background is an airy fantasy skyline of white towers, cathedral-like spires, clouds, feathers, and drifting pink petals, with bright ethereal backlighting and a dreamy heroic atmosphere. Compose it like a polished key visual poster with abundant Japanese typography integrated into the artwork. At the upper left, place the Japanese tagline text "願いが、未来を照らす。" with two smaller lines below it. At the upper right, place a star-like emblem, the large character name "ルミナ", the subtitle "— Lumina —", and a smaller CV credit line. On the right side, add 3 vertically stacked feature callouts, each with a small icon and a bold Japanese heading followed by 2 short lines of smaller text. On the left side, add 1 vertical Japanese copy block running downward beside the character. At the lower right, include 3 small portrait inset panels of the same girl, stacked diagonally: 1 calm front-facing expression, 1 side-profile serious expression, and 1 smiling eyes-closed expression. At the lower left, place the large Japanese title "星紡ぐレガシア" with the English subtitle "— LEGACIA: Weave the Stars —" beneath it. At the bottom right, add the date text "2025. 夏" and one short Japanese tagline line below. At the very bottom edge, include 2 small social or website info blocks on the left and a tiny copyright line on the right. Render in high-end modern anime promotional illustration style, luminous pastel fantasy atmosphere, elegant composition, smooth linework and coloring, soft cel shading, delicate fabric movement, glossy highlights, intricate costume details, clean typography layout, and refined commercial poster finish.

items.title: Modern Luxury Mansion Exterior
items.description: This prompt generates a polished photorealistic front-view image of an upscale contemporary mansion, ideal for luxury real estate, architectural visualization, or dream-home concept art.
items.content: A photorealistic architectural exterior rendering of a large modern luxury family house viewed straight on from the front gate, perfectly centered and symmetrical. The house is a two-story contemporary mansion with smooth off-white stone or stucco walls, dark charcoal roof trim, large black-framed windows, and a grand recessed entrance with tall dark double doors under a flat canopy. On the left side, an open garage clearly reveals 1 white luxury SUV parked inside. On the right side, a floor-to-ceiling glass living room window shows 1 black grand piano inside, with elegant interior lighting faintly visible. In the foreground, 2 tall gray stone gate pillars frame the entrance, each topped with 1 classic black lantern for a total of 2 lanterns, and the right pillar has a gold nameplate engraved with Japanese text {argument name="nameplate text" default="藤 咲"}. A wide light-gray tiled walkway leads from the gate to the front door, bordered by neatly manicured green lawn and abundant white rose flowerbeds on both sides. Add trimmed shrubs, slender cypress-like trees near the doorway, low hedges, and rooftop terrace greenery. Surround the property with lush leafy trees at the edges of the frame. Use bright midday summer sunlight, crisp shadows, a vivid deep blue sky with a few small white clouds, ultra-clean materials, high-end residential design, realistic reflections in the glass, and a polished aspirational real-estate advertisement look.

items.title: Japanese Character Relationship Chart Poster
items.description: This prompt turns a cast lineup reference into a polished Japanese novel-style character introduction and relationship map poster for story promotion or reader guides.
items.content: Using REFERENCE_0 as the cast reference, transform the simple lineup into an ornate Japanese light-novel character relationship chart poster. Keep the same 10 named characters and reuse their existing portrait art as the base visuals, but redesign the layout into a polished infographic on a soft cream and pale-blue fantasy background with decorative borders, sparkles, roses, and a small European-style hotel building vignette in the upper left. Add a large Japanese title at the top, 「支配人はかりそめの顔」, with the subtitle 「キャラクター紹介＆相関図」, and place a dark badge in the upper right that says 「ネタバレ配慮版」. Put the heroine 一条 紬希 in the center as the main focus in a framed character card labeled 「主人公」, and place 秦野 啓司 in a large framed card on the right as the key counterpart. Arrange the remaining 8 characters around them in individual profile cards: 加賀坂 その葉, 川原 澪, 樫村, 紬希の母, ハルカ, 杏子, 美果, 桜子. Connect the characters with multiple colored arrows and relationship labels to visualize the network; include exactly 14 visible relationship labels: 「親友」, 「理解者」, 「本音を見抜く」, 「憧れ」, 「相談」, 「画策」, 「仲直り中」, 「直感的理解」, 「メンター」, 「実務支援」, 「保護者的存在」, 「後輩　ムードメーカー」, 「後輩　グループを支える」, 「後輩　明るさ・希望」. Also add the 8 central horizontal relationship callouts between 一条 紬希 and 秦野 啓司: 「偽溶み→公認」, 「ライバル」, 「秘密を共有」, 「対等な相棒」, 「気になる存在」, plus a pink central badge reading 「反発から信頼へ」, and 3 lower callouts: 「信頼」, 「協力を後押し」, 「二人の空気に気づく」. Include a gold-ribbon group label above the three lower girls that says 「ASTRALの仲間たち」. Add a bottom section with exactly 10 smaller summary cards, one for each character again, lined up across the width. On the far right, add 2 boxed sidebar sections titled 「作品のキーワード」 and 「関係の見どころ」; the first should contain 4 bullet items with icons, and the second should contain 4 bullet items with icons. Fill every card with dense Japanese profile text and role tags in a clean editorial style, as if for a promotional relationship guide included with a novel. Make the overall design elegant, readable, romantic-mystery themed, and magazine-quality.

items.title: Blue Neon Denial ASMR Anime Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a close-up anime VTuber-style ASMR illustration with a whispering girl, binaural microphones, and a glowing denial-themed holographic text panel.
items.content: A polished anime-style close-up illustration of a young virtual streamer girl leaning toward the viewer in a dim blue neon studio, themed around harshly dismissive ASMR. She has short fluffy white hair with faint icy blue highlights, soft layered bangs partly covering one eye, bright blue half-lidded eyes, pale skin, and a slightly smug, cold, teasing expression with a small open mouth as if whispering criticism directly into the listener’s ear. One hand is raised beside her mouth in a whispering pose. She wears large futuristic over-ear headphones with glowing cyan rings and a small liquid-droplet motif on top, a white short-sleeved dress uniform with navy trim, gold buttons, a large dark blue ribbon at the collar, and a large blue bow at the back, plus a visible side tag reading “shizuku.” Add 2 blurred black binaural ASMR microphones in the foreground at the lower left, creating strong depth of field. Place 1 glowing holographic vertical panel on the left side with Japanese text and waveform graphics, including the headline {argument name="headline text" default="全否定 ASMR"} and small branding text {argument name="brand name" default="SHIZUKU"}. Include 4 short Japanese negative whisper lines beneath the headline, styled like a translucent cyan UI display. The room behind her is dark, atmospheric, and softly blurred with cool blue shelves and scattered glowing droplets or bokeh lights. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, cool monochrome blue and white tones, glossy highlights, delicate blush, highly detailed eyes and hair strands, soft bloom, crisp cel-shaded anime rendering, intimate composition, slight Dutch angle, and a feeling that the character is invading the listener’s personal space for an ASMR recording. The character should read as {argument name="character name" default="Shizuku"}, with {argument name="hair color" default="white with light blue highlights"} and {argument name="eye color" default="icy blue"}.

items.title: Sunlit Desk with White Cat and Laptop
items.description: This prompt generates a cozy realistic lifestyle photo of a white cat on a sunlit desk beside a laptop, coffee, notebook, and houseplant, ideal for home office or calm productivity visuals.
items.content: A cozy sunlit home office scene photographed in a realistic lifestyle style. A white short-haired cat with pale green eyes sits upright on a warm wooden desk near the center-left, facing the camera with a calm attentive expression, its tail curled around its front paws. To the left of the cat is 1 leafy potted houseplant in a textured beige pot and 1 ceramic mug filled with dark coffee. In front of the cat lies 1 open spiral notebook with handwritten notes and 1 silver pen resting diagonally across the pages. On the right side of the desk is 1 open laptop angled slightly toward the viewer, showing a vivid wallpaper of a turquoise lake and dramatic snow-capped mountain peaks under a blue sky. Behind the desk is a large window with soft cream curtains, bright golden morning sunlight streaming in from the right and casting natural shadows across the desk. Include 2 framed wall pictures partially visible on the left wall. The atmosphere should feel peaceful, productive, and warmly domestic, with soft cinematic lighting, crisp details, shallow depth of field, and high-end editorial photography realism.

items.title: Warm Penguin Fantasy Movie Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a sentimental Japanese-style fictional movie poster featuring a plush penguin mascot held up at sunset, ideal for parody film key art and viral social media visuals.
items.content: A heartwarming fictional movie poster in a soft cinematic Japanese drama style, photographed at golden hour with dreamy backlight and gentle lens glow. A person seen from behind and slightly below, wearing a cozy cream knit sweater, lifts a plush penguin toy high toward a bright sunset sky. The plush is centered and fills much of the frame: black fuzzy body, white belly, small yellow beak, yellow feet, outstretched stubby wings, and a humanlike anime-girl face framed by short dark brown bobbed hair with hairpins, creating a cute surreal mascot character. The background is an outdoor field with warm bokeh trees and a glowing sun low on the horizon, all in creamy beige, honey, peach, and gold tones. Several white feathers float through the air; show exactly 5 visible feathers scattered around the composition. Make the mood tender, nostalgic, hopeful, and slightly fantastical, like a family fantasy film poster. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: at the top center, the tagline "この出会いが、世界をやさしく変えていく。"; along the left side vertically, "ずっと、いっしょだよ。"; near the bottom center, a large handwritten glowing title "{argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}" in warm white neon-like script with a small pink heart above it; directly below in elegant serif capitals, "{argument name="subtitle" default="THE MOVIE"}". Beneath that, place a pink ribbon banner with the Japanese line "ずっと、いっしょだよ。". At the very bottom, add small centered Japanese credit text in a realistic film-poster layout, including cast and staff lines and production/distribution credits; include "gugugagaTokyo" and "AI Studio Tokyo" on the final line. Use a vertical one-sheet poster composition, polished commercial key art, shallow depth of field, soft filmic contrast, premium cinematic lighting, sentimental fantasy-drama aesthetic.

items.title: Japanese Auto Laundry Folder Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese-style product advertisement poster for a compact automatic clothes-folding appliance, suitable for mock marketing visuals and concept campaigns.
items.content: Create a clean Japanese lifestyle advertisement poster for a futuristic compact home appliance that automatically folds laundry. Use a bright, airy, minimalist Scandinavian-style living room in the background with soft daylight, white walls, a light wood table, a sofa, and green plants near a window, all softly blurred to keep focus on the product. The main product is a sleek white rectangular machine with rounded corners on a tabletop, shown in a 3/4 front view, with its front door tray folded down and a neatly folded white T-shirt sliding outward from the machine. Add a faint digital display on the top front panel showing “04” and subtle modern control icons. Place a small stack of exactly 4 folded garments in the foreground at lower left: 3 white shirts and 1 pale blue shirt at the bottom. Use a premium consumer-electronics ad style, photorealistic product rendering, soft shadows, high-key lighting, gentle blue-gray accents, and a clean composition with lots of white space. At the top left, add very large blue Japanese headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="置くだけ、4秒。"}. Beneath it, add a smaller dark gray Japanese subheadline reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="毎日の“たたむ”をゼロに。"}. On the left side below the subheadline, place 3 rounded rectangular feature badges stacked vertically, each with a blue outline icon and Japanese text: 1) a T-shirt icon with "Tシャツ・タオル対応", 2) a cube icon with "コンパクト設計", 3) a family icon with "家族みんなで使える". Along the bottom center, add exactly 4 minimalist blue line icons with labels separated evenly: 1) stopwatch icon with "最短４秒", 2) T-shirt outline icon with "サイズぴったり", 3) folded towel icon with "省スペース", 4) hand snap icon with "誰でも簡単". At the bottom left, add the product branding in a modern sans-serif layout: {argument name="product name" default="Foldy Home 20"} with smaller Japanese text below reading {argument name="product category" default="全自動服たたみ機"}. At the bottom right, display a large blue price reading {argument name="price" default="￥19,800"} with smaller gray text "（税込）". Include a subtle "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner. Vertical poster format, crisp commercial layout, realistic Japanese home-appliance catalog aesthetic.

Use cinematic lighting with warm amber-brown tones across the desert and cool neon blues in the planets, soft mist, high contrast, ultra-clean digital rendering, sharp terrain detail, and a calm, otherworldly mood.

items.content: A traditional Chinese ink calligraphy artwork on aged beige xuan paper, presented as a clean flat scan or photograph of a single hanging scroll page with no frame. The composition is entirely vertical Chinese cursive script, bold expressive grass-script brushwork in deep black ink with dynamic stroke variation, flying-white texture, dry-brush breaks, and elegant rhythm. Write the full poem {argument name="poem text" default="怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切。\n靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头，收拾旧山河，朝天阙。"} in large vertical columns arranged right to left, about 8 main poem columns across the page, each column flowing freely with slight variations in spacing and tilt. Leave a wide left margin containing a smaller vertical inscription with 3 narrow columns: the title and attribution reading {argument name="inscription text" default="岳飞 满江红 甲辰書月 某元"}, written in a more restrained but still cursive hand. Add exactly 3 small red seal stamps: 2 stacked square seals in the lower-left margin beneath the inscription, and 1 small oval seal near the upper-right edge beside the first main column. The paper should have subtle warm tan mottling, soft fibers, faint age marks, and natural uneven tone. Overall mood is heroic, scholarly, and museum-quality, with authentic Song-inspired Chinese calligraphy aesthetics, minimal background, high detail, and faithful brush texture.

items.title: Japanese Eel Derby Logo
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese mascot logo with eel-integrated lettering, water effects, and racing-inspired accents for branding or social media visuals.
items.content: Create a bold Japanese logo on a clean light gray background for a fictional racing-themed eel character brand. The main text should be large stylized katakana/kanji reading {argument name="main logo text" default="ウナ娘"}, with a smaller subtitle banner below reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="ヌルヌルダービー"}. Integrate exactly 2 eel illustrations into the lettering: one dark navy eel curling over the top left of the first character with a cute smiling face and pale belly markings, and one second eel forming a sweeping curl around the right side of the final character. Use a vivid aquatic palette with deep cobalt blue, electric blue, cyan, teal, white highlights, and metallic gold edging. The lettering should have thick white inner borders, gold outer trim, subtle drop shadows, and a glossy high-energy arcade mascot style. Add dynamic water splash effects around the bottom left and lower right, flowing wave ribbons beneath the text, exactly 6 gold star-shaped sparkles scattered around the logo, and exactly 4 small blue diamond-like sparkle accents near the center and top. Behind the subtitle, include a blue-and-white checkered racing flag pattern stretching horizontally. The overall composition should feel playful, premium, and fast-paced, combining marine motifs with horse-racing or derby energy, rendered as crisp vector-like logo art with polished gradients and strong sticker-style outlines.

items.title: Minimal SaaS Poster with Pink Mascot
items.description: This prompt generates a modern startup brand poster with editorial typography, a cute blob mascot, and high-contrast black-and-pink design for landing pages or campaign mockups.
items.content: A bold minimalist brand poster on a matte black background with a soft grainy print texture, designed like a startup landing-page hero graphic. In the top left, place a simple cream-colored logo icon followed by the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Biscuit"} in a refined serif wordmark. Below it, create a large left-aligned typographic block occupying roughly the left half of the composition. The main headline reads: {argument name="headline text" default="Built for solopreneurs."} in oversized elegant cream serif type with strong contrast and generous line spacing. Directly beneath it, add a second headline line in vivid hot pink italic serif reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Backed by simplicity."}. Below that, add a smaller white sans-serif body copy block, left aligned, reading {argument name="body text" default="Everything you need to launch, run, and grow—all in one place."}. Near the bottom left, place the URL {argument name="website text" default="biscuit.so"} in bold hot pink sans-serif. On the right half, feature a cute abstract mascot: a rounded irregular cloud-like pink blob character with scalloped edges, 2 large cream-and-black circular eyes, 1 small curved smiling mouth, and 2 tiny rounded hands resting on top of a large curved pink foreground shape that rises from the bottom edge like a hill or product surface. Add a dense field of hot pink spray-like speckles and particles in the upper-right quadrant fading toward the center, giving a playful cosmic ink-splatter effect. Use a limited palette of black, cream, white, and saturated pink; high contrast editorial typography; lots of negative space; a clean, modern, approachable, founder-friendly SaaS branding aesthetic; centered-right character placement; portrait poster composition.

items.title: Vintage Newspaper Front Page Generator
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating realistic vintage newspaper designs with customizable headlines and cinematic black-and-white photography.
items.content: Create the most realistic front page design of a vintage newspaper featuring the main character. The layout should be made in the style of a real printed newspaper with a cinematic black-and-white aesthetic. The main photo should be prominently placed in the center, framed, like the image in the title of the article. The subject in the photo should remain unchanged and clearly distinguishable in natural light and slightly increased contrast in order to match the spectacular editorial style. Create a bold, attention-grabbing headline at the top (create a unique title that matches the spirit of the photo - it can be romantic, mysterious, funny, or dramatic). Add a smaller subtitle under it, which will look like a real newspaper caption. Add realistic newspaper elements: Columns of small text (in the style of lorem ipsum, but framed like real news) At the top is the fictitious name of the publication (for example, “The Daily Prompts”, “AI Times” or similar - think creatively, according to the picture) Date, issue number and location Decorative lines, dividers, and vintage typography Small additional articles or captions to the main image Optional stamps, doodles, or editorial notes to add personality. Style: Black and white or slightly faded monochrome paper Fine paper texture, grain, and ink defects Small shadows and creases that mimic real printed paper The aesthetics of a clean but slightly worn vintage newspaper Mood: Give the design personality, expressiveness and plot, as if the plot is part of the main article. Aspect ratio: 4:5 or 1:1 High-detail, ultra-realistic hybrid of editorial photography and print design.

items.title: Commercial Ad Storyboard Layout
items.description: A highly structured prompt for generating a six-panel commercial storyboard layout with consistent characters and a narrative progression.
items.content:
Create a cinematic commercial storyboard sheet.

LAYOUT:
- Fixed 6-panel grid (2x3), evenly spaced
- Clean white or neutral background
- Each panel clearly separated, no UI, no clutter

GLOBAL STYLE:
- Cinematic realism, high-end commercial look
- Soft controlled lighting, consistent across all panels
- No character or environment drift

STORY ARC (strict order):
1. Setup
2. Tension
3. Product reveal
4. Product interaction
5. Transformation (impact)
6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

PANEL REQUIREMENTS (for EACH panel include):
- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)
- Camera (shot type, angle, movement)

PRODUCT RULES:
- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

VISUAL PRIORITIES:
- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

TEXT:
- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)
- No extra graphics

items.title: Minimalist Film Noir Poster
items.description: A high-contrast graphic design prompt for a poster featuring a man in a fedora with a melting ink effect against a vibrant red circle backdrop.
items.content:
Subject & Composition:

Central Figure: A {argument name="subject profile" default="sharp profile view of a man wearing a classic 1940s fedora and a formal suit"}.

Melting Effect: The lower half of the man's torso should dissolve or "drip" into long, vertical black ink streaks and splatters, creating a surreal, liquid-bleed effect against the background.

Graphic Element: A large, {argument name="background shape" default="solid vibrant red circle"} is positioned directly behind the man's head and shoulders, creating a "halo" or "rising sun" motif that anchors the composition.

Style & Color Palette:

Color Scheme: A strict {argument name="color scheme" default="minimalist palette of True Red, Deep Black, and Off-White/Cream"}.

Photography Style: High-contrast, black and white film noir photography for the subject. The texture should look like a high-resolution fashion editorial with a shallow depth of field.

Background: A clean, slightly textured off-white paper or canvas background to give it a premium, physical poster feel.

Technical Details:

Lighting: Strong "Rembrandt" lighting to define the facial contours, emphasizing the bridge of the nose and the jawline with deep shadows.

Atmosphere: Somber, intellectual, and high-stakes. The design should feel modern yet period-accurate to the mid-20th century.

Framing: Vertical poster orientation (A-frame), with significant negative space on the left and right to emphasize the central vertical axis.

Aspect ratio is 9:16
