items.title: Luxury Skincare Brand Key Visual (KV)
items.description: An extremely detailed professional prompt for a high-end luxury skincare advertisement, combining Eastern aesthetics with high-tech vibes.
items.content:
极简东方高级广告风格，高端护肤品牌KV海报，品牌名“BRAND”，整体气质纯净、克制、科技感与东方美学融合

画面中心为一款高端精华产品，玻璃瓶身，通透渐变质感（上部透明→下部冷调青绿色），底部带液体光感，搭配香槟金金属瓶盖，产品放置于圆形高光底座之上，材质为抛光石材与金属结合，细节精致清晰，作为视觉绝对中心

产品周围环绕细腻金色能量光环与流动光带，形成轻微S型动线，象征修护与再生能量，光线从产品向外扩散，强化“功效视觉化”

一位东方女性位于画面后方偏右位置，半身回眸侧脸，气质冷静优雅，五官精致自然，冷白细腻肌肤呈现通透光泽（强调护肤效果），低饱和橘粉妆容，带微弱金色高光

黑色长发随风流动，发丝中融合金色光粒与微弱光带，整体干净克制不过度装饰，与产品光效形成呼应关系

身穿半透明丝绸服装与披肩，轻盈流动，材质通透，带细腻鎏金纹理与柔和反光，呈现高级质感

光影系统为干净暖金色主光源（侧后方），产品为主光聚焦点，人物为辅助受光，边缘光柔和，体积光轻微存在，空气中漂浮细小金色光粒，整体光线通透不过曝

背景为极简浅色渐变（米白+暖金过渡），大面积留白，画面干净无杂质，具备广告排版空间

画面下方加入冷调青绿色水面或矿物质质感元素（象征纯净科技与成分来源），增强品牌“纯净科技感”

色彩体系严格控制：主色为金色+米白，点缀冷调青绿色与香槟金，整体低饱和高级色调

构图为稳定中心构图+轻微S型动线，视觉聚焦明确，层级清晰（产品 > 光 > 人物）

整体风格：高端、纯净、修护再生、抗老科技感，国际大牌护肤广告质感（类似La Mer / SK-II级别）

超精细，8K质感，商业摄影级光影，真实材质表现

负面：产品变形，文字错误，过多装饰，画面拥挤，廉价金色，光影混乱，过曝，低清晰度
items.translatedContent: Minimalist Eastern luxury advertising style, high-end skincare brand KV poster, brand name "BRAND", overall vibe is pure, restrained, combining technology with Eastern aesthetics. The center of the screen is a high-end essence product, glass bottle, transparent gradient texture (transparent top → cold cyan-green bottom), with liquid light at the bottom, paired with a champagne gold metal cap. The product is placed on a circular high-light base made of polished stone and metal. Details are exquisite and clear, serving as the absolute visual center. The product is surrounded by delicate golden energy halos and flowing light ribbons, forming a slight S-shaped movement, symbolizing repair and regeneration energy, with light diffusing outwards to strengthen "efficacy visualization". An Eastern woman is positioned in the background slightly to the right, looking back with a side profile, calm and elegant temperament, delicate natural features, cold white skin with a transparent glow (emphasizing skincare effects), low-saturation orange-pink makeup with faint golden highlights. Black long hair flows with the wind, hair strands integrated with golden light particles and weak light ribbons, overall clean and restrained without over-decoration, echoing the product's light effect. Wearing translucent silk clothing and a shawl, light and flowing, the material is transparent with fine gold-gilded textures and soft reflections, presenting a high-end texture. The lighting system is a clean warm-gold main light source (side-rear), the product is the focus, the person is auxiliary light, edge light is soft, volume light exists slightly, fine golden light particles float in the air, overall light is clear and not overexposed. Background is a minimalist light gradient (off-white + warm gold transition), large areas of negative space, the screen is clean without impurities, providing space for advertising layout. Cold-tone cyan-green water or mineral texture elements are added below (symbolizing pure technology and component sources), enhancing the brand's "pure technology feel". Strictly controlled color system: main colors are gold + off-white, accented with cold cyan-green and champagne gold, overall low-saturation high-end tones. Composition is stable center composition + slight S-curve, clear visual focus and hierarchy (Product > Light > Character). Overall style: high-end, pure, repair and regeneration, anti-aging technology, international big-brand skincare advertising quality (similar to La Mer / SK-II level). Ultra-fine, 8K texture, commercial photography-grade lighting, realistic material expression. Negative: product deformation, text errors, too much decoration, crowded screen, cheap gold, chaotic lighting, overexposure, low resolution.

items.title: Japanese Realist Romance Movie Poster
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for a Japanese movie poster aesthetic, focusing on composition, natural lighting, and emotional distance inspired by classic romance films.
items.content: 日系现实主义爱情电影海报风格，灵感来自《花束般的恋爱》，一对二十岁左右的日本年轻情侣站在城市日常场景中（街头或路口），彼此之间保持微妙而真实的距离，没有肢体接触，像关系逐渐疏远的瞬间。情绪安静克制，带未说出口的情感与时间流逝感。构图为电影主视觉，人物位于画面下方或一侧，画面保留大面积留白，强调空间与空气感。光线为自然光（阴天或黄昏），低饱和灰蓝、米色与暖灰色调，真实摄影质感。画面带细腻胶片颗粒与轻微生活感，不刻意唯美，不过度修饰，像真实电影中的一帧。可在画面边缘或前景加入少量自然花材作为隐喻（克制、不过度、不装饰化）。在留白区域加入标题「花束みたいな恋をした」，细明朝体，排版简洁疏朗；下方小字号加入《花束般的恋爱》。整体要求：真实日本电影海报质感，文艺、克制、生活化，强调关系而不是浪漫符号，避免甜腻爱情表现，避免花朵堆砌，避免网红唯美，避免构图拥挤，避免“精致但空洞”的AI感。AI感，过度唯美，花海，浪漫滤镜，光效泛滥，高饱和，霓虹灯，情侣亲密拥抱，摆拍感，大头贴构图，网红风，插画感，3D渲染，元素堆砌。日系极简文艺电影海报风格，灵感来自《情书》，冬季雪地场景，一位年轻女子的脸部特写，面部贴近雪地或半埋在雪中，细小雪花自然落下。构图为克制的近距离侧脸或微偏角度面部，人物占画面较大比例但不过度清晰锐利，边缘轻微柔化或轻微失焦。表情为伤心之后的平静，眼中带泪或泪痕，情绪内敛、克制、像刚刚哭过又慢慢恢复安静，眼神不看镜头，带回忆与空白感。光线为冬日自然散射光或阴天柔光，冷白、浅灰、淡蓝色调，低饱和、低对比，无强阴影、无戏剧光效。雪地与空气形成干净背景。画面质感为真实摄影与胶片之间，带轻微颗粒、轻微雾感、略微泛白或轻微过曝，像一张被时间冲淡的旧照片或电影静帧。皮肤不过度细节，不磨皮、不锐化、不精修。构图不对称，可局部裁切面部，背景极简，保留适当留白。在留白区域加入极简标题「Love Letter」或「ラヴレター」，细明朝体或细衬线字体，字距拉开、排版疏朗，颜色为浅灰；下方极小字号加入《情书》。整体要求：真实日本文艺电影海报质感，安静、含蓄、克制，像一段被雪覆盖的记忆，避免写真感、避免网红审美、避免精致滤镜、避免光效、避免高对比高饱和、避免锐利数码感、避免情绪表演化、避免“好看但空洞”。AI感，磨皮，锐化，HDR，高对比，高饱和，梦幻光效，光斑，滤镜感，写真风，网红脸，摆拍，直视镜头，情绪夸张，3D渲染，插画风，复杂背景。
items.translatedContent: Japanese realistic romance movie poster style, inspired by 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet', a pair of young Japanese couple in their twenties standing in a daily urban scene (street or intersection), maintaining a subtle and realistic distance from each other, no physical contact, like a moment of gradual estrangement in a relationship. The mood is quiet and restrained, with unuttered emotions and a sense of time passing. The composition is the main visual of a movie, characters located at the bottom or to one side, retaining a large area of white space to emphasize space and atmosphere. Light is natural (overcast or dusk), low-saturation gray-blue, beige, and warm gray tones, realistic photography texture. The image has fine film grain and a slight sense of daily life, not intentionally aesthetic, not over-decorated, like a frame from a real movie. A small amount of natural floral materials can be added at the edges or foreground as a metaphor (restrained, not excessive, not decorative). Add the title '花束みたいな恋をした' in the white space area, thin Mincho font, simple and sparse layout; add 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet' in a smaller font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese movie poster texture, artistic, restrained, everyday life, emphasizing relationships over romantic symbols, avoiding sugary romance, avoiding flower piles, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding crowded compositions, avoiding the 'exquisite but hollow' AI feel. Negative prompt: AI feel, over-aesthetic, sea of flowers, romantic filters, excessive lighting effects, high saturation, neon lights, intimate couple embrace, posed feel, photobooth composition, internet celebrity style, illustration feel, 3D rendering, cluttered elements. Japanese minimalist artistic movie poster style, inspired by 'Love Letter', winter snow scene, a close-up of a young woman's face, face close to or semi-buried in the snow, tiny snowflakes falling naturally. The composition is a restrained close-up side profile or slightly tilted face, with the person occupying a large proportion of the screen but not overly sharp, edges slightly softened or slightly out of focus. Expression is calmness after sadness, with tears or tear marks in the eyes, emotions introverted and restrained, like having just cried and slowly returning to silence, eyes not looking at the camera, with a sense of memory and void. Light is winter natural scattered light or overcast soft light, cool white, light gray, pale blue tones, low saturation, low contrast, no strong shadows, no dramatic lighting effects. The snow and air form a clean background. The image texture is between real photography and film, with fine grain, slight mist, slightly white or slightly overexposed, like an old photo faded by time or a movie still. Skin not overly detailed, no skin smoothing, no sharpening, no retouching. Asymmetric composition, face can be partially cropped, minimalist background, retaining appropriate white space. Add the minimalist title 'Love Letter' or 'ラヴレター' in the white space area, thin Mincho or thin serif font, wide character spacing, sparse layout, color light gray; add 'Love Letter' in a tiny font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese artistic movie poster texture, quiet, subtle, restrained, like a memory covered by snow, avoiding photo studio feel, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding refined filters, avoiding lighting effects, avoiding high contrast and high saturation, avoiding sharp digital feel, avoiding theatrical emotions, avoiding 'pretty but hollow'. Negative prompt: AI feel, skin smoothing, sharpening, HDR, high contrast, high saturation, dreamy light effects, lens flare, filter feel, photo studio style, internet celebrity face, posing, looking directly at the camera, exaggerated emotions, 3D rendering, illustration style, complex background.

items.title: Epic Narrative Silhouette Movie Poster
items.description: A complex structural prompt that uses a character's silhouette as a container for an entire world-building scene, focusing on narrative depth and Eastern realism.
items.content: 根据{argument name="主题" default="红楼梦"}自动生成一张 收藏版史诗叙事海报，巨大优雅的{argument name="角色" default="林黛玉"}人物侧脸剪影作为外轮廓，剪影内部自动生长出最契合该主题的完整世界观、标志性场景、角色关系、象征符号、关键建筑、生物、道具与氛围。整体不是普通拼贴，而是高级的剪影轮廓填充式叙事合成，带有双重曝光式联想，但强化为电影级叙事表达与空间调度。电影海报风格 + 东方现实主义美学融合，强调真实物理光影、镜头语言、空间纵深与叙事层级。光影采用电影级侧逆光与局部暖光点缀，冷暖对比克制真实，加入体积光与轻雾增强空间感。材质表现为真实质感（建筑、丝绸、肌肤、石材），避免纯绘画笔触感，保留柔和空气透视，但优化为电影级景深与焦点控制。轻微胶片颗粒，边缘飞白与刷痕改为电影式柔和融合过渡，大面积留白，版式克制高级，安静、宏大、克制、宿命感强的东方电影叙事。所有元素必须强绑定主题，一眼识别，不要杂乱，不要硬拼贴，不要模板化背景，不要廉价奇幻素材。
items.translatedContent: Automatically generate a collector's edition epic narrative poster based on {argument name="theme" default="Dream of the Red Chamber"}. Use a giant, elegant silhouette of {argument name="character" default="Lin Daiyu"}'s profile as the outer outline. Inside the silhouette, let the complete world-building, iconic scenes, character relationships, symbolic icons, key architecture, creatures, props, and atmosphere most relevant to the theme grow naturally. This is not a simple collage but a high-end silhouette-filling narrative synthesis with double-exposure associations, enhanced for cinematic narrative expression and spatial choreography. A fusion of movie poster style and Eastern realist aesthetics, emphasizing realistic physical light and shadow, camera language, spatial depth, and narrative hierarchy. Lighting uses cinematic rim lighting with local warm accents, with restrained and realistic cool-warm contrast, adding volumetric light and light mist to enhance the sense of space. Textures should be realistic (architecture, silk, skin, stone), avoiding pure painterly strokes, retaining soft atmospheric perspective but optimized for cinematic depth of field and focus control. Fine film grain, with edge brushstrokes modified into soft cinematic transitions, large areas of negative space, and a refined, high-end layout. Quiet, grand, restrained, and infused with a strong sense of fatalism typical of Eastern cinematic storytelling. All elements must be strongly bound to the theme for instant recognition, avoiding clutter, hard collages, templated backgrounds, or cheap fantasy assets.

items.title: Futuristic Brand Visual Manual
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating a sophisticated brand visual manual that balances toy-like energy with high-end tech aesthetics.
items.content:
为一家名为「{argument name="品牌名称" default="任何品牌名称"}」的公司打造一套精致的多页品牌视觉手册(多张图片形式)。品牌整体气质应当充满趣味、具有未来感、色彩鲜明，并且设计感强烈，在“玩具般的活力”与“高端创意科技品牌的精致感”之间取得平衡。视觉风格需采用大胆且具有实验性的品牌语言，包括:高饱和亮色、简洁几何图形、现代字体设计、富有动感的视觉节奏，以及略带超 surreal 感的图像表达。
整体氛围应传递出:创造力、年轻感、节奏感、触感体验以及概念前卫性。在表达上，需要融合消费级产品的趣味性、时尚品牌的呈现方式，以及当代数字设计的语言体系。品牌手册中应体现:
对产品细节的极致关注(product obsession)多样化的视觉实验(visual experimentation)包装设计探索(packaging exploration)编辑风格摄影(editorial photography)沉浸式零售体验(immersive retail)跨平台品牌应用 (cross-platform brand application)最终呈现应构建一个自信、当代、统一且完整的品牌世界观一既易于理解与接近，又具备强烈的艺术指导感(artdirection)在视觉上保持高度一致性，同时展现出高端创意工作室级别的美学标准。
items.translatedContent: Create a sophisticated multi-page brand visual manual for a company named "{argument name="brand name" default="Any Brand Name"}". The overall brand persona should be playful, futuristic, vibrant, and highly designed, striking a balance between "toy-like energy" and the "sophistication of a high-end creative tech brand." The visual style should use bold and experimental brand language, including: high-saturation bright colors, simple geometric shapes, modern typography, dynamic visual rhythm, and slightly surreal image expression. The overall atmosphere should convey: creativity, youthfulness, rhythm, tactile experience, and conceptual avant-garde. The expression needs to integrate the fun of consumer products, the presentation of fashion brands, and the language of contemporary digital design. The brand manual should reflect: extreme focus on product details, diverse visual experimentation, packaging design exploration, editorial style photography, immersive retail experience, and cross-platform brand application. The final presentation should construct a confident, contemporary, unified, and complete brand worldview—both easy to understand and approachable, yet possessing a strong sense of art direction, maintaining high visual consistency while showcasing aesthetic standards at a high-end creative studio level.

items.title: Professional Brand Packaging System
items.description: A comprehensive, high-aesthetic prompt for creating a complete brand packaging system display with commercial photography quality.
items.content:
请为品牌【{argument name="品牌名称" default="品牌名称"}】、类目为【{argument name="品牌类目" default="品牌类目"}】创作一张高审美、高完成度的「品牌包装系统展示图」。这不是普通电商白底图，也不是单一产品图，而是一张具有品牌提案感、视觉识别系统感和商业摄影质感的包装家族陈列效果图。画面需要体现“同一品牌在多个包装载体上的统一落地”，呈现一个成熟消费品牌的完整包装系统。

【画幅要求】整体必须为固定 4:5 的竖版海报构图，画面方向明确为纵向，禁止生成横版构图、宽幅桌面陈列或过于分散的横向展示。整体构图需符合海报阅读逻辑：上方保留呼吸感，中部为品牌包装系统的主要视觉焦点，下方安排辅助包装、标签和产品本体，整体重心集中，适合直接作为品牌展示海报发布。

【核心要求】根据【类目】自动匹配最合理、最自然的包装组合与产品形态，并围绕【品牌名字】建立统一的品牌视觉系统。画面中应选择少量但有代表性的包装形式，组成一组完整而精炼的品牌包装系统，不追求堆砌数量，而强调主次层级、品牌统一性与陈列美感。可根据类目合理选择以下包装类型中的一部分：手提袋 / 购物袋、纸盒 / 礼盒 / 外包装盒、长条盒 / 单品盒 / 套装盒、包装袋 / 封套 / 小样袋 / 软袋、杯子 / 瓶子 / 罐子 / 管状容器 / 喷雾瓶 / 泵头瓶、标签 / 贴纸 / 封签 / 吊牌 / 小卡片，以及与类目对应的真实产品本体。

【类目适配逻辑】包装形式与产品形态需要根据【类目】自动匹配，但不局限于单一方向。可参考以下适配逻辑自由发散：若类目为食品 / 烘焙 / 零食 / 饮品，则以纸袋、纸盒、包装袋、杯子、食品容器、贴纸、封签及真实产品本体为主；若类目为茶饮 / 咖啡 / 饮料，则以杯子、瓶子、罐装包装、提袋、杯套、封口贴、礼盒等为主；若类目为美妆 / 护肤 / 彩妆 / 香水，则以瓶、罐、管、盒、礼盒、手提袋、小样包装等为主；若类目为香氛 / 家居 / 生活方式，则以香薰瓶、蜡烛杯、包装盒、礼盒、提袋、吊卡、标签卡等为主；若类目为服饰 / 饰品 / 潮玩 / 文创，则以包装盒、抽屉盒、防尘袋、手提袋、贴纸、吊牌、配件包装等为主；若类目为数码配件 / 工具 / 小型消费品，则以硬盒、外包装盒、收纳袋、说明卡、贴纸、封套、标签等为主。整体必须体现“类目合理、品牌统一、包装成体系”的效果。

【数量与密度控制】请控制画面中的物件数量，不要过多堆砌，也不要把所有可能包装形式全部展示出来。整体应呈现“少而精、完整但不拥挤”的品牌包装系统效果。建议选择最具代表性的包装载体进行展示：大件包装 1～2 个，中型包装 2～3 个，小型包装或辅助物件 2～4 个，真实产品本体 1～3 个，总可见元素建议控制在 6～10 个之间。包装种类应体现层次变化与系统感，但不宜重复过多同类物件。画面需要有足够留白与呼吸感，确保每个包装都清晰可见、主次明确、摆放舒展，宁可少而精，也不要为了“完整”而过度塞满。

【品牌视觉系统要求】所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，统一使用【品牌名字】作为核心品牌识别元素。整体应具备一致的 logo / 标志呈现、字体风格、图形语言、插画语言或纹样系统、排版逻辑、配色体系、材质与印刷质感。品牌调性、色彩方向、图案元素、辅助图形和视觉氛围，请根据【类目】自动匹配并合理发散，不局限于任何固定风格。整体风格应统一、协调、具有品牌识别度，可以是简约高级、自然有机、时尚现代、轻奢精致、年轻清新、艺术感、潮流个性或经典优雅，但必须符合【类目】特征，并呈现成熟品牌的设计完成度。

【配色机制要求】整体配色不要固化为某一种固定组合，也不要连续多次出现高度相似的主色系统。每次生成时应根据【类目】与品牌气质，主动形成不同的主色方案与配色关系，采用“受控发散”的方式进行色彩演绎。色彩可以是低饱和自然色、现代中性色、轻复古色、明快清新色、轻奢深色系或艺术感综合色系，但必须保持高级、统一、克制、有品牌感。允许每次生成时呈现不同的视觉气质，例如奶油白与焦糖棕、雾灰蓝与暖白、橄榄绿与亚麻米、酒红与奶霜白、可可棕与象牙白、炭灰与麦秆金、雾粉灰与米白、海军蓝与暖灰等，仅作为参考方向而非固定模板。不要荧光色，不要廉价高饱和，不要杂乱失控的多色拼贴。

【画面构图与陈列要求】画面采用品牌包装家族陈列逻辑，而不是杂乱堆放。整体为商业摄影棚场景，使用 3/4 轻俯视角或略带透视的正面陈列角度，形成有层次、有秩序、有主次的包装展示画面。构图参考以下逻辑：后景摆放 1～2 个较大的包装作为视觉支撑，如手提袋、大礼盒、大外盒；中景安排品牌核心包装或主力单品包装，作为主要视觉焦点；前景摆放较小包装、辅助包装、标签、贴纸及真实产品本体；至少有一个真实产品与包装产生自然互动，如产品半露出、摆放在包装前方、与包装组合展示；整体形成平衡而有设计感的三角式或错落式构图。画面干净、有留白、不拥挤，内容丰富但克制，以有限而精准的包装组合体现完整的品牌包装生态。

【视觉风格要求】整体呈现高端商业摄影质感与品牌提案感，背景为干净的摄影棚环境，可为白色、暖白色、浅灰色，或根据品牌调性自动匹配的极简背景。画面应强调真实的包装材质表现、清晰的纸张折痕、盒型结构、瓶罐轮廓、标签细节、印刷质感、压纹 / 烫金 / 哑光 / 棉纸纹理 / 牛皮纸纹理等材质细节，以及统一而高级的配色搭配、精致现代干净的品牌视觉语言和强烈的“这是一整套品牌包装系统”的完整感。

【光影要求】采用真实商业摄影级光影，可为柔和棚拍光，也可带有轻微方向性的自然侧光。需要有清晰但克制的阴影，以增强立体感、空间感与高级感。整体光线通透、明亮、干净，不要阴暗，不要廉价感，不要杂乱背景。

【最终效果要求】最终画面应像一个成熟品牌的包装系统展示海报、包装家族提案图或品牌视觉落地效果图，而不是零散商品拼图。重点突出：固定 4:5 竖版海报感、品牌统一性、包装家族完整性、商业摄影感、设计提案感、类目适配性，以及高级审美与视觉完成度。

Please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "Brand Packaging System Display Image" for the brand {argument name="brand name" default="Brand Name"} in the category {argument name="category" default="Product Category"}. This is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. The image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[Aspect Ratio Requirements] The overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. Horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. The layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. The weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[Core Requirements] Automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [Category] and build a unified visual system around the [Brand Name]. Choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. Prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. You can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[Category Adaptation] Adapt packaging forms to the [Category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for Bakery; cups and sleeves for Coffee/Tea; jars and tubes for Beauty/Skincare; candles and cards for Fragrance/Lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for Fashion/Collectibles. The result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[Quantity Control] Control the number of items; do not overcrowd. The scene should be "less is more." Suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. Total visible elements should be between 6-10. Ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[Visual System] All packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [Brand Name] as the core element. Maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. The style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[Color Mechanism] Avoid fixed combinations. Generate different schemes like Cream White/Caramel Brown, Mist Blue/Warm White, Olive Green/Linen Beige, Chocolate Brown/Ivory, etc. Avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. Maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[Composition] Use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. Arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. At least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). Create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[Visual Style] High-end commercial photography feel. Clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). Emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). Modern and clean visual language.

[Lighting] Commercial grade lighting. Soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. Use clear but restrained shadows for depth. The light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[Final Effect] The final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality.

【类目适配逻辑】包装形式与产品形态需要根据【类目】自动匹配，但不局限于单一方向。可参考以下适配逻辑自由发散：若类目为食品 / 烘焙 / 零食 / 饮品，则以纸袋、纸盒、包装袋、杯子、食品容器、贴纸、封签及真实产品本体为主；若类目为茶饮 / 咖啡 / 饮料，则以杯子、瓶子、罐装包装、提袋、杯套、封口贴、礼盒等为主；若类目为美妆 / 护肤 / 彩妆 / 香水，则以瓶、罐、管、盒、礼盒、手提袋、小样包装等为主；若类目为香氛 / 家居 / 生活方式，则以香薰瓶、蜡烛杯、包装盒、礼盒、提袋、吊卡、标签卡等为主；若类目为服饰 / 饰品 / 潮玩 / 文创，则以包装盒、抽屉盒、防尘袋、手提袋、贴纸、吊牌、配件包装等为主；若类目为数码配件 / 工具 / 小型消费品，则以硬盒、外包装盒、收纳袋、说明卡、贴纸、封套、标签等为主。整体必须体现“类目合理、品牌统一、包装成体系”的效果。

【数量与密度控制】请控制画面中的物件数量，不要过多堆砌，也不要把所有可能包装形式全部展示出来。整体应呈现“少而精、完整但不拥挤”的品牌包装系统效果。建议选择最具代表性的包装载体进行展示：大件包装 1～2 个，中型包装 2～3 个，小型包装或辅助物件 2～4 个，真实产品本体 1～3 个，总可见元素建议控制在 6～10 个之间。包装种类应体现层次变化与系统感，但不宜重复过多同类物件。画面需要有足够留白与呼吸感，确保每个包装都清晰可见、主次明确、摆放舒展，宁可少而精，也不要为了“完整”而过度塞满。

【品牌视觉系统要求】所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，统一使用【品牌名字】作为核心品牌识别元素。整体应具备一致的 logo / 标志呈现、字体风格、图形语言、插画语言或纹样系统、排版逻辑、配色体系、材质与印刷质感。品牌调性、色彩方向、图案元素、辅助图形和视觉氛围，请根据【类目】自动匹配并合理发散，不局限于任何固定风格。整体风格应统一、协调、具有品牌识别度，可以是简约高级、自然有机、时尚现代、轻奢精致、年轻清新、艺术感、潮流个性或经典优雅，但必须符合【类目】特征，并呈现成熟品牌的设计完成度。

【配色机制要求】整体配色不要固化为某一种固定组合，也不要连续多次出现高度相似的主色系统。每次生成时应根据【类目】与品牌气质，主动形成不同的主色方案与配色关系，采用“受控发散”的方式进行色彩演绎。色彩可以是低饱和自然色、现代中性色、轻复古色、明快清新色、轻奢深色系或艺术感综合色系，但必须保持高级、统一、克制、有品牌感。允许每次生成时呈现不同的视觉气质，例如奶油白与焦糖棕、雾灰蓝与暖白、橄榄绿与亚麻米、酒红与奶霜白、可可棕与象牙白、炭灰与麦秆金、雾粉灰与米白、海军蓝与暖灰等，仅作为参考方向而非固定模板。不要荧光色，不要廉价高饱和，不要杂乱失控的多色拼贴。

【画面构图与陈列要求】画面采用品牌包装家族陈列逻辑，而不是杂乱堆放。整体为商业摄影棚场景，使用 3/4 轻俯视角或略带透视的正面陈列角度，形成有层次、有秩序、有主次的包装展示画面。构图参考以下逻辑：后景摆放 1～2 个较大的包装作为视觉支撑，如手提袋、大礼盒、大外盒；中景安排品牌核心包装或主力单品包装，作为主要视觉焦点；前景摆放较小包装、辅助包装、标签、贴纸及真实产品本体；至少有一个真实产品与包装产生自然互动，如产品半露出、摆放在包装前方、与包装组合展示；整体形成平衡而有设计感的三角式或错落式构图。画面干净、有留白、不拥挤，内容丰富但克制，以有限而精准的包装组合体现完整的品牌包装生态。

【视觉风格要求】整体呈现高端商业摄影质感与品牌提案感，背景为干净的摄影棚环境，可为白色、暖白色、浅灰色，或根据品牌调性自动匹配的极简背景。画面应强调真实的包装材质表现、清晰的纸张折痕、盒型结构、瓶罐轮廓、标签细节、印刷质感、压纹 / 烫金 / 哑光 / 棉纸纹理 / 牛皮纸纹理等材质细节，以及统一而高级的配色搭配、精致现代干净的品牌视觉语言和强烈的“这是一整套品牌包装系统”的完整感。

【光影要求】采用真实商业摄影级光影，可为柔和棚拍光，也可带有轻微方向性的自然侧光。需要有清晰但克制的阴影，以增强立体感、空间感与高级感。整体光线通透、明亮、干净，不要阴暗，不要廉价感，不要杂乱背景。

【最终效果要求】最终画面应像一个成熟品牌的包装系统展示海报、包装家族提案图或品牌视觉落地效果图，而不是零散商品拼图。重点突出：固定 4:5 竖版海报感、品牌统一性、包装家族完整性、商业摄影感、设计提案感、类目适配性，以及高级审美与视觉完成度。 please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "brand packaging system display image" for the brand {argument name="brand name" default="brand name"} in the category {argument name="category" default="product category"}. this is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. the image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[aspect ratio requirements] the overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. the layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. the weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[core requirements] automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [category] and build a unified visual system around the [brand name]. choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. you can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[category adaptation] adapt packaging forms to the [category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for bakery; cups and sleeves for coffee/tea; jars and tubes for beauty/skincare; candles and cards for fragrance/lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for fashion/collectibles. the result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[quantity control] control the number of items; do not overcrowd. the scene should be "less is more." suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. total visible elements should be between 6-10. ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[visual system] all packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [brand name] as the core element. maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. the style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[color mechanism] avoid fixed combinations. generate different schemes like cream white/caramel brown, mist blue/warm white, olive green/linen beige, chocolate brown/ivory, etc. avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[composition] use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. at least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[visual style] high-end commercial photography feel. clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). modern and clean visual language.

[lighting] commercial grade lighting. soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. use clear but restrained shadows for depth. the light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[final effect] the final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality. larus canus 15210

items.title: Professional Anime Cinematic Storyboard
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a professional 9-panel anime storyboard, featuring complex character actions, camera directions, and a Makoto Shinkai-inspired aesthetic.
items.content: 一份专业的动漫院线分镜头（16：9），标题为《{argument name="标题" default="天空之击"}》，副标题为“{argument name="副标题" default="战士与圣石"}”。干净的浅米色背景，圆角矩形面板排列成三列网格，共 9 个场景。每个场景面板显示：橙色“场景 XX”标签、时间码、场景标题，然后是两个并排的画面，分别标有“开始帧”→“结束帧”，通过白色箭头连接，下面有注释（镜头/对白/特效/动作）。艺术风格：清晰的卡通渲染 {argument name="画风" default="新海诚的×工作室机智，×进击的巨人"}——柔和的画风光线、立体云朵、温暖的金色阳光、电影般的广角镜头、动态动作姿势、浓郁的天蓝和翡翠绿调，搭配黄铜和铜色点缀。需要描绘的场景：1. 广角景——一艘雄伟的蒸汽朋克飞艇，黄铜螺旋桨和飘扬的帆，在高空穿透积云海洋（慢速无人机推入）2.低角度特写一名女战士的靴子和交叉的双腿悬挂在飞艇木制栏杆上，风中头发飘动（静电→微微向上倾斜） 3.鸟瞰视角俯瞰栏杆下方：广阔的翡翠山谷，蜿蜒的河流和远处一个茅草屋顶的小中世纪村庄（眩晕变焦）4.飞艇桥内部——海盗船长戴着三角帽和长大衣，举着一块比蛋稍大、发着蓝光的圣石，脸上有耀眼的青色光（中→石头放大）5.甲板上的船员发现入侵者——一名满脸胡渣的海盗举起一把黄铜中世纪左轮手枪对准她，其他人震惊地转身（两枪→跟着瞄准）6.子弹飞行中极近距离，旋转穿过空中，伴随着运动模糊和烟雾轨迹，朝栏杆方向飞去（子弹时间追踪镜头）7.栏杆——空的。 她被放置的地方什么都没有，子弹穿过空气（快速剪辑，杂音）8。女战士在空中优雅地做月面翻身，背景是明亮的天空，头发和斗篷在动作中拖曳（慢动作，宽→近）9。着陆镜头——她悄无声息地在射手身后降落，低蹲着，手放在剑柄上，海盗转身半空震惊僵住（低角度→对峙） 底部部分包括：“关键角色”一行，有 4 个角色肖像（女战士、海盗船长、射手海盗、一名船员）;一个“音调与方向”盒子（动态动作、风和云粒子，吉卜力风格的奇观与武士的强烈情感）;“音乐与特效计划”时间线（环境风→紧张弦乐→子弹→→沉默）;以及“技术规格”盒装（30 秒，16：9 1920×1080,24 帧，全彩，mp4 H.264）。布局：简洁的信息图，细边框，粉彩色格，每帧内高度细致的动漫关键视觉，专业制作文档美学。

Each scene panel shows: an orange 'Scene XX' label, timecode, scene title, then two side-by-side frames labeled 'Start Frame' → 'End Frame', connected by a white arrow, with annotations below (shot/dialogue/VFX/action). items.title: Nostalgic Japanese Gal Grid Images
items.description: A prompt designed to generate a 3x3 grid of nostalgic, emotional snapshots themed around 90s-2000s Japanese subculture (Heisei Gal) with a film camera aesthetic.
items.content:
16:9の2K画像を以下のプロンプトに基づいて3×3のグリッド画像を４枚作成して。
深夜～早朝の{argument name="テーマ" default="平成ギャル"}をテーマにしたエモーショナルな画像。 但し、写真シチュエーションは<テーマ>の中から重複しないようにランダムに選んでください。 。 フィルムカメラで直射フラッシュを使用したスナップショットスタイル。 フィルムグレイン、周辺減光、暖色系のフェードトーンが特徴的。 90年代〜2000年代のコンパクトカメラの質感を持つ。 ノスタルジックで儚い写真。 

<テーマ> 
・深夜の繁華街 
・路上のベンチ — 缶チューハイで乾杯 
・真夜中の公園 
・ゲームセンター前 — UFOキャッチャーの景品を見せびらかす 
・プリクラ機の中 
・ゲーセンのダンスゲーム 
・クレーンゲーム 
・居酒屋の座敷 — ピースサインで乾杯ショット 
・カラオケボックス — マイク片手に熱唱＆タンバリン ・ファミレス（ガスト/デニーズ）深夜 
・屋台のラーメン — 〆のラーメンをすする 
・クラブのVIPブース 
・バーのカウンター — カクテル片手にケータイ通話
・牛丼屋（吉野家/すき家） — 夜明け前の腹ごしらえ ・終電の地下鉄 
・タクシーの後部座席 
・終電間際の駅ホーム — 厚底ブーツで走る 
・始発待ちのマンガ喫茶 — ブランケットにくるまる 
・改造車（VIPカー）の助手席 — ファーのダッシュボードとLED 
・タクシー乗り場 
・観覧車 — 夜景をバックにゴンドラ内ショット 
・レインボーブリッジの夜景 — 海沿いの柵にもたれて ・ラブホテル街の看板 — ネオンピンクに照らされた路地 
・屋上駐車場 — 夜景を見下ろしながらおしゃべり 
・公園のブランコ — 深夜に揺れながらケータイ光る
・海辺（湘南/お台場） — 夜の砂浜で花火 
・神社の境内 — 深夜の肝試し ・ガラケーで自撮り 
・プリクラ帳（手帳）交換 — デコりまくったプリ帳を見せ合う 
・路上でパラパラ練習 — 街灯の下で振り付け合わせ 
・ボウリング場 — レーンの照明に照らされたハイタッチ 
・朝帰りの始発電車 — 疲れ果てて寝落ち、膝にはプリクラ袋 
・エレベーター内 
・ルーズソックスを直しながら座る — 駅の階段に腰掛けて 
・ビデオ（DVD）レンタルショップ — 深夜にホラー映画を選んでる
・着うたをガラケーで流す 
・朝日の渋谷スクランブル

Create four 16:9 2K images as 3x3 grids based on the following prompt. Emotional images themed around {argument name="theme" default="Heisei Gal"} from late night to early morning. However, please randomly select photo situations from the <Theme> list without duplicates. Snapshot style using a film camera with direct flash. Features film grain, vignetting, and warm faded tones. Has the texture of a compact camera from the 90s to 2000s. Nostalgic and ephemeral photographs. 

<Theme> 
- Nighttime downtown area 
- Bench on the street — toasting with canned Chu-hi 
- Midnight park 
- In front of a game center — showing off UFO catcher prizes 
- Inside a Purikura machine 
- Dance game at an arcade 
- Crane game 
- Izakaya seating — toasting shot with peace signs 
- Karaoke box — singing passionately with a mic and tambourine 
- Family restaurant (Gusto/Denny's) at midnight 
- Ramen stall — slurping closing ramen 
- Club VIP booth 
- Bar counter — talking on a mobile phone with a cocktail in hand 
- Beef bowl shop (Yoshinoya/Sukiya) — meal before dawn 
- Last subway train 
- Taxi backseat 
- Station platform near the last train — running in platform boots 
- Manga cafe waiting for the first train — wrapped in a blanket 
- Passenger seat of a customized car (VIP car) — fur dashboard and LEDs 
- Taxi stand 
- Ferris wheel — shot inside the gondola with the night view in the background 
- Rainbow Bridge night view — leaning against a seaside fence 
- Love hotel district signs — alleys lit in neon pink 
- Rooftop parking lot — chatting while looking down at the night view 
- Park swing — mobile phone glowing while swinging at midnight 
- Seaside (Shonan/Odaiba) — fireworks on the beach at night 
- Shrine grounds — midnight test of courage 
- Selfie with a flip phone 
- Purikura book (planner) exchange — showing off heavily decorated sticker books 
- Para Para practice on the street — matching choreography under a streetlight 
- Bowling alley — high-fiving under lane lights 
- First train home in the morning — falling asleep exhausted with a Purikura bag on the lap 
- Inside an elevator 
- Sitting while adjusting loose socks — perched on station stairs 
- Video (DVD) rental shop — choosing a horror movie late at night 
- Playing ringtones on a flip phone 
- Shibuya Scramble at sunrise

items.title: Hyper-realistic Surreal Poster Design Prompt
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating a cinematic, photorealistic poster that blends reality with surreal concepts, featuring deep customization for branding and visual elements.
items.content:
ジャンル：{argument name="ジャンル" default="ハンバーガー"}
ブランド名：{argument name="ブランド名" default="かし子"}

この画像をベースに、世界中のどこにも存在しない、発想が常識を完全に逸脱したフォトリアルなポスター画像を生成してください。

単なる延長ではなく、「意味は通じるが解釈が狂っている」レベルまで発想を飛躍させること。

【絶対条件】
・フォトリアル表現（実写のような質感、空気感、光の粒子まで再現）
・言語はすべて日本語

【誇張・ブーストする要素】
■フォントデザイン
・文字そのものが物体化・現象化している
・フォントがテーマと物理的に相互作用している

■文字の配置
・通常のレイアウトを無視し、空間そのものに配置
・視線誘導が異常に強い配置

■構図
・非現実的なパース、極端な広角、歪み、スケール破壊

Based on this image, generate a photorealistic poster image with a concept that completely deviates from common sense and does not exist anywhere else in the world.

Don't just make it an extension; leap with the idea to a level where it 'makes sense but the interpretation is insane.'

[Absolute Conditions]
- Photorealistic expression (reproduce textures, atmosphere, and even light particles like a real-life photo)
- All language must be in Japanese

[Exaggerated/Boosted Elements]
■ Font Design
- The characters themselves are objectified or phenomenological
- The font physically interacts with the theme

■ Text Placement
- Ignore normal layouts and place text within the space itself
- Layouts with abnormally strong gaze direction

■ Composition
- Unrealistic perspective, extreme wide angles, distortion, scale destruction
- Clear foreground, middle ground, and background layers with abnormally high information density
- A central element that catches the eye instantly + countless subtle oddities in the details

■ Lighting
- Movie-level cinematic lighting
- Intense backlighting, rim lights, neon, particle light, volume light
- Light itself has meaning (functioning as a guide or emphasis)

■ Catchphrase
- Short, intense Japanese text that makes sense but is hard to fully grasp
- Copy that is slightly off-situation but fits strangely well

[Additional Effects]
- A sense of discomfort where reality and unreality coexist simultaneously
- Parts of the image ignore the laws of physics
- Quality that functions as a professional-level advertisement

Ultimately, make it a poster that is 'understandable yet beyond comprehension' and warrants a second look. If the reference image is a character, apply actions such as wearing, using, or trying to eat the brand. Do not use any real brand logos, company names, or personal names; make it completely original. Verify that no real-world elements are included in the final finish. Suppress noise or balance disruptions caused by excessive detail, maintaining overall visual unity and a sophisticated impression.

items.title: Swiss Travel Guide Relief Map Poster
items.description: A polished tourism infographic poster showing a 3D relief map of Switzerland with 12 labeled destinations, landmarks, and surrounding vintage travel elements for editorial or campaign use.
items.content: Create a highly detailed vintage-inspired illustrated travel poster and infographic for {argument name="country name" default="Switzerland"}, shown as a sculpted 3D relief map centered on a clean light gray background. At the top, place a huge bold black sans-serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SWITZERLAND"}, with smaller uppercase text below reading TRAVEL GUIDE, flanked by thin horizontal divider lines and a tiny red shield emblem with a white cross. The centerpiece is a raised topographic map of Switzerland rendered like a miniature diorama, with rocky borders, green valleys, snowy alpine peaks, blue lakes, winding white roads, and a few rail lines. Mark exactly 12 destinations on the map with black dot markers and bold black capsule labels with white uppercase text: BASEL, ZÜRICH, ST. GALLEN, LUCERNE, BERN, INTERLAKEN, CHUR, ST. MORITZ, LUGANO, ZERMATT, GENEVA, and LAUSANNE. Integrate miniature landmark buildings and scenery directly onto the map, including churches, old town towers, waterfront structures, castles, and mountain villages, plus two small red trains moving through the landscape. Add surrounding travel ephemera arranged around the map: 1 worn brown vintage suitcase with travel stickers and a red Swiss-cross badge in the upper left, 1 antique brass compass rose on the left, 1 postage stamp in the upper right reading TRAVEL TO SWITZERLAND with mountain art and postal cancellation marks, 1 realistic Swiss flag on a pole in the top right corner, 1 tilted polaroid photo in the lower left with snowy mountains and the caption {argument name="photo caption" default="Swiss Alps"}, and 4 faceted heart-shaped crystal charms total, with 2 clear/silver hearts and 2 red hearts placed around the composition. On the right side, add a vertical sightseeing list with icon illustrations and thin separators, containing exactly 12 city entries with headings and short attraction lines: ZÜRICH — Bahnhofstrasse; Old Town (Altstadt); Lake Zurich. LUCERNE — Chapel Bridge; Lion Monument; Lake Lucerne. INTERLAKEN — Jungfraujoch; Harder Kulm; Lake Brienz & Thun. ZERMATT — Matterhorn; Gornergrat Railway; Skiing & Hiking. GENEVA — Jet d'Eau; United Nations; Lake Geneva. LAUSANNE — Olympic Museum; Lausanne Cathedral; Lake Geneva. BERN — Federal Palace; Zytglogge Clock Tower; Bear Park. ST. MORITZ — St. Moritz Lake; Skiing; Luxury Shopping. LUGANO — Lake Lugano; Monte Brè; Swiss-Italian Culture. ST. GALLEN — Abbey Library; St. Gallen Cathedral; Textile Museum. CHUR — Old Town; Bishop's Palace; Rhine Valley. BASEL — Kunstmuseum; Basel Minster; Rhine River. Use a premium editorial travel-brand aesthetic, combining realistic miniature map rendering, crisp typography, soft studio shadows, subtle drop shadows under objects, and a polished tourism campaign look.

items.title: Tennis Hydration Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a bold, photorealistic outdoor tennis advertisement featuring a branded water bottle in dramatic forced perspective for sports marketing and beverage campaigns.
items.content: Create a hyper-realistic sports advertising poster shot from an extreme wide-angle, low courtside perspective on a bright sunny day at an outdoor tennis court. In the extreme foreground, a male tennis player lunges dramatically toward the camera while thrusting a large matte cobalt-blue insulated water bottle toward the viewer, making the bottle the dominant object in the frame. The bottle is covered with visible condensation droplets and has a brushed metallic gold cap, with the white logo text {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} printed near the bottom. The athlete wears a clean white athletic t-shirt, bright blue tennis shorts, white wristbands, white socks, and white tennis shoes. His other arm stretches back holding a black tennis racket, with 1 bright yellow-green tennis ball visible near the racket on the right side of the image. The pose should feel dynamic and athletic, with one leg bent deeply and the other extended in a wide lunge across the blue hard court. Use strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, vivid saturated blues, and a clear cloudless sky, with green trees and a dark fence line in the distant background. Compose it like a premium hydration brand campaign, with sharp focus on the bottle and athlete, dramatic foreshortening, commercial polish, and energetic motion. Add clean white ad typography integrated onto the court surface in the lower half: a smaller line reading {argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}, a very large bold line reading {argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}, and a smaller subheading reading {argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keeps up with every move."}. Place the {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} logo again in white at the top right, and a small website URL in white at the bottom right reading {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}.

items.title: Cyberpunk Cyborg Skull Mask Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photoreal close-up cyberpunk character portrait suitable for sci-fi concept art, posters, and social media visuals.
items.content: A hyper-detailed cyberpunk close-up portrait of a futuristic woman cyborg, framed from the shoulders up and turned in 3/4 profile, looking directly at the viewer with one visible intense emerald-green eye. She has messy, wispy {argument name="hair color" default="bright teal"} hair tied loosely back with stray strands falling across her face. The lower half of her face is covered by a translucent neon-lime skull-shaped respirator mask with visible teeth structure, glossy acrylic material, and internal glowing green highlights. Her head and neck are partially exposed mechanical anatomy: black metal plates, pistons, cables, micro-circuitry, screws, and robotic joints integrated into the jawline, temple, ear area, and throat. She wears a black futuristic jacket with a high collar and a small caution-style label near the shoulder. Background is a soft-focus, saturated {argument name="background color" default="orange"} neon panel glow with blurred interface-like light blocks, creating strong color contrast against the teal hair and acid-green mask. Lighting is cinematic and glossy with sharp reflections on the mask and metal parts, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic skin texture, high contrast, moody sci-fi atmosphere, premium concept art, photoreal, extremely detailed, 85mm portrait lens look.

items.title: Monkey Patrol in Cardboard Police Car
items.description: A photorealistic comedic street image of four macaques riding a handmade cardboard police car through a crowded Chinese market, ideal for absurdist viral visual prompts.
items.content: A humorous photorealistic street scene in a busy Chinese market district in daylight, showing a tiny handmade police car driving down the road as if on patrol. The vehicle looks like a rough life-size toy or parade prop built from corrugated cardboard and tape, boxy and slightly crooked, painted white with dark blue police graphics, a red-and-blue light bar on the roof, the Chinese characters for police on the hood and side doors, the English word POLICE on the hood, a police badge emblem on the front doors, and a front license plate reading 京A8888. Inside and hanging out of the windows are 4 macaque monkeys total: 1 monkey in the driver’s seat wearing a white police cap with one hand on the steering wheel, 1 monkey in the front passenger seat leaning out the window and pointing forward, and 2 monkeys leaning out from the left side rear windows, each extending an arm and pointing outward. The monkeys have expressive alert faces and tan-brown fur, making the scene look like a monkey patrol. Surrounding environment is a real urban street with scooters, pedestrians, market stalls, green canopy tents, and dense red Chinese storefront signage in the background, all slightly out of focus. Shoot from a front-left three-quarter angle at street level, with the cardboard car centered and moving toward the viewer. Bright natural midday light, candid documentary photography style, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, comedic absurdity, high detail.

items.title: Barcelona Transfer Poster for Saka
items.description: A cinematic football transfer announcement poster showing Bukayo Saka in FC Barcelona colors, ideal for social media reveal graphics and fan concept art.
items.content: Create a dramatic football transfer announcement poster for {argument name="player name" default="Bukayo Saka"} joining {argument name="club name" default="FC Barcelona"}. Use a vertical 4:5 sports-poster composition with a deep electric blue and crimson red color grade, high contrast lighting, cinematic shadows, subtle glow, and premium social-media graphic design styling. Center a large chest-up portrait of the player wearing the {argument name="jersey description" default="2024/25 FC Barcelona home shirt with Spotify sponsor"}, facing forward with a serious confident expression. Behind him, place a much larger low-opacity side portrait of the same player on the right side as a background layer, tinted dark blue. Add a huge faint FC Barcelona crest spanning the middle background, blended into the red-blue gradient. At the very top center, place 2 club identifiers: the FC Barcelona crest and above it a small vertical red-and-blue striped motif. On the upper left, include the text “MÉS QUE UN CLUB” in small gold uppercase letters. On the left lower-middle, create a bold typographic name stack with 2 lines: small gold uppercase first name “BUKAYO” above very large white condensed sans-serif “SAKA”. In the foreground near the lower center, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with arms stretched wide in celebration, wearing the same Barcelona kit, navy socks, light boots, and a white wrist wrap. At the bottom, show a stylized illuminated view of Spotify Camp Nou curving across the width of the poster in dark blue with red highlights, with small visible stadium text “SPOTIFY CAMP NOU”. In the bottom left corner, include 2 small lines of text: “FC BARCELONA” in gold and “2024/25” in red. Add a small gold sleeve detail on the right shoulder area. Keep the layout clean, layered, modern, and aspirational, like an elite club transfer reveal graphic. Use sharp photo-illustration compositing, realistic fabric texture, glossy highlights, and polished poster finish.

items.title: Luxury Bilingual Tasting Menu Photo
items.description: A realistic overhead photograph of an elegant French-Japanese fine-dining menu sheet, ideal for showcasing AI-generated editorial menu design systems.
items.content: A photorealistic top-down product-style photograph of a single luxury tasting menu printed on bright white textured paper and placed on a dark walnut wooden tabletop, with soft warm ambient lighting and gentle natural shadows. The sheet is portrait orientation, slightly rotated clockwise, occupying most of the frame with clean margins around it. The design is an ultra-minimal fine-dining menu with elegant editorial typography, lots of negative space, precise alignment, and a refined black-and-dark-gray ink palette. At the upper left, the restaurant identity appears in 3 stacked lines: a large serif word {argument name="restaurant name" default="Silence"}, below it 2 Chinese characters "沈默", and below that a large serif French line "Le Silence". Under the title is a small location line reading "Ginza, Tokyo B3F". At the upper right is a small date line in French followed by Japanese date text: {argument name="date text" default="22 Avril 2026 • 令和八年四月二十二日"}. The main body is organized into 3 vertical content zones: a left numbered course list, a middle translated course list, and a far-right icon column. The left list contains exactly 9 numbered courses labeled 1 through 9, each with French title and Japanese subtitle and an English ingredient line beneath; the 9 visible course titles are: "Huître de Bretagne, eau de mer", "Daurade de Kyoto, pétale de sakura", "Oursin d’Hokkaidō, consommé d’algue", "Asperge de Nemuro, sauce mousseline", "Homard de Miyako, bisque légère", "Canard de Challans, figue et balsamique", "Boeuf de Kagoshima, truffe noire", "Fromage de chèvre, miel du Japon", and "Agrume, thé vert et gin". The middle list repeats the 9 dishes in a second compact column with French titles and Japanese descriptions. The far-right column contains exactly 9 horizontal icon rows aligned to the courses, each row showing small monochrome hand-drawn ingredient or allergen pictograms; some rows have 2 icons and some 3, for a total of 19 icons overall. Near the lower left is a section titled "Le mot du chef" followed by a short French paragraph in small serif text. Below that is a section titled "Origine des ingrédients / 食材の産地" with a dense 2-row ingredient-origin grid listing exactly 15 numbered origin entries in tiny text. In the lower right quadrant, include a small label "Chef" above a large sweeping handwritten signature reading {argument name="chef name" default="Keiichiro Aoyama"}. Along the very bottom edge is a thin horizontal rule and a centered allergen legend line with exactly 7 small outline icons and labels: shellfish, crustaceans, egg, fish, milk, gluten, sulfites, each labeled in French with Japanese beneath. The overall impression should be high-end Michelin-style menu design, editorial restraint, immaculate spacing, subtle paper grain, sharply legible text hierarchy, and realistic photography rather than a flat scan.

items.title: Inventor Portrait Memory Map
items.description: This prompt generates a flattering stylized portrait of a woman surrounded by scientific memory-map visuals, ideal for personal branding, concept art, or speculative interface design.
items.content: A stylized half-body portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a brilliant young woman inventor"} in a dark, moody studio, rendered as a warm amber-and-copper digital painting with semi-realistic detail and subtle sketch-like linework. She faces forward in a relaxed upright pose, cropped from about mid-torso upward, with long dark brown hair swept loosely over one shoulder, a few flyaway strands rim-lit by orange backlight, and thin clear-framed eyeglasses partly visible. Dress her in a glossy mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a deep burgundy turtleneck sweater. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic: a glowing spherical lattice lamp sits behind her on the left, casting a golden halo and warm edge light around her hair and jacket, while the rest of the background fades into charcoal brown shadow. Behind her, integrate the feeling of a visual memory map or inventor's mind palace: faint technical sketches, geometric construction lines, and handwritten scientific notes drawn directly onto the background like illuminated chalk. Include exactly 2 large wireframe forms on the right side: 1 tilted basket-like lattice ellipsoid near the upper right and 1 faint rectangular diagram with axis-like guide lines near the lower right. Include exactly 1 glowing lattice sphere lamp on the lower left. Add small handwritten text in the upper right that reads “TPMS” with three bullet-like lines underneath: “gyroid”, “diamond”, and “primitive”, and a small formula note reading “E = hv” near the right-center. The overall mood should feel intelligent, elegant, flattering, and slightly futuristic, like a portrait merged with a conceptual memory interface. Use a rich palette of burnt orange, gold, auburn, brown-black, and wine red, with high contrast, luminous highlights, and a polished editorial-art finish.

items.title: Edible History Pop-Up Chocolate Book
items.description: A photoreal macro editorial image of an antique open book transformed into a whimsical cocoa-and-Swiss-chocolate pop-up scene, ideal for food storytelling, historical campaigns, and premium generative art comparisons.
items.content: Create a square 1:1 macro photography image of an open antique history book on a clean white background, styled like an edible history pop-up book. The book is thick, vintage, leather-bound, and lying open flat at 180 degrees. Its pages are aged parchment with yellowed paper, worn edges, and visible paper texture. On the left page, show an abundant, slightly messy cocoa harvest spread partially covering the printed text: exactly 5 whole or split cacao pods in deep red-orange and brown tones, 1 wooden bowl filled with cacao nibs, a large scatter of loose cacao beans, broken cacao shells, small piles of nibs, and several glossy green leaves tucked among the ingredients. Everything should feel organic, overflowing, and tactile. On the right page, create a large 3D pop-up sculpture of assorted Swiss chocolate built entirely from chocolate and confectionery materials: exactly 8 visible chocolate bars or bar segments in mixed dark, milk, and white chocolate, arranged in a bouquet-like upright structure with 5 large leaf-shaped cacao or chocolate leaves behind them, curled pale chocolate shavings at the base, scattered cacao crumbs, and a wrapped paper base with a vintage label reading “CHOCOLAT SUISSE” and smaller text “Maison de Qualité”. Beside it, place a tiny 1:35 scale Victorian-era chocolatier gentleman in an apron, actively presenting and adjusting the chocolate display with both hands. Print on the right page in bold black serif text: “Vevey, 1875”. Below that, include a short faded cursive lore paragraph about cacao and Swiss chocolate culture. The paragraph should read: “From the cacao pod’s humble shell emerges a confection of elegance. In Swiss chocolate houses, cacao is refined into a treasured delicacy, shared in salons and homes alike, prized for comfort, celebration, and the craft of sweet invention.” Lighting is soft, warm museum lighting focused at the center of the open book. Mood is educational, whimsical, and richly textural. Emphasize photorealism, shallow depth of field, miniature world aesthetic, premium editorial styling, and extremely high material texture fidelity.

Shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with Panavision anamorphic lenses, subtle organic Kodak Vision3 film grain, shallow depth of field, creamy oval bokeh, dramatic volumetric cinematic lighting, high contrast, glossy reflections, premium blockbuster color grading. The subject has dark curly hair pulled up in a messy high tied style with loose wet strands, 1 visible dangling metallic earring, and minimal visible cybernetic facial circuitry with 2 glowing eye implants implied by the cybernetic design. Outfit has 3 key pieces: a metallic {argument name="jacket color" default="purple"} bomber jacket with bright {argument name="led trim color" default="neon blue"} LED piping tracing the collar, zipper line, chest seam, and both sleeves; a dark inner top; and black designer tactical pants with fitted panels and 2 visible buckle straps around the knee and thigh area. Add 1 illuminated tech module on the upper sleeve of the jacket. Background is a dense futuristic alley or street canyon with tall blurred buildings, wet atmosphere, vertical neon signage in cyan, magenta, blue, and warm amber, soft fog, and distant practical lights. Emphasize glossy fabric texture, rain-slick urban mood, moody blue-purple palette, realistic skin detail, luxe sci-fi fashion editorial energy, and a photoreal cinematic portrait aesthetic.

items.title: Scientific Neuron Anatomy Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed educational neuron infographic poster with a central 3D biological rendering and multiple labeled anatomical inset diagrams for textbook, editorial, or classroom use.
items.content: Create a highly detailed scientific anatomical poster of a {argument name="subject" default="neuron"} on a clean warm off-white paper background, presented as a museum-quality hybrid of 3D pencil drawing and ultra-realistic biological illustration. The composition centers on one large neuron in three-quarter view, with an oversized spherical purple nucleus inside a textured cell body, many branching dendrites spreading outward like winter tree branches, and a long axon extending diagonally down to the right. The axon is partially cut away to reveal its internal structure and is wrapped in segmented blue-gray myelin sheaths with visible gaps at the nodes of Ranvier. At the far end, the axon branches into exactly 15 thin terminal fibers, each ending in a rounded synaptic bulb with pale peach and pink tips. The main central figure should look sculptural, organic, and slightly glossy, with intricate membrane textures, subtle beige, ivory, silver, brown, and violet coloration, and extremely fine linework for the distal branches. Surround the centerpiece with 6 labeled educational inset sections arranged like a textbook infographic: top left a title block reading {argument name="title text" default="NEURON (NERVE CELL)"} with a short explanatory paragraph and a numbered structure list containing exactly 10 items; upper right a smaller monochrome full-neuron sketch labeled {argument name="style note" default="3D PENCIL DRAWING"}; lower left a cell body soma detail diagram with labels pointing to internal organelles; bottom left a myelin sheath cross-section cylinder diagram; lower center a square grayscale microscopic view panel with 4 labels; right center an electrical signal section with a small action potential graph showing membrane potential versus time; lower right a synapse close-up drawing with receptor and neurotransmitter labeling. Include fine serif typography, delicate leader lines, small circled numbers on the main neuron, and the feel of an elegant old scientific plate mixed with modern biomedical visualization. Keep the layout airy and balanced, with the central neuron dominating most of the canvas, landscape orientation, extremely high resolution, crisp educational poster design, and a refined neutral aesthetic.

items.title: VTuber Debut Poster from Character Sheet
items.description: This prompt turns a character reference sheet into a dramatic, text-heavy VTuber debut promotional poster for social thumbnails and announcement art.
items.content: Using the provided reference image as the character and design base, transform the clean Live2D model reference sheet into a polished VTuber debut announcement poster while keeping the same character design, hoodie, headphones, choker, star and constellation motifs, and overall purple-blue night palette. Change the composition from a full-body reference sheet to a dramatic upper-body key visual of the character seated at a streaming desk, one hand near the face, in a cozy nighttime bedroom-studio. Add a starry city-night window background, curtains, hanging star ornaments, glowing monitors, desk microphone, keyboard/controller, and a drink mug, with soft cinematic lighting and sparkly atmospheric effects. Preserve the branding of Yume Asta and make the layout feel like an X/Twitter thumbnail or promotional key visual. Add dense decorative typography and framed info panels in elegant Japanese idol/VTuber promo style: a large title with the Japanese name and romanized 'Yume Asta', a short poetic tagline, 4 boxed profile sections labeled 'Profile', 'Like', 'Keyword', and '配信スタイル', plus 1 smaller boxed hashtag/community section at the bottom left. Add a large glowing headline at the bottom center reading 'VTuber Debut' and 'Coming Soon', plus a ribbon-style banner beneath it with Japanese debut-stream text. Make it richly detailed, dreamy, luminous, and premium, like an official VTuber debut teaser poster.

items.title: Urban Graffiti Hoodie Fashion Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic full-body streetwear portrait of a young woman in an oversized hoodie posing against a colorful graffiti wall, ideal for urban fashion and nightlife-themed AI imagery.
items.content: A moody full-body fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing in a narrow urban alley or tunnel covered in dense colorful graffiti, photographed at night with dramatic low-key lighting and flash-lit realism. She is leaning casually against the wall with 1 hand touching a large pair of over-ear black headphones and 1 hand tucked into the front pocket of an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="mustard yellow"} hoodie. The hoodie is long enough to read almost like a hoodie dress and has a simple black smiley-face graphic centered on the chest with white drawstrings. She wears a black backpack with 2 visible shoulder straps, white crew socks, and chunky black-and-white low-top sneakers. Her legs are bare, and her pose is relaxed with one knee slightly bent and one foot set forward. Her hair is shoulder-length, slightly messy, and {argument name="hair color" default="dark blonde"}. Compose the shot vertically from head to shoes, with the subject centered slightly left of frame. The background is a gritty painted wall dominated by turquoise blue, yellow, pink, and black spray paint, with drips, tags, and abstract cartoon-like graffiti shapes creating a raw street-art atmosphere. The floor is dark, worn, and reflective with paint splatters. Use high contrast, deep shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, editorial streetwear photography style, underground urban vibe, sharp focus on clothing and body, subdued facial detail, and a cinematic dark nightlife mood.

items.title: Fake Apple CEO Announcement Poster
items.description: A photorealistic Chinese Apple-style corporate announcement poster designed for viral AI-generated tech satire or speculative branding visuals.
items.content: A sleek, photorealistic Chinese tech-announcement poster in Apple advertising style, vertical 4:5 composition, with a dramatic dusk-to-night gradient sky in deep navy blue fading lighter near the horizon. Center the upper body of a middle-aged East Asian man in the foreground, wearing a minimalist black button-up shirt over a black undershirt, standing confidently with a calm executive posture in front of Apple Park’s curved glass architecture. His face is mostly front-facing and slightly turned, with short black hair and thin dark eyeglasses, styled like a serious corporate portrait. Behind him on the right side, place a large glowing white Apple logo floating against the sky. At the very top center, include a small white Apple logo with the Chinese line “Apple 新篇章 由此开启” in a refined thin sans-serif layout. In the top right corner, add large bold red Chinese text: “AI生成”. Across the upper-middle area, place a huge bold white Chinese headline: “罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO”. Directly below it, add a smaller spaced-out white Chinese slogan: “用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”. On the left middle area, add a quoted statement block in dark text with an oversized opening quotation mark, reading: “我不是来改变 Apple， 而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。” and beneath it a handwritten-style signature “罗永浩”. Across the lower middle, overlay a translucent dark horizontal feature bar containing exactly 4 icon-and-text columns with thin white line icons: 1) a hammer icon with the title “工匠精神” and subtitle “极致产品主义”, 2) a speech bubble icon with the title “用户至上” and subtitle “体验细节控”, 3) a light bulb icon with the title “创新驱动” and subtitle “重新定义未来”, 4) a heart outline icon with the title “真诚沟通” and subtitle “打造人的科技”. At the very bottom center, add large white English text: “Think Different. Think Again.”, and below it smaller Chinese text: “现在，交给罗永浩。” with another handwritten signature underneath. Use luxury tech keynote poster aesthetics, cinematic soft lighting, glossy reflections on the building, high contrast, clean typography, premium Apple-inspired branding, polished commercial realism.

items.title: Cross-Strait Dialogue Editorial Illustration
items.description: A symbolic editorial-style illustration showing two anonymized people discussing across a table with scales and speech bubbles, suitable for articles about cross-strait relations, negotiation, and public discourse.
items.content: A minimalist editorial illustration about cross-strait relations and dialogue, in a muted flat-paper collage style with soft grain texture and rounded shapes. Show 2 human figures seated across a table in profile, facing each other: on the left a man in dark desaturated blue, resting his chin on one hand in a thoughtful pose; on the right a woman in warm brown, gesturing with one hand as if explaining. Both faces are intentionally anonymized with soft blurred rectangular blocks over the facial area. Centered between them is a dark blue balance scale, upright and symmetrical, symbolizing justice, negotiation, and equilibrium. Above the figures are 2 overlapping speech bubbles, one blue-gray on the left and one pale beige on the right, indicating conversation and contested viewpoints. At the bottom center, place 1 white silhouette of a human head in side profile containing a simple growing plant with stem and leaves, symbolizing peace, understanding, or constructive thinking. Use a cream background with 4 large translucent abstract circular forms around the composition, including a pale gray shape on the far left, a beige shape behind the upper center-right, a warm tan shape on the far right, and a darker blue-gray semicircular shape along the bottom foreground. Keep the composition balanced, calm, symbolic, and poster-like, with no text, no sharp outlines, no photorealism, and a subdued palette of dusty blue, slate, beige, cream, and brown.

items.title: Anime AI Studio Girls at Sunset
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed anime-style group scene of five stylish women in a warm startup studio surrounded by AI-themed devices, notes, and branding, ideal for editorial or social-media artwork.
items.content: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a cozy creative studio at golden hour, showing 5 young women gathered around a cluttered wooden worktable, lit by warm sunset light through large windows, hanging pendant lamps, and string lights. The mood is stylish, intelligent, playful, and slightly chaotic, like a startup loft mixed with an artist workspace. In the left foreground, a tall woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy auburn"} hair wears a white daisy flower crown and a sleeveless rust-red dress with a belt; she stands closest to camera and holds up a handwritten paper sign that reads exactly: {argument name="sign text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}, with a small heart doodle. Behind and to the right of her stands a second woman with platinum-blonde twin ponytails, a black gothic mini dress, black thigh-high stockings, and large headphones around her neck; she poses confidently with one hand on her hip near an open laptop covered in stickers, prominently featuring a large X logo. In the center background stands a petite girl with very long straight black hair and a dark navy dress, reserved and quiet, positioned in front of a wide monitor displaying a glowing Gemini star logo on a dark screen. To the right of center, a glamorous woman with a short black bob and earrings leans over the desk in a fitted red floral cheongsam-style dress, looking toward the papers and laptops. On the far right, a fifth woman with messy light-brown hair in a loose bun wears an oversized open shirt over a cropped white T-shirt with the OpenAI knot logo and casual pants, leaning over the table with one hand braced on the surface and the other near a drawing tablet. The room should contain 2 laptops visible on the desk, 1 central monitor, 3 mugs, 2 sticky notes, 1 paper sign, 1 notebook page titled "Plans", and many scattered creative objects like pens, cables, books, papers, and cans. The first laptop is covered with stickers including a large X logo; the second laptop has an OpenAI logo. The desk includes a black mug with a moon-and-text design, a white mug that says "Good answer takes time.", a white cup with an orange sunburst logo, an energy-drink can, a clear plastic drink cup, a closed notebook, loose handwritten notes, and a tablet on the far right. One sticky note says "You got this" with a heart, and another says "One step at a time" with a tiny flower. The notebook page on the desk reads "Plans" and lists 3 items: "1. World peace", "2. More coffee", "3. Nap", with a small cat doodle. The environment should include bookshelves, framed prints, potted plants, warm wood textures, and wall decor with visible posters and signs, including "Anthropic", "Kindness intelligence", "DO GOOD BUILD COOL SHIT", and a neon-style sign that says "focus fuel". Use cinematic composition, rich amber and sepia tones, intricate linework, soft painterly shading, detailed fabrics and hair, subtle glow on screens, and a polished modern anime illustration aesthetic. No blur, no distortion, no extra people, and no duplicated objects.

items.title: Cinematic City Crash Explosion
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic disaster-movie street scene with a fleeing man, flipping cars, and multiple explosions, useful for dramatic action artwork or AI image model comparisons.
items.content: A cinematic ultra-realistic action scene on a rain-soaked urban street at dusk, showing a sudden multi-car crash and explosion in the middle of a modern city. In the foreground, one adult man with a blurred, indistinct face is running toward the camera between lanes, wearing a dark jacket and dark pants, his posture urgent and off-balance as if escaping danger. To his left is a dark gray sedan with headlights on, splashing through wet pavement. In the midground on the right, 2 wrecked cars are colliding: 1 silver sedan with its driver-side door open and 1 dark vehicle flipping upside down in midair, surrounded by shattered glass, torn metal, and flying debris. Count 2 visible fireballs in the background, one on the far left street and one large explosion on the right side, both sending sparks and black smoke into the sky. Show heavy smoke plumes rising above a dense downtown skyline of tall, slightly out-of-focus buildings. Include wet reflective asphalt, scattered car parts across the road, glowing streetlights, utility poles, overhead power lines, and a moody blue-gray storm atmosphere with orange firelight reflecting in puddles. Framing should be wide-angle and low to the street, with strong motion, dramatic perspective, cinematic depth of field, realistic physics, volumetric smoke, flying embers, and high-detail disaster-movie lighting. Add a white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} watermark in the top-right corner.

items.title: Seaside Cafe Event Poster
items.description: A vibrant Chinese promotional poster for a casual seaside coffee meetup, useful for social event announcements, community gatherings, and lifestyle marketing.
items.content:
Create a lively Chinese event poster with a warm, trendy coffee-shop aesthetic, photographed from inside a seaside cafe looking out through large floor-to-ceiling windows at palm trees, a bright blue sky, outdoor seating, and a Ferris wheel in the distance. The composition should feel like a candid lifestyle scene combined with energetic graphic design. In the foreground, place a dark wooden table with 1 open laptop centered near the bottom, 1 takeaway coffee cup with a black lid on the right side of the table, 1 black bag on the left, and 1 short stack of books near the left edge. Use a sunlit, slightly golden afternoon atmosphere with reflections on the glass and a relaxed vacation vibe.

Overlay bold poster graphics in a collage style using torn paper, brushstroke paint, stickers, and taped note-paper elements. The main headline on the upper left should be huge, hand-painted Chinese calligraphy in dark brown and orange, reading “疯狂星期四”, with a small yellow tag near it that reads “第11期”, and an even smaller top-left badge reading “活动预告” with a tiny megaphone icon. Beneath the main headline, add a green brushstroke banner with the text “下周四，不见不散！”, and below that a smaller line in parentheses: “（五一长假前最后一期）”.

Add 2 torn notebook-paper cards: 1 in the upper right and 1 in the lower left. The upper-right note should contain a short invitation paragraph in Chinese, neatly typeset in black and orange text, reading: “让我们海边小聚，远眺摩天轮，吹吹海风，和 App & AI Builder 们一起聊聊产品、远程生活与创作。” and include a small orange heart doodle in the bottom-right corner of that note. The lower-left note should list 3 info blocks with icons and orange section headers: “时间”, “地点”, and “说明”. Under “时间”, write “2026年04月23日 (星期四)” and “12:00 ~ 18:00”. Under “地点”, write “南山区·前海石公园·福叁咖啡”. Under “说明”, write “无需报名，随时来吧！”.

Across the middle-right area, place a large playful white script-style slogan with a dark outline, angled slightly upward, reading “喝咖啡、随意交流 海边散步，主打一个 Chill~”. Add 1 illustrated coffee cup sticker next to this slogan on the right. Use energetic orange paint splashes and sketch doodles around the headline and notes to make the poster feel youthful and spontaneous.

At the bottom, place a wide off-white torn-paper footer strip containing 3 feature blocks laid out horizontally. Block 1: a snowflake-like icon with the text “舒适环境” and smaller text “空调 + 宽敞桌椅”. Block 2: a Wi‑Fi icon with the text “电网无忧” and smaller text “WiFi + 插座”. Block 3: larger orange handwritten text “期待与你 海边相遇！” with a blue underline flourish and a tiny heart doodle. The overall design should mix real photography and graphic poster elements, with strong contrast, brush lettering, scrapbook textures, cafe lifestyle realism, and a fashionable AI-generated social-media event-poster look.

items.title: Teddy Bear Mona Lisa Hybrid
items.description: A whimsical surreal fine-art parody that turns the Mona Lisa into a teddy-bear hybrid portrait, useful for meme-like art, concept exploration, or playful classical remix imagery.
items.content: A surreal oil painting in the style of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, reimagined as a teddy-bear hybrid portrait. The subject sits in the same half-length frontal pose with folded hands, wearing the dark Renaissance dress and soft draped shawl of the original painting, against the classic hazy landscape with winding water, distant mountains, and muted atmospheric perspective. The figure has 2 round fluffy teddy bear ears on top of the head and 2 plush furry paws folded at the bottom, with a warm beige teddy-bear fur chest replacing the visible skin of the neckline and hands. Long dark brown hair falls smoothly over both shoulders. The face area is intentionally left as a flat featureless brown rectangular block, creating an uncanny censored or unfinished effect. Use cracked varnish texture, aged museum-painting patina, smoky sfumato transitions, low-saturation brown and olive tones, soft golden lighting, centered composition, highly detailed fur texture blended into classical portrait brushwork, whimsical yet eerie fine-art parody.

items.description: This prompt generates a whimsical fine-art parody of a Vermeer-style portrait featuring a teddy bear, ideal for playful museum-inspired AI art.
items.content: A classical oil painting in the style of a 17th-century Dutch master, closely inspired by Vermeer’s composition, showing a teddy bear posed as the subject of a formal portrait. It has soft golden-brown plush fur, one rounded fuzzy ear clearly visible and the other partially visible beneath a large blue-and-gold turban wrapped around its head, with a long fabric tail draping down the right side. The bear wears a single oversized pearl earring hanging from the visible ear area, echoing the iconic “girl with a pearl earring” look. The clothing includes 2 visible garments: a warm golden-brown robe or coat and a small white collar at the neckline. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the left, rich painterly texture, subtle canvas grain, realistic fabric folds, gentle highlights on the pearl, and a museum-quality old master atmosphere. Keep the composition simple, centered, and elegant, with the teddy bear’s face rendered as a plush toy version of a noble portrait subject, blending cute toy texture with fine-art realism.

items.title: Teddy Bear Creation Fresco
items.description: A humorous Renaissance-style parody image of The Creation of Adam in which teddy bears replace every figure, ideal for whimsical art prompts and viral social-media visuals.
items.content: A whimsical high-detail oil-painting parody of Michelangelo’s Creation of Adam, but all human figures are replaced by teddy bears. On the left, a single plush teddy bear sits reclined on a rocky slope, posed like Adam, with soft golden-brown curly fur, round ears, shiny black eyes, a small dark nose, and a slightly open mouth. Its left arm supports its body while its right arm stretches outward, index paw extended toward the other bear. On the right, a larger central teddy bear posed like God emerges from a deep reddish-burgundy swirling mantle, wearing a flowing white draped robe, leaning forward with one outstretched arm and pointed paw reaching toward the left bear, almost touching fingertips. Surrounding the robed bear inside the mantle are 8 additional smaller teddy bears clustered tightly together, peeking from different angles like attendant figures. The composition exactly echoes the iconic near-touching hands scene, with the gap between fingertips centered. Use a cracked fresco wall background in warm beige tones, muted Renaissance palette, soft directional light, realistic fabric folds, detailed plush texture, subtle shadows, and a museum-quality painted surface. Blend classical Renaissance fresco aesthetics with charming surreal humor, keeping the scene elegant rather than cartoonish.

items.title: Teddy Bear Last Supper
items.description: A detailed old-master parody image of The Last Supper rendered with 13 teddy bears, ideal for whimsical fine-art homage and surreal meme-style illustration.
items.content: A whimsical yet reverent Renaissance-style parody of The Last Supper, with exactly 13 anthropomorphic teddy bears seated along one side of a long banquet table in a grand classical dining hall. The central bear is the clear focal point, posed like Jesus, facing forward with a calm, solemn expression, wearing a muted red robe with a deep blue drape. The other 12 teddy bears cluster in animated conversational groups to the left and right, each with slightly different fur tones from honey brown to cream, all with soft plush texture, rounded ears, black bead-like eyes, and expressive paws raised in discussion. Dress the surrounding bears in painterly biblical robes in earthy reds, dusty blues, ochres, and greens. Recreate the composition closely to Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper: symmetrical perspective, coffered wooden ceiling, three rear windows with soft blue mountain landscape visible outside, dark wall tapestries on both side walls, and a long white tablecloth hanging over trestle supports. On the table, include scattered small bread rolls, plates, bowls, and multiple small glasses of dark red wine spaced across the full length. Use warm museum-like lighting, aged fresco tones, soft shadows, detailed oil-paint texture, and a highly polished old-master look, balancing humor with genuine artistic beauty. No modern objects, no text, no extra characters, straight-on wide composition, full table visible.
