items.title: Cute Chinese Tokenization Infographic
items.description: This prompt generates a pastel hand-drawn horizontal Chinese educational infographic explaining four tokenization methods with a Shiba Inu teacher and a blue token mascot, ideal for social media science posts.
items.content: A cute hand-drawn scrapbook-style horizontal educational infographic in Chinese on a warm beige paper background with rounded borders, pastel doodles, tape stickers, tiny stars, and a classroom-notebook aesthetic. The top center has a large headline in playful handwritten Chinese: "什么是分词？" with the second half in coral pink and the rest in dark brown. On the upper left, a chibi Shiba Inu teacher character stands facing forward, wearing a pale yellow shirt and blue necktie, holding a pointer stick upward, with a speech bubble that says "今天来学习分词(Tokenization)!". On the upper right, a cute blue square token mascot labeled "TOKEN" sits smiling, with blush cheeks, tiny legs and arms, and a magnifying glass; next to it is a speech bubble saying "我是 Token！被切得越合理，模型越聪明！". Near the right edge, add a small hanging notepad card reading "知识点 收藏夹" with a heart icon. Beneath the headline, place a rounded dashed text box containing the definition: "分词是将人类可读的文本切分成 Token 的过程。" with the word "Token" highlighted in blue. Below that, add a line of explanatory text: "下面以 “程序员Left” 和 “人工智能” 为例，看看不同的分词方式：" with "程序员Left" highlighted in light blue and "人工智能" highlighted in pink. The lower half contains exactly 4 rounded pastel panels arranged left to right, each with a numbered badge and title. Panel 1 is mint green and titled "1 词级分词". It includes the subtitle "按完整语义划分文本" and exactly 3 token bubbles: "程序员", "Left", "人工智能". At the bottom of this panel, show the Shiba Inu teacher giving a thumbs up with a speech bubble saying "语义完整，容易理解！". Panel 2 is pale yellow and titled "2 字符级分词". It includes the subtitle "逐字切分文本" and exactly 9 circular token bubbles arranged in rows: "程", "序", "员", "L", "e", "f", "t", "人", "工", "智", "能"—visually presented as individual characters from the example text, in a compact grid. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot holding a pencil, with a speech bubble saying "粒度最细，但序列会很长~". Panel 3 is pale pink and titled "3 子词分词". It includes the subtitle "按词根以及前后缀划分" and exactly 5 token bubbles: "程序", "员", "Left", "人工", "智能". At the bottom, show the Shiba Inu teacher thinking with one paw at its mouth and a question mark above the head, with a speech bubble saying "折中方案，效果 often 很好！". Panel 4 is pale blue and titled "4 字节级分词". It includes the subtitle "将字词转为字节编码，根据转换后的内容进行组合和划分" and displays exactly 14 small circular code bubbles: "E7", "A8", "8B", "...", "66", "74", "E4", "BA", "BA", "E8", "83", "BD", "..." arranged in multiple rows like encoded bytes. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot again, smiling, with a speech bubble saying "适合处理任意文本！" and a tiny light bulb doodle nearby. Across the very bottom, place a rounded banner note that reads: "不同分词方式各有优势，实际应用中会根据任务和数据选择合适的方案哦！". Use soft pastel green, yellow, pink, and blue for the four panels, dark brown handwritten text, subtle shadows, rounded shapes, and adorable kawaii expressions throughout. Keep the composition balanced, clean, and friendly, like a polished social-media science explainer poster.

items.title: Scrapbook Byte-level BPE Explainer
items.description: This prompt generates a wide hand-drawn educational infographic with cute mascot characters to explain byte-level BPE tokenization in a friendly Chinese science-pop style.
items.content: A cute horizontal educational infographic in a hand-drawn scrapbook style on a pastel desk-and-paper collage background, explaining Chinese word segmentation with byte-level BPE. The scene is divided into 3 clearly separated instructional sections arranged from left to right across a wide banner. On the far left stands a chibi Shiba Inu mascot, {argument name="character name" default="柴小七"}, with warm tan and cream fur, round face, small triangular ears, rosy cheeks, and a curious expression, holding a cup and standing beside a small desk with drawers, pencils, and a chair. Above the dog is a bold rounded white title box with black Chinese text: {argument name="headline text" default="中文分词：Byte-level BPE（BBPE）流程科普"}. In the first teaching section near the upper middle, show 4 small translucent blue token-shaped tiles lined up on a wooden shelf, each labeled “Token”, with a curved arrow and small handwritten Chinese note “词频语料统计” pointing toward the next step. In the second section, place a large magnifying glass highlighting 3 small frequency tiles labeled exactly “E7”, “94”, and “B5”, with the section label in a yellow note reading “2. 频率统计与合并”; beneath and inside the magnified area include a large black Chinese character “电”, and nearby a handwritten note “频繁字节对”. In the third section at lower middle-left, add a wooden sign and a larger merged translucent blue token tile labeled “Token”, with a small yellow note reading “3. 跨字合并”, large black Chinese text “我们→”, and a caption strip below that says “高频词组合并为 Token”. On the far right, show the final explanatory result with 3 small byte boxes labeled “E7”, “94”, and “B5” above a large black Chinese character “电”, then a note card reading “1. 字节级编码（UTF-8）”, and below that the large black Chinese word “我们”. Connect the sections with curved arrows in pink, blue, and green to show process flow. Include 1 animated blue token mascot with tiny arms and legs near the center-bottom, smiling and waving. Use soft cream, pink, beige, and light blue colors, thick clean outlines, sticker-like cutout shapes, taped paper corners, notebook textures, pencils around the edges, and a friendly hand-account illustration style suitable for a science explainer graphic.

items.title: Celestial Dynasty World Bible Board
items.description: This prompt turns one reference scene into a complete fantasy civilization pitch board with architecture, characters, costumes, vehicles, map, environments, and cultural details for concept development or franchise worldbuilding.
items.content: Using REFERENCE_0 as the visual foundation, expand the single sky-palace scene into a complete cinematic world-building presentation for a fantasy civilization. Preserve the same East Asian celestial imperial design language, floating architecture above clouds, gilded ornamentation, warm sunset lighting, and ultra-detailed realistic concept-art look, then turn it into a polished multi-panel lore board on a dark background with elegant editorial typography. Include 8 labeled sections: 1 large hero overview panel for the civilization, 1 architecture section with 9 images, 1 characters section with 7 full-body character designs, 1 clothing and armor section with 6 outfit variations, 1 vehicles and transport section with 4 vehicle designs, 1 world map section with 1 illustrated map, 1 environments section with 6 environment images, and 1 culture and details section with 6 close-up detail images. Add a refined fantasy title and short lore paragraph for the civilization, using the name {argument name="civilization name" default="Celestial Dynasty"}. The architecture section should show 9 distinct items: palace, temple, gate, pillar, bridge, throne hall, garden, library, and observatory. The characters section should show 7 archetypes: emperor, empress, high priest, general, royal guard, scholar, and artisan. The clothing and armor section should show 6 designs: ceremonial robe, battle armor, noble attire, priest robes, artisan garments, and dancer costume. The vehicles and transport section should show 4 designs: an airship, a flying beast mount, a sky chariot, and a ceremonial palanquin. The environments section should show 6 scenes: one wide banner panorama plus 5 smaller locations, including forest, mountain peaks, lotus valley, golden fields, and a celestial port. The culture and details section should show 6 images: dragon motif, lantern or artifact, palace interior, scholarly scene, mechanical instruments, and decorative symbols. Keep all panels visually unified as if from one official franchise world bible, with extremely rich detail, believable material design, and cinematic realism.

items.title: Reference-Based Cinematic World Expansion
items.description: This prompt turns a single reference scene into a new but stylistically consistent cinematic worldbuilding image, useful for expanding a concept into broader settings for films, games, or visual development.
items.content: Using the provided reference image as the visual civilization seed, expand it into a new cinematic world scene that keeps the same grand East Asian fantasy design language, monumental scale, intricate architecture-first worldbuilding, and ultra-detailed realism, but shift the setting from a luminous cloud palace into an ancient mechanical ruin on the ground. Replace the gilded celestial temple environment with colossal circular ring structures, giant embedded gears, heavy industrial stone-and-metal architecture, broken conduits, and overgrown ruins with pale flowering trees. Change the mood to cold, misty, desaturated blue-gray lighting with soft atmospheric fog, while preserving the epic, awe-inspiring worldbuilding feel from the reference. Add 1 lone wandering swordsman seen from behind in the foreground, wearing flowing white robes and carrying a sheathed sword, centered beneath the largest ring to emphasize scale. Make it feel like a frame from a high-budget fantasy film, with extremely rich environmental detail and a cohesive visual language derived from the reference image.

items.title: Isometric Coastal Base Under Naval Attack
items.description: This generates a detailed RTS-style isometric battle scene of a walled desert coast base being bombarded by missile-firing warships, ideal for game concept art or cinematic strategy illustrations.
items.content: An isometric real-time-strategy game battle scene viewed from a high oblique angle, showing a fortified coastal military outpost under naval attack in a desert oasis environment. The base sits in the lower left and center foreground, enclosed by pale concrete walls with defensive corner towers and several cylindrical turret emplacements. Inside the compound are 5 major structures: a large central metallic command or factory building with a curved roof and landing-pad markings, 1 long segmented industrial generator on the left, 1 smaller smokestack power structure near the bottom center, and 2 green cylindrical reactor or storage buildings on the right. Show dirt tracks, scattered crates, utility details, and a paved gray yard inside the walls. A large orange fireball explosion is erupting inside the base near the right-center interior, with smoke and debris. Another smaller explosion is happening outside the walls at the upper left on a dirt road near 2 red ground vehicles or launchers, with black smoke rising. The shoreline curves around shallow blue-green water with sandy banks, rocky cliffs, and many palm trees, creating a tropical desert cove. In the water on the right side, depict 5 gray modern warships in formation, angled diagonally, each leaving white wakes as they move. Count 8 missiles total with bright flaming trails arcing from the ships toward the land and base defenses; one missile is striking the nearest ship-side target area with a bright blue-white impact flash over the waterline, while others arc toward the compound and shore. Include tiny infantry figures near the beach and walls, some fallen, to suggest an active assault. The style should look like a polished high-detail strategy game screenshot, with realistic military sci-fi architecture, cinematic lighting, sharp textures, dynamic explosions, and readable spatial depth.

items.title: First-Person Tropical Island Warzone
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic first-person military battle scene on a tropical coastal base, ideal for FPS game key art or cinematic action visuals.
items.content: A cinematic first-person modern military battle on a tropical island coastline, viewed from the perspective of a soldier holding a black assault rifle in both hands at the lower right foreground, with dark tactical gloves visible. The scene shows a fortified coastal base under attack in bright midday sunlight beneath a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground and midground, depict a rugged dirt path with dry grass, scattered debris, crates, and metal barrels leading into a compact military installation made of futuristic-industrial bunkers and machinery painted olive green and gray. Include 5 prominent base structures: a rounded bunker with a small dome on the far left, a cylindrical tower just right of it, a large central arched hangar-like bunker with a dark entrance, 1 squat turreted structure on the right midground, and 1 stone-and-metal defensive wall section at the far right front. In the center midground, show 1 major ground explosion with orange fire and black smoke, plus 1 tall vertical smoke plume rising behind the base near the cliffs. The background features rocky cliffs lined with many palm trees and a small waterfall descending near the center-left, with the ocean and horizon visible to the right. Over the water, show 4 large gray battleships grouped near the coast on the right side. In the sky, include 3 helicopters, 4 smaller aircraft or drones in the distance, and 5 visible missile or rocket trails streaking diagonally across the sky from right to left, emphasizing an active large-scale assault. Ultra-detailed photorealistic AAA video game key art, realistic lighting, sharp textures, cinematic action composition, wide-angle first-person shooter viewpoint, high contrast, dynamic war atmosphere, epic scale.

items.title: Chinese Tomato Nutrition Poster
items.description: A polished Chinese produce advertisement showing fresh tomatoes with nutritional callouts and a bottom nutrition table, ideal for grocery, packaging, or food marketing visuals.
items.content:
A clean premium food advertisement poster on a light gray-white studio background, featuring {argument name="fruit name" default="tomatoes"} as the hero subject. In the center, show exactly 7 tomato pieces arranged on a shallow round wooden plate: 5 whole ripe red tomatoes stacked in a natural pyramid, 1 halved tomato standing upright at the front center with glossy flesh and visible seeds, and 1 wedge slice placed at the lower right foreground. The tomatoes are fresh, vivid red, covered with realistic water droplets, with green stems attached to most whole fruits. Add a few green leaves and two small yellow tomato blossoms near the lower right edge for freshness accents. Use soft commercial lighting, gentle shadows, sharp focus, and highly realistic texture, in a polished supermarket-poster style.

Design the layout as a Chinese nutrition and freshness infographic poster. In the upper left, place a large two-line Chinese headline with strong typographic hierarchy: the first line in black reads {argument name="headline line 1" default="自然成熟"}, the second line in large warm red reads {argument name="headline line 2" default="营养美味"}. Below it, add a smaller gray Chinese slogan: {argument name="slogan text" default="每一口都是大自然的馈赠"}. Under the slogan, place exactly 3 simple red line icons in a horizontal row with short Chinese labels and gray sublabels beneath each: 1) a sun icon with text "充足日照" and subtext "自然成熟", 2) a sprout or leaf icon with text "科学种植" and subtext "健康美味", 3) a heart outline icon with text "新鲜采摘" and subtext "产地直供".

On the right side, create a thin curved red guide line framing the tomatoes, with exactly 4 circular nutrient callouts stacked vertically from top to bottom. Each callout is a red or red-orange gradient circle with a white symbol or letter inside, connected to the curve. Use these Chinese labels and explanatory text: 1) top callout with "C" and title "富含维生素C", description "有助于增强免疫力 促进胶原蛋白合成"; 2) second callout with a molecular icon and title "番茄红素", description "强效抗氧化剂 有助于抵御自由基"; 3) third callout with a leaf icon and title "膳食纤维", description "促进肠道蠕动 帮助消化"; 4) bottom callout with "K" and title "钾元素", description "有助于维持 心脏健康".

On the left lower side of the tomatoes, add exactly 2 red text feature callouts with fine red leader lines: the upper one titled "美味多汁" with smaller gray text "果肉饱满，汁水丰富 酸甜可口，回味无穷"; the lower one titled "新鲜采摘" with smaller gray text "人工精选，严格挑选 确保每一颗都新鲜优质".

Across the bottom, place a rounded rectangular nutrition table bar in white with light gray dividers. On the left end, add a solid red rounded label block containing the Chinese title {argument name="table title" default="营养成分表（每100g含量）"}. To its right, show exactly 6 nutrient columns with gray headings and darker values beneath: "能量" "20kcal"; "蛋白质" "0.9g"; "脂肪" "0.2g"; "碳水化合物" "4.2g"; "维生素C" "14mg"; "钾" "179mg". Center a tiny gray footnote below the table: "* 数据来源于《中国食物成分表》". Overall style: elegant Chinese fresh-produce marketing poster, balanced whitespace, red-accented infographic design, realistic product photography blended with clean vector UI elements.

items.title: Chinese Cooking Cognition Infographic
items.description: A retro comic-style Chinese infographic illustrating the shift from intuition-based cooking to recipe-driven, tool-augmented cooking, suitable for articles or social posts about AI, workflows, and externalized cognition.
items.content: A vintage hand-drawn Chinese infographic on textured off-white paper with torn deckled edges, printed in a limited two-ink palette of deep purple and bright cyan accents, with halftone shading and poster-like comic line art. The composition compares intuitive manual cooking versus tool-assisted cooking and externalized cognition. On the left, a large adult cook in an apron is dramatically stir-frying in a wok with flames, flying ingredients, smoke swirls, and energetic motion lines; the cook’s face is obscured by a rectangular blur block. Above the head is a glowing brain-like thought bubble containing 3 small icons: a seasoning bottle, a flame, and a timer/clock, with rays radiating outward. At the lower left, a broken chain hangs beside large bold Chinese text reading “全凭手感”. Below the cook, a smaller confused person mixing in a bowl looks worried, surrounded by exactly 4 question marks. In the center, multiple thick arrows point from the cook’s intuition toward a structured cooking workflow. At upper center is large Chinese text “照着做”. Beneath it, a hand holds a smartphone recipe screen showing visible Chinese text including “5克盐” and “中火3分钟”, with a finger tapping the screen. Around the phone are measured cooking tools and ingredients: 2 measuring spoons, 1 measuring cup, 1 digital scale, and 6 small bowls arranged neatly, plus a pot on a stove with steam rising and a finished plated dish nearby. Near the plated dish is Chinese text “七八分” and a 5-star rating row with exactly 4 filled stars and 1 empty star. On the right, show a concept map of externalized cognition around a simple smiling stick-figure cook standing behind a table of food. The node network is connected with cyan lines and includes exactly 6 tool/info nodes: a smart oven at the top, 2 seasoning packets labeled “调料包” and “榨酱包”, 1 clipboard labeled “精准配方”, 1 blender, 1 rice cooker, and 1 recipe note sheet. Centered in this network is large Chinese text “认知外化”. The table in front of the figure holds exactly 5 dishes/bowls/plates of prepared food. Along the bottom is a simplified cognition equation: a large brain icon, then an arrow to a smaller brain icon, then a cluster of external tools/documents including a phone screen, a microwave-like appliance, and 3 paper/manual items, then an equals sign, then a muscular human silhouette with gears inside the torso and an upward arrow near the shoulder. Beneath or beside this equation is bold Chinese text “脑 + 外部工具 = 更强能力”, with the first “脑” also shown separately under the left brain icon. Use expressive sketched arrows, doodle lightning bolts, comic emphasis marks, and a balanced left-to-right flow that visually communicates the transition from pure instinct to repeatable systems and augmented ability.

items.title: Dark Chinese Fantasy Desire Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical Chinese mythic poster with giant calligraphy, a lone seeker climbing toward a radiant relic, and symbolic stone inscriptions for use as concept art or literary poster imagery.
items.content: A dark epic Chinese fantasy poster centered on the single gold calligraphy character {argument name="main Chinese character" default="欲"} dominating the upper left, rendered in huge textured brushed gold ink with rough edges and metallic leaf-like highlights. The scene is a cavernous infernal passage in deep black, bronze, and molten amber tones, lit by a blinding sacred glow at the top of a long stone staircase. At the top center-right stands an ornate golden lotus lamp or ritual chalice radiating holy light like a sun halo. In the lower center, show 1 lone ragged human figure from behind, slim and exhausted, wearing tattered dark robes shredded by the wind, reaching one arm upward toward the light while standing on a cracked stone path that becomes stairs. Flowing through the composition are 6 visible crimson silk ribbons or smoke-like fabric strands curling dramatically from left, right, and foreground, adding motion. Carve or inscribe 5 clearly visible Chinese characters onto broken stone slabs along the path and lower foreground: 情, 贪, 嗔, 痴, 慢, each glowing faintly in warm gold. Build the cave walls from writhing organic rock and shadow, with 3 large ghostly human faces emerging from the stone on the left and right sides, as if embodiments of temptation and suffering. Include 2 monstrous clawed hands reaching inward from the lower right toward the traveler. On the left side beneath the large title character, place 1 vertical block of elegant Chinese poem text in small gold calligraphy, plus 1 red seal stamp beside it. Along the bottom margin, add 1 horizontal line of small gold Chinese text with decorative dividers and the central highlighted character 心, plus 1 additional small red seal at the lower right. The overall style is cinematic, ultra-detailed, mythic, spiritual, and ominous, mixing Buddhist allegory, dark fantasy, and premium poster design; volumetric lighting, glowing dust, dramatic contrast, intricate brush typography, high detail, vertical composition.

items.title: Chinese Obsession Moonlit Fantasy
items.description: This prompt generates a moody ancient Chinese fantasy poster centered on a single calligraphy character, ideal for poetic concept art, book covers, or dramatic xianxia-themed visuals.
items.content: A dark, cinematic Chinese fantasy illustration inspired by the single character {argument name="Chinese character" default="痴"}, rendered as a poetic xianxia scene. Vertical composition. In the left foreground, a solitary young man with long black hair stands in three-quarter profile, wearing layered black robes with subtle embroidered patterns and hints of deep crimson inner fabric. His hair is partially tied into a traditional topknot with an ornate hairpiece and trailing red ribbons. He looks toward the distance with a melancholic, obsessed expression. In the upper right background, framed inside a glowing full moon or circular portal, a graceful woman in flowing white robes stands with her back turned, her long sleeves and red silk ribbons streaming in the wind, appearing ethereal and unreachable. The environment is a rocky, shadowed path at night, illuminated by moonlight and mist, with dramatic clouds, drifting pink flower petals, and arching branches of blooming cherry blossoms overhead. Thin red cords or fate-threads cross the composition diagonally, connecting space and emotion. Include 3 reflective mirror shards floating in the scene, each showing faint fragmented reflections of faces or figures, enhancing the sense of longing and fractured memory. In the upper left, place one large gold calligraphy character, {argument name="calligraphy text" default="痴"}, painted in expressive brush strokes, with a small red seal stamp beneath it and faint vertical calligraphy texture receding into the dark background. Use painterly detail, high contrast, soft atmospheric glow, rich black-red-gold palette, romantic tragedy, obsession, yearning, and dreamlike ancient Chinese aesthetic.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Dark Fantasy Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a moody ink-wash fantasy poster with a giant Chinese character, a solitary robed figure, pagodas, and shattered mirror fragments, ideal for atmospheric concept art or cover imagery.
items.content: A dark, cinematic Chinese ink-wash fantasy illustration centered on the large black calligraphy character "安" painted in bold expressive brushstrokes across a glowing full moon-like white disc in the background. In the lower center-right foreground, show 1 lone East Asian warrior-scholar figure in side profile facing left, with a loose messy topknot, stray windswept hair strands, and a long shredded black robe dissolving into smoke and ink. The figure feels solemn, ghostly, and dramatic, standing amid stormy mist and swirling black watercolor clouds. The palette is nearly monochrome charcoal, black, ash gray, and cold white, with very sparse deep crimson accents. Include 4 visible pagoda structures: 2 small distant pagodas on the right side, 1 pagoda reflected inside a large broken mirror shard at bottom left, and 1 taller pagoda near the upper right emerging from fog. Surround the composition with 5 prominent shattered glass or mirror fragments: 1 large triangular shard at bottom left, 1 tall shard near the upper center, 1 large vertical shard at upper right, 1 small hanging shard below it, and 1 large curved shard at bottom right, plus a few tiny splinters. In 1 shard near the left side, include the partial reflection of a human face. Add 1 red seal stamp with Chinese characters near the left side beneath the large calligraphy. Use splattered ink textures, torn paper-like edges, dripping red marks, and layered smoke to create an eerie wuxia-horror atmosphere. High contrast lighting, painterly mixed-media style, textured brushwork, poster-like composition, ultra-detailed, moody, mystical, and elegant.

items.title: Dreamy Kimono Woman by a Koi Pond
items.description: This prompt generates a romantic fantasy-style Japanese garden scene with a kimono-clad woman, koi pond, lotus flowers, and glowing twilight ambience for decorative illustration or wallpaper use.
items.content: A dreamy, romantic East Asian garden illustration at blue-hour twilight, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired fantasy style with soft glow and slightly abstract, heart-stirring atmosphere. In the right foreground, a graceful young woman in an elaborate traditional kimono sits demurely on worn stone steps beside a koi pond, holding a large wagasa paper umbrella above her shoulder. Her face is softly obscured and not sharply defined, keeping the mood poetic rather than portrait-realistic. Her hair is styled in a formal updo adorned with many pink cherry blossoms, dangling ornaments, and delicate hairpins. The kimono is pale icy blue with flowing layers and intricate patterns of orange koi fish, curling waves, and floral motifs; she wears white tabi socks and traditional sandals, and a patterned obi at her back. The umbrella is cream-colored with visible bamboo ribs and decorated with hanging crystal-like teardrop charms in pastel colors. The pond fills most of the scene, with exactly 10 blooming lotus flowers in pink, peach, and pale yellow, broad green lily pads, and exactly 9 visible koi fish in orange, white, black, and gold swimming in luminous swirling water. Tiny glowing fireflies and magical light specks float throughout the air and reflect on the pond surface. In the midground, an arched wooden bridge crosses the water. In the background, a serene Japanese garden extends with lush greenery, moss, shrubs, a stone lantern on the left, another warm garden lantern on the right, a small traditional pavilion with a dark tiled roof, and trees with red-orange autumn leaves mixed with deep green foliage. Add a few cherry blossom branches near the seated woman. Use cinematic composition, wide framing, rich color contrast between cool blue water and warm lantern light, delicate linework, painterly textures, reflective highlights, gentle depth haze, and an enchanting, elegant, slightly surreal mood.

items.content: A cinematic urban night street scene in heavy rain, viewed from a low street-level angle. In the foreground, 1 solitary pedestrian appears as a nearly black silhouette crossing left to right, mid-stride, holding 1 open umbrella overhead and wearing a dark coat with a backpack. The person’s face is obscured by shadow and backlighting. In the midground on the right, 1 city bus approaches with bright warm headlights and an amber LED route display, slightly blurred by rain and motion. On the far left, 1 pedestrian crossing signal glows red with a raised hand icon. The street is soaked with large reflective puddles, creating intense mirrored streaks of red, blue, orange, and white neon and traffic lights across the asphalt. Tall buildings line both sides of the street as a dense downtown corridor, with scattered illuminated signs and windows fading into a deep blue-black rainy atmosphere. Use a widescreen composition, with the silhouetted walker centered-left and the bus positioned mid-right.

The composition is vertical, warmly lit in amber and sepia tones, with dramatic side lighting, deep shadows, and ultra-detailed paper grain, skin texture, dust, and metallic reflections. On the upper left, the printed title text appears in elegant serif typography, with the author name below it and a short italic quote in smaller script beneath. The page transforms into a detailed map-like desert tableau with exactly 16 tiny human figures scattered across the scene: 1 lone standing figure balanced beside the pen nib, 3 figures near a small campfire, 2 central robed men in conversation, 3 figures gathered beside the biplane, 1 solitary figure walking near the lower middle, 2 riders on camels at the lower left, 3 standing figures near the truck at the lower right, and 1 tiny seated figure near the wreckage at the lower left. Include exactly 1 vintage biplane parked on the right with visible markings, exactly 1 old expedition truck at the bottom right, exactly 1 windsock near the center-right, exactly 1 desert oasis town with palm trees on the right, exactly 1 ruined sandcastle-like mound on the left, exactly 1 dark tent encampment on the left-center, exactly 1 wrecked engine or fuselage fragment in the lower left corner, and exactly 1 compass rose printed at the bottom left. The ink trail should branch through dunes and cracked earth like a route on an old map, connecting landmarks labeled with place names including {argument name="map label one" default="Tamanrasset"}, {argument name="map label two" default="Agadir"}, and {argument name="map label three" default="Dakar"}. Blend antique cartography, literary symbolism, and miniature diorama realism, evoking exploration, memory, loneliness, and the romance of early aviation.

items.title: Golden Wuxia Palace Poster
items.description: A lavish historical Chinese movie-poster prompt for generating an ensemble wuxia court drama image with one imperial man, eight women, ornate typography, and an epic palace backdrop.
items.content: A dramatic vintage Chinese martial-arts movie poster in a luxurious dark-gold and amber palette, styled like a classic historical epic. Center the composition on a young imperial man seated in front, wearing an ornate black-and-gold dragon robe and a Qing dynasty red-tasseled official hat, posed with one hand near his mouth in a sly, playful, confident manner. Surround him with exactly 8 beautiful court women in layered silk hanfu and gauzy robes, arranged tightly around him in a glamorous harem-like group portrait, with 4 women in the upper row and 4 women in the lower row. Each woman has an elegant updo with elaborate gold hairpins, floral ornaments, dangling earrings, and soft warm makeup; their expressions are alluring, gentle, or curious. Render the women in champagne, blush, peach, rose, and pale jade fabrics with translucent sleeves, embroidered bodices, and richly textured jewelry. Behind the group, place a large aged wooden plaque with carved golden Chinese calligraphy reading “鹿鼎记”, with a smaller line above it reading “金庸武侠经典”. Add vertical cast-name text in Chinese placed beside different figures: on the far left “苏荃”, below left “陈圆圆”, upper middle-left “阿珂”, upper middle-right “建宁公主”, far right upper “沐剑屏”, right middle “方怡”, lower right-middle “双儿”, and far lower right “曾柔”. Also add a vertical poetic slogan along the upper left margin in Chinese: “小人物，大智慧，游走江湖庙堂，玩转天下，抱得美人归”. At the bottom, blend in a secondary cinematic scene: an ancient palace gate and courtyard with soldiers and banners forming a grand processional crowd, with one lone figure centered in the foreground walking toward the viewer. Finish with a narrow line of Chinese tagline text across the bottom edge: “一部颠覆传统的英雄传奇 一段令人捧腹的江湖神话”. The whole image should feel opulent, theatrical, romantic, and slightly mischievous, with smoky sepia shadows, glowing rim light, rich texture, symmetrical poster composition, and polished high-end period-drama key art.

items.title: Anime Boxing Title Match Poster
items.description: A high-impact anime-style championship boxing poster for promoting a fictional premium fight event with two named rival fighters.
items.content: A dramatic Japanese boxing match poster in a polished anime illustration style, vertical composition, split straight down the center into warm gold on the left and electric blue on the right. At the very top, huge metallic gold embossed lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="JUNGLE PREMIUM Vol.7"}, with a bright glow and beveled 3D effect. Directly beneath it, centered white Japanese text reads "世界4団体フェザー級タイトルマッチ". Show 2 male featherweight boxers facing each other in fighting stance inside a boxing ring, both full body, highly muscular, lean, and sharply defined with glossy skin highlights. The left boxer is a blond anime-style young man with short tousled hair, wearing gold boxing gloves, black-and-gold trunks with a white-red accent on one leg, black boxing boots with gold laces, and a thick championship-style waistband patch reading "SEIJI". He stands on the gold side with explosive golden sparks and streaks surrounding him. The right boxer is a black-haired anime-style young man with short spiky hair, wearing bright blue boxing gloves, dark navy-blue trunks, blue boxing boots, white socks, and a waistband patch reading "JUNICHI". He stands on the blue side with swirling blue energy, light trails, and glowing particles. Place a circular championship belt emblem in the center background between them, with ring ropes visible behind, and the words "WORLD CHAMPION" legible on the belt medallion. Add 2 large faded portrait overlays in the background, one behind each boxer: the left background portrait tinted gold and the right background portrait tinted blue. Along the far left side, place bold vertical Japanese calligraphy reading "黄金の閃光" in glowing white-gold. Along the far right side, place bold vertical Japanese calligraphy reading "蒼き鉄拳" in glowing white-blue. At the bottom, feature 2 very large Japanese name blocks: left in gold reading "松浦聖司", right in icy blue-white reading "藤原潤一", with a blazing gold "VS" between them. Beneath that, centered large white date text reads {argument name="event date" default="7月19日(日)"}. At the very bottom, centered gold serif text reads {argument name="venue name" default="SUN BIRTH STADIUM"}. Use extreme contrast, cinematic arena lighting, energetic particle effects, premium sports-event poster design, glossy typography, and a heroic high-stakes championship atmosphere.

items.title: Antique Celestial Goddess Mural
items.description: This prompt generates a weathered blue-and-gold East Asian devotional mural featuring a central lotus-bearing celestial goddess with three attendants, ideal for sacred fantasy art or antique wall-scroll imagery.

author.name: 新清士@(生成AI)インディゲーム開発者

items.content: A richly detailed vertical mural in the style of an aged East Asian religious wall painting on weathered silk or plaster, with visible cracks, abrasions, faded pigment, and distressed gold leaf. At the center, a celestial bodhisattva-like goddess floats gracefully above a large pink lotus pedestal, framed by a huge circular golden halo filling the upper middle of the composition. She wears an elaborate jeweled headdress, layered necklaces, armlets, and flowing robes in muted cinnabar red, cream, teal, and soft green, with long ribbon-like scarves swirling around her body in elegant arcs. Her right arm is raised, delicately holding a pink lotus flower, while her left hand extends outward in a gentle offering gesture. Surrounding her are exactly 3 smaller attendant maidens: one at lower left standing on clouds and playing a pipa, one at lower center kneeling or floating while presenting a tray of lotus blossoms, and one at lower right standing lightly on clouds with both hands raised in reverence. The background is a deep lapis-blue celestial sky filled with stylized cream and jade clouds, faint flying birds, lotus blooms, and 2 ornate temple pavilions in the upper left and upper right corners. items.title: Surreal Neon Japanese Megacity Overlook
items.description: This prompt generates a highly detailed vertical cyberpunk-style cityscape illustration for posters, concept art, or atmospheric editorial visuals about dense urban loneliness.
items.content: A hyper-detailed ultra-high-resolution vertical illustration of a surreal Japanese futuristic megacity at night, viewed from a very high, steep downward angle through a cramped canyon of buildings, as if standing on a dark hillside alley or rooftop overlook. Keep the composition 9:16 and dramatic, with a deep plunging perspective into an immense glowing urban basin packed with tightly layered low rooftops, narrow streets, elevated walkways, and towering skyscrapers fading into the distance. Frame the scene with dense foreground architecture on both sides: on the upper left, a large glowing red paper lantern sign with bold black Japanese characters hanging from an old wooden eave; on the right, a tall building facade with many lit windows and several vertical neon signs; across the image, tangled overhead utility wires and poles cut through the view. The city below should feel overcrowded yet mesmerizing, blending retro Showa-era alleyway aesthetics with cyberpunk futurism. Use a rich, graphic painterly style with strong black inky linework, bold cel-shaded shapes, and luminous neon accents, preserving a Midjourney-like cinematic beauty while adding much finer environmental detail. Dominant colors are blazing orange and amber window light, saturated crimson and scarlet signage, deep violet night sky, hot magenta highlights, and electric cyan accents. Populate the lower city with countless tiny readable micro-scenes implied through silhouettes and lit windows: festival processions in the streets, nightlife crowds, exhausted salary workers, hidden gang figures in side alleys, dancers in entertainment lanes, students studying in apartment windows, arguing couples, gamers at glowing screens, and many other small human stories embedded throughout the architecture. Emphasize the contrast between urban splendor and emotional isolation, overcrowded boredom and decadent beauty, with a satirical undertone about meaningless modern life. The image must remain aesthetically harmonious despite the density, with crisp small details visible everywhere, glowing signage in Japanese, layered depth, atmospheric haze, and a surreal, slightly oppressive but beautiful mood.

items.title: Anime Roses and Books End Card
items.description: A polished anime-style commemorative illustration of a girl surrounded by roses and books, ideal for festive key visuals, social posts, or end-card art.
items.content: A dreamy anime end-card illustration of a relaxed young woman sitting sideways in a whimsical library of roses and books, surrounded by floating petals and open books. She has {argument name="hair color" default="vivid purple"} hair in a high ponytail tied with a black scrunchie, loose bangs, small gold earrings, and a tiny gold hair clip reading "AI" near her bangs. Her face is mostly obscured by a soft rectangular blur, but the composition still treats her as the central heroine. She wears a turquoise T-shirt with large white text {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"}, an oversized pastel windbreaker in icy blue with pink paint-splatter accents, and pale denim shorts. She holds 1 red rose in her right hand and 1 dark blue hardcover book in her left hand titled {argument name="book title" default="Roses & Books"}. Pose her lounging casually with one leg extended and one bent, like a stylish anime ending-card key visual. The setting is an ornate fantasy reading nook with 2 towering stacks of books framing her on the left and right, entwined with blooming rose vines in red and pink. Include exactly 6 clearly readable book spines or covers with decorative serif titles: "Poems & Books", "Roses & Books", "Dreams", "Memories", "Letters", and "Language of Flowers". Add 1 takeaway coffee cup at the lower left with the printed phrase {argument name="cup text" default="Read. Write. Bloom."}. Place 1 open notebook with a pen in the foreground near her legs, showing a rose sketch and notes, plus 1 additional open illustrated botanical book at the lower right. In the upper area, include exactly 4 floating open books and several loose pages drifting in the air. Behind her, create a bright arched window revealing a pastel fairytale city with a cathedral-like spire against a clear sky-blue background. Fill the whole image with scattered red and pink rose petals, sparkles, soft painterly light, decorative floral details, and richly colored book covers in navy, pink, and cream. Use polished anime illustration styling, highly detailed linework, luminous pastel highlights, romantic fantasy atmosphere, balanced symmetrical framing, and the feel of a commemorative spring book-and-rose themed visual for {argument name="occasion" default="Sant Jordi Day"}.

items.description: A polished full-body fantasy character illustration of an anime spearwoman, suitable for RPG concept art, character sheets, or promotional artwork.
items.content: A full-body anime fantasy warrior girl standing alone on a plain light gray background, clean character illustration with soft painterly rendering and crisp line art. She is a slender young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair, center-parted with long face-framing strands and a small tied section at the back, light {argument name="eye color" default="amber-brown"} eyes, fair skin, and a calm slightly serious expression. Her pose is dynamic and confident: legs apart in a stable stance, one arm raised over her head gripping a long spear shaft behind her shoulders, the other hand holding the spear lower near her side so the ornate spear extends diagonally across the composition. The weapon is 1 elaborate dark metallic spear with a long narrow blade, cross-shaped barbs, engraved gothic details, and a sharp butt spike. Her outfit is a refined dark fantasy battle costume with exactly 6 visible main pieces: 1 black steel armored right arm gauntlet with engraved plating, 1 fitted black-and-bronze corset breastplate, 1 white high-neck blouse with sheer long sleeves, 1 short asymmetrical white skirt with flowing split overskirt panels, 1 pair of black thigh-high armored boots with silver filigree knee and ankle accents, and 1 brown belt set with straps including a right-thigh garter strap. Add subtle silver ornamentation at the collar and armor edges, elegant leather textures, polished metal highlights, and gently wind-swept fabric. Keep the palette muted and sophisticated in ivory, charcoal, bronze, and silver. The style should feel like premium Japanese RPG character concept art, highly detailed, graceful, slightly gothic, isolated full figure, no extra props, no scenery, only a faint soft ground shadow beneath her feet.

items.title: Full-Body Fantasy Adventurer Male
items.description: This prompt generates a polished full-body RPG-style male character illustration suitable for fantasy character design, profile art, or concept presentation.
items.content: A full-body fantasy character illustration on a plain light gray background, painted in polished anime-inspired RPG concept art style with crisp linework, soft rendering, and realistic leather, fur, and skin textures. Show a tall, athletic young man with a muscular build and fair skin, standing in a relaxed contrapposto pose. His right arm is raised across his forehead as if shielding his eyes from light, with his gloved hand touching the brim of a dark cap; his left arm hangs down with a clenched fist. His face is mostly obscured by the raised forearm and cap shadow, making the expression unreadable. He has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blond"} medium-length hair, slightly tousled, visible beneath a {argument name="headwear" default="black flat cap"}, with a small earring on one ear. Dress him in layered adventurer clothing dominated by dark brown, black, and muted reddish-brown. The upper body has a fitted black short-sleeve shirt under a brown leather vest with wide straps and buckles, topped with a thick pale fur collar draped around the neck and shoulders. Add a necklace with small metallic ornaments at the collarbone. Both hands wear dark fingerless gloves or fitted leather gloves, with multiple stacked wristbands and bracers. Around the waist, include several crossing leather belts, metal clasps, and hanging accessories, plus a reddish-brown sash tied at the hips with long hanging strips. On the left hip, attach 1 small leather pouch. The pants are slim dark trousers with a strapped harness around 1 thigh, including metal rings and buckles. The boots are 1 matching pair of tall, dark leather lace-up boots with reinforced knee guards or ornate metal-plated shin-and-knee armor, slightly weathered but stylish. From the right side of the waist, let a long torn cloth panel hang down, patterned near the end with subtle decorative motifs and finished with 1 dangling metal charm or spearhead-shaped ornament. Emphasize a rugged handsome adventurer aesthetic, detailed costume design, and a refined game character sheet feel, centered composition, full figure fully visible from head to boots, with a faint soft cast shadow on the floor.

items.title: Cute Japanese Romcom Movie Poster
items.description: A sparkly Japanese-style theatrical poster for a mascot heroine romantic comedy, ideal for parody film promos, character branding, or social media key art.

author.name: けんいち｜電子文藝×漫画

items.content: A flashy Japanese romantic comedy movie poster in a cute-but-dramatic pop anime mascot style, designed like a theatrical film teaser. Center the composition on a full-body cartoon bunny girl mascot named {argument name="character name" default="パン子"}, with a large white face, black body and one black ear, one bright red ear, thick black outline, half-lidded glamorous eyes with long lashes, pink blush circles on her cheeks, a tiny red nose, a small tongue peeking out, and a pink bow with white polka dots on top of her head. She wears a sleeveless pink dress with white polka dots and a black scarf-like neck detail, posing with one hand near her cheek in a confident, slightly flirty stance. The background is a dreamy sunset waterfront city skyline with golden reflections on the water, pastel pink-orange-blue sky, sparkles, soft bokeh, and a ferris wheel on the left. Place 2 male silhouette figures in the midground, one on the left standing casually and one on the right in a suit-like pose, suggesting potential love interests. Add lush tropical flowers and leaves around the borders, especially pink hibiscus blossoms in the corners, plus floating hearts and glitter effects throughout. Use a bold, layered Japanese poster layout packed with decorative typography and stickers. At the top, handwritten-style Japanese text reads: 「笑って、泣いて、恋をして。アラサーの私、まだまだ諦めない！」 with pink emphasis and doodled heart lines. On the upper left, include a bright pink scalloped badge that says 「2026年 夏公開」. Along the right side, place vertical Japanese text: 「私の幸せ、探しにいきます。」. Near the lower left, add a pink ribbon label reading 「劇場版！」. Across the bottom center, create the large main title in bold decorative Japanese lettering: 「アラサー パン子の 婚活奮闘記」 with pink and dark navy text, white outlines, and a cute heart accent. Beneath it, add a pink slogan banner with yellow-highlighted text: 「恋に迷って、人生はもっとキラキラする♥」. Include small faux credits at the bottom in Japanese film-poster style. Around the lower area, place 4 small polaroid-style inset snapshots of the bunny character: 2 on the lower left and 2 on the lower right, each showing different cute situations such as a close-up pose, sitting at a cafe table, wearing sunglasses, or posing outdoors. Add a small notebook page labeled "Today's Mission" with checklist hearts in the lower left, and a plastic iced drink cup with straw plus sunglasses in the lower right. Overall feeling: feminine, comedic, inspirational, sparkly, over-the-top, and nostalgic, like a parody of a live-action romance film poster starring a mascot heroine. Use vivid pinks, peach sunset tones, sky blue, white, and navy, with glossy highlights and a polished promotional-poster finish.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Isekai Novel Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic anime-style dark fantasy light-novel cover with three heroines, burning medieval ruins, and bold vertical Japanese title text for book cover or promotional art use.

author.name: いとよ（バーチャル僧侶）@VRChat

items.content: A dark fantasy anime light-novel cover in a vertical composition, painted with detailed dramatic brushwork and moody cinematic lighting. Show three young women posed in a triangular arrangement against a ruined medieval city engulfed in flames at night, with smoke, embers, collapsed timber buildings, and a large stone castle on a rocky hill in the upper background. In the foreground center, place a beautiful young woman with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="powder blue"} hair, wearing an off-shoulder blue corset dress with white frilled sleeves and lace-up bodice, one hand lightly gripping her chest, her expression serious and vulnerable. Behind her on the left, place a tall woman with silver-white hair tied in a high ponytail and a white headscarf, wearing a modest black dress with a high collar and front fastenings, standing in profile with a stern, unreadable presence. Behind her on the right, place a blonde girl with twin braids under a brown hooded cloak, pale blue-green eyes, holding a black book with a star-like emblem on the cover close to her chest, looking sideways with a guarded expression. Use layered character overlap, strong contrast, and slightly desaturated colors except for warm firelight and deep reds. Add large vertical Japanese title typography along the left side in distressed calligraphic style: 「異世界辺境伯領」 in black and dark red, plus two smaller vertical text blocks near the lower left reading 「現代の倫理観を捨て」 and 「権力と暴力で泥臭く生き延びます」. Add a decorative compass-like emblem near the lower left and a large bold vertical subtitle 「転生」 at the bottom left. Ornate corner filigree, gritty light-novel cover design, intense isekai war atmosphere, high detail, premium illustrated novel cover.

items.title: Japanese Manufacturing Challenges Infographic
items.description: A polished Japanese business infographic illustrating labor shortages and skill transfer issues in manufacturing, suitable for articles, presentations, and corporate reports.

author.name: YOHEI｜インハウスマーケター（BtoB）

items.content: A clean corporate editorial infographic illustration for a Japanese business article about manufacturing industry challenges, set inside a realistic modern factory with metalworking machines and a cool gray-blue color palette. The composition is split into two thematic halves over a blurred industrial workshop background. items.content: A hyper-detailed, ultra-colorful anime festival illustration of 2 kemonomimi girls jumping midair in a joyful pose, filling the center of a tall vertical composition. The girl on the right is a cheerful catgirl with white-blonde hair, large fluffy cat ears, bright blue eyes, one eye winking, and a big open smile, wearing a vivid blue floral kimono-inspired short dress with oversized sleeves, layered frilly white petticoat trim, a large multicolored obi bow, floral hair ornaments, white ankle socks, and geta sandals, with a fluffy pale tail visible behind her; her right arm is raised making a peace sign and her left hand is near her chest. The girl on the left is a doggirl with medium brown hair, fluffy brown-and-white dog ears, and a curled fluffy tail, wearing a vivid pink and magenta floral kimono-inspired short dress with layered frills, a large decorative obi bow, floral hair ornaments, white socks, and sandals; she is also leaping with one arm raised in a peace sign. The overall palette mixes hot pink typography, summer sunlight, teal, blonde, and saturated street-art hues. items.title: Post-Apocalyptic Ruins at Dusk
items.description: A cinematic ruined cityscape with a collapsed foreground structure and a distant domed tower, suitable for concept art, matte painting, or dystopian worldbuilding imagery.
items.content: A moody post-apocalyptic cinematic landscape at dusk, painted in a dark sepia and amber palette, showing the ruins of an industrial or urban structure beneath a turbulent sky filled with dense, glowing clouds. In the left foreground, a large diagonal collapsed metal beam or crane arm rises from the bottom left toward the upper left, draped with torn fabric or shredded sheeting and tangled cables. A single long cable stretches diagonally downward across the frame toward the center. In the hazy midground, slightly right of center, stands a damaged domed tower or observatory-like building, partially obscured by dust, smoke, and drifting debris. The ground is filled with jagged rubble, broken structures, and silhouetted wreckage. Use dramatic backlighting from the cloud breaks near the horizon, soft volumetric haze, atmospheric perspective, painterly textures, and a ruined-world epic tone. The composition should feel vertical, solemn, desolate, and cinematic, with no people visible.

items.title: Cute Winking Schoolgirl Peace Sign
items.description: A clean kawaii vector-style illustration of a smiling schoolgirl in uniform making double peace signs, suitable for icons, stickers, and simple character art.
items.content: A simple cute flat vector illustration of a cheerful Japanese schoolgirl centered on a plain light gray background, shown from about mid-thigh up in a front-facing pose. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with side-swept bangs, fair skin, a rounded face, pink blush on both cheeks, one eye open and the other eye winking, a small nose, and an open smiling mouth. She is wearing a classic Japanese high school uniform with a dark navy blazer, white shirt collar, large red ribbon bow at the neck, and a gray pleated skirt, with 2 visible gold blazer buttons. Both arms are stretched straight out horizontally to the sides toward the viewer, and both hands are making peace signs with the fingers angled downward. Use bold clean black outlines, soft pastel-like flat colors, minimal shading, kawaii sticker-style proportions, symmetrical composition, and a friendly playful expression.

items.title: Apocalyptic Ruined City Street
items.description: This prompt generates a dark cinematic concept-art scene of a devastated urban street with collapsing buildings, smoke, and drifting embers, suitable for dystopian or post-apocalyptic visuals.
items.content: A dark, apocalyptic city street at night, viewed from ground level looking upward through a narrow canyon of ruined tall buildings on both sides. The architecture is heavily damaged and partially collapsed, with jagged silhouettes, broken facades, and blackened gothic-industrial details fading into shadow. A dense column of smoke and stormy cloud fills the center of the sky, backlit by a cold pale glow near the horizon, creating a dramatic high-contrast focal point. The overall palette is nearly monochrome deep navy, charcoal, black, and muted steel blue, with scattered tiny orange ember-like specks drifting through the air across the whole scene. The mood is bleak, ominous, and cinematic, like a post-disaster wasteland or bombed urban ruin. Painterly digital concept art, soft atmospheric haze, heavy texture, subtle film-grain feel, no people, no vehicles, no readable signs, wide composition, high detail in the ruined structures, strong vertical framing from the buildings, and a foreboding smoky sky dominating the upper half.

items.title: Doodle-Style Cozy Restaurant Table Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a dark, cozy restaurant food photo with handwritten Japanese doodles and annotations, ideal for trendy social media, menu, or lifestyle editorial visuals.
items.content: A moody, dark restaurant table photo styled like a trendy handwritten doodle edit, shot from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. The scene shows a wooden table with 4 main food-and-drink items: in the center-left, a large white pasta bowl with black rim text reading "OLIO E PIU," filled with creamy spaghetti or truffle pasta and topped with a glossy raw egg yolk, with a spoon resting inside the bowl and soft steam rising; at the lower right, a large white dinner plate cropped by the frame, holding roasted vegetables and a piece of browned meat with light green seasoning dust; at the lower left, a stemmed glass of white wine, partly cropped; at the upper right, a goblet-style glass of dark sparkling drink. The background is very dim and warm, almost black, making the food and glassware stand out under low ambient light. Add white hand-drawn overlay doodles and Japanese handwritten notes directly on top of the photo: one large curved headline at the upper left that says "おいしい時間、しあわせだな〜♡" with a sweeping underline and 2 small hearts; one note above the pasta that says "しっとり、たまごとろり" with a dotted arrow pointing to the egg yolk; one note near the upper-right drink that says "さっぱり、リフレッシュ！" with a dotted arrow pointing to the glass; one note at the lower left near the wine glass that says "sparkling. ちょっとした ごほうび。♡" with a curved dotted arrow; and one note near the lower center-right that says "あまくて、やわらかい :) ♡" with a dotted arrow pointing to the plated food. Include exactly 10 doodle embellishments besides the text: 2 steam squiggles above the pasta, 2 small sparkle stars near the wine glass, 2 small sparkle marks near the lower plate, 2 tiny droplet marks beside the upper-right drink, and 2 hearts near the headline. Use thin white chalk-like lines, casual imperfect handwriting, and a cozy editorial social-media aesthetic, keeping the composition realistic and photographic while the doodles look playful and hand-sketched.

Around her right side, a curved arc of glowing magical particles forms 1 crescent-shaped trail made of luminous white roses, petals, and tiny lights, rising from the water near her reflection and curling upward beside her. The water is glassy with subtle ripples and crisp reflections of the woman, moon, stars, and magical light. Low dark islands sit on the distant horizon. At the bottom center, add elegant luminous cursive text reading {argument name="quote" default="In me the tiger sniffs the rose"}. Ultra-detailed, ethereal, poetic, photoreal fantasy art, soft moonlight, cool blue palette, high contrast, gentle bloom, mystical atmosphere, widescreen composition.

items.content: A dreamy pastel pink Japanese mobile game advertisement poster in a vertical smartphone format, kawaii fantasy style, ultra-cute and glossy. The main subject is a fluffy white baby kitten with huge sparkling violet-blue eyes, soft blush on its cheeks, tiny pink nose, and a mischievous smile, lying on a pink cushion or blanket in the foreground while holding a baby bottle in its paws. The kitten is extremely fluffy and round, with soft glowing fur and a plush-toy feel, lit with warm magical highlights. The entire scene is filled with pink hearts, sparkles, lace details, soft bokeh, and candy-colored decorations, creating a soothing but playful atmosphere. In the background is a pastel pink bedroom or nursery interior with shelves holding exactly 3 stuffed animals: a pink rabbit, a mint-blue cat, and a lavender bear. Add translucent floating soap-bubble circles with white bone-shaped icons inside, small decorative charms, ribbons, and floral ornaments. On the left side, large bold vertical Japanese headline text in glossy bubble lettering reads 「脱出できない」 with smaller vertical text beside it reading 「かわいくて、」, all in bright pink with white glow and thick outline. Near the top inside a white lace-edged circular badge, include Japanese text reading 「もふもふ にゃんこと おへやから脱出？」 with a pink paw print icon beneath it. At the bottom, place a decorative game logo with large rounded Japanese text reading 「もふふミルクと にゃんこ」 and a ribbon banner below reading 「脱出ゲーム」, using pastel teal, cream, and pink colors with a shiny outlined style. Add a small rounded text plaque in the lower left that reads 「癒されるのに、意外とむずかしい…!?」 decorated with tiny flowers and a dangling baby bottle charm. Use a polished promotional key visual look for a cute indie app, highly detailed, soft airbrushed illustration, glossy typography, enchanting, comforting, and irresistibly adorable.

items.content: A dreamy painterly anime-style full-body illustration of a young woman standing just outside a sunlit cafe entrance, with strong attention to the direction of her face and gaze. She is turned slightly to the right side of the image, her head angled sideways as if looking off-camera toward the street. Her face is softly simplified and partially obscured by bright light, with delicate features and no harsh outlines. She has long wavy brown hair with warm golden highlights, loose strands catching the sunlight, and a small hair clip near one side. She wears a loose cream-beige long-sleeved romper or short dress with a gathered waist and soft flowing sleeves, white scrunched socks, chunky white sneakers, and a small white shoulder bag with a thin gold chain strap. She holds 1 clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a black straw in both hands at chest height. The setting is the exterior of a cozy cafe with tall glass doors and windows on the right, and 2 visible cafe signs that read “MOUNT TOKYO” with smaller text “COFFEE, SANDWICH and more...” — 1 wall-mounted rectangular sign and 1 black A-frame sidewalk sign near the lower left; the A-frame also includes small opening hours text near the bottom. Include 1 simple wooden bench along the left edge. The whole scene is filled with dappled sunlight and dense leaf shadows cast across the walls, glass, ground, bench, and the woman’s clothing, creating a shimmering summer atmosphere. Use a soft watercolor and gouache-like rendering style with luminous overexposed highlights, warm cream, gold, and peach tones mixed with cool blue shadow accents, textured brushwork, reflective glass, and a nostalgic airy mood. Vertical composition, full body visible from head to shoes, elegant fashion illustration framing, highly detailed environment, sun-washed cafe street scene in Japan.

items.title: Pastel Blueberry Cake Anime Poster
items.description: A stylized Japanese anime film poster featuring a lavender-themed girl, an exploded blueberry pound cake, and dramatic handwritten typography, ideal for cinematic key art or promotional visuals.
items.content: A dreamy pastel-purple Japanese movie poster illustration in a glossy shoujo anime style, packed with blueberry dessert chaos and soft sparkles. The scene shows 1 seated teenage girl with a short silver-lavender bob haircut, side bangs, a small lavender bow hair clip, and alternative cute fashion, sitting on the floor in a messy kitchen or baking workspace. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered square censor block in muted lavender-gray. She wears an oversized translucent lavender jacket with black ribbon details on the sleeves, a light purple graphic top, layered silver necklaces, a purple plaid skirt, slouchy white leg warmers decorated with lavender heart patches and black bows, and chunky lavender platform sneakers with ribbon accents. She holds 1 blueberry near her mouth with one hand and 1 metal mixing bowl smeared with vivid purple blueberry batter in the other. In front of her is 1 large golden pound cake split open dramatically, overflowing with dark glossy blueberries and purple filling, spilling across 1 cooling rack and the tabletop. Counted blueberries are scattered throughout the composition as floating and resting props, creating a whimsical suspended effect. The environment is cluttered with baking tools and notes: 1 spiral notebook page in the upper right labeled in English with a handwritten recipe for blueberry pound cake, 1 whisk in the lower right, 1 small pinned photo print in the lower left showing 2 anime girls, and 1 handwritten note card in the lower right with Japanese writing and a small bunny doodle. Use a monochrome palette of lilac, violet, periwinkle, cream, and deep blueberry purple, with luminous highlights, soft haze, translucent overlays, and romantic glitter. Add large expressive Japanese calligraphy text dominating the left half of the poster, reading vertically and diagonally like a dramatic light-novel or film advertisement, plus a ribbon banner near the cake with the date text “2026年7月メロードショー”, vertical copy on the right side, small production-credit text across the bottom, and a final tagline line at the very bottom. Make the composition feel like a cute disaster: beautiful but failed baking, sweet melancholy, fashionable messiness, and cinematic promotional poster energy.

vertically and diagonally like a dramatic light-novel or film advertisement, plus a ribbon banner near the cake with the date text “2026年7月メロードショー”, vertical copy on the right side, small production-credit text across the bottom, and a final tagline line at the very bottom. make the composition feel like a cute disaster: beautiful but failed baking, sweet melancholy, fashionable messiness, and cinematic promotional poster energy. 千菊 15351

items.title: Pastel Anime Blueberry Cake Movie Poster
items.description: A whimsical Japanese-style anime poster showing a pastel girl carrying a disastrously overflowing blueberry pound cake, ideal for parody film-poster art and cute cinematic social media visuals.
items.content: A dreamy pastel anime movie-poster illustration set in a narrow outdoor alley completely covered in dense floral mosaic wall art, rendered with glittering sparkles, soft haze, and romantic shoujo color grading in lavender, pink, periwinkle, and cream. In the foreground, show a cute teenage girl from a rear three-quarter view, her face mostly hidden, with short silvery-lavender bob hair and a large mauve bow hair accessory decorated with tiny flowers. She wears an oversized translucent lavender hoodie with embroidered floral appliqués on the sleeves, a layered pastel skirt, and carries a shiny lilac backpack covered with charms, ribbons, plush pom-poms, pins, and star details. She is holding a plate with a blueberry pound cake loaf that has been sliced open, and the center is dramatically overflowing with glossy dark-purple blueberry filling that pours out in thick syrupy streams down the cake and plate. Scatter whole blueberries around the cake and lower foreground. Make the scene whimsical, delicate, and slightly comedic despite the beautiful presentation. Design the image as a Japanese film poster with many decorative text overlays and laurels. Across the top, include 3 small award lines with laurel wreaths. Add a huge hand-lettered Japanese title in layered pink, white, and purple lettering with glow and sticker-like outlines reading: 「冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件。」 Below it, add a smaller subtitle line: 「〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜」. On the right side, place 1 vertical white quote box with Japanese text: 「うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。」 In the lower left, add 1 pinned pink note card that says “Sweet but clumsy.” and 1 torn recipe memo sheet with handwritten Japanese checklist items. Add a small speech bubble near the cake that says “Oops!”. Include a circular stamp-style seal near the lower right that reads “Blueberry disaster”. At the bottom, add film-credit style text in white, including “A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL”, and a large release line in pink and white: “{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} ROADSHOW”. Under that, add the Japanese tagline: 「失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。」 Frame the whole poster with lace, stickers, scraps of paper, and scrapbook-style decorations. Make it ultra-detailed, glossy, sentimental, kawaii, cinematic, and intentionally over-the-top like a fake coming-of-age movie poster about a baking failure.

items.title: Vintage Japanese Crime Film Poster
items.description: A gritty retro Japanese theatrical poster for a hard-boiled detective film, useful for generating faux 1970s movie key art with authentic typography and layout.

author.name: おさじ｜66歳・AI×セキュリティ実務家

items.content: A vintage late-1970s Japanese crime film poster in the style of a Nikkatsu theatrical one-sheet, vertically composed on aged beige paper with visible grain, faint stains, and slightly faded ink. The main image is a large, moody half-body portrait of {argument name="lead actor name" default="原田芳雄"} occupying the upper right and center, turned partly away from camera, with thick curly dark hair, a serious expression, and a wrinkled light gray suit jacket over an open-collar white shirt; his face is mostly in shadow. Behind him is a bleak industrial waterfront with cranes, low factory structures, and heavy gray smoke rising into a washed-out sky. Across the lower middle, place a huge hand-brushed red Japanese title reading {argument name="title text" default="影の街"}, painted diagonally and aggressively, partially overlapping the portrait and the lower scene. In the lower half, add a second scene: a rainy urban street at dusk or night with wet reflective pavement, a dark police car at left with a glowing red roof light, and 6 men in suits and trench coats walking forward, with 1 central detective figure in a beige trench coat and loosened tie leading the group. On the far right, include a vertical strip of 5 stacked inset cast portraits framed in thin borders, each a dark cinematic still with different characters. Add vertical Japanese typography: on the upper right, the actor credit “原田芳雄 主演”; on the upper left, a 2-line tagline column reading “その男、刑事。 正義より、真実を追う。”; and near the lower right of the main image, another vertical blurb reading “誰が敵で、誰が味方か。闇に消えた事件の中で、ただひとつの真実を掴むまで—”. At the bottom, include dense small Japanese credits spanning the width, plus a large release date on the lower right reading {argument name="release date" default="11.23"} with “日活ロードショー” beneath it and a small studio mark. Use muted charcoal, sepia, smoky blue-gray, and off-white tones, with the red title as the only vivid color. The overall feeling is hard-boiled, melancholic, gritty, and cinematic, like a lost 1970s Japanese detective movie poster.

items.content: A brightly lit Japanese TV variety show studio screenshot in a cheerful pastel idol-program style, framed as a medium-wide group shot of {argument name="group size" default="5"} young women standing close together, with the center performer slightly forward and the others partially visible around her. Their faces are intentionally obscured by soft rectangular blur mosaics, as if anonymized for a social media post, but their hairstyles, outfits, body positions, and the set remain clear. They wear coordinated feminine stage uniforms in dusty pink and beige with white ribbon bows at the collar, floral lace trim on the shoulders and chest, puff sleeves, gold buttons, and small black lavalier microphones clipped near the neckline. The center woman has a shoulder-length light brown bob with side-swept bangs; two taller women in the back and right have long dark brown wavy hair; only the tops of two more members are visible at the lower left and lower right corners. The studio background is colorful and busy: a cream-and-pastel brick wall, stylized tree cutouts near the top left, a decorative pink ornate frame around a glowing purple LED panel with white flower icons on the left, and geometric pastel wall panels on the right. Add bold Japanese TV captions with crisp, readable text. In the top left, place a yellow-and-black construction-sign style box with diagonal hazard stripes reading "乃木坂工事中" and smaller roman text "nogizaka under construction". In the top right, place a black rectangle with yellow hazard-stripe border containing two lines of Japanese text: "イントロ中のアドリブ曲紹介" and "ピッタリ歌い出しまで埋めろ!". Across the lower center, add a huge playful headline in thick rounded Japanese lettering reading {argument name="main caption" default="1つ この曲を"}, colored bright yellow with orange shading, a white inner border, thick pink outline, and sparkly star accents integrated into the phrase. The composition should feel like a genuine paused television broadcast, colorful, polished, and highly legible, with a 16:9 aspect ratio and the visual emphasis on the large bottom caption and the center performer.

items.title: Japanese Waterproof Rainwear Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese e-commerce hero image for a unisex waterproof rain suit set, suitable for online marketplace listings and product advertisements.

author.name: おくだ｜奥田準祐【著書】中国輸入―Yahoo!ショッピング完全攻略ガイド(ぱる出版)

items.content: A clean Japanese e-commerce promotional poster for a waterproof rainwear set, square format, bright high-key product ad style. Show 2 adult models walking outdoors on a wet pavement in light rain with a soft blurred background: 1 taller male model wearing a taupe-brown hooded waterproof jacket and black rain pants, and 1 shorter female model wearing a dusty pink hooded waterproof jacket and black rain pants. Both outfits are lightweight rain suits with zip-front jackets, subtle fabric sheen, visible water droplets on the surface, and casual sneakers. Faces are de-emphasized and not the focus. Use a white and pale gray background layout with the models placed center-right and full body visible. On the left side, large bold Japanese headline text in a mix of black and vivid blue reads exactly: "雨でも快適。しっかり防水" with small blue raindrop accents and a small umbrella icon near the text, plus a yellow brushstroke underline accent beneath the second line. Beneath the headline, add a blue ribbon-style banner with white Japanese text: "上下セット / 男女兼用". Below that, place exactly 3 circular blue feature icons in a horizontal row with Japanese labels: 1) water drops icon with text "耐水圧 20,000mm", 2) upward stretch arrows icon with text "ムレにくい", 3) feather icon with text "軽量設計". At the bottom left, display exactly 6 small product color variants as miniature jacket-and-pants set thumbnails arranged in 2 rows of 3. The 6 colorways are: black set, navy set, olive green set, pink set, beige set, and light gray set. In the top right corner, add a gold laurel award badge with red ribbons and Japanese text reading "Yahoo! ショッピング 第1位 RANKING" with smaller text beneath indicating a daily ranking note. Overall style: polished Japanese marketplace listing hero image, realistic apparel photography composited with clean graphic design, commercial catalog quality, waterproof outdoor lifestyle feel, soft overcast lighting, crisp typography, premium but accessible consumer product presentation.

items.content: Create a clean Japanese e-commerce advertisement image for a premium yoga mat in a bright minimalist home interior. The main scene shows 1 woman with her face softly blurred, doing an upward-facing dog yoga pose on a thick pastel pink yoga mat placed diagonally across a pale wood floor. She wears a white sports bra and light gray leggings, with her hair in a neat bun. In the left foreground, show 1 rolled purple yoga mat secured with 2 black straps. Along the bottom edge, display exactly 7 small rolled mat color variations in a row: pink, lavender, sky blue, mint green, beige, light gray, and black. Add large Japanese promotional typography on the left in a stylish modern layout: the headline reads "やさしく支える。" with "やさしく" in handwritten pink script and "支える。" in black, followed by a bold large line "極厚 10mm" with "10" oversized in pink and "mm" smaller in pink italic style. Under that, add a pink rectangular banner with white text reading "滑りにくい / TPE素材". Beneath the banner, place exactly 3 circular feature icons with labels in Japanese: 1) a non-slip texture icon labeled "滑り止め", 2) a cushioning icon with downward arrows labeled "クッション性", 3) a feather icon labeled "軽量". In the upper right corner, add a gold laurel award badge with a crown and layered red ribbons, containing the Japanese text "Yahoo! JAPAN ショッピング RANKING 第1位 ヨガマット部門". In the lower right corner, add a pink angled label reading "選べる 7色" with the number 7 large and white. The background should be soft, airy, and high-key with a white wall, natural daylight, and a slightly out-of-focus potted green plant and woven basket on the right side. Use a polished commercial product-photography style, soft shadows, pastel color palette, luxury wellness branding, sharp layout, and realistic materials, suitable for an online marketplace hero image.
