items.content: Create a high-converting Japanese e-commerce product advertisement square image for a pair of ultra-cushioned insoles, styled like a Rakuten marketplace hero banner. Bright sky-blue gradient background with soft white clouds, clean glossy commercial design, energetic and premium. Large central Japanese headline in bold white calligraphic serif text with blue glow: "雲インソール". Above it, a rounded white capsule banner with blue text: "履いた瞬間ふわっ！". Below the main headline, smaller white handwritten-style Japanese subheading: "まるで雲の上を歩くような心地よさ". Show 4 insole product views total: 1 large white foam sole held vertically in a realistic human hand at lower left foreground, featuring a pebble-like bubble texture with small ventilation holes; 1 gray fabric-covered insole standing upright in the center; 2 stacked angled white insoles at lower right, emphasizing thick soft cushioning and textured underside. Add a large gold award badge at top left with crown and laurel, containing the Japanese text "第1位" and a red ribbon reading "楽天ランキング". Add a vertical gold ribbon badge at top right with the Japanese text "累計販売数 10万足 突破!". On the left side, place 4 vertically stacked rounded white icon boxes under a small blue handwritten caption "こんなお悩みに!", with simple blue line icons and labels: 1 "足の疲れ", 2 "衝撃吸収", 3 "長時間の立ち仕事", 4 "ウォーキング スポーツに". On the right side, place 2 rounded white feature boxes with blue outlines and blue-gray icon illustrations: top box text "衝撃吸収 疲れにくい" with a walking person icon; bottom box text "通気性◎ ムレにくい" with airflow lines icon. At the bottom right, add a large white cloud-shaped callout with bold blue Japanese text "極上の クッション感" and a tiny blue cloud icon. At the bottom center, place a small blue rounded label "選べるサイズ" with large blue size text underneath: "23.0cm〜29.0cm". Use crisp product-photography lighting, soft shadows, glossy highlights, vivid contrast, and a polished online shopping ad composition optimized for instant conversion.

Add subtle {argument name=\"fantasy element\" default=\"angel wings\"} in some frames only, blending dreaminess into realism. items.title: Anime VTuber Minecraft Stream Thumbnail
items.description: A flashy neon anime livestream thumbnail featuring a catgirl streamer, bold Korean text, and a dramatic Minecraft Creeper scene, ideal for gaming video or broadcast cover art.
items.content: A vibrant anime-style YouTube thumbnail for a livestream gaming broadcast, in a wide 16:9 composition, with a neon purple and pink streamer room. Center the scene on a cute catgirl VTuber sitting at a desk, shown from the waist up, leaning forward energetically with one hand on a computer mouse and the other hand reaching toward the viewer. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light orange-blonde"} bob-cut hair with soft bangs, fluffy brown-and-cream cat ears, and a visible cat tail. Her face is intentionally obscured by a solid rectangular censor block in the center. She wears a black-and-white maid-inspired outfit with a frilly white blouse, black dress bodice, puff sleeves, white ruffles, black ribbon bow, and a gold bell choker. Place a mechanical keyboard with bright RGB lighting on the desk, a glowing gaming mouse, and a streamer microphone on the far left with pink-purple LED lighting. Put 2 cat-themed desk items in the foreground: a plush cat face on the bottom left and a black cat-shaped mug on the bottom right. Behind her is a gaming chair with paw-print details. On the left side, add large bold Korean headline text in thick white block letters with black fill shadows and a glowing purple outline, stacked in 2 lines: {argument name="headline text" default="방송중 대참사"}. Below it, add a smaller yellow comic-style burst caption with black outline reading {argument name="sub text" default="> 크리퍼 실화냐"}. On the right side, show 1 large computer monitor angled inward, displaying a Minecraft-like scene with bright blue sky, green trees, water, and a large green Creeper popping out toward the viewer, outlined dramatically like a sticker cutout. Add starburst effects and neon accents around the monitor to heighten the chaos. Use exaggerated thumbnail aesthetics: ultra-saturated colors, sharp cel shading, thick outlines, glossy highlights, high contrast, dynamic perspective, and a clickworthy streamer-disaster mood.

items.title: Candy Lunar New Year Shrine
items.description: A hyper-detailed symmetrical candycore festival shrine illustration, ideal for generating maximalist celebratory fantasy art with kawaii and Lunar New Year motifs.
items.content: An ultra-dense maximalist fantasy illustration in a perfectly symmetrical front-facing composition, depicting a candy-themed Lunar New Year shrine scene exploding with color and detail. At the exact center, a kawaii doll-like girl deity sits cross-legged in a meditative lotus pose on a mound of sweets, framed by a huge radiant mandala halo shaped like layered lotus petals and ornamental festival patterns in gold, pink, orange, teal, and neon rainbow hues. She has a glossy bob haircut with blunt bangs in dark brown with purple sheen, a porcelain face with red lips, and her eyes are covered by a dramatic striped visor or blindfold made of yellow-and-black caution-tape-like ribbons. Her hair is decorated with oversized candy beads and lollipops, and her outfit is an extravagant sculptural dress made of frosting, sprinkles, bows, hearts, candy charms, pastel mascot faces, and dripping confection textures. Her hands rest open on her knees, palms up, in a serene ceremonial pose. Surrounding her is a packed altar-city of miniature pagodas, lantern towers, dragons, dolls, sweets, toys, and lucky symbols, all arranged in mirrored abundance. Include 4 large circular framed dessert mascots in the corners: top left a smiling pink frosted cupcake, top right a smiling pink macaron with a bow, bottom left a smiling gingerbread cookie, bottom right a smiling pink sprinkled donut. Include 6 prominent red-and-gold round festival signs across the upper half with Chinese characters such as fortune, prosperity, joy, and luck. Add 2 ornate dragon figures flanking the center, 2 decorated elephants in the mid-lower left and right, and 2 gold ingot bowls near them. Scatter many small doll girls in traditional festive dress throughout the background like collectible figurines. The entire foreground should be buried under countless colorful gumballs, candies, tiny teddy bears, smiley-face sweets, lollipops, beads, and toy-like creatures, with no empty space anywhere. Style: hyper-detailed, glossy 3D digital art, candycore, pop surrealism, toy diorama, festival altar, Chinese New Year iconography, saturated reds, pinks, oranges, and golds, sparkling highlights, crisp focus, intricate textures, celebratory and divine atmosphere.

items.title: Japanese Visual Novel Promo Poster
items.description: A polished anime-style gal game advertisement poster combining a dramatic key visual with a synopsis panel, feature icons, and stacked screenshot previews for visual novel marketing.
items.content:
Create a Japanese bishoujo game promotional poster in the style of a premium visual novel box cover and store page composite. The image is split into three vertical areas. The left two-thirds is a dramatic illustrated key visual at sunset: a dreamy spring sky filled with pink and violet clouds, glowing rim light, drifting petals, and a reflective wet road or riverside path. Show 4 anime girls in school uniforms, all with soft emotional expressions and highly detailed hair moving in the wind. The largest girl is centered upper-left, shown from the chest up in profile or three-quarter view, with long dark hair and a small flower hair ornament, looking wistful. A second girl stands at lower-left with very light silver hair and a ribbon accessory, turned slightly away. A third girl is at lower center, smaller, with mauve or reddish-brown hair and a bowed, melancholy pose. A fourth girl is at mid-right, blonde or light brown-haired, facing upward with a hopeful expression. At the very bottom center of the key art, show 2 tiny full-body silhouettes of a boy and girl holding hands in the glowing distance, reflected in the wet ground. Add a white feather near the upper-left and scattered cherry blossom petals throughout. Overlay elegant Japanese title typography in large white brush-like serif lettering near the bottom-left to center: 「{argument name="title text" default="さよならの向こう側で"}」, with a smaller subtitle line beneath it. Along the far left edge, place 3 vertical lines of small Japanese catchphrase text in white. In the bottom-left corner, add 2 stacked black product labels with white text like a PC game package badge, one reading Windows compatible and one reading all ages.

The center is a narrow dark indigo vertical band separating the art from the info panel. On this band, place the game title again vertically in large white Japanese characters, with a smaller vertical tagline beneath it. Keep this band clean and elegant, like the spine of a game box.

The right third is a soft cream-colored information panel with a gentle paper texture. At top-left of this panel, add a bold Japanese heading in brackets: 「【あらすじ】」 followed by several lines of Japanese synopsis text laid out like a visual novel description page. Below that, add a dotted or dashed divider line. Then add a second bracketed heading: 「【特徴】」 with 4 feature bullets, each preceded by a simple icon. The 4 features are: branching choices, full voice support, tearjerking emotional story, and many beautiful CGs. Use small dark blue-gray icons and text. Add another divider line, then a third bracketed heading: 「【プレイヤーへ】」 followed by 2 short lines of Japanese message text.

On the far right side of the cream panel, stack 4 rounded-rectangle screenshot thumbnails vertically, each with thin white borders. Thumbnail 1: the dark-haired heroine by a seaside railing at sunset. Thumbnail 2: a pale-haired heroine with windblown hair against a bright blue ocean. Thumbnail 3: a girl indoors by a sunlit classroom or café window, warm and contemplative. Thumbnail 4: a girl surrounded by cherry blossoms in soft pink light. At the bottom of the cream panel, place a wide rounded lavender feature bar containing 4 large icons with short Japanese labels beneath or beside them: an open book, a microphone, an image/photo symbol, and a branching path/share-like icon. The overall mood should be nostalgic, romantic, cinematic, and emotionally overwhelming, like a high-budget Japanese gal game advertisement from the 2000s to 2010s. Use polished anime illustration, luminous backlighting, rich pastel sunset colors, glossy reflections, detailed typography, and authentic visual novel promo design.

items.title: Anime Mecha Pilot Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a high-detail anime sci-fi character poster with one central pilot figure, three inset panels, and dense futuristic typography for use as a premium fandom key visual or collectible print.
items.content: Create a dramatic anime sci-fi poster of {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}, inspired by a cyber-newtype pilot from a mecha war setting. The composition is a vertically oriented character key visual with one central full-body female figure in a sleek red and black pilot bodysuit, shown standing confidently in a slightly low-angle pose. She has short layered orange hair with long side bangs, pale skin, and a serious, emotionally distant expression. items.title: Cyberpunk City Highway HDRI
items.description: A futuristic rainy-night city panorama designed as a 360-degree HDRI environment map for 3D rendering backgrounds and lighting.

author.name: appletea 🍎アップルティ☕丨AI動画制作

items.content: Create a seamless-looking 360-degree equirectangular HDRI environment map of a futuristic urban expressway at night, viewed from the middle of a wide wet roadway beneath elevated highways in a dense modern city. Use a panoramic full-surround composition with strong fisheye-like equirectangular distortion at the top and bottom edges, designed for use as a Blender world background. The scene should feature 2 large curving elevated highway ramps, one on the left and one on the right, arching inward toward the center, with multiple supporting pillars and additional overpass layers receding into the distance. Surround the roadway with a skyline of illuminated high-rise office towers and apartment buildings, with cool blue and cyan windows and a few magenta and purple accent lights. Make the road surface glossy and rain-soaked, reflecting the city lights in long horizontal streaks of neon blue, violet, and pink. Add subtle light trails and luminous reflections across the pavement, creating a cyberpunk mood. The sky should be dark, cloudy, and atmospheric with a faint bright glow at the zenith and soft haze around distant buildings. Keep the overall palette dominated by deep indigo, electric blue, cyan, and purple. The image should feel cinematic, moody, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high dynamic range, with realistic urban lighting and mirrored wet-surface reflections, suitable as an HDRI backdrop. Include slight panorama seam artifacts and stretched distortion near the poles so it feels like an AI-generated but usable environment map.

items.title: Epic Shiva Tandava Fire Dance
items.description: A dramatic devotional fantasy artwork of Shiva dancing in a fiery sacred arena, ideal for mythological poster art, album covers, or spiritual concept illustration.
items.content: A monumental mythological fantasy painting of Lord Shiva performing the Tandava in the center of a fiery sacred arena, full-body, dynamic dancing pose with one leg raised and the other foot pressing down on a fallen figure beneath him. Shiva has ash-blue skin, a powerfully muscular physique, long wild flowing dark hair exploding outward in all directions, a high matted topknot, and a white crescent moon tucked into the hair. His expression is intense and divine. A cobra is coiled around his neck, and he wears multiple rudraksha bead necklaces, bracelets, and armlets, large circular earrings, and sacred ornaments. His clothing is a tiger-skin loincloth with dramatic red-orange cloth sashes whipping through the air. One raised hand holds a small damaru drum, one front hand is lifted in a blessing gesture with the Om symbol visible on the palm, and another hand conjures a bright flame above the open palm. Behind his head is a large glowing circular halo inscribed repeatedly with Sanskrit mantra text, creating a radiant mandala effect. The setting is an apocalyptic Himalayan temple landscape with dark storm clouds, smoke, embers, rocky mountains, waterfalls, and ancient stone shrines and temple towers on both the left and right sides. A trident wrapped with red cloth stands upright on the left side of the scene. Around Shiva is a circle of exactly 10 worshippers and ascetics, split across both sides, shown chanting, kneeling, raising arms, carrying torches, and playing drums in devotion. Beneath Shiva is exactly 1 fallen dark-skinned male figure lying on the stone ground. The ground is cracked and molten, with a blazing ring of lava and fire encircling the dance platform. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, glowing orange firelight against deep charcoal shadows, highly detailed anatomy, intricate jewelry and textures, swirling hair and fabric motion, devotional epic fantasy realism, painterly brushwork, symmetrical central composition, ultra-detailed, high contrast, vertical poster format.

items.title: Cinematic Beyblade Rooftop Launch
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic live-action style poster of a rooftop Beyblade launch at sunset, ideal for toy advertising, fan art, or action campaign visuals.
items.content: A hyper-realistic cinematic action photo of a young man mid-jump above a rooftop at golden-hour sunset, captured from a dramatic low angle against a glowing orange sky filled with scattered clouds. He is centered in the frame, airborne with both knees bent, wearing a woven straw hat, an open {argument name="jacket color" default="bright red"} overshirt flaring in the wind, a white tank top, dark loose cargo-style pants, rugged dark boots, layered necklaces, fingerless gloves, and a belt with a launcher holster clipped at his waist. His right arm is thrust toward the camera, launching a spinning top toy on a visible ripcord, with the toy in the extreme foreground on the right side rendered large and motion-blurred for depth and speed. Place a transparent plastic Beyblade battle stadium at the bottom foreground, catching warm reflections from the sunset, with the clearly visible printed logo text {argument name="brand text" default="BEYBLADE X"}. The city skyline stretches across the lower background with several high-rise buildings silhouetted by the setting sun near the horizon. Lighting is intensely warm and backlit, with strong rim light, cinematic contrast, subtle lens flare, and dynamic fabric movement. The composition should feel like a live-action promotional poster for {argument name="toy franchise" default="Beyblade X"}, emphasizing energy, youth, speed, and urban rooftop competition, in vertical poster format.

items.title: Cinematic Spinning Top Street Duel
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic live-action style action image of a straw-hatted hero battling suited opponents with 2 colliding spinning tops in a historic city street, ideal for cinematic poster art or viral anime-inspired concept imagery.
items.content: A cinematic live-action action scene in a narrow old European stone street at golden-hour sunset, shot from an extremely low, close-up perspective with a dramatic wide-angle lens. In the center-left foreground, a dynamic male fighter inspired by {argument name="character name" default="Luffy"} lunges forward in mid-motion, wearing a straw hat, an open {argument name="jacket color" default="red"} shirt, a light tank top, and dark pants. His body is twisted aggressively as he launches a spinning-top battle attack with a handheld launcher. In the right foreground, a sharply dressed gangster-like man in a dark suit and white shirt leans in, also firing a launcher, with two more suited men behind him and a crowd of onlookers filling the street. In the immediate foreground, exactly 2 spinning tops collide on a glossy dark surface, producing showers of bright orange sparks and multiple circular light trails that arc around them, emphasizing speed and impact. The environment is dense and atmospheric: weathered stone buildings rise on both sides, the street is packed with spectators, and a grand baroque cathedral dome and towers stand in the sunlit background. Use intense warm amber and copper lighting, deep shadows, high contrast, dust and spark particles, gritty texture, dramatic motion blur, shallow depth of field, and an epic blockbuster tone. The composition should feel like a hybrid of underground battle, street duel, and anime-inspired live-action adaptation, with kinetic energy, tension, and hyper-detailed realism.

items.title: Surreal Futurist Japanese Collage Poster
items.description: A richly layered mixed-media poster prompt for generating a dense editorial collage that merges Tokyo street life, space-age symbolism, protest art, and eco-futurist cityscapes.
items.content: A dense surreal collage poster blending retro Japanese street culture, dystopian futurism, environmental collapse, and cosmic dream imagery in one vertically stacked composition. The image should feel like layered mixed-media street art made from torn posters, ink illustration, manga textures, watercolor washes, newspaper print, spray paint, and graphic design fragments. The overall palette combines deep midnight blues, black, cream paper tones, neon magenta, crimson red, cherry blossom pink, and industrial gray. In the upper left, show a large red sun behind Mount Fuji with cherry blossom branches crossing the corner, and a small airplane in the sky. Along the left side and lower left, depict a crowded Tokyo-like city street packed with pedestrians, glowing signs, dense buildings, and a tall cylindrical building with a smiley face near the top and a vertical sign reading AI IS WATCHING YOU. Include stylized Japanese-style signage on nearby buildings. Add a giant wave motif and a pagoda integrated into the urban scene. In the upper center, place a dark industrial skyline with multiple smokestacks releasing massive black clouds, transitioning into a giant astronaut floating forward with one hand reaching out. In the upper right, transform the sky into outer space with stars, a swirling purple-and-blue nebula, and a black hole. Beneath that, create a futuristic eco-city of sleek skyscrapers mixed with lush trees, cliffs, and cascading waterfalls. Add a glowing neon sign on the far right that reads DREAMING IS FREE. Near the astronaut, place a torn poster with the text THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN in large type and below it But we are the authors in smaller type. Across the center, layer floral elements including cherry blossoms and large roses around a partially obscured central human portrait to give the sense of fragmented identity. In the lower center, show a person from behind wearing a dark hooded jacket with graffiti-style text reading QUESTION EVERYTHING. Around them, include additional cutout portrait fragments, a Mondrian-inspired geometric block of red, blue, yellow, white, and black rectangles, a classical marble bust fragment, a white dove in flight, a small protest sign that reads EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY, and a seated figure looking toward the futuristic landscape. In the lower left corner, include part of a noir-style person in a dark hat and coat, and in the lower right, part of a manga-style female face in profile. Scatter graffiti, torn edges, ink splatters, layered paper textures, and poster remnants throughout. The composition should be extremely busy, cinematic, and thought-provoking, balancing hope and anxiety, tradition and technology, nature and urban overload, in the style of a high-detail contemporary collage mural.

items.title: Short-Form Attention Tax Poster
items.description: A high-contrast editorial infographic poster about the hidden cognitive cost of short-form media, suitable for awareness campaigns, social commentary, or magazine-style design.
items.content:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. items.title: Gothic Anime Witch Library Ensemble
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic dark-academia anime group portrait of eleven stylish magical schoolgirls posed in an opulent gothic library, ideal for fantasy key art or ensemble character posters.
items.content: A lavish dark fantasy anime illustration of 11 elegant young women gathered in a grand gothic library at night, composed like an elite magical academy coven portrait. The room is filled wall-to-wall with towering wooden bookshelves, rolling ladders, crimson velvet banners with occult gold sigils, carved paneling, candlelight, a warm table lamp on the far left, red upholstered armchairs and sofas, stacked antique books, potion bottles, crystal orbs, brass instruments, and a tall arched window showing a deep violet night sky. The overall palette is black, crimson, gold, and purple, with dramatic low-key lighting, rich shadows, glossy highlights, and a luxurious, sinister atmosphere. All 11 characters wear coordinated occult-school uniforms: black tailored jackets with gold embroidery and crest details, white shirts, red ties or ribbons, layered belts and chains, short skirts or fitted bottoms, black thigh-high stockings, and black capes lined in dark red. Place 3 seated prominently in the middle on ornate red chairs and sofa, 3 in the back row standing among the shelves, 3 in the front row on the floor or leaning close to the table, and 2 reclining at the far left and far right edges. Vary their hair colors and styles across the group, including {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"}, silver, black, red, blue, brown, and purple; use long wavy hair, twin tails, straight long hair, side ponytail, and loose layered cuts. Give each woman a calm, confident, slightly dangerous expression, as if they are genius witches or aristocratic students. Count and include 6 clearly visible magical effects or props being actively handled: 1 red flame floating above a raised hand in the back center, 1 glowing purple orb held by a standing girl near the upper right center, 1 swirling purple magic circle over an open book at the lower left, 1 faint purple arcane flame near the lap of the seated silver-haired girl on the right-center, 1 dark violet smoky aura around the far-right reclined girl, and 1 glowing purple crystal lamp or alchemical vessel on the central coffee table. Also include 4 additional glass vessels in the foreground and side tables: 1 crystal ball at the bottom left, 1 tall red potion bottle at the bottom right, and 2 smaller laboratory bottles beside it. Add multiple open and closed grimoires across laps, tables, and the floor, with at least 8 visible books in total. The central focal character is a poised blonde girl seated in the largest armchair, legs crossed, hand near her face, framed as the leader. Render in highly detailed polished anime style, ultra-detailed fabrics, intricate gold trim, subtle facial shading, luminous eyes, cinematic composition, wide group shot, fantasy key art quality, moody gothic academia, magical sisterhood, sharp focus, ornate environment, no modern objects.

items.title: Doomscrolling Editorial Poster
items.description: A monochrome brutalist poster about social media addiction, ideal for awareness campaigns, magazine-style graphics, or conceptual editorial art.
items.content: A stark black-and-white editorial anti-tech poster on an off-white background, designed like a modern brutalist magazine cover about digital addiction. The composition is vertical and highly typographic, with one central surreal image and multiple blocks of small text. At the top center, huge bold condensed sans-serif text reads DOOM on one line and SCROLLING below it, with the word SCROLLING stretched across the page and partially motion-blurred or smeared horizontally. In the upper left corner, a tiny text block reads “SCROLL. SWIPE. NOTHING CHANGES.” with a short horizontal line above it. In the upper right corner, small text reads “24 / 7 / 365” above “THE FEED NEVER ENDS” with a horizontal divider line below. On the left side under the title, add a definition paragraph in small editorial text: “the act of spending an excessive amount of time scrolling through negative or distressing content online, often leading to feelings of anxiety, helplessness, and fatigue.” Beneath that, include 2 short horizontal divider lines, then a large statistic reading “67%” followed by smaller text: “OF PEOPLE AGED 18–24 SAY THEY SCROLL MORE THAN THEY INTEND TO. — PEW RESEARCH, 2023”. Below that, another statement reads “MORE SCROLLING. LESS LIVING.” with a divider line beneath. The center of the poster features a glossy black smartphone standing vertically at the bottom center, seen front-on, with the bottom speaker holes and charging port visible. Emerging from the phone screen is a long impossible staircase receding upward into a narrow tunnel made of repeated translucent vertical panels, creating a claustrophobic corridor. Within the tunnel, a giant grayscale human eye appears in the upper half, partially obscured by haze, vertical slicing, and ghosted repetitions, as if trapped inside the feed. The central image should feel eerie, dreamlike, oppressive, and cinematic, with soft fog, high contrast, photocopy grain, subtle motion smear, and layered transparency. Along the right side of the central image, add a narrow vertical numbered index with exactly 24 visible entries: 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, 015, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 024, 025, 026, and an ellipsis, plus a thin downward arrow underneath. In the right column, add a text block titled “DESIGNED TO KEEP YOU HOOKED.” followed by 4 short lines: “Infinite feeds. Unpredicted rewards. Endless comparison. It’s not a glitch— it’s the business model.” Below that place a simple eye/globe icon, then a black rectangular box containing the message: “AWARENESS IS THE FIRST STEP: PUT THE PHONE DOWN. LOOK UP. RECLAIM YOUR TIME.” On the lower left, place a massive cropped black word fragment reading END near the bottom edge, with another stacked statement beside it: “THE MORE YOU SCROLL, THE LESS YOU LIVE.” Add tiny vertical microtext near the left margin for editorial flavor. Across the bottom footer, place 4 icon/text groups: a globe icon, an eye icon, a small warning text block reading “WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”, an expand-corners icon, a barcode, and a final statement on the far right reading “STAY PRESENT. LIVE IN REAL LIFE.” Use minimalist Swiss-grid alignment, generous negative space, sharp black typography, subtle distressed print texture, and a high-fashion poster aesthetic.

items.description: A flashy anime-style Japanese airline ad poster for youth travel promotions, ideal for recreating branded campaign visuals with a fashionable character and airplane backdrop.
items.content: A vibrant Japanese airline advertisement poster in glossy anime style, vertical composition, featuring a stylish young female idol-inspired traveler standing in the foreground at an airport apron with a pink-and-white passenger airplane behind her. The plane is branded {argument name="brand name" default="peach"} in large lowercase letters on the fuselage and tail. Bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds, airport terminal buildings in the distance, and scattered confetti-like geometric shapes in pink and yellow create an energetic promotional mood. The character has long split-color hair, black on one side and vivid pink on the other, with cat-ear-like hair accessories or headphones, side clips, and a single ahoge strand. Her face is partially obscured by a centered rectangular blur block. She wears large metallic headphones, a silver choker, a black mesh crop top layered over a black bralette, a short black-and-white asymmetrical skirt with two front buckles, a glossy oversized pink bomber jacket slipping off the shoulders, and a teal thigh strap. She poses with one hand reaching toward the viewer and the other holding a pink boarding pass or ticket card branded with the airline name. Add a second floating ticket on the right side reading “Everywhere!” in English. Use a bold commercial layout with exactly 8 distinct text areas: 1 large top-left logo reading {argument name="brand name" default="peach"}, 1 handwritten Japanese slogan across the upper left, 1 central promotional headline block in Japanese reading {argument name="main headline" default="学生割引"}, 1 blue circular badge reading {argument name="badge text" default="U25限定!"}, 1 large discount callout reading {argument name="discount text" default="20%OFF!"}, 3 rounded white icon boxes along the bottom each with small pink travel-related icons and Japanese captions, and 1 cursive English tagline at bottom left reading {argument name="tagline" default="Fly Peach. Love Life."}. Include a small search-bar style UI element at the bottom right, extra diagonal pink graphic borders at the top and bottom, and polished ad-design typography. High-saturation pink palette, youthful urban fashion, dynamic perspective, crisp cel-shaded rendering with soft airbrushed lighting, premium anime promotional poster aesthetic.

She holds exactly 2 travel documents in one hand, a passport booklet and a boarding pass or ticket booklet in matching red-and-white airline branding. items.title: Anime JAL Student Travel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style airline advertisement poster featuring a schoolgirl traveler, a Japan Airlines plane, and a student discount campaign layout for youth travel marketing.
items.content: A bright, polished Japanese airline promotional poster in anime illustration style, formatted as a full advertising key visual with a wide 4:3 composition. The scene shows an airport tarmac under a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds, sun flare, and a large Japan Airlines passenger aircraft parked behind the character, with the fuselage and tail logo clearly visible. In the foreground stands a cheerful high school girl traveler in a dynamic welcoming pose, one arm stretched toward the viewer as if inviting them to come along. She has long blonde twin-tail hair with soft waves and pink-dyed tips, windblown dramatically, and her face is simplified and unobstructed for a clean commercial illustration. She wears a black school blazer with gold trim, a white dress shirt, a red-and-black ribbon bow, a pleated black skirt with gold hem, thigh-high black socks, and carries a black shoulder bag with a cute round animal charm. Beside her is 1 silver rolling suitcase covered with multiple colorful travel stickers, including a prominent airline-themed sticker. The overall mood is youthful, aspirational, energetic, and travel-forward, blending school life and air travel. Include exactly 2 handwritten-style English phrases in the sky area: "Let's go!" near a doodled white airplane trail at upper right, and no other English handwritten phrase besides the brand text. Recreate the poster layout with exactly 1 airline brand block at top left reading "JAPAN AIRLINES" with a red crane logo, 1 large Japanese headline in brush-style lettering across the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="羽ばたけ、未来の私へ！"}, and 1 smaller Japanese subheadline beneath it reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="旅は、きみをもっと強く、もっと自由にする。"}. In the mid-left area, place a large white promotional panel with pink accents for a student discount campaign. This panel contains exactly 1 campaign title block with Japanese text reading {argument name="campaign name" default="JALの学生割引 スカイメイト"}, exactly 1 pink circular badge reading {argument name="discount text" default="最大12% OFF!"}, and exactly 3 bordered icon boxes aligned horizontally underneath. The 3 icon boxes should show: 1 graduation cap icon with Japanese text indicating students can use it, 1 suitcase icon with Japanese text indicating all domestic routes are eligible, and 1 calendar icon with Japanese text indicating same-day reservation changes are allowed. Add additional handwritten-style Japanese copy in smaller sizes around the lower half of the image for an emotional travel-ad feel, plus 1 pink call-to-action banner at the bottom left with a search-bar-like box containing Japanese reservation text. Place 1 circular red JAL logo at the bottom right corner. Use glossy anime poster rendering, crisp linework, vivid lighting, subtle lens glow, saturated sky blues, pink accent graphics, and premium commercial ad composition.

items.title: Epic French Dystopian Book Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a dark cinematic French-language novel cover featuring a lone figure overlooking a frozen city crowned by a gigantic central tower.
items.content: A cinematic French dystopian science-fantasy book cover in vertical poster format, dark and epic, with a cold desaturated palette of charcoal blue, steel gray, ash white, and muted silver. In the foreground, show 1 solitary young traveler seen from behind, standing on a snow-dusted rocky cliff at lower left, small against the environment, wearing a weathered winter jacket, rugged pants, boots, and a large worn backpack, with messy light brown hair visible, posture still and contemplative as he looks out over a vast ruined city. In the middle distance, depict 1 immense circular or sprawling fortified city in a frozen valley, dense with countless dark gothic-industrial buildings and spires, surrounded by icy water channels and connected by several narrow bridges. Rising from the exact center of the city, place 1 colossal needle-like black tower that dominates the skyline, dramatically taller than everything else. Surround the city with jagged snow-covered mountain ranges on both sides and in the far distance. Above, create a stormy sky filled with heavy textured clouds, faint snowfall or drifting ice particles, and a pale backlit glow breaking through behind the central tower, giving a mythic apocalyptic atmosphere. Composition should emphasize scale, isolation, and awe, with the traveler occupying only a small portion of the image and the city and tower centered. Add distressed serif typography integrated as a cover design: at the very top in small uppercase French text, "DANS L’UNIVERS DE APRÈS L’EFFONDREMENT"; below it, a huge title in cracked weathered off-white serif capitals, "{argument name="title text" default="ELON"}", spanning nearly the full width; beneath the title place 1 small compass-star ornament centered with thin horizontal lines. At the bottom center, add the author name in refined serif capitals, "{argument name="author name" default="MARTINOLLI"}". Make the overall image look like premium dark fantasy / post-apocalyptic cover art, ultra-detailed, atmospheric perspective, realistic textures, dramatic lighting, moody, monumental, polished publishing design.

Keep the dish itself recognizable, but integrate it as the main visual in the top-right hero area and build a complete premium branding presentation around it on a warm beige editorial layout with refined Moroccan-inspired styling. Add a top-left brand block with the restaurant name as a large serif logotype, a small geometric emblem above it, and the French tagline “SAVEURS D’AILLEURS, SOURIRES D’ICI.” Include a short French brand paragraph and a bold closing sentence beneath. Then create a structured grid brand guide with exactly 9 sections: 1) “LOGO PRINCIPAL” showing the main logo on a light background, 2) “VARIATIONS” with 3 logo variations — one red square version, one green square version, and one circular seal version, 3) “TYPOGRAPHIES” showing 3 text styles — titles, subtitles, and body copy, 4) “PALETTE DE COULEURS” with 6 color swatches labeled Casbah Red, Sahara Sand, Olive Green, Spice Orange, Mint Green, and Charcoal, each with hex codes, 5) “INSPIRATION” with 3 image tiles — Moroccan arch tilework, colorful spices, and fresh mint leaves, 6) “PACKAGING” with 3 mockups — paper takeout bag, food bowl with sleeve, and takeaway coffee cup, 7) “MERCHANDISE” with 3 mockups — apron, tote bag, and cap, 8) “RÉSEAUX SOCIAUX” with 3 social post designs using the food and ingredient imagery plus short French marketing copy, and 9) “VOIX DE LA MARQUE” with 4 brand voice traits and short French descriptions. Add a minimalist quote block on the right reading “BIEN MANGER. SOURIRE. RECOMMENCER.” Finish with a full-width deep red footer band containing the logo centered and subtle Moroccan geometric patterns. Overall look: luxury restaurant branding board, clean agency presentation, cohesive Moroccan visual identity, elegant typography, realistic mockups, soft natural textures, editorial spacing.

items.title: Dogs Carrying Giant Bone by the Sea
items.description: This prompt generates a humorous painterly coastal scene of four dogs riding in a vintage car with an enormous bone strapped to the roof, ideal for whimsical art prints or social media visuals.
items.content: A whimsical painterly illustration of a vintage turquoise station wagon driving along a coastal road, shown in clean side profile against a simple blue sky and calm ocean horizon. On the roof, tied down with 4 visible tan ropes, is an absurdly oversized white dog bone, rough-textured and sculptural, longer than the car itself. Inside the car are 4 dogs total: 1 golden-brown dog in the driver’s seat with one paw on the steering wheel, 2 golden-brown dogs sitting in the middle and rear windows looking outward, and 1 white-and-brown dog at the back with its head tilted slightly up. Use thick expressive oil-paint brushstrokes, soft impasto texture, slightly naive folk-art realism, gentle humor, and a minimalist composition with the car centered horizontally. The road is dark in the foreground with a thin sandy strip near the water, and the palette is dominated by sky blue, sea blue, faded turquoise, cream white, and warm brown. Bright daylight, no text, no extra objects, serene but funny road-trip mood.

items.title: Anime Fantasy Travel Movie Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished vertical anime film poster with a central silver-haired girl, layered travel scenery, Spanish promotional text, and theatrical award-style graphics for cinematic concept art or mock movie campaigns.
items.content: A cinematic anime movie poster for a fictional film titled {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"}, in polished modern Japanese animation style with a natural, less over-detailed look. Center a teenage anime girl from mid-thigh up, facing forward, with a short silver bob haircut, pale skin, a black choker, small black geometric earrings, a white tank top, and a dark navy oversized zip hoodie with two yellow stripes running down the sleeves. She has a backpack strap over one shoulder and both hands tucked casually into the hoodie pockets. Her face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a muted beige tone, covering the entire face area. Place her in a dramatic twilight coastal city setting that blends travel, nostalgia, and fantasy: on the left, a lit train platform with a commuter train approaching, its destination sign showing Japanese characters; behind it, a glowing city skyline with a ferris wheel. In the distance and lower left, layered mountains and a winding illuminated valley road. On the right, a cliffside coast at sunset with the sea reflecting warm light, a crescent moon in the sky, several flying seabirds, and a curving highway descending along the hillside. Also on the right, include a wooden signpost with exactly 3 directional signs labeled "NUEVOS CAMINOS", "VIEJOS RECUERDOS", and "SIN LÍMITES". At the top center, add the Spanish tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"} in elegant serif capitals. On the upper left, create an awards column in gold typography with laurel wreaths and exactly 4 award blocks: one text block reading "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS" with 5 gold stars beneath it, then three laurel award sections reading "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE ANIMACIÓN / 2024", "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE CINE / 2024", and "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL / ACADEMIA DE CINE ANIMADO / 2024". Place the film title large across the lower center in luminous ornate serif lettering with a magical glow and sweeping flourishes, layered partly over the character. Beneath it, add the Spanish quote {argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."}. Below that, add "UNA PELÍCULA DE ESTUDIO LUMINARIA" in small caps. At the bottom, add the release line {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"} in large gold serif capitals, plus tiny production logos and credits along the footer, including a small studio emblem on the left. Rich blue, violet, and warm sunset orange palette, glossy poster lighting, romantic adventure mood, balanced composition, highly polished theatrical key art, vertical one-sheet film poster.

items.title: Tradition and Modernity Toothpaste Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a premium split-screen dental campaign visual contrasting traditional oral care and a modern toothbrush, ideal for luxury brand advertising and social media comparison posts.
items.content: Luxury advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Colgate Sensation White"}, split vertically into two mirrored halves by a narrow ornate mirror with a bright blue glow at the center. On the left side, an elderly African woman in three-quarter profile stands with arms folded, wearing a richly patterned indigo-and-gold traditional wax-print dress, a matching wrapped headscarf, layered gold bead necklaces, drop earrings, stacked bracelets, and holding 1 traditional chewing stick upright in one hand. On the right side, a younger African woman in matching indigo-and-gold dress and gold jewelry mirrors the pose and holds 1 modern white-and-blue toothbrush upright in one hand. Both figures are elegant, dignified, and photographed from the waist up against a warm textured brown studio backdrop with cinematic golden lighting, high contrast, polished skin tones, and premium beauty-ad aesthetics. Add 1 red circular Colgate logo in the top left corner. Overlay large refined serif typography in cream across the middle-lower area: left text {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."} and right text {argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."}, with a glowing blue tooth icon centered between the two phrases on the mirror divide. Add a smaller centered serif tagline near the bottom in cream: {argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science"}. Place 1 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste box in the bottom right corner, angled slightly toward camera, glossy and realistic. The overall composition should communicate the fusion of ancestral tradition and modern dental science, premium African fashion portraiture, symmetrical balance, editorial campaign design, and a sophisticated international cosmetics advertisement.

items.title: Censored Anime Girl Selfie Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a soft, intimate anime-style portrait of a seated young woman with her face hidden by a censor block, ideal for profile art or mood-driven social media visuals.
items.content: A soft, muted anime-style illustration of a young woman seated indoors at a table, shown from a slightly elevated close-up angle as if taken in a casual selfie. Her face is fully obscured by a centered square censor block in a warm taupe tone. She has long, slightly tousled {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair with delicate strands falling over her shoulders and chest, natural shine, and a gentle layered cut. She wears an oversized {argument name="top color" default="off-white"} sweatshirt over a visible gray inner collar, plus a thin silver necklace with a small drop pendant. Her pose is relaxed and intimate, with one arm extending toward the viewer, shoulders slightly angled, and her body turned diagonally across the frame. The background is minimal and calm: a beige wall, a dark bench or chair back, and the corner of a wooden tabletop visible at the lower right. items.title: Tradition and Science Colgate Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a premium split-screen toothpaste advertisement contrasting ancestral dental care and modern brushing for brand campaigns or social media marketing.
items.content: Create a polished square advertising image for Colgate Sensation White, split vertically into two equal halves with a glowing divider line in the center, showing a side-by-side contrast between tradition and modern science. On the left half, place an elderly African woman seated behind a pale marble tabletop in a warm, earthy interior with carved wooden wall panels and a clay pot in the background. She wears a richly patterned traditional rust-orange and gold wrap dress with layered bead necklaces and bracelets, and has short gray natural hair. She holds a natural chewing stick near her mouth in a calm, dignified pose. Curve the French headline text above her head in large warm golden-yellow letters: "Depuis toujours." On the right half, place a young African child seated behind the same tabletop in a sleek modern blue interior with soft glowing lights and vertical gold accents. The child wears a vivid traditional-modern outfit: a copper-brown tunic with bright blue patterned front panel and gold trim, with neat braided hair, and holds a Colgate toothbrush near the mouth. Curve the French headline text above the child in large bright blue letters: "Pour toujours." At the bottom center, spanning both halves and placed prominently on the marble table, show exactly 2 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste boxes stacked slightly offset, with one matching toothbrush resting on top. The packaging must be highly legible and realistic, featuring the red Colgate logo and blue-white Sensation White branding. Add a bold white French tagline centered along the bottom edge: "Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science". Use cinematic commercial lighting, premium product-photography realism, rich skin tones, balanced symmetry, and a visual story of heritage meeting innovation.

items.title: Editorial Woman in Wildflower Hills
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic outdoor editorial portrait of a woman in sheer white lace standing in a flower-filled mountain meadow, useful for fashion, lifestyle, or dreamy countryside photography concepts.
items.content: A soft, editorial-style outdoor fashion photograph of a woman standing in a wildflower meadow in the mountains during daylight, shown from behind with her body turned slightly three-quarters to the side and her head angled back toward the camera. She has shoulder-length to mid-back tousled {argument name="hair color" default="dark blonde"} hair, windblown and slightly messy. Her face is fully obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in a warm beige-brown tone. She wears a delicate, sheer white lace outfit consisting of 2 visible pieces: a long-sleeved semi-transparent floral lace top with ruffled cuffs and high-waisted white lace bottoms. The pose is relaxed and sensual, one arm hanging down and the other resting near her hip. Surround her with dense natural grasses and blooming wildflowers, including visible white daisies and small yellow flowers in the foreground and midground. Place her in front of rolling green and golden hills with dramatic chalky white cliff faces and erosion lines across the background. Use a wide open landscape, partly cloudy blue sky, warm natural sunlight, earthy tones, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition, realistic photography, high detail, soft contrast, and a dreamy bohemian countryside mood.

items.title: Japanese Roman Typeface Specimen Poster
items.description: A sophisticated editorial poster showcasing a fictional bilingual serif typeface, suitable for font presentation, branding mockups, or typographic art prints.
items.content:
Create a refined vintage-modern type specimen poster for a fictional typeface named {argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}, designed as an elegant fusion of Roman and Japanese typography. Use a tall portrait layout on warm ivory textured paper with thin gray divider lines, black letterforms, and muted vermilion accent text and seals. Center the composition around a large serif Latin wordmark "{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}" above 2 oversized Japanese kanji, "華世", set in a matching high-contrast classical style. Above the title, place the small heading "INTRODUCING" with a tiny ornamental diamond. To the right of the title area, add a vertical Japanese tagline reading "古典の美、未来の書体。". Under the main kanji, add the subtitle "A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE" and below it a Japanese line in vermilion: "ローマの精神、日本の美。". On the far left, create a narrow sidebar with the stacked English text "A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN", a small circular crest, the Japanese text "製作 — MMXXIV", and "CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN".

Build the lower two-thirds as a meticulous type specimen sheet with exact labeled sections. In a left column, include 2 sections: "WEIGHTS" with 5 items — Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold — and "POINT SIZES" with 9 items — 8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt. In the main area, include a section titled "ROMAN CHARACTERS" showing 4 specimen lines: uppercase alphabet A through Z, lowercase alphabet a through z, numerals 0 through 9, and a punctuation/symbol line with slashes, commas, semicolons, exclamation mark, question marks, apostrophes, quotation marks, em dash, parentheses, brackets, braces, ampersand, at sign, dollar sign, asterisk, dagger, and double dagger. Below that, include a section titled "JAPANESE CHARACTERS" with 4 lines: 19 kanji "日 月 山 川 花 鳥 風 林 火 水 土 金 木 道 心 時 空 光 夢 永", 23 hiragana "あ い う え お か き く け こ さ し す せ そ た ち つ て と な に ぬ ね の", 21 katakana "ア イ ウ エ オ カ キ ク ケ コ サ シ ス セ ソ ン タ チ ツ テ ト ナ ニ ヌ ネ ノ", and a symbols line including Japanese punctuation, corner brackets, wave dash, middle dot, parentheses, angle brackets, double angle brackets, black lenticular brackets, postal mark, reference marks, and iteration mark.

Along the next row, add 4 compact specimen panels: "LIGATURES" with 10 items — Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU, and "st ct fi fl ft fb"; "STYLISTIC ALTERNATES" with 12 items — A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t — arranged as a neat sampling grid; "SPACING STUDY" showing the word "KASEI" with wide tracking above the kanji string "華世永美"; and "NUMERAL STYLES" with 4 lines — lining figures 0123456789, oldstyle figures 0123456789, and small caps combinations "H 0123" and "H 0123". Add tiny red Japanese captions beneath some of these sample boxes.

At the bottom, create 3 feature panels. Left panel titled "WORDS" with 3 entries: "HARMONIA" with the red Japanese and English gloss "調和  HARMONY", "VERITAS" with "真実  TRUTH", and "FORTITUDO" with "勇気  COURAGE". Center panel with a large Japanese quote "時を越え、美は残る。" above the English statement "BEAUTY ENDURES\nBEYOND TIME." and a small signature line "— KASEI" in red. Right panel titled "DETAILS" with a large kanji "永" over faint construction circles and guide lines, plus 4 right-aligned Japanese annotation callouts connected by fine dotted leader lines.

Finish with a footer containing 4 blocks: a small crest and "KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY" with "WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP"; a centered language support note "SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES" and "LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS"; a right-side statement "DESIGNED WITH RESPECT\nCRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE"; and a square vermilion seal bearing "華世". Overall style should feel like a premium Japanese foundry specimen sheet, balancing editorial Swiss-grid precision, classical book typography, subtle Japanese branding, generous margins, restrained luxury, and museum-poster elegance.

items.title: Futuristic STEM Classroom with Holograms
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic photorealistic classroom scene of children exploring immersive holographic science exhibits, ideal for STEM education campaigns, concept art, or innovation marketing.
items.content: A bright futuristic classroom or science museum learning lab filled with school-age children interacting with large mixed-reality holograms, cinematic ultra-detailed photorealism. The scene is a wide-angle interior during warm late-afternoon sunlight, with floor-to-ceiling glass windows, modern tables, bookshelves, digital displays, and a clean high-tech educational atmosphere. About 9 children and 1 adult teacher are spread across the room, actively exploring science exhibits with gestures and touch interactions. In the center, a glowing semi-transparent holographic human heart floats at chest height while 3 children gather around it, reaching toward it in curiosity. Suspended overhead is a large holographic solar system mobile with exactly 9 planets orbiting a bright sun, with luminous orbit trails and a magical scientific visualization style. On the left side, one child interacts with a tall vertical holographic DNA double helix. On the front-left table, there is a circular tabletop hologram of a miniature mountain-and-river ecosystem containing exactly 4 visible animals: an elephant, a deer, a llama or alpaca, and a bear. On the back-left table, there is a circular holographic architectural city model featuring a grand classical domed building and surrounding structures. On the right-front table, there is a large ball-and-stick molecular model made of glowing spheres and rods. In the mid-right and upper-right space, include additional floating science holograms: exactly 2 geometric polyhedra, exactly 2 molecule diagrams, exactly 2 spherical energy or data globes, and 1 hourglass-like abstract hologram. The children should be ethnically diverse, dressed casually, engaged, amazed, collaborative, and looking at different holographic subjects. Use soft volumetric sunlight, realistic reflections on glass and tabletops, subtle blue and gold glow from the holograms, shallow atmospheric haze, and a premium inspirational STEM-education advertisement aesthetic.

items.title: Watercolor Elf Girl on Sunlit Bed
items.description: This prompt generates a dreamy watercolor anime portrait of an elf girl seated on a bed, ideal for fantasy character art, soft illustration prints, or mood-piece concept imagery.
items.content: A soft pastel watercolor anime illustration of a young elf girl sitting on a bed in a quiet sunlit bedroom, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. She has {argument name="hair color" default="warm orange"} shoulder-length hair with soft layered strands, large blue eyes, pale skin, and long pointed elf ears. A red flower hair clip decorates the left side of her hair. Her expression is calm and dreamy as she gazes upward toward the bright light on the right side of the image. She wears a loose sage-green chiffon dress with ruffled trim, sheer puffed long sleeves, gathered ribbon details at the chest, and a black lace camisole visible underneath, plus a thin red choker with a small pendant and dark thigh-high stockings. She is posed seated near the edge of a lavender bedspread, leaning back with both hands resting on the mattress behind her, legs extended diagonally toward the lower right. The room is delicate and minimal: 1 bed with 2 white pillows, 1 wooden headboard or bedside surface behind her, 1 window on the left, 1 small potted plant on the windowsill, and flowing lavender curtains. Strong warm sunlight floods the scene from the right, creating a large glowing white area and gentle washed-out highlights. Use an airy handmade watercolor look with visible paper grain, soft bleeding edges, pastel lilac and cream shadows, subtle sparkled pigment texture, and a serene fantasy slice-of-life mood.

items.title: Futuristic Audi Tron Concept Coupe
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic studio render of a white futuristic Audi-like electric concept car with exposed rear mechanical components, ideal for sci-fi automotive concept art and premium vehicle visualization.
items.content: A futuristic concept coupe based on an {argument name="car brand" default="Audi"}, shown in a low rear three-quarter side view facing right, isolated in a vast black studio with a dark matte floor and almost no background detail. The car has a sleek white body with a long fastback roofline, blacked-out windows, an ultra-low stance, wide body proportions, and smooth minimalist surfacing. The side features 1 large pale gray swoosh graphic across the door and rear quarter panel, resembling a sporty decal. The rear is partially transparent or cut away to expose the performance drivetrain: 1 visible battery pack mounted low behind the cabin, 1 exposed metallic motor or transmission assembly, and 3 thick silver exhaust or intake pipes curving through the rear mechanical bay. The tail includes a continuous thin LED light bar spanning the width, the Audi rings glowing at center, and the word “tron” illuminated beneath. The wheels are deep black multi-spoke performance rims with low-profile tires; both visible tires have glowing white sidewall lettering, with stylized Japanese characters and racing text. Add subtle illuminated branding near the side skirt and front wheel arch. Lighting is cinematic and moody with cool blue rim light, glossy reflections, soft bloom, and a faint cyberpunk halo around the illuminated elements. Hyper-detailed automotive render, premium concept-car design visualization, photorealistic materials, dramatic contrast, clean composition, no people.

items.title: Night Drift Futuristic Sports Sedan
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic realistic photo of a modified futuristic sedan drifting through a wet city street at night, ideal for automotive concept art and high-end car advertising visuals.
items.content: A cinematic night automotive action photo of a futuristic white electric sports sedan inspired by an Audi e-tron GT, captured in a fast side-tracking shot while it drifts hard across a wet city street. The car is shown in clean left-side profile with the front pointing to the right, low and aggressive stance, black roof, dark tinted windows, black wheels, and a continuous thin LED rear light bar glowing red. The rear bodywork is radically modified and partially removed, exposing metallic turbo-like piping and mechanical components behind the rear wheel area. Thick white tire smoke billows from the back of the car and fills the entire left side of the frame. The pavement is glossy from rain and reflects blue, white, and amber city lights. The background is very dark with soft bokeh from distant buildings and streetlights, plus faint vertical poles and barriers, all heavily motion-blurred to emphasize speed. Use a moody urban color palette of black, steel blue, cool white, and warm orange highlights, realistic photography, high detail, low-angle tracking perspective, long-lens panning shot, dramatic reflections, shallow depth of field, and intense motorsport energy.

Surround the scene with abstract urban bokeh, streaking neon signage, reflections of red, blue, and white city lights across the wet pavement and glossy bodywork. items.content: A cinematic nighttime automotive action shot of a futuristic electric sports coupe racing through a modern downtown city, viewed from a low rear three-quarter tracking angle. The car is a sleek {argument name="car brand" default="Audi"} concept vehicle with a glossy {argument name="body color" default="white"} body, black roofline, dark tinted windows, extremely wide rear tires, illuminated rear light bar, and glowing {argument name="rear badge text" default="tron"} branding centered on the back. The rear lower section is partially transparent or open, revealing advanced electric drivetrain and battery hardware with metallic detail and cool blue illumination. The background is filled with tall glass office towers at night, hundreds of bright window lights, scattered red aircraft warning lights on rooftops, and streaking traffic lights in the distance. Include reflections along a barrier or wall on the far left edge to emphasize speed and camera motion. Lighting is cool, high-contrast, and moody, with blue-white highlights, glossy reflections on the road, and a premium sci-fi luxury aesthetic. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, long-exposure feel, dynamic tracking shot, sharp focus on the car while the city environment blurs from speed.

items.content: A romantic high-fashion travel campaign image set in a sunlit Spanish coastal village at golden hour, viewed down a narrow cobblestone stair street descending toward the sea. Whitewashed Mediterranean houses line both sides of the alley, with textured stucco walls, terracotta roof tiles, black wrought-iron balconies, wall-mounted lanterns, and many potted plants and flowers. On the right side, show 2 wrought-iron balconies, 2 wall lanterns, 1 vivid deep-blue door, and at least 8 terracotta pots with green plants mounted or placed along the facade. On the left edge, frame the scene with bright pink bougainvillea blossoms in the foreground. In the distance, the calm ocean reflects the warm sunset, with a rocky coastline and glowing horizon under a soft peach-and-gold sky. In the lower middle of the street, place 1 couple walking away hand in hand: a woman in a flowing light summer dress and a man in a pale shirt and shorts, small in scale to emphasize the environment. Composition is vertical editorial poster style, luxurious, serene, cinematic, aspirational, with warm golden sunlight casting long shadows and making the white walls glow. Add elegant overlay typography on the upper left in a refined serif font, warm brown color: the large line reads {argument name="headline text" default="España,"}, below it in italic serif reads {argument name="quote" default="siempre en mi corazón."}, with a thin ornamental flourish beneath the text. Include a subtle white {argument name="brand name" default="Pollo.ai"} logo in the upper right corner. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, premium tourism advertising aesthetic, soft atmospheric haze, natural depth, magazine-cover quality.

STILL INSPIRING. In the background, create a collage of Córdoba city landmarks: a cathedral facade on the right side, a river with bridge and low skyline on the left side, all blended into the textured poster composition. Add oversized bold condensed serif typography at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="EDU PEREYRA"}, with “EDU” in large distressed off-white letters and “PEREYRA” below in gold. items.title: Retro Constructivist Fight Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a bold vintage propaganda-style poster with two women in a stylized fight scene, ideal for satirical pulp artwork or dramatic graphic poster designs.
items.content: A gritty retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of black, deep red, and aged beige paper texture, designed like a bold vintage screen-printed action poster. Show 2 stylized women in a dramatic diagonal composition, frozen mid-fight. On the left, a woman dressed like a nurse in a short white uniform and angular nurse cap lunges forward with one knee raised and one arm bent, her body sharply foreshortened. On the right, a woman in a fitted black dress and wide-brim black hat leans backward in a defensive pose, one arm raised above her head and the other near her torso, long dark hair flowing behind her. Render both figures with hard-edged geometric shapes, exaggerated limbs, sharp shadows, and high-contrast noir facial planes. Use aggressive red diagonal rays sweeping across the background, with black architectural bars and abstract constructivist shapes framing the scene. Add distressed paper grain, ink wear, and slight misregistration for a worn print effect. Place a small blurred monkey head emblem in the upper-right corner. Include large blocky poster text in the lower left across 3 lines reading “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” then “MINCE AND” then “TATTIES”, with the first 2 lines in beige and the final 2 lines in strong red, using a heavy squared sans-serif display font. Add a red cross-like graphic element in the lower-right corner. The overall mood is violent, satirical, cinematic, and strikingly graphic, like a Soviet constructivist pulp film poster advertising {argument name="dish name" default="Scottish Recipe: Mince and Tatties"}.

items.title: Tweet Screenshot of QR Code Dice Demo
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic social media screenshot showing a tweet about an AI-made die with QR codes, useful for recreating tech demo posts and UI-based concept images.
items.content: A realistic dark-mode social media screenshot of a tweet viewed on a desktop interface. At the top left is a circular profile photo and the display name Riley Goodside with a blue verification badge, followed by the handle @goodside and the timestamp 10h. The tweet text reads: "ChatGPT Images 2.0 generates a game die but instead of numbers it has working QR codes for each of their Wikipedia articles". Beneath the tweet is a large embedded image with 2 side-by-side panels inside a rounded rectangle. The left panel shows a glossy white six-sided die resting on a warm brown wooden tabletop, photographed at a slight angle, with 3 visible faces, and each visible face contains a different black QR code instead of pips; the lighting is soft and realistic with subtle reflections on the die’s rounded edges. Above the die image is a dark UI header area with a small line of text reading "Thought for 1m 43s" and a cropped speech-bubble-like overlay near the top that says "for the corresponding Wikipedia article for its number." The right panel is a mobile-style Wikipedia page screenshot for the number 1, with a white background and thin gray borders, showing the tabs "Article" and "Talk" at the top, small interface icons, and article text beginning with "This article is about the number. For the year AD 1, and other uses, see One (disambiguation) and Number One (disambiguation)" followed by a boxed notice about special characters and the bold opening line "1 (one, unit, unity) is a number, numeral, and grapheme." The social media interface around the embedded image uses a nearly black background with standard reply, repost, like, analytics, bookmark, and share icons along the bottom, with visible counts of 45 replies, 157 reposts, 3.5K likes, and 191K views. Crisp UI typography, authentic desktop X/Twitter layout, realistic screenshot style, high legibility, subtle compression and screen-capture appearance.

items.title: Viral Tweet Menu Before-and-After
items.description: A realistic social media screenshot showing a verified post comparing a plain restaurant menu with a richly illustrated food-photo version, ideal for showcasing AI-powered menu redesigns.
items.content: A realistic dark-mode social media screenshot styled like an X/Twitter post on a black interface. At the top left is a profile avatar, the display name {argument name="profile name" default="Deedy"} with a blue verification badge, and the handle {argument name="handle" default="@deedydas"}. On the top right is a large white Subscribe button and small interface icons. The post text reads {argument name="post text" default="Bring real menus to life with pictures of the food"}. Below the caption is a side-by-side comparison image of 2 menu pages placed on a warm wooden tabletop. The left page is a minimalist fine-dining menu on white paper with sparse elegant typography, the restaurant name {argument name="restaurant name" default="Nari"} in teal handwritten script near the top right, small section headings for first course and second course, and a short list of dish names with prices in a clean editorial layout. The bottom left of the page says “Thai. Inspired.” in loose script, and a small boxed chef’s pick note appears at the lower right. The right page is a transformed illustrated menu version of the same restaurant, keeping the same restaurant name in teal script at the top and the subtitle “Thai Inspired. Bold flavors. Fresh ingredients. Made with heart.” This page is richly decorated with painted tropical leaves, flowers, and scenic borders in cream, green, and warm earth tones. It contains 2 labeled sections, “first course” at the upper left and “second course” near the middle-lower area. The first course section shows 8 plated dishes in a vertical arrangement with dish names, short descriptions, and green circular price badges: caviar, gaeng gradang tod, pretty hot sweetbreads, som tum khao po, yum polamai, naea khao tod, miang pla, and khao tung & ngor. The second course section shows 8 plated dishes with the same treatment: caramelized fish sauce cabbage, kua kling moo, giang bumbai aubergine, gaeng som pla, massaman ge, gaeng kiew wan nuea, grilled pork jowl, and naemtok moo. Near the upper right center of the illustrated page is a warm lifestyle painting of 3 diners sharing food at a table outdoors. Every dish is shown as an appetizing overhead or three-quarter plated food photo-illustration integrated into the menu layout. At the very bottom of the full screenshot, the post metadata line reads “2:52 AM · Apr 22, 2026 · 16.6K Views”. The overall image should feel like a polished viral demo screenshot showing before-and-after menu design enhancement, highly legible, photoreal UI framing with detailed editorial food-menu artwork.

items.title: Tweet Screenshot With Handwriting Match
items.description: A realistic social media screenshot showing a handwriting-matching notebook comparison, useful for generating viral AI demo post mockups.
items.content:
A realistic dark-mode social media post screenshot styled like X/Twitter on a black interface. At the top left is a small blurred circular profile photo beside the display name {argument name="profile name" default="Pratham"} with a blue verification badge, and the handle {argument name="handle" default="@Prathkum"} underneath. At the top right is a rounded white Subscribe button plus two small interface icons. The tweet text in large white sans-serif type reads: {argument name="tweet text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0 can match your handwriting."} Below it is a side-by-side comparison image made of 2 notebook photos separated by a narrow black vertical gap. Both photos show an open lined notebook page shot from above under dim indoor lighting with soft shadows near the bottom edge. The left notebook page is mostly blank except for 2 handwritten lines in neat blue cursive at the top that say: {argument name="handwriting prompt text" default="match my hanawriting ana write a poem for me.."} Keep the misspellings and punctuation exactly as written. The right notebook page shows the same first 2 handwritten lines at the top, followed by a handwritten poem in matching blue cursive handwriting filling the page in 4 stanzas. The poem text reads exactly: {argument name="poem text" default="between the pages, quiet dreams, where ink becomes the stars, i write what my heart means, and let it heal the scars.

the world may move so fast, but here, time slows its pace. in every line i’ve made to last, i find a softer space.

some days are clouds, some days are sun, but i keep showing up. with every word, i’m not alone— my pen is my cup.

so here’s to thoughts, both big and small, to hopes, to fears, to me. i’ll keep on writing through it all, and set my spirit free."} The handwriting should look natural, slightly uneven, and convincingly human, with blue ballpoint pen texture. At the bottom left of the post, include a small sparkle icon and the words “Made with AI”. Preserve the look of a genuine mobile app screenshot with realistic spacing, rounded image corners, crisp UI typography, and subtle screen-capture softness.

items.title: Historic Galleon and Chinese Junk
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed seascape of two different historic sailing ships with a small foreground boat, ideal for maritime art, historical illustration, or cinematic wall art.
items.content: A highly detailed historical maritime scene at water level, showing two large wooden sailing ships anchored close together on calm reflective water under a bright blue sky with soft scattered clouds. On the left, a massive ornate European galleon dominates the composition, viewed from the rear-left stern quarter, with richly carved baroque stern decorations in gold, red, blue, and cream, heraldic emblems, multiple stern windows, and a dark hull with warm reddish-brown planking. It has 4 visible masts including a bowsprit, dense black rigging, crow's nests, and many cream-white square sails partially unfurled and hanging loosely. On the right, a traditional Chinese junk faces slightly left, with 1 very large rust-brown battened sail raised, a curved wooden hull in brown, black, and white, carved stern details, and smaller masts and rigging. In the foreground center, include 1 small wooden rowboat with 1 standing boatman wearing light clothing and a brimmed hat, adding scale between the two ships. In the distant background, show faint silhouettes of additional sailing vessels near the horizon on the far left. Lighting is crisp daylight with warm highlights on the wood, subtle reflections in the rippling water, and a painterly yet photorealistic finish, ultra-detailed textures, cinematic composition, wide aspect ratio, no modern elements.
