items.title: Futuristic Cyber Skincare Product Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a glossy 4K beauty product advertisement with icy glass shards, skincare callouts, and a cyber-protection aesthetic for premium social or print marketing.
items.content: A futuristic luxury skincare product advertisement in a cool icy blue palette, shot as a high-end studio beauty campaign. Center a frosted white pump bottle labeled {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} with minimalist navy text reading {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, plus smaller lines "for risk-free connections", "pour des connexions sans risque", and "75 ml / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier" near the bottom. Place the bottle upright on a glossy wet reflective surface covered with realistic water droplets, with the translucent round cap lying off to the right behind the bottle. Surround the product with floating sharp-edged transparent glass shards and crystal fragments, suspended in midair like shattered ice. Several larger shards act as labeled callout panels: exactly 6 text shards reading "TEXTURE" on the left over a close-up of dewy skin, "SHIELD" in the upper right, "HYDRATION" on the right over a close-up of a blue eye and wet skin, "SECURITY SHIELD" in the lower left over a subtle hexagonal honeycomb pattern, "PROTECT" at bottom left, and "CLEANSE" at lower right. Integrate beauty-image fragments inside some of the shards: one shard shows cheek and lips with luminous skin texture, one shows a female eye with long lashes and water droplets on the skin, and one shows a scientific honeycomb barrier pattern. Add a tall soft rectangular frosted panel hovering behind the pump head in the upper center to create layered depth. Include two iridescent glass spheres on the wet surface, one at the lower left corner and one at the lower right corner. Use bright sparkling highlights, prismatic rainbow refractions, glowing rim light, floating mist, micro-particles, and a crisp 4K cosmetic advertising finish. The composition should feel premium, clean, protective, and cyber-skincare themed, blending hydration science with digital security metaphors.

items.title: Sunset Futuristic Megacity Panorama
items.description: A cinematic prompt for generating an ultra-detailed sci-fi cityscape with flying vehicles, towering spires, and a glowing sunset skyline, ideal for concept art or dramatic worldbuilding visuals.
items.content: A vast cinematic sci-fi megacity at sunset, viewed from a high observation platform between dark futuristic superstructures, with an immense glowing orange-and-gold sky filled with dramatic clouds and haze. The scene shows a sprawling vertical city extending far into the distance, packed with countless ultra-tall needle-like skyscrapers and luminous architectural spires rising through layers of clouds. A colossal hovering platform-city dominates the upper right-middle area, dark metallic and heavily detailed, suspended above the skyline with smaller towers and structures attached beneath it. In the lower left foreground, a sleek futuristic spacecraft is launching away from a terrace, angled diagonally outward toward the center, with bright blue engine exhaust trails and reflective metallic panels. Tiny human silhouettes stand along the terrace edge for scale. Multiple small flying vehicles and hovercraft are scattered across the sky at different distances, creating dense air traffic. Far below, the city grid glitters with warm lights through atmospheric mist. Use a grand panoramic composition, high contrast between dark architectural framing and radiant sunset light, intricate techno-industrial detail, atmospheric perspective, volumetric clouds, reflective surfaces, and a richly colored palette of amber, peach, violet, deep navy, and electric blue accents. Ultra-detailed, epic futuristic concept art, photoreal matte-painting feel, sharp focus, dramatic scale, vertical 4:3 composition, no text or logos.

items.description: A cinematic sci-fi cityscape prompt for generating a vast floating metropolis above the clouds with sunset lighting, towering architecture, and sleek spacecraft.
items.content: A vast cinematic sci-fi megacity floating above dense glowing clouds at sunset, viewed from a high aerial perspective. The scene shows an expansive futuristic skyline with dozens of ultra-tall elegant skyscrapers and needle-like towers rising from hovering platforms, connected by distant structures and suspended districts. In the center-right, a large floating urban hub features multiple illuminated glass domes and layered circular bases, surrounded by several monumental towers, including one especially tall central spire with a wide ring-like observation structure near the top. Warm golden sunlight pours in from the left horizon, creating a dramatic orange, peach, and lavender sky with thick clouds and atmospheric haze, while the lower half of the image is filled with soft pink and blue cloud banks reflecting the sunset. Several flying vehicles are visible: 1 large dark metallic spacecraft in the lower left foreground with bright blue engine trails, 1 circular landing-pad-like platform craft in the lower right foreground, 2 medium ships crossing the midground with blue light trails, and multiple tiny distant air vehicles scattered across the skyline. Add intricate city lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, immense scale, serene futuristic grandeur, and highly detailed concept art styling. items.title: Cinematic Heist Mastermind at Whiteboard
items.description: This prompt generates a moody crime-drama scene of a lone strategist mapping a robbery plan on a whiteboard, ideal for thriller posters, social media promos, or cinematic concept art.
items.content: A cinematic, moody heist-planning scene in a dimly lit office at night, shot in a realistic thriller style. A single adult man stands with his back mostly to the camera, slightly turned in profile, writing on a huge whiteboard filled edge to edge with tactical notes, building sketches, floor plans, arrows, routes, and hand-drawn diagrams. He has wavy dark hair and wears a dark olive or charcoal casual jacket over dark trousers, giving the impression of a mastermind strategist. The whiteboard is the focal point and contains multiple readable planning areas: the top left title says "OPERATION NIGHTHAWK"; the left column has 3 sections labeled "OBJECTIVE," "TARGET," and "TIMELINE"; the upper right has 2 labeled diagram areas, "ENTRY PLAN" and "CAMERA NETWORK"; the lower middle-right has 4 labeled planning blocks, "TRANSIT," "EQUIPMENT," "HOTEL ROUTE," and "CONTINGENCIES." Include sketched building elevations, a rooftop access drawing, loading bay notes, room labels, arrows in black and red marker, and a small van sketch near the lower center. The room is warm and shadowy with amber practical lighting. On the left side of the frame, show a desk lamp glowing over a dark wooden desk with scattered papers, and a wall with 3 framed black-and-white photographs arranged vertically. Composition is a medium-wide over-the-shoulder shot, the man centered slightly left, the whiteboard dominating the background. High contrast, soft filmic grain, tense atmosphere, realistic textures, prestige TV crime-drama aesthetic similar to a brilliant planner preparing a robbery, but not depicting any specific copyrighted character. Add a white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner.

items.title: Summer Menswear Lookbook Grid
items.description: This prompt turns a single reference portrait into an 8-look men's fashion styling board with full-body outfit variations and handwritten item labels, useful for wardrobe visualization and editorial outfit planning.
items.content:
Using the provided reference image as the same person and body base, transform it into a clean men's summer fashion lookbook on a plain warm beige studio background. Keep the subject recognizable, with the face intentionally blurred in every look, and generate 8 full-body outfit variations arranged in a 4-by-2 editorial grid. Add handwritten stylist notes with arrows labeling the key clothing items for each outfit.

Top row look 1: cream knit polo, navy tailored shorts, white leather sneakers. 
Top row look 2: sage green linen shirt, white linen shorts, brown leather sandals, sunglasses hanging from the shirt. 
Top row look 3: off-white ribbed tank, brown pleated trousers, white canvas sneakers, cream canvas tote bag over one shoulder. 
Top row look 4: light camp-collar floral shirt, light blue denim shorts, tan suede loafers. 
Bottom row look 5: white graphic tee with green "WELLNESS CLUB" text, dark green athletic shorts, white running sneakers, white crew socks, light baseball cap, canvas tote bag. 
Bottom row look 6: navy short-sleeve overshirt worn open over a white tank, beige relaxed chinos, dark brown boat shoes. 
Bottom row look 7: cream textured knit short-sleeve shirt, light wash jeans, tan wallabees, light cap. 
Bottom row look 8: black fitted tee, white linen drawstring trousers, black slide sandals, black crossbody bag.

Make it look like a polished fashion styling guide with realistic proportions, soft even lighting, minimal shadows, and elegant handwritten annotations beside each person.

items.title: Cinematic Red Heist Team in Bank
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic movie-poster-style image of a five-person masked heist crew in red jumpsuits inside a grand old bank, ideal for thriller promos and crime-series-inspired visuals.
items.content: A cinematic, gritty heist-team group portrait inspired by a Spanish crime thriller, showing exactly 5 robbers standing shoulder to shoulder in a grand historic bank interior. The scene is framed symmetrically in a low-angle medium full-body shot, with the tallest figure centered in front as the leader and 2 teammates on each side. All 5 wear identical deep red hooded jumpsuits zipped up the front, black straps and backpack harnesses, and their hoods up, creating a menacing anonymous look. The far-left and far-right robbers stand with arms crossed; the second-left and second-right robbers stand with arms relaxed at their sides; the center robber stands squarely facing camera with hands down and a dominant posture. Their faces are intentionally obscured and featureless, hidden in shadow and blur beneath the hoods. The setting is an opulent old bank hall with dark polished wood, brass safety deposit boxes lining both side walls, ornate columns, balcony railings, classical architectural details, and warm globe lamps. A bright golden overhead light pours down from the ceiling behind the group, creating dramatic backlighting, rim light on the red suits, long shadows, and a tense high-contrast atmosphere. Color palette: crimson red, black, dark brown, brass, and warm gold. Style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, suspenseful crime-drama poster aesthetic, highly detailed fabric texture, moody lighting, symmetrical composition, shallow haze in the background, sharp focus on the team. Add a white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} logo in the top-right corner.

items.title: Faux Pixel Raven in Wheat Field
items.description: A retro-inspired faux pixel art scene showing a dark raven in a golden field under clouds, suitable for demonstrating pixel-art-like AI imagery or creating nostalgic game-style landscapes.
items.content: A stylized faux-pixel-art landscape illustration of a single {argument name="bird species" default="black raven"} standing in profile in a golden wheat field, facing right. The image should look like retro pixel art at first glance when viewed zoomed out, but not be perfectly grid-aligned or true sprite-based pixel art; instead it should feel like painterly image-generation imitating pixel art, with soft inconsistencies in the block shapes and edges. Place the bird large in the foreground, slightly left of center, with glossy near-black feathers shaded in deep navy and indigo, a dark beak, and one small amber-brown eye visible. Surround it with tall yellow-gold grasses and exactly 9 visible small purple wildflower blossoms scattered in the foreground. In the midground, show a broad rural plain with patchy fields and a dark green tree line including a few tall narrow conifers on the right. In the distance, add a low mountain range in muted blue-violet tones. Above, create a bright {argument name="sky color" default="soft blue"} sky filled with large chunky cumulus clouds and a few smaller cloud bands, all rendered in limited-color dithered blocks. Use a warm late-afternoon palette with gold, blue, lavender, and dark charcoal, strong atmospheric depth, and a calm pastoral mood. Full-frame composition, landscape orientation, thin black border around the entire image, crisp blocky edges, retro game background aesthetic, highly detailed but simple, no text, no UI, no extra animals.

items.title: Zoomed Fake Pixel Art Grid Analysis
items.description: This prompt generates a close-up analysis-style image used to illustrate how AI-made pixel-art-looking visuals fail to align cleanly to a true pixel grid.
items.content: A tightly zoomed-in comparison image demonstrating fake pixel-art rendering, showing a low-resolution-looking scene enlarged on screen with a thin bright blue square grid overlay across the entire frame. The composition is an abstract close crop of a pixel-art-style environment: sandy tan and ochre blocky forms on the left and center, a dark navy and black stepped diagonal mass on the right, muted olive-green and slate-blue shapes along the upper background, and a few lighter golden highlights. Every edge looks staircase-like and blocky at first glance, but the colors softly blur and blend within the apparent squares instead of aligning perfectly to the grid, creating the impression of pixel art that breaks down under inspection. Include a small white crosshair cursor near the upper left quadrant to suggest image analysis in an editor. The overall look should feel like a screenshot from a graphics program or social media demonstration about how AI can imitate retro game art aesthetics without producing true grid-perfect pixel art, with no text labels visible.

items.title: Empty Fort Strategy at the City Gate
items.description: A cinematic Three Kingdoms illustration of Zhuge Liang calmly playing music above an open gate while enemy cavalry hesitates outside, ideal for historical scene generation and epic Chinese classic adaptations.
items.content: A cinematic historical Chinese scene depicting the Empty Fort Strategy at dawn, viewed from outside a massive ancient city gate. In the foreground, a dark armored general on horseback, seen from behind in a flowing black cape, pauses with several spear-bearing soldiers and banners, facing the open gate in suspicion. The huge wooden gate doors stand fully open, revealing a long stone-paved street inside the city. Exactly 6 townspeople are visible inside, calmly sweeping the street with brooms, spaced along the road, creating an eerie sense of normalcy. Above the gate, on a timber balcony of a traditional tiled gatehouse, a calm strategist in white robes and a tall scholar’s headdress sits behind a guqin table, with a small incense burner sending up thin smoke. Exactly 3 attendants stand around him on the balcony. The city walls are built of aged gray stone, and ranks of soldiers with upright spears line the battlements in the background. Use authentic Three Kingdoms era architecture, weathered wood, layered roof tiles, muted earth tones, soft golden morning light, distant misty mountains, long shadows, atmospheric haze, ultra-detailed textures, dramatic vertical composition, epic historical realism, cinematic framing, and a tense, quiet mood.

items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic Three Kingdoms oath ceremony tableau under peach blossoms, ideal for historical illustration, concept art, or dramatic literary scene recreation.
items.content: A cinematic historical scene from Romance of the Three Kingdoms showing the {argument name="scene name" default="Peach Garden Oath"}. Three ancient Chinese men stand side by side behind a ceremonial altar table in a blooming orchard of pink peach blossoms, each holding a respectful fist-and-palm salute at chest height. The man on the left is broad and heavily built, wearing dark lamellar armor with a deep red robe panel and rugged warrior styling; the man in the center is shorter and slimmer, wearing layered brown scholar-official robes and a simple topknot; the man on the right is tall and imposing, wearing flowing dark green robes with armor details, a long black beard, and a noble commanding presence. In front of them is one large carved wooden altar table arranged with exactly 10 ritual elements: 1 bronze incense burner in the center with three lit incense sticks and visible curling smoke, 4 bronze candlesticks with small flames placed near the corners, 1 fruit plate with peaches, 1 ewer or wine vessel on the left, 2 bronze pouring vessels on the right, and 1 open scroll laid across the tabletop. Pink petals drift through the air and scatter on the ground. The orchard forms a tunnel of flowering branches overhead, with rustic wooden fencing and traditional buildings softly visible in the background through light spring haze. Include exactly 2 horses flanking the group: a dark horse on the far left and a white horse on the far right, both saddled and calm. Composition is symmetrical, eye-level, centered on the oath ritual, with rich period textures, realistic faces and fabrics, soft natural morning light, shallow atmospheric depth, and an epic, reverent, painterly-cinematic realism in the style of a prestige historical drama.

items.title: Burning Red Cliffs Night Battle
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical cinematic illustration of the Three Kingdoms Battle of Red Cliffs, ideal for epic historical art, posters, or social media visuals.
items.content: A monumental cinematic historical painting of the Battle of Red Cliffs at night, showing an entire ancient Chinese river fleet consumed by fire. The composition is a tall vertical frame viewed from a slightly elevated dockside angle, with the river running deep into the center distance and packed with burning warships. Count exactly 3 dominant foreground raft-like platforms or deck structures on the lower left and center foreground, each made of rough timber and engulfed in flames, with soldiers standing shoulder to shoulder among drums, poles, and red battle flags. Count exactly 2 mounted commanders in the lower right foreground galloping toward the viewer along a wooden pier or bridge: the front rider is sharply visible, wearing dark lamellar armor and a wind-whipped deep red cloak, shouting with urgency; the second rider beside him is darker and partially obscured. Across the middle ground, count dozens of ancient Chinese sail warships and smaller boats, many already burning, with traditional battened sails, wooden hulls, siege-like superstructures, and collapsing masts. The far shoreline and fleet form a continuous inferno, with towering sheets of orange flame, black-red smoke clouds filling the sky, and countless sparks and embers blowing through the air. The water reflects molten orange firelight with streaks of black shadow between ships. Fill the image with dense soldiers, rigging, banners, drums, weapons, and chaotic battlefield detail, but keep the overall readability centered on the river of fire. Use a dark, dramatic palette of black, ember red, burnt orange, and bronze, with intense high-contrast firelight, volumetric smoke, epic scale, ultra-detailed textures, dynamic motion, and the grandeur of a legendary Three Kingdoms scene. Historical Chinese warfare aesthetic, grim, heroic, catastrophic, painterly realism, no modern elements, no text.

items.title: Borrowing Arrows with Straw Boats
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic photorealistic Three Kingdoms river battle scene, ideal for illustrating the famous stratagem of borrowing arrows with straw boats.
items.content: A cinematic historical war scene from Romance of the Three Kingdoms depicting the straw boat borrowing arrows on a wide gray river during a violent rainstorm, viewed from a slightly elevated front angle. In the foreground, a convoy of 6 narrow wooden boats is lashed together in a line, each boat wrapped thickly with dense bundles of straw along the sides and bow, creating rough protective walls. Hundreds of black-feathered arrows are embedded all over the straw armor, sticking out in every direction, with more arrows flying diagonally through the air in heavy wind and rain. The lead boat dominates the frame; its cabin is covered with dark blue fabric curtains and blue roof panels. Standing calmly inside the front cabin are 2 robed ancient Chinese strategists, one in a pale white robe holding a feather fan and one darker-robed companion beside him, both composed and unhurried amid the chaos. Along the left side of the boats are clustered oarsmen and soldiers in dark period clothing, with several large war drums visible on the decks. In the background across the river, a massive enemy river fleet fills the misty distance: dozens of tall wooden warships, watchtowers, and platforms crowded with troops and archers. Multiple military banners bearing the single large Chinese character "曹" rise above the fleet, indicating Cao Cao's forces. The atmosphere is cold, desaturated, and epic, with fog, smoke, rain streaks, rough water, low contrast blue-gray lighting, and highly detailed realistic textures in wet wood, straw, fabric, and river spray. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic ancient Chinese battlefield tableau, dramatic scale, moody historical realism, vertical composition.

items.description: A polished product-poster prompt for generating a fictional anime mecha schoolgirl plastic model kit advertisement with a hero figure and five labeled detail panels.
items.content:
Create a premium Japanese plastic model kit product-poster layout on a clean white studio background with subtle gray gradients and a glossy floor reflection. The main subject is a highly detailed anime mecha schoolgirl figure posed dynamically in the center-left, in a wide combat stance, holding a katana horizontally across the frame with one robotic hand gripping the hilt and the other making a peace sign near her face. The character has a blurred face area, short dark navy-blue hair in a tousled bob with small side strands, and gold horn-like mechanical hair ornaments. Her outfit is a fusion of a Japanese high school sailor uniform and hard-surface sci-fi armor: white armored torso with mechanical panel lines, a red sailor neckerchief, a pleated navy skirt, bulky white armored thighs and shins, red and blue accent parts, gold circular joint details, a dark blue waist ribbon or back cloth, and red mechanical backpack-like attachments at the hips and lower back. The katana has a dark blade and a blue-and-gold wrapped handle. Render the figure like a professionally photographed collectible model or action plastic kit, with sharp material definition, realistic molded plastic surfaces, slight satin sheen, and commercial product-shot lighting.

Design the page as a figure advertisement/spec sheet with exactly 1 large hero image and 5 smaller detail panels stacked vertically on the right. The 5 right-side panels must show: 1) close-up of the head and hair ornaments, 2) upper-body torso detail with sailor scarf and chest armor, 3) weapon and articulated hand close-up with the sword near the face, 4) waist attachment and skirt/hip armor detail, 5) leg detail close-up showing joints and armor construction. Include thin blue divider accents around the right-side panel area.

At the top left, place a large Japanese title in bold serif-like characters reading "女子甲生", with the middle character in dark red and the others in dark navy. Beneath it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle line: "— メカ × 少女 × 青春 —". On the upper right, place a sleek logo and brand name reading "{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}" with small Japanese text beneath it. Add a vertical Japanese slogan block on the left side of the hero figure reading "鋼に咲く、乙女の意志。" with the middle phrase in red. Add Japanese captions beneath each of the 5 right-side detail panels: "表情造形", "上半身ディテール", "武装・可動手", "腰部アタッチメント", "脚部ディテール". In the lower left, include a boxed scale label reading "{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"}" and nearby English product text reading "FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT". Add two small bullet lines in Japanese beneath that: "◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属" and "◆ マーキングデカール付属". Across the bottom, add a dark navy footer band with the brand logo and "{argument name="footer brand" default="TENNEN"}" centered, plus small Japanese text below.

Use a polished modern hobby-brand aesthetic, Japanese mecha-girl collectible packaging design, minimal white negative space, crisp typography, balanced editorial layout, and realistic studio-photo rendering of a non-existent original figure. Color palette: white, navy blue, dark blue, red, gray, black, and metallic gold. Aspect ratio 3:4.

items.title: Samurai Mecha Girl Figure Poster
items.description: A luxury Japanese-style product poster for an original anime mecha-girl figure, ideal for mock collectible figure ads and hobby brand presentation layouts.
items.content:
Create a premium Japanese figure advertisement poster on a clean off-white background with subtle pale gray brushstroke textures and tiny scattered gold flecks. The layout should look like a luxury hobby product introduction page for an original anime/mecha statue. The main centerpiece is a highly detailed 1/7 scale-style figure of {argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, a slim teenage anime girl in a dramatic crouching attack pose, turned three-quarters to the viewer, with one knee bent under her body and the other mechanical leg planted forward. She raises a katana overhead with both hands as if about to strike. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur block. She has long brown hair with loose strands flying outward, a white headband with a small mechanical side ornament, and a navy Japanese sailor school uniform with a cropped long-sleeve top, red neckerchief, short pleated skirt, and exposed midriff. Her arms and legs are mostly robotic: metallic silver-gray mechanical arms with articulated fingers and visible joints, bulky armored mech thighs and calves with realistic pistons, seams, weathering, and small orange caution markings. The sword is a polished katana with a white-and-black wrapped handle and a metallic guard. Render the statue as a realistic painted collectible figure with studio lighting, glossy and matte material contrast, precise shadows, and showroom-grade product photography.

Design the page like a commercial figure brochure with exactly 5 numbered detail callout sections. On the left side, stack 4 rectangular close-up panels vertically, each with a number and Japanese label plus short descriptive body text in Japanese: panel 1 shows a close-up of the face and hair, labeled "01 表情"; panel 2 shows the upper torso and uniform, labeled "02 上半身"; panel 3 shows the raised mechanical arms and sword grip, labeled "03 メカアーム&ソード"; panel 4 shows the mechanical legs, labeled "04 メカレッグ". At the bottom right, add a wider rectangular panel labeled "05 武装・ディテール" showing exactly 2 katana close-up views arranged horizontally, one above the other. Keep all panel images bordered lightly and integrated into the poster layout.

At the upper left, place a large expressive brush-calligraphy title reading {argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, with an ink-brush circle motif behind the first word. At the upper right, add a gold minimalist logo and the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}, with small Japanese tagline text beneath it. Along the right side, place a vertical Japanese promotional slogan in elegant dark text. In the lower left area, include small product specification text in Japanese with exactly these lines of product info styling: scale, product name, sculptor credit, paint credit, brand, and a release date line. Use {argument name="release date" default="2025年12月"} in the schedule area. Along the bottom, add a dark horizontal footer bar with the gold brand logo on the left, the brand name repeated, a short Japanese brand statement in small text across the center, and tiny legal/disclaimer text at the far right. Overall style: high-end Japanese figure marketing sheet, refined editorial composition, realistic collectible statue photography, elegant white-and-gold packaging aesthetic, anime girl fused with hard-surface mecha design, polished and premium.

items.title: Juventus Yamal Transfer Poster
items.description: A dramatic vertical sports poster showing a young footballer in a Juventus kit, designed for transfer announcements, fan edits, and viral social media graphics.
items.content: Create a dramatic vertical football poster for {argument name="player name" default="Yamal"} in a Juventus transfer-announcement style, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, black-and-white with metallic gold accents, gritty premium sports graphic design. The composition has 2 visible portraits of the same young male footballer with dark brown skin and short tight curly hair: one large upper-body rear three-quarter portrait dominating the top half, wearing a glossy white Juventus jersey with the name {argument name="jersey name" default="YAMAL"} printed large across the back, head turned slightly left so one ear and partial cheek are visible; and one full-body action pose in the lower center, arms spread wide while running or celebrating, wearing the modern Juventus home kit with black-and-white vertical stripes, white shorts with the number {argument name="squad number" default="19"}, white socks, and light-colored boots with a subtle pink accent on the sole. Keep the face areas softly obscured and non-detailed. Use a dark moody background with layered architectural imagery of Turin, including 3 landmark elements: a faint domed historic building on the left mid-background, a tall tower resembling Mole Antonelliana on the lower right, and a shadowy stadium structure across the lower middle. Add 3 Juventus logos: one small white logo at the top left, one large translucent logo integrated into the upper right background, and one medium white logo at the bottom right. Add bold typography and editorial layout elements: the word {argument name="main vertical text" default="YAMAL"} set vertically in huge white condensed sans-serif letters along the left side, small vertical gold text reading "JUVENTUS FOOTBALL CLUB" beside it, gold text on the right reading {argument name="side name text" default="YAMAL"} above the large gold number "19", a gold signature scribble below, the slogan "FINO ALLA FINE" stacked in gold on the lower left, "JUVENTUS" in small white text beneath it, and small coordinate text at the bottom left reading "45.0703° N, 7.6869° E" and "TORINO, ITALIA". The jersey on the action figure should include visible sponsor and badge details: Juventus crest with 3 stars, Adidas logo, Jeep sponsor, a circular tricolor badge on the chest, and a black sleeve patch reading "azimut". Add energetic white paint streaks and brush slashes in 3 main areas: upper right, lower center near the kicking leg, and subtle scratches on the left edge. Include marble-like black texture panels, gold star accents, faint chevrons, and smoky atmosphere. items.title: Vintage Fantasy Postcard of Beacon Hollow
items.description: This prompt generates a weathered retro travel-postcard illustration for a fantasy destination, ideal for creative worldbuilding promotions, fictional tourism art, or nostalgic branded concept pieces.
items.content: Create a vintage fantasy travel postcard poster for {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"}, designed like a large-letter souvenir postcard from the 1950s–1960s. The composition is a single richly detailed horizontal scene with heavily weathered paper texture, rounded postcard corners, faded inks, creases, scratches, foxing, and worn edges. Across the top and center, huge dimensional block letters spell “BEACON HOLLOW” in classic retro postcard style, with warm cream outlines and red-brown extruded shadows; each letter contains miniature painted scenic vignettes of the destination, including alpine peaks, waterfalls, pine forests, a magical manor, glowing towers, and valley landscapes. In the upper left, hand-painted script text reads “GREETINGS FROM” in dark red. In the upper right, include a circular black postal cancellation stamp reading “BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT,” overlapping a vintage postage stamp labeled “BEACON HOLLOW” and “CREATIVE RETREAT” with “7c,” depicting a moonlit mountain and a lighthouse-like beacon tower. Beneath the title, place a small curved ribbon banner reading {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"} with tiny compass-star ornaments. The main background should show a majestic golden-hour mountain valley with a winding river, distant snowy peaks, dense evergreen forests, and on the right a large timber-and-stone fantasy lodge perched on a cliff, warmly lit from within, with stairs descending the slope. Scatter subtle magical blue lights and faint arcane circular glyphs around the lodge and foreground for a worldbuilding-meets-magic atmosphere. In the lower left, place exactly 3 foreground desk objects: a dark ceramic mug with a compass emblem, an open sketchbook spread, and a fountain pen resting diagonally across the pages. The left page of the sketchbook is titled “Campaign Ideas” and lists 3 bullets: “The Forgotten Vale,” “Clockwork Pilgrims,” and “Echoes of the First Light,” with a small castle drawing below; the right page shows a tree illustration and the handwritten text “Beery world Hollow.” Across the lower center, add an old illustrated map spread out on the table, showing mountain icons and hand-drawn cartographic details. In the lower right, place exactly 5 more foreground elements: a closed leather journal embossed with a star compass and the phrase “Ideas Become Legends,” a cluster of 4 polyhedral dice, a rustic wooden signpost with 4 directional slats reading “STORY,” “GAME DESIGN,” “WORLD BUILDING,” and “AI FOR CREATORS,” a glowing glass lamp or tube device, and a nearby floating arcane target-like sigil. Add a pinned handwritten note left of center on aged paper reading, “Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — {argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"}” in blue cursive. Use painterly illustration with high detail, nostalgic Americana postcard design, fantasy concept art sensibility, warm sunset lighting, muted teal sky, sepia aging, and an inviting creative-retreat mood.

items.title: Cyberpunk Manga Page of a Giant Robot Cat
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed monochrome manga comic page of a massive mechanical cat in a Japanese city, ideal for cinematic sci-fi illustration or manga-style concept art.
items.content: A highly detailed black-and-white manga page showing a gigantic mechanical cat walking through a dense nighttime Japanese city street. The page has 4 panels total: 1 wide top panel spanning the full width, 2 smaller stacked panels on the bottom left, and 1 tall large panel on the bottom right. In the top panel, a colossal robotic cat dominates a narrow neon-lit alley lined with tall buildings, tangled power lines, vertical shop signs, and tiny pedestrians staring upward in shock. The cat has realistic feline proportions but is built from exposed armor plates, rivets, pistons, cables, gears, segmented metal limbs, and intricate machine internals, with a tag hanging from its neck that reads "猫神". The wet street reflects city lights. Add multiple Japanese signs in the environment including "古書 2F", "万事屋 B1", and "酒処". Include a large manga speech bubble in Japanese in the upper right of the top panel reading "うわっ？でっけえ!!". In the upper bottom-left panel, show a close-up of a long-haired woman seen from behind and slightly to the side, looking toward the creature, with a vertical Japanese speech bubble reading "…何でこんな街にこんなものが…". In the lower bottom-left panel, show a group of startled onlookers from the front, including a young man in the foreground and other shocked pedestrians behind him, with a vertical Japanese speech bubble reading "神様の使いか!?". In the tall bottom-right panel, show a dramatic low-angle close-up of the mechanical cat towering between buildings under a bright moon, emphasizing its chest machinery, massive forelegs, whiskers, and regal face, with the neck tag "猫神" clearly visible. Add a large stylized Japanese sound effect near the cat reading "カシ…". Use classic seinen manga aesthetics, cinematic panel composition, fine ink crosshatching, heavy contrast, detailed urban textures, realistic crowd scale, and a sense of awe, mystery, and divine cyberpunk presence.

items.title: Cozy AI Agents Studio Group Portrait
items.description: A warm anime-style ensemble illustration of five personified AI assistants in a sunlit creative workspace, ideal for editorial memes, social posts, or concept art about coding-agent culture.
items.content: A warm, highly detailed anime-style illustration set in a cozy, cluttered indie workspace that feels like a book café mixed with a startup studio, lit by golden afternoon sunlight streaming through tall windows on the right and by 4 black industrial pendant lamps hanging from the ceiling, with string lights, overflowing bookshelves, plants, and handwritten motivational signs covering the background. Show 5 young women standing around a large wooden worktable, framed as a wide group portrait. The mood is whimsical, slightly satirical, and aspirational-but-chaotic. On the far left, place a tall woman with very long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="auburn"} hair wearing a crown of white daisies and a sleeveless rust-brown dress with a white sunburst emblem on the chest and a dark belt at the waist; she holds a small handwritten note toward the viewer that reads exactly {argument name="note text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}. In front of her on a side table is a glass cup of tea, a book stack, and a tiny potted plant. Next to her, place a punky blonde woman with twin ponytails tied with black bows, large black headphones resting around her neck, and an off-shoulder black dress marked with a bold white X on the torso; she stands confidently beside an open sticker-covered laptop with another large X logo. In the center rear, place a mysterious slim girl with extremely long dark navy-black hair, pale skin, and a gothic dark dress, standing quietly in front of a desktop monitor showing a blue glowing star or sparkle on a dark screen. To the right of center, place an elegant woman in a fitted red cheongsam-inspired dress with floral embroidery and a side slit, leaning one hand on the wooden table near an open notebook filled with sketches or writing. On the far right, place a casually dressed brunette with messy hair in a bun, wearing a white T-shirt with a black knot-like AI logo under an open beige overshirt, standing behind an open silver laptop with the same logo. Scatter many cozy desk objects across the main table: 2 mugs, 1 open notebook, 1 pen, 1 small black figurine, 1 closed book stack, and laptops. Add readable handwritten wall notes and signs throughout the room: “FOCUS SHIPS DREAMS” on the upper left, “SHIPPING IS MY CARDIO” on the left wall, “turn caffeine into code” near the top center, “be kind to your future self” near the window, “The Art of Asking Nicely” on a book spine at lower left, “WORLD’S OKAYEST MODEL” on a black mug near center-left, “MOONSHOT DIARIES” on a book stack near lower right, “Good Prompts Only” on a mug at lower right, and a sticky note at the bottom right reading “AGI is already for ready us” with a small doodle. Use painterly linework, intricate textures, expressive fashion styling, warm brown and amber color grading, soft cinematic depth, and a polished social-media-viral illustration aesthetic.

On the far left, place a tall woman with very long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="auburn"} hair wearing a crown of white daisies and a sleeveless rust-brown dress with a white sunburst emblem on the chest and a dark belt at the waist; she holds a small handwritten note toward the viewer that reads exactly {argument name="note text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}. In front of her on a side table is a glass cup of tea, a book stack, and a tiny potted plant. Next to her, place a punky blonde woman with twin ponytails tied with black bows, large black headphones resting around her neck, and an off-shoulder black dress marked with a bold white X on the torso; she stands confidently beside an open sticker-covered laptop with another large X logo. In the center rear, place a mysterious slim girl with extremely long dark navy-black hair, pale skin, and a gothic dark dress, standing quietly in front of a desktop monitor showing a blue glowing star or sparkle on a dark screen. To the right of center, place an elegant woman in a fitted red cheongsam-inspired dress with floral embroidery and a side slit, leaning one hand on the wooden table near an open notebook filled with sketches or writing. On the far right, place a casually dressed brunette with messy hair in a bun, wearing a white T-shirt with a black knot-like AI logo under an open beige overshirt, standing behind an open silver laptop with the same logo. Scatter many cozy desk objects across the main table: 2 mugs, 1 open notebook, 1 pen, 1 small black figurine, 1 closed book stack, and laptops. Add readable handwritten wall notes and signs throughout the room: “FOCUS SHIPS DREAMS” on the upper left, “SHIPPING IS MY CARDIO” on the left wall, “turn caffeine into code” near the top center, “be kind to your future self” near the window, “The Art of Asking Nicely” on a book spine at lower left, “WORLD’S OKAYEST MODEL” on a black mug near center-left, “MOONSHOT DIARIES” on a book stack near lower right, “Good Prompts Only” on a mug at lower right, and a sticky note at the bottom right reading “AGI is already for ready us” with a small doodle. Use painterly linework, intricate textures, expressive fashion styling, warm brown and amber color grading, soft cinematic depth, and a polished social-media-viral illustration aesthetic.

items.title: Pixar-Style AI Web Design Sprint Poster
items.description: A cinematic animated-style event poster for a web design sprint, ideal for promoting hackathons, creative coding meetups, or startup workshops.
items.content: A stylized cinematic poster for a creative coding event, designed like a Disney-Pixar-inspired animated movie one-sheet. Vertical composition, warm cozy interior at night with a large loft window on the left showing a city skyline at sunset, exposed brick walls, and a neon-lit creative studio atmosphere. At the top center, big glossy dimensional typography reads "Disney•PIXAR" above the main title "The AI Web Design Sprint" in huge bold white 3D letters. Directly underneath, smaller bright text reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." In the center foreground, 2 adult men sit side by side at a wooden table with a laptop between them, casual startup-founder vibe, one in a dark hoodie and one in a light sweatshirt and baseball cap, both facing camera in a friendly promotional pose. Their faces should be generic and unobtrusive, with the emphasis on the event-poster composition rather than portrait realism. The laptop lid has 3 visible stickers: a purple code-brackets sticker, a black sticker with a white burst symbol, and a rectangular slogan sticker reading "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." Around the scene, include 4 whimsical animated mascot elements: a small hovering robot drone lamp in the upper left with glowing blue eyes and a cone of warm light shining downward; a smiling cartoon sun icon in the upper right; a tiny red pixel character floating nearby; and a glowing blue cat-like digital mascot standing on the table in front of the laptop. On the right side, a vertical monitor displays a dark coding interface with readable text including "// Welcome back, Julian!", "Opus 4.6", "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", "Surfers (late set)", and a checklist titled "Sprint Plan" with 4 items: "DISCOVER", "IDEATE", "BUILD", "SHIP". On the left side, a hand-lettered paper signboard contains 4 notices pinned together: "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", and "$10 ADV / $12 DOS". In the lower left foreground, a white coffee mug reads "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL" with a small skull icon. In the lower right foreground, a terracotta plant pot with green leaves reads "CREATIVE COLLISION". At the bottom center, large bold text reads "APRIL 27–30" and below it "LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB." Add a tiny line of faux credits along the bottom edge in classic movie-poster style, referencing names like Julian Lopez and Harvey Specter, projects such as Minimal Playground, Agency 976, Cyberpunk Cafe, and Surfers, and a playful production credit. Use dramatic warm-orange and cool-blue lighting, polished animated-film rendering, soft depth of field, glossy surfaces, rich contrast, highly detailed poster design, charming tech startup energy, and a premium event-advertisement finish.

items.title: Swiss Poster for AI Web Design Sprint
items.description: A bold editorial event poster for a live AI and web design sprint, ideal for conference promotion, creative tech events, and social media announcements.
items.content: Create a bold Swiss-modernist event poster for a live AI and web design sprint, portrait orientation, with a warm off-white paper background, stark black typography, and vivid red accent blocks. The composition is asymmetrical and editorial, with a strong grid and generous negative space. In the top left, place a small red uppercase line of text reading {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}, followed by a thin horizontal black rule stretching toward the right. Below it, set an oversized stacked headline in ultra-bold black sans serif, left aligned, reading {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}, broken across 4 lines with dramatic scale so the words dominate the left half of the poster. In the upper right quadrant, add 1 large solid red rectangle as a graphic block. Beneath that red block, place a compact black uppercase subhead in 3 lines: {argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}. In the lower middle, include 2 cropped grayscale portrait photos of men from the chest up, side by side, documentary style, slightly overlapping the typography area; the left man has dark slicked-back hair and a short beard, the right man wears a dark baseball cap with embroidered lettering and has facial hair. Obscure both faces with 2 vertical soft-edged gray censor rectangles centered over each face. Along the right side, create a vertical feature column with 4 black square icons, each separated by thin horizontal divider lines and paired with uppercase labels. The 4 items are: a starburst icon with the label "CREATIVE COLLISION", a connected-nodes icon with the label "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS", a code brackets icon with the label "CODE IN MOTION", and a terminal prompt icon with the label "REAL-TIME DESIGN". Near the bottom, add a full-width footer separated by a thin horizontal black rule. Inside the footer, create 4 text blocks divided by slim vertical lines: block 1 says "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.", block 2 lists "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" with a small red line beneath reading "LIVE ON THE WEB", block 3 lists "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" and below it "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" and then "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY", block 4 lists ticket info as "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS". On the far lower right edge, add vertical red text reading {argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}. Use a clean neo-grotesk typeface similar to Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk, heavy weight for the headline, condensed uppercase for supporting text, crisp alignment, subtle paper texture, and a high-contrast black-red-cream palette. The overall look should feel like a contemporary design-conference poster mixed with punk tech culture and brutalist editorial branding.

items.title: Punk AI Sprint Flyer
items.description: A gritty punk-collage event poster prompt for creating rebellious promotional artwork for tech sprints, hack nights, or underground creative events.
items.content: Create a raw, high-contrast punk rock gig poster collage for an event called {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"}. The design should feel like a xeroxed underground flyer pasted on a city wall: rough torn paper edges, photocopy grain, ink smudges, distressed black-and-white textures, hot magenta paint splashes, DIY zine aesthetics, and chaotic layered paper scraps taped and pinned together. Use a vertical poster composition with a black background and a central oversized torn white rectangle set at a slight angle, filled with huge condensed black distressed lettering for the main title. At the very top, add a smaller black torn strip with handwritten brush lettering in neon magenta reading {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}. On the left side, place a hot pink torn paper block with hand-drawn black text listing the date {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}, then smaller stacked lines reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right side, add an off-white torn note with magenta "WITH:" at the top and four supporting acts listed in black handwritten text: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". In the center-lower area, show exactly 2 black-and-white photocopied punk band members from the chest up, standing shoulder to shoulder, both wearing leather jackets with patches and pins; the left one has round glasses, the right one wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be generic and partially obscured by the collage styling so the poster focus remains typographic and graphic rather than portrait-specific. Add a hot pink spiky starburst on the mid-right containing a black circle with a simple white radial symbol. Near the bottom right, place a beige masking-tape-like paper scrap with bold handwritten black text reading "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.". Near the bottom left, add a black rectangular venue block with magenta hand lettering for {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} and smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL", plus a small white skull icon nearby. Include exactly 2 silver safety pins, one near the upper left corner and one near the lower left area, and exactly 1 strip of dark duct tape on the left edge of the main title paper. Finish the bottom edge with a black-and-white checkerboard strip spanning the full width. Overall mood: rebellious, loud, youthful, anarchic, street-pasted punk flyer meets tech event promo, with intense contrast, gritty halftone noise, screen-print imperfections, and hand-made collage energy.
items.translatedContent: Create a raw, high-contrast punk rock gig poster collage for an event called {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"}. The design should feel like a xeroxed underground flyer pasted on a city wall: rough torn paper edges, photocopy grain, ink smudges, distressed black-and-white textures, hot magenta paint splashes, DIY zine aesthetics, and chaotic layered paper scraps taped and pinned together. Use a vertical poster composition with a black background and a central oversized torn white rectangle set at a slight angle, filled with huge condensed black distressed lettering for the main title. At the very top, add a smaller black torn strip with handwritten brush lettering in neon magenta reading {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}. On the left side, place a hot pink torn paper block with hand-drawn black text listing the date {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}, then smaller stacked lines reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right side, add an off-white torn note with magenta "WITH:" at the top and four supporting acts listed in black handwritten text: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". In the center-lower area, show exactly 2 black-and-white photocopied punk band members from the chest up, standing shoulder to shoulder, both wearing leather jackets with patches and pins; the left one has round glasses, the right one wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be generic and partially obscured by the collage styling so the poster focus remains typographic and graphic rather than portrait-specific. Add a hot pink spiky starburst on the mid-right containing a black circle with a simple white radial symbol. Near the bottom right, place a beige masking-tape-like paper scrap with bold handwritten black text reading "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.". Near the bottom left, add a black rectangular venue block with magenta hand lettering for {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} and smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL", plus a small white skull icon nearby. Include exactly 2 silver safety pins, one near the upper left corner and one near the lower left area, and exactly 1 strip of dark duct tape on the left edge of the main title paper. Finish the bottom edge with a black-and-white checkerboard strip spanning the full width. Overall mood: rebellious, loud, youthful, anarchic, street-pasted punk flyer meets tech event promo, with intense contrast, gritty halftone noise, screen-print imperfections, and hand-made collage energy.

items.title: Cute Subscription Celebration Illustration
items.description: This prompt generates a cozy fan-art style thank-you scene showing a robot mascot and creator celebrating a new subscriber, ideal for social posts and supporter shout-outs.
items.content: A warm, cute digital illustration in a cozy desk setting celebrating a new subscription. On the left is a friendly humanoid robot mascot with a glossy black face screen showing pixelated purple LED eyes and a smiling mouth, wearing a tall black top hat with a purple band and a dark hoodie with a small American flag patch on one sleeve and the text "USN VET MSSP" on the chest. The robot gives a thumbs-up with one hand and holds a small rectangular sign in the other that reads "Subscribed!" with a purple heart underneath. On the right is a delighted young woman with long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair, seated at the desk with hands clasped near her chin in an excited grateful pose, wearing a white long-sleeve top with red and blue striped trim and a small chest logo. Her face is obscured by a simple square censor block. Above them, large playful handwritten text says "{argument name="headline text" default="Nick subscribed Sharon!"}". Beneath the headline is a rounded notification card showing a circular avatar of the same robot mascot, the name "{argument name="subscriber name" default="Nick"}", and the text "Subscribed to {argument name="creator name" default="Sharon Riley"}" followed by a purple heart. A speech bubble next to the woman says "{argument name="speech bubble text" default="Thank you!"}". Scatter exactly 7 pink heart doodles around the composition and add 1 small white sparkle near the center. Place everything on a wooden tabletop. On the left side of the desk, include 1 black mug with the text "CRYPTO CAN'T BE EVIL" and 1 gold coin featuring a Shiba Inu dog face. In the center-right foreground, include 1 white mug reading "AI FOR GOOD" with a blue heart. On the far right, stack exactly 3 books with visible spine titles: "AI & CREATIVITY", "ENTERTAINMENT", and "DREAM BIG" with a heart, beside 1 small potted plant. Use a softly blurred home-office background with shelves, pastel decor, and a framed letter X on the wall. Soft peach and beige lighting, painterly shading, rounded shapes, wholesome streamer fan-art aesthetic, polished storybook-style digital painting.

items.title: Japanese Video Production Poster

items.content: Create a clean, premium Japanese corporate poster for a {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} video production company, in a minimalist editorial layout on an off-white background with lots of negative space. Portrait orientation, A4-like poster proportions. items.title: J.Crew Mascot Fashion Editorial
items.description: This prompt turns a mascot reference infographic into a four-look J.Crew-style fashion editorial spread for playful brand mockups or character styling concepts.
items.content: Using the provided reference image as the character and color-palette guide, transform it into a polished J.Crew-style editorial fashion lookbook starring the same mascot. Replace the infographic/chart layout with a clean 2x2 magazine spread on an off-white background. Add a large serif brand header reading {argument name="headline text" default="J.CREW"} and an italic subhead reading {argument name="subhead text" default="Gritty’s Off Hours: Cool & Casual"}. Show exactly 4 styled outfit photos of the same character, keeping the fuzzy orange fur, big eyes, and black helmet, but placing the mascot in modern menswear inspired by the “best” colors from the reference: 1) “CLASSIC CREW” — seated on a stool in a navy sweater over a crisp white oxford with dark denim; 2) “EASY LAYERS” — standing casually in a teal overshirt, white tee, and charcoal trousers; 3) “POP OF PLUM” — relaxed pose in a plum cardigan with dark pants; 4) “MODERN SPORT” — seated in a black sporty layer with black pants, white socks, and white sneakers. Give each panel a short catalog-style caption under it matching those 4 titles and concise fashion copy. Use soft natural indoor lighting, minimal home-interior editorial settings, premium catalog photography, and a tasteful upscale preppy aesthetic. Add a small closing line centered at the bottom: {argument name="footer text" default="TIMELESS STYLE. PLAYFUL SPIRIT."}

items.title: Premium Beverage Commercial Poster
items.description: A detailed professional prompt for a high-end orange juice advertisement featuring hyper-realistic textures, studio lighting, and minimal typography.
items.content:
Create a bold, high-end commercial poster for a premium {argument name="product" default="orange juice"} brand, shot in a hyper-realistic studio environment with a strong emphasis on freshness, precision, and striking visual appeal.
Hero Composition:
A sleek transparent bottle filled with rich, vibrant {argument name="liquid" default="orange juice"} stands at the center. The label is minimal, modern, and premium, featuring a clean orange graphic with refined typography. The bottle is topped with a matte black cap, enhanced by subtle highlights and realistic reflections.
Action & Story:
Two hands wearing matte black gloves interact with the product:
One hand firmly grips the bottle from the top
The other slices through a thick, juicy orange using a sharp stainless steel knife
The cut is captured mid-action, showcasing the juicy pulp and fresh citrus texture. A few orange slices are placed at the base, slightly scattered to create a natural yet styled composition.
Lighting & Mood:
Background: deep, rich green gradient with cinematic falloff
Surface: dark matte table with soft, controlled reflections
Lighting: dramatic studio setup
Strong key light from one side for depth
Soft fill light for balance
Crisp highlights on the bottle and knife
Deep, clean shadows for contrast
Typography Layout:

Top corner:
Clean, modern brand name (e.g., “VITRA”, “FRESCO”, or “NATURO”) in white
Bottom section:
Small line: “Not your average juice”

Large bold headline: “{argument name="headline" default="PURE ORANGE. NO COMPROMISE."}”
Typography should feel modern, bold, and premium with a strong visual hierarchy. Use a rich orange tone for the headline to complement the juice.

Visual Style:

High-end food advertising aesthetic

Cinematic, bold, and contrast-driven

Ultra-sharp details and textures

Premium editorial look (like a global campaign)

Clean yet powerful composition

Output Requirements:

4K resolution

Photorealistic, advertisement-grade quality

Sharp focus, rich contrast, high dynamic range

items.content:
A high-fashion surrealist advertising poster for {argument name="brand" default="Crocs"}. The scene is set in a minimalist, monochrome {argument name="background color" default="light blue"} studio with a semi-reflective floor.

A fashion model with long dark hair, dressed in a {argument name="clothing" default="clean, all-white coordinated sweatshirt and wide-leg trousers"}, leans her entire back against the giant shoe in a relaxed, leaning posture. In the background, the word "CROCS" is written in massive, bold, white condensed sans-serif typography, partially occluded by the giant shoe and the model to create a sense of depth. At the  top right, "Designed with ChatGPT"

The lighting is soft, cool, and even, casting gentle shadows and a soft reflection of the subjects on the glossy blue floor. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and high-concept.

Make the aspect ratio 3:4

items.title: Black-and-White Fine Art Portrait
items.description: A cinematic monochrome portrait prompt capturing an introspective man in a vintage setting with high-contrast lighting.
items.content:
A cinematic, black-and-white portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man"} sitting on a {argument name="furniture" default="wooden chair"} in a vintage indoor setting. He is positioned sideways, leaning forward slightly, resting his head gently on his folded arms placed over the backrest of the chair. His posture is relaxed but heavy, conveying emotional depth and quiet introspection. He gazes downward, lost in thought, with a soft, melancholic expression.

He has slightly messy dark hair, subtle texture, and light stubble or a short beard, adding realism and character. A few strands of hair fall naturally across his forehead. He wears a {argument name="clothing" default="simple, slightly oversized white shirt"} with soft fabric folds, enhancing the candid, natural aesthetic.

Lighting is soft and natural, coming from a large window behind or to the side of him. The light wraps gently around his face and arms, creating delicate highlights while casting deep, dramatic shadows across the room. The lighting is diffused yet high-contrast, evoking classic analog film photography.

The environment is a vintage interior—aged wooden furniture, textured walls, and a large window with visible panes. The background is softly blurred but still readable, adding depth and context without distracting from the subject.

Mood is emotional, quiet, and introspective—capturing loneliness, contemplation, and stillness.

Color grading: monochrome (black and white) with rich contrast, deep blacks, soft highlights, and a film-like tonal range.

Depth of field is shallow, focusing sharply on the subject’s face and arms while smoothly blurring the background.

Style: fine art photography, cinematic film still, analog aesthetic, high dynamic range, subtle grain, timeless mood.

Camera details: 50mm or 85mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.2 aperture, natural light photography, strong subject isolation, gentle vignette.

Composition: vertical frame (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, using the chair as a framing element for a layered, storytelling composition.

items.title: Artistic Portrait with Mural Background
items.description: A complex prompt for a cinematic portrait featuring a subject in a studio with a large abstract mural in the background.
items.content: A striking artistic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="charismatic woman"} (image attached) that precisely captures her face, seated in a serene yet powerful pose. She sits cross-legged on a minimalist floor with decorative tiles, wearing a modern {argument name="top" default="blue sweatshirt"} with a minimalist print, {argument name="bottom" default="loose-fitting jeans"}, and black Converse sneakers. Her expression is serene and subtly confident, with a gentle smile and relaxed eyes as she gazes slightly toward a diffused light source. Behind her rises a monumental abstract mural of her own face, painted with bold and expressive brushstrokes in charcoal gray, white, gold, and muted red. The mural is not a literal copy, but a stylized and emotive interpretation of her: intense eyes, fragmented textures, broad brushstrokes that suggest movement, ambition, and inner complexity. Its scale dominates the background without overshadowing the main figure, creating a harmonious balance between reality and artistic representation. The lighting is cinematic and evocative, with soft reflections at the edges and a subtle overhead glow that defines her silhouette. Fine particles, like dust, float subtly in the air, catching flashes of light and enhancing the atmosphere. The setting evokes the fusion of a modern art studio with a dreamlike exhibition space: clean, spacious, minimalist, yet charged with emotion. Photographed with ultra-realistic quality, using a 50mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, sharp details, and elegant color gradation, the scene conveys creativity, introspection, and personal transformation. Negative: blurry, overexposed, cartoonish, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, poorly drawn hands, merged faces, unrealistic colors, watermark, text. ar. 9 :16

items.title: Hand-Drawn Annotated Food Diary Style
items.description: A complex, multi-layered prompt for creating Instagram-style food photography with artistic hand-drawn notes and stickers.
items.content: 生成一张{argument name="风格" default="英国牛排店"}风格的{argument name="食物" default="牛排和甜点"}的照片。像是用智能手机拍摄的、适合发到Instagram的照片。没有人物。然后，观察照片中出现的元素，并为每个元素添加有意义的手绘注释。 【描写规则】・像用白色笔画出那样的细手绘线条・一笔写成风格的粗糙、略微不均匀・像描摹物体外周那样添加轮廓线・用箭头或虚线制造视线引导【文本规则】・英文手写文字 ・简短，像自言自语一样的评论・语气是“日记・一言・情感寄托”【评论生成规则】・饮料 → 味道・温度・心情（例：清爽、温柔的甜味）・食物 → 口感・美味（例：湿润、最高）・空间 → 氛围（例：放松、美好时光）・整体 → 一言总结（例：幸福过头了～）【装饰】・蒸汽、闪闪发光、心形、小表情符号等适度添加・不过度，留出“空白”【完成风格】・Instagram故事风、杂志的粗糙笔记风 ・时尚且轻松的氛围
items.translatedContent: Generate a photo of {argument name="food" default="steak and dessert"} in the style of a {argument name="style" default="British steakhouse"}. It should look like it was taken with a smartphone and suitable for posting on Instagram. No people. Then, observe the elements appearing in the photo and add meaningful hand-drawn annotations to each element. [Drawing Rules] - Thin hand-drawn lines as if drawn with a white pen - Rough, slightly uneven single-stroke style - Add outlines as if tracing the outer periphery of objects - Use arrows or dashed lines to create visual guidance [Text Rules] - English handwritten text - Short, self-talking comments - Tone is "diary, single word, emotional connection" [Comment Generation Rules] - Drink -> Taste, temperature, mood (e.g., refreshing, gentle sweetness) - Food -> Texture, deliciousness (e.g., moist, best) - Space -> Atmosphere (e.g., relaxed, good time) - Overall -> Single word summary (e.g., too happy~) [Decoration] - Moderately add steam, sparkles, hearts, small emojis, etc. - Do not overdo it, leave "white space" [Finished Style] - Instagram story style, rough magazine note style - Fashionable and relaxed atmosphere

【基础设定】
主题世界观：【游戏主题】

Please create a high-completion, high-information-density "Pixel World Asset Atlas" suitable for serialized release based on [Game Theme: {argument name="game theme" default="Demon Slayer/Tanjiro"}].

This is not a regular pixel illustration or a single game scene, but a "2D pixel game asset overview map" for game development, art setting, level design, and visual proposals. The visual should look like a complete game material board, systematically organizing core characters, enemies, items, terrain, scenes, mechanisms, Bosses, and decorative elements required for a [Game Type: {argument name="game type" default="Side-scrolling action"}] into a single clear, professional, and reusable game asset atlas.

[Basic Settings]
Theme Worldview: [Game Theme]
Game Type: [Game Type]
Era Background: [Era Background]
Protagonist Identity: [Protagonist Identity]
Enemy Types: [Enemy Types]
Main Scenes: [Main Scene Environment]
Overall Style: [Style Direction, e.g., {argument name="style" default="16-bit retro arcade pixel style"}]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Secondary Color: [Secondary Color]
Accent Color: [Accent Color]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, Landscape 4:3]
If not filled, automatically match according to the optimal plan for the game theme.

[Overall Visual Requirements]
The visual uses a large landscape canvas with a light or low-interference background, looking like a game development asset sheet or an instruction-style resource catalog. All elements should be 2D pixel art sprites with uniform pixel density, clear black/dark outlines, limited color scales, and retro game textures. Do not generate realistic photography, 3D rendering, painterly illustration, or movie poster styles. Focus on being "systematically complete, clearly categorized, resource-rich, and high in developability."

[Layout Structure]
The map uses a modular grid layout with fine lines dividing different resource areas. Each area needs a numbered title and short category labels, with a reading path from left to right, top to bottom. The layout should have the orderliness of an instruction manual or game dev document. Information density must be high but not chaotic; elements within each module should be equidistantly arranged.

[Modules to Include]
1. Player Character Module: Show complete action frames including standing, walking/running, jumping, etc. frames arranged horizontally like a sprite sheet.
2. Enemy Unit Module: Design multiple enemies including common, ranged, heavy, and elite units.
3. Weapons & Items Module: Show melee, ranged, projectiles, effects, and pickups.
4. Basic Terrain Tile Module: Show ground, walls, platforms, corners, and different material blocks.
5. Natural/External Scene Resource Module: Show trees, grass, rocks, and obstacles.
6. Building/Base/Camp Resource Module: Show doors, windows, walls, ladders, and camp facilities.
7. Special Terrain Module: Show bridges, water bodies, cliffs, and cave openings.
8. Indoor/Underground/Facility Resource Module: Show pipes, consoles, metal doors, and equipment.
9. Boss / Encounter Resource Module: Show large Bosses, special vehicles, and giant mechanisms.
10. General Decoration & Interaction Elements Module: Show ladders, ropes, signs, switches, and mechanisms.

[Visual Detail Requirements]
All resources must maintain consistent pixel size logic and worldview consistency. Clear scale relationships. Action frames must show continuity; terrain tiles must be tileable; items and mechanisms must have functional recognizability; Boss elements should feel oppressive.

items.title: Isometric Micro-World Cross-Section Archive
items.description: A professional and highly detailed instruction prompt for generating isometric, cross-section views of miniature thematic worlds with high information density.
items.content:
请根据【主题】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「微缩世界剖面馆 / Isometric Micro-World Archive」视觉图。

这不是普通房间插画，也不是单纯的建筑图，而是一张结合“等距轴测视角 + 建筑剖面结构 + 多层功能空间 + 高密度主题道具 + 微缩模型感 + 游戏场景设定集感”的主题空间总览图。画面需要像一个被剖开的微缩世界、经营模拟游戏场景、玩具屋模型或世界观设定图，让观者可以一眼看懂整体结构，又能反复观察其中的小细节。

【基础设定】
主题：【主题，例如昆虫研究所 / 未来生存基地 / 魔法药剂工坊 / AI自动化公司 / 植物工厂 / 儿童学习中心 / 太空补给站】
空间名称 / 品牌名：【品牌名或空间名称，可为空】
世界观方向：【现实 / 科幻 / 童话 / 魔法 / 末日 / 博物馆 / 实验室 / 经营模拟 / 校园 / 自然生态】
建筑类型：【小屋 / 基地 / 工厂 / 实验室 / 商店 / 博物馆 / 地下空间 / 飞船 / 多层工作室】
核心功能：【这个空间主要用来做什么，例如研究、生产、展示、生活、训练、交易、学习、维修、种植】
主色调：【主色调，例如浅蓝、薄荷绿、奶油黄、粉色、橙绿、紫蓝、白蓝科技色】
辅助色：【辅助色，可为空】
点缀色：【点缀色，可为空】
画幅比例：【1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16】
信息密度：【中高密度 / 高密度 / 超高密度】
整体气质：【治愈、可爱、精密、童趣、科普、未来感、复古、清爽、探索感】

如果某些字段没有填写，请根据【主题】自动合理推导，不要让画面留空。所有内容都要围绕主题统一生成，避免加入无关元素。

【画面结构】
采用清晰的等距轴测视角 / isometric view / axonometric view，主体是一个被剖开的多层主题建筑或功能基地。观者可以同时看到建筑的正面、侧面、顶面和内部空间。整体建筑位于画面中心，占据画面主要面积，背景环境适度淡化，用来衬托主体。

建筑内部需要分成多个功能区域，每个区域都要有明确用途，而不是随机堆放装饰。可以包含：
1. 主工作区 / 核心操作区
2. 展示区 / 收藏区 / 标本区
3. 研究区 / 实验区 / 控制区
4. 储藏区 / 货架区 / 物资区
5. 生活区 / 休息区 / 小型居住区
6. 能源区 / 机器区 / 管道区
7. 种植区 / 培养区 / 生态区
8. 入口区 / 运输区 / 维修区
9. 楼梯、平台、走廊、栏杆、梯子等空间连接结构

各个区域之间要通过楼梯、走廊、平台、管道、桥架或电缆形成清晰的空间关系，让画面像一个真实可以运转的小型系统。

【道具与细节】
根据【主题】生成大量相关道具，并让它们分布在不同功能区中。道具需要具体、可识别、有主题关联，不能只是泛泛的装饰。每个小物件都应像游戏资产一样清晰可读，具有可点击、可互动、可收集的感觉。

道具类型可以包括：
- 主题设备：机器、仪器、工具、控制台、容器、屏幕、工作台
- 生活物件：桌椅、书架、床铺、杯子、箱子、柜子、灯具
- 展示物件：标本、模型、海报、说明牌、玻璃柜、陈列架
- 连接结构：管道、电线、梯子、楼梯、输送带、滑轨、平台
- 生态元素：植物、水箱、培养箱、土壤、树枝、岩石、标本
- 角色元素：少量小人物、小动物、机器人或主题生物，用来提供尺度感和故事感

道具数量要丰富，但要保持秩序。所有道具都应服务于空间功能和主题世界观。

【风格要求】
