Please create a high-completion, high-information-density visual map of an 'Isometric Micro-World Archive' suitable for serialized publishing based on the [Theme].

This is not a regular room illustration or a simple architectural drawing, but a thematic space overview combining 'isometric perspective + architectural cross-section structure + multi-layer functional space + high-density thematic props + miniature model feel + game scene concept art feel.' The image should look like an opened miniature world, a business simulation game scene, a dollhouse model, or a world-building concept map, allowing viewers to understand the overall structure at a glance while repeatedly observing the small details within.

[Basic Settings]
Theme: [Theme, e.g., Insect Research Institute / Future Survival Base / Magic Potion Workshop / AI Automation Company / Plant Factory / Children's Learning Center / Space Supply Station]
Space Name / Brand Name: [Brand name or space name, can be empty]
Worldview Direction: [Reality / Sci-Fi / Fairy Tale / Magic / Post-Apocalyptic / Museum / Laboratory / Business Simulation / Campus / Natural Ecology]
Building Type: [Cottage / Base / Factory / Lab / Shop / Museum / Underground Space / Spaceship / Multi-layer Studio]
Core Function: [What this space is mainly used for, e.g., research, production, display, life, training, trading, learning, maintenance, planting]
Main Color: [Main color, e.g., light blue, mint green, cream yellow, pink, orange-green, purple-blue, white-blue tech color]
Auxiliary Color: [Auxiliary color, can be empty]
Accent Color: [Accent color, can be empty]
Aspect Ratio: [1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16]
Information Density: [Medium-high / High / Ultra-high]
Overall Vibe: [Healing, cute, precise, childlike, popular science, futuristic, retro, refreshing, sense of exploration]

If some fields are not filled, please automatically derive them reasonably based on the [Theme]; do not leave the screen blank. All content must be generated uniformly around the theme, avoiding irrelevant elements.

[Visual Structure]
Adopt a clear isometric perspective / axonometric view, where the main subject is an opened multi-layer thematic building or functional base. Viewers can simultaneously see the front, side, top, and internal space of the building. The entire building is located at the center of the screen, occupying most of the area, with the background environment moderately faded to highlight the subject.

The interior of the building needs to be divided into multiple functional areas, each with a clear purpose, rather than randomly piled decorations. It can include:
1. Main work area / Core operation area
2. Display area / Collection area / Specimen area
3. Research area / Lab area / Control area
4. Storage area / Shelving area / Supply area
5. Living area / Rest area / Small residential area
6. Energy area / Machine area / Piping area
7. Planting area / Cultivation area / Ecological area
8. Entrance area / Transport area / Maintenance area
9. Spatial connection structures like stairs, platforms, corridors, railings, ladders, etc.

Clear spatial relationships must be formed between various areas through stairs, corridors, platforms, pipes, bridges, or cables, making the image look like a real, functioning miniature system.

[Props and Details]
Generate a large number of relevant props based on the [Theme] and distribute them in different functional areas. Props need to be specific, identifiable, and thematically related, not just vague decorations. Each small object should be as clear and readable as a game asset, with a feel of being clickable, interactive, and collectable.

Types of props can include:
- Thematic equipment: machines, instruments, tools, consoles, containers, screens, workbenches
- Lifestyle objects: tables/chairs, bookshelves, beds, cups, boxes, cabinets, lamps
- Display objects: specimens, models, posters, signboards, glass cabinets, display racks
- Connection structures: pipes, wires, ladders, stairs, conveyor belts, slide rails, platforms
- Ecological elements: plants, water tanks, incubators, soil, branches, rocks, specimens
- Character elements: small number of characters, animals, robots, or thematic creatures to provide a sense of scale and story

The number of props should be rich but orderly. All props should serve the space's function and the thematic worldview.

[Style Requirements]
The overall style is clear, cute, precise hand-drawn cartoon isometric illustration. Lines are clean, edges are slightly rounded, colors are bright and soft, with an overall relaxed, healing, and exploratory feel. The image should have the feel of a business simulation game, a children's science picture book, a miniature model, or a concept art page.

Avoid over-realism, strong dark lighting/shadows, heavy oil painting feel, and complex noise. The focus is on being clear, exquisite, layered, and highly readable.

[Color and Lighting]
Use high brightness, low-to-medium saturation soft color schemes. The main color is unified, auxiliary colors are used to distinguish different spaces, and accent colors are used to highlight key equipment and small props. Line art colors should not use dead black; instead, use soft outlines like dark gray, blue-gray, or brown-gray.

Keep lighting and shadows lightweight; strong realistic projections are not needed. Build layers through color blocks, structures, lines, and local highlights. The background should use light colors and low-contrast processing to make the main building stand out more.

[Composition and Reading Path]
The main subject is centered or slightly upper-centered, with the building in a multi-layer cross-section structure. The visual reading path should start from the overall building outline, enter the functional areas of each floor, and finally observe the detailed props. The gaze can be guided by elements such as stairs, platforms, corridors, pipelines, and tracks.

The overall image should be full but not crowded, rich but not messy. Every room, platform, and corner should have content, yet still maintain clear spatial boundaries.

[Background Environment]
The background can include a weakened external environment according to the theme, such as a forest, city, street, underground rock layer, experimental park, seabed, space, campus, factory exterior, etc. The background should not compete with the subject; light colors, low opacity, and low contrast are recommended to achieve a 'subject clear, background receding' effect.

[Final Effect]
The final image should look like a complete thematic space concept map, with both the structural feel of an architectural cross-section and the detail of a game scene asset map, combined with the cute exploration feel of a miniature dollhouse. It should be suitable for serialized visual creation, IP worldview display, game scene settings, brand space concept maps, science content covers, or Little Red Book/Pinterest style visual posts.

Ensure the image has:
1. Clear isometric perspective
2. Clear architectural cross-section structure
3. Complete multi-layer functional areas
4. Rich props and thematic unity
5. Soft and bright colors
6. Clean and clear line art
7. Weakened background, prominent subject
8. High information density but not messy
9. A sense of an explorable, operable, and observable miniature world.

items.content: 请根据【主题：{argument name="角色名" default="写人物名字"}】创作一张高完成度、高叙事张力、适合系列化发布的「暗潮群像封面 / Shadow Ensemble Cover」。这不是普通角色插画，也不是简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面感、漫画主视觉感、游戏宣传感和暗黑奇幻插画感的“群像式动作封面”。画面需要通过一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效和留白标题区，共同构成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。【基础设定】主题：{argument name="场景主题" default="咒术战斗 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 山海经猎妖队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗团"}作品名：[作品名]系列名 / 品牌名：[品牌名或系列名]副标题：[副标题]风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏主视觉"}主色调：墨绿黑灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕金红 / 沙黄铁锈 / 深紫金色点缀色：血红能量、青绿色法术光、金色神光、蓝色雷电画幅比例：2:3竖版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 9:16竖版【画面结构】采用竖版封面构图。画面中必须有一个体量巨大的主视觉人物，作为整张图的精神核心和气质压场元素。这个人物可以是侧脸、半身像、背影、正面凝视或巨大轮廓，占据画面右侧、上方或背景主区域，表情冷静、神秘、有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张图的气质。在中景安排3到6个动作角色，形成一个战斗阵营群像。角色之间需要有明确分工和姿态差异，例如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免所有人物站桩，必须形成强烈的动作节奏和视觉动线。背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，例如怪物、巨兽、反派阴影、机械军团、妖魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，增强危机感和叙事深度。画面需要设置1到2个高饱和能量爆点，例如红色火焰拳、蓝色雷电、绿色诅咒气息、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色刀光。能量光效应集中在关键角色或关键武器上，形成视觉焦点，不要全画面平均发光。【构图方式】整体采用“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”的结构。画面可以使用斜向动线组织角色，让角色群像从左上到右下、或从下方冲向中央，形成强烈推进感。保留一块明显的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或画面侧边。留白区域使用米白、灰白、浅纸色或低饱和背景色，用于放置【品牌名 / 作品名 / 副标题】。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，可以使用优雅衬线字体、复古标题字、漫画封面标题或高级杂志式排版。文字区要清晰，不要被角色和背景完全遮挡。插画边缘不要做成完整矩形铺满，可以使用不规则笔刷边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸式留白或自然消散的方式，让角色和背景像从纸面中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术质感。【视觉风格】整体风格应为手绘厚涂与漫画封面结合，具有纸张质感、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，人物轮廓清晰，局部能量光提供高对比焦点。画面不要过度干净，不要像普通AI光滑插画，应保留手绘纹理、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。色彩上采用低饱和暗调为主，辅以少量高饱和能量色。整体氛围应具有压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。【画面目标】最终画面应像一张成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特别篇封面、游戏角色阵营主视觉或IP宣传海报。它需要同时具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 有动作节奏的角色群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量光效；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。请确保画面信息丰富但不混乱，角色层级清晰，视觉重心明确，阅读路径自然，适合后续替换主题继续生成同系列作品。
items.translatedContent: Please create a high-completion, high-narrative tension 「Shadow Ensemble Cover」 suitable for serialized release based on the [Subject: {argument name="character name" default="Write character names"}]. This is not an ordinary character illustration, nor a simple combat poster, but an "ensemble action cover" with the feel of a novel cover, manga visual, game promotion, and dark fantasy illustration. The image needs to be composed of a huge spiritual core figure, multiple mid-ground action characters, background threat elements, local energy light effects, and a blank title area to form a complete character faction and worldview cover. [Basic Settings] Theme: {argument name="scene theme" default="Jujutsu battle / Dark Journey to the West / Cyber Hunter / Monster Hunting Team / Doomsday Survivor / Magic Academy Battle Group"} Work Name: [Work Name] Series Name / Brand Name: [Brand Name or Series Name] Subtitle: [Subtitle] Style Direction: {argument name="style" default="Dark fantasy, retro manga cover, hand-painted impasto, fantasy novel cover, game visual"} Main Tone: Dark green-black-gray / Deep blue neon / Dark brown-gold-red / Sand yellow-iron rust / Deep purple-gold Accent Color: Blood red energy, turquoise spell light, golden divine light, blue lightning Frame Ratio: 2:3 vertical / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 9:16 vertical [Screen Structure] Use a vertical cover composition. There must be a huge visual figure as the spiritual core and atmosphere-dominating element. This person can be a profile, half-body, back, front stare, or huge silhouette, occupying the right, top, or main background area, with a calm, mysterious, and oppressive expression, not necessarily participating in the battle, but must govern the temperament of the whole picture. Arrange 3 to 6 action characters in the middle ground to form a combat faction ensemble. There should be clear division of labor and posture differences between characters, such as charging, holding a knife, casting spells, defense, summoning, jumping, alerting, long-range attack, etc. Avoid characters standing still; a strong rhythmic action and visual movement must be formed. Add enemy threats or worldview elements in the background, such as monsters, giants, villain shadows, mechanical legions, demons, ruins, forests, alien spaces, battlefield smoke, or city disasters. Background threats should not overshadow the main subject but wrap around characters like shadows to enhance the sense of crisis and narrative depth. Set 1 to 2 high-saturation energy hotspots, such as red flame fists, blue lightning, green cursed aura, purple magic, golden divine light, or white sword light. The energy effect should be concentrated on key characters or weapons, forming a visual focus, not uniformly lit across the screen. [Composition] The overall structure is "large spiritual core character + mid-ground action ensemble + background threat shadow + bottom or side blank title area". The image can use diagonal lines to organize characters, letting the ensemble rush from top-left to bottom-right or from bottom to center, forming a strong forward push. Retain a clear blank title area, suggested at the bottom-left, bottom, or side. Use off-white, gray-white, light paper color, or low-saturation background colors for the blank area to place the [Brand Name / Work Name / Subtitle]. The title typography should have a publication cover feel, using elegant serif fonts, retro title letters, manga cover titles, or high-end magazine-style layout. The text area must be clear and not completely blocked by characters and background. Do not make the edges a complete rectangle; use irregular brush edges, ink diffusion, torn paper style, or natural dissipation to let characters and background grow out of the paper, enhancing the hand-drawn cover feel and artistic quality. [Visual Style] The overall style should be a combination of hand-painted impasto and manga cover, with paper texture, brushstrokes, dark layers, and a retro publication temperament. Lighting is mainly low-key dark light with a darkened background, clear character silhouettes, and high-contrast focal points provided by local energy light. The image should not be excessively clean; it should retain hand-painted textures, paper grain, edge strokes, and dark mist. Use low-saturation dark tones mainly, supplemented by a small amount of high-saturation energy colors. The overall atmosphere should have a sense of pressure, mystery, combat, and worldview thickness. [Visual Goal] The final image should look like a mature fantasy novel cover, manga special cover, game character faction visual, or IP promo poster. It needs to possess: 1. A clear main visual character; 2. An ensemble with rhythmic movement; 3. Clear enemy threats or worldview background; 4. Strong but restrained energy effects; 5. A readable title text area; 6. An overall texture of a retro hand-drawn cover. Ensure the image is informative but not cluttered, with clear character levels and visual gravity, suitable for continuing to generate the same series with different themes.

items.title: Ethereal Buddhist Pure Land scene
items.description: A highly detailed prompt describing the Western Pure Land (Sukhavati) with golden ground, lotus ponds, and divine architecture.
items.content:
西方极乐世界（又称西方净土、安乐国），是阿弥陀佛（无量寿佛）的佛土，核心特点是无有众苦、但受诸乐，与我们这个 “堪忍”（婆婆）世界形成鲜明对比。
在我们世界的西方，距离十万亿佛土之遥（《阿弥陀经》）。

佛主：教主阿弥陀佛（无量光、无量寿），常住说法；左右胁侍为观世音菩萨、大势至菩萨，合称 “西方三圣”。

国土环境：七宝庄严，完美无瑕
大地：黄金为地，平坦柔软、光明洁净，无山川沟壑、荆棘土石。
七宝池与八功德水：
遍地七宝池（金、银、琉璃、玻璃、砗磲、赤珠、玛瑙）。
池水具八功德：甘、冷、软、轻、清、香、饮时、饮已，能除烦恼、润身悦心。
池底金沙，阶道七宝，池中莲花大如车轮，青、黄、赤、白，各放光明。
建筑：七宝楼阁、宫殿、讲堂，浮空而起、随心大小，光明通透，胜过天界无数倍。
宝树与天乐：
七重行树、七重栏楯、七重罗网，皆四宝所成。
风吹宝树罗网，出微妙法音，如百千乐同时俱作，闻者自然生念佛、念法、念僧之心。
气候与天雨：无寒暑、无风雨，永远温和舒适；昼夜六时，天雨曼陀罗花，缤纷铺落，香气芬芳。
奇禽：白鹤、孔雀、鹦鹉、迦陵频伽等，皆佛变化所作，出和雅音，宣说佛法，令众生常生善念。

众生：无苦唯乐，寿命无量
往生方式：众生由七宝池莲花化生，非父母胎生，无生老病死之苦。
身形：紫磨金色身，相好庄严，与阿弥陀佛相似；具天眼、天耳、他心、宿命、神足五通，自在无碍。
寿命：无量无边阿僧祇劫，几乎永恒，无夭折衰老。
心性：皆是诸上善人，无贪嗔痴、无嫉妒争斗，人人慈悲平等、智慧清净，常闻佛法、不退菩提。
生活：衣食自然化现，不需劳作；清晨可赴他方十万亿佛土供养诸佛，食时即返，自在无碍。

时间与空间：无限永恒
时间：无昼夜、无年月，永恒安乐，世界无 “成住坏空” 之变。
空间：广大无边，十方众生尽往亦不拥挤；一微尘可纳三千大千世界，事事无碍。
items.translatedContent:
The Western Paradise (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha (Infinite Life Buddha). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering and the experience of only joy, in stark contrast to our 'enduring' (Saha) world. Located in the west of our world, ten trillion Buddha-lands away (Amitabha Sutra).

Main Buddha: Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the 'Three Sages of the West'.

Land Environment: Adorned with Seven Treasures, flawless.
Ground: Gold as the ground, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or stones.
Seven Treasure Ponds and Eight Merit Waters: Seven treasure ponds everywhere (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna, red pearl, agate). The water possesses eight merits: sweet, cold, soft, light, clear, fragrant, thirst-quenching, and heart-nourishing. Golden sand at the bottom, seven-treasure pathways, and lotuses in the pond as large as wheels, emitting blue, yellow, red, and white light.
Architecture: Seven-treasure pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls, floating in the air, changing size at will, transparent and bright, countless times better than the heavenly realms.
Precious Trees and Heavenly Music: Seven rows of trees, seven rows of railings, seven rows of nets, all made of four treasures. The wind blows through the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds like hundreds of thousands of instruments playing together, naturally leading listeners to mindfulness of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
Climate and Heavenly Rain: No heat or cold, no wind or rain, always mild and comfortable; Mandarava flowers rain down from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful.
Marvelous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, Kalavinkas, etc., all manifested by the Buddha to produce harmonious sounds proclaiming the Dharma.

Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, infinite lifespan.
Rebirth: Beings are born from lotus flowers in the seven treasure ponds, not from parents, free from the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death.
Appearance: Purple-gold bodies, majestic and solemn, similar to Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: heavenly eye, heavenly ear, telepathy, past-life recall, and spiritual travel, free and unobstructed.
Lifespan: Immeasurable kalpas, nearly eternal, without early death or aging.
Nature: All are superior good people, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, equal, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma.
Life: Clothing and food manifest naturally without labor; in the morning, one can visit ten trillion Buddha-lands to offer to Buddhas and return by mealtime.

Time and Space: Infinite and Eternal.
Time: No day or night, no months or years, eternal happiness; the world does not undergo the changes of formation, existence, decay, and void.
Space: Vast and boundless, never crowded even with beings from all ten directions; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great worlds.

items.title: Landscape Archive Model Template
items.description: A comprehensive template for creating professional, museum-style 'landscape archive models' that combine 2D maps with 3D terrain and professional annotations.
items.content:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="中国长城 / 珠穆朗玛峰 / 上海外滩 / 广州珠江"}创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / Landscape Archive Model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：{argument name="主题内容" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城"}
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风"}
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系 and 清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。
items.translatedContent:
Please create a high-quality, professional 'Landscape Archive Model' visual based on {argument name="subject" default="The Great Wall / Mt. Everest / The Bund / Pearl River"} suitable for a series.

This is not a regular map or simple landscape illustration, but a high-end archival visual combining '2D map drafting + 3D regional model + professional annotation system + museum exhibition feel'. The image should look like a real physical geography research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or world-building exhibit, with a professional, restrained, precise, and tactile premium texture.

[Basic Settings]
Subject: {argument name="subject content" default="Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing"}
Subject Type: [Natural Terrain / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape]
Core Subject: [Core subject, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark group, island city, ruins, main urban area]
Content Focus: [Content focus, e.g., terrain elevation / urban landmarks / road network / hydrology / nature-city relationship / setting collection display]
Style: {argument name="style" default="geographic surveying style, paper-cut model style, architectural proposal style, museum archival style, urban planning style"}
Primary Color: [Primary color, e.g., off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand, snow white]
Secondary Color: [Secondary color, e.g., earth brown, rock gray, cool gray, light blue, moss green]
Accent Color: [Accent color, e.g., thin black lines, red routes, blue hydrographic lines, yellow numbered markers]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect ratio, e.g., 16:9 landscape / 3:4 portrait / 4:5 portrait / 1:1 square]

[Composition]
The main subject is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean tabletop or white cloth. The base plate has real thickness with visible section structures on the edges, like a refined map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained information layer, including contour lines, road networks, hydrology, zonal boundaries, geographical textures, a sense of coordinates, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area, a 3D model 'grows' out of the 2D map, becoming the visual core of the entire image.

If [Subject Type] is Natural Terrain: The subject consists of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, or coastlines, emphasizing elevation, layered contour structures, rock wall textures, and natural terrain undulations.

If [Subject Type] is Urban Space: The subject consists of the core urban area, CBD, old town blocks, landmark clusters, waterfronts, road nodes, bridges, water systems, or parks, emphasizing architectural massing, urban identity, spatial layers, and planning structure.

If [Subject Type] is Mixed Landscape: It integrates both natural terrain and man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, apocalyptic wastelands, fantasy capitals, or sci-fi bases.

[Detail Requirements]
- Surface retains map paper and professional information feel.
- Terrain areas should have contours, slope layers, and depressions.
- Architectural areas should have massing, block relationships, and clear hierarchy.
- Water bodies use low-saturation light blue.
- Greenery/forests use moss green or low-saturation green.
- Road networks use fine lines without being distracting.
- Landmarks should be clearly identifiable.

items.searchIndex:
landscape archive model template a comprehensive template for creating professional, museum-style 'landscape archive models' that combine 2d maps with 3d terrain and professional annotations. 请根据{argument name="主题" default="中国长城 / 珠穆朗玛峰 / 上海外滩 / 广州珠江"}创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / landscape archive model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：{argument name="主题内容" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城"}
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、cbd、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风"}
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、cbd、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系 and 清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏ui感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

items.title: Pastel Luxury Skincare Ad
items.description: A soft pastel vertical beauty advertisement featuring a glowing serum bottle in a feminine vanity setup, ideal for skincare branding and social media promotional creatives.
items.content: Create a vertical luxury skincare advertisement in a soft feminine pastel aesthetic, styled like a viral Instagram or TikTok beauty promo with no app UI. Show a single glass dropper serum bottle centered on a fluffy lavender-purple surface, photographed in ultra-realistic studio lighting with warm golden sunlight streaming from the upper left, soft shadows, glossy reflections, dreamy haze, and creamy bokeh in the background. The bottle label should read {argument name="brand name" default="ELEGANT SKINCARE"} and {argument name="product name" default="SERUM"}, with a pale pink-lilac translucent bottle and shiny rose-gold dropper cap. Surround the product with an elegant feminine vanity setup: 1 gold-framed round tabletop mirror on the left, 1 lit white candle in a glass jar on the right, 1 pearl necklace draped across the lower left foreground, and 4 clusters of white baby's breath flowers placed in the left foreground, left midground near the mirror, right foreground, and far right edge. Add cute hand-drawn doodle decorations in white and purple: curved arrows pointing toward the serum, sparkles, tiny hearts, short accent strokes, and small loops scattered around the composition. Include 2 paper note cards: one left of the bottle saying {argument name="left note text" default="My daily glow secret!"}, and one lower right saying {argument name="right note text" default="Feels amazing!"}; add 1 small round lavender sticker attached to the right note that says "MUST HAVE". Use large handwritten dark-purple headline text at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"}, with a torn white tape-style strip underneath containing {argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"}. Add smaller dark-purple copy to the upper right of the bottle reading "For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin", and at the bottom center repeat "For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin" with "Self care Everyday" beneath it in a lighter soft white tone. Keep the composition clean, premium, cozy, glossy, and highly aesthetic, with the serum as the clear focal point.

items.content:
Luxury feminine skincare advertisement, vertical 9:16 composition, ultra-realistic studio beauty product shot with dreamy soft focus and warm golden morning sunlight. Center a single elegant pump bottle serum in the foreground on a fluffy lavender-purple faux fur surface. The bottle is translucent pastel lavender glass with a shiny metallic gold pump and collar, premium glossy reflections, soft shadows, and subtle sparkle in the liquid. Beneath it, place a horizontal lavender paint-stroke banner with the subheading {argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"} in white handwritten lettering. Clean composition, premium soft feminine branding, Instagram/TikTok-friendly viral beauty ad style, polished editorial product photography, pastel purple and gold color palette, cozy glamorous atmosphere.

items.content: A realistic street photography image in India, vertical composition, showing the exact rear view of a black-and-yellow auto rickshaw centered in frame on a narrow busy market street. The top yellow canopy has bold uppercase red text reading {argument name="top text" default="AB TO PEECHHAA CHHOD DO MERA"}. The back panel below the window is black with large bold uppercase white text in 3 stacked lines reading {argument name="bottom text" default="ITNI BHI SUNDAR NAHI HU MAIN"}. In the rear window there is a printed portrait of a glamorous woman with long dark brown hair, turned sideways with one bare shoulder visible and a black strap, styled like a poster behind the glass; her face appears obscured or blurred. The street background contains market shops, signboards, pedestrians on both sides, and a few distant figures, but kept softly blurred with shallow depth of field so the rickshaw remains sharp. items.title: Filmmaking Eras Typographic Grid
items.description: A polished 2x2 studio-rendered typographic artwork showing four letters and numbers built from filmmaking equipment from different cinematic eras, ideal for editorial, poster, or concept-visual use.
items.content:
Create a clean 2x2 grid on a pure white studio background featuring 4 large 3D typographic sculptures, each a single character built entirely from filmmaking equipment from a different era. The four glyphs are exactly 4 characters: top-left letter A, top-right number 5, bottom-left letter X, bottom-right number 9. Each character should be front-facing, centered in its quadrant, legible but formed from a dense pile of realistic cinema tools and on-set props, with believable occlusion, weight, and construction logic. Use high-end Cinema 4D product visualization, subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting with a softbox overhead, crisp shadows, realistic materials, and isolated composition.

Top-left: the letter A made from early cinema and silent-era equipment, assembled from vintage wooden tripods, hand-cranked film cameras, brass lenses, reels, megaphones, bell-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, leather straps, and aged wood. Surface qualities should include worn varnished wood, black crackle paint, brass tarnish, scuffed metal, and dusty antique patina. The silhouette should feel chaotic but readable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies defining the A shape.

Top-right: the number 5 made from mid-century analog filmmaking gear, assembled from classic film cameras, magazine reels, metal canisters, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric packs, director chairs, cylindrical lenses, grips, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The 5 should be chunky and balanced, with stacked props tightly packed into the glyph.

Bottom-left: the letter X made from late 20th century video and broadcast equipment, assembled from shoulder-mount camcorders, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, cassette-like modules, control panels, worn blue and gray plastic housings, and rugged field electronics. Include visible wiring and taped components. Materials should feel utilitarian and slightly battered, with dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber grips, and yellow accent details. The crossing diagonals of the X must be clear and substantial.

Bottom-right: the number 9 made from contemporary digital cinema and virtual production gear, assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, gimbals, matte boxes, black modular accessories, and a vivid green chroma screen wrap forming part of the numeral. Include sleek vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The 9 should feel the most modern and refined, with modular precision and clean industrial design.

Keep the background plain and uncluttered, no extra text, no floating objects, no flat typography, no 2D rendering. The sculptures should look like physical objects at realistic scale, highly detailed, photorealistic, and suitable as a graphic design asset.

items.title: Back-to-Back Sirens in Sakura Dusk
items.description: A cinematic fantasy artwork of two tattooed female warriors standing back-to-back in a cherry blossom field at sunset with two glowing energy swords, ideal for dramatic character art and poster-style hero imagery.
items.content: Two powerful fantasy women standing back-to-back in the center of a vast cherry blossom field at dusk, full-body heroic composition, seen from a slightly low angle, ultra-detailed cinematic anime-realism. The woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="vivid crimson red"} short layered hair, a curvy athletic build, and a fierce dominant presence; she wears a black and dark red strappy battle outfit with a cropped leather top, high-cut bottoms, garter-like thigh straps, flowing translucent red ribbons, and long glossy black armguards. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="golden blonde with soft pink ends"} wavy shoulder-length hair, an athletic curvy build, and extensive floral tattoo sleeves and body tattoos across her arm, shoulder, ribs, and thigh; she wears a black and purple strappy fantasy outfit with sheer purple fabric panels, chain accents, and black gloves. Their bare upper backs press together as they face opposite directions with calm, intimidating confidence. There are exactly 2 massive glowing energy swords planted upright in the ground behind and beside them: 1 on the left radiating molten red-orange fire and ember-like cracks, and 1 on the right radiating electric violet and cyan energy with lightning coursing through the blade. items.title: Surreal Planetary Sculpture Still Life
items.description: This prompt generates a dark, cinematic surreal still life with a floating planet-like sphere, organic foliage, and marbled stone elements, ideal for fine-art concept visuals or luxury editorial imagery.
items.content: A surreal still-life in a dark black void, staged like a moody luxury sculpture display under a single soft spotlight. At the center, a large floating sphere dominates the composition, about one-third of the frame height, with a glossy translucent surface textured like swirling clouds and planetary gas bands in muted teal, cream, gray, and pale gold. Beneath and around the sphere sits an organic mound of dense mossy foliage and coral-like plant forms in olive green and bronze, mixed with a cluster of tiny luminous white-violet flowers on the left and a brighter white floral cluster on the right. Behind the sphere are 2 horizontal rectangular slabs suspended in space: 1 dark smoky slab on the left, partially hidden, and 1 larger warm brown-and-gold marbled slab on the right with vein-like lightning patterns. In the lower right foreground is 1 polished rectangular stone block resting on the ground, colored black, gray, and white with dramatic marble veining. The ground is a smooth matte surface with a pale green elliptical pool of light fading into darkness. Cinematic fine-art product photography style, surreal contemporary installation, minimal composition, strong negative space, soft bloom, subtle film grain, low-key lighting, glossy and mineral textures, slightly vintage color grading, high contrast but gentle focus, elegant and mysterious atmosphere.

items.title: Vintage Chinese Food Map Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a richly illustrated watercolor tourism map poster featuring regional dishes, scenic landmarks, and labeled routes for destination food-promotion and cultural travel design.

author.name: AI Time Traveler | 时光旅行者

items.content: A hand-painted vintage Chinese tourist food map poster in watercolor and ink wash style, shown from a bird’s-eye view over a misty mountainous county landscape. The composition is a stylized illustrated map of {argument name="place name" default="缙云"}, with pale rice-paper texture, soft beige background, green-gray mountains, winding rivers, country roads, old towns, scenic rocks, bamboo leaves, and pink flowers framing the corners. Large artistic Chinese calligraphy title at the upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="缙云 山野美食暴走地图"}, with a small subtitle ribbon below reading “黄帝缙云·人间仙都”. Add a poetic text block on the left in Chinese: “山水缙云，仙都奇境 百味乡野，烟火人间 跟着美食，遇见缙云 一城山水，一口乡愁”. In the center is the main county town labeled “缙云县城”, surrounded by illustrated routes connecting scenic destinations and local dishes. Include exactly 12 numbered food stops, each with a realistic painted bowl or plate of food placed on the map near its location, with orange circular numbers and Chinese labels plus a short one-line description. The 12 stops are: 1 “河阳土爽面” with description “山野本味，宾客烟火”; 2 “笕川笋干菜” with description “时令山珍，晒干留香”; 3 “缙云烧饼” with description “炭炉焦香，卷云招牌”; 4 “敲肉羹” with description “鲜香软糯，地道乡味”; 5 “岩下炖汤” with description “石材慢炖，暖身养胃”; 6 “溪鱼鲜” with description “山水河鲜，鲜掉眉毛”; 7 “壶镇扁食/落菜” with description “古法胶味，越吃越香”; 8 “葛根豆腐” with description “山野清润，解腻爽口”; 9 “山粉饺” with description “皮薄馅足，山野风味”; 10 “苦槠豆腐” with description “山林珍味，自然本鲜”; 11 “农家焐年糕” with description “糯香浓郁，儿时味道”; 12 “老街米糕” with description “清甜米香，古法手工”. Mark exactly 8 place labels on the map: “新建镇”, “壶镇镇”, “大洋镇”, “仙都景区”, “河阳古民居”, “岩宕书房”, “蛟龙大峡谷”, and “缙云县城”. Paint recognizable scenic clusters with white-walled black-roofed traditional houses, steep karst peaks, bridges, and terraced terrain. Add a small legend box at the lower right with exactly 5 items labeled “山脉”, “河流”, “主要道路”, “乡镇”, and “景点地标”, plus a sixth food icon label “美食推荐”. Include a decorative compass rose nearby. Overall mood is elegant, artisanal, nostalgic, and premium, like a cultural tourism poster combining local cuisine guide and scenic map illustration, with highly polished composition and refined Chinese branding.

items.title: Bursting Soap Bubble Macro Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic high-speed macro image of a child blowing a soap bubble as it bursts into droplets, ideal for dramatic nature and motion-freeze photography visuals.
items.content: A high-speed macro photograph of a soap bubble bursting in a sunlit garden, framed horizontally. On the far left edge, show the side profile of a young child with visible cheek, nose, lips, and part of one closed or half-closed eye, gently blowing toward the bubble. Place 1 large soap bubble near the center-left of the frame. The left half of the bubble remains intact as a smooth, glossy, iridescent sphere with vivid rainbow colors and strong reflective highlights, including a bright sun glint near the upper area and reflections of trees and garden scenery on the surface. The right half of the bubble is exploding outward into countless tiny droplets, mist, and thin web-like liquid filaments, frozen sharply in mid-air and spreading to the right side of the image. Emphasize the dramatic transition line between the intact sphere and the shattered spray. Use bright direct sunlight, very high shutter speed, crisp macro detail, high contrast, saturated color, dark green leafy background rendered as soft bokeh, and a Kodak Ektar 100 film look. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, dynamic motion frozen in time, shallow depth of field.

items.title: Cinematic Last Supper Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a warm, photorealistic biblical dinner scene of Jesus and the 12 disciples, ideal for historical, devotional, or cinematic concept imagery.
items.content: A cinematic, historically grounded depiction of {argument name="scene subject" default="Jesus with his disciples during the Last Supper"} inside a modest ancient Middle Eastern dining room at night, shown from a close, immersive viewpoint at table height as if the viewer is seated among them. Include exactly 13 men gathered tightly around a long narrow supper table, with the central figure reading clearly as Jesus through calm presence, shoulder-length dark brown hair, a beard, and a soft off-white robe with a light beige shawl. The 12 disciples should vary in age and appearance, with curly or wavy dark hair, beards, and earth-toned robes in cream, brown, tan, muted blue, and dusty gray, leaning inward in conversation and attention. The room should have rough plaster walls, dark exposed wooden ceiling beams, a heavy wooden door at the back, simple wall niches, and small oil lamps or candle sconces casting warm amber light. On the table, show rustic period-appropriate food and vessels: round flatbread, grapes, olives, shallow bowls, clay plates, ceramic cups, and copper or earthenware goblets, with one small candle near the center creating a focal glow. Composition should be wide and intimate, slightly crowded at the foreground edges, with several figures partially cropped to enhance realism and immersion. Lighting should be low, golden, and dramatic, with soft shadows, a reverent mood, realistic skin tones, natural fabric folds, and rich cinematic contrast. Render in a photorealistic style with ultra-detailed textures, subtle depth of field, and the emotional tone of a historical biblical film still.

items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic biblical group portrait of Jesus and the 12 disciples taking a modern smartphone selfie, ideal for humorous cinematic concept art.
items.content: A cinematic, photorealistic reimagining of the Last Supper as a modern anachronistic selfie scene inside a dim ancient stone room. Show {argument name="central figure" default="Jesus"} seated at the center front of a long rustic wooden table, wearing dark earth-toned biblical robes, extending one arm toward the camera and holding a modern black smartphone to take a group selfie. Surround him with exactly 12 disciples crowded closely around the table, making 13 people total, all dressed in simple first-century robes in beige, brown, taupe, muted blue, and cream. The composition should feel intimate and slightly humorous but still believable, with everyone leaning inward toward the phone as if posing for the photo. Use warm candlelight and soft firelit illumination, with several visible candles on the table and wall niches, creating amber highlights, deep shadows, and a sacred old-world atmosphere. Include rustic pottery, clay cups, wooden bowls, torn flatbread, and simple food on the table. The background should feature rough plastered stone walls, hanging cloth drapes, wooden pegs, and sparse historical decor. Frame it as a medium-wide group portrait from the phone camera’s point of view, with shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, detailed fabric textures, natural skin tones, and a rich warm brown color palette.

items.title: Nostalgic Youth Memory Photo Grid
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic 4x4 collage of blurred-face candid friendship and young-romance snapshots, ideal for creating fictional sentimental memory boards.
items.content: A nostalgic collage of 16 candid youth snapshots arranged in a clean 4x4 photo grid, square format, styled like nonexistent memories from a Japanese coming-of-age film. Show a pair or small group of college-age friends spending time together through day and night, with a dreamy sentimental mood, soft blue and pink color cast, slight film grain, low-light bloom, motion blur, shallow focus, and the imperfect texture of casual phone photos. The main recurring subjects are a young woman with {argument name="hair style" default="short wavy bob"} wearing a {argument name="top color" default="white or light gray knit top"}, and a young man with dark hair in casual dark outerwear or a pale hoodie, appearing as close friends or a shy couple. Faces are intentionally obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks over every visible face, but body language remains warm, intimate, and natural. Include exactly 16 tiles: 1) night street portrait of the woman alone, 2) nighttime two-shot outdoors with the man and woman side by side, city lights behind them, 3) close indoor selfie of two friends shoulder to shoulder, 4) indoor two-shot near curtains, 5) blurred moving street selfie of the pair, 6) cozy cafe table scene with drinks, the woman touching her face while the man sits across, 7) spring park scene under blooming cherry blossoms, 8) playful outdoor shot with a hand partially covering the lens, 9) indoor couch or booth snapshot with one person holding a compact camera, 10) blue-hour overlook or rooftop shot with city lights and the pair standing together, 11) nighttime waterfront or city-light background portrait of two friends, 12) close side-by-side night snapshot of the pair, 13) heavily blurred close selfie with one figure in motion, 14) indoor mirror-area or restaurant snapshot with one person raising a camera, 15) indoor casual peace-sign pose beside a brick or tiled wall, 16) picnic-in-the-park scene with snacks and one friend holding a camera toward the viewer. Overall feeling: wistful, cinematic, intimate, youthful, spontaneous, and bittersweet, like a scrapbook of memories that never really happened.

items.title: Editorial Studio Portrait in Neutral Streetwear
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic half-body studio fashion portrait with clean lighting and minimal neutral styling, ideal for editorial, branding, or portrait photography concepts.
items.content: A high-end studio fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} in her mid-30s to early 40s with a naturally fit build, shown in a half-body to upper-thigh framing, standing in a relaxed, confident pose with both hands tucked into her pants pockets. She has long, dark chestnut-brown wavy hair parted near the center, softly cascading over her shoulders, and wears 2 small gold hoop earrings on one visible ear, a delicate gold necklace, and a thin bracelet. Her outfit is modern minimal casual streetwear in soft neutral tones: a light beige zip-front jacket worn open, a fitted white cropped tank top, and matching light beige drawstring jogger pants. Shoot at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, keeping the subject tack sharp with shallow depth of field. Use professional studio lighting with 1 softbox key light from the front-left, subtle fill to soften shadows, and 1 gentle warm rim light along the hair and shoulder for separation. The background is a clean studio backdrop with a smooth taupe-to-warm-gray neutral gradient and no distractions. The image should feel highly realistic and editorial, with natural skin tones, balanced color grading, ultra-high detail, crisp fabric texture, soft natural shadows, no noise, no motion blur, no cartoon styling, and no anatomical distortions.

items.title: Woman Riding Motorcycle on Cliff Road
items.description: This prompt transforms the reference woman into a dynamic pixel-art scene of her riding a motorcycle on a cliffside coastal road, useful for action-oriented character edits from portrait references.
items.content: Using REFERENCE_1 as the character base and REFERENCE_0 as the scene/mood reference, regenerate the same woman in pixel art as an action shot riding a motorcycle along a narrow cliffside coastal road at sunset. Change the composition from a close portrait to a wider cinematic full-body view, with the motorcycle moving toward the viewer on a winding road carved into steep seaside cliffs. Keep her brown leather jacket and overall look consistent, but make her hair blow back in the wind and pose her with both hands on the handlebars. Emphasize the dramatic ocean drop on the left, rocky cliff wall on the right, and a warm orange-purple sunset sky. Keep the retro 16-bit-style pixel-art aesthetic.

items.title: Luxury Magazine Cover With Featured Book
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic premium magazine cover mockup featuring a prominently displayed nonfiction book in an elegant editorial interior, ideal for publishing, branding, or promotional visuals.
items.content: A photorealistic premium magazine cover in the style of an international design and business publication, shot as a sophisticated editorial still life. The cover features a dark, moody interior with shallow depth of field and warm ambient lighting. Center-right, standing upright on a glossy black marble table, is a cream-colored paperback book titled {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"} by {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}. The book is angled slightly to the left so both the front cover and spine are visible. The cover illustration is minimalist navy-blue line art showing an office interior with an open door leading into a winding outdoor path, framed pictures on the wall, a water cooler, a desk with stacked papers, and a person slumped in an office chair. The author’s name appears near the lower left of the front cover, and the title also runs vertically on the spine. To the left of the book on the marble surface is a small stack of 4 books, softly out of focus, and in the lower-left foreground sits 1 dark coffee cup on a saucer. Behind them is a dim, elegant room with blurred shelving and a soft green plant shape in the background. The magazine masthead dominates the top: {argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"} in very large white serif letters across the width, with small white issue text at top left reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"} and small white tagline text at top right reading “THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”. Beneath the masthead is a thin rule and a category line in small gold serif text with 6 categories separated by dots: “AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”. On the left side, large white serif cover headline text reads “Rethinking Success”. Below it is a white serif subheadline about leaving the default path behind and building a life and work that matters, followed by a small gold page number. Further down the left column are 4 editorial teaser blocks, each with a gold circular icon and gold uppercase heading, white descriptive text, and a gold page number. The 4 headings are “ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”, “WORK WITH PURPOSE”, “A NEW STORY”, and a boxed teaser “DESIGN SPECIAL”. At the bottom right is a realistic barcode block with small pricing text above it and a small issue number beside it. The overall layout should feel like a real luxury magazine cover mockup: crisp typography, elegant serif fonts, black, white, cream, and gold palette, glossy reflections on the marble, cinematic shadows, subtle product reflection beneath the book, and high-end editorial photography styling.

items.title: Minimal SVG Pelican on Bicycle
items.description: This generates a simple geometric vector-style pelican riding a bicycle, useful for SVG demo art, code-themed visuals, or playful minimalist illustrations.
items.content: A minimalist flat vector illustration on a light gray background showing a stylized pelican riding a bicycle, composed from simple geometric SVG-like shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines and sparse details. The bicycle is shown in side view with 2 large wheels, each with a circular rim and a simple cross of 4 spokes, a black frame, seat, crank, and handlebars, resting on a single thin horizontal ground line near the bottom. The pelican is abstract and slightly awkward, built from clean outlined shapes: a white circular-oval body positioned over the bike, 2 narrow orange-yellow leg shapes hanging down toward the pedals, a white neck and head extending forward, 1 small black eye, a long triangular orange-yellow upper beak, and 1 large pale pink lower pouch. Add a separate white wing shape angled upward above the body. Keep the composition intentionally simple and a little imperfect, as if it were an SVG demo drawing generated from code in a code editor screenshot, but render only the artwork itself with no interface, no text, no shadows, and no extra scenery.

items.title: Neuron on a San Francisco Cable Car
items.description: A surreal cinematic character portrait of a neuron dressed as a vintage commuter riding a classic San Francisco cable car, ideal for whimsical editorial or AI art prompts.
items.content: A whimsical cinematic portrait of an anthropomorphic neuron riding on the outside step of a classic San Francisco cable car at golden hour. The character has a large neuron head with a rounded central body and dozens of long branching dendrites radiating outward like a crown, textured in pale lavender, mauve, and fleshy gray with subtle organic sheen. Its face area is obscured and featureless. The figure is dressed like a Victorian or Edwardian gentleman commuter: dark tweed jacket, patterned waistcoat, collared shirt, necktie, pinstriped trousers, polished brown leather shoes, and a pocket watch chain. One hand grips a brass pole on the cable car, and the other hand holds up a vintage transit ticket reading "MUNICIPAL RAILWAY SAN FRANCISCO ADMIT ONE." Add a small round lapel pin that says "MUNI." A slender purple tail-like axon curls behind the body. The cable car is richly detailed varnished wood and brass, with a route sign on the side reading "POWELL AND MARKET / HYDE AND BEACH / FISHERMANS WHARF." In the background, show a steep San Francisco street with cable tracks descending into the distance, a second cable car far down the hill, dense urban buildings on both sides, and Coit Tower visible on a hazy hilltop. Warm nostalgic lighting, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed textures, surreal realism, humorous but elegant mood, centered full-body composition, vertical framing.

items.title: Nostalgic Watercolor Anime Adventure Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a painterly retro-anime commemorative poster with a double-exposure child profile, fantasy montage scenes, and elegant Japanese typography for franchise tribute art or collector-style prints.
items.content: A nostalgic watercolor anime poster on textured off-white paper, composed as a vertical double-exposure illustration inspired by late-1990s adventure anime. The main silhouette is the left-side profile of a young boy wearing large swim goggles pushed up on his head, his face turned to the right, with the silhouette filled by a dreamlike montage of memories and fantasy scenes. Inside the upper center of the silhouette, show 8 children from behind standing together on a ridge and looking toward a glowing, distant crystalline tower beneath a circular celestial portal in a cloudy blue-violet sky; include 7 small creature companions among them. On the upper right inside the silhouette, place a large dragon-like monster emerging from the clouds. Near the center, add a glowing round handheld digital device with a small screen, radiating light. In the middle-lower area, depict 2 iconic small dinosaur-like creatures sitting above an old shrine approach, one purple horned creature and one small yellow reptilian creature. In the lower area, show a mossy torii gate, overgrown stone steps, utility poles, and a small rural train on the right, all wrapped in mist and foliage. At the very bottom, include the 8 children again as tiny silhouettes walking away together along a path, reinforcing the theme of friendship and remembrance. Use soft ink-and-watercolor washes, muted blues, indigo, lavender, sepia, and warm golden highlights, with splattered pigment edges and painterly cloud textures. Keep the composition airy and elegant, with a refined modern poster-design sensibility and almost no generic AI gloss. Add vertical Japanese text on the right side reading あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。 and place a Japanese title logo at the lower left reading デジモンアドベンチャー, with a small English subtitle “DIGIMON ADVENTURE” and the date line “1999 - 永遠の冒険”.

items.title: Journey to the West Ink Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a refined Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster using a double-exposure character silhouette, ideal for mythic book covers, film posters, and cultural concept art.
items.content: A majestic Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster inspired by Journey to the West, composed as a double-exposure silhouette of {argument name="character name" default="Sun Wukong"} in left-facing profile occupying most of the page. The portrait is formed from soft sepia, ash gray, parchment white, and smoky black watercolor textures on an off-white paper background with splattered brush edges and negative space. The figure has a strong simian facial profile, a short beard, and a golden circlet across the brow. Inside and around the silhouette, build a layered mythic landscape in traditional shan shui style with luminous mist, cliffs, clouds, and ancient temples. At the top center inside the head, place a glowing full moon behind a celestial Buddha-like figure seated above a grand heavenly palace complex with multiple tiered roofs. In the upper-middle right, show 4 traveling figures on a cliff path: a monkey warrior with a staff, a monk riding a white horse, a pig-faced companion, and a dark-robed companion. In the middle, depict 1 dramatic battle scene of the monkey warrior confronting a coiling dragon or serpent in swirling clouds. In the lower-right, place 1 illuminated temple shrine nestled in the mountains with a golden sacred statue visible inside. In the lower area, add 3 tiny pilgrims walking through the misty valley. Use atmospheric depth, elegant calligraphic brushwork, drifting fog, and a refined cinematic composition that feels painterly rather than digital. Add vertical Chinese calligraphy on the left reading {argument name="title text" default="西游记"}, with smaller vertical side text and several seal-style stamps for an authentic poster design. Include another subtle vertical location inscription on the right cliff face. The mood is sacred, epic, ancient, mystical, and poetic, with premium concept-art polish and almost no generic AI look.

items.title: Gritty Evangelion Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dark, distressed retro-anime mecha poster suitable for cinematic fan art, collectible prints, or editorial-style sci-fi key visuals.
items.content: A dramatic vintage anime poster in the style of a gritty sci-fi mecha key visual, featuring three teenage pilots standing back-to-back in the foreground and a towering purple biomechanical robot looming directly behind them. The center pilot is a slim teenage boy in a dark navy and black plug suit with white shoulder panels and a glowing red circular core on the chest, standing front-facing with a serious expression. On the left is a pale teenage girl with short icy blue bob-cut hair and a white futuristic bodysuit, turned slightly away in profile. On the right is a teenage girl with long auburn hair flowing to the side, wearing a vivid red plug suit, looking outward with determination. Behind all three, the giant mecha head dominates the composition, centered and symmetrical, with a single horn, glowing orange eyes, angular armor, and massive shoulder structures rising like black wings. The background is outer space with 2 visible celestial bodies: 1 huge cratered moon directly behind the mecha’s head and 1 smaller planet at the right side. The bottom of the poster shows a ruined futuristic cityscape with broken buildings, rubble, sparks, and debris. At the very bottom center, include 2 tiny human silhouettes running forward through destruction, framed by pink energy streaks arcing left and right. Use a dark indigo, black, purple, rust red, and ash gray palette with heavy film grain, distressed ink texture, weathered paper wear, paint splatter, scratched print damage, and a rough screen-printed poster finish. Compose it as a full theatrical one-sheet with dense typography integrated into the edges: large vertical English title text on the left reading "NEON GENESIS EVANGELION", smaller vertical red text beside it reading "HIRANO OF EVANGELION", a red NERV insignia and the word "NERV" near the lower left, a boxed label at bottom left reading "TOKYO-3" and "JAPAN", a red warning box at the upper right reading "ANGEL ATTACK" with Japanese characters beneath, and multiple vertical Japanese taglines along the left and right borders. Cinematic, moody, apocalyptic, highly detailed, iconic 1990s anime poster design with premium modern illustration quality.

items.title: Dark Chinese Crime Drama Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a premium neo-noir Chinese crime-series poster suitable for thriller key art, streaming covers, or cinematic promotional design.
items.content: A dark, gritty Chinese crime-thriller movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, with a moody neo-noir aesthetic and heavy cinematic contrast. The composition centers on a half-length portrait of a menacing middle-aged East Asian man with wavy black hair, wearing a dark textured overcoat over a black shirt, his face mostly swallowed by shadow, shown from chest up and slightly off-center to the right. His hands are visible in the lower-right area, calmly holding a string of dark wooden prayer beads, suggesting power, danger, and ritual. The background is a dim urban alley or old city street at night, layered with grunge textures, wet pavement reflections, decayed walls, and faint architectural silhouettes. In the lower center, place 1 small back-facing seated figure in a chair under a harsh spotlight, surrounded by 9 standing human silhouettes in the darkness, creating a tense interrogation or underworld confrontation scene. Use an almost monochrome palette of black, charcoal, and dirty gray, with deep blood-red accents and distressed white typography. On the left side, add 1 huge vertical column of expressive red Chinese brush-calligraphy title text, painted with rough splashes and dry-brush texture, dominating nearly the full height of the poster. Along the far left edge, add 2 vertical lines of smaller Chinese text in white and red: "我叫高启强，" and "风浪越大，鱼越贵". On the right side, add 1 vertical cast credit line in white Chinese text with a red circular separator: "张颂文 饰 高启强". In the lower-right quadrant, add 1 bold white brushstroke Chinese subtitle/title mark reading "狂飙", with the small English subtitle "THE KNOCKOUT" in red serif capitals beneath it. Add tiny faint Chinese release or tagline text along the bottom edge. The overall feeling should be oppressive, violent, prestigious, and highly designed, like a premium streaming-platform crime drama key art poster, with layered depth, dramatic shadows, textured smoke and grime, and realistic photographic detail.

items.title: Jing'an Temple Line 2 Station Entrance
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic smartphone-style photo of commuters entering Shanghai Metro Jing'an Temple Station on Line 2, suitable for transit, urban realism, or location-based scene generation.
items.content: A realistic documentary-style photo of the entrance area inside {argument name="station name" default="Jing'an Temple Station"} on {argument name="subway line" default="Line 2"} in Shanghai Metro, viewed from a passenger's eye level while walking toward the fare gates. The scene is a wide indoor station concourse with a modern ceiling made of dark brown curved wooden slats and long linear white lights. In the center hangs a large dark overhead wayfinding sign with a green square route marker showing the number 2 and the text “2号线 / Line 2,” the main station name “静安寺站 / Jing'an Temple Station,” and a service center icon with the bilingual text “服务中心 / Service Center.” Below the sign are multiple stainless steel fare gates, with exactly 6 visible gate lanes in the foreground, some showing green arrow indicators and at least one showing a red no-entry symbol. Show a busy but orderly flow of commuters, around 10 to 15 adults in everyday autumn clothing, seen mostly from behind, walking into the station through the gates; include jackets, jeans, backpacks, shoulder bags, and neutral colors. On the left wall, include ticket or vending machines and another smaller green Line 2 sign. On the right wall, create a decorative white station wall with large black Chinese calligraphy reading “静安寺” and subtle wave-like graphic lines, plus a small green Line 2 marker nearby. Materials should feel authentic: polished gray speckled stone floor, metallic columns, tiled walls, and realistic transit fixtures. Lighting is bright, even, and fluorescent, with a clean public-transport atmosphere. Compose it as a slightly wide-angle smartphone photo, centered on the overhead sign and gate area, highly realistic, candid, detailed, and true to an actual Shanghai metro station interior.

items.title: Pastel Anime Kimono by Lotus Pond
items.description: This prompt generates a dreamy vertical anime fantasy illustration of a kimono-clad woman by a glowing lotus pond, ideal for wallpaper art or elegant character-themed visuals.
items.content: A dreamy pastel anime illustration of a serene young woman in a moonlit spring garden beside a pond, rendered in delicate Japanese fantasy style with flat anime coloring, no shadows, ultra-clean linework, and no grainy texture. She is seated in three-quarter back view at the water’s edge, turning her face slightly toward the viewer with a calm, melancholic expression. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with soft bangs and floral ornaments woven into a blossom crown. She wears an elegant flowing kimono in pale blue and cream, richly patterned with stylized waves and white foxes, with layered fabric pooling around her. A large traditional paper parasol rests behind her on the right side, partly open, with dangling crystal-like ornaments. Surround her with dense blooming cherry blossom branches overhead and scattered petals in the foreground. The pond is filled with exactly 10 glowing lotus flowers floating on reflective water and exactly 4 visible koi fish swimming near the surface. In the distant left background, include a small multi-tier pagoda silhouette across the water. From the upper left, a soft rainbow beam of light descends diagonally onto the pond, creating iridescent reflections. Hang several faceted crystal ornaments from the branches so they sparkle in the light. Use a palette dominated by lavender, blush pink, pale blue, ivory, and soft gold. The atmosphere should feel ethereal, romantic, tranquil, and magical, with intricate decorative detail, luminous water reflections, and a polished vertical composition.

items.title: Modern Queen on Iron Throne Poster
items.description: A dramatic fantasy parody poster of a modern woman casually ruling from a sword throne, ideal for personalized epic character portraits and social-media memes.
items.content: A cinematic fantasy poster in the style of an epic medieval throne-room drama, showing a modern woman seated confidently on a dark iron sword throne. She is centered in a full-body portrait, sitting with one leg crossed over the other and both arms resting casually on the throne arms, projecting relaxed queenly confidence. She has long, wavy {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair falling over her shoulders, and wears contemporary casual clothing instead of period costume: a fitted long-sleeve {argument name="top color" default="deep burgundy"} shirt, dark blue skinny jeans, and black ankle boots. The throne is massive, jagged, and forged from overlapping weathered swords, filling most of the background. The setting is a dim, moody royal hall with warm firelight, soft glowing candles, faint sparks or embers in the air, and two vertical banners in the distant background bearing a red three-headed dragon-style sigil. Use dramatic, high-contrast lighting, rich dark metallic textures, warm orange highlights, and a polished premium fantasy-poster look. Add faint handwritten-style text near the upper left arc of the throne reading {argument name="name text" default="LAREENA STARKER"}. At the bottom, add large ornate metallic-gold title typography in a fantasy serif style reading {argument name="main title" default="BABE"} on the first line, smaller centered "OF" below it, and {argument name="subtitle" default="THRONES"} in very large letters across the bottom, with the O stylized as a circular emblem with vertical bars. Vertical poster composition, symmetrical framing, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, regal but playful modern parody of an iconic fantasy throne poster.

items.title: Netflix-Style Vibe Coder Poster
items.description: A dark comedic streaming-poster prompt for generating a polished fake Netflix-style teaser about an AI-powered 'vibe coder' in a neon-lit programmer workspace.
items.content: A cinematic parody streaming-poster in vertical 2:3 format, styled like a dark Netflix original teaser poster for a humorous AI programming drama. At the very top, small white text reads {argument name="top banner text" default="A NETFLIX ORIGINAL"}. Centered and dominating the composition, huge glowing sci-fi sans serif title text in icy white with a faint lavender-blue neon bloom reads {argument name="title text" default="VIBE CODER"}, stacked on two lines. Below it, smaller white text says "STARRING" and beneath that a pink cast name in bold all caps reads {argument name="cast name" default="HUNKINS"}. The scene shows a dim moody programmer bedroom or office at night lit by monitors and purple-blue neon. In the center foreground, a plush teddy-bear-like mascot with white fuzzy paws sits slouched in a black desk chair wearing a black hoodie, face mostly hidden in shadow for a mysterious comedic look. On the hoodie chest, 4 lines of small off-white text read exactly: "// SHIP IT", "// VIBE CHECK", "// NO BUGS", "// JUST VIBES". In front of the character is an open laptop covered with 4 visible stickers: "vibe > spec", "DON'T THINK JUST PROMPT", a smiley face sticker, and "Claude 3.5", plus an abstract AI-style logo sticker. Behind the laptop are 2 widescreen monitors displaying dense code on dark themes. The background includes 2 wall notes/signs on the left: a sticky note reading "IDEAS > PLANS" and, on the right, a whiteboard with 3 stacked handwritten lines reading "BUILD FAST", "BREAK THINGS", "ASK AI", and a fourth line "REPEAT" beneath, plus a hand-drawn smiley. Next to the whiteboard is a pink-purple neon </> code icon sign. On the desk at lower right sits a matte black drink can with pink text reading "FOCUS (optional)" and a cardboard pizza box edge labeled "ITERATE LATER". Use rich shadows, soft practical light, purple and cyan rim light, subtle monitor glow, shallow depth of field, high contrast, glossy premium poster finish, and a slightly absurd, self-aware startup-comedy tone. At the bottom, centered white tagline text reads {argument name="tagline text" default="HE’S NOT A PROGRAMMER. HE’S A VIBE CODER."}, with the word "VIBE" highlighted in pink. Below that, a release line in white and red reads {argument name="release line" default="ONLY ON NETFLIX | COMING SOON"}, with "NETFLIX" in bold red. Make it look like a polished official teaser one-sheet for a fictional streaming series.

items.content: A clean 2x2 portrait collage of {argument name="subject" default="a young East Asian woman"} in a minimal studio setting with a soft white background, photographed in a high-end beauty editorial style. All four panels are tightly framed close-up or cropped bust portraits with soft diffused lighting, realistic skin texture, crisp pores, subtle natural freckles, glossy eyes, and sharp details around the eyelashes, lips, and hair strands. The overall color palette is pale, airy, and neutral with gentle pink accents, while the subject has straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and wispy bangs in most panels. In the top-left panel, she faces forward with both hands pressed to her cheeks, elbows out of frame, creating a cute symmetrical pose; her face is largely covered by her hands, only the hair, ears, and sides of the face visible. In the top-right panel, show the clearest beauty portrait: direct eye contact, calm slightly melancholic expression, crossed fingers held in front of the lips, long translucent pale pink manicure, and exactly 4 chunky pink plastic flower rings across the fingers, with delicate makeup and softly parted lips. In the bottom-left panel, she leans on a white tabletop with one arm folded forward, wearing exactly 2 pink hair clips on the left side of her hair, casual and youthful styling, relaxed posture. In the bottom-right panel, show a cropped portrait with the hair tied back, one hand supporting the chin, wearing a fluffy off-white sherpa zip jacket over a light pink top, minimal makeup, and a quiet natural expression. Keep the composition editorial and balanced, with each panel separated by thin white gutters, ultra-realistic beauty photography, enhanced image clarity, deblurred details, natural skin, soft shadows, and premium cosmetics campaign quality.

items.title: Neumorphic Glass UI Kit Board
items.description: This prompt generates a polished board of 18 premium neumorphic interface controls, ideal for showcasing futuristic app UI components or smart-device dashboard concepts.
items.content: A clean neumorphic UI component showcase on a soft light gray background, arranged as a balanced design board of 18 separate interface elements with subtle shadows, frosted translucent white plastic surfaces, rounded corners, and glossy glass-like depth. Use a premium minimal product-design aesthetic with white-on-white layering, soft ambient occlusion, delicate inner shadows, and a restrained accent palette of deep teal green and vivid orange. Include 18 distinct components: 1 large circular rotary knob in the upper left with a dark teal glossy center, fine radial tick marks, and a small orange position indicator; 1 small circular directional control pad with a teal center button and four tiny arrow icons around it; 1 circular play button with a teal triangle icon and a short orange progress arc on the rim; 1 horizontal pill toggle switch at the top right with a teal knob positioned to the right; 1 rounded square heart button with a simple teal outline heart; 1 small circular indicator button with a single orange dot in the center; 1 pill-shaped plus-minus control with a teal minus on the left and teal plus on the right separated by a vertical divider; 1 long horizontal volume slider with a teal speaker icon on the left, fine slider ticks, a teal track, a teal knob near the right side, and a faint waveform icon on the far right; 1 circular percentage dial showing 60% with radial ticks and a few orange highlight marks near the upper right; 1 rounded square bell notification button with a teal outline bell icon; 1 compact music player card with a small square album image of misty evergreen trees on the left, the title {argument name="track title" default="Forest Drive"}, the subtitle {argument name="track subtitle" default="Ambient Journey"}, a thin progress bar, and a circular play button on the right; 4 small circular utility icon buttons in one row showing sliders/settings, search, share, and ellipsis; 1 large circular compass with cardinal letters N, E, S, W plus diagonal labels, a teal-and-orange needle, and metallic center; 1 tall vertical slider on the right with a teal track, teal knob around the middle, small side dots, an orange accent near the bottom, and a tiny speaker icon below; 1 bottom navigation bar in a long rounded pill containing 4 icons separated by subtle dividers: home, bar chart, compass, and user profile, with the home tab active in teal; 1 large rounded pill call-to-action button in glossy dark teal labeled {argument name="button text" default="Explore"} with a circular orange arrow button attached on the right; and 1 rounded square fingerprint button with a teal fingerprint icon. Keep spacing generous, alignment grid-based, and the overall render highly polished, tactile, and futuristic, like a luxury smart-device UI kit mockup.

items.content: A clean neumorphic mobile dashboard UI mockup shown straight-on, centered on a soft light gray background, inside a white rounded smartphone frame with subtle embossed shadows and glossy soft highlights. The interface uses a minimalist white-on-white design with teal green and warm orange accent colors. At the very top of the phone, include a small circular menu button on the left, a centered speaker slit and front camera dot, and status icons on the right showing Wi‑Fi, signal, 100%, and battery.
