items.title: Neumorphic Smart UI Kit
items.description: A polished neumorphic interface board featuring smart controls, media widgets, weather cards, and app icons, ideal for generating premium dashboard or mobile UI concept art.
items.content: Create a premium neumorphic smart-home and media control UI kit on a clean light gray background, arranged as a balanced dashboard-style composition of floating rounded cards and circular controls with soft extruded shadows, subtle inner highlights, frosted white surfaces, and elegant teal-and-orange accents. The overall style is minimalist, futuristic, tactile, and highly polished, like a high-end mobile interface concept. Include exactly 18 discrete UI modules and icons: 1 large circular volume knob card in the upper left with a glossy deep teal center, dotted perimeter, plus and minus symbols, and the text “VOLUME 67%”; 1 vertical volume slider card with the label “VOLUME”, a white knob, orange level bars, small speaker icons, and “67%”; 1 large circular balance dial at the top center-right with numeric markings 25, 50, 75, 100, the central value “72%”, the label “BALANCE”, and a small orange indicator dot; 1 circular compass widget in the upper right with N, E, S, W labels, a metallic teal compass needle, and a small orange accent dot on the rim; 1 smaller circular min-max knob on the left middle with a teal center, textured white dial edge, orange indicator dot, and “MIN” and “MAX” labels; 3 small circular utility buttons beneath it in one row, showing a power symbol, a connectivity or wireless symbol, and a heart outline; 1 horizontal toggle switch below those buttons with a teal knob and the text “ON”; 1 large media player card in the center with a square album cover showing abstract layered teal dunes or waves, the track title “Beyond The Horizon”, the artist name “Aurora Nights”, a heart icon in the top right, a waveform progress display, timestamps “1:45” and “3:58”, and 4 playback controls along the bottom row: shuffle, previous, central orange play button, next, and repeat; 6 rounded-square app icons in two columns on the right side, arranged in 3 rows, showing exactly these symbols: paper plane arrow, stacked layers, shield with check mark, cloud, bell with a small orange notification dot, and gear; 1 rectangular clock card at the bottom left with a circular analog clock face, large digital time “10:58 AM”, the date line “Thursday, May 23”, and sunrise/sunset times “06:15 AM” and “08:24 PM”; 1 weather card at the bottom center with the location “San Francisco”, current temperature “18°”, condition “Partly Cloudy”, high/low “H: 21°  L: 13°”, a large sun-behind-cloud illustration, and a 5-column hourly forecast labeled “11 AM”, “12 PM”, “1 PM”, “2 PM”, “3 PM”; 1 pill-shaped tab selector at the lower right with 3 tabs, where the left tab is active in teal with an audio waveform icon, and the other 2 tabs show a user icon and a folder icon; 1 search bar directly beneath it with a magnifying glass and placeholder text “Search...” ; 1 horizontal slider below the search bar with a teal progress line and a white knob; 1 large rounded CTA button at the bottom right reading “{argument name="button text" default="EXPLORE"}” with a right-facing orange arrow; and 5 circular bottom navigation icons centered along the bottom edge, showing home, bar chart, calendar with “23”, chat bubble, and user profile, plus 2 floating action buttons beside them: a camera icon and an orange plus sign. Use a restrained palette with white and very light gray surfaces, deep teal-green gradients for active states, and warm orange for highlights and notifications. Emphasize depth through soft ambient shadows, subtle bevels, glossy reflections, and realistic material rendering. Keep the layout spacious, symmetric but not rigid, and suitable for a luxury mobile app concept presentation.

items.title: Wuxia MMORPG Ancient Town Screenshot
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic Chinese fantasy RPG gameplay screen with a full HUD, ideal for mock game key art, UI concepts, or immersive MMO scene creation.
items.content: A highly detailed cinematic third-person wuxia MMORPG gameplay screenshot set in a bustling ancient Chinese water-town market street at dusk, viewed from behind the player character standing in the center foreground. The player character is a wandering swordsman in layered dark gray and blue hanfu-style robes with embroidered fabric, long black hair tied in a low ponytail, and a sheathed sword on his back, facing forward into a crowded street. The environment is a richly rendered Ming- or Song-inspired town with traditional wooden shopfronts, tiled roofs, hanging red lanterns, pink cherry blossom trees, damp reflective stone pavement, soft golden evening light, and a lived-in crowd of townsfolk in historical clothing. On the right foreground, exactly 3 elegant female courtesans in translucent pastel hanfu sit and stand outside a richly decorated teahouse or brothel draped with red silk curtains; one is playing a pipa, one is seated in pale green and cream robes, and one stands in flowing rose-pink robes. The largest shop sign above them features large gold Chinese calligraphy on a black plaque, and additional vertical shop banners with Chinese characters hang along the street. The composition should feel like a premium AAA fantasy Chinese RPG, with realistic character proportions, dense environmental storytelling, dramatic but natural lighting, atmospheric depth, and intricate costume materials. Include a complete game HUD overlay in Chinese: top left circular character portrait with level 36 and 2 horizontal bars for health and mana; a left-side quest tracker panel with exactly 4 quest entries under tabbed headings; a bottom left semi-transparent chat box with multiple lines of Chinese world chat; a top right circular minimap with location text; a right-side vertical menu with exactly 6 icon buttons; a bottom center skill bar with exactly 10 slots including 8 square skill icons plus 2 circular end slots labeled with keyboard keys; and a bottom menu row with exactly 6 navigation icons. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic fantasy game interface mockup, polished UI, immersive crowded street scene, 16:9 aspect ratio.

items.title: Japanese Graduation Photo Under Sakura
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic nostalgic group portrait of 6 Japanese schoolgirls in uniform posing with peace signs at a cherry-blossom-lined school graduation entrance.
items.content: A soft, realistic Japanese graduation-day photo in the style of vintage film photography, showing 6 teenage schoolgirls standing together outdoors in front of a school gate under full-bloom cherry blossoms. They wear matching Japanese high school uniforms: navy blazers, white shirts, burgundy ribbon bows, gray-blue plaid pleated skirts, navy knee-high socks, and black loafers, each carrying a large navy school bag. The group stands close together on the road at the entrance, with relaxed celebratory body language and a candid class-photo feel. At least 5 of the girls are making peace signs near their faces, and one girl on the far right raises her hand in a playful salute-like pose. Emphasize natural, flattering leg shapes, neat straight dark hair with soft bangs, youthful styling, and believable proportions. The composition is front-facing and full-body, with the students centered slightly left and the school gate on the right. Include a tall black gate pillar with vertical gold Japanese text reading "桜花女子高等学校" and a white ceremonial signboard beside it with large Japanese text reading "卒業証書授与式" and smaller school-name text below. Background filled with pale pink sakura trees in bloom, shallow depth of field, soft pastel tones, gentle spring haze, overcast bright daylight, subtle film grain, muted contrast, and an understated nostalgic atmosphere like an old-fashioned commemorative photograph.

items.content: A cinematic third-person fantasy RPG gameplay screenshot set in an ancient Chinese market city at golden hour, viewed from slightly behind a small group of foreground characters and looking down a busy stone-paved street toward a grand multi-tier pagoda in the distance. The scene is dense with exactly 1 central male hero in ornate dark red and black robes with gold armor accents, holding a drawn sword pointed downward, and exactly 1 female companion beside him in elegant flowing white Hanfu with red trim and gold accessories. Around them are exactly 4 blurred foreground onlookers or guards framing the shot, 2 on the left and 2 on the right, plus a large crowd of townspeople in period clothing filling the street. Traditional wooden buildings with curved tiled roofs line both sides, with hanging lanterns, red banners, fabric awnings, market stalls, and warm window lights. Add drifting flower petals or glowing particles in the air, soft atmospheric haze, strong depth, and rich warm sunlight with long shadows. items.title: Blue Couture Group Portrait
items.description: A moody luxury fashion prompt for generating an elegant group portrait of women in coordinated sapphire gowns for editorial, beauty, or formal campaign imagery.
items.content: A luxurious studio fashion portrait of {argument name="group size" default="four"} elegant young women posed closely together in a dramatic royal-blue fantasy setting, all wearing coordinated deep sapphire and midnight-navy couture evening gowns with glittering beadwork, floral appliqué, sequins, lace sleeves, sheer mesh details, and voluminous layered skirts. The scene is monochromatic blue with a cool, moody, high-end editorial color grade. Arrange the women in a tight triangular composition: two standing or elevated in the back and two seated in front on draped fabric, with varied graceful poses, one woman raising an arm above her head, one leaning slightly, one seated upright, and one resting her chin on her hand. Their dresses should each be distinct but harmonized, featuring ornate crystal embellishments, embroidered flowers, and fitted bodices. Add matching sapphire jewelry including dangling earrings, gemstone necklaces, and floral hair accessories. Use long flowing hair in mixed dark black and soft light brown tones, styled smooth and glamorous. Surround them with opulent set dressing: 2 classical urn vases filled with blue roses, 1 fluted stone column in the background, heavy shimmering velvet curtains, and abundant draped satin fabric pooling around them. Lighting should be soft and diffused with subtle highlights on satin and jewels, creating a regal, mysterious, romantic atmosphere. Shoot as a vertical fashion editorial portrait, waist-up to full seated composition, highly detailed fabric textures, polished luxury beauty campaign aesthetic, no visible text.

items.content: A candid street-fashion portrait of a young woman standing at a busy Tokyo crosswalk in daylight, framed from the upper torso up and turned slightly away from the camera so her bare shoulder is prominent. She has a short messy bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"}, soft wispy texture, and a delicate build. She wears an airy off-shoulder blouse in {argument name="clothing color" default="white"}, made of thin semi-sheer fabric with loose drape and a romantic, lightweight feel. Use a warm vintage film aesthetic with faded colors, noticeable grain, slight blur, soft sunlight, muted contrast, and a nostalgic analog snapshot mood. The overall tone should feel stylish, spontaneous, and cinematic, like a fashion photo captured in the middle of a bustling city.

items.title: Elegant Chinese Calendar App UI
items.description: This prompt generates a polished mobile UI concept for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, suitable for app design showcases or product mockups.
items.content: A clean, elegant iPhone app UI mockup for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, shown as a full-screen mobile screenshot on a soft warm white background with subtle paper-like texture and refined East Asian editorial aesthetics. The interface uses a minimalist serif-and-sans mix, muted brown, gray, black, pale blue, green, and gold accents, with spacious layout and delicate dividers. Show the iOS status bar at the top with the time 8:45, cellular signal, Wi‑Fi icon, and a battery indicator reading 96. Below it, a header for {argument name="month" default="4月"} with secondary text “24日 | 每日万年历” and, on the right, a rounded rectangular date-picker button labeled “择日” with a calendar icon plus a separate plus symbol. The main section is a monthly calendar grid for {argument name="year" default="2026"}, with 7 weekday columns labeled Sunday through Saturday in Chinese: 周日, 周一, 周二, 周三, 周四, 周五, 周六. Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the {argument name="selected date" default="24"} cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. Overall style: premium app design concept, calm scholarly Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product shot, realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, subtle shadows, soft contrast, and polished startup-quality UI.

items.title: Minimalist Anime Girl Side Profile
items.description: This prompt generates a clean single-character anime portrait with a flat-color background, ideal for stylish social posts, profile art, or minimalist illustration studies.
items.content: A minimalist anime-style portrait of a young woman shown from the chest up in side profile, facing left, with her head slightly turned so only part of one eye and ear are visible. She has a short straight bob haircut with soft inward-curving ends, light tousled strands, and {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair. Her skin is pale and smooth, and she wears an off-shoulder loose white top or sweater slipping down one shoulder, exposing the collarbone and upper back. The composition is clean and graphic, with thin dark navy linework, flat muted colors, almost no shading, and a calm editorial illustration feel. Use a solid {argument name="background color" default="bright cyan blue"} background with no objects, no scenery, no text. Center the bust portrait slightly left of frame, leaving negative space around the figure. Keep the mood quiet, stylish, modern, and elegant, like a Japanese social-media anime girl illustration. Do not add accessories, jewelry, or extra background elements.

items.title: Moonlit Tiger and Rose Fantasy Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a poetic vertical fantasy poster of a moonlit woman on water with a glowing tiger reflection and rose vine, ideal for artistic quote imagery and symbolic AI art.
items.content: A dreamy, cinematic fantasy illustration in vertical poster format, showing {argument name="celebrity model" default="Liu Yifei"} in side profile walking barefoot across a perfectly still midnight-blue lake under a luminous full moon and a richly detailed star-filled sky with the Milky Way stretching diagonally behind her. She is a graceful East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a shimmering silver sleeveless evening gown with a flowing skirt and a thigh slit, the fabric sparkling like stardust. Her expression is calm and introspective, and she faces to the right as one foot touches the water, creating delicate glowing ripples. Two small dark islands sit low on the horizon, one on each side, emphasizing the vast open water and sky. A glowing vine of soft white roses and petals wraps around her body in an elegant S-curve, beginning behind her upper back, spiraling around her waist and legs, and continuing downward into the reflection. Beneath the water, instead of a normal reflection, create a large luminous line-art tiger formed from fine white neon-like contours, upside down relative to the woman above, with its body curled dynamically and its head near a large glowing white rose at the lower right; the tiger should feel majestic, lean, and ethereal rather than aggressive. The overall palette is cool blue, silver, and white, with gentle moonlight, soft bloom, mirror-like reflections, magical realism, ultra-clean composition, high detail, romantic fantasy mood. Add elegant cursive text centered near the bottom that reads {argument name="quote" default="In me the tiger sniffs the rose."}, plus one small four-point star icon near the lower right corner. Make it refined, poetic, and visually symbolic of inner strength and tenderness.

items.description: A detailed traditional-style Chinese medical infographic poster explaining Alzheimer’s disease for health education, awareness campaigns, and social media science posts.

slogan"},"text":{"main_title":"阿尔茨海默病","subtitle":"—— 了解、预防、关爱，共筑记忆的长城 ——","body_language":"Simplified left","count":4,"labels":["一种起病隐匿的慢性疾病","以记忆力减退为主要表现","随着病情进展，影响语言、思维、行为、情绪及日常生活能力","目前尚无根治方法，但早期干预可延缓进展、提高生活质量"]},{"title":"疾病机制（大脑的变化）","position":"upper right","count":4,"labels":["大脑内出现异常的蛋白质沉积，导致神经元受损、死亡，从而引起认知功能逐渐衰退。","正常大脑","阿尔茨海默病患者大脑","β-淀粉样蛋白斑块沉积 and Tau蛋白神经纤维缠结"]},{"title":"危险因素","position":"middle center","count":4,"labels":["早期（轻度认知障碍期）","中期（轻度痴呆期）","中晚期（中度痴呆期）","晚期（重度痴呆期）"]},{"title":"如何诊断？","position":"lower left","count":4,"labels":["详细病史采集","认知功能评估","影像学检查","实验室检查"]},{"title":"预防与延缓建议（健康生活，从现在开始）","position":"lower right","count":7,"labels":["健康饮食：地中海饮食，多吃蔬果、全谷物、鱼类、坚果。","规律运动：每周至少150分钟中等强度运动。","积极动脑：阅读、学习新技能、下棋、书法等。","社交活动：保持人际交往，积极参与社交。","控制慢病：管理好血压、血糖、血脂，戒烟限酒。","良好睡眠：保证充足睡眠，治疗睡眠呼吸暂停。","保持乐观：积极心态，减少压力和抑郁。"]}],"centerpiece":"a large multi-panel educational layout with red section headers and thin ornamental borders"},"illustrations":{"count":14,"items":["2 cross-sectional brain diagrams comparing healthy and Alzheimer’s brains","2 circular pathology insets showing amyloid plaque and tau tangle","5 round risk-factor icons","4 patient-stage illustrations showing progression from mild confusion to bedridden late stage","1 clipboard icon in diagnosis section plus supporting medical-style icons"]},"typography":{"headline":"large expressive black brush-calligraphy title","section_headers":"white Chinese text on dark red brushstroke banners","body":"neat printed Chinese serif text with moderate spacing"},"quality":"high-resolution, balanced editorial composition, polished healthcare infographic suitable for social media sharing, public education, or clinic awareness poster"}

items.title: AI Guangzhou Food Map Comparison
items.description: A social-media-style comparison poster showing two side-by-side AI-generated Guangzhou foodie map illustrations with a Chinese prompt box, useful for benchmarking image model outputs.
items.content: A comparison graphic on a black background with a faint gray square grid, designed like a social media test result poster. At the top are 2 large side-by-side titles in bold sans serif text: “GPT image 2” above the left image and “Nano Banana” above the right image. Below them are 2 vertically oriented illustrated posters placed next to each other with a small gap. Both posters depict the same concept: a hand-drawn foodie walking map of Guangzhou in Chinese, but rendered in 2 different visual styles. The left poster is more detailed, textured, dense, and richly illustrated, while the right poster is cleaner, flatter, and simpler. The left poster has a warm cream paper background and an intricate vintage hand-painted travel-map style with fine linework, watercolor texture, decorative flowers and lychee fruits, miniature buildings, roads, river areas, and many food illustrations. The large Chinese title at the top of the left poster reads “广州 吃货暴走地图”. The map includes roughly 12 featured food spots distributed across the city, each shown as a small food illustration with Chinese labels and short handwritten-style annotations. Visible foods include skewers, roast poultry, noodle dishes, clay pot dishes, rice rolls, dumplings, soups, and dessert bowls, with landmarks such as the Canton Tower and riverfront scenery integrated into the map. The right poster also has the Chinese title “广州 吃货暴走地图” and shows the same general idea but in a cleaner infographic-like map style with simplified roads, icons, floral and lychee border decorations, food callouts, a river, the Canton Tower, and approximately 12 labeled food illustrations around the map. At the bottom of the overall comparison graphic is 1 rounded black text panel with a white outline. Attached to its upper left edge is 1 bright yellow rounded tab label reading “提示词” in bold black Chinese characters. Inside the black panel is a block of white Chinese text describing the image-generation prompt; it appears as a multi-line paragraph. The composition is centered, high contrast, and presented as a polished AI image comparison post for Chinese social media, with crisp typography, poster-like symmetry, and a clean test-benchmark aesthetic.

items.content: A vertical social-media comparison poster on a black background with a subtle gray grid, designed like a clean tech review graphic. At the top are two large side-by-side headings: on the left, bright yellow text reading “GPT image 2”; on the right, white text reading “Nano Banana”. Below the headings are 2 tall poster mockups placed side by side with narrow spacing, each in an off-white paper style. The left mockup shows a traditional Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster inspired by Journey to the West, with large vertical Chinese calligraphy “西游记” near the upper left, muted sepia and gray watercolor mountains, cliffs, mist, temple architecture, and 4 tiny human figures visible in the composition: 2 heroic figures near the upper middle on a rocky ledge, plus 2 travelers lower in the scene; a swirling luminous mist vortex appears near the lower area. The right mockup shows a more graphic surreal poster built inside the side-profile silhouette of a human head facing left, filled with a Chinese fantasy landscape including pagodas, water, paths, figures, and the vertical title “西游记” inside the silhouette; the silhouette is painted in dark navy and black watercolor with cream paper around it. Each of the 2 posters has a large centered vertical rectangular blur censor block over the middle area, with soft edges and gray-beige color. Along the bottom is a rounded black caption panel with a thin white outline. Attached to its upper left corner is a bright yellow pill-shaped label containing the Chinese text “提示词” in bold black. Inside the bottom panel is a block of bold white Chinese text in multiple lines. The text should read: “西游记主题收藏版史诗海报，人物侧脸剪影中生长出完整世界观与经典场景。整体偏电影海报和梦幻水彩插画风，安静、宏大、神圣、怀旧，带纸张颗粒、轻雾感、飞白刷痕与高级留白。” The overall style is a polished Chinese tech comparison thumbnail, high contrast, editorial layout, centered composition, 4:5 portrait aspect ratio.

items.title: AI Hanfu Poster Comparison
items.description: A side-by-side social media comparison graphic contrasting two AI-generated Chinese Hanfu infographic posters with headings and a prompt text box, ideal for benchmarking image model results.
items.content: A dark tech-comparison poster on a black background with a subtle gray square grid, showing two vertically oriented infographic images side by side for an AI image generation comparison. At the top, place two large bold yellow headings: “GPT image 2” above the left panel and “Nano Banana” above the right panel. The left panel is an elegant antique-style Hanfu reference poster on warm aged paper, with a large Chinese calligraphy title at the top reading “汉服·解构图鉴”, smaller subtitle text beneath, and a full-body woman in pale traditional Hanfu standing in the center, her face intentionally blurred. Surround her with many small labeled diagram blocks, fabric swatches, embroidery closeups, accessory notes, silhouette studies, and fine Chinese annotations in a scholarly museum-poster layout. Use beige, cream, light gray-blue, and faded ink tones, giving the panel a refined archival aesthetic. The right panel is a cleaner modern infographic poster on light beige paper with a bold Chinese title across the top reading “中国传统汉服：大明朝服解构图谱”. In the center, show a bright red Ming-style robe drawn as a technical exploded garment diagram with multiple callout arrows and labeled parts. Around it, include material samples, decorative pattern examples, a horizontal row of 6 circular color swatches, construction details, and a bottom strip with 4 small human figure diagrams showing wearing sequence or silhouette comparison. Make the right poster feel more graphic-design driven, with sharper contrast and more vivid red accents. At the bottom of the overall image, add a large rounded black text box with a thin white outline spanning most of the width. Attach a yellow rounded label tab on its upper-left corner containing the Chinese word “提示词” in bold black text. Inside the black box, place a dense paragraph of white Chinese text describing the test prompt for generating a Hanfu-themed decomposition chart, resembling a screenshot quote block. items.title: Luxury Germany Travel Poster
items.description: A refined tourism poster showcasing Germany’s iconic landmarks, cultural highlights, and traditional foods, ideal for destination marketing or editorial travel art.
items.content:
Create a luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Germany"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign advertisement. Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a small gold national emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"} in deep navy blue. Under it, add the slogan “LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.” in gold uppercase, followed by a smaller classic serif tagline reading “Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.” with a tiny horizontal accent in the colors black, red, and gold.

Show a majestic panoramic montage of iconic German scenery at golden hour under a softly glowing blue sky with scattered clouds. On the left, feature a fairy-tale white hilltop castle resembling Neuschwanstein, perched above autumn trees. In the center distance, place dramatic alpine mountains. On the right, show a historic European riverside city with dense red-roofed houses, an arched stone bridge crossing the water, a domed cathedral, and a towering Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add calm river reflections and a small white sightseeing boat at the lower right. The image should feel nostalgic, romantic, and aspirational, with warm sunlight, crisp architectural detail, and rich cinematic color grading.

Along the lower middle, include exactly 5 gold line-art cultural icons with labels beneath them, evenly spaced in a horizontal row: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “VIBRANT CULTURE”, “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”, and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”.

At the bottom, create a dark horizontal food showcase strip with the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY” in gold. Inside the strip, include exactly 5 framed food panels, each labeled in white uppercase beneath the image: “BREZEL”, “BRATWURST”, “KARTOFFELSALAT”, “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”, and “GERMAN BEER”. Show each item as an appetizing close-up: a glossy pretzel on a plate, grilled sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, a slice of Black Forest cake topped with cream and cherry, and a frothy beer mug. Keep the overall design polished, high-end, poster-like, and suitable for a luxury destination campaign.

items.title: Luxury Northern Europe Travel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished premium-style tourism poster showcasing four Northern European destinations and five regional foods, ideal for travel marketing or editorial cover art.
items.content: Create an elegant luxury travel poster for {argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign brochure cover. Use a wide symmetrical layout with a thin gold decorative border and refined editorial typography. At the top center, place a small compass-star icon above the word DISCOVER, then a very large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"} in deep navy blue. Below it, add a gold uppercase tagline: {argument name="tagline" default="BREATHTAKING NATURE. RICH CULTURE. TIMELESS EXPERIENCES."} and beneath that a smaller elegant italic line: {argument name="subheading" default="Four Countries. Countless Memories."}. The main image area is divided into 4 equal vertical scenic panels showing iconic destinations at golden hour with soft glowing skies and cinematic realism. Panel 1: Denmark, Copenhagen, a colorful harbor waterfront with historic buildings, boats, calm reflective water, and a domed landmark in the background; include a small Danish flag above the labels DENMARK and COPENHAGEN. Panel 2: Sweden, Stockholm, a waterfront old-town skyline with church spires and warm sunset light reflected in the water; include a small Swedish flag above the labels SWEDEN and STOCKHOLM. Panel 3: Finland, Helsinki, a small stone castle-like island fortress in blue water under a bright sky; include a small Finnish flag above the labels FINLAND and HELSINKI. Panel 4: Norway, dramatic fjords with steep jagged mountains, a waterfall, and a tiny red-roof coastal village at the water’s edge; include a small Norwegian flag above the labels NORWAY and FJORDS OF NORWAY. Beneath the 4 country panels, add a row of 4 gold line icons with captions, evenly spaced: mountain icon with ICONIC LANDSCAPES, Viking ship icon with RICH HERITAGE, moose icon with WILD NATURE, camera icon with UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS. Near the bottom center, place a gold divider and the title A TASTE OF THE NORTH. Under it, show exactly 5 food thumbnail panels in a horizontal strip, each on a plate or bowl with warm appetizing lighting and dark blue framing: 1) Smørrebrød — Denmark, open-faced sandwich topped with shrimp; 2) Köttbullar — Sweden, Swedish meatballs with cream sauce and lingonberries; 3) Gravad lax — Finland, sliced cured salmon in a bowl; 4) Fish soup — Norway, creamy fish soup with herbs and seafood; 5) Kanelbulle — Sweden, a glossy cinnamon bun on a plate. Use a polished high-end travel-ad aesthetic, photorealistic scenery, soft sunset color grading, navy and gold graphic design, balanced composition, crisp text placement, and a nostalgic upscale European tourism mood.

items.description: This prompt generates an elegant tourism poster for Austria, ideal for travel marketing, destination showcases, or nostalgic European-themed promotional art.
items.content: A luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Austria"}, designed like a premium tourism advertisement. Use an elegant, symmetrical poster layout with thin gold decorative border lines and small ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a minimalist gold mountain emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large refined serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="AUSTRIA"} in deep burgundy red. Beneath it, add a small uppercase tagline in gold: “TIMELESS BEAUTY. RICH HERITAGE. UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES.” and below that an italic script line: “Where Tradition Meets Breathtaking Nature.” Place a small horizontal Austrian flag motif between the lines. The main image should be a breathtaking composite alpine lake scene at golden hour: on the left, a dramatic hilltop fortress resembling Salzburg Castle perched on a rocky cliff above the water; in the center distance, a calm reflective lake leading into a valley of towering snow-capped Alps; on the right, a picturesque Austrian lakeside village resembling Hallstatt with steep-roofed houses, a tall church spire, a hillside church, and clustered wooden buildings descending to the water. Warm sunlight from the left, crisp blue sky, glowing highlights on the mountains, rich reflections in the lake, romantic cinematic atmosphere, ultra-detailed, majestic and inviting. Along the lower middle, show exactly 5 gold icon-and-label tourism highlights spaced evenly: 1 castle icon with “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, 1 classical column icon with “RICH HERITAGE”, 1 music note icon with “VIBRANT CULTURE”, 1 heart icon with “WARM HOSPITALITY”, and 1 mountain icon with “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”. At the bottom, create a horizontal food strip with exactly 5 framed culinary photos separated by thin dividers under the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF AUSTRIA”. The 5 dishes are: Wiener Schnitzel, Appelstrudel, Kaiserschmarrn, Sachertorte, and Melange. Each food image should be realistic, warmly lit, plated attractively, and labeled in uppercase serif text beneath the image. Overall style: high-end European travel campaign poster, polished editorial design, romantic nostalgia, refined typography, harmonious gold and burgundy accents, photorealistic scenery blended with luxury brochure aesthetics.

items.title: Chibi Tetsuzankou Impact Attack
items.description: A high-energy chibi anime action scene of a red-haired girl delivering a dramatic shoulder strike, ideal for manga-style martial arts illustrations and comedic combat visuals.
items.content: A dynamic anime action illustration in a comedic chibi style, showing a tiny but fierce girl performing a powerful Chinese martial arts shoulder strike, tetsuzankou, into the side of a startled boy. The girl is the main focus: {argument name="character name" default="red-haired martial artist girl"}, with long vivid {argument name="hair color" default="crimson red"} hair streaming violently backward, sharp red eyes, and a determined angry expression. She is lunging from right to left at extreme speed, body low and compact, one shoulder and upper back driving into the boy’s torso, one fist pulled back and the other arm tucked for balance, with one knee bent forward and one leg trailing behind. She wears a short red Chinese-style qipao dress with gold floral embroidery, gold trim, side slit, and black flat shoes. The boy is a chibi black-haired teenager in a dark navy Chinese kung fu outfit with gold piping and black shoes, recoiling from the impact with a shocked open mouth, blank white eyes, sweat drops, and his body thrown backward to the left. Emphasize the exact moment of collision with a bright explosive impact burst at his side, flying debris, sparks, and strong speed-line distortion across the entire background. Add dust clouds and ground streaks near the girl’s trailing foot to show explosive forward momentum. Use a manga-inspired composition with exaggerated motion, foreshortening, and a diagonal rush from lower right to upper left. Include 3 large Japanese sound-effect text elements integrated into the art: one vertical right-side callout reading "鉄山靠!!", one smaller vertical annotation beside it reading "てつざんこう", and one large lower-left impact sound effect reading "ドガッ!!". The overall mood is fast, funny, aggressive, and high-impact, with polished modern anime rendering, glossy hair highlights, crisp line art, and dramatic red-white-black contrast.

items.title: Pastel Idol Portrait with Neon Heart
items.description: This prompt generates a dreamy kawaii idol-style portrait photo with elaborate pastel fashion styling, ideal for social media visuals, aesthetic branding, or character-inspired fashion art.

author.name: 神楽やよい【ブルベア】5/8ワンマン

items.content: A close-up upper-body portrait of a cute Japanese idol-style girl in an ultra-kawaii pastel bedroom, centered in frame, with her face hidden by a large solid rectangular censor block in a muted mauve-brown color. She has dark brown medium-length wavy hair in twin tails, decorated with 2 oversized translucent pink bows, pearl strands, ribbon streamers, and 2 dangling star charms. Her outfit is an extravagant yume-kawaii idol dress in shimmering {argument name="main colors" default="pink and lavender"}, with glossy satin fabric, lace trim, frilly off-shoulder sleeves, sheer ruffles, beadwork, tiny gem details, and a large jeweled heart brooch at the center of the chest. Include a lace camisole neckline underneath, a sparkly collar with tiny pastel charms, a ribbon bow near one curl that she gently holds with one hand, and matching frilled wrist cuffs. The background is a dreamy, heavily decorated kawaii room filled with soft fairy lights, pastel curtains, ribbons, bows, plush textures, and glowing decor. On the left side, add a pink neon heart sign with a bow outline containing the Japanese text {argument name="neon sign text" default="夢は叶えるもの"}. Use a soft-focus lens, glittery highlights, pearlescent textures, warm pink-purple ambient lighting, bokeh sparkles, and a vertical social-media photo composition. The overall mood is sweet, magical, idol-core, feminine, and hyper-detailed, like a pastel fashion photo taken in a decorated kawaii studio.

items.title: Gothic Idol Concert Selfie
items.description: A vertical close-up concert portrait of a gothic-style idol leaning into the camera, ideal for generating dramatic live-performance visuals or fan-focused promotional art.

author.name: 神楽やよい【ブルベア】5/8ワンマン

items.content: A dramatic close-up selfie-style stage photo of a Japanese idol performer leaning toward the camera from a low angle, filling most of the frame with her upper body and outstretched arm. She has long straight-to-wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark auburn brown"} hair with glossy highlights and heavy side-swept bangs partly covering one eye. Her expression is cute and intimate, with one hand near her mouth in a shy idol pose, as if interacting directly with fans during a live concert. She wears a dark gothic idol costume in black and deep {argument name="accent color" default="purple"}, featuring 5 clearly visible outfit elements: a shiny corset-style cropped top with metallic trim, a black belt at the waist with silver grommets, sheer black mesh opera-length gloves, multiple strapped arm bands on the upper arm, and draped silver chains across the bodice and skirt. Add glossy patent-leather textures, studs, buckles, lace, and layered frilled fabric for a high-detail J-pop or anisong concert look. The background is a large indoor live stage with bright blue-white spotlights, haze, truss rigging, and an LED screen glowing with soft abstract shapes, creating strong backlight and bokeh. Use cinematic concert photography, high contrast, cool-toned lighting with purple-blue highlights, shallow depth of field, slight lens distortion from the close arm’s-length perspective, dynamic foreshortening, and a vertical smartphone composition. Make the image feel energetic, glamorous, and fan-service oriented, like {argument name="idol group concept" default="a dark fantasy idol live performance"}.

items.title: Yami Kawaii Idol Selfie
items.description: This prompt generates a moody pink-and-black idol selfie portrait with yami-kawaii fashion and neon Japanese decor, ideal for social media-style character art.

author.name: 神楽やよい【ブルベア】5/8ワンマン

items.content: A close-up vertical selfie portrait of a {argument name="idol theme" default="dark yami-kawaii idol"} girl in a cramped neon-pink room, shot with her arm extended toward the camera so one glittery sleeve and hand blur large in the foreground. She wears a highly detailed black-and-hot-pink plaid stage outfit with glossy vinyl straps, lace trim, ribbons, buckles, and layered accessories: a sleeveless bodice, black fishnet detached sleeves, multiple black armbands on one upper arm, pink bows, and a heart-shaped chest badge that reads "病みかわいい". Her hair is dark brown, styled in a high bun with long straight sections framing the sides, decorated with a large ribbon. Her visible hand is posed near her lips in a coy idol gesture, wearing a frilly pink lace fingerless glove, long decorated nails, and chunky rings. Add a pink armband on the upper arm with handwritten Japanese text, and subtle earrings. The face is intentionally hidden by a large centered rectangular censor blur covering most of the face from forehead to chin. The background is dense and grungy, filled with black-and-pink graffiti, plastic curtains, plush toys, and distressed decor. Include exactly 4 visible Japanese text elements in the scene: graffiti on the left reading "闇ー?", graffiti below it reading "嫌いにならないで", graffiti further down reading "私だけ見ててね", and a glowing heart-shaped neon sign on the upper right reading "病みしか勝たん". Place 2 plush figures in the background: one pale pink stuffed animal on the left and one black plush with X eyes on the right. Lighting is moody club-style magenta and violet with glossy highlights, giving a chaotic underground idol dressing-room vibe. Ultra-detailed, flashy textures, glitter, lace, vinyl, messy cute-goth atmosphere, high contrast, smartphone selfie composition, portrait orientation.

items.title: Office Fashion Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a polished editorial magazine cover portrait of a stylish businesswoman in a modern office, ideal for fashion, branding, and workwear campaign visuals.
items.content: Luxury fashion magazine cover, vertical portrait, featuring a poised young professional woman seated in a black leather office chair in a modern high-rise office. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair styled in a sleek high ponytail with soft side bangs, and wears a fitted ribbed short-sleeve knit top in {argument name="top color" default="deep burgundy"}, a high-waisted pleated midi skirt in taupe-brown, and a delicate silver necklace with small key-like layered pendants. She sits with legs crossed, holding a slim tablet across her lap, looking calm, composed, and quietly powerful. The setting is a polished executive office with a wooden wall panel on the right, floor-to-ceiling glass behind her, a blurred meeting scene with 2 indistinct businesspeople visible through the glass on the left, and a desk edge in the lower left corner with an open laptop and stacked documents. Soft natural daylight, refined editorial styling, realistic fashion photography, warm neutral tones, subtle background blur, premium magazine aesthetic. Overlay elegant magazine typography: giant serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICIELLE"} across the top in ivory white, small subtitle below the left side reading "STYLE. CONFIDENCE. CAREER.", date at top right reading {argument name="cover date" default="MAY 2024"}. Add 5 cover lines total: left upper "DESK to DESTINY" with smaller subtext "Elevating everyday workwear with intent and ease.", left middle "POWER IN POISE" with smaller subtext "Refined staples and modern silhouettes for the woman who leads.", right middle "FOCUS & FLOW" with smaller subtext "Thoughtful style that keeps you confident from morning to night.", large bottom-left headline "MODERN ELEGANCE" with italic subheading "Polished looks. Purposeful days." and small text "Timeless style for the new generation of professionals.", and a circular badge at lower right containing "WORKWEAR EDIT" and smaller text "Burgundy tones, warm neutrals, effortless confidence." Clean balanced layout, upscale women’s fashion magazine cover, confident office-as-runway mood, highly realistic, sophisticated, cinematic softness.

items.title: Office Fashion Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a luxury editorial-style magazine cover featuring a stylish woman walking through a modern office, ideal for fashion branding, mock covers, and office-chic campaign visuals.
items.content: A high-fashion editorial magazine cover set inside a modern open-plan office, photographed in a polished realistic style with soft commercial lighting and a luxury fashion mood. Center the full-body figure of a tall slim East Asian businesswoman walking confidently down the aisle between desks as if on a runway, shoulders back, arms relaxed, gaze forward. She wears a fitted ribbed knit short-sleeve top in {argument name="top color" default="powder blue"}, tucked into a long high-waisted ribbed mermaid skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="white"}, with clean white pointed heels. Her hair is dark brown to black, styled in a high ponytail. The office around her is bright, elegant, and contemporary, with rows of desks on both sides, flat computer monitors, ergonomic white-and-gray office chairs, glass meeting room walls, warm wood panels, ceiling strip lights, and several blurred office workers seated and working, plus one suited figure standing in the background. Compose it like a premium fashion magazine cover with the woman dominating the center frame and the office receding in perspective behind her. Add large masthead text across the very top in oversized pale blue serif letters reading {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICESTYLE"}. Add small white cover line text near the upper left: {argument name="issue text" default="SUMMER 2024"}, and near the upper right: "FASHION & INSPIRATION". On the left side, place a large white serif headline broken over three lines: "Grace in Motion", with 2 smaller Japanese teaser blocks beneath it. On the lower left, add a blue serif subheadline: "Blue & White" with 2 lines of smaller Japanese text below. On the right side, add a white serif headline: "Modern Elegance" with 2 lines of smaller Japanese text below. In the lower right corner, place a large pale blue circle containing the white serif text "More inside" with 3 short lines of smaller Japanese teaser text beneath. Keep the overall palette airy and refined, dominated by blue, white, gray, and soft beige, with a clean magazine-cover layout, luxurious typography, subtle depth of field, and an aspirational office couture aesthetic.

Large brush-calligraphy headline at the top left: {argument name="headline text" default="五一出行计划"}. Directly below it, a green ribbon subtitle with white Chinese text: {argument name="route text" default="广州→湖南→武汉→北京"}. Add a smaller line of Chinese text under the subtitle: “一路向北·发现中国之美”. The background is a pale illustrated map of central and northern China in beige and light sage green, with faint mountain textures, soft rivers, and subtle floral decoration in the corners. A vertical curved railway line runs from the bottom center upward to the top center, connecting 4 cities with orange-red location pins and bold red Chinese city names. The 4 cities are, from bottom to top: 广州, 湖南, 武汉, 北京. Along the route, place small white high-speed train icons on the track and 3 green travel-time labels: “广州→湖南 高铁约2.5小时”, “湖南→武汉 高铁约1.5小时”, and “武汉→北京 高铁约4.5小时”. Near each city, include a scenic collage or illustrated landmark cluster: Guangzhou with a modern skyline and Canton Tower; Hunan with green mountains and cultural scenery; Wuhan with Yellow Crane Tower and historic architecture; Beijing with the Forbidden City / imperial palace architecture. Add small scenic tag labels near the city illustrations reading “花城广州·美食之都”, “山水湖南·人文荟萃”, “江城武汉·英雄之城”, and “中国首都·历史与现代交融”. Under the main title, show exactly 4 minimalist icon badges with short Chinese labels, evenly spaced in one row: a camera icon labeled “精选景点”, a train icon labeled “高铁直达”, a suitcase icon labeled “轻松出行”, and a star icon labeled “美食推荐”. Around the map, place 4 rounded rectangular itinerary cards with green headers, cream backgrounds, and photo thumbnails. Each card must contain day-by-day plans, a starred section for recommended attractions, and a starred section for recommended food. The 4 cards are: 1) top right card titled “北京｜2天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 2) right middle card titled “武汉｜1.5天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 3) left middle card titled “湖南｜2天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 4) bottom left card titled “广州｜1天”, with exactly 1 day row, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo. Fill the itinerary text with compact Chinese travel-plan copy in a practical social-media infographic style. At the lower right, add a rounded notes panel containing exactly 2 sections with green titles: “行程亮点” and “出行小贴士”. Under “行程亮点”, list exactly 4 bullet points with small icon markers. Under “出行小贴士”, list exactly 4 bullet points with small icon markers. Decorate the notes area with a small luggage illustration and a handwritten-style diagonal Chinese phrase in green, such as “出发吧！去感受春天的风景”. At the bottom center, place a small rounded summary bar titled “行程总览”, including exactly 4 summary items with icons: total duration “总时长：约6.5天”, total distance “总里程：约2100公里”, recommended transportation “推荐交通：高铁”, and best travel period “最佳出行时间：4.29 - 5.5”. In the bottom left foreground, place a large sleek white high-speed train angled diagonally upward, partially overlapping the border as a hero element. Add a calligraphic closing slogan near the train in Chinese: “最美的风景在路上 最好的时光在五一”. Use an elegant olive-green, sage, beige, and warm red palette, combining traditional Chinese travel-poster charm with modern infographic clarity, crisp typography, soft shadows, rounded cards, realistic photo inserts, and clean editorial layout.

items.title: Office Style Fashion Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a polished magazine-style editorial cover of a confident professional woman in a luxury office setting, ideal for fashion branding, mock covers, and corporate style campaigns.
items.content: A luxury fashion magazine cover photographed in a modern executive office, featuring a stylish young East Asian businesswoman standing beside a wooden desk in a confident editorial pose. She has long, smooth, dark brown to black hair parted slightly off center, falling over both shoulders, and wears a fitted ribbed knit short-sleeve top in {argument name="top color" default="deep navy"}, tucked into a high-waisted ribbed pencil skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="black"}. Add a delicate silver necklace with a small key pendant. Her body is angled slightly toward camera, with one hand lifted loosely near shoulder height and the other hand pointing down toward papers on the desk, conveying poised authority and effortless elegance. The setting is a refined corner office with warm wood bookshelves filled with books, a tufted brown leather executive chair, a polished wooden desk with neatly arranged documents and dark desk pads, and a tall window on the right revealing a soft blurred city skyline. Use soft natural daylight from the window mixed with warm interior tones, shallow depth of field, premium magazine photography, polished skin, realistic fabric texture, tasteful retouching, and a sophisticated editorial mood. Overlay elegant serif magazine typography: a very large masthead at the top left reading {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICE STYLE"}, small issue text at the top right reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY/JUN 2024 VOL.28"}, and 5 cover lines total: on the upper right, "Modern Professional Wardrobe" with the smaller subtext "Refined pieces for confident everyday elegance."; on the upper left, "THE POWER OF PRESENCE" with the smaller subtext "Style is not just what you wear—it's how you carry yourself."; on the left middle, "DESIGNED FOR IMPACT" with the smaller subtext "Clean silhouettes. Timeless colors. Endless possibilities."; across the lower left in very large serif type, {argument name="main cover line" default="CONFIDENT & CAPABLE"}; and on the lower right, "FOCUS ELEVATE ACHIEVE" with the smaller subtext "Professional style that moves with you.". Vertical portrait layout, high-end fashion magazine cover composition, clean spacing, muted luxury palette, realistic office styling, chic corporate femininity, confidence in motion.

items.title: Japanese Fashion Cover with Koinobori Dresses
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese magazine cover featuring two women in pastel carp-streamer-inspired couture, ideal for editorial fashion, seasonal campaigns, or mock magazine designs.
items.content: A fashion magazine cover styled like a luxurious Japanese women's magazine, photographed in soft natural daylight against a pale blue sky with a faint city skyline blurred in the background. The masthead is huge and elegant across the top, reading {argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"} in oversized soft pink serif lettering, with small Japanese cover text above and around it, plus a small issue marker on the upper right reading "5", "May 2026", and "No.218". Center the cover on exactly 2 young adult Japanese women standing close together from about thigh-up, facing camera in a poised editorial pose, with their faces intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman on the left wears a flowing pale blue dress inspired by koinobori carp streamers: high Mandarin-style collar, sleeveless inner dress, long sheer cape panels draping from the shoulders, elaborate layered metallic and satin fish-scale appliqué across the bodice, a large stylized fish eye motif on the chest, more scale detailing and fin-shaped ornamentation at the hip, and a cinched waist with decorative jeweled clasp. Her dark hair is in an elegant updo with loose wisps, and she wears dangling earrings. The woman on the right wears the same design concept in pale pink and white, also with a high collar, translucent cape-like side panels, layered fish-scale bodice, a visible fish eye motif near the waist sash, soft pleated skirt, tassel ornament at the belt, and matching dangling earrings; her dark hair is also swept into a refined updo with a few loose strands. The overall styling is airy, graceful, feminine, and sophisticated, mixing traditional Japanese elegance with modern couture. Use a pastel palette dominated by baby blue, blush pink, white, and subtle gold trim, with bright but diffused lighting and a premium glossy magazine editorial finish. Include visible Japanese cover lines arranged like a real magazine layout: one left-side block introducing the cover girls, one large main headline block across the lower half, one right-side vertical cluster of smaller teaser text, and exactly 2 pale blue circular callout badges on the right side containing Japanese text; the upper badge advertises a special appendix gift set and includes exactly 2 small product images of pouch-like accessories, and the lower badge contains a shopping-plan checklist with exactly 3 checkbox lines. Add a small pink ribbon-like label above the main headline. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and seasonally themed around Golden Week and koinobori fashion.

items.title: Japanese Koinobori Fashion Magazine Cover
items.description: A luxury Japanese women's magazine cover featuring two models in koi streamer-inspired outfits, ideal for editorial fashion spreads and mock magazine covers.
items.content:
A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover photographed in a bright, airy outdoor setting with a pale blue sky and softly blurred modern railing in the background, portrait orientation. The masthead is enormous across the top in elegant soft pink serif letters reading "L’Allure", with small Japanese text above it and a bracketed Japanese subtitle at the top right. The issue information appears on the upper left as a large black "5" with smaller stacked text beside and below it indicating May 2026, No.156, and a May 2026 issue line. The cover features two adult East Asian women standing side by side from about mid-thigh upward, posed like a luxury editorial cover. Their faces are intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. Lighting is soft, natural, and flattering, with a refined premium magazine aesthetic.

The woman on the left wears a navy blouse with dramatic koi-scale sleeves in navy, white, and silver, styled with a bow or scarf-like neckline, tucked into a long flowing off-white skirt with a wide waistband. She carries 1 fish-shaped handbag: a navy and cream koi-inspired purse with a round eye detail, scale pattern, tail fin silhouette, gold hardware, and a thin chain strap hanging from her hand. Her hair is dark brown to black, loosely tied in a low messy bun with soft strands framing her face. Her pose is elegant and slightly angled, one hand near her chin.

The woman on the right wears a crisp white blouse with a soft bow-tie or vertical ruffle/placket detail at the front, paired with a striking koi-inspired skirt or dress panel featuring 2 main colors, coral pink and deep blue, with layered fish-scale motifs and a circular eye-like ornament at the waist. She holds 1 structured handbag: a rectangular white bag with coral pink koi face paneling, blue accents, gold hardware, top handles, and a shoulder strap. Her dark hair is tied back in a low ponytail. She stands facing slightly left with relaxed hands and a calm editorial expression implied by pose.

The fashion concept is themed around koi streamers and carp motifs, transforming traditional Japanese koinobori imagery into sophisticated contemporary womenswear. The palette is soft sky blue, blush pink, navy, white, cream, and coral red. Fabrics appear smooth, elegant, and lightly flowing, with printed or embroidered scale patterns. The overall mood is graceful, feminine, seasonal, and upscale, balancing tradition with modern fashion.

Add multiple Japanese cover lines in a realistic editorial layout. On the left side, include 4 grouped text blocks: 1 feature header in red and black about moody carp streamer fashion, 1 smaller blue subhead about inheriting traditional beauty with a fresh elegance balance, 1 black text block about basics and updates for women in their twenties, and 1 blue makeup feature line about translucent early-summer makeup. On the right side, include 3 grouped text blocks: 1 red "Cover Story" heading with larger black Japanese headline text beneath, 1 blue text block about conservative style that shines in fresh greenery, and 1 pink boxed reader gift notice with black Japanese text below about luxury brand new bags and accessories. Near the lower left, place 1 circular pink badge with white and cream Japanese text about a special walking guide supplement. Across the lower center, place a large dramatic Japanese main headline in pink and black serif and brush-style type, spanning most of the width.

Design this as a realistic premium women’s fashion magazine cover for {argument name="magazine name" default="L’Allure"}, themed around {argument name="fashion theme" default="koinobori-inspired spring fashion"}, featuring {argument name="issue month" default="May 2026"}. Keep the text predominantly in Japanese, the masthead in large pink serif type, and the composition clean, aspirational, and luxurious.

items.title: Otaku-Friendly Gyaru in Sunset Classroom
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style portrait of a kind gyaru schoolgirl in a sunlit classroom, ideal for nostalgic social media art and character illustrations.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAIイラストレーター

items.content: A warm, golden-hour anime illustration of a fashionable high school gyaru girl standing in an empty classroom, leaning slightly forward between wooden desks with one hand resting on a desk and the other tucked into her cardigan pocket. She has long, voluminous wavy {argument name="hair color" default="bleached blonde"} hair with soft shine and layered strands, a trendy, approachable gal aesthetic, and multiple ear piercings with delicate jewelry. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat square censor block in the center of the image. She wears a Japanese school uniform consisting of 4 visible outfit pieces: a loose cream-beige cardigan with buttons, a white shirt with the collar open, a large navy plaid ribbon bow, and a short dark plaid pleated skirt. Add subtle accessories including 2 necklaces and manicured nails. The classroom is lit by strong sunset light streaming from tall windows on the left, casting long warm shadows across the desks, floor, and her clothes. In the background, show a green chalkboard with handwritten Japanese farewell-style messages including "ありがとう♡" and "ございました!", plus a few small doodles, and several neatly arranged desks and chairs. The mood should be soft, nostalgic, flirtatious, and kindhearted, capturing the feeling of an otaku-friendly gal after school. Highly detailed anime painting, soft rim light, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, polished linework, luminous hair highlights, realistic fabric folds, and a vertical portrait framing.

items.title: Sparkling Anime Idol Concert Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style virtual idol performance illustration, ideal for VTuber promo art, music visuals, or celebratory character posters.
items.content: A dazzling anime idol concert illustration of a single female virtual singer performing center stage, shown in a dynamic medium full-body shot from slightly below, with one hand holding a microphone near her chest and the other arm reaching outward toward the viewer. She has extremely long, voluminous twin tails that flow dramatically across the entire composition, in a soft peach-blonde to pink gradient with glossy highlights and curled ends, plus a teal futuristic headband and matching ear-cover accessories. Her face is intentionally obscured by a simple square censor block in a muted beige-pink tone. She wears a vivid turquoise-blue idol dress with a glossy, jewel-like finish, a fitted bodice, white frilled cap sleeves, a white sailor-style collar, a large red bow at the chest set with a blue gem, gold chain ornaments and gold buttons at the waist, and a layered flared skirt with white ruffles underneath and thin pink stripe accents near the hem. Add long flowing red ribbon tails streaming from the waist and costume, black thigh-high stockings, and a gold-and-teal handheld microphone. The stage is a spectacular futuristic arena packed with a glowing audience of blue and purple penlights, surrounded by intense sparkling bokeh, glitter, confetti pieces, lens flares, and star-like light bursts. Fill the background with curved luminous stage structures, neon arcs, and multiple pink, purple, and blue spotlights crisscrossing overhead, creating a magical high-energy live-show atmosphere. The art style is polished modern anime key visual, ultra-detailed, glossy painterly rendering, radiant lighting, shimmering highlights on fabric and hair, saturated cyan-magenta palette, celebratory and emotional idol performance energy.

items.title: Kawaii Street Fashion Duo Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a stylish two-girl urban fashion portrait with Japanese streetwear and graffiti-wall atmosphere, ideal for trendy social media art and lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A candid street-fashion portrait of two cute anime-inspired girls standing close together in front of a colorful urban graffiti wall on a city sidewalk in Japan, photographed at eye level with a shallow depth of field and soft overcast daylight. Both have smooth pale skin and short blunt bob haircuts with straight ends, their bangs covering part of the forehead, and their faces intentionally simplified or blurred for an anonymous doll-like look. The girl on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="silver gray"} hair, wears a black knit beanie with a rectangular patch logo reading "Nightfall", a black leather jacket over a white graphic T-shirt with a dark distressed illustration and purple accent graphic, layered silver chain necklaces including a heart pendant, a black choker, and a black backpack strap over one shoulder. The girl on the right has icy light blue hair, wears a black knit beanie with a white scribble-style logo, an oversized black hoodie with bold hot-pink Japanese graffiti lettering across the chest, a silver chain necklace, and black backpack straps on both shoulders. They lean in slightly toward each other in a relaxed, stylish pose, with one hand lightly touching the hoodie shoulder area. The background is a vivid mural wall in pink, blue, and purple tones, plus a sticker-covered utility pole on the right edge with visible layered street stickers including "SMILE", "AQUARIUS", and a red "HELLO my name is" sticker covered in tags. Emphasize Japanese street style, alternative fashion, kawaii cool mood, realistic fabric textures, crisp clothing detail, subtle cinematic color grading, and a trendy Harajuku snapshot aesthetic.

items.content: A simple centered full-body illustration of a cute chibi {argument name="animal type" default="rabbit"} character on a plain {argument name="background color" default="light gray"} background, drawn in a flat cartoon style with thick clean black outlines and minimal shading. The character has a white body, a large rounded head, 2 tall upright ears with bright cyan inner ear shapes, 2 large oval eyes with cyan irises, black pupils, and small highlights, tiny curved eyebrows, a small red-pink nose area, and a slight smiling mouth. The pose is front-facing with both arms stretched straight out horizontally to the sides, legs apart in a simple standing pose, and a short fluffy tail visible on the right side of the body as a curved semicircle made of short black dash marks. Overlay a clear OpenPose-style skeleton marker system on top of the character: 2 purple eye keypoints, 1 red nose keypoint, 1 blue neck keypoint, 2 shoulder keypoints, 2 elbow keypoints, 2 wrist keypoints, 1 yellow spine or pelvis center point, 2 hip keypoints, 2 knee keypoints, and 2 ankle keypoints, for a total of 17 colored points connected by thin colored lines across the face, shoulders, torso, arms, and legs. Use vivid point colors including purple, magenta, red, blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange, and teal so the pose overlay is clearly visible. Keep the composition vertically centered, symmetrical, clean, and diagram-like, with the cute mascot character and pose-estimation overlay as the sole subject.

items.title: Shiba Inu Space Dream Poster
items.description: A cinematic Japanese poster featuring a business-suited Shiba Inu, self-help books, and a surreal path from office burnout to space-bound dreams, ideal for inspirational social media art or parody account posters.

author.name: たかお文島 | Kindle作家 | 文鳥ではなく"ふみしま"です

items.content: A dramatic Japanese motivational movie-poster style illustration set at dusk, mixing corporate burnout and hopeful space-dream fantasy. In the center foreground, an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu with warm tan fur smiles confidently at the viewer, wearing a sharp navy business suit, white dress shirt, and blue striped tie. The dog holds a black e-reader in the left paw with the screen text “kindle” and a black-and-gold fountain pen in the right paw. Behind the character, the background is split into two thematic halves that blend together: on the left, a dense Tokyo-like city skyline at sunset with Tokyo Tower glowing orange, dark office buildings, and exhausted salary workers at desks under a stressful atmosphere; on the right, a deep starry cosmos with blue nebulae, a rocket launching upward, 3 airplanes, a winding glowing golden trajectory line, 1 small planet, 2 floating paw prints, 2 packaged breads labeled “カンパン,” and 1 round biscuit labeled “南部せんべい.” Near the right lower background, show a family of 4 from behind walking toward the bright horizon with a dog, symbolizing hope and future dreams. Add 3 black signboards floating in the left midground with the Japanese words “残業,” “プレッシャー,” and “会議 満員電車.” In the foreground on a wooden desk, place exactly 3 prominently displayed books standing upright: book 1 on the left is white and blue with the title “忙しい社会人のやり直し英語勉強法” and a small illustrated author portrait; book 2 in the center is dark blue and gold with the large title “『あたりまえ』を続けることは 最強の生存戦略である”; book 3 on the right is white and blue with the title “『すぐやる』は最速の仕事術” and a large “5” plus a circular “5 MIN” icon. Also on the desk, include 1 black coffee mug with the text “未来は 5分で変わる,” 1 spiral notebook opened flat with a handwritten to-do list in Japanese reading “今日やること ① ブログを書く（5分） ② 家族と過ごす（大切） ③ 未来を信じる（ワクワク）” plus a paw-print doodle, 1 black fountain pen lying beside it, 1 globe on a stand at the far right, 1 plate of crackers, 1 extra packaged “カンパン,” and small framed photos at the lower left edge. At the top, large luxurious gold Japanese headline text reads “{argument name="headline text" default="5分で宇宙へ！"}” with a smaller gold subtitle beneath: “〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物語〜”. Below that, centered white copy reads “忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、夢は本気で掴んだ。” At the bottom center, add a cinematic English tagline: “Based on a true story of たかお柴犬” and beneath it “A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams”. Use ultra-detailed glossy poster rendering, warm orange sunset versus cool blue space contrast, inspirational commercial key art, sharp typography, rich cinematic lighting, whimsical but sincere tone, highly polished social-media poster composition, vertical format.

items.title: Romantic Tokyo Couple Photo Collage
items.description: Generates a nostalgic 12-panel collage of intimate candid couple moments in Tokyo, ideal for moodboards, social-media aesthetic visuals, or romantic lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A moody 4-by-3 photo collage made of 12 candid smartphone-style snapshots of a young couple during summer nights in Tokyo, shot with a nostalgic film look, soft grain, muted colors, slight blur, low contrast, dim ambient street lighting, and intimate casual framing. The overall tone is romantic, youthful, private, and documentary-like, with a warm gray-brown palette and a slightly desaturated teal-orange night city atmosphere. The man has messy dark hair, a slim build, and wears a dark overshirt or lightweight jacket over a white T-shirt; the woman has long dark brown hair, a slim build, and wears a white sleeveless top with thin black shoulder straps from a bag. In every panel, both faces are intentionally obscured by large soft-edged blur blocks for anonymity. Include exactly 12 images arranged in a tight seamless grid: top row panel 1, an extreme close-up side profile of the man at night; panel 2, the woman taking a mirror or phone selfie while standing beside the man outdoors at night; panel 3, the couple pressed close together near a street sign with Japanese text; panel 4, the couple kissing at a busy crosswalk in the city. Middle row panel 5, a pavement shadow photo of two people, one making a peace sign; panel 6, the couple standing close on a sidewalk in an urban shopping street; panel 7, a sunset skyline over water with Tokyo Tower visible, no people; panel 8, a high-angle shot looking down on the woman and the man close together on stairs or a walkway. Bottom row panel 9, a tight intimate close-up of the couple touching faces or kissing; panel 10, the man adjusting or touching the woman's hair on a city street; panel 11, the couple riding together on a scooter or motorcycle, both wearing helmets, captured in motion blur; panel 12, the couple embracing against a pale blue sky, framed from the shoulders up. Backgrounds should include Japanese city streets, storefronts, crosswalks, signage, buildings, night traffic, and urban evening ambience. Keep the composition casual and imperfect like real memories, with varied crops, soft focus, motion blur, and authentic handheld phone photography.

items.title: Gothic Anime Girl with Black Roses
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic red-and-black gothic anime portrait, ideal for character art, profile images, or dark fantasy illustration concepts.
items.content: A dark anime gothic portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up, centered in the frame, with long layered {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair in messy twin tails and loose strands falling over the shoulders. She wears two large black ribbon-and-lace hair ornaments, a black gothic dress with voluminous sleeves and delicate lace trim, black lace fingerless gloves, and a black leather choker with a buckle. Around her neck are 2 layered silver chain necklaces, one ending in a prominent cross pendant. items.title: Cinematic Couple Memory Collage
items.description: A 12-photo nostalgic collage of a young couple's candid urban moments, ideal for generating moodboards, album-cover visuals, or romantic lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A 4x3 photo collage of 12 cinematic, nostalgic snapshots of a young Japanese couple in everyday life, shot like candid film photography with soft blur, muted colors, grain, bloom, and shallow depth of field. The overall mood is intimate, wistful, urban, and slightly melancholic, with a warm-and-cool mixed color palette and natural imperfect composition. Include 12 distinct photos: 1) a close nighttime portrait on a city street, one person in a scarf, face partially obscured, surrounded by glowing bokeh lights; 2) the couple sitting closely together on a train at night, leaning on each other, quiet and sleepy; 3) a rear three-quarter view of one person walking alone on a city street at night with traffic lights and storefront bokeh; 4) a rooftop or elevated outdoor portrait at dusk or early morning, one person turning back toward camera with windblown hair and a jacket; 5) a bright daytime suburban street snapshot with one person standing near a hedge, casual and slightly overexposed; 6) a very close, dimly lit selfie-like frame of the couple together indoors or at night, both faces soft and out of focus; 7) the couple seated side by side on a beach watching the sunset over the ocean, seen from behind; 8) the couple talking across a small table inside a cozy izakaya or retro restaurant with posters and warm tungsten lighting; 9) a cramped candid indoor or transit photo with one person slumped or resting, heavy motion blur and dark green tones; 10) the couple standing face to face in a narrow alley at night, surrounded by lantern light and vertical Japanese signs; 11) a quiet cropped detail shot of intertwined hands and draped clothing while sitting outdoors beside pavement; 12) a night portrait with one person against a background of tall city buildings and colorful defocused lights. Keep all 12 images borderless in a seamless grid, with slight variation in framing and exposure, as if taken over many dates and ordinary moments. Use {argument name="film style" default="moody 35mm film"}, {argument name="couple age" default="early 20s"}, {argument name="city" default="Tokyo"}, {argument name="season" default="autumn"}, and {argument name="overall mood" default="romantic nostalgia"}.

items.title: Photoreal librarian presenting AI book
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic commercial-style portrait of a librarian-like woman presenting an AI-themed book, suitable for promotional book ads or social media marketing visuals.
items.content: A photorealistic vertical promotional portrait in a cozy modern library or bookstore interior, showing a young East Asian woman standing behind a wooden counter and presenting a large book toward the camera. She has long straight dark brown hair parted near the center, small delicate earrings, and a neat, friendly, professional appearance. She wears a white button-up shirt, a muted green striped necktie, and a beige apron tied at the waist with a stitched name patch reading “Librarian Ai-chan” and a small open-book icon. Her left hand holds the book upright at chest height, angled slightly toward the viewer, while her right hand is open beneath it in a classic product-introduction gesture. The book is the clear focal point: a glossy dark cover with dramatic orange title text reading “Pollo AI” twice, one large at the top and one glowing near the center over a cinematic landscape image, plus smaller Japanese subtitle and feature text and a circular P-style logo near the lower left. Place a transparent acrylic desk sign on the left side of the counter with Japanese text above and the large name “Ai-chan” below. On the right side of the counter, stack exactly 3 hardcover books horizontally, each with numbered spine labels and Japanese titles. In the softly blurred background, include a tall wooden bookshelf on the left with books, small potted plants, and a warm lamp; a framed wall poster on the upper right with Japanese writing; and a leafy indoor plant on the far right. Add a small white “Pollo.ai” watermark in the top-right corner. Use warm ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, soft beige and wood tones, realistic skin and fabric texture, clean commercial composition, and the polished look of a professional lifestyle advertisement for a book or AI-related publication. Keep the framing from mid-thigh to above the head in a portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.

Emphasize shimmering wet surfaces, refracted light, sparkling rain streaks, reflective glass, and a slightly overbright iridescent glow.
