items.title: Japanese Gourmet Curry Ad Layout
items.description: This prompt turns a reference photo of homemade curry into a premium Japanese restaurant-style editorial advertisement page for menus, promos, or social posts.

author.name: 大橋一慶（7月に新刊でます）

items.content: Using the provided reference image of the curry in the pan, transform it into a polished Japanese gourmet magazine advertisement page for {argument name="dish name" default="キーマカレー"}. Keep the curry recognizable as the same dish, but restyle it as a premium food photograph served in a rustic ceramic bowl on a wooden tabletop, with richer gloss, deeper color contrast, and more appetizing texture. Create a full editorial layout with 3 main content areas: 1) a large hero section at the top featuring the plated curry on the right and Japanese promotional copy on the left, including a small top banner label and a large headline; 2) a bottom-left chef profile area with 1 portrait of a chef in dark workwear and apron, arms crossed in a restaurant kitchen, plus vertical Japanese copy and a handwritten-style name caption; 3) a bottom-right information area containing 1 quote block and 1 framed “secret of deliciousness” panel with exactly 3 numbered steps, each paired with a food or cooking image. Add warm ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, spices and garlic props around the hero dish, and an upscale traditional restaurant branding feel. Include Japanese text throughout, with the main headline emphasizing slow-cooked, exquisite curry, and use elegant Mincho-style typography in brown, cream, and gold tones. The final composition should look like a high-end restaurant feature article or promotional brochure page.

items.title: Retro Sci-Fi Heroine With Police
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic cinematic portrait of a worn armored heroine holding her helmet while being confronted by two police officers, useful for tokusatsu-inspired editorial or film-still imagery.
items.content: A realistic live-action style photo of a young Japanese woman in worn retro-futuristic tokusatsu-style power armor, standing outdoors between 2 female police officers in dark navy uniforms. The armored woman is centered in a medium shot from about thigh to head, facing forward, while the 2 officers are shown in partial side profile at the left and right edges of the frame, turned toward her as if questioning or surrounding her. The main subject wears glossy red and silver metal armor with visible scratches, chipped paint, and slight grime, including oversized rounded shoulder plates, a silver chest plate with asymmetrical panel lines and 1 large circular blue orb on the right side of the chest, black flexible under-suit sleeves, a white neck seal, and 2 short ribbed hose-like tubes rising from the collar to the shoulders. She has short dark brown to black bobbed hair peeking out above the armor and holds 1 matching red helmet with a black visor and silver trim in both hands at waist level. The 2 police officers wear plain dark navy jackets; the left officer has a visible shoulder patch, and both have black hair tied back in neat low buns. Set the scene against a gray urban concrete wall with soft daylight, shallow depth of field, and a muted documentary cinematic look. Composition should feel candid and tense, like a behind-the-scenes arrest or inspection of a sci-fi heroine. items.title: Elegant Oni Warrior Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style full-body portrait of a horned oni woman in ceremonial kimono attire, ideal for character art, posters, or fantasy-themed key visuals.
items.content: A refined anime illustration of a tall adult oni woman in a calm, elegant full-body portrait, standing in three-quarter view with her hands folded over the pommel of a large upright sword. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair flowing past her knees, pale skin, pointed elf-like ears, narrow crimson eyes, and two smooth curved red horns rising from her forehead. Her expression is cool, aloof, and slightly melancholic. She wears a {argument name="outfit style" default="white ceremonial kimono with black and red accents"}: a fitted white dress-like inner layer with a deep neckline, a black obi and layered waist ornaments, a translucent patterned outer robe with subtle geometric motifs, wide sleeves lined in red, and a short skirt hem decorated with smoky dark flame shapes. Her forearms are covered in polished silver armor gauntlets, adding a warrior feel. The sword is oversized and heavy, planted vertically before her, with a black blade and hilt, metallic guard, and vivid glowing red flame-like patterns running down the center. The composition is graceful and balanced, mixing Japanese traditional aesthetics with dark fantasy. The background is a soft pale lavender-gray decorative collage with a circular window framing Mount Fuji and a winding river landscape, delicate floral silhouettes and blooming branches, abstract cloud motifs, hanging tassel ornaments, geometric textile patterns, and a red sun-like circle on the right. Use muted whites, lilacs, gray-violets, black, and deep crimson as the main palette. Add subtle paper texture, clean linework, soft cel shading, delicate highlights, and an ornate high-detail anime style. Make the overall mood serene, noble, mystical, and slightly ominous, like {argument name="character name" default="Oni Alter"} in a luxurious Japanese fantasy key visual.

items.title: Retro Fake Anime Movie Poster
items.description: A dramatic fictional Japanese anime film poster featuring a girl, a glowing smartphone, and explosive time-travel energy, ideal for parody cinema key art or nostalgic promotional designs.
items.content: A retro Japanese movie poster for a fictional anime film, designed like an overdramatic 1980s to 1990s theatrical poster with intentionally tacky but charming pulp energy. The scene shows a teenage girl manga artist in a dim wooden Japanese room at night, seated on the floor beside a low desk covered with scattered manuscript pages, pens, ink, books, and drawing tools. She has messy dark shoulder-length hair blown by supernatural force, a cream-beige long-sleeve blouse with loose ruffles, and a dark plaid skirt. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She stretches one arm upward, holding a glowing {argument name="device type" default="smartphone"} toward a shattered window as a blinding explosion of light and lightning bursts through the glass, illuminating the whole room with gold-white energy. Outside the window is deep blue night with stormlike streaks and electric cracks. The composition is dynamic and diagonal, with the raised arm and device pointing into the central blast. Use painterly anime key art styling, dramatic rim light, textured film-poster shading, rich teal, navy, amber, and crimson colors, and a nostalgic hand-painted cinema-poster feel. Fill the poster with bold Japanese promotional copy in multiple blocks on the left side, including exaggerated red and yellow emphasis marks and three small cartoon reaction faces of a classic manga boy character. Add a vertical Japanese tagline on the right side. Place an enormous stylized Japanese title across the lower middle in red and blue metallic gradient lettering with sharp highlights and heavy shadow, reading {argument name="title text" default="トキヲ描ける少女"}. Include a cream starburst badge near the lower right with more Japanese text and a small manga face. At the lower left, add a large release date block in Japanese with bright yellow numerals and white text, defaulting to {argument name="release date" default="2025年 7月18日(金)"}. Along the bottom edge, add exactly 6 small rectangular film-strip preview stills from the movie. Add small production credits in Japanese and English across the bottom center, including {argument name="studio name" default="Building Fictions"}. Make the whole layout feel like a fake time-travel comedy anime poster set in 1935, loud, nostalgic, cinematic, and slightly cheesy in the best possible way.

items.title: Manga Cover With Bass Girl and Designer Boy
items.description: This prompt generates a colorful Japanese manga-style cover featuring a punk girl with a bass guitar and a creative boy with a tablet, ideal for comic, light novel, or character-driven promotional art.
items.content: A vibrant Japanese comic-style cover illustration with two anime characters standing side by side against a split pink-and-blue pop graphic background filled with stars, dots, music notes, hearts, spark lines, and playful doodles. At the top, place a huge bold Japanese title in thick black and brown kanji with white outline and pink shadow reading 夜坂さんと茶藤くん, arranged in an energetic layered composition inside a fluffy cloud-like title shape. The left half of the background is pink and the right half is light blue, with a diagonal dividing rhythm and decorative manga-cover accents. Show exactly 2 characters from about mid-thigh up. On the left is a rebellious teenage girl with a straight black bob haircut and blunt bangs, pale skin, punk-rock fashion, and a slightly annoyed withdrawn pose with one hand near her mouth. She wears an oversized black zip hoodie over a red-and-black horizontal striped shirt, a red plaid pleated skirt, fishnet stockings, and a black heart-shaped choker. She holds a black electric bass guitar vertically across her body, with visible tuning pegs, strings, pickups, and chrome hardware. On the right is a cheerful teenage boy with messy light brown hair, fair skin, and a friendly expressive pose. He wears a white button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a fitted black vest with a small emblem on the chest, and black slacks. He holds a stylus pen near his face in one hand and a dark drawing tablet tucked in the other arm. Add exactly 2 vertical Japanese speech balloons: on the left, うるさいのはキライ。 in a pink outlined balloon; on the right, そのセンスもっとみんなに届けたいです… in a blue outlined balloon. Include small floating icons between and around them: exactly 2 black music notes, 2 pink hearts, 2 blue stars, and a few curved arrows and spark marks suggesting lively chemistry. The overall style is polished modern manga cover art, clean linework, glossy shading, expressive character design, bright pastel pop palette, high detail, commercial light novel or comic serialization cover aesthetic.

items.title: Embarrassed Anime Girl on Tiny Stool
items.description: This prompt generates a cute pastel anime reaction scene of a flustered girl being teased about her posture in a cozy streamer bedroom, ideal for VTuber-style fanart or comedic character illustrations.
items.content: A soft pastel anime illustration in a cute VTuber fanart style, showing a shy petite teenage girl with light brown hair in two short braids, fluffy bangs, a small ahoge, and tiny hair clips including a heart-shaped clip. She has large warm brown eyes, a deeply embarrassed expression, flushed cheeks, teary sweat drops, and a small trembling mouth. She is sitting hunched awkwardly on a tiny wooden stool in the center of a cozy streamer bedroom, knees together, hands clenched nervously in her lap, clearly self-conscious about her posture. She wears an oversized cream hoodie, a dark short skirt, black socks, and black low-top sneakers with white laces. From the left edge of the frame, only one large hand and forearm in a dark blue sleeve enters the scene, pointing at her accusingly or teasingly. Add comic-style stress symbols around the girl: 1 red scribble frustration cloud near her head, 2 wavy trembling marks near her body, and 6 blue sweat-drop marks floating around her. On the lower right, include 1 white speech bubble with Japanese text that reads "あうぅ…！姿勢…悪い？". The background is a softly lit pastel room with a cream beanbag chair on the left, a bookshelf filled with books, small figures, plush toys, and framed items, and on the right a desk with 1 monitor, 1 PC tower, and 1 microphone arm. Add wall art and character sketches behind the desk, a pink blanket draped over furniture on the far right, a pale rug on a wooden floor, and warm indoor lighting. Use a gentle pink-beige color palette, clean line art, subtle cel shading, slightly chibi proportions, and a wholesome but comedic embarrassed mood.

できます。"}. Beneath it, add 1 subheadline line in white reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="楽天専用 A/Bテスト自動化ツール"}, accented by a thin cyan underline. items.title: Enchanted Gothic Study Interior
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic fantasy library-study room with ornate furniture and magical blue-violet lighting, ideal for background art, concept design, or atmospheric scene creation.
items.content: A lavish fantasy gothic study interior, shown as a wide symmetrical room shot with no people present. In the center, place an ornate dark wooden writing desk with carved details, an open book, loose papers, an ink bottle, a quill, and exactly 2 small stacks of books on top, with a tall throne-like upholstered chair behind it in deep blue-gray velvet and intricate baroque trim. Overhead, include exactly 3 hanging light fixtures: 1 crystal chandelier with glowing candles in the center, 1 dark metal lantern on the upper left, and 1 warm amber pendant lamp on the upper right. On the left side of the room, add a tall carved bookshelf packed with books and curios, a small side table with papers and objects, and a tall arched stained-glass window casting cool blue light. On the right side, add an ornate carved architectural alcove or fireplace-like structure, a plush vintage sofa in dusty teal with 2 throw pillows, and a candelabra with lit candles. Use a richly decorated old mansion or magical library setting with stone walls, carved wood, antique furniture, and layered decorative clutter. The floor should be covered by a large patterned rug leading toward the desk. Light the scene with a dramatic mix of cool moonlit blue and glowing violet-magenta ambient haze, plus warm candlelight highlights, creating an enchanted, mysterious, cinematic atmosphere. Ultra-detailed, painterly 3D fantasy illustration, soft volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, luminous bloom, high detail textures, centered composition, elegant, whimsical, magical, storybook realism.

items.title: Crimson Dark Sorceress Ritual
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic dark-fantasy character poster of a floating sorceress silhouetted against a glowing red magic circle, ideal for gothic concept art or cinematic cover imagery.
items.content: A dark fantasy illustration of a single floating woman centered in the frame, shown as a near-black silhouette against an intense glowing crimson background. She hovers a little above a reflective black-red water surface, barefoot, with both arms relaxed and slightly extended downward, fingers softly spread, her posture calm but powerful. Her very long {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair streams dramatically to the left in wild windblown tendrils, and her gown is a shredded, smoky, semi-translucent {argument name="dress color" default="black"} dress with layered ribbons and torn fabric trailing downward into shadowy wisps. Behind her is one enormous ornate circular magic sigil, perfectly framing her body like a halo, rendered in intricate gothic filigree, concentric rings, and arcane lace-like geometry, glowing bright blood red with a hot white-red core. The entire scene is dominated by a black and deep red palette, with swirling smoke, embers, and magical energy filling the air. At the lower left and lower right edges are 2 clusters of sharp red crystals emerging from darkness. The bottom of the image shows one glossy reflective pool with rippling crimson highlights mirroring the light above. Make the atmosphere infernal, mystical, and regal, as if {argument name="character role" default="a dark sorceress"} is awakening in a forbidden ritual chamber. High contrast, cinematic backlighting, volumetric glow, ultra-detailed digital painting, vertical composition, centered symmetrical framing, ominous elegance, no text, no extra characters, no visible facial details.

items.title: Okinawa Summer Travel Banner
items.description: A bright Japanese travel-agency promotional banner for Okinawa, suitable for summer tour ads, website hero images, and campaign marketing.
items.content:
Create a polished Japanese travel agency summer banner ad for Okinawa in a bright, inviting commercial style. Use a wide horizontal layout with a vivid tropical beach scene as the full background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand shoreline, small green island in the mid distance, deep blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, and palm leaves hanging in from the upper right corner. On the right foreground, place 1 traditional Okinawan shisa lion-dog statue sitting on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus flowers and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, include 1 small glass-bottom sightseeing boat floating close to shore. Add 2 small simple fish doodle icons over the sea.

Make the typography the hero element. Across the left-center to center, place very large Japanese calligraphic headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="夏の沖縄"}, with a blue gradient and white glow or soft outline, highly legible and elegant. Above it, add a handwritten-style Japanese catchphrase in blue reading {argument name="catchphrase" default="青い海、青い空、心ほどける島時間。"} with a loose underline flourish. Under the main headline, add a smaller Japanese subheading reading {argument name="subheading" default="感動の景色と、あたたかいおもてなしに出会う旅へ。"}.

In the upper left, add a circular summer badge with a sunburst feel, soft cream background, tiny wave lines, a small hibiscus accent, and Japanese text reading "この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!". Decorate the headline area with 1 pink hibiscus flower on the left and subtle ocean-wave graphic strokes.

Along the lower middle, place 3 rounded white feature cards in a row, partially overlapping the beach scene. Count and depict all 3 cards clearly: the first card shows a sea turtle swimming underwater in a circular photo, with Japanese heading "美しい自然を満喫" and smaller body text about transparent waters and scenic spots; the second card shows a bowl of Okinawa soba in a circular photo, with heading "沖縄グルメを堪能" and smaller body text mentioning 沖縄そば and ゴーヤチャンプルー; the third card shows Shuri Castle in a circular photo, with heading "観光スポットも充実" and smaller body text mentioning 美ら海水族館 and 首里城. Add small coral, shell, hibiscus, and starfish decorations around these cards.

On the right lower-middle, overlap the beach with 1 tilted circular promotional sticker in pale blue and cream, with a small yellow tab on top. The yellow tab says "早めの予約がおトク!" and the main circle says "夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!". Add a white plumeria flower accent near the sticker.

Create a full-width dark blue footer bar across the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place a white travel company logo icon and company name text {argument name="company name" default="〇〇旅行株式会社"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline below. Across the center of the footer, place exactly 3 circular line-icons with short Japanese captions: 1 calendar icon for tour plans, 1 support staff icon for travel assistance, and 1 suitcase icon for comfortable travel help. On the right side of the footer, add a boxed CTA area with Japanese text "詳しくはこちらから" and a mock search field containing {argument name="search text" default="〇〇旅行　沖縄"} plus a search icon. Overall design should feel premium, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable, like a professional Japanese web banner or travel campaign visual.

items.description: A soft, photorealistic close-up portrait prompt for generating a young Japanese idol-style woman with delicate features and intentionally imperfect teeth.

author.name: 美鳴らいら【ブルベア】🩵5/8渋谷cyclone

items.content: A hyperrealistic close-up portrait of a young Japanese woman idol, framed vertically from the shoulders up, with her head slightly tilted and looking directly into the camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} straight medium-length hair with full blunt bangs that partially cover her forehead and lightly frame both sides of her face. Her skin is very smooth and pale with soft even lighting, large dark brown eyes with a gentle glossy catchlight, a small natural nose, and subtly glossy pink lips parted slightly to reveal uneven front teeth, with one upper tooth visibly irregular and overlapping, creating a charming imperfect smile. Her expression is calm, soft, and innocent. She wears a delicate light blue frilled lace top with sheer ruffle details visible at the shoulders. The background is softly blurred in cool pastel tones of lavender, blue, and pink, suggesting an indoor stage or event backdrop with bokeh-like highlights. Emphasize realistic facial texture, accurate asymmetrical teeth, beauty-idol photography styling, shallow depth of field, and a clean polished Japanese portrait aesthetic.

items.title: Japanese AI Battle YouTube Thumbnail
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic Japanese-language AI competition thumbnail with 3 competing brand zones and a futuristic presenter, ideal for YouTube or social media tech commentary.
items.content: A bold Japanese YouTube thumbnail about the AI competition era, 16:9 widescreen, high contrast, dramatic tech-news style. Use a dark futuristic control-room background filled with 3 glowing holographic dashboard screens and blue cyber interface elements around the edges. On the left and center, place a luminous circular hub labeled “AI” in bright blue, with 3 directional glowing energy arrows branching outward to competing platforms: “Google” on the left in a blue electric region, “Claude” on the upper right in a gold electric region, and “OpenAI” at the bottom center in a magenta-purple electric region. Add a subtle world-map or territory-battle visualization effect under each brand region, like illuminated digital land masses or influence zones. On the right side, show a young Japanese-looking woman from waist up, facing forward, wearing a long straight split-color wig with pastel pink on one side and pastel blue on the other, a plain white T-shirt with the printed text “OKIHIRO AI Creative”, and a light pink skirt. She raises one index finger beside her face in a presenter pose. Her face is fully obscured by a large soft-edged rectangular blur block. Across the top, add huge distressed white Japanese headline text: {argument name="headline text" default="AI戦国時代"}. Beneath it, add a second line in bold gold Japanese text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="性能だけの話じゃない"}. Across the bottom, place a wide black banner with massive bold gold Japanese text: {argument name="bottom text" default="空気を取った側が勝つ"}. Make the typography oversized, gritty, and attention-grabbing, with slight glow and drop shadow. Use a color palette of black, electric blue, gold, magenta, and neon white, with intense contrast and thumbnail readability.

items.title: Cyberpunk AI Tools Comparison Poster
items.description: A dramatic sci-fi thumbnail-style graphic comparing Google, Claude, and OpenAI tools, ideal for tech videos, social posts, or presentation cover images.
items.content: A futuristic Japanese tech comparison poster in a dark cyberpunk control-room setting, wide 16:9 composition. Large distressed white Japanese headline text at the upper left reading "三つ巴", with a bold gold subtitle directly below reading "それぞれの武器". Across the center-left are 3 glowing holographic comparison panels arranged horizontally and connected by neon arrows: a blue panel labeled "Google", an amber-gold panel labeled "Claude", and a purple-magenta panel labeled "OpenAI". The Google panel contains 4 inner cards: 2 larger top cards labeled "Gemini" and "Antigravity", plus 2 smaller bottom cards showing analytics/dashboard-like visuals and a blue isometric cube graphic. The Claude panel contains 4 inner cards: 1 large top card labeled "Claude Code", plus 3 smaller bottom cards showing a network diagram, text/code list, and chart analytics. The OpenAI panel contains 5 inner cards: 2 larger top cards labeled "ChatGPT" and "Codex", plus 3 smaller bottom cards showing interface/code windows and a geometric wireframe cube. Add glowing bidirectional arrows between Google and Claude, and between Claude and OpenAI. At the bottom center, place a large neon-framed banner with gold text reading "Google / Claude / OpenAI". On the right side, include a young woman standing and pointing left toward the panels, with long straight split-dyed hair in pastel pink and cyan blue, a plain white t-shirt with black text reading "{argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}", and a soft pink pleated skirt. Her face is obscured by a smooth rectangular blur block. Use cinematic sci-fi lighting, glossy hologram UI details, high contrast, vivid blue-gold-purple accents, and a polished YouTube thumbnail aesthetic.

items.title: Japanese AI Creative Promo Slide
items.description: A futuristic Japanese marketing graphic showcasing AI-generated image use cases across thumbnails, banners, slides, social posts, and flyers for business promotion.
items.content: Create a futuristic Japanese promotional hero graphic for an AI creative service, designed like a high-impact social media ad or presentation slide. Use a dark black-and-deep-blue cyber background with glowing circuit patterns, star-like particles, and neon light trails forming circular rings around a central editing screen. The composition is a single wide landscape layout with 6 distinct visual panels plus 1 human presenter on the right. At the top center, place a huge bold Japanese headline in distressed metallic gold and white text reading "鍵は画像" on the first line and "一瞬で伝わる" below it, with dramatic 3D depth, rough texture, and strong glow. In the center, place the largest panel: a luminous blue-framed desktop editing interface showing a vivid futuristic cityscape at sunrise, viewed from above with a river, greenery, sleek skyscrapers, warm orange sunlight, and a right-side vertical toolbar including sliders and a color wheel. Surround this centerpiece with 5 smaller glowing panels connected by curved gold arrows pointing outward from the center. Top left panel: a thumbnail example with a futuristic city image and Japanese text reading "未来を、いま創る。", smaller subtext "AI × Innovation" and "時代のソリューション", and a bright cyan label below the panel reading "サムネイル". Top right panel: a banner example with an abstract blue digital globe or network image and Japanese text reading "AIで、未来をデザインする。" with smaller subtext "テクノロジーで、社会にインパクトを。", and a cyan label below reading "バナー". Bottom left panel: a slide/document example with a business infographic style, title text "AIでビジネスを加速", three circular icon areas, an upward graph on the right, and a cyan label below reading "資料・スライド". Bottom center panel: an SNS post example showing a person standing on a mountain peak at sunrise with bold Japanese text "挑戦が、未来を変える。", small social media engagement icons and counts along the bottom bar, and a cyan label below reading "SNS画像". Bottom right panel: a flyer example with a dark blue event poster layout, title text "AI活用セミナー", smaller line "ビジネスの可能性を広げる", large date "6.15", time "10:00–17:00", a yellow circular badge reading "参加費無料", and a cyan label below reading "チラシ・パンフレット". On the right side of the overall composition, place a young woman presenter from waist up, facing forward, lightly smiling, raising her right index finger near her face as if making a key point. She has long straight split-dyed hair, pastel pink on one side and pastel blue on the other, fair skin, and wears a white T-shirt with black text reading "{argument name="brand text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}" and a high-waisted soft pink skirt. Her face is intentionally simplified or obscured in a clean ad-like way. At the very bottom, add an enormous gold Japanese slogan inside a black-and-gold framed banner reading "非エンジニアに刺さる". Use intense contrast, neon cyan edge lighting, gold accent typography, glossy UI frames, energetic motion arrows, and a polished tech-marketing aesthetic that feels optimized for convincing non-technical business users about AI-powered image generation.

items.title: Neon AI Thumbnail Comparison
items.description: A bold cyberpunk comparison thumbnail showing a shift from Nano Banana image generation to GPT Image 2 with practical marketing output examples, ideal for YouTube or social media promos.
items.content: Create a dramatic Japanese YouTube thumbnail in a futuristic neon cyberpunk style, 16:9 landscape. Use a dark tech-city background with faint skyscrapers, digital grid lines, glowing particles, and high-contrast blue, pink, and gold lighting. In the exact center, place a young woman from the waist up with long straight pastel blue hair, wearing a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and a light pink skirt, posing thoughtfully with one hand near her chin and the other arm folded; anonymize her face with a soft rectangular blur. Across the very top, add huge distressed bold white Japanese headline text reading 主導権が揺れた, and directly below it add large bold yellow text reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="Nano Bananaから"}. On the left side, create a glowing blue hexagonal-framed panel titled Nano Banana with a smaller subtitle 画像生成. Inside that panel, include exactly 4 image tiles in a 2x2 grid: 1) a fantasy floating island landscape at sunset, 2) a sunlit forest path with tall trees, 3) a neon futuristic city street at night, 4) an outer-space planet scene with stars and a spacecraft. Beneath the left panel, add a blue glowing ribbon label reading かつては優位だった. On the right side, create a glowing magenta hexagonal-framed panel titled {argument name="right panel title" default="GPT Image 2"} with a smaller subtitle 実務で使える出力へ. Inside it, include exactly 4 example thumbnail cards in a 2x2 grid, each featuring the same blue-haired woman with a blurred face and bold Japanese text. The 4 card labels above the tiles are: サムネイル画像, 記事のアイキャッチ画像, LPのセクション画像, SNS投稿画像. The large text inside the 4 cards should read respectively: 1) AIで変わるクリエイティブの未来, 2) AI時代のクリエイティブ戦略 成功する企業の条件, 3) AIで加速するビジネス成長, 4) 未来をつくるのは AI×あなたのアイデア. Between the left and right panels, place a bright glowing gold arrow pointing from left to right with spark-like particle trails, indicating transition or superiority shift. Along the bottom, add a very large black banner with a glowing gold border and massive bold gold text reading {argument name="bottom banner text" default="GPT Image 2へ"}. Overall composition should feel like a comparison graphic showing a shift from older image generation to more practical commercial output, with aggressive thumbnail typography, strong glow effects, metallic texture on major text, and polished social-media marketing visuals.

items.description: This prompt generates a polished fashion-magazine-style office portrait with Japanese editorial typography, ideal for creating stylish career-wear cover art.
items.content: A refined Japanese fashion magazine editorial cover set inside a bright modern office corridor, featuring a full-body portrait of a beautiful professional woman walking confidently toward the camera. She wears a sleek monochrome gray office outfit: a fitted ribbed mock-neck short-sleeve knit top with a diagonal shoulder strap detail accented by 4 metallic buttons, a high-waisted gray pencil skirt, and a matching gray belt with a rectangular buckle. She carries a folder and documents in one hand, with the other arm relaxed mid-stride. Her hair is long, dark brown, and styled in a thick side braid draped over one shoulder, with soft neat bangs. The mood is elegant, mature, feminine, and quietly powerful. The setting is a sophisticated open-plan office with glass meeting rooms on the left, desks and seated coworkers on the right, soft daylight mixed with clean overhead office lighting, subtle indoor plants, and a shallow depth of field that keeps the woman sharply in focus while the background remains softly blurred. Compose the image vertically like a premium magazine cover, with the model centered and occupying most of the frame from head to knees, polished editorial retouching, realistic fabric texture, flattering natural skin tones, and understated luxury styling. Overlay stylish magazine typography in Japanese and English: a large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="Update"} across the upper left, smaller Japanese copy above it, a script subtitle reading "The Office Muse," a right-side teaser block with "NEW BASIC, NEW ME.", a left feature block titled "Focus on DETAIL", a mid-left article box titled "My Work Style", a lower-right feature titled "Style Tip", a small right-side box titled "Scene PRESENTATION DAY", a circular callout near the lower left reading "CHECK!", and small footer text with page number 25. Use a luxury fashion magazine aesthetic, clean layout, restrained grayscale palette, editorial balance between text and subject, realistic photography, high detail, soft contrast, and an aspirational office-wear campaign feel.

Warm daylight streams in from the window, creating soft highlights on her clothing and skin, subtle reflections on the glass, and a luminous cityscape of tall office buildings outside. The interior background is softly blurred, showing a minimalist office with 1 potted plant, 1 desk, and 1 office chair. Compose the image vertically like a premium magazine cover, full body cropped around mid-calf, with the model centered slightly right to leave room for typography on the left. Include 5 additional text blocks: 1 Japanese subtitle under the main title, 1 left-column beauty section with the heading "BEAUTY" and Japanese body text, 1 left-column career section with the heading "CAREER" and Japanese body text, 1 large lower-left headline reading "Focus On You" with a short Japanese subline, and 1 lower-right circular callout with the heading "Interview" and Japanese text inside a translucent pale circle. Add 3 small blue rectangular tags near the lower left reading {argument name="tag line 1" default="SKINCARE ROUTINE"}, {argument name="tag line 2" default="WORK SMARTER"}, and {argument name="tag line 3" default="MINDFUL LIFE"}. Overall mood: sophisticated, feminine, aspirational, urban, graceful, professional, luxurious, clean natural light, realistic digital photography with subtle fashion-retouching, premium Japanese magazine cover design.

items.title: Elegant City Fashion Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic luxury fashion magazine cover featuring a stylish woman walking through a sunset-lit business district, ideal for editorial, branding, and cover design concepts.
items.content: Create a high-fashion magazine cover photo in a polished editorial style, vertical portrait orientation, showing a beautiful young adult woman walking confidently toward the camera in the middle of a modern financial district at sunset. She is centered full-body, photographed at street level with cinematic depth of field, framed by tall glass office towers on both sides reflecting warm golden evening light. The mood is elegant, urban, powerful, and refined, like an upscale fashion magazine cover about after-work style. The woman has long dark hair styled in a thick side braid over one shoulder, a slim sophisticated silhouette, and a poised runway-like stride. She wears a fitted ribbed turtleneck sweater in {argument name="top color" default="burnt orange"} with decorative gold buttons on one shoulder, a high-waisted pencil skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="warm brown"}, a black belt with a gold buckle, and carries a structured black handbag in one hand. Her expression should feel calm, self-assured, and graceful. Use flattering soft golden-hour lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, crisp fashion-photography detail on the outfit, and slightly blurred businesspeople in the background walking through the plaza to suggest a busy city evening. The background should include exactly 4 distant office workers, softly out of focus, spread across the walkway. Add realistic magazine cover typography integrated over the image: a very large elegant serif masthead on the upper left reading {argument name="magazine title" default="CITY POISE"}; beneath it on the left, the cover lines "AFTER-WORK STYLE THAT COMMANDS THE EVENING", "MODERN ELEGANCE", "Polished looks for the office and beyond.", "WORK. WALK. WIND DOWN.", "Versatile pieces that move with your day.", "THE POWER OF NEUTRALS", and "Warm tones, clean lines, Quiet confidence."; on the upper right, small text "STYLE & CULTURE" and "MAY 2024"; below that on the right, the teaser "Sunset meetings and city lights. Your best look starts here."; in the lower right, the cover line "EVENING ELEVATED" with the smaller text "From desk to dinner plans— effortless style that transitions beautifully."; and a realistic barcode box at the bottom right with "MAY 2024", US and CAN prices, small issue numbers, and barcode lines. Make the overall composition clean, premium, balanced, and convincingly like a real contemporary fashion magazine cover.

items.title: Dark Cyber Elf With Crimson Blade
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic high-detail anime dark fantasy character poster, ideal for concept art, key visuals, or striking AI art showcases.
items.content: A dark ultra-detailed anime cyber-gothic portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="female elf warrior"} in a three-quarter side profile, framed from upper thighs to head, standing in a ruined futuristic industrial city. She has a short blunt bob in {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}, pale skin, long sharp elf ears, and a calm cold expression with one visible glowing {argument name="eye color" default="crimson red"} eye. Her hair is windswept across her face, and she wears a black star-shaped metallic hair ornament near one temple. Outfit is a sleek black biomechanical armored dress with glossy obsidian surfaces, spiked and layered plates, torn lace-like textures around the shoulders and chest, and intricate demonic exoskeleton detailing. One arm is heavily armored into a massive organic-mechanical gauntlet. She holds or merges with an enormous jagged living sword crossing diagonally from the lower left foreground toward her torso; the blade is black metal with glowing veins, embedded red cores, and violent molten energy bursting through it like liquid fire. Red energy ribbons, sparks, smoke, and ember-like particles swirl around her body and weapon. The background is a vertical dystopian megastructure filled with black steel towers, cables, hanging chains, fragments of red holographic code, occult-tech insignias, and faint industrial symbols, all mostly swallowed by shadow. Use a black and deep crimson palette with extreme contrast, glossy highlights, sharp rim light, dramatic backglow behind the head, dense detail, chaotic painterly effects, and a grim apocalyptic atmosphere. Composition should feel like premium dark fantasy key art, highly polished, cinematic, intimidating, elegant, and explosive.

items.title: Cyberpunk 404 Witch Summoning
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed anime cyberpunk witch illustration on a neon rooftop, ideal for dark fantasy key art, posters, or social media showcase images.
items.content: A dramatic anime-style cyberpunk witch standing on a dark rooftop high above a dense futuristic city at night, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The main subject is a petite young witch girl with pale skin, short icy blue bobbed hair, pointed elf-like ears, and glowing red eyes, wearing a sly confident smile. She raises a black wand overhead in her right hand, with a dangling orb charm at the tip glowing faintly purple and red. Her oversized crooked witch hat is black with purple lining and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, straps, and white graphics including a large “404” and a skull emblem. She wears a black and purple techwear outfit: oversized hooded jacket with many straps and tags, black crop top with “404” on the chest, layered belts, short bottoms, fishnet on one leg, black lace-up combat boots, chokers, and metallic accessories. Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.

items.title: Tokyo DisneySea Front-Row Battle UI
items.description: A comedic realistic game-style screenshot showing two rival fan groups battling for the front row at Tokyo DisneySea, useful for parody arcade fighting game visuals.
items.content:
Create a hyper-detailed comedic Japanese arcade fighting game screenshot styled like a versus battle scene, using a real-world photo aesthetic with game UI overlaid on top. The scene shows an intense mock battle between two groups of theme-park fans competing for the front row at an outdoor show plaza in Tokyo DisneySea. Use a wide 16:9 composition. In the background, clearly show Mediterranean Harbor and Mount Prometheus under bright daytime skies, with the waterfront and DisneySea architecture visible. In the foreground, show exactly 10 young adult people in winter casual clothing, split into 2 opposing teams of 5, physically leaning, grabbing, reaching, and shoving in a tug-of-war-like scrum over position, with exaggerated competitive body language and frozen action as if in a fighting game. Faces should be anonymized with soft blurred blocks. Add floating character labels above each person with levels and names in Japanese. The overall tone is absurdly realistic, like a real candid photo transformed into a polished arcade game battle screen.

Add a full Japanese fighting-game HUD with glossy blue-versus-red interface styling. At the very top, place a center stage title bar reading "東京ディズニーシー　ミッキー広場　ショー最前列バトル" and a large timer in the middle reading "TIME 89". In the top left, add a blue team header "PLAYER1" and team name "最前列ガチ勢A". In the top right, add a red team header "RIVAL" and team name "ライバルグループB". On the left side, stack exactly 5 blue player status panels with portraits, level, Japanese class-like nicknames, HP, SP, and BURST meters. The 5 left-side labels are: "Lv.25 ガチ勢リーダー ユウキ", "Lv.24 筋肉マン タケシ", "Lv.23 眼鏡オタク シンジ", "Lv.23 開角心MAX ケント", "Lv.22 サポート要員 リョウ". On the right side, stack exactly 5 red rival status panels with the labels: "Lv.27 ライバルリーダー ダイキ", "Lv.26 パワフル代表 マサル", "Lv.24 戦略家 コウジ", "Lv.23 熱血漢 リク", "Lv.22 サポート女子 サキ". Each panel should include numeric HP and SP values and segmented BURST gauges, styled like a Japanese arcade RPG-fighter interface.

Place exactly 10 in-battle nameplates above the fighters in the center scene, color-coded blue for the left team and red for the right team. The 10 labels are: "Lv.24 タケシ", "Lv.25 ユウキ", "Lv.23 シンジ", "Lv.23 ケント", "Lv.22 リョウ", "Lv.27 ダイキ", "Lv.26 マサル", "Lv.23 リク", "Lv.22 サキ", "Lv.22 ミサキ".

At the lower left, add a skill menu titled "スキル" listing exactly 5 skills with SP costs: "ダッシュ突撃 SP 20", "肩押し強奪 SP 25", "荷物で場所確保 SP 15", "ロープくぐり SP 10", "本気の根性 SP 50". Beneath that, add a dark description box explaining the highlighted skill "本気の根性" with the Japanese text: "気合で相手を威圧し、どかす！ 一定時間、相手が怯みやすくなる！ （バーストゲージを大きく消費する） 効果時間：10秒".

At the bottom center, add an item menu titled "アイテム" with exactly 5 item slots showing icons and counts: a water bottle "x3", a folded purple towel "x2", a blue drawstring bag "x1", a gray backpack "x1", and a boxed meal "x2". At the lower right, add a quest panel titled "クエスト" with the mission text "ショー開始までに最前列を死守しろ！" and condition text "条件：ライバルグループを全員後ろに押し戻せ！" and countdown text "ショー開始まで：02:30". Beside it, add a mini-map titled "ミッキー広場MAP" showing red and blue dots for both teams in the plaza. Along the very bottom edge, include small controller prompts in Japanese for actions such as skill use, item use, grab/push, and dash.

Use dramatic, saturated lighting, crisp detail, realistic clothing folds, authentic plaza stone pavement, and a high-end Japanese game screenshot look. The image should feel like a ridiculous but believable crossover between a real Tokyo DisneySea crowd photo and a competitive arcade battle game interface.

items.title: Japanese AI App Promo Banner
items.description: A futuristic Japanese marketing banner for an AI-powered certification battle app, suitable for app ads, landing pages, and social media promotions.

author.name: OraToy｜200+種類の資格試験×対戦×SNSアプリ

items.content: Create a polished Japanese tech advertising banner for a mobile app, widescreen 16:9, with a futuristic blue-to-purple gradient background filled with glowing network lines, connection nodes, soft lens flares, and subtle digital particles. At the top center, place a modern app logo: a cyan hexagon icon with large white letters “SC” and a small circuit symbol inside the C, followed by the brand text “SKILL Cert by AI” in a clean sans-serif font, with “SKILL” large and black, “Cert” below it in black, and “by AI” smaller in cyan. Center the composition around a bold Japanese headline in very large white text with a dark navy outline and soft drop shadow: {argument name="headline text" default="AIが出題する資格バトルアプリ"}. Directly below, add a second line of medium-large white Japanese text with the same outline and shadow: {argument name="subheadline text" default="200以上の資格でオンライン対戦"}. In the middle foreground, place one large glossy rounded rectangular call-to-action button in bright cyan with subtle gradient, bevel, and shadow, containing bold white Japanese text: {argument name="button text" default="今すぐ無料で対戦"}. Show exactly 3 smartphone mockups arranged around the center: 1 on the lower left, tilted slightly right, showing a leaderboard app screen with a line graph at the top, small profile avatars, ranking rows, and Japanese UI labels; 1 large phone on the lower right, tilted slightly left, showing a multiple-choice quiz screen with Japanese question text and radio-button answers plus a cyan bottom button; 1 smaller phone on the far right edge, angled inward, showing a darker dashboard-style screen with charts and Japanese text. Add exactly 4 floating UI graphic clusters in the background: 1 analytics line-chart panel near the upper left, 1 holographic cube/dashboard cluster near the upper right, 1 glowing wireframe brain or neural sphere near the lower left-center behind the button, and 1 hexagon chart/card element near the right-center. Use a sleek AI, SaaS, and edtech marketing aesthetic, high contrast, crisp typography, layered depth, neon glow accents, and premium app-promo lighting.

items.title: Weathered Custom Cub Concept Bike
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed concept-art style illustration of a heavily customized retro utility motorcycle, ideal for vehicle design, mech art, or post-apocalyptic industrial aesthetics.
items.content: A highly detailed concept illustration of a customized vintage step-through motorcycle inspired by a Honda Super Cub, shown in a clean studio-like three-quarter left side view on a plain light gray background. The bike has a rugged post-apocalyptic street-build aesthetic with a black, white, and muted gray color scheme accented by small pink stickers and decals. Emphasize heavy weathering: chipped paint, scratches, oil stains, grime, rust flecks, ink splatter, worn edges, and layered sticker residue across the entire body. The front has 1 square headlight with an X-shaped light pattern and 2 smaller stacked auxiliary lights beneath it. Use spoked wheels, thick all-terrain tires, visible front suspension, exposed mechanical detail, chain drive, and a sturdy center stand touching the ground. The leg shield and side panels are covered in graphic decals, Japanese-style warning labels, numbers, symbols, and distressed typography, including a bold large kanji mark on the front fairing. Add 2 hard side cargo boxes on the rear, one larger box on the far side and 1 nearer black box with extra stickers, plus 1 hanging vertical tag charm attached near the rear case. Include 1 long black ribbed seat, rear rack framing, exposed wiring, metal brackets, bolts, and compact utility accessories that make it feel hand-modified and functional. Render it like an industrial design sketch mixed with polished anime mech concept art: precise linework, watercolor wash shadows, soft gray ground shadow, high-detail mechanical realism, slightly messy inked edges, and a collectible custom-bike illustration feel.

items.title: Medieval Shot Reverse Shot
items.description: A cinematic two-angle medieval countershot scene for demonstrating over-the-shoulder framing and shot-reverse-shot composition.
items.content: A cinematic medieval shot-reverse-shot pair presented as a gritty historical film still in an ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio, overcast natural light, muted earth tones, damp autumn atmosphere, realistic muddy textures, shallow depth of field, and strong foreground shoulder framing. Set the scene on a rutted muddy country road running through a rural valley with rough wooden wattle fences on both sides, low rolling hills covered with sparse trees in the distance, open fields, and a small pale stone farmhouse or chapel on the far right hillside. The two characters face each other on the road. One is a weary medieval peasant man in a dirty brown tunic and cap, average build, carrying a wood-handled axe resting on his shoulder with a leather strap across his chest. The other is a knight or armed traveler in dark weathered chainmail and a worn hooded surcoat, standing still with a guarded posture. Create this as a grammar-of-cinema countershot demonstration: first frame shows the {argument name="foreground character" default="peasant man with axe"} from behind in the right foreground, his shoulder and back occupying the near right side of the frame, while the {argument name="background character" default="knight in chainmail"} stands full figure in the left midground facing camera on the muddy road; second frame reverses the angle and shows the knight’s shoulder and hooded back blurred in the left foreground while the peasant stands in the right midground holding the axe on his shoulder. Keep both shots consistent in location, weather, costume continuity, lens feel, and character spacing, with subdued dramatic realism and a tense conversational standoff.

items.title: Anime Sakura Movie Poster
items.description: A cinematic Japanese anime poster for a bittersweet girls' coming-of-age romance, ideal for film key visuals, teaser art, or dramatic promotional posters.
items.content: A polished Japanese animated film poster in a soft, luminous springtime anime style. The main scene shows 2 teenage schoolgirls walking hand in hand down a quiet residential street lined with blooming cherry blossom trees. They wear matching Japanese sailor school uniforms: white long-sleeve blouses with navy sailor collars, pale blue neckerchiefs, and dark navy pleated skirts, each carrying a navy school bag. The girl on the left has dark hair tied in a low side bun with loose strands and a small pink cherry blossom hairpin; she turns toward the other girl with a tender, slightly wistful expression. The girl on the right has long straight dark hair and looks back at her softly. Pink sakura petals drift through warm late-afternoon backlight, creating a romantic, emotional atmosphere with glowing rim light, gentle lens bloom, and painterly detail. Along the left edge, add a vertical collage of 7 inset memory scenes from the story: 1) two children together in a nostalgic childhood moment, 2) a close portrait of the long-haired girl, 3) the two characters standing apart in a tense or reflective moment, 4) an indoor conversation scene with 3 people, 5) a close profile of the bun-haired girl, 6) an intimate almost-kiss close-up of the two leads, 7) a rear view of the two girls walking together beneath cherry blossoms. At the top, include the Japanese tagline: 「変わってしまった朝、変わらなかった想い。」 Across the lower center, place the large glowing handwritten title {argument name="title text" default="Story of U"} in elegant pink neon script. Beneath it, add small Japanese subtitle text and a release line reading {argument name="release text" default="2027年春公開"}. At the very bottom, add dense small white Japanese credits in authentic movie-poster layout. Overall mood: bittersweet yuri coming-of-age drama, cinematic key visual, emotionally resonant, highly detailed, pastel pink and navy palette, vertical poster composition.

items.content: A clean editorial magazine cover on an off-white studio background, designed like a premium illustrated automobile magazine. The main headline at the top is huge condensed blue sans-serif text reading {argument name="magazine title" default="AUTO ICON"}, with a small subtitle beneath it reading "THE ILLUSTRATED AUTOMOBILE MAGAZINE". In the top right, place small blue issue text reading {argument name="issue date" default="May 2026"} above a larger blue number line reading "No.128" with a thin underline. To the right of the car stands a slim anime-style {argument name="companion character" default="blue-haired girl"}, full body, facing left toward the car, short muted blue bob haircut with a small tied section in back, minimalist facial detail, white long-sleeve top, pale blue skirt, white socks, blue sneakers, and a blue shoulder bag, posed casually with one arm bent near her chest. Use a refined blend of soft cel-shaded anime illustration and realistic automotive rendering, with lots of negative space and elegant print-layout balance. At the bottom left, include two blocks of small Japanese cover copy and a realistic barcode with tiny issue digits. Keep the overall aesthetic minimal, sophisticated, airy, and poster-like, with soft daylight shadows and a high-end Japanese magazine cover composition.

items.title: Mobster Cats Playing Poker
items.description: A cinematic photoreal prompt for creating a smoky noir scene of seven gangster cats playing poker in a dimly lit underground card room.
items.content: A cinematic, ultra-detailed noir-style scene of 7 anthropomorphic domestic cats gathered around a round green felt poker table in a dim, smoky backroom bar. The central cat is the boss: a serious tabby wearing a dark pinstripe suit, white shirt, tie, black fedora, and black sunglasses, calmly smoking a thick cigar with dramatic smoke curling upward into the overhead lamp. Around him sit 6 other cats, each holding playing cards and dressed like underworld gamblers: on the far left a gray tabby in a textured flat cap and round dark sunglasses; next a ginger cat in a dark fedora, chunky gold chain, and dark glasses; to the right of center a fluffy gray cat in a brown fedora; further right a white-and-tabby cat in a dark New York Yankees baseball cap and pendant necklace; in the near right foreground a striped cat in a fedora and sunglasses seen in profile; all styled as mobsters. The table is crowded with exact poker details: 7 cats total, each with cards in paw, multiple stacks of red, blue, white, and black poker chips, scattered US dollar bills, a short whiskey glass in the front right, and 5 community cards face up in the middle. Use warm amber overhead lighting from a single large hanging lamp, deep shadows, richly textured fur, realistic whiskers, reflective sunglasses, and dense atmospheric cigar smoke. Background should be a dark wood-paneled gambling den with framed vintage posters and signs including a large poker poster on the left and an "ALL IN OR FOLD" sign on the right, plus bottles on shelves. Composition is eye-level and slightly wide-angle, centered on the smoking cat, with a gritty, luxurious gangster mood, photorealistic, dramatic depth, high contrast, and filmic color grading.

items.title: Retro Super Famicom RPG Ad
items.description: A faux 1990s Japanese Super Famicom advertisement for a fantasy RPG, useful for recreating nostalgic game box art or magazine promo layouts.
items.content: Create a full-page vintage Japanese Super Famicom game box advertisement designed like a worn 1990s magazine spread or game package front, on aged yellowed paper with creases, stains, frayed corners, fold marks, and slight print fading. The layout should feel authentically retro and densely composed, with bold Japanese promotional copy, a fake fantasy RPG logo, a character lineup on the right, a gameplay screenshot on the left, and pricing and feature callouts near the bottom. At the top left, place a large black “SUPER FAMICOM” header with smaller Japanese subtitle text beneath it, and nearby a red Japanese slogan line. At the top right, include a small Super Famicom style logo badge in a black rectangle with the English text “SUPER FAMICOM LICENSED BY NINTENDO” underneath. In the upper center, feature the game title logo “Epic 7 Seven” in ornate fantasy typography, dark teal and black, layered over a circular magical crest or sigil in pale blue. Under the logo, add small Japanese katakana subtitle text. On the right half, show 4 anime fantasy party members in a polished JRPG promotional illustration style: 1 white-haired young male hero in a white cloak and blue-black outfit holding a sword, 1 pink-haired female knight or mage in dark armor with gold trim, 1 tall long-black-haired swordsman in dark layered robes, and 1 blonde twin-tailed maid girl in a black-and-white frilled dress reaching one hand forward. Their faces should be generic and soft-featured, front-facing or three-quarter view, grouped in a heroic composition. Add 4 dark blue nameplates with Japanese character names and short class descriptions near each character. Place a tall vertical yellow Japanese slogan with black outline between the screenshot and the character group. On the left lower-middle, include 1 in-game battle screenshot framed in a dark blue rounded rectangle: a pixel-art dungeon battle scene showing 1 purple dragon monster facing a 4-character party in a stone corridor. At the bottom of the battle screen, show a classic RPG interface with 4 command options in Japanese and a party status list with character names, HP, and MP values. In the lower left, add a red Japanese headline followed by 4 black square bullet points of Japanese feature text. Near the bottom center, place a red circular burst sticker with white Japanese text indicating strong sales, beside a large printed price reading “9,800円” with smaller surrounding Japanese retail text. At the bottom right, include 1 yellow information box labeled “RPG” with additional Japanese text and a separate dark box below for player count reading “1人”. Use a muted retro print palette of cream, dark blue, teal, red, gold, black, and faded pastel character colors. The whole image should resemble a highly convincing fictional Super Famicom advertisement for a classic fantasy RPG titled {argument name="game title" default="Epic 7 Seven"}, with visible Japanese text, nostalgic print imperfections, and authentic 1990s console game marketing design.

items.title: Vintage Roaring Tiger Japanese Poster
items.description: A stylized roaring tiger poster with Japanese typography and infographic-like side details, ideal for bold branding, album art, or graphic print concepts.
items.content: Create a bold vintage Japanese-inspired poster on a square canvas with a fierce front-facing tiger head as the single central subject, perfectly symmetrical and filling most of the frame. The tiger is roaring with its mouth wide open, showing long curved ivory fangs, smaller lower teeth, a vivid pink tongue, a dark throat, a pink nose, intense yellow eyes, and dramatic black stripes over saturated orange fur with white cheek and neck fur. Add ornamental swirling stripe patterns on the forehead to give the face a stylized mythic look. Use a gritty retro screenprint or risograph texture with visible grain, worn ink, slightly distressed edges, and a limited palette of burnt orange, black, cream, white, muted pink, and small accents of yellow. The background should be a flat textured orange-red field. In the top right, include 1 small technical diagram panel showing a side-view tiger skeleton in thin cream line art with compact vertical Japanese annotation text beneath and beside it, like a pseudo-scientific label block. In the bottom left, include 3 vertically stacked icon boxes with thin cream borders: the first contains a heart icon with the label 心, the second contains crossed bones with the label 力, and the third contains three claw marks with the label 本能. Across the bottom center, place 2 very large cream-colored Japanese kanji characters with heavy black drop shadows and a rough hand-cut block print feel: 猛獣. Keep the overall composition aggressive, iconic, poster-like, centered, and highly graphic, blending traditional Japanese poster aesthetics, tattoo flash energy, and vintage animal anatomy chart styling.

items.title: Open Notebook with French Handwritten Plans
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic top-down desk photo of an open notebook filled with handwritten French planning notes, ideal for productivity, lifestyle, or blog-themed visuals.
items.content: A realistic overhead lifestyle photo of an open lined notebook lying on a dark wooden desk, shot in soft natural indoor light with warm neutral tones. The notebook fills most of the frame and is centered vertically, opened to two pages with neat black handwritten French notes, casual rounded handwriting, slight imperfections, a few doodles, and some crossed-out lines. Show a black ribbon bookmark hanging from the bottom center of the notebook. Include a partial stack of pale books or paper at the top left edge and a partial white mug entering from the top right corner. The pages should look cream-colored with faint horizontal ruling and a subtle center crease. On the left page, write the underlined heading "Plan articles blog" near the top, followed by exactly 6 bullet items: "Écris intro + pourquoi j’ai lancé le blog", "10 idées reçues sur le minimalisme" with the number 10 circled, "Ma routine du matin (version réaliste)", "Témoignages / retours lecteurs", "Outils que j’utilise au quotidien", and one crossed-out line reading "bons plans (liens affiliés)". Lower on the left page, add the underlined subheading "Idées à creuser :" followed by exactly 3 bullet items: "article sur les achats impulsifs", "parler d’argent sans tabou" with a small star doodle nearby, and "digital declutter : par où commencer ?", plus one additional fully crossed-out handwritten line beneath them. At the bottom left, draw a large cloud-shaped outline containing the text "Objectif : publier 2x/mois et rester authentique !" and add a small heart doodle near the lower right corner of the left page. On the right page, write the underlined heading "Routine matin idéale" at the top, then exactly 6 schedule lines: "6h30 : réveil (sans tel !!)", "6h40 : eau citron + respiration", "6h50 : 10 min de lecture", "7h05 : écriture / gratitude", "7h20 : sport / yoga / marche", "7h45 : douche + préparation", and then "8h15 : focus boulot" lower down with a hand-drawn star doodle to its right. Beneath that, add the underlined subheading "Pensées du jour :" and the quote across 3 lines: "La discipline, c’est choisir entre", "ce que tu veux maintenant et", "ce que tu veux vraiment.", with a small heart doodle below. At the bottom right, add the underlined subheading "À ne pas oublier :" followed by exactly 3 bullet items: "appeler la banque", "prendre rdv médecin", and a crossed-out "annuler abo salle (trop cher)". Keep the composition clean, minimal, and believable, like an authentic productivity journal or blog planning notebook photographed casually from above.

items.title: Tropical Citrus Soda Ad Poster
items.description: A bright French-language beverage advertisement showing a chilled citrus soda bottle on a tropical beach, ideal for summer product marketing and packaging mockups.
items.content: Create a vibrant tropical commercial poster for a citrus soda bottle, in a bright summer advertising style. Show a single large plastic bottle of {argument name="product name" default="Soda"} centered slightly to the right, tilted a little left, with a yellow cap and transparent bottle covered in cold condensation droplets, filled with glowing golden-orange soda. The label should feature sliced oranges and citrus artwork with the brand text "{argument name="product name" default="Soda"}", the phrase "aux agrumes d'été", and a small green "500 ml" mark. Use a sunny beach background with vivid blue sky, turquoise ocean, soft clouds, and blurred tropical palm leaves entering from the upper right corner. Add dramatic water splashes around the base of the bottle, scattered clear ice cubes, and 5 visible citrus pieces in the foreground: 2 orange wedges, 1 lime half, 1 grapefruit half, and 1 partial orange slice at the far right edge. Place large French promotional text on the left: a huge white headline "{argument name="headline text" default="Soda"}" with a small splash accent above it, then yellow script text "aux agrumes d'été" underneath. Add a yellow paint-stroke badge at mid-left with the text "LA FRAÎCHEUR QUI PÉTILLE !". Add a vertical feature list on the lower left with 3 round icons and French captions: "SAVEURS NATURELLES", "SANS COLORANTS ARTIFICIELS", and "EXTRA RAFRAÎCHISSANT". Add a green brushstroke banner at the bottom left reading "FORMAT PRATIQUE 500 ml". Add a round beige eco-style seal at the bottom right with green outline and leaf motif, containing the text "{argument name="seal text" default="PLAISIR FRUITÉ À CHAQUE GORGÉE"}". Lighting should be glossy and high-energy with strong sun flare from the upper left, saturated citrus colors, crisp packaging detail, realistic droplets, and polished supermarket-ad realism.

items.title: Moonlit Barn Fashion Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic full-body fashion portrait of a woman in a yellow dress seated on hay inside a rustic barn, ideal for moody editorial or lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A cinematic photorealistic portrait of a young woman sitting barefoot on a rectangular hay bale inside a rustic wooden barn at night, wearing a flowing mustard-yellow satin maxi dress with thin spaghetti straps, a deep neckline, a small bow-tie knot at the center of the bust, a fitted waist, and a long draped skirt pooling onto the straw-covered floor. She has long wavy auburn-brown hair styled half-up in a loose top knot, with soft strands falling over her shoulders. Her pose is elegant and demure: legs crossed at the ankles and extended forward, one hand resting near her lap, the other hand raised to partially cover her face. Warm golden light from the right side illuminates her skin and dress, creating soft highlights and deep shadows, while cool blue moonlight enters from a small open window on the left. Outside the window, show a bright full moon in a dark blue sky with silhouettes of pine trees. The barn interior is made of dark stained vertical wooden planks with built-in bench ledges along the walls, scattered loose straw on the floor, and 2 visible hay bales, including the one she sits on. Shot full body in a vertical composition, centered slightly right of frame, shallow depth of field, intimate moody atmosphere, high-detail skin and fabric texture, editorial fashion photography, soft cinematic contrast.

items.title: Ancient Egyptian Queen with Black Panther
items.description: A photorealistic fantasy portrait of an Egyptian-inspired royal woman posed beside a black panther, ideal for cinematic character art and mythic luxury imagery.
items.content: A cinematic ancient Egypt portrait of a glamorous queen-like woman kneeling on warm desert sand beside a large black panther in the courtyard of a sandstone temple. The woman has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} long wavy hair, medium-brown skin, and wears an ornate Egyptian gold headband with a central turquoise jewel and sun-disc detail, long rectangular gold earrings, a wide layered Egyptian collar in gold and blue, multiple gold armbands and bracelets, and a revealing ivory-and-gold draped outfit with gemstone ornaments, delicate gold chain adornments across the torso, a jeweled belt, and strappy sandals. Her pose is elegant and grounded, one hand resting on the sand, knees folded to one side, body angled slightly toward the viewer. Beside her is 1 sleek black panther with subtle rosette patterning and bright amber eyes, lying sphinx-like in the foreground, calm, regal, and protective. The setting includes 3 massive carved temple columns in the background with hieroglyphic and animal relief details, softly out of focus. Golden-hour sunlight, warm sandstone tones, realistic skin and fabric textures, dramatic yet natural shadows, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, luxurious, mythic atmosphere, centered vertical composition, full-body seated figure with animal companion.

items.title: Colossal Labyrinth Woman Monument
items.description: A cinematic surreal prompt for generating a towering maze-covered female statue with a doorway in its base, ideal for dark fantasy concept art and atmospheric architectural imagery.
items.content: A surreal dark-fantasy photorealistic scene of a colossal humanoid statue shaped like a woman standing in a rugged mountain landscape, viewed from a dramatic low angle so the figure towers into the sky. items.title: Occult Cyber-Gothic Collage Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dark, text-heavy surreal collage poster suited for gothic album art, horror editorial covers, or occult-themed concept art.
items.content: A dark occult cyber-gothic collage poster in vertical format, dense and layered like a ritualistic noir album cover, with a distressed black, sepia, bronze, and deep crimson palette. Combine analog decay, glitch textures, scanned paper, technical schematics, surveillance graphics, sacred geometry, and fragmented photomontage into one unified composition. On the right side, feature a large aged human skull in profile, highly detailed, weathered, and partially overlaid with circles, target marks, sigils, thin grid lines, and red diagram annotations. Near the upper center, place a mysterious woman with long dark hair and pale skin, wearing a low-cut black garment, posed sensually with one hand raised near her face; behind her head, add a large dim red halo ring. On the left upper quadrant, include the draped back or shoulder of a pale classical-statue-like figure, ghostly and fragmentary. In the lower middle-right, place a dark-skinned ritual figure or priestess wearing layered beads, necklaces, and ceremonial adornment, partially obscured by texture and collage interference. In the lower right, show one worn cloth doll or voodoo-style rag figure hanging or suspended, with visible seams and outstretched limbs. In the bottom center, depict a rainy night street scene with 1 lone trench-coated figure walking away under dim lights and 1 car parked or idling on the wet road, reflections glowing red on the pavement. In the lower left, add a faceted black pyramid or crystal-like geometric form emerging from darkness. Scatter exactly 7 visible Latin text blocks throughout the design, styled as aged serif typography and cryptic inscriptions: "IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.", "ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.", "PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA", "EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.", "III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.", "COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.", and "IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO". Add small UI-like microtext, barcode fragments, tiny charts, occult emblems, crosshair symbols, and illegible data panels across the entire image. The composition should feel oppressive, esoteric, cinematic, and surreal, with heavy texture, layered transparency, subtle red accents, chiaroscuro lighting, and a premium dark-art poster finish.

At the center, place a confident woman named {argument name="character name" default="Penny"} standing from the waist up with arms crossed, wearing a light cream floral V-neck dress, messy blonde hair in a high bun, softly rim-lit with a subtle glow around her silhouette. Behind her, show exactly 8 office coworkers arranged as a blurred ensemble cast in staggered rows inside a corporate office interior with blinds, desks, and framed company signage; keep them secondary and slightly shadowed so the central woman dominates the composition. NEW SCRANTON." On the left side, place a torn-paper transfer slip with a stamped, photocopied look; it should contain exactly 2 labeled sections, "FROM:" with "DUNDER MIFFLIN PAPER COMPANY, SCRANTON, PA, EST. 1949" and "TO:" with "THE OFFICE, SCRANTON, PA", plus a small office icon at the bottom. Add a hand-drawn blue arrow from this slip pointing toward the central woman. Along the bottom center, include a narrow blue banner reading "DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="Penny"}". items.title: Pink Fashion Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a polished pink-toned fashion magazine cover with a cozy glamorous model and editorial typography, ideal for beauty branding or mock publication covers.
items.content: A glossy high-fashion magazine cover portrait in a vertical format, styled like a premium beauty and fashion publication. Show a young woman from the chest up in a soft glamorous studio setup, turning slightly sideways with one hand raised near her lips in a coy elegant pose. Her face is intentionally obscured by a solid rectangular block in a muted warm beige tone, centered over the face area. She has long, softly wavy light brown hair with pink rim lighting catching the strands, large thin silver hoop earrings, and long manicured pale pink nails. She wears a fluffy fuzzy knit sweater in blush pink with oversized sleeves and a cozy luxurious texture. Use a monochromatic pink palette with warm rosy lighting, soft glow, shallow depth of field, beauty-retouch polish, and editorial fashion photography aesthetics. The background should be a smooth pink gradient with subtle studio haze and light bloom. Design it as a magazine cover with layered typography: a very large pale pink masthead reading "{argument name="magazine title" default="GPT"}" across the top, with elegant serif text "{argument name="cover line" default="image 2.0"}" in the upper right. Add small upper-left text reading "MAY 2024" and "FASHION & BEAUTY MAGAZINE". Add three side feature blocks: left upper "Special Interview" with Japanese text beneath and "8P"; left lower "Trend Report" with Japanese text beneath; right middle "Beauty Update" with Japanese text beneath; right lower "Style Guide" with Japanese text beneath. At the bottom, place a large dramatic serif headline reading "{argument name="main headline" default="The Power of Confidence."}" with "The Power of" in black italic serif and "Confidence." in oversized deep pink italic serif. Beneath it, add the Japanese subheadline "自分を信じて、もっと輝く私に。" Keep the cover luxurious, feminine, trendy, and polished, like a contemporary Japanese fashion magazine.

items.title: Pink Office Transfer Announcement Poster
items.description: A scrapbook-style pink workplace announcement poster featuring a central female employee and her office team, ideal for parody promos, character edits, or celebratory transfer announcements.
items.content: A glossy, feminine scrapbook-style office announcement poster inspired by a sitcom workplace promo, in a vertical 2:3 composition. The scene shows 1 central woman standing in front of a group of 7 office coworkers inside a warm beige office with venetian blinds, desks, and a visible Dunder Mifflin-style wall sign in the background. The central woman has blonde hair in a messy high bun, a light pink floral V-neck dress, folded arms, and a confident, celebratory pose. Behind her, the 7 coworkers are arranged in a loose semicircle, wearing office attire in muted blues, browns, black, and lavender. Build the image as a mixed-media collage with torn paper, taped notes, brush-lettered headlines, glitter textures, flowers, and pink-and-gold accents. At the top left, place a pink rectangular company card with a white office icon and the text “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC” and “PAPER COMPANY”. Across the upper center, place a large torn-paper headline reading “TRANSFER CONFIRMED” in expressive brush lettering, with “TRANSFER” in hot pink and “CONFIRMED” in black, plus pink underline strokes and a hand-drawn heart. At the top right, pin a small off-white note card with a pink pushpin and pink tape reading “NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON.” Near the lower center, layer a bold title made of 4 stacked text strips: “{argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}” on a pink paint-stroke banner, “IS” on a small white strip with 2 tiny hearts, “JOINING” on a gold brush-stroke banner, and “THE OFFICE” on a pale pink strip. On the lower left, hang a tall pink transfer tag clipped with a gold paperclip, reading “FROM DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC PAPER COMPANY / SCRANTON, PA / EST. 1949” and below that “TO THE OFFICE / SCRANTON, PA”, with a pink women-and-desk restroom-style icon at the bottom. On the lower right, place a pink note card with 3 labeled sections: “NEW ROLE” with “{argument name="job title" default="Sales Representative"}”, “NEW TEAM” with “{argument name="team text" default="Same Paper"}”, and “NEW MEMORIES” with “{argument name="memories text" default="Let’s make some!"}”, each accented with small pink hearts. Along the bottom center, add a pink ribbon strip reading “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}♡”. Beneath that, include 3 small icon-and-text items in one row: sparkle icon with “NEW JOB”, group icon with “NEW TEAM”, and heart icon with “NEW MEMORIES”. At the bottom right, add large handwritten pink script saying “LET’S GO!”. Decorate the corners with pink peonies, tiny white filler flowers, torn paper edges, soft glitter dust, and subtle gold foil flecks. Use a warm rosy palette with blush pink, cream, gold, and black, with polished poster compositing, soft glam lighting, and a cheerful celebratory mood.
