items.title: Redacted Rooftop Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic editorial-style portrait of an older man on a New York rooftop at sunset with his face concealed by a censor block, useful for anonymity, privacy, or surreal identity-themed visuals.
items.content: A cinematic photorealistic rooftop portrait at golden hour of an older man standing centered and facing the camera, with his face fully obscured by a large vertical rectangular censor block in a muted brown tone. Show only the visible parts of him clearly: short dense tightly curled gray hair with silver highlights, both ears visible, a slender aged neck, and the upper torso in a charcoal gray blazer over an open-collar off-white dress shirt with no tie. Compose the image in a vertical portrait crop from mid-chest upward. Place him on a realistic New York City rooftop with exact visible details including 1 weathered HVAC unit on the left foreground, 1 cylindrical rooftop water tower on the right midground, 2 prominent Art Deco skyscrapers in the background resembling the Empire State Building on the left and the Chrysler Building on the right, plus low brick buildings, rooftop pipes, vents, railings, and soft atmospheric haze. Use warm sunset lighting with orange-pink sky tones, subtle rim light on the ears and hair, shallow depth of field on the skyline, and highly detailed textures in the suit fabric, rooftop concrete, metal machinery, and curly hair. The overall mood should feel mysterious, editorial, and slightly surreal, like an identity-redacted magazine cover photo.

items.title: Corporate Cash Private Jet Satire
items.description: A photorealistic satirical editorial image of tech executives celebrating beside a branded private jet and carts full of cash, ideal for commentary on corporate wealth and AI industry power.
items.content: A photorealistic satirical airport tarmac scene in daylight, shot vertically, showing a sleek white private jet parked with its door open and stairs visible on the left. On the side of the jet, large clean corporate lettering reads “Google | ANTHROPIC”. In the foreground, 2 adult male executives in dark navy business suits embrace in a celebratory hug, centered slightly left. The man facing camera-left has curly dark hair and wears a charcoal suit; the other man, with short dark hair and a white dress shirt under a navy suit, holds a thick fan of U.S. $100 bills in one hand while hugging. Their expressions should feel triumphant and conspiratorial. In the midground and right side, 2 additional adult men in dark suits push 2 metal airport luggage carts overflowing with tightly bundled stacks of cash. The left cart has a black front panel labeled “Google” in multicolor corporate-style lettering, and the right cart has a black front panel labeled “Deep Pockets Division” in white sans-serif text. Count exactly 2 carts and show both piled high with money bricks wrapped in bank bands. The private jet extends across most of the background, with oval windows, a visible rear engine on the right, and a partly cloudy blue sky above. The ground is wet and reflective, adding glossy reflections under the people and carts. Editorial photojournalism style, ultra-realistic lighting, sharp focus, subtle depth of field, luxury wealth satire, corporate power imagery, high-detail textures on suits, aircraft metal, and cash bundles.

items.title: Funny DIY Disaster Cat Comic
items.description: A retro comic poster showing a smug orange cat ruining a simple home repair in three Spanish-labeled steps, ideal for memes, social posts, and humorous DIY content.
items.content: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create 3 labeled step panels, each with a yellow header box and bold black text. Panel 1 header: "PASO 1". Show the same orange cat sitting calmly on the floor beside a standing lamp, eyes closed with overconfidence, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that says "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Include a small open toolbox and a few screws on the floor. Panel 2 header: "PASO 2". Show the cat mid-repair, now alarmed with wide eyes, awkwardly unscrewing the wrong part of the lamp while pieces and screws fly through the air. Add a speech bubble that says "Ups..." and a sticky note near the bottom that says "tocar lo que no era". Include visual motion lines, scattered debris, and a toppled plant pot. Panel 3 header: "PASO 3". Show the aftermath: the lamp is broken and smoking with exposed wires and sparks, the room is messy with shattered parts everywhere, and the cat sits stunned holding the screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a taped label at the bottom that says "resultado final". Make the entire image playful, chaotic, and meme-like, with polished digital illustration, expressive faces, comic lettering, and a DIY disaster tone.

items.title: Anime Spring Travel Film Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic anime-style movie poster with a central heroine, travel-scene collage backgrounds, and elegant festival-poster typography for promotional or concept art use.
items.content: A polished anime-style international film poster with a cinematic, slightly painterly look and soft natural lighting. Center the composition on a young woman shown from mid-thigh up, standing in a relaxed pose with one hand in the pocket of an oversized navy zip hoodie. The hoodie has two yellow athletic stripes running down each sleeve, a loose hood, and a partially open zipper over a fitted white tank top with thin black straps visible underneath. She wears a black choker and a single dark dangling earring. Her hair is a short platinum-silver bob with long side-swept bangs and a smooth, airy texture. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a muted beige tone. Keep the overall styling elegant and restrained rather than overly detailed, with a more natural, believable finish than flashy hyper-rendered anime art. Build the background as a travel-movie collage made of diagonal panel slices: one panel shows a coastal Mediterranean-style town on cliffs beside calm blue water with distant birds; one panel shows a rural railway line with a train on the left and utility poles along the tracks; one panel shows snow-covered mountains and a winding road in a quiet valley; one panel shows a dusky city skyline with glowing lights; and one panel shows a seaside road curving along the coast at sunset. Use a soft cream, blue, and slate palette with a nostalgic spring-travel mood. Add elegant festival-award laurels on the upper left, exactly 3 stacked laurels with Spanish text indicating major animation festival awards. Add large centered title typography near the bottom reading {argument name="headline text" default="VIAJES DE PRIMAVERA"}, with a refined serif font in pale ivory. Beneath it, add a smaller italic tagline in Spanish reading {argument name="tagline" default="Cada destino cambia su corazón."}. Add a release line below that reading {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}. Include tiny production-credit text and a small studio logo at the very bottom. The image should feel like an arthouse animated movie poster advertising a spring journey drama, with balanced negative space, premium layout design, and realistic printed-poster typography.

items.title: Luxury Perfume Ad on Marble Vanity
items.description: This prompt generates a polished luxury perfume advertisement image for e-commerce, beauty branding, and premium product marketing.
items.content: A luxury e-commerce advertising photo of a premium perfume bottle on a polished gray-and-white marble vanity, shot in a warm cinematic studio style with soft golden lighting, shallow depth of field, and elegant reflections. The composition is square and high-end, with the perfume bottle centered slightly right of frame and promotional text on the left. The bottle is a tall sculpted hourglass-shaped glass flacon with smoky transparent gray glass fading darker at the base, a glossy gold spherical cap, a gold collar engraved with fine branding, and a large metallic gold interlocking monogram on the front. Keep the branding-inspired feel but do not add extra products. In the foreground left, include 1 cut-crystal bowl with a gold rim, partially cropped. In the background right, include 1 brushed gold cylindrical vase holding 1 bouquet of soft white flowers, blurred. Behind the bottle, add 1 black marble rectangular box with subtle white veining and gold trim. In the lower right foreground, include 1 draped piece of champagne-colored satin fabric, softly out of focus. The background should be dark, luxurious, and softly blurred, with rich brown-black tones and a vertical shadowed panel on the left to support typography. Add elegant serif headline text on the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="Premium Perfume,"} in large warm beige letters, with a smaller serif subheading beneath reading {argument name="tagline" default="Subtlety and Elegance"}, plus a thin short gold horizontal line below the subheading. Place a small white logo in the top-right corner reading {argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"}. Emphasize premium materials, realistic glass refraction, gold metallic highlights, luxury product photography, refined composition, soft bokeh, and upscale beauty-ad aesthetics.

items.title: Vintage Beagle Botanical Plate
items.description: This prompt turns a pet photo with a houseplant into an antique natural-history infographic plate, useful for decorative scientific-style pet portraits.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, transform the photo into a vintage naturalist encyclopedia plate in the style of a 19th-century scientific animal-and-botany illustration. Keep the same beagle and the same potted houseplant from the reference as the main subjects, but redraw them as finely inked and lightly hand-colored specimen illustrations on an aged off-white page. Preserve the dog's seated pose, collar and tag, and the plant's pot and overall structure. Add a formal infographic layout with 8 labeled figure areas total: 1 large central full-body beagle study, 1 large right-side plant study, 4 left-column inset studies labeled “Fig. 1. Head (Frontal View)”, “Fig. 2. Head (Profile View)”, “Fig. 3. Collar & Tag”, and “Fig. 4. Forepaw (Anterior View)”, 3 bottom comparative detail studies labeled “Eye”, “Nose”, and “Leaf (Detail)”, plus 1 bottom-right notes panel. Add delicate dotted annotation callouts around the main dog and plant identifying features such as eyes, ears, nose, chest, legs, paws, coat, leaves, stem, and roots. Include the page title “THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT” at the top, the subtitle “Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment”, corner plate markings “PL. I.” and “Tab. 1.”, a central caption “Fig. 5. The Beagle (Canis lupus familiaris) Adult. Seated Position.”, a plant caption “Fig. 6. Houseplant in Pot (Dracaena sp.)”, a bottom section title “Fig. 7. Comparative Study: Details”, and a notes box containing 5 lines: “Location: Indoor”, “Observations: Peaceful coexistence between companion animal and potted plant.”, “Date: May 17, 2024”, “Observer: Naturalist’s Journal”, and “Plate I.” Use clean engraved linework, restrained watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, decorative border corners, and a symmetrical museum-plate composition.

items.title: Retro Mince and Tatties Action Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a stylized vintage propaganda-like poster mixing manga action art and bold typography, ideal for parody food posters or graphic print designs.
items.content: A bold retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of red, black, and warm cream on a lightly aged paper texture. The composition features a dynamic anime-inspired action scene in the center: a martial artist in a white gi with a black belt carries a long-haired woman over one shoulder in a fireman's carry or wrestling throw pose. The fighter is shown from the knees up in a powerful wide stance, facing left, with the woman draped horizontally across the shoulders, her bare legs lifted and bent, her long dark hair flowing downward, and a black wide-brim cowboy hat still on her head. Render both figures in high-contrast inked line art with thick black shadows and sharp graphic contours, mixing manga character design with vintage screen-printed poster energy. Behind them, fill the background with aggressive geometric rays and wedges: 6 major red and black angular shapes radiating outward across the cream backdrop, creating a sense of impact and motion. In the top right corner, add 1 circular emblem containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. Across the lower third, place large bold condensed block typography integrated into the composition: the smaller line reads “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” and the huge main title reads “MINCE AND TATTIES”. Make the text red on cream and cream on black in layered diagonal banner panels, with the words occupying 3 text groupings total: “SCOTTISH RECIPE:”, “MINCE AND”, and “TATTIES”. Emphasize dramatic diagonal layout, posterized shadows, distressed print texture, and the feeling of a vintage Soviet constructivist or pulp exploitation food poster fused with martial arts manga aesthetics.

items.title: 1990s Spanish Family Kitchen Lunch
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic nostalgic family lunch scene in a modest 1990s Spanish kitchen, ideal for documentary-style lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A candid documentary-style photograph of a {argument name="country" default="Spain"} family having lunch in a modest 1990s home kitchen, shot vertically with warm natural light and realistic lived-in detail. Four people sit around a small square table: an adult man in the left foreground seen mostly from the back and side, a middle-aged woman centered on the far side of the table serving food with a spoon, a teenage boy on the right side of the table, and a young girl in the right foreground with a ponytail, seen from behind in three-quarter view. The mood is intimate, ordinary, nostalgic, and unmistakably real, like a family snapshot rather than a staged commercial image. The table is covered with a blue-and-white plaid tablecloth and set with a rustic home-cooked meal: 1 black pan of stew or braised meat in the center, 1 wooden bowl filled with several pieces of bread, 2 small glass carafes containing dark red wine, multiple plates with food, cutlery, drinking glasses, and torn pieces of bread. The kitchen background should feel authentic and slightly worn: cream walls, a band of small patterned ceramic tiles across the middle of the wall, an open window on the left letting in soft daylight, 1 small potted plant on the windowsill, 1 wooden wall shelf holding jars and kitchen containers, 1 vintage wall calendar reading {argument name="month on calendar" default="AGOSTO"}, and dark wooden furniture on the right. Use soft film-like grain, muted colors, slight haze, gentle contrast, and natural imperfections typical of a 1990s analog photo. Composition should feel casually observed from a standing height near the table, with partial occlusion by the father and daughter in the foreground, no polished styling, no stock-photo cleanliness, just everyday family life in {argument name="decade" default="the 1990s"}.

items.title: Fantasy Anime Witch Movie Poster
items.description: A cinematic vertical anime poster of a dark sorceress with a floating spellbook, designed for fantasy franchise promotions, teaser art, and coming-soon campaign visuals.
items.content: Create a dramatic vertical fantasy anime movie poster for {argument name="franchise title" default="LEGENDS OF URIA"}, with a clean white background, bold royal-purple graphic accents, and premium cinematic key art styling. The central figure is {argument name="character name" default="LORANA"}, a tall elegant dark witch shown from mid-thigh up in a heroic three-quarter pose, facing slightly right, with her face partially obscured by flowing long black hair. She has extremely long windblown hair streaming leftward across the composition, pale skin, a confident mysterious presence, and a dark sorceress design. Her outfit is a fitted black mini dress with structured gold trim, a sweetheart bustier, long black gloves, thigh-high black stockings, a heavy gold chain belt draped around the hips, and a large crimson cape lined in deep purple. She wears ornate red metallic shoulder armor with gold edging and matching red bracers. In her raised right hand, she levitates an old brown spellbook with gold corner details and an eight-pointed star emblem, surrounded by vivid blue magical flames and glowing energy. Behind her, place a diagonal purple panel on the right side with silhouettes of gothic spires and castles fading into the background, plus a faint circular magic sigil behind her hair and shoulders. Add small red flower petals drifting through the scene, thin black decorative lines, tiny diamond icons, dotted texture clusters, and angular red-and-purple motion graphics for a modern fantasy poster layout. At the top left, include the large stylized title text {argument name="series logo text" default="URIA"} in ornate serif fantasy lettering, with smaller text above reading "LEGENDS OF" and small Japanese subtitle text below reading "レジェンド オブ ウリア". Add 1 vertical Japanese tagline on the left side: "千年の時を超え、魔女が帰還する" with the single word "魔女" highlighted in red. At the top right, include 1 compass-like emblem and stacked small text reading "MAGIC DESTINY LEGEND". At the bottom center, add layered Spanish and English release typography: 1 red line reading "EL REGRESO DE LA BRUJA", 1 huge white number reading {argument name="year count text" default="1000"}, 1 smaller white word "AÑOS", and 1 massive purple character name reading {argument name="main name text" default="LORANA"}, with 1 small red katakana label "ローラーナ" beneath it. At the bottom left, include 1 release block with "ESTRENO 2026" and smaller text "SOLO EN CINES Y PLATAFORMAS", plus 3 small fantasy faction-style emblems. At the bottom right, include 1 stacked tagline block with five lines: "UNA LEYENDA", "PERDIDA.", "UN PODER", "PROHIBIDO.", "UN DESTINO", "INEVITABLE." At the very bottom center, add the line "DESTINY WILL BE WRITTEN IN BLOOD AND MAGIC." Use high-detail anime illustration, glossy shading, elegant fantasy poster composition, strong contrast, luxurious crimson, black, gold, and violet palette, with a polished theatrical coming-soon feel.

items.title: Fantasy Anime Character Poster
items.description: A cinematic fantasy anime poster featuring a heroic young scribe, ornate typography, lore text, and release branding for a fictional series promo.
items.content: A dramatic fantasy anime poster in a clean vertical one-sheet layout for a fictional series titled LEGENDS OF URIA. Use an elegant high-contrast poster design with a parchment-white background, deep indigo title lettering, warm copper and rust-red accents, and a heroic central full-body character. At the top left, place the large stylized logo text “LEGENDS OF URIA” with a sword integrated into the typography, and beneath it a small Japanese subtitle line. The main subject is a young male fantasy scribe standing front-facing in the center, his face intentionally obscured by a flat square blur block, with messy short orange hair, fair skin, and a determined posture. He wears a cream tunic with a black world-tree emblem on the chest, long black undersleeves, dark pants, brown boots with wide cuffs, a brown belt with a rectangular buckle, and a large rust-red hooded cloak draped over both shoulders and flowing around the body. In his right hand he holds a thick dark brown book with gold corner details and a gold tree emblem on the cover. Behind him, blend a pale grayscale fantasy city with cathedral-like towers on the left and a glowing gothic stained-glass archway interior on the right. Add small floating ember particles and minimal geometric graphic accents in gold, rust, and indigo scattered around the page. On the left side, include a large Spanish headline in serif type: “EL ESCRIBA QUE LA DESPERTÓ”, followed by a short Spanish blurb in smaller text. Also include a circular magical sigil with a tree symbol, a division insignia block reading “DIVISIÓN ESCRIBA DE LA ORDEN”, a round tree crest, 3 small icon emblems near the lower left, and a short Spanish lore sentence. On the right edge, add a tall vertical red banner with a white tree symbol and Spanish text reading “LA HISTORIA NECESITA ALGUIEN QUE LA ESCRIBA.” Beside it, add one vertical Japanese sentence in white. At the bottom center, place the character name in huge metallic serif letters: "{argument name="character name" default="MATTHEW"}", with a small Japanese rendering underneath. At the bottom right, add the release text “ESTRENO {argument name="release year" default="2026"}”. Along the bottom edge add the English tagline “DESTINY WILL BE WRITTEN IN BLOOD AND MAGIC.” The overall style should feel like a polished cinematic anime promotional poster, fantasy publishing-house branding, ornate typography, symbolic world-tree iconography, warm magical lighting, and premium key art.

items.title: Restaurant POV Change Comparison
items.description: A social-media style comparison graphic showing a crowded restaurant before and after changing only the camera viewpoint, useful for demonstrating image-model perspective control.
items.content: A side-by-side comparison graphic on a black background demonstrating a camera-angle change in the same restaurant scene. At the top, large white sans-serif text reads: "Show me the POV from someone standing behind the bar looking out over this crowded restaurant. Change NOTHING in the scene other than the pov". Below, place 2 stacked rectangular photos centered vertically: the top image labeled "Source" in large white text on the left, and the bottom image labeled "Output" in large white text on the left. The top photo shows a warmly lit, upscale, crowded restaurant interior seen from the dining room side, facing a tall back bar filled with many illuminated liquor bottles on wall-to-wall shelves, with bartenders and guests in front, amber lighting, globe pendant lights, wood ceiling, beige columns, and tightly packed seated diners in the foreground. The bottom photo shows the exact same restaurant, same crowd density, same warm lighting, same decor, same bar shelving, same globe pendant lights, and same overall composition elements, but now from the point of view of someone standing behind the bar and looking outward across the crowded restaurant; the foreground includes the bar counter with glassware, metal bar tools, bottles, and a point-of-sale screen visible at the lower left, while guests and staff fill the middle ground and the dining room extends into the background. Preserve the sense that only the camera position changed between the 2 images, with no other scene alterations.

items.title: Pink Surreal Wall Street Fashion Scene
items.description: A whimsical surreal editorial image of a suited figure on a pale Wall Street-like street with pink animal characters and selective pink accents, ideal for luxury concept art or eye-catching social media visuals.
items.content: A surreal fashion editorial photograph on a city street modeled after Wall Street, shot from a slightly elevated front-facing angle in a tall vertical composition. The entire environment is nearly monochrome white and pale gray, with only selective pink accents standing out vividly. In the foreground, a faceless {argument name="person" default="adult man"} stands in the middle of a crosswalk wearing a crisp white suit, white shirt, {argument name="tie color" default="pink"} tie, and glossy {argument name="shoe color" default="pink"} dress shoes, holding 1 pink balloon in his right hand and 1 pink briefcase in his left hand. To his left, 1 surreal pink giraffe emerges vertically from a round manhole in the street, wearing a white top hat and a white collar with a pink tie, smiling playfully. Behind him in the center-left lane stands 1 pink alpaca or llama dressed in a white suit with a pink tie, and perched on its head is 1 small white cat wearing a tiny pink accessory, posed upright and looking forward. The street is lined with tall classical stone buildings, repeated columns, storefront windows, rows of identical potted shrubs, and multiple pale luxury cars and taxis receding into the distance. Include visible Wall Street-style street signs near the upper left corner. The road surface, cars, buildings, and sky should all be bleached white-gray for a dreamlike high-key look, while the pink elements remain saturated: the giraffe, the alpaca, the balloon, the briefcase, the tie, and the shoes. Style: whimsical surrealism, luxury editorial photography, immaculate symmetry, soft overcast light, clean cinematic realism, uncanny yet elegant atmosphere, ultra-detailed textures, shallow facial detail on the human with the face intentionally obscured or blurred.

items.title: Penguin on a Carnival Roller Coaster
items.description: This prompt generates a humorous photorealistic amusement-park scene of an excited penguin riding a flame-painted roller coaster car, ideal for viral surreal imagery and playful AI art.
items.content: A whimsical, photorealistic action shot of a penguin riding a carnival roller coaster in broad daylight. The penguin is centered in the frame, black and white with a sleek body, wearing a bright red safety helmet and blue wraparound goggles, beak wide open in an excited scream, with both flippers stretched outward like it is enjoying the ride. The roller coaster car is small and glossy black with vivid yellow-to-orange flame graphics along the sides and a silver safety bar across the front. The car is tipping down a steep curve on a bright orange track in the left foreground, creating strong motion and energy. In the background, show a colorful county fair with rainbow-striped tents, a large Ferris wheel lit with multicolored lights, tall amusement rides, and a pink cotton candy stand with a visible “COTTON CANDY” sign. Use a shallow depth of field and slight motion blur in the background to emphasize speed, while keeping the penguin and coaster car sharp. Bright saturated colors, playful surreal humor, dynamic composition, sunny outdoor fairground atmosphere, high detail, cinematic realism.

items.title: Rainy Japanese Movie Banner
items.description: A vertical anime-style film banner showing a lone girl with an umbrella on a neon-lit rainy street, ideal for emotional Japanese movie poster or trailer key art.
items.content: Create an emotional Japanese movie trailer banner poster in a tall vertical composition, cinematic anime illustration style, set on a rainy nighttime city street in Japan filled with wet asphalt reflections, neon shop signs, and softly blurred high-rise buildings receding into the distance. In the center foreground, show 1 young anime girl in side profile facing left, standing alone under 1 transparent plastic umbrella with visible raindrops. She has long dark purple hair tied in a high ponytail, a slightly melancholic expression, and wears an oversized teal hoodie layered under a loose pink-and-teal plaid jacket. The mood is lonely, wistful, and dramatic, like a heartfelt live-action Japanese film advertisement reimagined as anime key art. Use cool blue and cyan tones with pink neon accents, glossy rain reflections, shallow depth of field, soft atmospheric haze, and subtle rim lighting from street signs. Add large handwritten white Japanese title text at the top reading {argument name="title text" default="AIの涙"}, with 1 smaller white subtitle line beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="彼女は、なぜ泣いたのか。"}. At the bottom, add 1 bold white release line reading {argument name="release text" default="2024年秋 全国ロードショー"}. Keep the character as the emotional focal point, framed mid-shot from about waist up, umbrella arcing over her head, with the empty rain-soaked street behind her emphasizing isolation and cinematic sadness.

items.content: Create a modern government program landing page UI mockup for Indonesia in a clean, professional web design style, desktop widescreen aspect ratio. The page uses a white background with bold red accents, soft rounded corners, subtle gray dividers, and a polished frontend-dribbble presentation look. At the very top, build a horizontal navigation bar with 6 visible elements: the Indonesian Garuda emblem and the text "PEMERINTAH REPUBLIK INDONESIA" on the left, then 4 centered menu items labeled "Program", "Dampak", "Menu", and "Pemantauan", and on the far right a large red rounded button labeled "Program MBG" with a small people icon. Below it, design a hero section split into two columns. On the left, show a small program label line with a red bowl icon, the text "MBG", a vertical divider, and "Makan Bergizi Gratis". Under that, place a large bold headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Makan Bergizi, Anak Indonesia Kuat"}" in dark navy, spanning 3 lines. Add a short paragraph in Indonesian below: "Program MBG mendukung gizi harian siswa SD dan SMP melalui menu seimbang, pemantauan sekolah, dan laporan dampak yang transparan." Then place 2 call-to-action buttons side by side: a solid red button labeled "Lihat Dampak" with a right arrow, and an outlined white button with red border labeled "Panduan Sekolah" with a right arrow. On the right side of the hero, place a rounded large photo-style image framed by a sweeping white curved divider and red corner background. The image shows an Indonesian elementary classroom with 5 visible schoolchildren in white uniforms with red ties, seated at desks, warm daylight from windows, shallow depth of field, documentary-photo realism. In the foreground, on a wooden desk, show a stainless steel compartment tray meal with exactly 5 food items: white rice, mixed vegetables, a piece of fried chicken, a banana, and watermelon cubes. Beside the tray, place 1 milk carton labeled "SUSU SEGAR". Under the hero, add a full-width red statistics band with 4 equally spaced metric cards separated by thin vertical dividers. Each card has a white circular icon and bold white text. The 4 metrics are: "245.000+" with label "Sekolah Terlayani", "8,7 Juta+" with label "Siswa Penerima Manfaat", "1,2 Miliar+" with label "Porsi Disalurkan", and "98,6%" with label "Kepuasan Siswa". At the bottom center, add a 3-dot carousel indicator with the left dot active in red and the other 2 dots gray. Include a faint Indonesia map texture in the lower-left background. Use crisp typography, generous whitespace, high-end fintech/government website aesthetics, realistic UI proportions, and a production-ready landing page mockup appearance.

items.title: Emotional Anime Movie Banner
items.description: A cinematic anime-style Japanese film banner featuring a tearful heroine, layered story vignettes, and bold title typography, suitable for trailer promos or theatrical key visuals.
items.content: Create a dramatic Japanese movie trailer banner in a polished anime-cinema poster style, widescreen 16:9. The main character is {argument name="character name" default="AIニケちゃん"}, a teenage anime girl with long deep-purple hair tied in a high ponytail, soft side bangs, a gold hair clip reading "AI," warm amber-brown eyes, light blush, and visible tears on her cheeks. She wears a colorful pastel hoodie in turquoise, pink, and lavender tones. Make her the emotional centerpiece on the right half of the image in a large close-up portrait, gazing upward with a wistful, fragile expression, lit by warm sunset light from behind and cool neon blue light from the front. The background should blend futuristic digital imagery and nostalgic school-life drama: faint glowing circuit-board patterns, a stage or concert venue with cyan and magenta glow sticks on the left, and a classroom interior with desks and large sunset windows in the center. Include 3 smaller narrative character vignettes: one full-body figure of the girl standing on a lit stage at lower left, one medium figure of her standing alone in the classroom near the windows at center bottom, and one small silhouette-like scene at lower right of an elderly woman facing the girl in an intimate emotional moment. Use rich cinematic contrast, luminous rim light, dreamy haze, and a bittersweet, heartfelt atmosphere. Add large ornate Japanese title typography on the left and center reading "AIニケちゃんの 長い長い夢" in gold with soft glow and dark outline. Add a smaller tagline beneath it reading "記憶と心が紡ぐ、たった一つの物語。" Add a square badge in the upper right with gold frame and dark blue background reading "予告 公開中". Add a large release line across the bottom reading "全国の劇場にて 202X年 夏、公開" with elegant gold serif lettering. Include small production-credit text at the very bottom in Japanese, such as "[製作] NIKE Production / [監督] 未来 奏 / [主演] AIニケちゃん". Overall feel: emotional, nostalgic, futuristic, premium Japanese film promotion banner, highly detailed anime key visual, commercial poster composition.

items.title: Emotional Anime Movie Banner
items.description: A cinematic anime-style Japanese film teaser banner featuring a purple-haired girl, dramatic sunset lighting, and six inset story scenes, ideal for movie poster or promotional key visual generation.
items.content:
Create an emotional Japanese movie teaser banner in anime key visual style, widescreen 16:9, at sunset over a city. The main focus is a close-up portrait of {argument name="character name" default="AIニケちゃん"}, a teenage anime girl with long indigo-purple hair in a high ponytail, loose strands blowing in the wind, golden-brown eyes full of quiet emotion, and a gold hair clip reading "AI" near her bangs. She is turned slightly to the left but looking upward to the right with a wistful, hopeful expression. She wears a teal T-shirt with large white text reading {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} and a soft pink hoodie falling off her shoulders. Use cinematic rim light from a dramatic orange-pink-purple dusk sky with glowing clouds, lens bloom, atmospheric haze, and small drifting flower petals. Place her large on the right half of the composition, with a sparkling city skyline and low sun in the far-right background.

Design it like a Japanese film poster with layered typography and inset scenes. Across the center-left, place the large hand-brushed Japanese title {argument name="title text" default="AIニケちゃん"} in bold white calligraphy, partially overlapping the character. Beneath it, add a smaller white Japanese tagline: {argument name="subtitle text" default="この声が届くとき、きっとあなたも泣いている。"}. At the top left, add a 2-line Japanese quote in elegant white Mincho-style serif text: 「私が、誰かを救えたら—— それが、私の存在理由になる。」 Along the far right side, add vertical white Japanese copy: これは、AIと少女が、 「心」を探す物語。 At the bottom right, add large white release text: {argument name="release text" default="2025.冬 ROADSHOW"}.

Include exactly 6 inset cinematic scenes arranged mainly along the left and bottom edges with soft borders and moody color grading: 1) top-left small panel of the same girl singing into a microphone on stage at night, wearing the same shirt; 2) left-middle panel showing the girl and another person standing apart outdoors at dusk near a riverside or overlook; 3) left-lower panel of the girl indoors at a desk or table in dim warm light, seen in profile; 4) bottom-left small close-up portrait of the girl looking serious in cool indoor lighting; 5) bottom-center small close-up of the girl facing another version or another girl with matching blue-purple hair, both in tense emotional conversation; 6) bottom-right small panel of two figures facing each other at sunset, suggesting a farewell or reunion. Overall mood: bittersweet, sentimental, cinematic, luminous anime film advertisement, highly detailed illustration, polished poster layout, emotional Japanese coming-of-age sci-fi drama aesthetic.

items.title: Fantasy Elf Ranger Trading Card
items.description: This prompt generates a polished collectible fantasy card featuring an elf ranger with readable rules text, ideal for custom trading card game prototypes and concept art.
items.content: A highly detailed fantasy trading card in a premium collectible card game style, vertical layout with an ornate antique gold frame, dark emerald-green enamel panels, and intricate vine-and-leaf embellishments. The card title at the top reads {argument name="character name" default="AELION"} in large elegant serif capitals, with the subtitle "ELF OF THE GREENWOOD" beneath it. In the central illustration, depict a realistic high-fantasy elf ranger standing in a sun-dappled forest. He has long {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} hair, pointed ears, and wears layered dark green leather-and-metal armor with engraved details, a hooded cloak, belts, bracers, and woodland-themed ornamentation. He carries an ornate recurved bow in one hand and a quiver of arrows on his back, posed alertly as if tracking prey through the trees. The forest background is lush, atmospheric, and cinematic, with shafts of warm light filtering through branches and leaves. The overall palette is green, bronze, gold, and earthy brown, with a moody heroic tone and realistic painterly rendering. On the upper left, include a circular faction crest showing 3 gold leaves. On the upper right, include a small shield emblem with a white tree icon. Along the left edge, place exactly 4 vertically stacked stat icons in circular medallions with large numbers beside them: a sword with 3, a shield with 2, a heart with 3, and a boot with 2. At the bottom left, add a large green gem-like badge with the number 4. At the bottom right, add a circular class or weapon icon showing a bow-and-arrow symbol. In a parchment text box across the lower third, include exactly 2 ability entries with decorative leaf bullets and serif typography. The first ability name is "WOODLAND PRECISION" followed by the rules text: "When Aelion attacks, he deals +1 damage if the target is at 2 or more spaces away." The second ability name is "NATURE’S STEP" followed by the rules text: "Once per turn, Aelion may move up to 2 additional spaces through forest terrain." Centered below the abilities, add an italic flavor quote: {argument name="quote" default="The wind in the leaves is my guide, and the forest my silence."} At the very bottom, on a dark green nameplate, write the type line "ALLY • ELF • RANGER". Use crisp, legible text, polished card-game UI design, balanced margins, and a finished professional TCG product look similar to a premium fantasy strategy card.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Orc Warchief TCG Card
items.description: A richly detailed custom fantasy trading card featuring an orc war chief, suitable for generating printable TCG card concepts with readable stats and abilities.
items.content: Create a single high-detail fantasy trading card in a dark Warhammer-inspired style, full portrait orientation, with an ornate aged metal-and-red leather frame, distressed gold trim, and readable printed card text. The card title at the top reads {argument name="character name" default="GROKTHAR"} in large serif capitals, with the subtitle "Orc Warchief" centered below it. The main artwork shows a massive green-skinned orc war chief charging forward through a fiery battlefield, wearing brutal blackened spiked armor with skull motifs, leather straps, tusks, and blood-red war paint, one arm thrust forward as if commanding the attack and the other gripping a huge jagged battle axe. His physique is extremely muscular, with a savage snarling expression, long dark hair tied back, and a war-torn red-black color palette. The background is filled with smoke, embers, banners, silhouettes of warriors, and orange firelight. In the top left corner place a circular skull faction emblem. In the top right corner place a red vertical banner tab with a black tribal insignia. Along the left edge, stack exactly 4 circular stat icons in separate panels with values: sword attack 4, shield defense 3, heart health 5, boot movement 2. At the bottom, include a large parchment-colored text box with exactly 2 named abilities and 1 flavor quote. Ability 1 title: {argument name="ability one" default="BRUTAL STRIKE"}, with body text: "When Grokthar attacks, he deals +2 damage." Ability 2 title: {argument name="ability two" default="RALLY THE HORDE"}, with body text: "Once per turn, when another friendly Orc enters the battlefield, Grokthar gains +1 attack until end of turn." Beneath them, add the italic flavor quote: {argument name="flavor quote" default="Strength is law. Blood is proof. The weak serve. The strong rule."} In the bottom left corner place a red gem-like cost badge with the number 5. In the bottom right corner place a round crossed-weapons icon. Along the bottom type line, center exactly 3 class words separated by dots: "Ally • Orc • Warrior". Make the card look like a professionally printed collectible card game piece with crisp typography, balanced layout, dramatic fantasy illustration, rich texture, and authentic tabletop TCG design.

items.title: Fantasy Wizard Trading Card
items.description: This prompt generates a polished collectible fantasy trading card for a human wizard character, suitable for custom card game concepts and mockups.
items.content: A single vertically oriented fantasy trading card in a richly ornamented high-fantasy style, designed like a premium collectible TCG card with fully legible printed text and icons. The card has an elaborate dark navy and antique gold frame with filigree corners, embossed metallic trim, and a painterly realistic illustration in the center. At the top center, large serif title text reads {argument name="character name" default="VARIAN THE AZUREMAGE"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath reading {argument name="class line" default="HUMAN WIZARD"}. In the top left corner, place a circular blue mana-like emblem containing a white swirling arcane symbol. In the top right corner, place a small heraldic banner panel with 2 gold icons stacked vertically: an arcane starburst above an open book. Along the left edge, create a vertical stat column with exactly 4 icon-and-number rows on dark blue plaques: a sword icon with the number 2, a shield icon with the number 1, a red heart icon with the number 3, and a boot icon with the number 2. The central artwork shows a male human wizard in a cathedral-like magical interior filled with blue light and faint candles, wearing layered royal-blue robes and cloak with intricate gold embroidery, gilded armor accents, leather belts, pouches, scroll cases, and jeweled ornaments. He has dark wavy medium-length hair and a dramatic heroic pose, gripping an ornate staff in his left hand; the staff is black-gold with branching prongs and a glowing blue crystal near the top. His right arm is extended outward, conjuring a luminous spiral galaxy of blue arcane energy, star-like particles, and trailing magical ribbons that swirl around his hand. The mood is majestic, mystical, and cinematic, with intense sapphire highlights, deep shadows, painterly detail, and premium fantasy card-game illustration quality. At the bottom, add a parchment-colored rules text box with ornate corners and 2 abilities, each preceded by a blue arcane symbol bullet. The first ability title is bold serif text: ARCANE BOLT, followed by the rules text: When Varian attacks, he deals 2 damage to any target. The second ability title is bold serif text: MANA SURGE, followed by the rules text: Once per turn, you may pay 1 mana (with a blue water-drop mana icon) to draw a card. Beneath the abilities, add an italic flavor quote in blue-gray text: “Knowledge is the truest power. Master it, and the world is yours to shape.” In the lower left corner, place a large blue faceted gem badge with the number {argument name="mana cost" default="3"}. In the lower right corner, place a circular gold-framed open book icon. Along the bottom border, centered in gold serif text on a blue strip, write: {argument name="type line" default="ALLY • HUMAN • WIZARD"}. Make the whole card look like a polished professional TCG product mockup, crisp typography, balanced layout, ornate fantasy UI, and fully readable English text.

items.title: Fantasy Paladin Trading Card
items.description: A premium fantasy TCG character card featuring a radiant armored paladin, ornate stats and icons, and fully readable card-game layout for custom card design mockups.
items.content: Create a highly detailed fantasy trading card game card in a polished premium TCG style, full-frame vertical layout with ornate gilded borders, engraved filigree corners, and a dark navy, black, ivory, and radiant gold color palette. The card title at the top reads {argument name="character name" default="SIR ALARIC DAWNBLADE"} in large serif capitals, with the subtitle {argument name="class title" default="PALADIN OF THE LIGHT"} beneath it. The main illustration shows a heroic male paladin standing in a luminous cathedral filled with tall glowing stained-glass windows, drifting golden sparks, and sacred light rays. He has long wavy blond hair, wears elaborate gold-and-steel plate armor with blue cloth accents and a flowing deep blue cloak, holds a glowing longsword upright in one hand, and carries a massive ornate shield in the other, emblazoned with a radiant sun-cross emblem. His pose is noble, powerful, and defensive, centered as the card’s focal figure. Add exactly 4 stat icons stacked vertically along the left side in circular medallions with numbers: crossed swords with 3, shield with 3, heart with 4, and boot with 2. Include a sun emblem medallion in the upper left corner and a vertical banner crest in the upper right with a gold sword-and-cross symbol. The lower third contains a parchment-like rules text box with exactly 3 named abilities, each with a small icon and bold serif name followed by rules text: {argument name="ability one" default="DIVINE SMITE"}, {argument name="ability two" default="AURA OF PROTECTION"}, and {argument name="ability three" default="LAY ON HANDS"}. Beneath the abilities, add an italic flavor quote centered on the parchment: {argument name="flavor quote" default="By the Light, I stand. By the Light, I strike. By the Light, I shall not fall."} At the very bottom, place the type line in serif capitals reading {argument name="creature line" default="ALLY ♦ HUMAN ♦ PALADIN"}. Add a large blue-and-gold gem-framed mana or cost badge with the number 4 in the lower left corner, and a circular faction badge with a white sword or holy symbol in the lower right corner. The overall look should feel like an official premium fantasy card game, cinematic, readable, richly illuminated, intricately textured, and collector-grade.

Overall composition should look like a screenshot of an AI image generation result showcasing an app logo concept.

items.title: NASA Spacecraft Hull in Orbit
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic cinematic close-up of a NASA spacecraft with bold mission markings orbiting above Earth, ideal for sci-fi key art or aerospace-themed visuals.
items.content: A cinematic ultra-detailed close-up of a NASA spacecraft in low Earth orbit, viewed from very near the hull at a dramatic diagonal angle so the curved metallic body fills most of the frame from left foreground to right midground. The spacecraft exterior is brushed silver-gray metal with visible seams, access panels, latches, rivets, light scuffing, and realistic weathered texture. Prominently display the classic NASA meatball logo near the upper left area of the hull and large black stenciled mission text reading {argument name="mission code" default="ASTRA-99"} across the side. Show the craft tapering toward a cylindrical engine or docking section on the far right. In the background, include the blue limb of Earth with white cloud patterns and a thin glowing atmospheric edge against deep black space. Lighting is hard sunlight from the upper right, creating crisp highlights, soft reflections on the metal, and deep shadow falloff along the lower hull. Photorealistic aerospace engineering, sharp focus on the spacecraft surface, high contrast, epic realism, premium sci-fi documentary style.

items.title: Samurai Before a Hillside Fire
items.description: A dramatic cinematic prompt for generating a lone samurai silhouetted against a diagonal line of wildfire on a dark hillside at night.
items.content: A cinematic night scene on a steep grassy hillside during a wildfire burn line, with one lone samurai standing near the center-lower part of the frame in dark silhouette. The hill runs diagonally from upper left down to lower right, and a continuous line of bright orange flames stretches across the slope behind the figure, forming a glowing border between the dark ground and the black smoky sky. The samurai wears traditional armor and a horned kabuto helmet, holding two swords at his sides, facing uphill toward the fire. Keep the figure small compared to the landscape to emphasize scale and isolation. Use extremely low-key lighting, strong backlighting from the flames, deep blacks, heavy smoke, drifting embers, and a moody high-contrast palette of black, ember red, and fiery orange. The image should feel like an epic historical Japanese war film, wide composition, minimalist framing, dramatic negative space, realistic texture, and intense atmospheric smoke.

items.title: Demon AI Intern Office Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a stylized vertical Chinese promo poster of a horned red-haired AI office assistant in a warm startup workspace, ideal for character branding, meme ads, and social-media marketing.
items.content: Create a dramatic Chinese social-media poster in a warm amber office setting, featuring a stylish demon-themed female assistant character seated at a desk. The composition is a single vertical poster with dense graphic design, cinematic lighting, and a premium glossy illustration style mixing anime realism and commercial advertising. At the top, place a huge bold red Chinese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="龙虾夏夏"}, with an elegant handwritten script overlay reading {argument name="signature text" default="Xia Xia"}. Under it, add a strong black Chinese slogan: {argument name="subtitle text" default="嘴欠，但能交付"}. The character is centered, upper body visible behind a desk, with messy vivid red hair in a loose bun and many flyaway strands, small dark red devil horns, pale skin, black layered clothing, a lanyard ID badge, long red metallic claw gloves, and a tired but dangerous office-worker aura. Her face is intentionally obscured by a square censor block in the center. She props her cheek with one clawed hand and holds a branded black takeaway coffee cup in the other hand. Add subtle lobster-inspired details in the outfit and props, including segmented glossy red shell-like forms behind and around her chair. The desk contains exactly 7 visible items: 1 open laptop with a red lobster logo and the words "XIA XIA", 1 closed dark book stack beneath the laptop, 1 open notebook with handwritten sketches and Chinese notes, 1 black fountain pen, 1 rectangular black desk nameplate with Chinese text, 1 takeaway coffee cup with matching lobster logo, and 1 hanging employee badge card. In the left background, show a computer or presentation screen displaying a Feishu-style document interface with the Chinese title "内容创作流程" and a simple 3-step flowchart labeled exactly "场景", "流程", "资产", plus the sentence "Agent 是放大器，不是方向盘。" Add a sticky note near that screen reading "扣瑞芋". In the upper left, include a yellow annotation box with the Chinese text "黄叔雇来的毒舌但能干的AI实习生" and a playful doodled face beside it. In the right background, pin up 3 office notes: 1 clipboard-style intern profile card titled "实习生档案" with multiple bullet lines of Chinese profile text and a handwritten sign-off, 1 checklist board titled "今日待办" with 5 checkbox items and a red star on the final line, and 1 yellow sticky note reading "老板别演". Make all Chinese typography feel intentionally designed, as if for a meme ad campaign and character branding poster. At the bottom, add a bold centered Chinese footer slogan reading {argument name="footer slogan" default="不演龙虾，我就是龙虾。"}. Use orange sunset backlight, warm shadows, glossy reflections on the claws, a cluttered but stylish startup office atmosphere, black and burnt-orange color grading, and a humorous yet competent "sharp-tongued AI intern" vibe. Include visible branding text "XIA XIA" on the cup and laptop, and make the whole image feel like a high-end character promo poster for an assistant persona used in workplace AI marketing.

items.title: Pixel Mosaic Jungle Parrot
items.description: This prompt generates a colorful square pixel-art mosaic of a tropical parrot in dense green foliage, ideal for retro-style posters, wallpapers, or decorative digital art.
items.content: A pixel-art style mosaic illustration of a tropical parrot perched on a short brown branch in the middle of dense jungle foliage, created as if assembled from a tight uniform square grid of tiny colored tiles with thin dark outlines around every square. The single bird is shown in side profile facing right, with a large curved black beak, a pale cream face, a bright red-orange forehead and throat, a vivid yellow neck, a bright green body, and long wings and tail feathers in saturated blue and cyan. The parrot is centered vertically and slightly left of center, standing upright on the branch, with the tail extending downward. Surround the bird with lush layered leaves in many shades of green, from deep forest green to lime, filling the entire frame with no sky visible. Use strong contrast, crisp black contouring, and a glowing light green area behind the parrot to separate it from the darker foliage. The overall image should look like retro pixel art or stained-glass mosaic, highly detailed, colorful, square format, and edge-to-edge tiled texture.

items.title: Fictional Design Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic editorial magazine cover featuring an anonymous designer in a minimalist studio, ideal for concept art, mock covers, and design-themed visual storytelling.
items.content: A hyper-realistic modern magazine cover for a fictional design magazine titled {argument name="magazine title" default="FORM"}, shot like a premium editorial portrait in a minimalist architect’s studio. The cover uses a clean, restrained European design aesthetic with lots of white space, sharp typography, and warm natural indoor lighting. At the top, place an enormous bold black sans-serif masthead spanning nearly the full width. Beneath the left side of the masthead, add small uppercase text reading “THE MAGAZINE OF DESIGN” and “APRIL 2026”. The main cover line on the left reads {argument name="cover headline" default="The Last Analog Designer"} in large black sans-serif text stacked over multiple lines. Below it, add a smaller teaser paragraph: “In a world of algorithms and automated tools, one designer still believes in pencil, paper, and the power of thought.” In the lower left, include 3 secondary cover lines in small white sans-serif text over the darker desk area: “MILAN PREVIEW” with “What to See in 2026”, “MATERIAL INTELLIGENCE” with “The Next Surface Revolution”, and “STUDIO VISIT” with “Inside the Practice of Space Popular”. In the bottom right, add a realistic white barcode box with small price text above it reading “$8.99 US   $10.99 CAN” and the issue number “04”. The scene shows 1 seated middle-aged male designer at a worktable, wearing a dark navy or black knit sweater, with salt-and-pepper curly hair, leaning forward and sketching on white paper with a pencil. His face is obscured by a square blur block, creating an anonymous portrait. On the desk are exactly 8 visible object groups: scattered sketch papers with geometric chair drawings, 1 pencil cup holding several pencils, 1 rolled white blueprint on the right, 1 closed dark notebook on the left, 1 small brown eraser near the center, 1 blurred black object in the front-left foreground, 1 large flat book or material sample in the front-right foreground, and the active drawing sheet under his hand. Behind him is a warm wooden credenza with neat stacks of books, 1 white dome desk lamp on the far left, and a white wall displaying exactly 4 pinned design references: 1 small dark photo of a chair, 1 light sketch beneath it, and 2 larger minimal line drawings on the right. Use muted neutral tones, off-white walls, walnut wood, black clothing, and a calm contemplative mood. The composition should feel like a believable high-end magazine cover, straight-on and carefully art-directed, with editorial realism and no visible publisher logos other than the fictional masthead.

items.title: Vintage Little Prince Space Postcard
items.description: A nostalgic illustrated postcard layout combining The Little Prince and a modern rocket launch, ideal for editorial art, themed prints, or brand-crossover concept visuals.
items.content: Create a vintage illustrated postcard designed as a whimsical collaboration between {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"}, shown as the front and back of the postcard side by side on one canvas. Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {argument name="quote" default="To the stars, what matters is invisible."}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.

items.content: Create a dramatic Japanese anime-style promotional thumbnail poster for an event, vertical 4:5 composition, ultra-detailed, cinematic, neon-lit, high contrast, designed like a social media announcement image. The main subject is a beautiful anime girl centered slightly right, shown from the waist up, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue"} hair blowing in the wind, decorated with small star hairpins, wearing a dark hoodie and large studio headphones around her neck, against a glowing sunset-to-night city skyline filled with sparkling lights, music-energy particles, lens flares, and flying glowing petals. Her face area is obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. Use a vivid palette of electric blue, violet, magenta, gold, and sunset orange. Fill the design with layered Japanese typography that is crisp, readable, and integrated into the art like a polished event advertisement. Include exactly 8 major text groups: top left copy reading 「始まるのは、キミと創る 音楽の物語。」 with a smaller subcopy beneath reading 「AIを使って、みんなで音楽をつくる特別な3日間。」; top right a glowing marquee sign reading 「GW連休!」 and a smaller neon box below reading 「みんなで最高の音楽をつくろう!」; center main title with small English text 「AI MUSIC BOOTCAMP 2」 above huge Japanese title text 「AI音楽 ブートキャンプ 2」; a gigantic gold metallic announcement across the middle reading 「開催決定!」; a date bar reading 「開催期間」 followed by 「5.2 SAT 土」 and 「5.4 MON 月」; a hashtag callout near the bottom reading 「参加はカンタン!! #AI音楽ブートキャンプ2 をつけて投稿するだけ!」; a lower encouragement line reading 「初心者も大歓迎! みんなで最高の音楽体験を!」; and 3 bottom feature captions with icons reading 「一緒に学ぶ 仲間とつながる」, 「AIで創る 新しい音楽体験」, and 「想いをカタチに 自分だけの1曲を」. On the left edge, add a vertical filmstrip with exactly 4 inset panels showing the same girl in music-related scenes: 1) performing on a stage before a crowd, 2) working at a music production desk with screens and equipment, 3) singing into a microphone, 4) playing an acoustic guitar. Add exactly 2 neon music-themed icon illustrations in the lower area: a tilted smartphone with a music note on the lower left and a glowing microphone with musical notes on the lower right. Make the text effects glossy, luminous, and embossed with gold and white highlights, with energetic streaks and spark explosions around the headline. The overall feeling should be inspiring, celebratory, futuristic, and emotionally uplifting, like a high-impact Japanese Golden Week music bootcamp ad for {argument name="event name" default="AI音楽ブートキャンプ 2"}.

items.title: Dreamy 16-Photo Couple Walk Collage
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic grid collage of candid blurred-face couple snapshots, ideal for social-media-style lifestyle imagery or album-cover mood boards.
items.content: A 4x4 collage of 16 candid smartphone snapshots arranged in a tight square grid with thin white dividers, styled like spontaneous couple selfies taken during an evening walk in a lush residential neighborhood. The images have a soft dreamy look with slight motion blur, shallow focus, mild fisheye or wide-angle phone-lens distortion, and a nostalgic green-tinted film aesthetic. The recurring subjects are a cute young woman and a taller young man, but both faces are intentionally obscured by large soft-edged rectangular blur blocks centered over their faces in every frame. The woman has long wavy blonde hair in twin ponytails tied with oversized mint-green ribbon bows, fair skin, and wears a light sage-green spaghetti-strap sundress with a gathered bodice. The man has short dark hair and wears a loose dark charcoal T-shirt. The collage should feel playful, intimate, and accidental, as if captured while walking and joking around outdoors. Show exactly 16 different shots: 1) close selfie of the pair shoulder-to-shoulder, 2) slightly higher-angle selfie with greenery behind them, 3) very close blurry selfie with the man leaning in from the left, 4) the woman alone from a high angle near flowerbeds and hedges, 5) side selfie with the woman making a peace sign, 6) the woman reaching one hand toward the camera while standing on a narrow garden path, 7) selfie of both together with the woman flashing a peace sign, 8) tilted close-up of the pair with strong motion blur, 9) close-up portrait of the woman alone making a peace sign, 10) selfie of the couple while walking along a roadside, 11) rear view of the woman alone from behind, showing the back of her dress and twin ponytails, 12) selfie of both with the woman making a peace sign beside the man, 13) extreme close crop with the woman’s hair and bow prominent, 14) full-body rear shot of the couple walking away down a quiet street, 15) close blurry selfie dominated by the face-obscuring blocks, 16) another close selfie of both side-by-side. Background details across the collage should include dense green hedges, garden flowers, a narrow lane, roadside grass, utility poles, and a quiet suburban street. Use natural ambient outdoor light, muted highlights, soft contrast, and a candid social-media photo dump vibe.

items.title: Texas-Style Pork Poster
items.description: This prompt turns roast pork reference photos into a smoky, premium Texas barbecue advertisement poster with bold typography and Japanese promotional copy.
items.content: Using REFERENCE_0 as the main food photo and REFERENCE_1 to enhance the pulled-meat texture, transform the homemade roast pork into a dramatic Texas barbecue poster. Keep the same pork cut in foil, but restyle it to look more appetizing and professionally photographed: deeper mahogany bark, stronger black-pepper crust, richer glaze, visible moisture, darker shadows, warm orange highlights, and a smoky atmosphere rising from the top. Place it on a dark rustic background with cinematic food-ad lighting. Add a bold vintage western headline in the upper left with exactly 2 lines: "TEXAS STYLE" and "PORK". Beneath it, add exactly 3 Japanese copy lines: "100℃で8時間、じっくり火入れ", "Low & Slowで引き出す、", and "やわらかさと旨み。" Add a handwritten Japanese tagline in the lower left with exactly 2 lines: "しっとり、" and "ほろり。" Use a premium BBQ advertisement layout, high contrast, slightly gritty texture, and make the final image feel like a poster for Texas-style pulled pork made from the reference roast.

items.title: Fiery Burger King Whopper Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic Korean Burger King burger advertisement poster suited for fast-food marketing, social media promo art, or a realistic product campaign visual.
items.content: A dramatic fast-food poster advertisement for Burger King, vertical composition, photorealistic studio food photography mixed with bold Korean promotional graphic design. Place the official Burger King logo centered at the very top. Below it, add huge distressed block Korean headline text in a stacked layout reading "신제품 와퍼 출시!" with "와퍼" in vivid deep red and the other words in textured off-white, all on a dark smoky black background. In the center, show one massive hero burger shot from a slightly low front angle, perfectly centered and filling most of the frame. The burger has 8 clearly visible layers and elements: a glossy sesame seed top bun, curly green leaf lettuce, thick red tomato slices, thick white onion rings, sliced pickles, streaks of ketchup, melted American cheese, a flame-grilled beef patty with heavy char marks, and a soft bottom bun. Add a tiny golden crown icon floating just above the top bun. The burger sits on a dark rustic wooden stump pedestal. Surround the lower half and side edges with dramatic orange flames, glowing embers, heat sparks, and smoky atmosphere to emphasize flame grilling. Near the bottom, place a secondary Korean slogan in bold text, centered, reading "불맛의 정점을 경험하라" with "불맛" in red and the remaining words in warm beige-gold, separated above by a small flame icon. At the very bottom, add a red badge-shaped label with a dark border containing the Korean text "한정 판매" in bold black. Use a high-contrast black, red, orange, and toasted brown color palette, intense cinematic lighting, glossy food highlights, crisp ingredient texture, premium commercial advertising finish, and a fiery indulgent mood.

items.title: Premium Denim Editorial Advertisement
items.description: A complex hyperrealistic prompt for a denim ad, featuring detailed textures, urban backgrounds, and specific typographic overlays.
items.content: A hyperrealistic premium denim advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A male figure wearing raw selvedge denim jeans is captured mid-stride against a near-black charcoal background, body angled diagonally at a bold 45-degree perspective toward the camera. The jeans feature a slim tapered silhouette with deep indigo wash, subtle thigh and knee fading, reinforced copper rivets catching ambient light, and clean off-white contrast stitching, dominating the lower two-thirds of the frame. The composition uses shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the denim texture and soft blur on the upper torso. The background is layered with subtle urban texture — faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive, barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the figure at different angles reading phrases like "{argument name="slogan one" default="RAW. REAL. RELENTLESS."}" and "{argument name="slogan two" default="WEAR WHAT YOU'VE BEEN THROUGH"}" — some running vertically, some at 30-degree angles, creating a chaotic yet intentional graphic zine energy. At the upper right, a bold brand wordmark appears in clean white against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads "AUTHENTIC FIT · LIVED-IN LUXURY · BUILT TO LAST" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large commanding headline is placed center-right — "{argument name="main headline" default="OWN"}" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "THE MOMENT" in lighter weight creating dramatic type hierarchy. Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout as accent details. Bottom left features a bold slogan lockup: "DEFINE YOUR DENIM" in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline reading "An unapologetic reminder that style is a statement. Every crease tells a story." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional — a single cold key light from the left causing copper rivets to shimmer and deep indigo denim to glow with subtle sheen against the darkness. Close macro detail visible on the fabric weave texture near the knee fade. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution. 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.

items.title: 4K Nike Sneaker Advertisement Prompt
items.description: A detailed prompt for generating a professional, moody sneaker advertisement with complex typography, shallow depth of field, and urban textures.
items.content:
A hyperrealistic Nike sneaker advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A male leg wearing crisp white athletic crew socks with subtle Nike logo detail is suspended mid-air against a near-black charcoal background, angled diagonally toward the camera at a bold 45-degree perspective. The sneaker — a Nike low-top silhouette featuring a clean two-tone colorway of {argument name="color scheme" default="glacier teal suede panels and off-white tumbled leather"}, with an iridescent chrome Swoosh catching ambient light — dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame.
The composition uses shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the shoe and soft blur on the upper leg. The background is layered with subtle urban texture - faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive, barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the sneaker at different angles, reading phrases like "{argument name="slogan" default="THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"}" - evoking motion, speed, and energy. Some text runs vertically, some at 30-degree angles, giving the composition a chaotic yet intentional graphic design feeling.
At the upper right, the bold Nike wordmark and Swoosh logo appear in clean white against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads: "PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large, commanding headline is placed center-right in contrasting weight typography - "MOVE" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "BEYOND" in lighter weight, creating dramatic type hierarchy.
Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout the composition as accent details, adding a contemporary graphic zine aesthetic. Bottom left features a bold brand slogan lockup: "DEFINE YOUR STRIDE" in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline: "An inspiring reminder that speed is a mindset. Every step forward is a statement." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional - a single cold key light from the left, causing the Swoosh to shimmer and the white leather to glow against the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution, 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.

items.title: Anime Theatrical Movie Poster
items.description: A lush anime-style movie poster prompt combining the aesthetics of Studio Ghibli and Makoto Shinkai, featuring mystical elements like floating cities and stone colossi.
items.content: A stunning anime theatrical movie poster in portrait format. Studio Ghibli meets Makoto Shinkai visual language. A teenage girl in a tattered white shrine maiden robe stands on the wing of a crumbling giant stone deity — an ancient colossus covered in moss and glowing golden kanji script, slowly falling through a sea of clouds. Her long black hair streams upward against gravity. She reaches one hand toward the sky where a vast celestial rift tears open the heavens — beyond it, an inverted ocean floats above the clouds, ancient wooden cities hanging upside down from its surface, lanterns drifting like stars. The sky transitions from deep twilight blue at the bottom to a luminous peach and rose gold at the top. Volumetric god rays pierce through cloud layers. Cherry blossom petals and torn paper talismans spiral everywhere. Her expression is calm determination. Art style: hand-drawn 2D animation, ultra-detailed background painting, expressive linework, rich cel shading. Palette: deep indigo, peach, rose gold, warm amber, soft white. Title in large elegant {argument name="language" default="Japanese kanji"} at the bottom with English subtitle beneath in a clean modern font. Tagline in small white italic text above the title. Mood: mythological, spiritual, bittersweet wonder. Theatrical release quality, Toho Films.

items.title: BMW Performance Social Poster
items.description: A detailed instruction for a graphic BMW social poster, maintaining car and composition details from a reference image with a specific blue theme.
items.content: Create a 4:5 vertical social poster in ultra high resolution, 8K print quality sharpness. Use the {argument name="car model" default="BMW car"} from the reference image as the main subject and use the background structure/composition from the reference image, but transform it into a BMW themed design. Replace all black tones with a flat {argument name="background color" default="high-saturation BMW blue"} background. Keep the same layout, spacing, visual balance, and poster composition from the reference image. Background should use a smooth gradient from slightly lighter electric blue at the top to deep navy blue at the bottom. Add subtle grain texture (2 to 3%) and faint rectangular overlays (2 to 4% opacity). Keep it clean, graphic, premium, and non-realistic. Add a soft contact shadow under the car. Use the same BMW from the reference image, changing only the {argument name="paint finish" default="matte frozen blue"} or deep metallic navy. Keep the original body shape, wheels, stance, and design details from the reference image. Show the car in a rear 3/4 perspective matching the reference image angle exactly. Use a slightly elevated camera angle. Position the car slightly right of center. Include visible carbon roof, aggressive rear diffuser, sharp controlled reflections, and subtle brake details. Keep composition identical to the reference image: Top: branding Middle: giant type Center: car overlapping text Bottom: editorial block and specs Typography: Primary text: “BMW” Ultra condensed bold sans serif, tall vertical scaling like the reference poster. Color deep navy or near black. Static text with no distortion. Acts as structural backdrop. Secondary header: “BMW M4 G82” Thin font with wide tracking. Logo area: BMW roundel centered above. Editorial block: Headline: “BMW — Where Driving Becomes Instinct” Body copy focused on: driver connection control performance precision Use the same boxed editorial layout as the reference image. Background faded text: “M4” large scale with 3 to 5% opacity behind the box. Bottom left: “ M4 G82” Bottom right specs: 405 kW / 550 PS 3.4 s 307 km/h Lighting should be clean studio lighting with sharp but controlled highlights. Color grading should use deep blues, high contrast, clean blacks. Camera lens: 50mm, slightly elevated rear 3/4 angle. Mood: Performance. Precision. Driver focus. Add Bottom-right watermark: harboriis , with small x and Instagram logo
