items.title: Vibrant Automotive Poster Design
items.description: A detailed prompt for a high-impact, modern graphic poster featuring a sports car with specialized typography and technical infographics.
items.content: A vibrant {argument name="car color" default="lime green"} {argument name="car model" default="Porsche 911 GT3"} is showcased in a dynamic, graphic poster. The car is positioned in the center, viewed from its left side in a three-quarter profile, facing right. Its sleek, aerodynamic design is emphasized with black accents, large rear spoiler, and distinctive wheels. Subtle overlays of a faded lime green Porsche hint at its branding and lineage in the background. A prominent vertical lime green stripe cuts through the poster, framing the Porsche crest and the "PORSCHE" text above the car. Below the vehicle, the "911 GT3" model designation is displayed in a bold, stylized font. Graphics illustrating acceleration, power, and top speed are arranged at the bottom, along with descriptive text. The overall composition is clean, modern, and energetic, utilizing a limited color palette of lime green, white, black, and the red, gold, and black of the Porsche emblem. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the car's contours and the graphic elements of the poster, creating a high-impact visual presentation.

items.title: Luxury Minimalist Footwear Ad
items.description: A sophisticated editorial prompt for a high-fashion sneaker advertisement with precise technical lighting, layout, and typography instructions.
items.content: A hyper realistic luxury editorial advertisement for Nike, executed with a restrained, high-fashion aesthetic. A male leg is suspended mid-air at a precise 45-degree angle toward the camera, styled with immaculate white athletic crew socks featuring a subtle, tonal Nike logo. The composition is clean and intentional, with generous negative space. The sneaker occupies the lower half of the frame, positioned slightly off-center for a balanced editorial layout. The footwear is a premium Nike low-top silhouette with glacier teal suede overlays and off-white tumbled leather panels. The iridescent chrome Swoosh reflects soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a refined, mirror-like highlight without harsh glare. Shot with a shallow depth of field: the sneaker remains perfectly sharp, while the leg transitions into a soft, elegant blur. Background & Atmosphere: A deep matte charcoal background with a subtle gradient falloff. No visible graffiti or noise—only a faint, almost imperceptible texture to avoid flatness. A soft vignette gently draws focus toward the sneaker. Lighting: Soft, controlled, diffused lighting from camera-left. Low contrast compared to sports ads, but with precise highlight control. Gentle specular highlight on chrome Swoosh. Soft glow on white leather. Minimal shadow harshness. Studio-quality, fashion editorial lighting. Typography & Layout (Luxury Minimalism). Top center (very small, spaced serif): “PRECISION · FORM · MOTION”. Center-right headline (elegant hierarchy): “FORM” (ultra-bold, clean sans-serif), “IN MOTION” (thin, high tracking). Microtext (extremely subtle, small scale): “Engineered simplicity. Refined movement.” Graphic Style: No bright accent colors. No arrows or aggressive elements. No clutter. No zine-style overlays. Pure, editorial restraint. Bottom-left Lockup: “LESS, BUT BETTER.” (bold, minimal sans-serif). Subline (small, refined): “Every detail serves a purpose.” Branding: Upper right: Nike wordmark and Swoosh in soft white or light gray. Small, understated—never overpowering Finish. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography. Luxury fashion campaign aesthetic. Ultra-clean composition. 4K resolution. Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Optimized for premium digital campaigns and editorial placements

items.title: Professional Tool Launch Poster
items.description: A professional SaaS-style poster prompt for announcing tools, emphasizing legible text and modern tech aesthetics.
items.content: 1. 为「AI Agent 工具发布」设计一张现代科技感海报，竖版 4:5，主标题清晰醒目，副标题解释产品价值，使用黑白灰+荧光绿点缀，包含抽象网络、代码窗口、智能体节点，整体像高端 SaaS 发布海报，文字必须准确可读。 2. 生成一张适合 X/Twitter 长文的封面图，主题是「2026 AI 工具趋势」，横版 16:9，风格干净高级，包含标题、3个关键词：Agent / Workflow / Automation，背景是桌面工作流、浏览器、终端、数据面板的组合，排版像科技媒体头图。 3. 为一款 Web3 钱包安全工具生成广告图，画面中心是一部手机展示钱包界面，周围有链上地址、风险预警、盾牌图标、交易路径可视化，风格专业可信，中文标题：让每一笔链上操作更安全。 4. 制作一张中文信息图，主题是「AI Agent 的 5 层能力」，包含：理解任务、调用工具、读取数据、执行操作、复盘优化。用清晰层级结构展示，每一层配一个小图标，白底，科技蓝点缀。 5. 生成一页 4 格漫画，讲一个创作者从手动找资料、写文案、做图，到用 AI Agent 自动完成工作流的过程。风格轻松幽默，人物一致，中文对白简短清晰，最后一格突出“效率翻倍”。 6. 为一个 AI x Crypto 项目生成路线图视觉图，包含 Q2、Q3、Q4 三个阶段：MVP、Agent Marketplace、Onchain Automation。风格像融资 Deck 里的产品页，干净、可信、有未来感，文字清晰可读。

Show this in a clear hierarchical structure, each layer with a small icon, white background, and tech-blue accents. 5. Generate a one-page 4-panel comic strip about a creator going from manually searching for info, writing copy, and making images to completing the workflow automatically with an AI Agent. The style should be lighthearted and humorous, with consistent characters and short, clear Chinese dialogue. The last panel should highlight "double the efficiency." 6. Generate a roadmap visual for an AI x Crypto project, including three phases: Q2, Q3, and Q4: MVP, Agent Marketplace, and Onchain Automation. The style should look like a product page in a funding deck—clean, credible, futuristic, and with clearly readable text.

items.content: 在雨夜的城市公交站台，一位{argument name="人物" default="年轻成年女性"}独自站在昏黄路灯和公交站灯箱下，微微低头看手机，没有看向镜头，展现自然等待的状态。她穿着{argument name="着装" default="浅色薄外套、深色半裙和白色运动鞋"}，长发自然垂落，一只手拿着手机，另一只手轻握透明雨伞。人物位于画面右侧三分之一的位置，左侧有模糊的前景遮挡，像从街边人群或车窗边缘偶然看到的一瞬间。公交站牌、广告灯箱、路灯杆和雨伞边缘形成清晰的竖向与斜向线条，引导视线。地面有雨水反光，远处车灯和霓虹被虚化成柔和光斑。整体为冷蓝色雨夜环境与暖黄色路灯混合的真实城市光线，柔和顶光和侧光，没有强烈摆拍感。浅景深使主体清晰，背景略微虚化，画面带真实相机颗粒感、轻微运动模糊和不完美构图，呈现随手抓拍的真实瞬间。照片风格真实自然，非写真、非广告大片，无文字水印。

Shallow depth of field keeps the subject clear while the background is slightly blurred; the image has real camera grain, slight motion blur, and imperfect composition, presenting a real moment captured on the fly. The photo style is real and natural, not a photoshoot or commercial blockbuster, with no text watermarks.

author.name: 聖星あい＠AIギャルプロデューサー

items.content:
16:9の2K画像を以下のプロンプトに基づいて3×3のグリッド画像を４枚作成して。
深夜～早朝の2010年代アキバ系オタク男子（平成後期〜令和初期の典型的なアキバ系）をテーマにしたエモーショナルな画像。但し、写真シチュエーションは<テーマ>の中から重複しないようにランダムに選んでください。
2010年代のコンパクトデジタルカメラまたはiPhone 4〜X時代の直射フラッシュを使用したスナップショットスタイル。
デジタルノイズ、軽いJPEGアーティファクト、周辺減光、暖色系のフェードトーンと少しオーバーサチュレーションが特徴的。
2010年代〜2020年初頭のデジタル写真特有のノスタルジックで生々しい質感。
儚く、少しデジタル臭い2010sスナップ写真風。
<テーマ>
・深夜のアキバ中央通り — ネオンと看板に照らされて歩く
・メイド喫茶の出口 — 萌え袖をはめたメイドと記念撮影
・ゲーセン（秋葉原）の格ゲー筐体前 — 対戦終わりに汗だくでハイタッチ
・UFOキャッチャー前 — 取ったフィギュアやぬいぐるみを自慢げに見せる
・プリクラ機の中 — フレームにデコられた痛車シール貼り
・アニメイト深夜 — 新刊ラノベや同人誌を抱えてレジ待ち
・マンガ喫茶の個室 — ブランケットにくるまりながらノートPCでエロゲー
・終電の山手線 — 痛バッグとフィギュアの袋を抱えて寝落ち
・始発電車待ちのネットカフェ — モニターの光だけが顔を照らす
・ラブホ街の路地 — ネオンに照らされた秋葉原の裏路地でたばこ
・屋上駐車場 — 夜景をバックに痛車を自慢しながらスマホチェック
・秋葉原の駅ホーム — 厚底スニーカーやドレスシューズで走る
・ゲームソフト中古店前 — 深夜閉店後に袋いっぱいの獲物を並べて撮影
・カラオケボックス — アニソン熱唱＆タンバリン（またはコスプレ）
・牛丼屋（すき家）深夜 — 夜明け前に大盛り牛丼を頬張る
・ファミレス（ガスト） — トレカやスリーブを並べてデッキ構築
・クレーンゲームの筐体前 — 景品のエロゲやフィギュアを大量ゲット
・TSUTAYA秋葉原店深夜 — アニメBD特典付きを物色
・コンビニの駐車場 — 深夜に新作ゲームの発売日を待つ行列
・タクシーの後部座席 — 痛バッグだらけの荷物と一緒に
・観覧車ゴンドラ内 — 夜景をバックに萌えグッズを見せる
・神社の境内 — 深夜に同人誌即売会の打ち上げ
・スマホ自撮り（フロントカメラ） — 部屋にフィギュア棚が映り込む
・路上でコスプレ調整 — 駅近くの路地でウィッグ直し
・朝帰りの始発電車 — 徹夜明けで疲れ果てて寝落ち
・エレベーター内 — メイド服の女の子と一緒（微妙に距離を取る）
・秋葉原の屋台ラーメン — 〆にこってりラーメンをすする
・自宅マンションの階段 — 段ボールだらけの通販荷物と一緒に
・PCパーツショップ前 — 深夜セール後の巨大なPCケースを抱える
・朝日のアキバ中央通り — スクランブル交差点のような人混みで佇む

items.title: Instagram Story with Annotations
items.description: A complex prompt that combines live-action café settings with anime characters and hand-drawn annotations in an Instagram Story format.

author.name: 萌奈のおすそわけ♥️AI動画クリエイター🩷AI & Web3 KOL🧡💛💚

items.content:
{argument name="場所" default="おしゃれな実写カフェ"}想像する。
{argument name="料理" default="可愛いデザート、ランチ、コーヒー"}などその場に合わせた料理をテーブルに乗せて。

被写体はキャラクターシートを参考に実写空間にアニメキャラクターを登場させる。
ポージングはランダム。
リアルタイムトゥーンレンダリング品質。セルシェーディングの明確なエッジライン、アニメ調のハイライトと影のコントラスト、3DCGベースだが手描きアニメのような質感。肌はマットなセル塗り、髪にはツヤベタのハイライト帯、瞳は多層グラデーション。

背景・キャラクターのポージング要素を分析し、分析した要素に対して手描き注釈を追加する。
{argument name="注釈言語" default="日本語"}の手描き文字（ひらがな・漢字を使う）、白いペンで描いた細い手描き線。 
矢印や点線を使って要素へ視線誘導を作る。
画像の仕上がりはインスタストーリー風、写真に直接メモしたようなデザインにすること。
items.translatedContent:
Imagine a {argument name="location" default="stylish live-action cafe"}.
Place dishes suited for the setting, such as {argument name="food items" default="cute desserts, lunch, and coffee"}, on the table.

The subject features an anime character appearing in the live-action space, using a character sheet as a reference.
Poses are random.
Real-time toon rendering quality. Clear cel-shaded edge lines, contrast between anime-style highlights and shadows, 3DCG-based but with a hand-drawn anime texture. Skin has a matte cel-painted look, hair has high-gloss highlight bands, and eyes feature multi-layered gradients.

Analyze elements of the background and character poses, then add hand-drawn annotations to those analyzed elements.
{argument name="annotation language" default="Japanese"} hand-drawn characters (using hiragana and kanji) and thin hand-drawn lines made with a white pen.
Use arrows and dotted lines to create visual guidance toward specific elements.
The final image should be in an Instagram Story style, designed to look like a direct memo written on a photo.

items.description: A prompt for generating an illustration in the style of Gustav Klimt's 'The Kiss' but featuring a specific character and banana-themed patterns.

author.name: 萌奈のおすそわけ♥️AI動画クリエイター🩷AI & Web3 KOL🧡💛💚

items.content:
グスタフ・クリムト（Gustav Klimt）のウィーン分離派スタイルの縦型作品（9:16）。

中央に{argument name="キャラクター" default="萌奈"}（{argument name="衣装" default="ゴールド魔法少女衣装"}、茶色ショートボブ、バナナ型ティアラ）が抱擁するような自己完結したポーズで目を閉じている。

クリムト特有の要素：
- 衣装と背景の装飾パターンをすべてバナナの形をモチーフにした金の幾何学紋様で置き換える
- 本物の金箔を貼ったような輝く質感のゴールド装飾
- 顔と手だけが写実的で、それ以外はすべて平面的な装飾パターン
- 背景は黒×金の渦巻きとバナナ形のモザイク
- 渦・螺旋・矩形・花の幾何学が密集
- 絵画的なテクスチャ、油彩キャンバスの質感

右下に"{argument name="銘板テキスト" default="MONA BANANA, 2026, Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas"}"の銘板風テキスト。
本物のクリムト作品と見紛う格調。
items.translatedContent:
A vertical work (9:16) in the style of Gustav Klimt's Vienna Secession.

In the center, {argument name="character" default="Mona"} ({argument name="outfit" default="gold magical girl costume"}, brown short bob, banana-shaped tiara) is closing her eyes in a self-contained pose as if embracing.

Elements unique to Klimt:
- Replace all decorative patterns on clothing and background with gold geometric patterns using banana shapes as motifs
- Glowing gold decorations with a texture like real gold leaf
- Only the face and hands are realistic, everything else is a flat decorative pattern
- The background is a mosaic of black and gold swirls and banana shapes
- Dense collection of vortices, spirals, rectangles, and floral geometry
- Painterly texture, the feel of an oil canvas

In the lower right, a plaque-style text reading "{argument name="plaque text" default="MONA BANANA, 2026, Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas"}."
A dignified piece indistinguishable from a real Klimt work.

items.title: Traditional Japanese Buddhist Statue
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a serene and majestic Senju Kannon (Thousand-Armed Kannon) statue in the style of Heian or Kamakura period Japanese Buddhist sculpture, complete with museum-quality lighting and textures.

author.name: 新清士@AIコンテンツ開発者

items.content: 日本の古仏彫刻を思わせる、{argument name="仏像の種類" default="千手観音菩薩立像"}。{argument name="所蔵元" default="東京国立博物館"}に所蔵されている名品仏像のような、静謐で荘厳な雰囲気。正面向きの全身像、細身で端正な体躯、やわらかく慈悲深い表情、半眼、穏やかな微笑。頭上に精緻な宝冠、流麗な天衣、繊細な装身具。背後には放射状に広がる多数の腕を整然と配置し、千手観音の象徴性を強く示す。手は実際の仏像表現に即して42臂を基調としてもよい。台座は蓮華座、背後に光背。材質は{argument name="材質" default="木彫"}を基調に、漆箔、金箔の剥落、経年による古色、わずかな彩色の残存、ひび、摩耗、寺院伝来の歴史ある質感を表現。全体は平安〜鎌倉期の日本仏像彫刻を思わせる、端正で高貴、宗教性あふれる、宗教的荘厳さに満ちた造形。美術館で撮影された収蔵品写真のように、背景は暗めで落ち着き、像の立体感と質感が際立つ。博物館級、文化財級、超高精細。
items.translatedContent: A {argument name="type of Buddhist statue" default="standing statue of Senju Kannon Bodhisattva"} reminiscent of ancient Japanese Buddhist sculpture. It features a serene and majestic atmosphere similar to the masterpieces housed in the {argument name="collection" default="Tokyo National Museum"}. A full-body frontal view with a slender and elegant physique, a soft and compassionate expression, half-closed eyes, and a gentle smile. It includes an exquisite crown, flowing celestial robes, and delicate jewelry. A large number of arms are arranged in an orderly radial pattern behind the back to strongly emphasize the symbolism of the Thousand-Armed Kannon. The hands may be based on 42 arms in accordance with actual sculptural traditions. It stands on a lotus pedestal with a halo behind. The material is primarily {argument name="material" default="wood carving"}, depicting historical textures such as lacquer, peeling gold leaf, weathered colors from aging, traces of original color, cracks, wear, and a sense of temple heritage. The overall design evokes Japanese Buddhist sculptures of the Heian to Kamakura periods, characterized by dignity, nobility, and religious solemnity. Like a professional photograph of a museum collection, the background is dark and subdued, highlighting the three-dimensionality and texture of the statue. Museum-grade, cultural asset-grade, ultra-high definition.

items.content: A cinematic street food advertisement at night in a rainy city street, shot in a dramatic close-up food photography style with shallow depth of field. In the foreground, a bamboo steamer basket sits on a wet reflective table, filled with exactly 4 plump steamed momos, while a human hand from the right side lifts a fifth momo above the basket. Thick steam rises visibly from the dumplings. To the right front, place a small black bowl of glossy red chili sauce. To the left, include an open yellow takeaway box with the stylized WOW! momo logo printed in black and red, with one momo visible inside. The tabletop is covered with rain droplets, scattered chili flakes, and warm reflections. In the background, show a blurred urban street with car headlights, storefront glow, and falling rain, creating a moody blue-and-amber contrast. Add large distressed bold condensed white typography in the center reading {argument name="headline text" default="CRAVE THE MOMENT"}. At the top left, place the WOW! momo logo. Along the left vertical edge, add the words {argument name="side text" default="WARM • SOFT • COMFORT"} in a narrow vertical layout. Across the top background, faintly repeat the atmospheric words {argument name="background text" default="HEAT / COMFORT / AGAIN / RAIN"}. At the bottom center, add a small footer line reading {argument name="footer text" default="STEAMED MOMOS • SERVED HOT • 2026 EDITION"}, and place {argument name="website" default="wowmomo.com"} at the bottom right. Ultra-detailed commercial food ad, photorealistic, high contrast, warm steam against cool rainy night, glossy textures, cinematic lighting, premium brand campaign aesthetic.

items.title: Gritty Boxer Leaning on Ring Ropes
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic editorial-style portrait of an athlete in a boxing ring, ideal for fitness branding, sports campaigns, and moody gym lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A gritty, realistic fitness lifestyle portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a male athlete"} leaning back against the ropes of an old-school boxing ring inside a worn vintage gym. Mid-length vertical composition, framed from about mid-thigh to slightly above the head, with the subject centered and facing the camera. He wears an oversized heather-grey pullover hoodie with the hood up, visible drawstrings hanging down, soft cotton texture, natural folds, and a front kangaroo pocket; black satin-like athletic boxing shorts with white trim and curved white piping near the hem; and white hand wraps on both hands, slightly frayed and loosely wound. His posture is relaxed but strong: both arms draped outward and resting on the ring ropes at left and right, shoulders open, torso square to camera, hands hanging naturally over the ropes. Hair is dark brown, short-to-medium length, slightly messy and visible under the hood at the forehead. The physique is natural and athletic with realistic proportions and understated muscle definition. The boxing ring shows exactly 3 visible rope colors: a red rope in the upper background, a pale grey-white rope crossing behind the hands and waist, and a dark blue rope across the lower foreground. Background is softly blurred with distressed beige walls, scattered vintage gym posters and banners, industrial wear, and dim training-space atmosphere. Lighting is soft natural indoor light mixed with ambient gym light, creating gentle shadows and a moody cinematic tone. Photorealistic texture, subdued earthy colors, shallow depth of field, high detail in fabric, wraps, skin, and ring ropes, editorial sports portrait style.

items.title: Inclusive Indian T-Shirt Brand Banner
items.description: A premium wide-format fashion advertisement showing three Indian male body types modeling fitted t-shirts, ideal for apparel branding and inclusive marketing campaigns.
items.content: A clean premium fashion campaign banner shot against a warm beige textured plaster wall, featuring 3 Indian men standing side by side full torso to upper thigh, evenly spaced across the frame, all with their hands in their pockets and looking slightly away from the camera. The styling is minimalist, editorial, and aspirational, with soft natural studio lighting and muted earthy tones. On the left, a lean man with short curly dark hair wears a slate blue crew-neck t-shirt and off-white trousers; in the center, an athletic man with short black hair wears an ivory cream crew-neck t-shirt and dark charcoal trousers; on the right, a heavier relaxed-build man with medium-length wavy dark hair wears a faded charcoal crew-neck t-shirt and light beige trousers. The t-shirts should look well-fitted on different body types, with realistic cotton texture, subtle folds, and clean hems. Add large elegant serif text in the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="finally."} in off-white, with smaller sans-serif subheading below reading {argument name="tagline" default="Made for every Indian body."}. Place 3 small uppercase captions near the bottom beneath each model: left caption {argument name="left caption" default="BROAD SHOULDERS. PERFECT FIT."}, center caption "ATHLETIC BUILD. PERFECT FIT.", right caption "RELAXED FRAME. PERFECT FIT.". Add tiny uppercase footer text at the bottom left reading "DESIGNED IN INDIA. FITTED FOR INDIA." and brand text at the bottom right reading {argument name="brand name" default="JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS"}. Include a thin horizontal divider line running near the bottom across most of the image. Wide aspect ratio, luxury apparel ad aesthetic, realistic photography, neutral color grading, uncluttered composition, high-end Indian menswear branding.

items.title: Sustainable T-Shirt Plantable Tag Ad
items.description: A premium vertical fashion ad showing a minimalist T-shirt with a plantable seed tag growing into a tulsi sprout, ideal for sustainable apparel branding and campaign visuals.
items.content: A premium eco-conscious fashion advertisement, shot as a refined editorial product photo. A single off-white or natural cream crew-neck T-shirt hangs on a smooth wooden hanger with a black metal hook, placed against a lush wall of dense green leaves and climbing vines. The hanger has a small minimalist brand monogram engraved near the neck. The shirt is shown from the upper torso down to part of the hem, slightly angled, with soft natural folds and high-quality cotton texture. Printed inside the collar is a minimalist brand mark and the text "JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS". Hanging from the neckline is 1 rectangular recycled-paper seed tag tied with rustic brown twine; the tag reads "Tulsi" and "Plantable Seed Tag" with a tiny sprouting seed detail near the bottom. From the tag, 1 real tulsi plant stem grows upward across the front of the shirt, with several fresh green leaves, visually demonstrating that the tag is plantable. Add a small fine-label annotation near the tag reading "TULSI PLANTABLE SEED TAG". On the right side, large elegant white serif typography says {argument name="headline text" default="Plant it."}. Beneath it, place 3 stacked lines of narrow uppercase sans-serif copy: "WEAR IT.", "PLANT IT.", and "GROW WITH IT.". At the lower left, add the brand name in spaced uppercase serif text: {argument name="brand name" default="JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS"}, with a thin horizontal line above it. At the lower right, add 3 lines of small uppercase sans-serif text: "FSC® CERTIFIED PACKAGING.", "ZERO SYNTHETIC FIBRE", and "BACKED BY ZERODHA.". Use soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, moody green-and-cream color grading, luxury sustainable-brand aesthetics, clean composition, vertical poster layout, subtle shadows, and a calm organic atmosphere. Keep the design minimal, premium, and photorealistic, with the shirt occupying the left half and the typography balanced on the right.

items.title: Anime Tunnel Driving Cockpit Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a moody anime-style over-the-shoulder driving scene inside a vintage car, ideal for cinematic storyboards, manga-inspired keyframes, or motion comic sequences.
items.content: A cinematic anime-style interior car scene viewed from the back seat over the shoulder of {argument name="driver description" default="a young woman with shoulder-length black hair"} driving through a dim urban tunnel at night. She grips a classic three-spoke steering wheel with both hands, left hand around 10 o’clock and right hand around 3 o’clock, wearing a wristwatch on one wrist and a thin bracelet on the other, with a loose light-colored shirt and rolled sleeves. The dashboard is a vintage sports car cockpit with 4 visible round analog gauges glowing warm orange-red, a retro radio console, metallic trim, and a manual gear shifter in the lower right foreground. Outside the windshield, show dense tunnel traffic with multiple cars ahead, red brake lights, harsh overhead tunnel lights receding into the distance, and rough concrete walls streaked with speed lines. Composition is wide and immersive, emphasizing the driver’s hands, steering wheel, and instrument cluster, with the driver’s face seen in partial side profile on the left edge. Render in gritty manga-inspired linework with heavy ink hatching, dark shadows, muted blue-gray and black tones, and warm highlights from the dashboard and tunnel lights. Mood is tense, focused, nocturnal, and stylish, like a dramatic street-racing or thriller anime frame.

items.title: Hindi Poem Poster with Parashurama
items.description: A dramatic vertical Hindi literary poster combining a historical poet portrait, a central quote, and a mythic Parashurama figure, ideal for shareable social media or print art inspired by nationalist or moral themes.
items.content: A vertically oriented literary poster in a muted sepia, ash, and parchment palette with dramatic gold kintsugi-style cracks running diagonally across the entire composition. The background is a soft textured paper and watercolor wash with smoky clouds, worn stains, and faint marbling. In the upper left, place a large faded monochrome portrait bust of an older Indian man in traditional formal attire, partially emerging from the mist like a historical figure or poet, softly blended into the background. In the upper right, set a small Hindi title line {argument name="headline text" default="परशुराम की प्रतीक्षा"} with a smaller author credit below it, elegant and understated. Beneath that, place one large centered Hindi quote in refined serif-style Devanagari, framed by oversized quotation marks, using the exact text {argument name="main quote" default="जब नाश मनुज पर छाता है, पहले विवेक मर जाता है।"}. In the lower half, create a heroic mythic Indian warrior standing on jagged black rocks, facing slightly left, with a powerful windswept stance. He has a bare muscular torso, long wild dark hair blown upward, and a tattered deep red drape wrapped across his body and trailing dramatically to the right in torn ribbons. He holds 1 large battle axe in his left hand, the blade angled downward, suggesting Parashurama. Surround him with dust, smoke, tiny debris, and painterly splashes. Add 2 vertical blocks of smaller Hindi poem text, one on the lower left and one on the lower right of the warrior, balanced like a printed poetry poster. Keep the poem text dense and readable but secondary to the central quote and figure. Use painterly digital illustration with fine art poster aesthetics, soft atmospheric lighting, high contrast around the warrior, and subtle glowing gold fissures crossing through the portrait, text area, rocks, and fabric. The overall mood is solemn, prophetic, patriotic, and intense, like a shareable inspirational poem poster about moral collapse and righteous awakening in India.

items.content: A cinematic, ultra-realistic scene of a Tang Dynasty court dancer performing inside a grand ancient Chinese palace hall at night. A beautiful woman in an elegant {argument name="costume color" default="black and gold"} silk dance costume stands at center frame in a dramatic mid-dance pose, captured from a very low-angle with a slightly wide lens for an immersive, heroic perspective. Her costume is densely embroidered with metallic gold patterns and features layered translucent fabric, a high slit revealing one extended leg, long sheer sleeves, and wide flowing silk veils sweeping outward in two large arcs, creating a powerful sense of motion. She wears delicate gold accessories, fitted gold dance shoes, and an ornate golden headpiece over long black hair styled up with hanging ornaments. Her makeup is refined and regal. The palace interior is vast and luxurious, with tall red wooden pillars, dark carved beams, two large hanging lanterns visible overhead, a glowing ceremonial backdrop, and a large calligraphy plaque high behind her. In the softly blurred background, there are several attendants and musicians, including at least 6 visible human figures, arranged along the back and side edges of the hall. Lighting is dramatic and filmic, with warm amber lantern light, golden highlights on the costume, soft shadow falloff, subtle haze, depth of field, and slight motion blur in the swirling fabric. Highly detailed textures, realistic skin rendering, rich contrast, luxurious atmosphere, historical Chinese palace grandeur, widescreen composition, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"}.

items.title: Moody Vintage Bedroom at Night
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic nostalgic interior photo of an old bedroom lit by a bedside lamp, ideal for atmospheric storytelling, retro set design, or mood-board imagery.
items.content: A moody cinematic photograph of a small old-fashioned bedroom at night, viewed from bedside height. In the left foreground, a worn wooden bed with a dark headboard is covered by a faded patchwork quilt, with exactly 2 stacked floral pillows near the head of the bed. The walls are stained, cracked, and aged plaster in warm ochre tones, giving the room a lived-in, slightly neglected feeling. On the upper left wall hangs 1 framed vintage street-scene print, and near the center wall hangs 1 dark shoulder bag from a hook. Beside the bed is a small wooden nightstand lit by 1 warm glowing table lamp with a round shade, casting soft amber light and deep shadows across the room. On the tabletop sit exactly 5 visible objects: 1 red cylindrical tin, 1 small boxy container, 1 shallow cup or ashtray, 1 small round alarm clock, and the lamp itself. Beneath the nightstand is an open shelf with clutter. On the right side, a tall old window with dark wooden panes shows a deep blue nighttime exterior with a few distant blurry lights; the curtain is thin, worn, and partly drawn. On the windowsill are exactly 3 visible objects: 1 tall ceramic bottle, 1 dark glass bottle, and 1 vintage silver-and-black radio cassette player. At the lower right is 1 small stool or low table draped with newspapers, with more papers stacked underneath. The lighting should be low-key, tungsten warm indoors against cool blue night outside, with heavy film grain, soft focus, rich shadows, nostalgic realism, subtle dust, and the atmosphere of a quiet, lonely apartment from the late 1970s or 1980s.

items.title: Vintage Chinese General Store Interior
items.description: This prompt generates a warm, nostalgic documentary-style photo of an old Chinese corner shop interior, useful for retro lifestyle scenes and cinematic period imagery.
items.content: A nostalgic cinematic photograph of a small old-fashioned Chinese general store interior, shot from customer eye level with a slightly wide framing. Warm sepia and amber tones, soft window light from the left, subtle film grain, faint vignette, and a slightly hazy vintage look. Behind a long dark wooden-and-glass display counter stands 1 shopkeeper, a woman with a short black bob haircut wearing a plain white short-sleeve blouse, shown in side profile while working with her hands at the counter. The store feels authentic, modest, and lived-in, like the late 1970s to 1990s. On the right side, a black vintage sewing machine sits on an upper shelf with a handwritten price sign in Chinese beside it reading “768元”. Behind it are shelves packed with small colorful product boxes and tins. On the wall hang 1 large vertical handwritten price list in Chinese calligraphy and 2 old paper calendars or posters. The foreground glass cases display many old packaged goods: stacks of colorful tins and jars, several rectangular illustrated tins, 2 enamel wash basins with floral patterns, and multiple pairs of plain white canvas shoes arranged side by side on the bottom shelf. The left side of the frame shows bright wooden-framed windows and more countertop clutter, creating strong contrast between sunlight and the dim interior. Emphasize realistic documentary photography, richly textured wood, aged surfaces, retro packaging design, quiet everyday atmosphere, and a composition that leads the eye from the woman at center-left to the sewing machine and shelves at upper right.

items.title: Impossible Infinite Golden Library
items.description: A cinematic fantasy architecture prompt for generating a vast impossible golden library interior with extreme symmetry, monumental scale, and a lone scholar figure.
items.content: An impossible grand interior of a colossal palace-library called {argument name="location name" default="Library of Infinite Echoes"}, photographed as a cinematic ultra-wide {argument name="lens" default="8mm rectilinear"} architectural shot from a perfectly centered, symmetrical viewpoint. The scene shows a single vast central nave stretching to an unreachable vanishing point, with impossibly tall rows of black marble and gilded columns rising floor to ceiling on both sides, dense multi-story bookshelves packed with old leather-bound volumes, white veined marble walls, carved classical statues set into niches, ornate gold detailing, and hanging lanterns glowing warmly. In the exact foreground center stands 1 lone human figure in a long dark cloak, seen from behind at a monumental reading desk with 1 giant open book and small scholarly instruments on the tabletop, emphasizing scale and awe. The polished black stone floor is mirror-reflective, doubling the columns and golden light. Massive shafts of radiant amber sunlight pour from high unseen openings above and along the upper walls, filling the hall with luminous haze, dust motes, and divine volumetric glow. The architecture should feel hyper-detailed, baroque, sacred, and physically impossible, with endless vertical repetition, intricate ornament, surreal depth, and a dreamlike sense of infinity. Color palette dominated by molten gold, bronze, black marble, ivory stone, and warm firelit highlights. Render as an epic photorealistic fantasy architectural visualization, extremely detailed, sharp, majestic, immersive, and awe-inspiring.

items.title: Futuristic Animation Trade Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a polished editorial magazine cover featuring a glowing humanoid animation robot and realistic cover lines for a professional AI-and-animation publication.
items.content: Create a futuristic professional magazine cover for the animation industry, portrait orientation, high-end editorial design, cinematic and polished. The masthead dominates the upper left in huge bold white sans-serif letters split across two lines: {argument name="magazine title" default="FRAME RATE"}. Above it, a small yellow all-caps tagline reads: THE INDUSTRY TRADE MAGAZINE FOR ANIMATION PROFESSIONALS. Below the masthead, a smaller white subtitle reads: THE BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY & ART OF ANIMATION. In the upper right, place issue text in stacked bold type: VOL. 23 in yellow and SUMMER 2026 in white. The cover image shows a stylized humanoid female-coded robot or digital mannequin in a dynamic running pose, facing right, shown full body, with one leg lifted behind and one arm extended. Her body is semi-transparent dark mesh with glowing orange internal joints, spine, and limb mechanisms, accented by blue and purple neon tracing lines and circular motion rings around wrists, ankles, hips, and feet. She has messy tied-up blue hair and a smooth simplified face with minimal features, like a CG character prototype. Set her in a dark animation studio interior with blurred monitors, desks, and concept art pinned in the background, lit with low moody ambient light so the neon figure becomes the focal point. Add reflective flooring beneath her with concentric holographic rings under both feet in green, yellow, and orange. On the left side, arrange editorial cover lines in a clean magazine layout. A small yellow label says COVER STORY. Below it, a large bold white stacked headline reads: {argument name="cover headline" default="PIPELINES THAT LEARN. STORIES THAT MOVE."}. Beneath that, a yellow subhead reads: HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING EVERY STAGE OF ANIMATION PRODUCTION. In the lower left, include 3 secondary article listings, each with a short yellow rule above it: 1) INBETWEENING 2.0, with small white teaser text: Inside the new generation of AI Inbetweening models changing the industry standard., and page number p. 24 in yellow. 2) CONSISTENCY AT SCALE, with small white teaser text: Maintaining character performance with AI-assisted interpolation., and page number p. 38 in yellow. 3) ARTIST ORCHARD, NOT REPLACEMENT, with small white teaser text: How top studios integrate AI tools while keeping artists in the loop., and page number p. 52 in yellow. Near the lower right, add a black circular badge outlined in yellow containing yellow and white text: WORKFLOW SPOTLIGHT on top, DreamFrame Studios on building a proprietary AI animation stack beneath, and p. 60 at the bottom in yellow. In the bottom right corner, place a white barcode box with pricing above it reading: US $12.99   EUR €14.99, plus small issue code numbers. Use a color palette of black, charcoal, white, vivid yellow, electric orange, blue, and violet. The overall feeling should be premium, forward-looking, tech-savvy, and credible, like a real trade magazine cover about AI-driven animation pipelines.

Below the masthead, a smaller white subtitle reads: THE BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY & ART OF ANIMATION. In the upper right, place issue text in stacked bold type: VOL. 23 in yellow and SUMMER 2026 in white. The cover image shows a stylized humanoid female-coded robot or digital mannequin in a dynamic running pose, facing right, shown full body, with one leg lifted behind and one arm extended. Her body is semi-transparent dark mesh with glowing orange internal joints, spine, and limb mechanisms, accented by blue and purple neon tracing lines and circular motion rings around wrists, ankles, hips, and feet. She has messy tied-up blue hair and a smooth simplified face with minimal features, like a CG character prototype. Set her in a dark animation studio interior with blurred monitors, desks, and concept art pinned in the background, lit with low moody ambient light so the neon figure becomes the focal point. Add reflective flooring beneath her with concentric holographic rings under both feet in green, yellow, and orange. On the left side, arrange editorial cover lines in a clean magazine layout. A small yellow label says COVER STORY. Below it, a large bold white stacked headline reads: {argument name="cover headline" default="PIPELINES THAT LEARN. STORIES THAT MOVE."}. Beneath that, a yellow subhead reads: HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING EVERY STAGE OF ANIMATION PRODUCTION. Near the lower right, add a black circular badge outlined in yellow containing yellow and white text: WORKFLOW SPOTLIGHT on top, DreamFrame Studios on building a proprietary AI animation stack beneath, and p. 60 at the bottom in yellow. In the bottom right corner, place a white barcode box with pricing above it reading: US $12.99   EUR €14.99, plus small issue code numbers. Use a color palette of black, charcoal, white, vivid yellow, electric orange, blue, and violet. The overall feeling should be premium, forward-looking, tech-savvy, and credible, like a real trade magazine cover about AI-driven animation pipelines.

items.title: Miniature City Weather Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished vertical weather poster combining centered forecast typography with a whimsical miniature Chinese cityscape, ideal for travel-themed app visuals and social media weather art.
items.content: A vertical smartphone-style weather poster for {argument name="city name" default="成都"}, designed as a dreamy ultra-detailed miniature diorama cityscape under a bright blue sky. At the top center, place large bold white Chinese characters for the city name with soft 3D depth and a gentle drop shadow. Directly below it, center a fluffy white cloud icon made of rounded sculpted forms. Under the icon, add one line of smaller white text showing {argument name="date text" default="2026-04-22 星期三"}, then a larger bold white temperature line reading {argument name="temperature text" default="28° / 18°"}, then one more centered weather-condition line in white reading {argument name="condition text" default="多云"}. Keep all text vertically stacked, evenly spaced, and cleanly centered in the upper half of the image. In the lower half, create an enchanting hybrid city of traditional Chinese water-town architecture and a modern skyline: calm turquoise canals winding around tiny islands, 2 small arched stone bridges in the foreground, 1 pavilion on the left island, 1 tall multi-tier pagoda near the right-center, clusters of grey-tiled traditional houses and shopfronts, outdoor tea tables with umbrellas, lush willows, shrubs, flowers, and a few tiny boats on the water. In the distant background, show a contemporary skyline with many glass skyscrapers and 1 prominent needle-like observation tower. Scatter exactly 5 soft cumulus clouds across the sky including the central weather icon area, and add a few tiny birds for life. Use warm morning sunlight, cinematic atmospheric perspective, shallow depth of field, tilt-shift miniature photography aesthetics, highly realistic materials, delicate reflections in the water, and a polished whimsical travel-poster mood. Preserve a clean composition with generous sky above and the miniature city concentrated at the bottom, like a premium weather app hero image.

items.title: Chinese Ink-Wash Jinyun Travel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a poetic vertical Chinese landscape tourism poster with five scenic vignettes linked by a flowing red ribbon, ideal for cultural destination branding and editorial travel art.

author.name: AI Time Traveler | 时光旅行者

items.content: A vertical Chinese ink-wash tourism poster on an off-white textured rice-paper background, with a large flowing red silk ribbon that rises in an S-curve from the lower right to the upper left and transforms into drifting mist, visually connecting 5 scenic vignettes. At the bottom right, place a lone ancient Chinese figure in long white Hanfu with a high topknot, seen from behind, one arm raised as if guiding or releasing the ribbon; the robe has subtle red sash accents that echo the ribbon. Build the composition upward through layered pale gray mountains, clouds, mist, and sparse birds, in an elegant shanshui painting style mixed with refined travel-poster design. Include 5 distinct labeled scenic areas embedded along the ribbon path: 1) a towering central mountain peak emerging from clouds with pine trees, labeled vertically in Chinese near the top; 2) a traditional waterside old town with white walls, gray tile roofs, calm reflective water, and a small stone arch bridge, labeled vertically; 3) a stone-built cliff village clustered on rugged slopes beside a waterfall and stream, labeled vertically; 4) a modern glass building perched dramatically on a rocky mountaintop, labeled vertically; 5) a wide flower field or pastoral plain with pink and white blossoms, a windmill, distant mountains, and winding paths, labeled vertically. Use soft ink tones, muted grays, warm beige rock, and restrained dusty red as the main accent color. Leave generous negative space. Add large vertical brush-calligraphy headline text on the lower left reading {argument name="headline text" default="黄帝缙云 人间仙都"}, with smaller supporting Chinese calligraphy seals and printed location text near the bottom left reading {argument name="location text" default="浙江·缙云 / ZHEJIANG JINYUN"}. Include multiple red artist seals and elegant vertical scenic labels in traditional poster layout. The overall mood is poetic, airy, cultural, premium, and serene, like a high-end destination branding poster for {argument name="destination name" default="Jinyun"}.

items.title: Cyberpunk Future Cat Neon Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a square neon cyberpunk mascot poster with a wide-eyed black cat, holographic UI overlays, and futuristic city signage for synthwave cover art or social graphics.
items.content: A cyberpunk neon poster-style illustration of a cute futuristic black cat mascot centered in a dark rainy high-tech city. The cat is a simple rounded silhouette with two tall ears, huge white circular eyes with tiny black pupils, a tiny worried mouth, and two hot-pink whisker marks on each cheek. Behind the cat is a glowing circular holographic halo made of layered magenta and cyan rings. The background is a dense futuristic cityscape filled with vertical light streaks, holographic glitches, data noise, reflections, and luminous signage in electric blue, purple, and pink. At the top center, large glowing text reads "未来猫" with smaller text below reading "FUTURE CAT". Include exactly 7 interface panels and HUD elements around the cat: 1 top-left badge reading "LEVEL 99", 1 upper-left panel reading "NEKO PROTOCOL" with smaller Japanese text below, 1 left-mid slanted panel with tiny unreadable techno glyphs, 1 left-lower panel reading "ERROR_404", 1 top-right warning panel reading "WARNING" with a triangular alert icon, 1 right-lower panel reading "NEKO UNIT-01", and 1 bottom-center status strip reading "> SYSTEM ONLINE <". Also add 2 small cat icons, one near the top-right corner and one embedded in the right-side UI area. Add faint small Japanese microtext near the lower right area. Style is glossy synthwave cyberpunk, anime-game UI fusion, poster composition, high contrast, moody nighttime atmosphere, heavy glow bloom, chromatic aberration, glitch texture, holographic reflections, wet neon ambiance, ultra-detailed background with the mascot remaining bold and graphic in the foreground. Square composition.

items.title: Chinese City Brushstroke Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a premium vertical tourism poster that blends Chinese calligraphy, seal design, and a miniature landmark cityscape inside a sweeping ink brushstroke.
items.content: An elegant vertical Chinese city-poster on textured off-white rice paper, with a large black ink-brush calligraphy character for {argument name="city name" default="广州"} placed in the upper left and a small red seal stamp beside it. Beneath the calligraphy, add two centered lines of refined Chinese promotional copy in a classic serif-like print style, thin and balanced, with a delicate ornamental divider line. In the lower right, place a second red seal containing the city name and the romanized English name “GUANGZHOU” below it in small spaced capitals. The main image should be a sweeping ink-brush stroke that curves diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right, as if painted by a traditional calligraphy brush whose tip is still visible at the top right corner. Inside this single brushstroke, create a highly detailed miniature sculptural landscape that merges heritage and modern city identity: a winding turquoise river, rugged blue-gray mountains, a traditional multi-story pagoda, an arched stone bridge, a dense futuristic skyline, and a very tall landmark tower resembling the Canton Tower rising near the center-right. In the lower left foreground within the brushstroke, include 4 goats total: 1 large standing ram and 3 smaller goats on rocky terrain, referencing the city’s symbolic folklore. Blend clouds, stone textures, flowering shrubs, and architectural details into the scene so it feels like a carved diorama or relief sculpture embedded in paint. Use a restrained palette of ink black, muted teal, slate blue, warm beige stone, soft terracotta, and cinnabar red accents. The composition should feel premium, poetic, and culturally sophisticated, combining traditional Chinese ink painting, seal design, and ultra-detailed 3D miniature cityscape illustration for a high-end tourism publicity poster.

items.content: A highly realistic documentary-style photo of a rural Chinese primary school gate-side snack shop in {argument name="year" default="1998"}, shot in warm afternoon sunlight. The scene shows an old earthen-walled village storefront with cracked yellow-brown plaster, exposed brick edges, a traditional tiled roof with visible wooden rafters, and two weathered wooden window shutters opened outward to form a sales window. In front of the window is a simple glass display case filled with school supplies and small books. A middle-aged female shopkeeper sits on a low wooden stool beside the case, wearing a faded blue jacket, black pants, and black cloth shoes, handling stationery or a metal cash box. Four primary school boys stand in a short line at the counter with their backs and side profiles to the camera, wearing late-1990s Chinese school tracksuits and bright red Young Pioneer scarves; two wear red-and-white jackets with blue pants, and two wear blue-and-white jackets with blue pants. Add a faded red cloth hanging from the left side of the window frame, dusty ground, a long mud wall receding into the background, and large leafy trees casting soft shadows. The composition should feel candid, historically believable, and slightly nostalgic, like an authentic photograph taken outside a countryside elementary school in northern China in the late 1990s. Vertical framing, eye-level perspective, natural colors, detailed textures, no stylization, no cinematic exaggeration, strong realism.

The background shows a vast frozen mountain range and icy lake at night under a stormy cosmic sky, with a gigantic luminous X-shaped light formation centered behind the phone, creating a heroic focal point. At the top left is the brand wordmark “HONOR”, and at the top right is the Chinese tagline “荣耀电竞神机”. Across the upper center is a huge bold metallic Chinese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="以我知 探未知"}, rendered in oversized beveled silver typography with slight ice-texture highlights. Beneath it is a smaller line of Chinese text “荣耀 WIN X 新品发布”. In the center foreground, show 2 phones standing on a circular futuristic platform surrounded by mist and reflected blue light: the left phone shows the exterior back design in a three-quarter front-left angle, with a transparent industrial cyber-mechanical shell, angular panel lines, visible screws, a large black polygonal camera module near the top, “GT” marking on the upper right edge, a diagonal red accent slash, vertical “HONOR” branding near the lower left, and a large circular turbine cooling fan in the lower middle glowing bright electric blue with visible blades and a center cap labeled HONOR; the right phone stands slightly behind and to the right, showing the internal structure through an opened transparent back, with another bright blue circular cooling core near the upper center emitting energy beams to the right, and a massive vertical battery module labeled in huge text “15000mAh”. On the left side, include 3 stacked glowing rectangular feature panels with neon blue borders: panel 1 shows a small lake landscape image and Chinese text headed “15000mAh 青海湖电池” with smaller lines “超大容量 超长续航” and “-20℃ 极寒环境依旧耐用”; panel 2 shows a fan image and Chinese text headed “超强制冷风扇” with smaller lines “20000rpm 高速风扇” and “瞬时降温 战力全开”; panel 3 shows a chip image and Chinese text headed “最新骁龙 8Elite Gen6 处理器” with smaller lines “台积电 2nm 制程工艺” and “超强性能 巅峰能效”, plus a red-gold Snapdragon chip illustration labeled “Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6”. At the bottom center, place the product name in very large text “荣耀 WIN X”, with “WIN X” in bright blue gradient and the rest in metallic white, and beneath it the smaller slogan “为战而生 进化不止”. Along the very bottom edge, add a thin row of small Chinese specs text: “15000mAh 青海湖电池 | 超强制冷风扇 | 骁龙 8Elite Gen6 | 165Hz 荣耀绿洲护眼电竞屏”, plus tiny disclaimer text at the lower right. Make the composition symmetrical, aggressive, premium, and epic, like a flagship gaming phone reveal poster from a major tech company.

items.title: Street Portrait with Churro
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic golden-hour street fashion portrait of a young woman holding a packaged churro, suitable for lifestyle, travel, or casual food-adjacent editorial imagery.
items.content: A candid, photorealistic outdoor portrait of a young East Asian woman standing on a sunlit street or plaza, framed from mid-thigh upward, with a softly blurred background showing a food stall or kiosk and a few indistinct people. She has a neat short bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} with a side part, and she faces the camera in a relaxed upright pose. Her outfit consists of 2 visible clothing layers: a fitted ribbed turtleneck knit top in {argument name="top color" default="pale blue"} underneath a sleeveless A-line pinafore mini dress in {argument name="dress color" default="light beige"}, with broad shoulder straps, 2 decorative round buttons at the strap attachments, and a prominent full-length front zipper with a ring pull. In one hand she holds 1 long churro in a tall white paper sleeve printed vertically with orange Japanese text reading {argument name="package text" default="チュロス"} and a small orange snack illustration near the bottom. Warm afternoon golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, natural skin tones, soft shadows, realistic fabric texture, fashion-street-snapshot aesthetic, high detail, DSLR-style portrait photography.

items.title: Japanese Anime AI Launch Poster
items.description: A bright anime-style Japanese promo poster for an AI image model launch, suitable for social posts, ads, and announcement graphics.
items.content: Create a vibrant Japanese promotional poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Sousaku.ai"} announcing {argument name="product name" default="GPT Image 2.0"}. Use a vertical 3:4 layout with a flashy anime-tech advertising style, bright cyan, blue, purple, pink, and white gradients, glowing sparkles, lens flares, halftone dots, and dynamic diagonal light streaks. On the right side, feature a large half-body anime girl mascot in a futuristic streetwear outfit, silver-white long wavy hair with cool blue highlights, pale skin, blue eyes, a confident smile, and one hand thrust toward the viewer with an extended pointing finger in strong foreshortened perspective. She wears a glossy white and blue jacket over a dark inner outfit, a black choker, layered accessories, and a visible badge or tag with an S logo and the text Sousaku.ai. Her face area is covered by a plain square censor block. On the left, place a large stacked headline in bold Japanese display typography with thick outlines and drop shadows reading exactly: "Sousaku.aiに", "GPT Image 2.0", "が来た！". Below it, add a blue ribbon banner with white text reading "話題の現最強モデル". Under that, add a rounded blue header box with white text reading "GPT Image 2.0のここがすごい！". Beneath the header, create 4 rounded rectangular feature panels stacked vertically, each with a pastel icon circle on the left, Japanese text in the center, and a sample image thumbnail on the right. Panel 1: icon is a speech bubble with a Japanese flag, headline text in pink-red "日本語プロンプトOK", smaller black explanatory text in 3 lines, and a thumbnail of a traditional Japanese street with a pagoda and cherry blossoms. Panel 2: icon is a yellow lightning bolt, headline text in orange "即座に高品質生成", smaller black explanatory text in 3 lines, and a thumbnail of a futuristic neon city at night. Panel 3: icon is an artist palette and brush, headline text in green "多彩な表現力", smaller black explanatory text in 3 lines, and a thumbnail of an anime fantasy girl in a snowy or bright scenic setting, with the face lightly obscured. Panel 4: icon is a magic wand with sparkles, headline text in purple "高い一貫性と精度", smaller black explanatory text in 2 lines, and a thumbnail row containing exactly 3 close-up anime character portrait variants side by side, each face obscured. At the very bottom, add a bold call-to-action on a dark blue strip reading exactly "→ {argument name="call to action" default="Sousaku.ai で試してみよう"}" with the brand name in large yellow letters and the remaining text in white. Make the overall composition dense, polished, glossy, and eye-catching like a social media announcement poster for a new AI image model.

items.title: Warm Welcome Home Anime Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a cozy vertical anime character poster of a gentle woman welcoming the viewer home, ideal for emotional character art and comforting social media illustrations.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAIイラストレーター

items.content: A warm, healing anime illustration of a gentle older-sister type woman welcoming the viewer home at the apartment doorway at night, drawn in a soft romantic shoujo style with glowing amber indoor lighting, delicate linework, painterly shading, and a cozy emotional atmosphere. She is shown from a slightly low eye-level perspective, leaning forward as if opening the door and reaching one hand toward the viewer in invitation, creating an intimate first-person point of view. Her expression should feel tender, affectionate, and reassuring. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep brown"} long slightly damp-looking wavy hair, loosely tied back with soft strands framing her face. She wears a cream cable-knit cardigan with large buttons over a white camisole and a high-waisted brown pleated skirt with a ribbon tie. The background is a warmly lit home interior with wooden floor, soft curtains, a floor lamp, framed wall art, and potted plants, all slightly blurred to keep focus on her. Add subtle sparkles, floral lace corner decorations, and a thin ornamental border framing the entire image like a vintage character poster. Include prominent Japanese text integrated into the design: large vertical glowing text on the left reading "おかえり、今日もおつかれさま。", a small speech bubble near the upper right reading "ほら、こっちおいで♡", a smaller comforting line in a translucent box reading "ここでは、強がらなくていいよ。", and a large elegant name title at the bottom reading "{argument name="character name" default="白瀬まどか"}" with romanized subtitle "Shirase Madoka". She has long dark brown hair falling over her shoulders and wears an oversized navy track jacket with two white stripes running down both sleeves, loose light gray sweatpants, white crew socks, and chunky white low-top sneakers. Her pose is relaxed and slouched, knees bent and spread naturally, one shoulder leaning back against the wall, giving an effortless casual outfit snapshot vibe. The setting is gritty and authentic: weathered concrete walls, a metal door or utility panel, stickers, graffiti tags, exposed pipes, and a sunlit sidewalk with soft shadows. Add handwritten white Japanese text on the upper left wall in a casual marker style, arranged in 3 lines, reading exactly: "今日のコーデ\nわたしらしくて\nちょっとすきかも。" Keep the text looking naturally hand-drawn rather than typographically perfect. The composition should feel like a spontaneous social-media outfit post, with shallow depth of field, realistic fabric texture, subtle highlights on the hair, and understated muted city colors. items.title: Chinese Schoolchildren at Corner Shop
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic candid street scene of schoolchildren buying snacks at a small Chinese neighborhood shop, ideal for documentary-style lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A candid, photorealistic street documentary photo of three primary school children buying snacks at a small old-fashioned neighborhood convenience shop in China, shot in soft natural daylight. The scene is framed straight-on at storefront level, with a slightly compressed everyday snapshot feel, realistic textures, and subtle depth. On the left, one schoolgirl stands in profile wearing a light pink zip-up jacket, dark jeans, and a red scarf, her black hair tied in a ponytail with a white headband, looking down at coins or a small item in her hands. In the center, one schoolboy stands with his back to the camera in a bright blue school tracksuit and a navy-and-red backpack featuring a Mickey Mouse graphic, leaning slightly toward the counter. On the right, one younger schoolgirl with two low pigtails tied with pale pink hair ties leans against a large chest freezer, wearing a white long-sleeve top and blue athletic pants, with a pink backpack resting beside her. Behind the counter, inside the dim shop interior, one shopkeeper in a pink top with a cartoon character print stands partially obscured in shadow. The counter is cluttered with packaged snacks, clear plastic bags of candy, colorful biscuit boxes, jars, and small goods; the shelves behind are densely packed with drinks and snacks. A bunch of multicolored balloons hangs near the upper center of the shop entrance. The chest freezer in the foreground is white with a green lid trim and green Chinese branding on the side. The storefront is worn and modest, with peeling beige walls, a posted calendar or notice sheet on the left wall, metal-framed windows, and an open service window. Include authentic Chinese neighborhood shop details, natural messiness, believable lighting, muted urban colors, and an unposed slice-of-life atmosphere. Faces should be softly obscured or turned away, emphasizing realism and privacy rather than portrait detail.

items.title: Nostalgic Chinese School Shop Scene
items.description: A photorealistic slice-of-life street image of four schoolchildren buying snacks and toys at a worn neighborhood shop, ideal for nostalgic documentary or cinematic realism prompts.
items.content: A highly realistic documentary-style street photo in a small older Chinese town, showing a nostalgic elementary school convenience stall set against worn plaster walls and exposed brick. The main subject is a tiny roadside shop with a faded red hanging sign that reads "小卖部 便民商店", under a weathered clay-tile roof with rusted metal supports. In the right background, a concrete school gate bears a large red slogan reading "好好学习 天天向上" above a locked iron gate. In front of the stall, exactly 4 young schoolboys in matching blue-and-white Chinese school tracksuits stand in a loose line, viewed mostly from behind and in three-quarter rear angle, each carrying a backpack in different muted colors, as they browse toys and snacks after school. A shopkeeper sits inside the dim stall opening, partially obscured by merchandise. The storefront is densely packed with colorful hanging snack packets, candy, bubble gum, small toy capsules, plastic balls, lollipops, cheap stationery, children's books, and boxed goods. A glass display counter in front contains brightly colored toys, notebooks, small bottles, figurines, toy vehicles, and snack boxes; a metal bucket on the ground at left is filled with long colorful pens or pinwheels. The environment should feel candid and lived-in: cracked paint, peeling posters, dusty pavement, uneven concrete, old walls, soft afternoon sunlight, warm earthy tones, shallow depth of field, natural imperfections, authentic textures, and the visual feeling of a memory from the {argument name="time period" default="early 2000s"}. Photorealistic, cinematic realism, human-scale perspective, rich incidental detail, subtle haze, no stylization, no glamour, just believable everyday life in front of a school shop in {argument name="location" default="a small Chinese town"}.

items.title: Epic Fantasy Double-Exposure Poster
items.description: A cinematic fantasy series poster prompt for generating a dark double-exposure silhouette composition with dragons, castles, war, and bilingual title typography.
items.content: A vertically oriented epic fantasy poster in the style of a prestige television series one-sheet, designed like a Chinese theatrical promotional poster for {argument name="franchise title" default="Game of Thrones"}. The composition is a dramatic double-exposure silhouette of a woman in left-facing side profile occupying most of the frame, her braided hair forming the crown and upper contour of the silhouette. Inside and around the silhouette, blend a vast dark medieval fantasy world with storm clouds, smoke, mountains, castles, dragons, armies, and fire. At the top inside the head area, place 1 grand stone city or castle complex glowing with pale golden light beneath turbulent clouds, and 3 dragons in the sky: 1 large dragon flying prominently on the upper right and 2 smaller distant dragons near the top edge. In the midsection, show 2 fur-cloaked heroic figures standing close together in a bleak winter atmosphere, one centered and one slightly left, with a looming iron-throne-like structure behind them. In the lower right interior, include 1 icy blue-eyed undead king emerging from darkness. Across the lower half, transition from cold mist and coastal water on the left into burning ruins and orange fire on the right, with 1 medium dragon flying near the center-lower area above the battlefield. Scatter tiny marching soldiers and riders along ridgelines and paths to imply war across the landscape. Use a muted palette of ash white, charcoal black, slate blue, steel gray, sepia, and ember orange, with cinematic high contrast, volumetric fog, painterly photo-collage realism, and intricate textured detail. Leave negative space around the silhouette on a warm off-white paper-like background. Add vertical Chinese slogan text along the upper left margin reading {argument name="vertical slogan" default="风暴降临前 传奇永不终结"}. Add a small English logo area on the left reading {argument name="series logo" default="GAME OF THRONES"}. Place a large Chinese title near the lower left reading {argument name="main title" default="冰与火之歌"}, with the English subtitle "A SONG OF ICE AND FIRE" beneath it. Add small credit text below for the novel author George R. R. Martin. Along the bottom, display 5 house sigils in a horizontal row with bilingual labels: Stark, Lannister, Targaryen, Baratheon, Tarly. Beneath them, add the tagline {argument name="bottom tagline" default="THE SEVEN KINGDOMS, ONE THRONE."}. Premium, moody, majestic, collectible poster design.

items.title: Pastel Lavender Anime Girl Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a soft, ornate anime character portrait with long lavender-toned hair, frilly fantasy-lolita clothing, and a censored face, ideal for avatar art or stylized character visuals.
items.content: A delicate vertical anime portrait of a dreamy young woman in an ethereal pastel lavender palette, shown from about mid-thigh up against a soft decorative background of pale swirling lines, floating petals, tiny stars, and subtle sparkles. She has extremely long, voluminous silver-lilac hair styled in twin tails with flowing strands, soft bangs, and ornate ribbon decorations; each side is adorned with large lavender bows, ruffled headband-like trim, dangling gold star charms, and small white flower hair ornaments. Her face is centered and mostly covered by a flat solid pale lavender rectangle censor block, leaving only hints of her ears and hairline visible. She wears an elaborate fantasy-lolita inspired dress in white, pearl, and light violet, with glossy satin fabric, ruffled neckline, layered frills, puffed detached sleeves, gold trim, corset lacing at the waist, and multiple purple bows including 3 clearly visible bow accents on the outfit. Her hands are clasped gently near her chest in a shy, elegant pose. The image should feel soft, refined, feminine, and luminous, with high-detail anime rendering, smooth gradients, airy composition, flowing hair movement, and a romantic celestial aesthetic. items.title: Alishan One-Day Travel Poster
items.description: A richly illustrated vintage-style tourism poster showing a five-stop one-day itinerary through Alishan National Scenic Area, ideal for travel marketing and destination infographics.
items.content: Create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional Chinese for {argument name="destination name" default="阿里山國家風景區"}, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold Art Nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. At the top of the left panel, large headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="阿里山國家風景區一日遊"}. Beneath it, include a short centered tagline in traditional Chinese: 「一座高山，五個經典景點。難忘的奇幻旅程。」 with a small decorative mountain divider. The left panel must contain exactly 5 numbered itinerary stops stacked vertically, each with a circular black-and-gold number badge, a small vignette illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a short Chinese description. The 5 stops are: 1. 「阿里山車站」 at 「(8:00 AM)」 with a wooden mountain railway station illustration and description 「開啟探索神木與森林的旅程。」 2. 「阿里山森林鐵路」 at 「(9:30 AM)」 with a red-and-black steam train illustration and description 「穿越森林，體驗百年林鐵風情。」 3. 「神木區棧道」 at 「(11:30 AM)」 with giant cedar trees and elevated wooden boardwalk illustration and description 「漫步千年巨木下，感受森林靈氣。」 4. 「姊妹潭」 at 「(1:30 PM)」 with a tranquil forest lake and pavilion illustration and description 「欣賞靜謐湖光，聆聽自然樂章。」 5. 「小笠原山展望台」 at 「(4:00 PM)」 with a wooden observation deck above clouds at sunset illustration and description 「觀賞壯闊山景與雲海，欣賞日落。」 The right panel should depict a continuous glowing golden path winding through exactly 5 numbered map markers that match the left panel labels in order, with black-and-gold marker plaques reading: 1 「阿里山車站」, 2 「阿里山森林鐵路」, 3 「神木區棧道」, 4 「姊妹潭」, 5 「小笠原山展望台」. Show stop 1 as a rustic alpine wooden station perched on a cliff among pine forests; stop 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a curved mountain railway with smoke drifting upward; stop 3 as towering ancient red cypress trees with a spiral and zigzag wooden walkway around the trunks; stop 4 as an emerald lake surrounded by dense forest with a small pavilion and arched bridge; stop 5 as a lookout deck on a peak above a sea of clouds, facing a glowing sunset. The environment should feature layered mountain ranges, mist-filled valleys, evergreen forests, golden-hour light, luminous cloud seas, and a romantic painterly atmosphere with rich detail. At the bottom right, add a decorative compass rose labeled N, E, S, W, plus a dark green and gold information box with exactly 2 stats in traditional Chinese: 「總距離 ~9公里 / 5.6英里」 and 「預計時間 全天 - 14,500步」. Overall style: premium tourism poster, painterly digital illustration, nostalgic national-park brochure aesthetic, highly detailed, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, readable Chinese text, vertical 2:3 poster.

items.title: Japanese Space Conference Poster
items.description: A dramatic official-style Japanese poster for a space science conference, useful for recreating promotional event visuals that blend space imagery, local city identity, and detailed information design.
items.content: A polished Japanese event poster in a dramatic, aspirational sci-fi tourism style for {argument name="event year" default="2026"}, vertical layout, rich deep-blue space background blending into a bright daytime cityscape. At the top, outer space with a detailed Earth seen from orbit at upper left, a radiant sun flare at the planet’s edge, dense stars and faint nebulae across the sky. Large bold central Japanese headline text in white with subtle gold accents and a strong drop shadow: 「宇宙科学技術 連合講演会 {argument name="event year" default="2026"}」, with a smaller slogan above reading 「宇宙の未来を、ともに拓く。」. Surrounding the title, exactly 4 space elements: 1 lunar lander descending at left, 1 small satellite with blue solar panels near center-left, 1 larger satellite at upper right, and 1 white rocket launching vertically on the right with bright exhaust and billowing smoke. Add elegant golden orbital swoosh lines circling around the title and spacecraft. Below the title, place a gold badge reading 「宇科連」 and several centered lines of smaller Japanese descriptive text about Japan’s largest academic event for space science and technology, involving space science, JAXA space policy, space development startups, and comprehensive discussions on Japan’s space development strategy. The lower half transitions to a realistic panoramic view of Utsunomiya, Japan, with mountains in the distance and Mount Fuji-like snowy peak visible on the horizon, modern mid-rise city buildings, and a wide tram corridor. Feature a sleek modern yellow-and-black light rail tram prominently in the lower right foreground, angled toward the viewer, glossy reflective windows, destination sign reading 「宇都宮駅東口」, with overhead lines absent for a clean futuristic feel. Near the right midground behind the tram, include a large white satellite dish antenna facility. At the lower left, show a plated serving of exactly 6 golden-brown gyoza dumplings on a white dish with a small soy sauce dipping bowl in front; add a curved red Japanese label on the plate rim reading 「宇都宮餃子」. items.title: Awa Odori Chibi Figure Turnaround
items.description: This prompt turns the main dancer from a festival reference photo into a stylized chibi figurine shown in four product-style angles for character design or merchandise mockups.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, isolate the front-center dancer and transform her into a cute collectible chibi figure inspired by the same Awa Odori pose and costume. Keep the pink kimono, woven amigasa hat, raised arms, one-leg-up dance step, and overall festival identity, but replace the real person with a polished toy-like stylized character on a small wooden display base. Create a clean 2x2 multi-angle product sheet with 4 views: front view, back view, left-side profile, and a side-by-side left/right profile pair. Use a soft warm studio background with creamy bokeh instead of the crowded festival scene. Make it look like a high-end figurine photo shoot, with crisp details, gentle depth of field, and consistent lighting across all four panels.

items.title: Dynamic Awa Odori Night Scene
items.description: This prompt turns a reference parade photo into a more energetic nighttime Awa Odori dance image, useful for creating cinematic festival visuals from a static source.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, transform the front-center dancer into a more dynamic, cinematic Awa Odori festival scene at night. Keep the same pink kimono, amigasa hat, and overall festival identity, but push the pose into active mid-dance motion with one leg stepping forward, the skirt and sleeves swirling, and both arms raised expressively. Recompose the image into a tighter, lower-angle street-level shot centered on the lead dancer, with additional dancers in matching formation behind her for depth and movement. Change the setting from the wide parade crowd to a lantern-lit festival street with warm glowing paper lanterns, illuminated stalls, and visible vertical signage including Japanese text reading "阿波おどり". Emphasize motion, energy, and warm nighttime atmosphere, with vivid lighting, shallow depth of field, and a polished photoreal festival look.

items.title: Gothic Android Warrior Cathedral Key Art
items.description: This prompt generates a moody, high-detail anime game-poster illustration of a blindfolded female warrior in a ruined cathedral, ideal for dark fantasy key art and dramatic character posters.
items.content: A cinematic dark fantasy anime illustration in a ruined gothic cathedral, vertical composition. Show a lone female android-like warrior from behind, centered slightly low in frame, kneeling or sitting back on her heels on a reflective stone floor. She has extremely long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"} hair spreading across the floor and air, a sleek black blindfold visor covering her eyes, and a black high-cut gothic combat dress with elegant straps, long black opera gloves, and thigh-high black boots. Her physique is slim and graceful. She holds 1 large ornate sword upright in front of her, with both hands resting on the hilt, the blade planted on the ground like a memorial. The sword has a dark blade and a decorative gold ring-like guard near the handle. The atmosphere is solemn, tragic, and reverent. Place 3 tall pointed arched windows in the background, glowing with cold white backlight through haze and dust. Include 4 stone angel statues total: 2 larger angels in the left background and 2 in the right background, partially obscured by fog and darkness. Fill the air with drifting ash, snow-like particles, black debris fragments, and a few faint orange embers near the floor. Use dramatic volumetric light rays, soft bloom, smoky mist, high contrast, and a desaturated palette of charcoal gray, silver, blue-gray, and black. The scene should feel like a memorial after a battle, highly detailed, ultra-polished, melancholic, ethereal, and game key art inspired by {argument name="franchise title" default="NieR:Automata"}. Add 1 vertical Japanese title inscription near the lower left reading {argument name="vertical text" default="儚き夢と共にあれ"}, with 1 small vertical English subtitle beside it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="NieR:Automata"}.

items.title: Colorize Historical Aerial Photo
items.description: This prompt turns a black-and-white aerial photograph into a plausible colorized version using another aerial image as a color reference, useful for historical map and geography visualization.
items.content: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base image, colorize the monochrome historical aerial photograph while preserving the exact original framing, angle, scale, film border, edge markings, and all geographic structures. Use REFERENCE_1 only as a color-reference guide for plausible land-surface colors seen from above. Keep the old photo’s layout and terrain details unchanged, but infer naturalistic colors for 4 major surface types: river water in muted blue-green, vegetation and farmland in varied dark greens, bare soil/sand and construction areas in tan-beige, and roads/buildings/industrial roofs in subdued gray to light brown. Maintain a realistic archival aerial-photo look rather than a modern satellite style, with slightly restrained saturation, subtle contrast, and consistent coloring across the whole scene.

items.title: Aerial Photo to Land-Cover Map
items.description: This prompt converts a reference aerial photograph into a false-color land-cover classification map for urban analysis or map-style visualization.
items.content: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source geography and urban layout, transform the monochrome historical aerial photo into a clean land-cover classification map using the false-color visual language implied by REFERENCE_1. Keep the same top-down viewpoint and street/block structure, but replace photographic texture with flat segmented regions and crisp boundaries. Classify the scene into exactly 6 visual categories: 1) buildings as red, 2) roads and major paved corridors as white, 3) water bodies and canals as blue, 4) dense vegetation/parks as dark green, 5) open grass or sparse green areas as light green, and 6) industrial or large paved/open facility areas as gray. Produce a dense urban thematic map with strong contrast, minimal shading, and no labels, legends, borders, or photographic film markings.

items.title: Dreamy Underwater Woman With Translucent Fish
items.description: This prompt generates a soft surreal poster-like portrait of an anonymous woman in a dissolving white dress surrounded by many translucent fish and whimsical doodles, ideal for poetic social media art or cover visuals.
items.content: A dreamy surreal portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing underwater or in a liquid-like ethereal space, shown from about mid-thigh up, wearing a flowing sleeveless white dress that appears to dissolve into translucent water and shimmering fragments. Her long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair streams dramatically sideways as if suspended in water, and her face is intentionally obscured by a soft vertical blur block for anonymity. Surround her with an exact count of about 30 small translucent fish, some striped and some pale silvery white, swimming in multiple depths of field across the foreground, midground, and background, with several fish passing in front of her body and hair to create strong motion and depth. Use a soft pastel {argument name="background color" default="powder blue"} background with faint handwritten script texture layered across it, plus whimsical doodles scattered throughout: white and pale pink hearts, stars, curved squiggles, wave lines, dots, sparkles, and 2 smiley faces. Add prismatic rainbow refractions, glossy caustic highlights, and subtle lens-like chromatic shimmer on the fish and dress. The mood should feel delicate, introspective, airy, and magical, with high-key lighting, gentle contrast, soft focus in the foreground, and crisp detail on the torso and hair. Compose the figure slightly off-center with one arm relaxed downward and the body turned lightly in motion, as if drifting peacefully through a school of fish. Include tiny elegant footer text in white near the bottom edge, with a left signature, a centered website URL, and a small right credit mark, resembling an art-poster or social-media showcase image.
