items.title: Anime McDonald's Recommendation Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a bright Japanese anime-style McDonald's ad poster featuring a kemonomimi girl and four popular menu items for promotional or fan-art campaign visuals.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAIイラストレーター

items.content: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional anime poster in a vertical layout, themed around McDonald's recommendations. The background is a bold red and white graphic design with golden sparkles, sweeping shapes, and energetic ad-style composition. In the upper left corner, show the McDonald's golden arches logo inside a red square. On the left half, feature a stylish anime girl with fox or wolf ears and a fluffy tail, shown from mid-thigh up, wearing a modern dark navy and black streetwear outfit with blue accents: cropped top exposing the midriff, layered jacket, belt, straps, and small decorative pins. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple"}, medium-length and tousled. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft blurred rectangular censor block. She holds a large sesame-seed burger in her left hand and gestures invitingly with her right hand toward the food items. Across the top right, include large Japanese headline text reading 彩葉のおすすめ！マクドナルド, with a smaller black banner beneath it reading 食べたくなる定番メニューをチェック！. Arrange 4 numbered menu callouts in rounded white speech-bubble labels with red and yellow accents: item 1 is ビッグマック next to a Big Mac image near the center-right; item 2 is マックフライポテト next to a tall red fries carton on the right; item 3 is チキンマックナゲット next to an open nugget box containing exactly 6 chicken nuggets and a cup of red dipping sauce near the lower center-right; item 4 is てりやきマックバーガー next to a glossy teriyaki burger near the lower left-center. Also place a white McDonald's drink cup with ice and dark soda in the bottom left. On the right side, include 2 small informational badges stacked vertically: one badge with a sun and moon icon and Japanese text 朝は朝マック、夜は夜マックも楽しめる！, and one badge with a smartphone icon and Japanese text アプリでモバイルオーダーも便利！. At the very bottom, add a large bold Japanese slogan in white and yellow on a red banner: 今日はマックに行きたくなる！. Add tiny disclaimer text along the lower edge. The illustration style is polished, colorful anime key visual art mixed with commercial food photography rendering for the burgers, fries, nuggets, and drink; highly appetizing, glossy lighting, clean outlines, dynamic ad composition, and a cheerful promotional mood.

items.title: Anime KFC Princess Promo Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a bright anime-style Japanese KFC advertisement poster featuring a festive princess mascot and prominently displayed fried chicken meal items for commercial or parody promo art.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAIイラストレーター

items.content: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional poster in glossy anime advertising style, themed around KFC and a magical princess mascot. The composition is vertical and packed but still a single unified ad scene. At center-right, a cheerful young anime woman inspired by Princess Kaguya poses energetically toward the viewer with one hand reaching forward and the other arm lifted. She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, large sparkling amber-red eyes, a bright open smile, and ornate hair accessories including red floral ornaments, dangling beads, green ribbons, and a small gold crescent-moon crown. She wears a festive kimono-inspired outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative cords, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with a flower knot. Her hair and sleeves sweep dramatically as if caught in a lively breeze. In the lower left foreground, show 1 large KFC bucket overflowing with 4 pieces of crispy fried chicken, rendered extra crunchy, golden, juicy, and appetizing. Along the bottom foreground, include 3 side items: 1 chicken burger with sesame bun and lettuce, 1 small carton of fries, and 1 biscuit or pie-like pastry topped with glossy syrup. Use the KFC logo in the top right and on the bucket and fries carton, with the Colonel face partially censored by a rectangular blur on the bucket. Surround the scene with celebratory red-and-gold graphics, sparkles, brushstroke flourishes, and festive Japanese New Year-like motifs. Add large bold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading ケンタッキーの魅力 in thick red characters with white and gold outline. Add 2 white brushstroke callout bubbles on the left with red text: サクッと香ばしい！ and ジューシーで大満足！. Add a red flower-shaped badge on the right reading 今日のごほうびに. Add a red bottom banner with white text listing オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット. Extremely polished commercial illustration, high saturation, warm lighting, clean line art, glossy food rendering, energetic composition, premium poster finish.

items.title: Anime MOS Burger Promo Poster
items.description: A vibrant Japanese-style promotional poster blending an elegant fantasy anime heroine with four featured MOS Burger menu items for a branded ad or social media campaign.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAIイラストレーター

items.content:
A polished Japanese fast-food promotional poster in a bright anime-advertisement style, combining a fantasy princess character with clean product photography and cheerful branding. The composition is landscape and split visually: on the left, a full-body anime girl inspired by a moon-princess or bamboo-princess aesthetic stands in a welcoming pose with one hand extended toward the viewer and the other hand near her face. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white with pastel pink and lavender gradients"} hair, large expressive eyes, and an elegant floral-and-ribbon hair ornament in dark blue, gold, pink, and turquoise. Her outfit is a luxurious modernized kimono dress in white, teal, navy, and pink with translucent sleeves, floral patterns, layered obi bows, tassels, and gold ornaments, with a magical sparkling atmosphere around her. Behind her is a dreamy teal-and-cream background with soft circles, starry sparkles, faint floral motifs, sweeping decorative lines, and a subtle silhouette of a Japanese pagoda.

On the right is a neat food-ad layout for {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"}, with the red MOS BURGER logo at the top left corner and again at the bottom right. At the top center-right, place a green ribbon banner with the Japanese text "モスバーガー特集". Below it, add a large elegant handwritten-style Japanese headline: "行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。" with the middle phrase "できたて" emphasized in vivid pink-red while the rest is black. Under that, add a smaller subheadline in Japanese: "ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー". 

Feature exactly 4 food items arranged horizontally across the middle-right, each rendered as appetizing semi-photorealistic product shots with soft shadows and crisp detail. Item 1: a classic burger with bun, thick meat patty, sauce, mayonnaise, and a large tomato slice, with a red circular badge reading "定番人気" and the label "モスバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 2: a teriyaki burger with lettuce and glossy sauce, with a green circular badge reading "和風人気" and the label "テリヤキバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 3: a white paper carton of onion rings with a yellow circular badge reading "サイドも最高" and the label "オニポテ" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 4: a pink milkshake in a clear cup with straw, with a blue circular badge reading "ひんやり甘い" and the label "モスシェイク" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. 

Below the products, add a rounded rectangular recommendation box with a teal border and a teal ribbon title reading "おすすめポイント". Inside, include exactly 4 bullet points in Japanese with pink flower-like bullets, describing made-to-order freshness, the appeal of the classic meat sauce and tomato burger, the Japanese-style popularity of teriyaki burger, and that onion rings and shake are also must-try items. To the right inside the same lower area, include a smaller rounded box with line-art icons of cutlery, a drink, and a burger, plus Japanese copy that reads "モスのこだわり" and "おいしさは、まごころから。" followed by smaller explanatory Japanese text.

Across the bottom, place a large curved banner with a teal gradient and white center glow containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the lower right, add a small orange-red circular callout with Japanese text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!". Use a crisp commercial poster layout, vivid teal, aqua, white, pink, and gold accents, glossy food rendering, decorative sparkles, and a premium collaboration feel between anime fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

items.title: Anthro Idol Group Concert Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a high-detail anime-style concert poster of a five-member anthropomorphic idol group on a glowing stage, ideal for music visuals, key art, or VTuber-style unit branding.
items.content:
A polished anime idol concert key visual on a glowing stage staircase, featuring exactly 5 anthropomorphic performers posed in a dynamic diagonal formation under dramatic purple-blue concert lighting and sparkling spotlights. The scene is viewed from a slightly low, wide-angle perspective to emphasize depth and stage presence, with neon-lit steps leading upward and metal truss structures framing the background. At center back is a large illuminated crest with a pawprint inside a geometric star emblem, flanked by laurel motifs, suggesting an idol group logo. The floor and stair edges glow with violet and blue rim light, and tiny glitter particles plus a few gold confetti pieces float through the air. The mood is energetic, triumphant, and glamorous, like a promotional poster for a live performance.

The 5 performers are all kemonomimi or furry idol characters in coordinated fantasy-stage costumes with belts, chains, layered fabrics, fingerless gloves, and tailored accessories, each color-themed individually while sharing a unified group design language. From left to right: a gray wolf boy in a deep blue outfit, closest to camera, smiling confidently and reaching one paw forward toward the viewer; an orange fox boy in black, white, and orange, stepping forward with a playful grin and one hand extended; a gray-and-white wolf boy in black, white, and green, standing slightly behind center and pointing upward/outward; a white rabbit girl in black, white, and pink, with tall bunny ears, fluffy tail, short skirt layers, and one arm raised high in an idol pose; and a brown bear boy in navy and gold, turned mostly away in a cool over-the-shoulder stance with one arm extended sideways. All characters should have expressive anime faces, fluffy fur rendering, detailed tails and paws, and high-end polished illustration quality.

Give each outfit a distinct accent color: blue for the left wolf, orange for the fox, green for the center wolf, pink for the rabbit, and gold for the bear. Costumes should mix idol fashion with fantasy military stagewear: fitted jackets or vests, asymmetrical panels, short trousers or layered skirts, harness straps, metallic trims, hanging chains, decorative cords, and patterned fabric inserts. The characters should look like a cohesive idol unit named {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}. Use {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} as the dominant lighting palette, with bright white spotlights from above and subtle lens glow. Place {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel branches"} on the back screen. The overall style should be {argument name="art style" default="high-detail anime idol promotional illustration"}, and the atmosphere should feel like {argument name="performance mood" default="a climactic live show finale"}.

items.title: Clean Photo of The Last Supper Fresco
items.description: This prompt turns a reference photo of The Last Supper into a cleaner documentary-style image of the mural, useful for art reproduction or museum-style presentation.
items.content: Using the provided reference image of The Last Supper, recreate the same mural as a clean, straightforward full-frame photograph of the artwork itself. Keep the original composition, the 13 seated figures, the long table, the architectural room, and the aged fresco texture unchanged, but remove the museum-like presentation cues from the reference: eliminate the face blurring on all 13 figures, remove the large foreground barrier/plinth blocking the bottom center, and crop/compose it as a more natural documentary photo of the painting with the lower table and floor visible. Maintain the worn, faded Renaissance colors, frontal viewpoint, and realistic art-photography look.

items.title: Japanese Horror Game Street Reflection
items.description: This prompt generates a dark ultra-realistic survival horror game screenshot of a man confronting a distorted ghostly reflection in a rainy Japanese city street.
items.content: A cinematic Japanese psychological horror game screenshot at night, shown from a third-person over-the-shoulder perspective behind a young man wearing a dark hooded jacket, standing under a convenience store awning and staring into a large front window. In the glass, instead of a normal reflection, there is a terrifying humanoid figure with an unnaturally elongated oval head, long straight black hair hanging down both sides, a pale expressionless face, and a dark coat, standing directly opposite him. Beyond the reflection is a wet urban street in Japan with glossy rain-soaked asphalt, sparse pedestrians holding umbrellas, dim storefronts, vending machines, parking signs, and tall buildings bending inward in a surreal warped perspective toward a dark swirling vortex in the sky at the end of the street. items.title: Anime X Battle Poster
items.description: A dramatic anime poster of two schoolgirls arguing on X/Twitter, designed for viral social media battle visuals and stylized platform-themed key art.
items.content:
Create a dramatic anime-style social media battle poster inspired by X/Twitter, split vertically down the center into two opposing halves with a glowing lightning-like divide and a huge luminous VS at the bottom center. The composition is a tall smartphone-optimized promotional key visual with dense layered UI cards, speech bubbles, tweet screenshots, reaction counters, and explosive energy effects. At the top center, place a large X logo with the title text "BATTLE" and the Japanese subtitle "Xでレスバ中". The left side is a cool purple and black theme, the right side is a hot red and white theme, with sparks, streaks, embers, and motion lines flying across both sides.

Show 2 anime schoolgirl characters facing off. On the left, a calm, composed girl representing logical rebuttal: long dark black-to-purple gradient hair, straight bangs, pale skin, slim build, black sailor-style school uniform with purple neck ribbon, pleated skirt, black knee socks, loafers, holding a smartphone in one hand and touching her glasses or temple with the other. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur mosaic over the central face area. Her stance is reserved and still. Surround her with purple glowing tweet cards and speech bubbles. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "雲居モヤ @kumoi_moya". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "それ、前提が雑だよね。", "感情だけでは通らないよ。", and "論点、そこじゃない。". Also include exactly 5 smaller purple UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a small comment bubble reading "それな 千代先輩、強すぎ…", 2) a small comment bubble reading "論理的で草 完全に正論パンチ", 3) a like card reading "いいね! 12.8K", 4) a repost card reading "リポスト 9,341", and 5) a dark trend card reading "おすすめトレンド #モヤVSエナ 42,857件のポスト". Add a central dark smartphone tweet panel tilted slightly, showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "それ、前提が雑だよね。", and counters "312", "1,204", and "8,745".

On the right, show an aggressive, fiery girl representing emotional counterattack and confidence: vivid red hair in a high messy side bun with long loose hair, bright teal eyes, fair skin, energetic expression, open shouting mouth, pointing directly toward the opponent with one hand while the other hand rests on her hip. She wears a white blouse, black jumper-style dress or vest dress, oversized red bow tie, white loose socks scrunched around the ankles, and black loafers. Surround her with red glowing tweet cards and notification-style UI. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "緋空エナ @hisora_ena". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", and "逃げてないで答えて!". Also include exactly 6 smaller red UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a top notification badge card reading "通知 99+", 2) a small comment bubble reading "エナちゃん つよすぎるww", 3) a small comment bubble reading "言いたいこと全部言ってくれる!", 4) a like card reading "いいね! 18.7K", 5) a like card reading "いいね! 23.6K", and 6) a repost card reading "リポスト 11.2K". Add a red tweet panel near the center showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", and counters "278", "1,652", and "10.9K".

In the lower middle area, place exactly 3 central dark interface cards bridging both sides: 1) a quote-post card labeled "引用ポスト" showing both users and the exchange "論点、そこじゃない。" and "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", 2) a reply count card reading "返信 1,876件", and 3) a bottom navigation bar styled like the X mobile app with home, search, notifications, messages icons and a blue button labeled "ポスト". The overall aesthetic should be glossy, high-contrast, highly rendered anime illustration with neon edge lighting, intense backlighting, dynamic perspective, layered translucency, and a chaotic viral-internet argument atmosphere. Use crisp Japanese UI typography, dramatic red-vs-purple color contrast, and polished promotional-poster quality.

items.title: Brutal Red-Kimono Manga Fight Page
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic multi-panel manga page of a red-clad woman violently defeating multiple enemies, ideal for action comic art and intense seinen-style visuals.
items.content: A gritty black-and-white manga action page with selective red color on the heroine’s clothing, arranged as 6 comic panels with dynamic diagonal borders on a white page. The central and largest panel shows a fierce young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and blunt bangs, wearing a short red kimono-style robe with a wide golden obi sash, barefoot, delivering a high vertical kick into a burly man’s face; her face is obscured by a soft square blur, and the impact explodes with ink splatter and debris. In the top-left panel, the same woman crouches low in a feral fighting stance on cracked ground, one hand touching the earth, hair streaming outward, robe open enough to show powerful legs. A narrow close-up panel shows only her intense eyes under straight bangs, cold and focused. In the bottom-left panel, she drives a straight punch into an attacker with a dramatic burst effect at the point of contact. In the bottom-center panel, she performs a rising kick or sweeping upward strike against another large male opponent, with speed lines and hair flowing. In the bottom-right panel, shown from behind, she stands calmly amid defeated men lying on the ground with smoke or dust rising around them, her long hair cascading down her back and the red robe hanging loosely. Use rough ink brushwork, heavy speed lines, splattered impact effects, high-contrast manga shading, violent kinetic composition, and bold Japanese sound effect lettering in black. The mood is brutal, cinematic, and relentless, like a seinen revenge manga. Keep the page mostly monochrome except for the woman’s red robe and subtle warm sash accents.

items.title: Dark Moonlit Noir Album Cover
items.description: A cinematic dark-fantasy music cover image featuring a brooding man, a moonlit city, and a winged figure, ideal for album art or lyric-based promotional visuals.
items.content: A dark, cinematic album-cover-style scene inside a high-rise room at night, viewed from a moody interior looking out over a vast modern city filled with dense skyscraper lights. On the left side, a solitary man sits slouched beside a tall rain-speckled window, his face obscured in deep shadow and cigarette smoke drifting upward, wearing a dark suit or open-collar dress shirt with a disheveled, brooding presence. In the lower left foreground, place exactly 2 liquor bottles, 1 short tumbler glass with amber whiskey, and a cluttered tabletop reflecting low warm light. Outside the giant window on the right, a winged human figure with large black feathered wings hovers or descends over the city, silhouetted dramatically against a huge luminous full moon surrounded by torn clouds and faint sparkling particles in the sky. The palette is nearly monochrome with cold blue-black shadows and small warm amber highlights from the drink and room lights. Add layered atmospheric haze, smoke, wet glass texture, dramatic contrast, realistic photography blended with dark fantasy, luxury noir, melancholic and dangerous mood. Across the lower middle, overlay large ornate serif title typography reading {argument name="title text" default="Soul King D'Ryoichi"}, with a decorative crown and flourishes integrated into the lettering. Beneath it, add a smaller elegant Japanese subtitle line reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="見上げた月は存外に綺麗で"}. Make it look like a premium music single cover or visual for lyrics, highly detailed, polished, cinematic, centered composition, square format.

items.title: Japanese AI Product Landing Page Hero
items.description: A premium Japanese e-commerce hero image for a fictional AI food-safety scanner, suitable for startup landing pages and concept product marketing.
items.content:
Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional premium consumer tech product brand called {argument name="brand name" default="DOKUMI"}. The page should look like a modern beauty-tech and food-safety product website, in a soft warm beige and ivory palette with elegant editorial styling, lots of whitespace, and subtle luxury cosmetics branding. Use a wide desktop web layout screenshot with a top navigation bar, a large left-aligned headline block, and a right-side lifestyle product photo composition.

The top header contains 8 visible navigation elements in a single row: the brand logo text "DOKUMI" at far left, then "ABOUT", "PRODUCT", "FEATURE", "INGREDIENT", "VOICE", "Q&A", then a small user account icon, and a rounded red call-to-action button labeled "今すぐ購入する" at the far right. Beneath the button area on the upper right, add a vertical red ribbon badge with white Japanese text reading exactly 4 stacked text groups: "発売記念", "限定", "20%", "OFF", plus small "CAMPAIGN" text below.

The hero section is split into two main columns. On the left, place a very large Japanese headline in elegant Mincho-style serif typography over three lines: "一口目は、", then "AIが先に。" with dramatic scale and generous spacing. Below it, add a smaller two-line Japanese subheading describing AI-based detection of food toxins, foreign substances, and allergens before eating, in a refined gray tone. Under that, place 2 horizontal CTA buttons: a filled red rounded button labeled "今すぐ始める" with a right arrow, and a white outlined rounded button labeled "詳しく見る" with a right arrow.

Below the buttons, add a row of 3 rounded white feature cards with thin borders and simple black line icons. items.title: Anime Girl in Straw Hat Under Blue Sky
items.description: A clean, polished anime portrait of a windblown girl in a straw hat and white dress, ideal for generating serene summer key art or wallpaper-style character illustrations.
items.content: A serene anime-style summer portrait of a young woman standing outdoors under a vivid blue sky with 4 soft white cloud clusters visible near the frame edges and a few tiny sparkling light specks in the air. She is shown from a low angle, framed from about the waist up, slightly turned to the side while looking calmly toward the viewer with a gentle, quiet expression. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="very dark indigo-black"} hair with full blunt bangs covering the forehead and many loose strands flowing dramatically to the right in the wind, large soft brown-gray eyes, pale skin, and a faint blush on her cheeks. She wears a wide-brimmed natural straw sunhat with a dark band and a simple sleeveless white summer dress with thin straps and minimal detail. Lighting is bright midday sunlight with soft cel-shaded anime rendering, subtle rim light, clean linework, delicate gradients, and a dreamy polished illustration style. The mood is airy, nostalgic, elegant, and peaceful, with the sky filling the background and no buildings or other objects.

items.title: Low-Angle Anime Summer Hand Reach
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic single-character anime illustration of a woman in a windy summer countryside scene reaching toward the viewer, ideal for showcasing dramatic perspective and vivid seasonal atmosphere.
items.content: A dramatic anime-style summer scene viewed from an extreme low angle with strong foreshortening: a young woman in a flowing white sundress and a wide-brim straw hat stands on a sunlit country path and reaches one hand directly toward the camera, her open palm dominating the foreground in exaggerated perspective as if inviting the viewer to take her hand. She has very long {argument name="hair color" default="deep black"} hair streaming powerfully sideways in the wind, and a white ribbon tied to the hat also whips through the air. Her dress is sleeveless, softly pleated, light and breezy, cinched at the waist with a fabric bow on one side, with glossy sunlight highlights on her skin and fabric. The composition emphasizes motion, scale, and cinematic depth, with the character towering against a vivid cobalt summer sky filled with a few wispy cloud streaks and puffy white clouds near the horizon. Place her on a paved rural walkway bordered by rustic wooden fences on both sides, with green fields and distant low mountains in the background. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering with painterly detail, saturated colors, bright midday lighting, high contrast, ultra-clean linework, and a sense of awe and freedom. No text, no additional characters, single-subject illustration.

items.title: Rural Station Schoolgirl Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic anime-style countryside station scene with a lone schoolgirl, ideal for slice-of-life travel illustrations and atmospheric character art.
items.content: A cinematic anime-style illustration of a quiet rural Japanese train station in early summer, filled with travel nostalgia and bright midday light. In the foreground, one high school girl stands alone on the platform near the left side of the frame, facing slightly toward the viewer with a shy, gentle posture, her legs together and one foot angled inward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short bobbed hair with soft bangs, and wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor blouse with navy trim, a vivid red neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. She holds a dark school bag in one hand at her side. Her expression should feel calm, a little wistful, as if she was just about to speak before the train arrived. Place her beside an old weathered wooden station building with large windowpanes and a simple wooden bench. Above her is 1 hanging station sign reading {argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}, with smaller romanized text “YAMANOSHITA” and small local line information beneath it. The right half of the image opens to 1 set of railway tracks receding into the distance, bordered by lush green grass and wildflowers, with 1 small local train approaching from far down the line. Add a few utility poles running alongside the tracks. In the deep background, show a dramatic mountain range with lingering snow on the peaks under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Composition should balance the girl on the left and the railway perspective on the right, with detailed background scenery, crisp sunlight, soft anime rendering, realistic textures in the station wood and rails, and a heartfelt slice-of-life travel mood.

items.title: Japanese Skincare Lotion Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a polished spring-themed Japanese beauty advertisement featuring a dewy model, a transparent lotion bottle, cherry blossoms, and elegant editorial typography for skincare branding.
items.content: A high-end Japanese skincare advertisement for a moisturizing lotion, shot in a luminous soft-white studio with a clean airy beauty aesthetic. On the right half of the image, a close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman with flawless dewy skin, natural glossy lips, subtle peach-toned makeup, dark brown eyes, and dark hair loosely tied back with a few wispy strands across her forehead. She smiles gently at the camera and rests one hand against her cheek, wearing a simple white sleeveless top. On the left half, place 1 tall transparent frosted bottle of lotion standing upright on a reflective water surface, with tiny water droplets on the bottle and a shiny silver cap. The bottle label reads "SUIREN" and "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Surround the bottle with 3 pale pink cherry blossoms: 2 clustered at the lower left corner and 1 floating near the bottom center-right. Add faint sparkles and soft reflections in the water. Use a pastel palette of white, pearl, blush pink, and very light blue-gray, with diffused daylight, silky skin retouching, shallow depth of field, and a premium cosmetic campaign look. Include Japanese ad copy on the left in elegant black Mincho-style typography: a large 2-line headline reading "触れたくなる、" and "透明感。"; beneath it, 2 smaller lines reading "うるおい満ちて、" and "澄みわたる素肌へ。"; a thin outlined circle containing 2 stacked phrases with an × between them, "高保湿" and "透明感". In the lower right, add small Japanese text "うるおいが、私を輝かせる。" above the brand name "SUIREN" and the subtitle "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Composition should feel balanced and luxurious, like a magazine-ready spring skincare poster.

items.description: A soft kawaii App Store-style promotional image for a pastel Japanese escape game, useful for mobile game marketing visuals and store screenshots.

author.name: もやし太郎 | AI×個人開発

items.content: A polished Japanese mobile game promotional graphic in a soft pastel kawaii style, formatted as a square split-screen advertisement with 2 vertical panels side by side. The left half has a pale blush pink watercolor background, and the right half has a warm cream-to-pink gradient background. At the top of the left panel, place a large bold rounded Japanese headline in dark rose pink reading {argument name="left headline text" default="ミルクと、ふわふわ脱出。"}, with a smaller gray subtitle below reading {argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしい謎解きの世界へ"}. Centered below is a black-framed modern smartphone mockup showing the title screen of a cute pastel escape game: a fluffy cream-colored kitten with big watery eyes on a sparkly pink background, decorative bubbles and hearts, a logo in Japanese reading もふもふミルク にゃんこ with a smaller ribbon-like subtitle 脱出ゲーム, and a large rounded start button near the bottom reading はじめる. Around the phone on the pink background, scatter translucent soap bubbles, tiny bows, hearts, and star-shaped sparkles near the lower area. In the right panel, place a large bold rounded Japanese headline in dark rose pink reading {argument name="right headline text" default="謎を解いて、おへやを抜けだそう。"}, with a smaller gray subtitle below reading {argument name="right subtitle text" default="全10ステージの脱出パズル"}. Centered below is a second black-framed smartphone mockup showing in-game play: a dreamy pastel pink room with striped wallpaper, a wooden shelf unit or vanity table, 3 small plush animals lined up on the top shelf, 3 empty square frames or slots on the middle shelf, and 2 small objects on the lower shelf including a pink rectangular item and an angled card-like object. Add a tiny top-left room title inside the phone UI reading ミルクのおへや, a small circular icon at top right, a vertical lock icon on the right edge, and a pale bottom text bar reading アイテムがまだないよ. The entire composition should feel like an App Store screenshot for a gentle puzzle game, with soft lighting, pastel pinks and creams, rounded typography, clean spacing, and a cute feminine aesthetic.

items.content: Create a cute Japanese mobile game advertisement poster split vertically into 2 equal halves, with a soft pastel watercolor background and glossy translucent bubbles scattered around the canvas. The left half has a mint green to pale yellow wash, and the right half has a cream to blush pink wash. At the top left, place a large rounded Japanese headline in bold teal green: {argument name="left headline text" default="見つけて、ひらめいて、にゃ。"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it in muted brown-gray: {argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしいヒントで誰でも遊べる"}. At the top right, place a large rounded Japanese headline in bold raspberry pink: {argument name="right headline text" default="ミニゲームも、たっぷり。"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it in muted mauve-gray: {argument name="right subtitle text" default="記憶・パズル・スライドで遊びほうだい"}. Centered in each half is a black-bezel smartphone mockup shown straight-on. The left phone displays a hidden-object style game screen inside a bright greenhouse sunroom with lush tropical plants, a cream hammock stretched diagonally across the middle, pink tiled floor, warm sunlight through glass panels, hanging pastel glass orbs, lemons in the lower left foreground, and tiny cute character accents hidden in the scene; a Japanese room title appears at the top inside the phone UI: {argument name="left game screen title" default="おひるねサンルーム"}. The right phone displays a memory minigame screen on a pale pink interface with a back arrow, a centered Japanese title at the top reading "マカロン記憶ゲーム", a 3-step indicator showing 1 highlighted and 2 and 3 faded, small instruction text "よく見てにゃ…", and exactly 4 macarons arranged in a 2 by 2 grid: pink top left, blue top right, yellow bottom left, white bottom right, each on a soft circular shadow. Add small sparkling star icons and two decorative macarons at the bottom right outside the phone, plus tiny heart doodles nearby. The overall style is polished app-promo key art, kawaii, airy, elegant, soft-focus, with rounded typography, gentle gradients, subtle floral details, and a premium casual game advertisement look.

items.title: Candid Bedroom Lounge Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a soft, realistic vertical lifestyle photo of a woman resting on a bed in a minimalist room, ideal for editorial, fashion, or atmospheric slice-of-life imagery.
items.content: A candid, softly lit lifestyle photograph of a young woman lounging on a white bed in a minimal bedroom, shot vertically with a slightly wide lens from near her knees so her legs and oversized top dominate the foreground. She is lying on her back diagonally across the bed, wearing an oversized dark navy or black sweatshirt and very short light blue denim cutoff shorts with frayed hems, with bare legs visible in the foreground. Her arms are raised above and around her head in a relaxed, sleepy pose, one wrist bent loosely, and her face is mostly obscured by her arms and angle, giving an unposed, intimate feeling. Place the bed against a pale gray wall, with rumpled white bedding and large white pillows. On the left side near a window with sheer curtains, include a freestanding clothing rack holding exactly 8 visible hangers with neutral-toned clothes in black, white, beige, and gray, plus one blue garment draped over the top bar. On the right side behind the bed, include exactly 7 upright books lined on a narrow surface against the wall. Use natural daylight coming from the left window, soft shadows, muted cool tones, slight film-like grain, shallow depth of field, and a calm Japanese apartment aesthetic. Emphasize a relaxed weekend mood, understated realism, and the subtle sense of a presence caught in a private moment rather than direct eye contact.

items.title: Goth Streetwear Anime Icon Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a stylish anime-profile portrait with purple-black hair, dark streetwear, and a blurred face, suitable for social media icons or alternative character branding.
items.content: A centered anime-style bust portrait of an androgynous young person facing forward against a clean pale gray-white background. The composition is square and designed like a social media icon. The character has medium-length layered straight hair with a center part, mostly black with glossy deep violet highlights and vivid purple-dyed lower sections and tips. Loose strands frame the face and the hair falls to the shoulders. The face is intentionally obscured by a large soft-edged square blur block in the center, tinted muted mauve-gray, covering the eyes, nose, and most facial features while leaving the jawline and neck partly visible. Show only a small hint of pale skin around the edges of the blur. The visible ear on the right side is decorated with multiple silver piercings, including small hoops, studs, and a dangling cross earring with chain details. The outfit is dark monochrome streetwear with a subtle goth aesthetic: a black high-neck zip-up inner layer fully zipped to the throat, a black oversized semi-gloss jacket layered over it, a black strap with a rectangular metal buckle over one shoulder, and a thin chain accessory over the other shoulder. Add a long silver necklace with a cross pendant hanging at the center of the chest. Lighting is soft and diffuse, with polished digital painting detail and semi-realistic anime rendering. The mood is cool, stylish, slightly mysterious, and alternative. In the background, add sparse minimalist cyber-glitch accents: several thin vertical bars and tiny rectangular pixels in pastel cyan, lavender, magenta, and dark blue scattered around the figure, plus one faint four-point sparkle near the upper right side. Keep the background uncluttered and airy, with the character occupying most of the frame.

items.title: Anime BL Promo Thumbnail
items.description: This prompt generates a glossy anime-style promotional banner with Japanese headline text and two stylish young men, suitable for blog thumbnails, social posts, or article headers.
items.content: A bright, polished anime-style promotional thumbnail with a summer romance atmosphere. The composition is split visually, with large typography on the left and two handsome young men on the right. On the left side, place layered translucent white panels with soft glow and sparkles over a sky-blue background, featuring large elegant serif text "GPT" in a blue gradient at the top and "BL" in a lavender-to-violet gradient below. Add three lines of Japanese text arranged between and under them: "最新の画像生成で", "作って", and "遊んでみた", in deep blue calligraphic Japanese type. Include subtle decorative accents such as small star glints, diagonal light streaks, dotted texture, and a cyan underline swoosh beneath the middle text. On the right side, show 2 anime boys from the waist up, leaning casually together beside a chain-link fence under leafy trees. The taller boy has tousled dark brown hair, a navy overshirt worn open over a white T-shirt, layered silver necklaces, and holds 1 plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw. The shorter boy has messy silver-white hair, a white T-shirt with a small crest emblem on the chest, black backpack straps over both shoulders, layered silver necklaces, and one small earring. Their poses are relaxed and intimate, with the dark-haired boy’s arm resting around the other. Use a luminous blue-and-white palette with soft sunlight, lens flare, bokeh, and a faint cityscape in the background, creating a clean social-media header or article thumbnail aesthetic.

items.title: Anime Knight King on Burning Battlefield
items.description: A cinematic anime fantasy portrait of a blonde armored heroine wielding a glowing sword in a war-torn night scene, ideal for Fate-inspired character art and dramatic hero illustrations.

author.name: 護堂アオイ@小説家（いろいろ準備中）

items.content: A dramatic anime-style fantasy battle illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Artoria Pendragon"}, a young female knight with emerald green eyes and blonde hair styled in a braided bun with loose bangs and a single ahoge, shown in a powerful low-angle medium full-body shot. She stands in the center of the frame gripping a large glowing golden sword with both hands, the blade angled upward along the left side of the image, with ornate blue inlays and faint runic engraving. She wears blue and silver royal armor: a dark cobalt blue dress with gold trim, polished steel breastplate and faulds, heavy armored gauntlets, and layered plate armor over the torso and hips, with parts of the white underskirt torn and dirty from combat. Her expression is stern, focused, and determined, looking directly forward as if facing an enemy. The background is a burning nighttime battlefield under a deep navy sky with heavy clouds and faint stars, filled with embers, flames, ruined structures, broken spears, scattered swords, and wreckage. Include 2 visible flags in the background with blue fabric and gold heraldic emblems, partially tattered and waving in the smoke. Add subtle blood stains and battle damage on the lower armor, sparks drifting through the air, strong cinematic rim lighting from fires behind her, reflective highlights on the metal, and high-contrast heroic composition. Ultra-detailed polished anime illustration, Fate-inspired knight king aesthetic, intense atmosphere, sharp linework, rich blue-and-gold palette, vertical composition, SFW.

items.title: Elegant Anime Girl on a Flower Street
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style illustration of a stylish girl in a white frilled dress walking through a bright floral shopping street, ideal for character art and social-media-ready fantasy fashion visuals.
items.content: A highly detailed anime illustration of a fashionable young woman on an elegant daytime outing in a European-style flower street, shown in a full-body to three-quarter standing pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep indigo blue"} hair styled in 2 very long twin-tails with soft shine, loose strands, and white rose-and-frill hair accessories tied with black ribbons. She wears a romantic white mini dress with a fitted corset-like bodice, sweetheart neckline, black bow at the chest, layered ruffles, a dramatic asymmetrical overskirt, and white rose decorations at the waist. Her accessories include 1 black choker with a white flower ornament, 1 black armband on the upper arm, 2 white frilled wrist cuffs, 2 black garter straps, 2 sheer black thigh-high stockings with lace tops, and she carries 1 small black handbag. Her expression should feel delicate, elegant, and slightly shy, with one hand lifting a lock of hair and the other holding the bag. Set her in a sunlit cobblestone shopping lane lined with boutique windows, flower planters, and soft pastel architecture, with 2 visible signs reading "Rose Town" and "Rose Garden". Use luminous spring lighting, cool blue-violet shadows, sparkling highlights, abundant floral details, and a polished painterly anime style with a dreamy, refined, high-end illustration finish.

items.title: Chaotic Fourth Crusade Parody Poster
items.description: A dense Japanese fake movie poster that humorously dramatizes the Fourth Crusade getting lost and attacking Constantinople, ideal for satirical world-history visuals.
items.content: A chaotic fictional Japanese movie poster themed around world history, designed like a glossy blockbuster comedy-action epic about the Fourth Crusade getting completely lost and attacking Constantinople instead of reaching Jerusalem. The composition is dense, loud, and satirical, with a dramatic historical battlefield collage under a bright blue sky, flames, smoke, medieval ships, domes, city walls, and crusader armies. In the center foreground, a full-body medieval crusader in a dirty white tunic with a large red cross points directly toward the viewer, surrounded by four other medieval figures in ornate robes, hoods, helmets, and merchant-like clothing; their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blurs, making the poster look like a parody cast reveal. Across the top, huge hot-pink Japanese brush lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="方向性、完全に迷子。"}, with smaller black Japanese tagline text above and below it. A torn vertical caption on the left side in bold yellow Japanese text explains that they meant to head for Jerusalem but somehow crush the Byzantine Empire. Two large parchment banners cross the upper middle area: one says that the original destination was Jerusalem, and the larger center banner declares in bold red Japanese text that the destination is Jerusalem, followed by smaller black text saying that was supposed to be the plan. On the upper right, a pinned parchment itinerary board contains a 5-step comedic route list with icons and arrows: departure, no money, bowing to Venice, lightly attacking Zara, then Constantinople, ending with a red line implying they somehow arrived there. Around the characters are exactly 8 speech balloons and callout labels: one saying “Eh, huh?”, one saying “No money…”, one saying “By order, let’s go.”, one saying “Slight detour.”, one saying “I failed, lol.”, one saying “Zara? We passed there!”, one label for a “contract” with a note that it is kind of expensive, and one pointing to Venice as a sponsor-like label. Additional wooden or parchment location signs label exactly 3 places: Zara, Venice, and Constantinople, with Japanese side notes identifying them as Christian or Byzantine cities. The lower half becomes darker and more catastrophic, showing a burning Byzantine-style city with a large domed church resembling Hagia Sophia, naval combat, collapsing architecture, orange firelight, and black smoke. At the bottom center, enormous distressed Japanese title typography in yellow and white announces the film as the Fourth Crusade and says Constantinople burns due to getting lost, with gritty texture, heavy drop shadows, and explosive blockbuster poster styling. On the right side of the title area, a red stamped burst says in Japanese that it begins around 1204. Along the very bottom is a narrow cast strip with exactly 6 small cast thumbnails labeled in Japanese, plus tiny fake credits running across the footer. In the bottom right corner, place a bright pink starburst badge with yellow and white Japanese text reading {argument name="badge text" default="史実です。信じられないけど。"}. Overall style: absurd historical parody, cinematic key art, Japanese theatrical poster, high detail, photobashed realism mixed with exaggerated graphic design, weathered paper textures, bold manga-like captions, comedic educational tone, epic war-movie energy.

The woman on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose bangs, and wears a fluffy brown fleece jacket, dark pants, and a red lanyard with an ID card. She sits in a low camping chair and leans forward, using chopsticks over a small bowl or food container in her hands. The woman on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} shoulder-length hair and wears a muted purple hoodie layered under a black puffer vest, light gray sweatpants, and dark shoes. She sits in another low camping chair, resting her cheek on one hand in a relaxed, sleepy pose. Keep both faces obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, as if anonymized in a posted photo. Around them, include exactly 4 red beverage cans visible in the scene: 2 on the wooden table planks near the center, 1 cropped in the lower right foreground, and 1 farther back near the right side. Build a low U-shaped arrangement of 3 wooden bench planks surrounding the heater. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair that falls past her waist, with soft layered bangs covering one eye and long side sections framing the face. The style is refined, soft-shaded, and highly polished with delicate linework, subtle fabric folds, and a modern idol-goth aesthetic. She wears a short white and pale gray ruffled dress with 8 visible black front buttons, puff short sleeves, frilled sleeve hems, frilled shoulder straps, a square neckline with a small black ribbon bow at the chest, and a layered asymmetrical skirt with multiple airy ruffle tiers. Around her neck is a frilled lace choker. At the waist is a wide black belt with a large silver circular ring buckle and 1 hanging strap ending in a metal ring. She wears 2 black fingerless gloves with frilled cuffs and silver bracelet details, 2 white thigh-high stockings, and 2 black garter straps clipped from the skirt to the stockings, one on each thigh. Her shoes are glossy black Mary Jane heels with ankle straps and small bows on the toes. Add a small dangling cross earring on the visible ear. Keep the palette mostly monochrome white, gray, black, and silver, with a soft elegant mood and a clean studio presentation.

items.title: RPG Map to Anime Event Scene
items.description: This prompt turns a top-down RPG Maker town screenshot into a full-perspective anime cutscene illustration for visualizing in-game event moments.

author.name: 無量光秀＠アートゥルデザイン

items.content: Using the provided reference image, transform the top-down RPG town map into a polished anime-style event illustration from a human eye-level perspective. Keep the same village location and layout cues: the central stone well, the path network, the hedges, the wooden houses, and the narrow water canal on the left. Convert the 2 small sprite characters by the well into 2 full-size fantasy characters in the foreground: a silver-haired mage in a purple robe holding a staff, and a blonde elf in green-and-brown adventurer clothing, both leaning over and looking into the well. Add a cinematic JRPG feel with soft daylight, detailed painterly rendering, clean line art, and gentle depth of field. Preserve the sense that this scene is taking place in the same town square, but enrich it with natural perspective, more environmental detail, and 5 background villagers: 1 man cropped at the far left edge, 2 small figures standing on the center path in the distance, and 2 townspeople talking near the right-side buildings.

items.title: Anime Characters in Real Izakaya Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a believable mixed-style image where two women at a casual Japanese izakaya table are turned into anime characters while the restaurant scene remains photorealistic.
items.content: A candid indoor restaurant photo in a realistic anime-inspired style, showing two young women seated at a small worn wooden table inside a cozy Japanese izakaya with vertical wood-paneled walls and a clear plastic tent-like curtain on the right side. The camera is slightly above table height and angled diagonally toward the table, creating a casual snapshot feeling. One woman is in the left foreground with her back mostly to the viewer, leaning forward over the table; she has long straight dark hair and wears a bulky dark navy or black puffer jacket with a large hood. The second woman sits across from her on the right, facing the camera with a relaxed posture and one arm bent on the table; she has shoulder-length dark brown to black hair, a center part, a black puffer jacket, and a light inner shirt. Replace only the people with clean, natural-looking anime characters while keeping the restaurant environment photorealistic and unchanged. Preserve the mixed-media look of anime characters composited believably into a real photo. On the table, include 2 stainless steel mugs, 2 pairs of chopsticks, 1 smartphone with a bright blue case near the center-left edge of the table, 1 cigarette pack near the right woman, 1 large oval plate with thinly sliced white onions and a lemon wedge, 1 small dish of green vegetables, 1 small plate of brown food, 1 small plate with toast or grilled bread, 1 small dark bowl, 2 small empty white bowls, and 1 printed handwritten Japanese menu sheet lying on the lower right corner of the table. In the upper left background, include a wooden counter with white ceramic bottles and dishes, plus 1 handwritten Japanese wall menu poster. Warm indoor lighting, everyday nightlife atmosphere, documentary realism, detailed wood grain, slightly cluttered tabletop, authentic casual dining scene in Japan.

items.content: A photorealistic meme-style outdoor close-up of three tech CEOs standing together in a subtly tense but friendly composition. On the left foreground is {argument name="left person" default="Sam Altman"}, shown from the chest up, with short dark wavy hair, pale skin, a dark crewneck shirt, and an exaggerated smug, amused expression with raised eyebrows and a crooked smile, looking toward the man on the right. In the center background is {argument name="center person" default="Satya Nadella"}, bald, wearing black rectangular glasses and a dark jacket, calmly smiling and looking at the man on the right. On the right foreground is {argument name="right person" default="Elon Musk"}, seen mostly from the back and side profile, wearing a black leather jacket, with the center figure’s hand resting on his shoulder in a familiar, slightly possessive gesture. Use shallow depth of field, natural overcast daylight, blurred trees in the background, and a candid press-photo realism. The overall mood should feel like an industry-insider meme, with subtle social dynamics and ironic facial expressions.

items.title: Nike Surreal Poster From Reference
items.description: This prompt turns the provided reference into a refined high-fashion Nike ad poster with one giant sneaker, one leaning model, one oversized background brand word, and a two-line tagline.

author.name: 前田まさき｜組織の左腕

items.content: Using the provided reference image, regenerate the same Nike surreal fashion ad almost exactly as written, but present it as a polished finished poster: keep the cool light-blue minimalist studio, the single oversized white Nike sneaker standing on its heel at a steep diagonal, the single female model in an all-white outfit leaning back against the shoe in right-facing three-quarter profile, the large background word "NIKE," and the glossy semi-reflective floor. Make the composition tighter and more cinematic, with the giant shoe dominating the left half and the model standing full-body on the right half, her hands in her pockets. Render the background "NIKE" text as 1 huge bold white word spanning behind the subjects, partially obscured by both the sneaker and the model. Add the bottom-center tagline as 2 lines of elegant white sans-serif text: "Made for comfort, worn for confidence." and "Because life feels better when you move without limits." Keep the top-right corner empty and do not add any extra text, logos, watermarks, credits, signatures, or captions. Ultra-clean premium advertising finish, soft diffused cool lighting, subtle floor reflections, high detail, 3:4 aspect ratio.

items.title: Gothic Magical Girl with Spell Circle
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic full-body anime fantasy character illustration, ideal for creating polished magical-girl key art or poster-style character visuals.
items.content: A full-body anime fantasy illustration of a confident young magical girl standing in the center of a glowing spell circle inside a dark cathedral-like interior. She has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in twin high ponytails with large curled drill ringlets at the ends, straight bangs, and bright blue eyes, with a calm slightly smug smile. She wears a gothic black and deep navy frilled dress with gold filigree trim, corset lacing on the bodice, layered ruffles, puffed sleeves, black gloves, and multiple dark blue ribbon bows, plus a black lace garter on one thigh and glossy black ankle boots decorated with bows. In her raised right hand she holds an ornate magical staff with a circular head, wing-like ornaments, a star motif, and a glowing pink crystal core. Behind her are 2 large luminous stained-glass-like wing shapes made of intricate white and pink magical lines, creating the impression of angelic wings. Around her body and across the foreground are swirling ribbons of pink-violet magical energy, floating sparkles, and scattered glowing shards. The floor features 1 large intricate magic circle with runic lettering and layered concentric sigils radiating intense pink and lavender light. Compose the image in a dynamic low-angle view with the character centered, one leg forward, skirt flaring outward, and the staff extended toward the viewer. Use dramatic fantasy lighting, high contrast, ultra-detailed polished anime rendering, rich black, violet, and neon pink palette, sharp linework, glossy highlights, and an epic magical transformation atmosphere.

items.title: Fantasy Tokyo Coexistence Cityscape
items.description: This prompt generates a wide anime-style worldbuilding illustration of a modern Japanese city where humans, fantasy races, and sci-fi elements coexist, ideal for novel key visuals or setting art.
items.content: A wide cinematic anime key visual of a bustling modern Tokyo-like district transformed into a multicultural fantasy metropolis under a bright blue midday sky with fluffy clouds. The scene is viewed from street level along a broad pedestrian avenue leading toward a large red torii gate at the center distance, with stone steps, crowds of people, dense commercial buildings, and a Japanese castle rising on a green hill behind the city blocks. A very tall broadcasting tower resembling Tokyo Skytree stands slightly right of center in the background. Fill the sky with exactly 8 airborne fantasy and sci-fi elements: 2 large dragons in flight, 2 winged humanoid angels, 1 huge flying saucer, and 3 smaller UFOs scattered farther away. The city should feel like a coexistence society where humans and fantasy races live together naturally. Add many colorful digital billboards and vertical signs on buildings, including Japanese text and fantasy character advertisements; the largest curved screen on the left should display the text “Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界 ようこそ,” and a lower billboard should reference a multicultural society of different races. In the foreground, place exactly 6 prominent characters across the street scene: on the far left, a tall elf schoolgirl with long brown hair, pointed ears, a white blouse, ribbon tie, and plaid skirt; left-center, a humanoid crocodile or lizard man in casual urban clothes with a jacket and pendant; near him, a small child with animal-like ears wearing a red backpack and scarf; center-left, a white-haired young man with white feathered wings in a light jacket; center-right, a silver-haired cat-eared schoolgirl in a light jacket and dark pleated skirt; right-center, a black-haired teenage boy in a black hoodie with a backpack; and on the far right, a blonde elf schoolgirl with pointed ears, white short-sleeve shirt, tie, and brown plaid skirt. In the midground and background, add a crowd of pedestrians including a few more fantasy species. Also include exactly 3 additional perched or elevated fantasy figures on the right side architecture: 1 dark-clad black-winged girl standing on a ledge, 1 small blonde fairy-like winged girl floating near a rooftop, and 1 tiny golden winged creature near the street. Style: polished high-detail anime illustration, light novel promotional art, sharp linework, vibrant colors, clean atmospheric perspective, crisp sunlight, soft shadows, highly detailed urban signage, a sense of wonder, coexistence, and worldbuilding.

items.title: Urban Fantasy Coexistence Crossing
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed anime key visual of a modern city intersection where humans, angels, demons, elves, and beastfolk coexist, ideal for fantasy worldbuilding or light novel setting art.
items.content: A highly detailed anime-style urban fantasy illustration set at a busy Tokyo-style scramble crossing on a bright clear day, viewed at street level with a wide cinematic composition. The city blends modern realism with mythic fantasy: dense high-rise buildings covered in giant billboards, a red broadcast tower in the middle distance, blue sky with fluffy clouds, and a crowded crosswalk full of pedestrians. In the foreground, show 7 prominent character figures: a silver-haired elf woman in a flowing white dress holding an iced drink and tote bag on the far left; a central schoolgirl with long dark hair, black animal ears, a navy school blazer, plaid skirt, blue ribbon, and large navy shoulder bag, lifting one hand to her head; a young man in a dark suit looking down at a smartphone; an androgynous white-haired angelic figure in an elegant white-and-gold ceremonial outfit with large white wings; a small blonde girl in an ornate pastel pink frilled dress beside the angel; a dark-haired woman in a black coat in right foreground profile; and a small blue-haired cat-eared child in a blue dress with a bow standing near a cave entrance on the right. In the midground crowd, include mixed humans and fantasy races walking together naturally. Add 4 clearly visible nonhuman or supernatural background beings: 1 dragon flying in the sky, 1 winged female angel descending above the street, 1 lizard-headed businessman in a suit near the angelic figure, and 1 tall red-skinned horned demon with crossed arms standing by the hillside path. On the right side, transition the city into a lush shrine hillside with large green trees, a red torii gate, stone steps, and a wooden signboard reading Japanese kanji. Below it, place a rocky cave-like tunnel entrance glowing blue, with a wooden sign over the entrance and several figures descending into an underground shared district lit by crystals. Show 6 major billboard/sign elements across the cityscape: a huge left billboard reading "Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界" with a cosmic planet image; a large central political poster with Japanese text and a raised fist icon; 2 rooftop signs reading "未来研究所" on separate buildings; a large right billboard with Japanese text about coexistence and silhouettes of different beings; and 1 vertical banner with Japanese text on a nearby building. Emphasize the theme of coexistence between ordinary modern city life and hidden fantasy societies. Crisp anime linework, polished light novel key visual rendering, rich textures, soft sunlight, subtle atmospheric perspective, vibrant but believable colors, intricate clothing details, and a sense of awe, everyday bustle, and worldbuilding depth.

items.title: Japanese Classroom Long Hair Snapshot
items.description: A realistic school-life photo prompt showing three girls in sailor uniforms grooming exceptionally long hair inside a Japanese classroom, useful for candid youth scene generation.
items.content: A candid, photorealistic Japanese high school classroom scene in vertical smartphone-photo framing. Three schoolgirls wearing matching traditional navy blue sailor uniforms are the main focus in the foreground. The central standing girl has extremely long, straight, glossy black hair that falls well past her knees, almost to the floor, and she is gently combing the lower section with a small comb while looking downward. A second girl stands behind and slightly to the right, also with long straight black hair, holding an open compact mirror in one hand and adjusting her bangs or hair near her temple with the other. A third girl kneels on the floor at the right front, carefully holding and arranging the central girl’s long hair with both hands. All three wear dark navy sailor-style school uniforms with white stripe trim, pleated skirts, long sleeves, white socks, and indoor school shoes. Their faces are obscured or blurred. In the background, exactly 8 additional students in dark school uniforms sit at desks in small groups, facing away or sideways, creating the feel of an ordinary class period or homeroom. The classroom has wooden desks and chairs, large bright windows along the left side letting in soft daylight, a green chalkboard on the right wall, bulletin papers pinned near the board, and a framed Japanese calligraphy sign above the chalkboard reading {argument name="wall sign text" default="創誠造実"}. The atmosphere is natural and unposed, like a documentary snapshot. Emphasize realistic lighting, fine hair detail, the unusual dramatic length of the central girl’s hair, and a believable everyday school environment.

items.title: Anime PR Representative at Industrial Expo
items.description: A cel-shaded anime illustration of a corporate spokesperson in a futuristic heavy-industry exhibition booth, ideal for company mascots, promotional art, or branded character visuals.
items.content: A polished anime-style corporate booth illustration with cel shading and controlled highlights, showing a young adult female PR representative standing three-quarters view in a futuristic industrial exhibition space lit with cool purple and blue accent lighting. Her face is obscured by a centered rectangular blur block. She has very long straight dark hair with subtle purple undertones, flowing past her waist, and wears geometric dangling earrings. Her outfit is a sleek black business suit with white piping along the lapels, a dark inner shirt, a fitted pencil skirt, a belt, and a visible lanyard with ID card. On her left arm she wears a white armband printed with the company logo and the words OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES. In one arm she holds a black presentation folder with the same logo and company name, and with her other hand she gestures open-palmed toward the booth displays as if introducing the company. The booth branding is prominent: a large illuminated wall sign in the upper left with the logo, the Japanese company name "大野重工業株式会社", the English name "OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES", and the slogan "BUILDING THE FUTURE. SUPPORTING THE WORLD." Below it is a large poster panel showing an industrial refinery skyline at dusk with Japanese copy reading "技術で支え、未来を創る。" and smaller text beneath. In the lower left foreground, place a standing nameplate sign with the same logo and company name, plus the department line "広報部 | PR DIVISION" and the representative name "雲居 モヤ" with the romanization "KUMOI MOYA". Also show her hanging ID badge with the logo and small text suggesting PR staff credentials. The exhibition floor includes 3 visible industrial display elements: a white robotic construction machine model on a pedestal at left, a smaller mechanical display in the mid-background, and a large white humanoid or armored industrial mech figure on the right background. Use a high-end convention or trade-show setting with glossy reflective surfaces, glass panels, sharp perspective lines, and branded panels throughout. Composition should be vertical, waist-up to near full-body framing, with the character dominating the right-center and the company signage clearly readable on the left. Emphasize refined anime character design, professional corporate ambassador energy, futuristic heavy-industry branding, purple ambient glow, and clean cel-shaded rendering rather than overly sparkly effects.

items.title: Dark Fantasy PS5 RPG Cover Art
items.description: This prompt generates a faux PS5 fantasy action RPG cover featuring three armored elf heroines, two dragons, and dramatic Japanese game-poster typography, ideal for mock game key art.

author.name: 奥多摩プロンプト研究所

items.content: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG key art designed like a PlayStation 5 game cover poster. Vertical composition, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, cinematic dark fantasy. In the background, count 2 enormous black-purple dragons: one dominant dragon on the upper right with mouth wide open, glowing orange fire in its throat, jagged obsidian scales, and blazing eyes; one second dragon silhouette on the upper left with wings spread across the sky. Full moon in the center-top sky, purple nebula clouds, embers, ash, magical sparks, and a ruined gothic castle city on the right background. In the foreground, count 3 female elf warriors standing in a heroic triangular formation, all wearing ornate metallic armor with glossy magenta, silver, and violet tones. Center character: blonde elf princess-warrior, short to medium hair, small crown or jeweled tiara, white fur mantle over shoulders, polished silver armor exposing midriff, black gloves, confident battle stance, wielding a gigantic double-bladed ceremonial axe with intricate filigree, turquoise crystal core, and engraved silver-blue blades. Left character: taller elf archer-warrior with long light brown hair, pointed ears, elaborate rose-magenta armor, large curved fantasy sword in her right hand, and a quiver of pink-fletched arrows on her back. Right character: long dark magenta-haired elf swordswoman with floral hair ornaments, violet-magenta armor, black cape, holding a slender sword angled downward. The image should feel like premium box art for an original game titled {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}. Include visible game-package typography and branding elements: top left white PS5 logo; top right small bracketed studio tag [O-prompt laboratory]; large vertical Japanese slogan on the right side; count 2 lines of Japanese promotional copy on the upper left; the main title in huge glowing gold serif letters across the bottom center reading {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}; a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it; bottom left CERO C rating badge; bottom center count 3 short Japanese feature blurbs separated by diamond icons; bottom right OPL logo. Use a lavish painted-anime-meets-hyperreal style, dense detail, polished reflections, fiery rim light, purple and orange color contrast, and the overall feel of a mature-rated epic console fantasy adventure cover.

items.title: Fantasy RPG Game Cover with Three Knight Women
items.description: This prompt generates a polished fake PlayStation-style fantasy game cover featuring three armored women, a giant ornate axe, Japanese marketing text, and dramatic AAA key art styling.

author.name: 奥多摩プロンプト研究所

items.content: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG PlayStation 5 game cover poster in a dark ornate high-fantasy style, vertically composed like premium key art. Show three armored warrior women standing heroically in the foreground against a glowing night battlefield and a towering gothic fantasy castle city in the distance, with fireworks, embers, magical light trails, and a star-filled purple-blue sky. The central figure is a blonde elf-like knight with pointed ears, a fur-trimmed collar, silver and gold armor, and a powerful stance, holding an enormous double-headed ceremonial battle axe angled across the lower half of the image; the axe is highly detailed with filigree silver metalwork, turquoise-blue crystal inlays, and an intricate engraved circular blade. On the left stands a second female knight with long dark crimson hair, metallic breastplate armor in steel and burgundy tones, and a sword held downward; behind her looms 1 giant black raven or crow with one glowing blue eye. On the right stands a third female knight with long light brown hair covering her eyes, pointed ears, and glossy magenta-pink armor with revealing fantasy plate design; a quiver of arrows is visible behind her shoulder. Include 2 red flying bird-like creatures or phoenixes in the upper right sky. The mood is epic, intense, and slightly gothic, with dense sparks, glowing particles, rim lighting, and lavish metallic reflections. Add an ornate thin gold border framing the entire cover. At the top left, place a small circular emblem and the text "O-prompt Laboratory". Along the right side, add vertical Japanese tagline text: "絆と力に、運命を斬り拓け". At the bottom center, place the game title in large embossed gold serif letters: "{argument name="game title" default="ELYSION"}", with a subtitle beneath in smaller serif capitals: "{argument name="subtitle" default="REBIRTH"}". Below that, add the Japanese subtitle text "エリシオン・リバース". At the bottom left, include a realistic Japanese age rating badge reading "CERO C" with small text "15才以上対象". Along the bottom, add the Japanese tagline "美しき騎士たちの、終わりなき戦いが今、始まる。" and beneath it the English line "THE ETERNAL BATTLE OF THE KNIGHTS BEGINS NOW.". Make it look like polished AAA console box art for a nonexistent fantasy game, ultra-detailed, cinematic, richly textured, high contrast, with the composition dominated by the three women and the oversized axe.

items.title: Miami Dock Action Movie Still
items.description: A photorealistic vertical action scene of two armed protagonists on a sunny marina dock, suitable for cinematic thriller or buddy-cop promotional imagery.
items.content: A cinematic action movie still on a sunny waterfront dock in {argument name="city" default="Miami"}, shot in a vertical composition. In the foreground, a tough athletic man in his 30s stands in a wide defensive stance, aiming a black semi-automatic pistol with both hands directly off-frame. He has short dark hair, a rugged build, tan skin, light stubble, a silver wristwatch, a white T-shirt, an open short-sleeve blue patterned overshirt, and tan cargo pants. Slightly behind and to his left stands an athletic woman in her 20s or 30s with tan skin and long dark curly hair tied in a high ponytail. She wears a fitted black tank top, denim shorts, a black belt, layered gold necklaces, and holds a black handgun low at her side, ready for action. Set them on a weathered wooden pier beside bright blue water, with 1 large palm tree on the left, 3 modern high-rise buildings in the background, and 1 partially visible police boat on the right edge. Bright midday sunlight, clear blue sky, glossy skin highlights, tense body language, realistic proportions, shallow depth of field, high-detail photorealism, blockbuster buddy-cop energy, crisp focus on the characters, slightly blurred skyline.

items.title: Art Deco Gotham Tram Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a vertical retro-futurist Art Deco poster of Gotham City with a sunset skyline and elevated tram, ideal for vintage travel-poster style artwork.
items.content: A vintage Art Deco travel poster in a clean flat 2D 1950s-inspired illustration style, showing an elevated tram entering {argument name="city name" default="Gotham City"} at sunset. Use a tall vertical poster composition with strong geometric symmetry, sharp stepped deco framing, and no 3D relief or realistic textures. At the top, place a large angular Art Deco border in glowing peach-gold lines, with exactly 3 small circular dots centered near the top inside the frame. Inside this frame, set the headline {argument name="headline text" default="WELCOME TO GOTHAM CITY !"} in large elegant Art Deco lettering, stacked across 4 lines reading exactly: “WELCOME”, “TO”, “GOTHAM”, “CITY !”. Keep the typography crisp, centered, and integrated into the poster design. Below, create a stylized skyline of {argument name="city skyline style" default="futuristic Gotham skyscrapers"} with tall narrow towers, stepped crowns, spires, and simplified window slits; count 12 visible building masses across the skyline. Behind the buildings, place a large glowing half-sun low on the horizon. In the foreground, show 1 long streamlined elevated tram stretching diagonally from the lower left toward the lower right, with the front car prominent on the right side. The tram should have glowing cream windows, rounded front corners, exactly 3 circular lights on the front face, and overhead electric lines with elegant sweeping cables crossing the composition. Use exactly 2 visible rail tracks curving toward the viewer at the bottom. Palette: deep indigo, violet, plum, black, peach, amber, and warm cream gradients. Mood: nostalgic, sleek, cinematic, airy, optimistic retro-futurism. Make it look like a polished mid-century flat graphic poster for urban transit tourism.

items.title: Censored Man on Crimson Throne
items.description: This prompt generates a disturbing expressionist portrait of a suited man on a throne, useful for editorial, political, or psychological horror-style imagery.
items.content: A dark, expressionist oil painting of a seated older man in a business suit, posed front-facing on an ornate high-backed throne with gilded finials and carved armrests. He wears a black or very deep burgundy suit, a white dress shirt, and a saturated purple tie, with both hands resting heavily on the throne arms. His hair is light blond to gray-blond, swept back loosely. The face is completely obscured by a centered rectangular blur block in muted brown, creating an unsettling censored effect. The setting is a claustrophobic interior rendered in violent vertical strokes of crimson, scarlet, black, and maroon, as if the walls are bleeding paint downward. The floor is a black-and-white checkerboard pattern, partially broken and smeared by rough brushwork. Use thick impasto, aggressive palette-knife texture, smeared edges, high contrast, and a moody, sinister atmosphere. Composition is symmetrical and centered, full seated figure visible, throne dominating the frame, with a museum-scale portrait feeling and psychological horror undertone.
