items.title: Absurd Tabloid Panther Newspaper Front Page
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic comedic tabloid-style newspaper front page about a black panther leading a secret nightlife life, useful for satirical editorial art and viral fake-headline images.
items.content:
A realistic, slightly humorous tabloid newspaper front page photographed from above on a wooden table, designed to look like a printed broadsheet with subtle paper texture, fold marks, and mild lens distortion. The masthead at top left reads “The Daily Metro”, the date line near the top center reads “Friday, April 22, 2005”, and the top-right section marker reads “CITY NEWS | 05”. A red banner near the upper left says “EXCLUSIVE STORY”. The dominant oversized black headline spans multiple lines: “Zoo Panther Caught Living Double Life – As a Charming Bar Hopping Casanova!” Below it, a large subheadline reads: ““Marquise” the Panther Escapes Zoo at Night, Spends Eveningsvlenlars, Becomes Heartthrob Among Lonely Women”. The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid with 1 huge headline area, 1 large main photo on the upper right, 1 small inset photo under the main text on the left, 3 narrow text columns with dense newspaper copy in the center-left, 1 pull-quote box in the middle, 1 lower-left secondary story block with a panther portrait, 3 small bottom photo thumbnails in a row, and 1 right-side sidebar box titled “What’s Next For Mamquiss?”. Keep most body text tiny and partly nonsensical or pseudo-legible like AI-generated newspaper filler, but preserve the major visible headlines exactly.

The main photo on the upper right shows the back view of a glamorous blonde woman in a silky champagne-colored dress standing at a bar beside a large black panther upright on a stool or standing with forepaws elevated near the counter. The bar background contains many liquor bottles and glassware on shelves, warmly lit. The woman’s face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur/block. The panther is sleek, glossy, and realistically rendered. The inset photo under the headline at left shows the black panther near a zoo exit or pathway sign at night. The lower-left portrait shows a close-up of the panther’s face. The 3 bottom thumbnails show nightlife scenes: the panther moving through a bar interior, the panther seated near two women at a small round table, and the panther lounging in dim warm light.

Use an early-2000s tabloid aesthetic, high-contrast black headline typography, off-white newsprint, red accent rules, narrow columns, and slightly messy authentic newspaper composition. The overall tone is deadpan absurdist journalism, realistic enough to glance as a real newspaper, with the page filling most of the frame and photographed in natural indoor light.

items.title: Neon Anime Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a bold cyberpunk-style Japanese anime magazine cover with five diagonal character panels and dense editorial typography, ideal for mock magazine art or promotional key visuals.
items.content: Create a high-energy Japanese futuristic anime magazine cover in portrait orientation, designed like a glossy feature issue packed edge to edge with neon cyberpunk graphics. The composition is split into 5 sharp diagonal polygon panels outlined in black, each panel containing a different anime character portrait. At the top, place an oversized bold Japanese masthead reading {argument name="masthead text" default="次元交差"} in huge distressed white lettering with pink paint splatter and motion-streak accents, spanning almost the full width. Above it, add a small Japanese subtitle line in white. In the top right corner, design a magazine issue block with the words "FEATURE", a very large outlined "01", "VOL.", "MEMMODE", "2024 SPRING", and small Japanese text "創刊号" stacked in a clean editorial layout. The background should be dense with electric magenta, hot pink, cyan, blue, and black abstract streaks, halftone dots, glitch textures, floating plus signs, diagonal slashes, and light flares, giving a loud next-generation visual-culture feel. Show exactly 5 characters: 1) upper left panel, a handsome androgynous anime boy with messy layered silver hair, pale skin, black clothing with straps, zippers, layered necklaces, and a cool dark streetwear look; 2) upper right panel, a cute anime girl with light lavender-pink hair in twin braids, large magenta-violet eyes, a black cap labeled {argument name="cap text" default="MEMMODE"}, black X-shaped hairpins, and a black-purple outfit; 3) center panel, the main featured chibi-faced character with short white hair tipped with cyan and pink, one bright blue eye and one pink eye, wearing a glossy black cap and futuristic black outfit, looking directly at the viewer; 4) lower left panel, a serious anime boy with black hair and a bold white forelock, golden amber eyes, earrings, black hoodie and jacket layers, and blue neon rim lighting; 5) lower right panel, a softer feminine character with wavy blond hair under a dark cap, wearing a choker and holding a silver microphone near the chest, styled in pink-purple lighting. Make all characters highly polished, crisp, and vibrant, with large expressive eyes, sharp cel-shaded rendering, glossy highlights, and layered urban-tech fashion details. Add multiple editorial text blocks around the cover: on the left side a feature callout with Japanese text including "特集", a large stacked headline reading "交差する 5つの意志。", and two smaller Japanese lines below; a vertical side label reading "DIMENSION CROSS" and "MAIN"; a lower-left pickup box with "PICK UP", several Japanese lines, and 3 English hashtag lines such as "#IDENTITY #CONNECT #FUTURE", "#NEON #WILL #RESONANCE"; a bold page fraction "1/5 PAGE" at the bottom left; a bottom right focus box with "FOCUS" and small Japanese text; and a bottom-center Japanese tagline {argument name="bottom tagline" default="新たな物語の、はじまり。"}. The overall style should feel like a premium anime feature magazine cover, chaotic but balanced, with aggressive diagonal framing, strong contrast, glossy print design, and a black base flooded with neon pink and cyan energy.

items.title: Autumn in New York Travel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical Spanish-language poster for a New York autumn photography trip, ideal for travel promotions, workshops, and social media ads.
items.content: A vertical editorial-style travel poster in Spanish for a {argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"} titled “OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK,” designed with a sophisticated urban autumn mood and a premium photography-workshop aesthetic. Use a tall mobile-friendly poster layout with a warm off-white, beige, charcoal, and burnt orange palette. The composition is dominated by oversized condensed black sans-serif typography on the left: small text at the top reading “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO,” then the huge stacked headline “OTOÑO” on top, a smaller “EN” with short horizontal orange lines on both sides, and below it the huge stacked words “NUEVA YORK.” On the right side, place a narrow informational column with exactly 4 short benefit lines in uppercase: “7 NOCHES”, “GRUPO REDUCIDO”, “GUÍAS EXPERTOS”, and “MILES DE FOTOS” with the last line in orange. Below that, add the dates in large orange numbers “17-24” and beneath in black uppercase “DE OCTUBRE” and “DE 2026.” Add a thin vertical line near the far right edge and a tiny orange dot at the top. Integrate a moody New York street photo collage into the lower half and through the typography, centered on the Manhattan Bridge framed by dark brick buildings, wet streets, a few cars, steam rising from the roadway, and a lone photographer seen from behind in the foreground wearing a rust-orange beanie and a backpack, holding a camera toward the bridge. Let giant cropped letterforms from “NYC” or similarly bold graphic shapes blend with the city imagery across the bottom half, creating a layered double-exposure poster effect. Add distressed paper textures, rough torn-edge overlays, brushy white paint textures, and subtle grunge for a handcrafted editorial finish. On the left lower-mid area, place a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon and the curved text “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK.” Along the bottom, create a dark band with 2 presenter credits, one left and one right, separated by a thin vertical orange line: left “CARLOS SÁNCHEZ” with “@CHOCUTUTS” in orange below, right “JON TARAFA” with “@JONTCPHOTO” in orange below. Centered at the very bottom, add the website “VIAJENY.COM” in spaced orange uppercase letters. Include 2 partially cropped grayscale portrait cutouts in the bottom corners, one on the left and one on the right, blending into the dark footer area. Overall style: cinematic travel advertisement, contemporary magazine poster, bold typographic hierarchy, layered collage, gritty New York autumn atmosphere, high contrast, elegant and dramatic.

items.title: Premium Gaming Motherboard Studio Shot
items.description: This prompt generates a sleek, ultra-detailed studio product image of a high-end RGB gaming motherboard, ideal for tech advertising, hardware mockups, or product showcase visuals.
items.content: A high-end enthusiast ATX gaming motherboard product photo on a dark studio background, shown in a three-quarter top-down perspective angled from the lower left toward the upper right. The board is mostly matte black and gunmetal with sharp geometric armor plates, brushed metal textures, and subtle RGB edge lighting in blue, purple, and magenta. Feature an exposed modern Intel-style CPU socket near the upper center, 4 black DIMM memory slots on the right, large VRM heatsinks across the top and upper left, and multiple reinforced PCIe slots in the lower half. Include 3 major branded heatsink zones: a tall rear I/O shroud at upper left with an illuminated RGB eye logo and the text "MAXIMUS HERO", a left-side chipset/slot armor piece with the text "SUPREMEFX", and a large angular lower-right chipset cover with a silver ROG-style emblem plus a lower strip that reads "FOR THOSE WHO DARE". Show detailed capacitors, headers, power connectors, debug display reading "88" at the top right, and a small round start button nearby. Ultra-detailed commercial product photography, crisp focus across the board, realistic reflections on metal, premium luxury tech aesthetic, dramatic low-key lighting, clean black seamless backdrop, no cables, no CPU, no RAM, no other objects.

items.title: Pixel Art Bolirana Night Scene
items.description: A nostalgic pixel art bar scene showing a first-person bolirana game moment, ideal for social posts, gaming-themed artwork, or personalized nightlife memories.
items.content: A moody retro pixel art scene inside a Colombian neighborhood bar at night, shown in portrait orientation from a first-person perspective. In the foreground, a human hand at the bottom center holds a small shiny metal bolirana ball between the thumb and fingers, aimed toward a full bolirana lane machine in the middle of the room. The machine is custom themed with The Simpsons and Duff Beer branding: a red and yellow wooden lane with a large circular scoring hole at the front edge, several smaller scoring holes arranged near the backboard, three upright metal pins or bumpers, a backboard logo that says "Duff," and the text "THE SIMPSONS" near the lower front. The top marquee of the machine says "Tomate tu" and has a built-in digital score screen showing exactly 3 player labels: "JUGADOR 1", "JUGADOR 0", and "JUGADOR 2" with colorful pixelated score graphics. To the left on the brick wall, include a large illuminated beer sign with the eagle logo and the text "AGUILA CERVEZA." On the right side, a young man in a dark hoodie and jeans stands in profile beside the machine, one hand in his pocket and the other pointing at the scoreboard, his face intentionally obscured or blurred. In the lower right foreground, place a small wooden table holding exactly 2 bottles: a tall bottle labeled "AGUARDIENTE AMARILLO MANZANARES" and a brown beer bottle labeled "AGUILA." Add a narrow neon-lit vertical window or light panel in the back right glowing purple and blue. Use low-key warm amber and red bar lighting with deep shadows, brick walls, tiled floor, subtle reflections, and detailed 16-bit / 32-bit era pixel art shading, creating a nostalgic, intimate, slightly cinematic nightlife atmosphere in {argument name="location" default="Duitama, Boyacá"}.

items.title: Bold Potato Chips Advertising Poster
items.description: A vibrant snack product poster with dramatic typography, floating chips, and premium packaging design, ideal for food marketing and promotional campaigns.
items.content: Create a bold, high-impact commercial poster for a bag of potato chips in a bright warm orange-to-golden-yellow gradient background, with a dynamic snack-advertising layout and crisp studio lighting. The composition features one large open bag of chips in the lower right corner, tilted upward, overflowing with ridged golden potato chips, while exactly 9 clearly visible chips float around the upper and middle right area in midair with many small crumbs and seasoning flecks suspended for energy and motion. Use oversized distressed display typography stacked vertically on the left side reading exactly: “CRISPY.” on the top in dark reddish brown, “CRUNCHY.” in very large white letters, and “IRRESISTIBLE.” in saturated red-orange. Beneath that, place a dark brown brushstroke banner with handwritten cream script reading “Snack Happy!”. In the lower left corner, add one circular badge in red-orange with rough edges containing the text “MADE WITH REAL POTATOES” and smaller text “NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS”, plus 2 small potatoes illustrated at the bottom of the badge. Along the bottom edge, include exactly 3 simple white icon-and-text feature callouts separated evenly: “REAL POTATOES”, “NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS”, and “MADE FOR SNACK LOVERS”. The chip bag should be glossy metallic yellow with a large black irregular label shape on the front; inside it place the product name in big distressed white letters “{argument name="brand name" default="ZESTY"}” and below it a red banner with white text “{argument name="product type" default="POTATO CHIPS"}”, then smaller black text near the bottom right reading “{argument name="tagline text" default="BOLD FLAVOR. PERFECT CRUNCH."}”. Add a small rounded brand label in the upper left corner with the text “{argument name="headline brand" default="Pollo AI"}” and “GPT Image 2” beneath it. Emphasize appetizing texture, crunchy edges, realistic salt and seasoning specks, strong contrast, subtle grunge texture on the typography, and a polished modern supermarket-poster aesthetic ready for print or social promotion.

On the right side, add exactly 3 standalone circular icon callouts stacked vertically: 1) yellow lightning icon with "MORE ENERGY MORE YOU", 2) blue brain icon with "MENTAL CLARITY ALL DAY", 3) orange flexed arm icon with "BUILT FOR CHAMPIONS". At the bottom left, include a silhouetted male runner sprinting forward with green, blue, and orange speed trails behind him. Along the bottom edge, show a futuristic city skyline with glowing windows reflected on a wet street surface. Add a bright lime brushstroke banner at the bottom with the text "RISE ABOVE. items.title: 1980s Chinese Family Watching TV
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic nostalgic scene of a four-person Chinese family in an 1980s home watching an old television, ideal for retro cultural and lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A realistic nostalgic interior scene of a Chinese family of four at home in the 1980s, gathered closely in the living room and watching an old television. The room is modest, warm, and slightly worn, with a documentary-style candid composition. Show 4 family members total: a father seated at the far left in a dark blue Mao-style jacket, a mother beside him in a muted purple patterned blouse, a young boy in the foreground wearing a blue jacket and olive trousers seated on a small wooden stool, and a young girl on the right in a pink patterned jacket with her hair tied back. All four are turned toward the TV with attentive, quiet expressions, seen mostly in side profile or three-quarter back view. Place a vintage wood-framed CRT television on the right side atop a dark cabinet covered with a white floral lace cloth; the screen shows a black-and-white broadcast with a single person speaking. Behind the family, include cream-colored walls, a large old Mao poster on the upper left wall, and a vertical red calligraphy banner near the center reading {argument name="wall banner text" default="四化宏图 振兴中华"}. Add a wooden cabinet beneath a frosted-paned window, with lace runner cloth, enamel cups, a floral thermos flask, small jars, and a small bust decoration. On top of the TV place a square analog clock and a vase of pink flowers. In the foreground, include a simple rectangular coffee table with a lidded enamel mug and a plate piled with peanuts. Use soft indoor tungsten lighting, muted earthy colors, authentic 1980s Chinese household details, slight film grain, and a natural slice-of-life atmosphere. Set the overall scene in {argument name="setting" default="a Chinese family living room in the 1980s"}, with {argument name="family size" default="four family members"}, watching {argument name="tv program" default="a black-and-white television broadcast"}, in a {argument name="visual style" default="photorealistic nostalgic documentary photo"}.

All 4 people are turned toward the television in a calm, everyday family moment. items.title: French New Wave Torn Poster Collage
items.description: This prompt generates a distressed 1960s-style French art-house movie poster collage, ideal for retro cinema branding, editorial artwork, or vintage film-inspired cover designs.
items.content: A vintage 1960s French New Wave cinema poster collage on aged beige paper, designed like a torn-paper art-house one-sheet with analog grain, distressed print texture, rough ripped edges, ink wear, halftone imperfections, and slight misregistration. Center the composition around a large black-and-white portrait of a woman with messy dark hair, hand raised to her face, holding a cigarette, cropped from the chest up, with her face obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a layered collage layout with exactly 8 major paper elements: 1) a top-left black text block reading "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent" above the large stacked name "ANNA KARINA" and smaller text "dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD"; 2) a red torn quote panel on the left reading "Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD"; 3) a blue torn panel in the upper right with a black label reading "PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962"; 4) a narrow torn newspaper clipping on the upper right reading "l’amour est plus fort que la mort"; 5) a yellow torn panel on the mid-right showing a black silhouette of a man in a hat facing a woman, beside a vertical black filmstrip border with white sprocket holes; 6) a bottom-left black-and-white Paris street photo with wet pavement, a lamppost, pedestrians, and a visible sign reading "HOTEL DU NORD"; 7) a small bottom-left review text block reading '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'; 8) a bottom-right cropped black-and-white portrait of a man in a suit with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block, partially covered by a red torn paper shape. Across the lower middle, place the huge torn-paper title in bold condensed uppercase: "À BOUT DE" in black and "SOUFFLE" in red, slightly angled and spanning most of the width. Under the title, add a blue torn strip with white uppercase text "UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ". At the bottom center, add "COMING SOON" in black uppercase and below it "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR". Limit the palette to faded cream, black, deep ultramarine blue, muted poster red, and mustard yellow. The overall mood is rebellious, romantic, and cinematic, like an iconic French New Wave poster made from ripped magazines, street photography, and bold typography.

items.title: French New Wave Protest Film Poster
items.description: A distressed 1960s-style French art-house movie poster collage for creating rebellious vintage cinema graphics with torn paper, bold typography, and political street-poster energy.
items.content: Create a vintage French New Wave political cinema poster as a torn-paper collage, vertical one-sheet composition, aged and distressed like a weathered 1968 street poster pasted on a wall. Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.

items.title: Premium Earbuds Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a sleek photorealistic wireless-earbuds commercial poster for tech product ads, social campaigns, and magazine-style promotional visuals.
items.content: Create a high-end futuristic product advertisement poster for {argument name="product name" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}, styled like a premium tech magazine cover. Vertical composition, clean soft gray studio background with subtle rainbow prism lens flares around the edges. A fashionable young person is centered in the background, face obscured by a simple rectangular blur block, wearing a bright neon-lime knit beanie, wavy shoulder-length pink hair, and a black-and-white zebra striped top. One white wireless earbud is visible in their ear. In the extreme foreground, their hand is extended toward the camera holding an open glossy white charging case, shot with dramatic shallow depth of field and forced perspective so the case dominates the frame. Inside the open case, exactly 2 white earbuds are visible. Add 4 larger floating earbuds around the composition: 2 on the left side and 2 on the right side, softly blurred as if suspended in space. Place huge bold white sans-serif headline text across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="AIRPODS"}. On the upper right, add smaller stacked white sans-serif product text reading {argument name="product label" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}. On the left middle, add a white feature callout in stacked text: {argument name="left feature text" default="Premium sound and noise cancellation"}. On the right side, add 2 large numeric feature blocks in white: one reading "30" with smaller text "hours of battery life." beneath it, and one reading "1" with smaller text "year warranty." beneath it. Sleek commercial lighting, glossy reflections on the case, crisp product detail, modern fashion-tech aesthetic, polished Apple-inspired ad design, photorealistic, premium editorial finish.

items.title: Open Manga Spread of Skirt Battle
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic photo of an open printed manga magazine showing a chaotic two-page Japanese battle comic spread, useful for creating fake serialized manga pages or parody editorial visuals.
items.content: A photorealistic overhead view of an open Japanese manga magazine held in two human hands at the lower left and lower right corners, shown as a dramatic two-page black-and-white comic spread on slightly warm paper with visible page curvature, center gutter distortion, ink texture, screentone shading, and dense speed lines. The magazine fills almost the entire frame on a neutral tabletop. The spread depicts a fictional over-the-top battle sports manga about {argument name="sport name" default="スカートバウト"}, with exaggerated action, intense expressions, and absurdly serious tournament storytelling. In the center across both pages, show 2 main full-body schoolgirl fighters in a chaotic combat scene: on the left page center a long-haired teenage girl in a dark school blazer, ribbon tie, pleated skirt, and loafers spins powerfully with both arms raised overhead, her hair and skirt flaring in a circular arc; on the right page center a second teenage girl in a sailor-style school uniform is upside down in a handstand-like impact pose, one leg thrust high into the air, skirt exploding outward with violent motion lines, as if she has been thrown or is counterattacking. Make the composition packed with explosive radial lines, debris-like ink flecks, dramatic foreshortening, and giant bold Japanese sound-effect typography crossing the gutter. The spread should read like a mainstream shonen battle manga but focused on skirts and rotational motion rather than weapons. Include exactly 8 side panels around the central action: 4 stacked along the far left page and 4 along the far right page. On the left side, panel 1 shows a girl standing under a waterfall in ascetic training, panel 2 shows inverted handstand practice in shallow water, panel 3 shows intense physical training on the ground, panel 4 shows 2 girls in a close emotional conversation. On the right side, panel 1 shows a composed rival girl in portrait close-up, panel 2 shows a roaring audience in stadium stands, panel 3 shows a small comedic rules diagram explaining the sport with 2 simplified girls and a skirt icon, panel 4 shows a shocked face close-up reaction. Render all text as authentic Japanese manga lettering and captions, including vertical title calligraphy, side narration boxes, crowd chants, rule panel labels, and large impact kanji; use the visible phrases as inspiration but do not prioritize perfect legibility. Add one oversized vertical title on the left page reading {argument name="attack name left" default="白鳥の湖"} and one huge central impact phrase on the right page reading {argument name="attack name right" default="倒立回転逆襲"}. Preserve the feeling of a fake magazine feature or serialized manga chapter discovered in print, with believable halftone dots, slightly worn page edges, high contrast black ink, and a humorous yet sincerely epic tone.

items.title: Celestial Blue Anime Girl Floating
items.description: A polished anime-style full-body character illustration of a floating star-themed girl, ideal for fantasy key art, social avatars, or decorative character posters.
items.content: A full-body anime illustration of a dreamy celestial girl floating diagonally across a pure white background, viewed from above as if weightless in open air. She has very long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"} hair spreading in elegant ribbons around her body, with glossy highlights, loose strands, and star-shaped hair ornaments near one side of her head. Her face is softly obscured and de-emphasized, while the composition focuses on her delicate pose, costume, and swirling magical atmosphere. She wears a highly detailed white and blue sailor-inspired fantasy dress with translucent layered sleeves, frilled ruffles, sparkling lace, sheer fabric panels, and a large star-like crystal brooch at the chest. The outfit includes 5 clearly visible clothing elements: a short frilled dress, a sailor collar and neck ribbon, semi-transparent detached sleeves or draped chiffon layers, 1 white thigh-high stocking on one leg, and 1 dark blue starry thigh-high stocking on the other leg with a matching garter band. She is barefoot, with both feet visible. Her pose is graceful and drifting: one arm reaches upward with an open hand, the other hand rests near her chest, one leg extended and the other slightly bent. Surround her with a luminous constellation motif in cool blue tones, including exactly 6 prominent five-pointed star ornaments scattered around her, multiple tiny star sparkles, circular watercolor-like swirls, floating bubbles, and ornate crescent-ring filigree arcs framing parts of the image. Make the palette icy blue, cobalt, indigo, and white, with shimmering glitter textures, soft translucent overlays, crisp line art, and a light ethereal glow. The overall mood is magical, elegant, celestial, and serene, like a star maiden suspended in a winter night sky interpreted on a clean white canvas.

items.description: This prompt generates a full-body anime pastel-goth girl in a cute gothic tea-room, ideal for character art, social media illustrations, and fashion-forward anime posters.
items.content: A full-body anime illustration of a cute gothic lolita girl seated at a small round table in a pastel goth tea-room, facing the viewer with a confident mischievous smile. She has {argument name="hair color" default="ash taupe brown"} hair in twin tails tied with 2 black flower ribbons, soft bangs, pink-magenta eyes, and a tiny black bat hair clip. Her pose is relaxed and flirty: one elbow on the tabletop, one cheek resting on her hand, the other hand raised toward the viewer holding a black playing card with a large pink heart and 4 small pink crosses. She wears a black long-sleeved sailor-style dress with a white collar, oversized pink bow at the chest, heart-shaped pendant at the bow center, pleated skirt, black choker with a silver cross charm, layered silver necklaces, black thigh-high stockings, heart-ring garter straps on both thighs, and chunky black platform Mary Jane shoes with multiple straps, silver buckles, heart details, and cross accents. Add small cute earrings and delicate gothic accessories. The room uses a limited {argument name="accent color" default="black and pastel pink"} palette with soft lavender-gray striped wallpaper. Include 2 black curtain drapes with pink scalloped trim at the upper left and upper right corners, 1 black cross wall ornament, 1 black bat wall ornament, and 2 pink heart wall ornaments. On the left shelving, show exactly 2 teaware pieces: 1 white teapot with a pink heart and 1 white teacup with a pink heart. The girl sits on a black chair with a pink backrest shaped like a heart silhouette. In front of her is 1 small round black table with a pink top. On the tabletop, depict a cute board game in progress: 1 rectangular board with alternating light and dark spaces, 4 player pawns total with 2 pink and 2 dark navy, 3 visible single cards near the board, and 3 separate card stacks on the right side of the table. Add 1 pink jelly dessert on a pedestal plate near the back right of the table. The floor is a large black-and-pink checkerboard. items.title: Retro AI Creative Brand Poster
items.description: A gritty vintage-style cinematic branding poster for an AI creative professional, ideal for personal brand visuals, social headers, or promo artwork.
items.content: Create a retro cinematic personal-brand poster in a distressed 1970s propaganda-meets-film-advertising style, landscape orientation, with a thick worn black border and heavy paper grain, ink bleed, halftone texture, scuffed edges, and aged print imperfections. Use a bold limited palette of deep black, warm cream, saturated poster red, and mustard yellow. The composition is a single unified poster with a large cropped portrait of {argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"} on the left half, shown from chest up, wearing dark sunglasses, a dark shirt, a chain necklace, and a mustard yellow jacket, with short dark hair styled up; the face is intentionally obscured by a centered rectangular block in muted taupe-gray, creating an editorial anonymized look. On the far left, place a vertical black panel containing 2 stacked “AI” blocks and 1 subtitle: top block reads “AI”, beneath it the subtitle reads “CREATIVE AGENT”, lower down another large “AI” sits over a gold circuit-board graphic. Across the center-right, place the main diagonal cream title band with huge black condensed lettering for the name {argument name="main name text" default="HOSSEIN"} and an oversized red “AI” at the far right of the band. Beneath the large name, add a small stretched subtitle line reading “AI CINEMATOGRAPHER · ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND”. In the top-right corner, add a 3-line stacked headline reading {argument name="top right headline" default="AI CINEMATOGRAPHER ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND"} in bold cream text on red. On the red field below the title band, include exactly 4 stacked black label boxes with cream text: “CINEMATOGRAPHER”, “AI CREATOR”, “VISUAL ARTIST”, and “BRAND ADVISOR”. Near the right side, add a handwritten white script note with exactly 3 lines: “Visual Storyteller”, “Brand Builder”, and “AI Explore”. In the lower area, arrange exactly 6 creative-tech objects: 1 circular orange graphic icon, 1 white audio waveform/equalizer graphic, 1 black film clapperboard labeled with “AI”, 1 open silver laptop, 1 pair of black headphones, and 1 large professional cinema camera body with visible “RED” marking; also include the edge of a music keyboard/controller at the bottom right. In the bottom-right corner, place a small dark terminal-style text block with tiny white monospace lines suggesting AI-generated visuals and analytics. Keep the whole design bold, gritty, and highly graphic, like a premium personal branding poster for an AI creative director and visual storyteller.

items.title: Japanese Children's Day Photo Card
items.description: A minimalist lifestyle-style Children's Day image featuring a running child with koinobori and hand-drawn seasonal doodles, ideal for greeting cards and holiday social posts.

author.name: クラスタ | Claude Codeの始め方

items.content: A soft, airy studio photograph on a warm off-white background with a minimalist Japanese greeting-card aesthetic. Show a small child, about toddler to preschool age, running joyfully toward the camera from left-center, with one arm raised high holding a tall pole with 2 carp streamers attached: 1 large blue koinobori on top and 1 smaller red koinobori below. The child wears a simple handmade samurai helmet folded from paper, a loose long-sleeve ivory shirt, light beige pants with rolled cuffs, and white sneakers. Keep the face unobtrusive and generic, with the focus on motion, innocence, and seasonal atmosphere. Surround the child with delicate hand-drawn doodle illustrations in thin gray pencil-like lines and faint pastel accents: 2 puffy clouds, 1 flying bird, 1 small origami crane near the text, 4 drifting leaves, 2 curved wind-line clusters, 1 small house, 2 tall trees, 2 purple iris flowers with grass at the bottom left, and sparse grass marks along the ground. On the right side, add elegant Japanese handwritten text reading {argument name="headline text" default="こどもの日"}, beneath it smaller Japanese text {argument name="subtext" default="すこやかな\n成長を願って。"}, and below that the English subtitle {argument name="english subtitle" default="Children's Day"} in a light handwritten script. Use a clean editorial layout with abundant negative space, natural soft lighting, muted cream and beige tones, subtle pastel blue and red accents, gentle shadows, and a calm premium lifestyle-photography look suitable for a seasonal holiday card or social media post.

items.content: A clean, warm, minimalist promotional poster for a coding study meetup, in a soft lifestyle-photography plus editorial design style. Show 3 young adults seated around a light wooden table in a bright neutral room, collaborating with laptops and notebooks. The group consists of 2 men and 1 woman, all casually dressed in muted colors; the person on the left wears a dark navy sweater, the woman in the center-right wears an off-white knit top, and the person on the far right wears a light gray hoodie in side profile. Their faces are softly obscured and not detailed. Place 2 open silver laptops on the table, 2 ceramic mugs, 2 notebooks, 1 smartphone, and 1 pen visible near the right person’s hand. Compose the people on the right half of the image, with a large pale sage-green organic blob shape behind them as a graphic backdrop. Keep the lighting soft, natural, airy, and slightly warm, with lots of negative space on the left. On the left side, add large elegant headline typography reading {argument name="headline text" default="Claude Code"} on one line and {argument name="subheadline text" default="勉強会"} below it in large Japanese characters. Under the headline, add a thin dotted horizontal divider line, then 2 lines of smaller Japanese body text reading {argument name="body text" default="集まって、学んで、つくって、\n一緒にスキルをアップデートしよう。"}. Add playful hand-drawn doodles in thin dark lines around the layout: 1 hanging lamp centered near the top, 1 handwritten note in the upper left saying {argument name="note text" default="Let’s coding!"}, 1 small laptop icon in the upper right, 1 steaming coffee cup icon beside it, 1 potted plant icon in the lower left, and 3 long curving decorative squiggle lines distributed across the page. Use an off-white background, restrained Japanese cafe-meets-tech branding, balanced whitespace, and a polished social-media event flyer aesthetic with a 16:9 horizontal composition.

author.name: クラスタ | Claude Codeの始め方

items.content: A soft, airy lifestyle editorial image with a warm spring cafe mood. Place a Japanese woman in her late 20s to 30s on the right half of the frame, seated at a light wooden table and holding an open hardcover book as if quietly reading. She has {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair styled half-up with gentle curls at the ends, small earrings, and a calm, refined presence. Dress her in a navy blazer over a white top for an elegant casual-office look. On the table in front of her, show exactly 3 tabletop items: 1 white coffee cup on a saucer near the center front, 1 small clear glass vase filled with pale yellow and white flowers at the lower right, and 1 open book in her hands. Use bright natural lighting, soft shadows, a high-key cream background, and a clean minimalist composition with lots of negative space. On the left side, add Japanese editorial typography in a delicate, hand-drawn style: a large headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="春の休日、カフェで読書。"}, a smaller vertical-style body copy block below it reading "やわらかな陽ざしと、ページをめくる音。ゆっくり流れる時間が、いちばんのごほうび。", and a handwritten English phrase reading {argument name="accent text" default="Spring days"}. Surround the layout with subtle sketch-like spring doodles in muted gray ink and pale pink accents. Include exactly 9 falling cherry blossom petals scattered across the page, 2 simple line-drawn birds flying near the upper right, 1 outlined window frame with cherry blossom branches in the top right corner, 1 line drawing of a steaming coffee cup at the lower left, 1 line drawing of an open book with a small vase and leaves near the lower middle-left, and a few tiny leaf doodles. The overall style should blend real photography with delicate hand-drawn editorial illustrations, evoking a calm, feminine Japanese magazine advertisement about reading at a cafe in spring.

Use subtle shadows under the car for realism. Maintain a minimal yet aggressive composition with strong visual hierarchy.

Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic, 3d pixar portrait of a {argument name="gender" default="young child"}, preserving the exact facial identity, structure, and proportions from the reference image with high fidelity.

Pose (must match exactly):
Child is sitting on the floor with legs crossed. One elbow is resting on the knee, with the hand supporting the side of the face (cheek pressed into palm). Natural child proportions with slightly stylized softness. Maintain realistic anatomy, no exaggeration.

{argument name="hair style" default="medium to long natural hair, slightly tousled, soft volume"}

Clothing:

Denim jeans (rolled cuffs optional)
Clean white sneakers

Lighting:
Soft studio lighting, evenly diffused, gentle shadows under chin and body, smooth skin rendering without over-processing.

Background:
Minimal clean studio backdrop (light grey or soft neutral tone), seamless and distraction-free.

Details:
Highly detailed skin texture, realistic fabric folds, natural hair strands with subtle flyaways, crisp focus, 8k resolution feel.

Camera:
Eye-level perspective, centered framing, shallow depth of field but subject fully sharp.

items.title: Artistic Luxury Trophy Design Poster
items.description: A sophisticated poster prompt combining a pencil sketch transformation sequence with a hyper-realistic product showcase, using a luxury perfume-ad aesthetic.
items.content:
A vertical 2:3 premium design poster with two sections, inspired by elegant {argument name="theme" default="perfume advertisement aesthetics"}, luxury branding, {argument name="color palette" default="soft pink tones"}, and a magical storytelling atmosphere.
TOP HALF (PROCESS / TRANSFORMATION SEQUENCE)
A seamless horizontal sequence of 5 pencil sketch stages on a clean white background, flowing smoothly from left to right with no visible borders.
The sequence illustrates the transformation into a luxury trophy:
Motion – Abstract flowing lines and light gesture strokes, symbolizing energy and achievement in motion.
Emergence – The lines begin forming a graceful upward structure, hinting at a sculptural object.
Forming Shape – A recognizable trophy silhouette starts to appear, with soft curves and elegant proportions.
Refinement – Details sharpen: handles, base, and structure become clearer and more defined.
Final Sketch – A complete, polished pencil rendering of a premium trophy with intricate design details.
Style: delicate graphite pencil, soft shading, artistic motion trails, minimalist luxury sketch aesthetic.
BOTTOM HALF (FINAL PRODUCT SHOWCASE)
A hyper-realistic, premium gold trophy placed on a circular pedestal.
Material: polished gold with soft reflections
Base: black marble or glossy stone with a metallic nameplate
Background: flowing satin fabric in soft blush pink tones
Lighting: warm, cinematic glow with subtle sparkles and dreamy particles
Atmosphere: magical, elegant, aspirational luxury
TEXT ELEMENTS (LUXURY BRAND STYLE)
Top center (above sketches):
“FROM VISION TO VICTORY”
subtext: “Where ambition takes form.”
Bottom left (main copy):
“CRAFTED WITH PASSION”
“DEFINED BY EXCELLENCE”
Tagline (small, elegant):
“More than a trophy. A symbol of legacy.”
STYLE KEYWORDS
Luxury • Perfume-ad aesthetic • Soft pink palette • Gold accents • Minimal • Elegant • Dreamlike • Editorial • High-end branding • Cinematic lighting • Ultra-clean composition

items.description: A detailed prompt for creating high-end fashion advertisement portraits featuring a specific character aesthetic and miniature figurines.
items.content:
Photorealistic close-up beauty campaign portrait of a stunning young Western woman with long, voluminous curly dark hair, defined cheekbones, thick expressive eyebrows, and flawless luminous skin. Her features are sharp yet feminine, with a confident, slightly rebellious expression.

She wears a premium black and {argument name="color scheme" default="hot-pink"} baseball cap featuring bold, glowing {argument name="accent color" default="hot-pink"} 3D lettering “{argument name="name" default="SHARON"}” on the front, designed like a high-end streetwear brand logo. Trendy translucent pink-tinted round glasses sit perfectly on her face. A beige band-aid is placed on the bridge of her nose and another on her left cheek, adding a stylized edgy aesthetic. A lit cigarette rests between her slightly parted lips, revealing perfect white teeth.

Highly detailed miniature anime-style figurines (cute detective-inspired girl character: short brown bob haircut, oversized sparkling blue eyes, round glasses, bright red overalls, white shirt, yellow gloves) interact playfully across the composition: one sitting on the brim of the cap, one climbing her ear, one pulling her lower lip, one tucked inside her shirt collar, and one posed on her shoulder. A bold, oversized cyan pencil is tucked under the cap strap, acting as a striking graphic element.

Wardrobe styling: luxury streetwear aesthetic — black structured jacket layered over a crisp white-and-pink striped collared shirt, finished with a neatly tied pink scarf.

Color palette: deep blacks, vibrant hot-pink highlights, electric cyan accents, and warm yellow pops for contrast.

Lighting: high-end studio lighting with soft frontal illumination and dramatic rim lighting for depth and separation. Clean white seamless background.

Composition: ultra-sharp focus, editorial framing, luxury fashion advertisement style, cinematic depth, hyper-realistic textures (visible skin pores, detailed fabric weave, individual hair strands), 8K resolution, extremely intricate detailing.

Mood: bold, playful, high-fashion, Gen-Z luxury streetwear campaign, blending realism with surreal miniature storytelling.

items.title: Automotive poster transformation prompt
items.description: A prompt for transforming a car photo into a professional minimalist advertising poster with drifting effects and technical specifications.
items.content:
Ultra-clean automotive poster featuring the exact same car as the photo that will be provided later. The AI must replicate the car from the uploaded photo with identical body shape, proportions, stance, color, trims, wheels, and all visible exterior details.
The car is presented in a front three-quarter angle facing right, matching the perspective of the original reference layout, but now depicted in a subtle {argument name="action" default="drifting action"}. The drift is expressed through realistic weight transfer, slight body lift, controlled smoke plumes from the rear tires, and faint curved tire marks behind the vehicle, without distorting the original car’s geometry.
Headlights follow the exact style from the reference photo of the car, with optional warm fog lights glowing if the provided car has them. All decals, emblems, plates, and window tints must match the car from the uploaded photo.
The car drifts on a glossy white reflective studio-like floor that maintains soft reflections and realistic shadows, enhanced with light drift skid reflections and directional smudges.
Background remains a clean white-to-light-gray gradient with a giant semi-transparent bold typography of the car model name (auto-extracted from the uploaded photo) vertically dominating the background.
At the very top: clean branding text “{argument name="brand name" default="CAR COMPANY NAME"}” (or the brand detected from the uploaded car photo). Under it, spaced-out stylized tracking text containing the same brand and model name.
Below the car: centered title of the exact model name from the uploaded photo.
Under that, a short descriptive paragraph about the car’s character (efficiency, style, reliability).
Bottom section shows a clean grid layout of specifications. If real specs are known from the detected car model, generate accurate values; if not, generate placeholders in the same layout style (4 columns: horsepower, 0–100 km/h, top speed, engine displacement/fuel type).
Entire poster is minimalist, editorial, high-key studio lighting with ultra-sharp reflections, crisp shadows, modern typography, and 4K believability, blending clean design with dynamic drifting energy, Ratio 9:16

items.title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
items.description: A technical prompt for creating a 3D-rendered dance sequence guide using a reference character for consistent posing across a grid layout.
items.content:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {argument name="reference" default="image1"} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {argument name="clothing" default="well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

items.title: Concept to Form Design Process
items.description: A sophisticated prompt that generates an A4 vertical visual mapping the transformation from a concept to a finished product design.
items.content:
主题：【⭐︎例：{argument name="主题" default="网球发球"}】  
请将这一主题从概念到造型的转化过程，以及作为最终成果的完成设计，用一张 A4 竖版视觉图呈现出来。  上下两段式结构。  
上段是主题本质的五步可视化流程图。 构思的源泉 → 轨迹与能量 → 抽象化的线条与结构 → 立体形态 → 最终设计，按此流程构建。 精细的素描、线稿、设计图纸、小箭头、简短英文标签、留白考究的版式。 
标题是“MOTION TO FORM”。  
下图展示了从上文流程中最终成型的英雄视觉形象。 不固定类别，由 AI 根据主题选择最适合的设计对象。 可以是产品、物件、家具、饰品、包装、器皿、灯具、小工具、配件、艺术品等任何形式。 
生成虚构品牌名称、标语及简短文案，打造适用于广告或设计发布视觉效果的创意内容。  
整体呈现了融合概念板、品牌广告与设计开发资料的高完成度。 极简、诗意、知性、留白构成的美感。 色调以中性色为基础，搭配 1-2 种源自主题的强调色。 
精准描绘素材感、光线、阴影、结构美与质感表现。 高分辨率、商业级视觉品质。

Subject: [e.g., {argument name="subject" default="Tennis Serve"}] 
Please present the transformation process of this theme from concept to form, as well as the completed design as the final result, in an A4 vertical visual image. Two-part structure (top and bottom). 
The top section is a five-step visualization flowchart of the essence of the theme: Source of Inspiration → Trajectory & Energy → Abstracted Lines & Structure → Three-dimensional Form → Final Design. Build it according to this flow. Fine sketches, line drawings, design blueprints, small arrows, short English labels, and a layout with elegant negative space. 
The title is "MOTION TO FORM." 
The bottom image displays the final 'hero visual' image formed from the process above. The category is not fixed; the AI chooses the most suitable design object based on the theme. It can be any form, such as a product, object, furniture, accessory, packaging, vessel, lamp, gadget, accessory, artwork, etc. 
Generate a fictional brand name, slogan, and short copy to create creative content suitable for advertising or design release visual effects. 
The overall presentation has a high level of completion, merging concept boards, brand advertisements, and design development materials. A sense of beauty composed of minimalism, poetry, intelligence, and negative space. The color palette is based on neutral tones, paired with 1-2 accent colors derived from the theme. 
Accurately depict material feel, light, shadow, structural beauty, and texture representation. High resolution, commercial-grade visual quality.

items.title: AAA Fighting Game Storyboard Grid
items.description: A highly structured prompt for creating a 3x3 storyboard grid of a fighting game, maintaining consistent characters and full game UI elements.
items.content:
{
  "instruction": "Use the provided two character images as exact visual references. Preserve identity, face, outfit, proportions, and details perfectly.",
  "concept": "{argument name="game concept" default="AAA fighting game scene presented as a Tekken-style gameplay grid storyboard"}",
  "layout": {
    "type": "3x3 grid",
    "description": "nine panels showing a continuous fight progression with full game UI visible in each frame"
  },
  "panels": [
    "panel 1: dramatic VS screen — character A vs character B, both facing each other, glowing background, versus text in center",
    "panel 2: round start — both fighters in idle stance, READY text on screen",
    "panel 3: FIGHT moment — cinematic spark explosion as fight begins",
    "panel 4: first attack — character A throws a punch with motion blur",
    "panel 5: counter attack — character B kicks with impact sparks",
    "panel 6: combo sequence — multiple hit sparks, motion trails, dynamic camera",
    "panel 7: low health moment — health bar flashing red, tension moment",
    "panel 8: finishing move — slow motion heavy hit, cinematic angle",
    "panel 9: KO screen — opponent falling back, huge KO text, particles flying"
  ],
  "style": "{argument name="art style" default="ultra realistic AAA Tekken-style fighting game, cinematic gameplay rendering, highly detailed characters, realistic lighting"}",
  "camera": "in-game fighting camera, slightly angled side view, dynamic zoom during impacts",
  "environment": "high-end fighting arena, dark background with neon accents, subtle depth, not distracting",
  "ui_elements": {
    "health_bars": "top left and right, detailed, glowing, decreasing across panels",
    "timer": "center top",
    "player_names": "top left and right",
    "round_indicator": "visible",
    "combo_counter": "appears during hits",
    "hit_effects": "sparks, flashes, light streaks",
    "KO_text": "large, bold, center screen in final panel",
    "READY_FIGHT_text": "arcade-style bold typography"
  },
  "effects": [
    "motion blur on attacks",
    "impact sparks",
    "energy trails",
    "camera shake effect",
    "slow motion feeling in finishing hit",
    "screen glow during hits"
  ],
  "color_grading": "{argument name="color grading" default="high contrast, arcade cinematic, vibrant highlights, deep shadows"}",
  "output": "clean 3x3 grid, perfectly aligned panels, full UI visible, no logos, no watermarks"
}
"reference_style": "Tekken 8 gameplay UI, arcade fighting game interface, modern AAA fighting HUD"

items.content: 请帮我制作一张关于{argument name="人物姓名" default="[人物姓名]"}的信息图，视觉效果要非常丰富且有深度。不仅是罗列信息：我需要你深入挖掘他的生平、主要成就、职场关键节点、哲学思想，以及他对科技和设计的独特影响。不要用那种死板的一块一块的布局，要用图解、注释和引线标注把这些信息有机地结合在一起。画面风格：走那种大胆有力、图形感很强的插画路线。具体看起来是这样的：中心焦点是一张细节极其逼真、像照片一样的人物肖像。以此为核心，周围环绕着像时间轴、分析图表、经典产品、名言警句和短小精悍的文字。构图技巧：背景保持干净。运用分层构图，把逼真的人物肖像和强烈的图形元素（比如各种形状、图标、大色块）完美混搭在一起。整个画面要显得内容满满、有质感，看起来非常专业。
items.translatedContent: Please create an infographic about {argument name="subject name" default="[Name]"} with very rich and deep visual effects. It shouldn't just list information: I need you to dig deep into their life, major achievements, key career milestones, philosophical thoughts, and their unique impact on technology and design. Avoid a rigid block-by-block layout; use diagrams, annotations, and lead lines to organically combine this information. Visual style: Go for a bold, strong, and highly graphical illustration style. Specifically, it should look like this: the central focus is a highly realistic, photo-like portrait of the person. Surrounding this core are elements like timelines, analytical charts, classic products, famous quotes, and concise text. Composition: Keep the background clean. Use layered composition to perfectly mix the realistic portrait with strong graphical elements (like various shapes, icons, large color blocks). The entire image should look full of content, textured, and very professional.

items.title: Luxury Concept Poster Design
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating a minimalist, high-end conceptual poster featuring a subject and thematic metaphors like a rocket launch.
items.content:
あなたが生成するのは、普通のイラストではなく、「{argument name="人物名" default="ELON MUSK"}」という人物・名前が持つ意味や象徴性を、視覚的なメタファーとして表現した高級コンセプトポスターです。

巨大な文字「{argument name="人物名" default="ELON MUSK"}」を画面全体の主役として配置してください。文字は太く、力強く、圧倒的な存在感を持つサンセリフ体。背景は{argument name="背景色" default="深い黒"}、文字は少し黄味がかったオフホワイトで、ヴィンテージのシルクスクリーン印刷や古いポスターのような紙質感、粒子感、軽い擦れを加えてください。

画面中央下には、イーロン・マスクを想起させる男性のモノクロポートレートを配置してください。本人に似た雰囲気で、未来を見上げるような表情。顔は写実的すぎず、版画・ポスター調の強い陰影で表現してください。

右上には、ロケットが斜め上に打ち上がっていく構図を入れてください。ロケットの噴射炎と煙は{argument name="アクセントカラー" default="赤"}をアクセントカラーにし、巨大な文字の一部を切り裂くように通過させてください。これにより「未来へ突き抜ける」「既存の枠を突破する」「スケールの大きな挑戦」という意味を視覚化します。

全体は極簡で力強いグラフィックポスターにしてください。要素を増やしすぎず、文字、人物、ロケット、赤い噴煙だけで構成します。構図は大胆で、遠くから見ても一目で印象に残るデザインにしてください。

左下に小さく「VISION / SCALE / MOTION」、右下に「BUILD THE FUTURE.」のような短い補助テキストを入れてください。必要に応じてTeslaやXを連想させる小さな記号を控えめに配置してもよいですが、主役はあくまで「ELON MUSK」という文字と人物の象徴性です。

色数は黒、オフホワイト、赤の3色を中心に統一してください。高級感、未来感、野心、孤独、スケール感、破壊と創造のエネルギーが伝わる、強い視覚記憶を持つコンセプトポスターにしてください。
items.translatedContent:
What you will generate is not a regular illustration, but a high-end concept poster that expresses the meaning and symbolism of the person and name "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as a visual metaphor.

Place the giant letters "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as the main protagonist of the entire screen. The letters should be thick, powerful sans-serif characters with an overwhelming presence. The background should be {argument name="background color" default="deep black"}, and the characters a slightly yellowish off-white, with paper texture, graininess, and light scuffs like vintage silkscreen printing or old posters.

At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait of a man reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should have an atmosphere similar to the person himself, with an expression looking up at the future. The face should not be too realistic, but expressed with strong shadows in a print/poster style.

In the upper right, include a composition where a rocket is launching diagonally upward. Use {argument name="accent color" default="red"} as an accent color for the rocket's exhaust flames and smoke, and have it pass through the giant letters as if cutting through them. This visualizes the meaning of "breaking through to the future," "breaking through existing frameworks," and "large-scale challenges."

Make the overall design a minimalist and powerful graphic poster. Do not add too many elements; compose it only with the text, the person, the rocket, and the red smoke. The composition should be bold and designed to leave an impression at a glance, even from a distance.

In the lower left, add small auxiliary text like "VISION / SCALE / MOTION," and in the lower right, "BUILD THE FUTURE." You may discreetly place small symbols associated with Tesla or X if necessary, but the main focus remains the symbolism of the name "ELON MUSK" and the person.

Unify the colors around three main colors: black, off-white, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual memory that conveys luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, a sense of scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.

items.content:
日本のバラエティ情報番組のテレビ画面キャプチャ（16:9）。「○○の知らない世界」的な番組スタイル。

画面構成：

items.title: Dramatic Chibi Anime Poster
items.description: A highly detailed, structured prompt for generating an anime movie poster featuring a chibi character from a back view, using reference images for character consistency.
items.content:
image_generation_prompt:
  meta:
    description: "{argument name="シーン説明" default="ちびキャラがロードバイクに乗ろうとしている後ろ姿のアニメ映画ポスター風イラスト"}"
    reference_usage: "キャラクターの見た目は添付画像を参照"
  
  style:
    art_style: "{argument name="アートスタイル" default="アニメ映画のポスター (Anime movie poster)"}"
    mood: "ドラマチック"

  subject:
    type: "ちびキャラ (Chibi character)"
    pose:
      view: "後ろ姿 (Back view)"
      action: "画面奥（真上）のロードバイクに向かって左足を踏み出している"
      target_direction: "ロードバイクの方向（画像の真上方向）"

  composition:
    top:
      element: "赤色のロードバイク (Red Road bike)"
      layout: "画面の横幅いっぱいの大きさ、画像上端と平行"
    center:
      element: "ちびキャラの後ろ姿"
      angle: "俯瞰 (Overhead)"
    bottom:
      text_layer_base:
        content: "{argument name="テキスト" default="KASANE"}"
        style: "bold sans-serif font"
        color: "白色 (White)"
      text_layer_overlay:
        content: "カサネ"
        style: "太い筆でなぐり書きしたような荒々しい文字"
        color: "赤色 (Red)"
        position: "KASANEの文字の上に被る形"

  objects:
    road_bike:
      color: "赤色 (Red)"
      orientation: "真横 (Side view / Horizontal)"
      facing_direction: "左側 (Facing left)"
    road:
      detail: "道路の中央にまっすぐな白線が引かれている。その白線は、はっきりとは見えず、薄っすらと、ぼんやりとしか見えない。道路の左側の一部分に、かすかに、薄っすらと、ほんのすこしだけひび割れがある。"

  technical_settings:
    shot_size: "ロングショット (long shot)"
    shot_angle: "俯瞰 (overhead shot)"
    zoom_emphasis: "ちびキャラと自転車を大きく強調"
    lens_effects: "ビネッティング (Vignetting)"
    lighting:
      direction: "真上から照射 (From above)"

All visible text in the final image must be Korean only. Use clean Korean sans-serif typography. The title must be exactly “손금 분석 가이드”.

Create a refined two-panel layout:
Left panel: place the uploaded real palm photo inside a clean rounded card. Preserve the original hand shape, palm lines, skin texture, and natural details. Do not distort or redraw the hand.
Right panel: create a separate black-and-white palm contour interpretation diagram based on the same hand. Highlight the main palm lines with thin precise lines and label them in Korean.

Include Korean labels and sections:
“손금 분석 가이드”, “전체 요약”, “생명선”, “두뇌선”, “감정선”, “운명선”, “재물선”, “태양선”, “결혼선”, “성격”, “직업운”, “재물운”, “연애운”, “조언”, “확인 불가”.

Analyze palm shape, finger proportions, life line, head line, heart line, fate line, wealth line, sun line, marriage line, line depth, length, direction, breaks, branches, and overlaps. If something is unclear, write “확인 불가”. Keep the Korean interpretation short, realistic, calm, and advisory.

大理石广场，两侧站满媒体长焦镜头与闪光灯
远处建筑有巨型灯光装置与红毯延伸

分镜方案图，深黑色高端编辑排版，紫金配色标题：
"{argument name="分镜标题" default="IGNITE · 智界R7 × 盛典出场大片企划"}"

第一区块——角色与车辆参考（仿照专业lookbook排版）：
从参考图提取——人物正面、侧面、车辆全侧、车头特写、
配饰耳环与手包微距

第二区块——第二区块分为左右两部分——

左：场景环境参考实景图（夜间大堂氛围照）

右：空间俯视平面图
标注内容：
- 空间轮廓线（楼梯/广场/通道）
- 人物初始站位 + 移动路径虚线箭头
- 5个机位标注（编号 + 拍摄方式英文缩写）
- 摄影机朝向箭头
- 产品/道具摆放锚点
- 核心构图区域高亮框              5帧分镜故事板（2.39:1宽银幕）：

帧1：远景 · 车门打开瞬间
深夜广场，闪光灯海浪中，
车门开启，内饰紫色氛围灯先亮，
逆光剪影，发丝与礼服裙摆被风吹动

帧2：出场步伐 · 低机位仰拍
从地面仰角看她踩着细跟鞋落地，
大理石倒映裙摆，后方智界R7车身
作为发光背景板，闪光灯在远处炸开

帧3：转身回望 · 85mm人像特写
她侧身回头，眼神直视镜头，
金耳环在闪光灯中一瞬闪烁，
嘴角极轻微的弧度，表情掌控全场

帧4：车与人同框英雄镜头
她立于车前，微风吹起裙摆，
智界R7完整侧身在身后发光，
星云紫车漆与礼服形成同色系
高级共鸣，背景媒体人群虚化

帧5：离场尾镜头
她进入车内，车门缓缓关闭，
尾灯点亮，车辆在闪光灯中
缓缓驶离红毯，只剩光轨

光影与风格：
夜间强侧逆光 · 闪光灯瞬间曝光感
深黑背景 · 紫色车身作为唯一光源之一
2.39:1变形宽银幕 · 大光圈人像浅景深

- Character: Oriental female @image_1, black high ponytail, modified Cheongsam {argument name="dress color" default="dark purple"} gown @image_2, gold vintage large hoop earrings, red lips, cold and noble temperament.
- Vehicle: @image_3 {argument name="car model" default="Huawei Zhijie R7"}, Nebula Purple paint, streamlined sedan silhouette, license plate with Chinese characters 'Zhijie R7'.

Scene: Outside a top-tier night award ceremony or international film festival venue. Marble plaza, flanked by media with long lenses and flashlights. Faraway buildings with giant light installations and a red carpet extension.

Storyboard plan, deep black high-end editorial layout, purple and gold color scheme title: "{argument name="storyboard title" default="IGNITE · Zhijie R7 × Grand Ceremony Entrance Blockbuster Project"}"

Section 1 - Character and Vehicle Reference (professional lookbook layout style): Extracting from reference images - front/side of character, full side of vehicle, close-up of front, macro of earrings and handbag.

Section 2 - Divided into left and right parts:
Left: Real scene reference for environment (night lobby atmosphere photo).
Right: Top-down spatial floor plan. Notated with: spatial outlines (stairs/plaza/aisles), initial character position + dashed path arrows, 5 camera positions (number + abbreviation), camera direction arrows, product/prop anchors, highlighted core composition areas.

5-Frame Storyboard (2.39:1 CinemaScope):
Frame 1: Long shot · Moment door opens. Night plaza in a sea of flashes, door opens, purple interior ambient light lights up first, backlit silhouette, hair and hem blowing in wind.
Frame 2: Entrance walk · Low angle shot. Looking up from ground level as she steps down in stilettos, marble reflecting the hem, Zhijie R7 body in back as a glowing backdrop, flashes bursting in distance.
Frame 3: Turn back · 85mm portrait close-up. She turns sideways, looking directly at the camera, gold earrings glint in the flash, very slight curve of the mouth, expression controlling the scene.
Frame 4: Hero shot of car and person. She stands in front of the car, breeze blowing the dress, Zhijie R7 full side glowing behind, Nebula Purple paint and gown forming a high-end chromatic harmony, background media crowd blurred.
Frame 5: Departure end shot. She enters the car, door closes slowly, taillights light up, vehicle slowly drives away from the red carpet amidst flashes, leaving only light trails.

Lighting and Style:
Strong night side-backlight · Instant flash exposure feel. Deep black background · Purple car body as one of the only light sources. 2.39:1 anamorphic wide screen · Large aperture shallow depth of field. Keywords: Absolute protagonist aura · Event-level narrative · Movie premiere quality.

items.title: 1960s Art-House Film Poster
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating a vintage-style 1960s European art-house film poster with collage elements, bold typography, and a raw, tactile aesthetic.
items.content:
Create a vertical poster composition on aged cream paper with a handmade analog feel. Use rough ripped paper edges, layered magazine cutouts, photocopy grain, halftone texture, ink bleed, and slightly imperfect screen-print registration. Keep the subject as the main black-and-white photographic portrait, placed prominently in the center or upper center.

Surround the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as a rainy European street, film-strip borders, newspaper clippings, urban silhouettes, and cinematic details, arranged like a handmade 1960s art-house movie poster.

Use bold condensed typography with a strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text: “{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”. Add smaller subtitle text: “{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”. Add bottom text: “{argument name="event details" default="[BRAND NAME / EVENT NAME / COMING SOON / DATE]"}”. If needed, include a small top line reading “[TAGLINE]”.

The final result should feel cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial — like a lost 1960s European film poster with a strong point of view. Keep it raw, tactile, printed, imperfect, and handmade. Avoid a glossy modern finish.

items.title: Luxury Dream Home Real Estate Flyer
items.description: A bold vertical real-estate ad poster promoting luxury homes and property investment, ideal for social media marketing or sales flyers.
items.content: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.

items.title: Empowerment Sports Campaign Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished vertical sportswear advertisement featuring a crouching female athlete and bold activist brush lettering for global brand campaign visuals.
items.content: Create a high-end global sportswear campaign poster on a clean light gray studio background with a full-body female athlete crouching in the foreground, photographed in a fashion-advertising style. She is a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length slightly tousled hair, wearing a fitted white short-sleeve athletic t-shirt with a small black puma logo on the chest, black leggings, a light gray sweatshirt tied around her waist, and gray running shoes with subtle white branding. Her pose is low and powerful, one knee raised, one hand resting on the lifted knee and the other hanging loosely, facing camera with confident energy. Behind and around her, fill most of the composition with oversized black hand-painted brush lettering in an expressive activist style. The text must read exactly: "WE ARE THE VOICE OF" above, then the huge central word "STRENGTH," then beneath it "UNITY," and "AND CHANGE." Add a bold handwritten hashtag "#OWNYOURPOWER" near the middle-right. In the lower-right corner place the black Puma leaping cat logo above the wordmark "PUMA" and the tagline "FOREVER. FASTER." At the very bottom add 3 small footer text blocks: left "PUMA.COM", center "FOREVER. FASTER. TOGETHER. A GLOBAL MOVEMENT FOR EQUALITY, EMPOWERMENT AND CHANGE.", right "JOIN THE MOVEMENT. #OWNYOURPOWER". Composition should feel like a contemporary empowerment campaign, blending sports fashion editorial photography with protest-style brush typography, minimal palette of white, black, and gray, crisp studio lighting, premium ad layout, vertical poster format.

items.title: False-Color Garden Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a surreal medium-format portrait of a woman in a vivid red shirt standing in a lush garden transformed into magenta and purple false-color film tones, ideal for cinematic editorial or experimental photography.
items.content: A surreal medium-format portrait of a woman standing on a narrow garden path surrounded by extremely dense foliage, photographed in a dreamlike false-color film look. She wears a plain bright saturated {argument name="shirt color" default="red"} crew-neck T-shirt and dark black fitted pants, with shoulder-length dark hair that is slightly tousled and parted off-center. Her pose is relaxed and natural, arms hanging loosely at her sides, body facing the camera with a subtle turn, framed from about mid-thigh upward. The setting is an overgrown botanical garden packed with ferns, ivy, shrubs, and flowering plants on both sides of the path; all vegetation is dramatically color-shifted from green into vivid magenta, lavender, pink, and deep purple, creating an unnatural LomoChrome Purple XR aesthetic. Keep the subject's shirt intensely saturated and realistic against the transformed environment for strong visual contrast. Use soft overcast daylight, shallow to moderate depth of field, and medium format rendering with a {argument name="camera" default="Mamiya RB67"} feel, shot with a {argument name="lens" default="90mm lens"} at {argument name="aperture" default="f/5.6"}. Include organic film grain, slight edge halation, gentle vignette, soft bloom in highlights, and subtle vintage film border edges. Composition should be vertical in a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="6:7"} frame, with the subject centered slightly left of the path, foreground and background foliage softly blurred while remaining lush and detailed, producing an eerie, romantic, otherworldly portrait.

items.title: Ink-Wash Warrior Riding a Tiger
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic Chinese calligraphy and ink-painting style fantasy illustration suited for poster art, literary visuals, or heroic mythic scene design.
items.content: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink-wash fantasy painting on warm off-white rice paper, combining monumental calligraphy with a heroic figure scene. On the right side, a lone ancient warrior in ornate dark robes and layered black armor sits astride a large tiger on the edge of a jagged cliff, both shown in three-quarter back view facing left toward the open landscape. The warrior wears a flowing cape and long ribbon streamers whipping in the wind, and raises a straight sword vertically so that it becomes a brilliant pillar of golden-white light piercing upward into dense storm clouds. The tiger is powerfully built, realistic, alert, and richly detailed with bold stripes, white fur accents, and ceremonial cloth and tack with subtle gold ornament. The sky is filled with smoky gray ink clouds, softly blooming washes, and scattered gold flecks around the glowing sword beam. Below and to the left, a misty shanshui landscape opens into distant mountains, river water, tiny tree clusters, and layered atmospheric haze rendered in pale gray ink. On the left half of the composition, include 2 large vertical columns of expressive black brush-calligraphy in Chinese, bold and irregular, occupying most of the height; add 1 narrower vertical line of smaller calligraphy beside them and 4 red seal stamps total, with 2 small seals near the smaller inscription, 1 seal near the upper right edge, and 1 double-stacked red seal at the lower left. Emphasize high contrast between empty paper space and dark ink masses, literati painting aesthetics, sweeping brush energy, epic martial grandeur, and a subtle modern fantasy finish with restrained metallic gold highlights.

items.title: Chinese Ink Warrior on Horseback
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic monochrome ink-wash poster of a mounted ancient Chinese general overlooking an army, ideal for poetic historical art and wuxia-inspired visuals.
items.content: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink wash painting in monochrome black, charcoal, and soft gray on off-white rice paper, in the style of expressive shan shui brush art and heroic historical wuxia illustration. On the right side, a lone armored general sits upright on a dark warhorse atop a rocky cliff, viewed from behind and slightly in profile, looking out over a vast army below. The warrior wears layered black lamellar armor, a flowing windblown cloak, and a topknot with long trailing ribbons; he holds a straight sword angled downward beside the horse. The horse is muscular and glossy black, standing firmly near the cliff edge with its tail and mane subtly swept by the wind. Below and across the lower half of the scene, a dense battlefield mass of soldiers appears as misty silhouettes with upright spears and several battle flags, partially obscured by fog. In the distance, steep mountain peaks emerge through drifting mist on the upper right, with 7 small birds flying across the pale sky near the center. On the left side, include 2 large vertical columns of bold black Chinese calligraphy in wild cursive brush strokes: the main quote reading “一身转战三千里，一剑曾当百万师”, with a smaller vertical signature “王维” below, plus a small red seal stamp. Emphasize strong negative space, textured ink bleeding, splattered brush edges, atmospheric haze, epic solitude, martial grandeur, and a solemn, contemplative mood.
