items.title: Chinese Ink Swordsman and Calligraphy
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic wuxia-style ink painting poster with a lone swordsman, frontier landscape, and bold Chinese calligraphy, suitable for literary or historical art prints.
items.content: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink-wash painting on aged rice paper, minimalist monochrome with soft warm parchment tones, showing a lone ancient swordsman standing on the edge of a steep dark cliff at the right side of the composition, seen mostly from behind in three-quarter back view. He wears flowing historical robes and a long wind-whipped cloak, with long dark hair tied in a topknot and loose strands streaming sideways in the wind, and he holds a straight sword lowered in his right hand. Below and to the left stretches a vast misty landscape with 1 distant walled frontier city, faint watchtowers and rooftops, a winding river or plain, and layered mountain silhouettes fading into haze. Use expressive black brushwork, splattered ink textures, dry-brush edges, atmospheric empty space, and a powerful contrast between the dense dark figure and cliff and the pale open background. Add 2 large vertical columns of bold black calligraphy on the left half, reading “愿将腰下剑” and “直为斩楼兰。”, plus 1 smaller vertical inscription to the far left reading “塞下曲六首 李白”, and include 2 small red seal stamps, one near the small inscription and one near the upper right corner. The mood is heroic, lonely, contemplative, and defiant, like a Tang-dynasty poet-warrior poster rendered as traditional sumi-e.

items.title: Chinese Ink Painting with Calligraphy
items.description: This prompt generates a classical Chinese literati-style ink painting with a large poetic inscription and a misty mountain landscape, suitable for cultural art prints or poetic editorial imagery.
items.content: A vertical traditional Chinese ink-wash painting on aged off-white rice paper, minimalist monochrome palette with soft gray washes and deep black brushwork. The composition combines large expressive Chinese calligraphy on the left and center with a misty shanshui landscape on the right. Write the quote in bold hand-brushed characters: “照人如照水，切玉如切泥。” arranged in 2 vertical columns, with 4 large characters in the left column and 4 large characters plus punctuation in the center-right column, each character painted with energetic dry-brush and wet-brush variation, visible tapering strokes, splashes, and ink texture. Add 2 red seal stamps: one small oval seal near the upper left beside the calligraphy, and one square seal near the lower left corner. On the right half, paint towering craggy cliffs with sparse pine trees, drifting fog, and 2 thin waterfalls descending into a calm river. In the lower right foreground, show 2 ancient Chinese scholars in flowing hanfu robes and topknots, seated across a flat stone table on river rocks, leaning over a board game or manuscript in quiet discussion; their forms should be small relative to the landscape. Include still water reflections, distant low islets, and layered atmospheric mist. Overall feeling: contemplative, literati painting, poetic solitude, elegant scholarly mood, Song-dynasty-inspired ink illustration with masterful calligraphy.

items.title: Old Shanghai Fusion Poster
items.description: A handcrafted 3D-style cultural poster celebrating Shanghai through miniature architecture, food, signage, and retro typography, ideal for travel, branding, or editorial design.
items.content: A vertical cultural travel poster on warm off-white textured paper, designed like a handcrafted 3D shadow-box collage that forms the silhouette of the Chinese character for Shanghai. Use a refined old-meets-new Shanghai theme with miniature architecture, street scenes, props, food, and typography, photographed straight-on with soft studio lighting and delicate drop shadows. The composition should feel elegant, editorial, nostalgic, and premium, with muted cream, brass gold, teal green, brick red, jade, and weathered wood tones. At the upper left, build the top section of the character from 1 modern glass skyscraper, 1 tall historic high-rise with a golden crown, 1 domed neoclassical waterfront building, 1 clock-tower civic building, 2 smaller background towers, 2 red vintage Shanghai trams, and 1 rickshaw. Beneath that, create a canal-town section with 2 tall red Oriental Pearl Tower spheres-and-columns motifs, 2 qipao dresses displayed vertically, 4 old shikumen and lane houses, 1 curved waterfront canal, 4 wooden boats on the water, and 2 gramophones placed at the far left and right edges. Across the center, place a large diagonal metallic-gold embossed title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"} in bold retro 3D lettering. To the right of the upper composition, add hand-lettered vintage script text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}. On the lower left, add serif text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}. The lower half should form the rest of the character using traditional Chinese architectural miniatures and market objects: 1 large classical Chinese roofed building complex, 4 vertical neon-style shop signs with Chinese characters, 2 square decorative plaques, 1 small green ceramic ewer, 2 shallow food trays, 1 rectangular tray of 6 soup dumplings, 1 long tray with 3 white tanghulu-like skewered sweets, 2 round mooncakes, and 1 small sauce dish, 1 rectangular display shelf containing 4 steamed buns, 1 bowl of noodles, 2 golden pastries, 1 plate of white flower-shaped sweets, 1 small doll figurine, and 2 painted opera masks, plus 2 hanging newspapers at the lower right. Keep the background spacious and minimal, with the collage and text arranged diagonally for a sophisticated poster layout. Make the whole image look like a meticulously assembled handmade paper-and-wood diorama, combining Art Deco Shanghai glamour, Republican-era nostalgia, Jiangnan water-town charm, and traditional Chinese market culture.

items.title: Beijing Cultural Heritage Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a premium city-culture exhibition poster featuring Beijing-themed architectural calligraphy and elegant editorial typography, ideal for tourism, museum, or heritage branding.
items.content: A refined vertical cultural exhibition poster on a warm ivory textured paper background, designed with abundant negative space and an elegant museum-catalog aesthetic. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

items.title: Astronaut on a Red Desert World
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic photorealistic sci-fi landscape of a solitary astronaut overlooking a vast Mars-like desert, ideal for storyboards, film keyframes, and space exploration visuals.
items.content: A cinematic wide shot of a lone astronaut standing on a rocky ledge and facing away from the camera, looking out across an immense red desert plain on a Mars-like planet. The astronaut is centered in the lower middle of the frame, wearing a realistic white EVA spacesuit with subtle gray panels, a life-support backpack, heavy boots, and dark gloves; the helmet is not visible from the front because the figure is seen from behind. The landscape is vast and barren, covered in rust-red dust, scattered stones, and low rock formations, with a rugged cliff edge on the left foreground, sparse rocky mounds across the middle distance, and hazy mountain ranges stretching along the far horizon. Use soft warm peach and terracotta tones, thin atmospheric haze, and gentle late-afternoon light that casts a long shadow behind the astronaut’s feet. The mood is solitary, awe-filled, and exploratory, like the opening frame of a sci-fi film about first contact with an alien world. Photorealistic, high detail, ultra-wide composition, natural cinematic color grading, epic scale, minimalism, no buildings, no vehicles, no text, no HUD, no other people.

items.content: A high-end surreal sports advertising poster in a 3:4 vertical composition featuring an athletic woman frozen mid-jump against a deep moody charcoal-to-violet gradient background. She is centered slightly to the right, with her body stretched dynamically as if sprinting through the air, left arm extended back, right arm bent forward, one leg kicked forward and the other trailing behind. She has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair in a messy bun with loose wisps, and wears an off-white oversized Nike crewneck sweatshirt, loose violet-gray marbled athletic pants, and clean white Nike sneakers with a subtle violet glow along the soles. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, creating an anonymous editorial fashion look. Behind and around her, dramatic electric violet smoke and energy clouds erupt and swirl, wrapping around her torso, legs, and feet, with luminous vapor trails and a storm-like aura that intensifies the motion. Place 1 white Nike swoosh logo in the top-left corner. Integrate 3 huge metallic silver 3D words across the lower middle of the poster reading {argument name="slogan text" default="JUST DO IT"}, split into the visible word blocks “JUST”, “DO”, and “IT”, partially overlapping the athlete’s body and cutting across the composition like bold campaign typography. The overall look is glossy, cinematic, premium, and energetic, with dramatic rim lighting, strong contrast, soft atmospheric haze, fashion-ad realism, and a viral AI-generated sports campaign aesthetic for {argument name="brand name" default="Nike"}.

items.title: Winter Deer Papercut Forest
items.description: This prompt generates a refined layered paper-cut illustration of four deer in a snowy winter forest, ideal for seasonal art prints, editorial illustration, or decorative wall art.
items.content: A highly detailed layered papercut diorama illustration of a deer family standing on a narrow forest path in deep winter. Show exactly 4 deer facing forward: 1 large stag with tall branching antlers positioned slightly right of center, 1 adult doe on the left, 1 smaller young deer in the middle foreground, and 1 young deer on the right. The scene is built entirely in intricate cut-paper craft style with stacked paper layers, crisp cut edges, sculpted contours, and soft dimensional shadows between layers. The animals are made from warm brown, chestnut, tan, and cream paper with delicately layered chest fur, white muzzles, alert ears, and small patches of snow resting on their heads, backs, and shoulders. Surround them with a dense winter forest of tall bare trees and fir trees, all rendered in layered paper silhouettes. Snow heavily coats the branches, bushes, rocks, and ground. Compose the trees as an enclosing corridor that frames the deer symmetrically, with the snowy path leading from the foreground into the group. Use a restrained cold palette for the environment: white, off-white, pale gray, slate gray, and charcoal, contrasted by the warm brown deer. Add subtle depth haze in the distant trees, clean studio-like lighting, and a calm storybook atmosphere. Ultra-detailed craftsmanship, elegant winter scene, realistic paper texture, refined 3D paper sculpture look, vertical composition.

items.title: Minimalist Literary Cover for The Vegetarian
items.description: This prompt generates a refined, surreal modern book cover with torn-paper collage, female profile, and botanical imagery, ideal for literary fiction and translated novel designs.
items.content: A minimalist literary book cover for {argument name="book title" default="素食者"}, designed in an elegant East Asian art-book style with muted dark forest green and warm off-white as the only main colors. The composition is vertical and highly refined, with a split layout: the left two-thirds are textured off-white paper, while the right third is a deep green field divided by a rough organic torn-paper edge running vertically from top to bottom. On the lower center-right, place a grayscale side-profile portrait of an East Asian woman facing right, her head slightly tilted upward, eyes closed or nearly closed, with black hair tied in a low bun. Her figure should feel quiet, fragile, and contemplative. The upper part of her head is visually replaced by a torn white paper shape that merges into the page, creating a surreal collage effect. From inside the opening around her head and neck, thin wild plant stems with tiny leaves and buds grow upward diagonally, as if vegetation is emerging from her body. Add subtle paper grain, print texture, and soft tonal fading for a poetic, fine-press look. Set the main Chinese title vertically in very large dark green serif-style characters on the far left: {argument name="title text" default="素食者"}. Near the upper middle-left, add vertically arranged author and translator credits in Chinese, small and elegant: "[韩] 韩江 著" and "胡椒筒｜译". In the upper right on the dark green area, add small Korean and English text in a delicate serif font: {argument name="korean title" default="채식주의자"}, "The Vegetarian", and {argument name="author name" default="Han Kang"}. On the mid-to-lower right, add a short vertical Chinese quote in small type: {argument name="quote" default="我的身体里 有一片荒芜的森林 它枯萎了 我不想吃的东西"}. At the bottom right, place the publisher and year in small Chinese text: "四川文艺出版社" and "2022". Include one small solid dark green dot on the left side below the title as a graphic accent. The overall mood is restrained, melancholic, intelligent, and literary, like an award-winning modern novel cover.

items.title: Minimalist Literary Cover for Educated
items.description: This prompt generates a sophisticated Chinese-market literary book cover with bold vertical typography, a blue mountain collage, and a bird motif, ideal for premium fiction and memoir cover design.
items.content: Design a literary Chinese book cover in a refined minimalist collage style on warm off-white textured paper with subtle grain and faint aging. The composition is tall and elegant, with one dominant central-right vertical Chinese title in large distressed black calligraphy-style characters reading “你当像鸟飞往你的山”, arranged in 2 vertical columns, with the right column reading “你当像鸟” and the left column reading “飞往你的山”. A delicate indigo-blue bird flies near the top center, and a thin winding blue dotted flight path snakes diagonally down across the title and toward the lower right, creating a sense of ascent and freedom. In the lower left, place a large triangular mountain form like a torn paper collage or painted wedge, its peak white and snowy, fading into deep ultramarine and navy textures below. Integrate a faint vertical strip of tiny English book text along the mountain’s right edge, as if the mountain is partially constructed from printed pages. Inside the blue mountain, set the original English title in serif type: “Educated” on one line and “A Memoir” below it, in white. On the upper left, add a short vertical block of small Chinese quote text in black, arranged as 6 lines, with a long dash below, then the author name “Tara Westover” in muted blue serif on 2 lines, followed by another dash. Along the lower right edge, add slim vertical credits in small type: Chinese text for the author followed by the English name “Tara Westover” in blue, then translator and publisher lines beneath in black. Keep the layout spacious with strong negative space, asymmetrical balance, and a poetic contemporary publishing aesthetic. Use only 3 main colors: black, off-white, and indigo blue. The overall feeling should be intellectual, restrained, modern, and award-winning, suitable for a premium edition of {argument name="book title" default="Educated"} by {argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"}.

items.title: Minimalist Literary Novel Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a sophisticated modern book cover for literary fiction, ideal for classic novels, translated works, and prestige publishing mockups.
items.content: A literary book cover in a refined minimalist editorial style, vertically oriented, with a muted palette of deep black, dark green, sepia, and warm cream. The composition is divided by large flowing curtain-like abstract shapes that create dramatic negative space and diagonal wedges of light. On the right side, show an elderly butler-like man seen from behind, standing upright in a formal black tailcoat or tuxedo jacket, white shirt cuffs visible, hands clasped behind his back, facing a tall softly glowing window with sheer curtains. His posture is reserved, dignified, and solitary. On the lower portion, within a triangular beam of light, place a dim still life on a table: exactly 3 objects, a wine glass, a teapot, and a plate, all partially obscured in shadow. The left side should carry elegant vertical Chinese title typography reading {argument name="title text" default="长日将尽"}, set large in pale gold serif-like characters. Beneath it, include smaller Chinese author and translator lines, and a short Chinese quote in small text. Near the lower left, add small English text reading {argument name="english title" default="The Remains of the Day"} and {argument name="author name" default="Kazuo Ishiguro"}, plus a small publisher line and the year {argument name="year" default="2024"}. The image should feel like an award-winning contemporary literary fiction cover: quiet, melancholic, restrained, cinematic, with paper grain texture, soft vignette, subtle painterly shading, and highly intentional asymmetrical layout. Keep the typography integrated into the design, with generous negative space and no bright colors.

items.title: Minimalist No Longer Human Cover
items.description: A moody minimalist literary book cover prompt for generating an elegant East Asian edition of a classic novel with collage textures and symbolic imagery.
items.content:
A minimalist literary book cover in a refined East Asian editorial style, portrait orientation, with a warm off-white paper background and subtle grainy print texture. The composition is vertically split into 2 large abstract fields: a rough torn gray paper shape occupying the upper left half, and a deep black painted block occupying the lower left corner. Emerging from the black area is 1 stark white theatrical mask shape with a single black eye slit, cropped large and angled upward, suggesting alienation and hidden identity. At the center-bottom where the gray and white fields meet, place 1 tiny solitary human figure in a long dark coat standing on a narrow triangular ledge, facing forward, emphasizing isolation and vulnerability. From near the top center, let 1 thin red thread descend vertically with a slight waviness, ending around the middle in 1 muted red circular seal-like disc, aligned above the figure. Set 1 large vertical title in bold expressive black Chinese calligraphy on the right-center: {argument name="title text" default="人间失格"}. Add 1 small vertical Japanese reading beside it: "にんげんしっかく". On the far right margin, add 1 vertical quote in fine black text: "—— 我的不幸，恰恰在于我缺乏拒绝的能力 ——". On the upper left, add 1 vertical author and translator credit in small black type: "【日】太宰治｜著　杨伟｜译". Below that, add 1 short two-line Chinese phrase in black: "生而为人
我很抱歉". On the lower right, add 1 small red vertical note: "太宰治
代表作". Beneath it add 1 small publication block in black with 3 lines: "人间失格", "太宰治", "だざい おさむ". On the lower left, add 1 publisher block in small black text: "上海译文出版社
2024" with a short horizontal line beneath. Use restrained negative space, asymmetrical balance, raw paper collage edges, sumi-ink and gouache textures, muted charcoal black gray and faded vermilion palette, elegant literary melancholy, premium contemporary Chinese novel cover design.

items.title: Icy Fantasy Anime Woman in Blossom Snow
items.description: This prompt generates a polished vertical anime-style fantasy character illustration, ideal for character art, wallpaper, or magic-themed concept imagery.
items.content: A highly detailed anime fantasy illustration of a tall elegant woman resembling an ice sorceress or qilin-inspired warrior, shown in a full-body three-quarter back view with her head turned slightly away, standing in a luminous snowy mountain landscape filled with soft pink cherry blossoms. She has {argument name="hair color" default="very light icy blue"} hair, extremely long, thick, and flowing in the wind with layered strands, soft bangs, curled tips, and a loose ahoge on top. Two dark curved horn-like ornaments with subtle red patterning rise from either side of her head. Her face is obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in a pale lavender-gray tone. She wears an ornate fantasy bodysuit and dress in black, white, periwinkle, and sapphire blue with gold filigree armor details: a black fitted chest piece, detached translucent bell sleeves with blue crystal-like feather cuffs, a backless white-and-blue upper garment, intricate gold waist armor with a glowing blue gemstone centerpiece, sheer black tights with gold geometric accents, layered translucent blue fabric panels, and exactly 3 visible red tassel ornaments hanging from the waist and side sashes. Her right arm is extended with an open gloved hand, levitating a glowing translucent blue water sphere containing swirling yin-yang-like currents. Around her are curling arcs of water and icy energy ribbons. The background is a dreamy ethereal alpine scene with 1 distant pagoda-like tower on the right, misty snow-covered peaks, frosted trees, sparkling atmosphere, drifting petals, and pastel blossom clusters framing the foreground and upper left corner. Use soft radiant backlighting, iridescent highlights, polished anime rendering, delicate gradients, crisp decorative costume detail, magical fantasy mood, cool blue and lavender palette with pink accents, vertical composition, no text, no extra characters.

items.description: This prompt generates a polished four-panel isometric science infographic with miniature 3D dioramas for biology, physics, chemistry, and astronomy, ideal for concept visualization or educational social posts.
items.content: A clean 2x2 conceptual entity model infographic on a soft light background, showing four separate floating isometric diorama tiles that personify branches of {argument name="theme" default="science"} in a polished 3D illustration style with pastel gradients, glossy materials, soft ambient lighting, subtle shadows, rounded futuristic forms, and high detail. Top left: BIOLOGY, a lush bio-lab island with a large central DNA double helix tower, curved glass greenhouse architecture, spiral stairways, layered organic pathways, greenery, plant beds, and fluid biomorphic structures; the word "BIOLOGY" is integrated on the front edge of the platform. Surrounding this tile are 4 small biology-related icons: a microscope, a DNA symbol, a sprouting plant, and a circular cell or petri-dish symbol. Top right: PHYSICS, a high-tech energy laboratory tile in cool blue tones with a central glowing platform, circular accelerator rings, copper-like electromagnetic coils, stairs leading up to the core, a monitor screen with waveform graphics, and a futuristic industrial base labeled "PHYSICS"; add 4 surrounding physics-themed icons: an atom, a horseshoe magnet, a lightning bolt, and a line graph waveform. Bottom left: CHEMISTRY, a modular molecular research structure in purple and silver, built from spheres-and-rods lattice frameworks, lab columns, beakers, flasks, and a glowing crystalline core; the platform prominently reads "CHEMISTRY" on two visible sides. Surrounding this tile are 4 chemistry-related icons: two molecular diagrams, a pair of lab test tubes or flasks, and a small burner. Bottom right: ASTRONOMY, a rocky lunar observatory island with cratered terrain, a dome observatory, a telescope, stairs carved into the rock, and a circular cosmic starfield backdrop behind it; the front edge reads "ASTRONOMY". Surrounding this tile are 4 astronomy-themed icons: a ringed planet, spark-like stars, a small rocket, and a crescent moon. Keep all 4 tiles evenly spaced in a quadrant layout, each with its own muted geometric backdrop shape, cohesive pastel palette tuned per discipline, and a premium gpt-image-2 style that makes each concept feel like a collectible miniature world. No people, no extra text beyond the four discipline labels.

items.title: Luxury Emerald Fruit Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dark, premium editorial advertisement poster featuring dewy green tomatoes and blueberries with elegant typography, ideal for luxury food branding or high-end seasonal campaign visuals.
items.content: A luxurious editorial-style fruit advertisement poster on a dark moody background, featuring a close-up arrangement of fresh green cherry tomatoes and deep indigo blueberries covered in sparkling water droplets, resting on glossy wet green leaves. Use dramatic low-key lighting with rich shadows, golden highlights, and a premium cinematic macro-photography look. The composition should feel lush, expensive, and sensorial, with the fruit clustered densely across the lower two-thirds of the image and softly fading into darkness around the edges. Add elegant high-fashion serif typography in warm champagne-gold across the poster, with the giant central headline {argument name="headline text" default="EMERALD BLOOM"} dominating the upper half. Add 1 vertical rounded capsule element on the right side containing a soft olive-green gradient, like a minimalist product swatch or bottle silhouette. Keep the overall design polished, upscale, fashion-magazine-inspired, and reminiscent of a premium seasonal jewelry or fragrance campaign, but centered on fruit as the hero subject.

items.title: Raiden Shogun Beach Cosplay Cover
items.description: This generates a realistic fashion magazine cover featuring a Raiden Shogun-inspired beach cosplay portrait, ideal for editorial mockups and cosplay-themed cover art.
items.content: Create a high-fashion magazine cover photo of a glamorous beach cosplay portrait inspired by Raiden Shogun from Genshin Impact. A single adult woman sits on a large dark seaside rock in a three-quarter front pose, one hand resting behind her on the rock and the other relaxed near her side, with one thigh raised prominently toward the camera. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor centered over the face. She has very long, rich violet-purple hair with magenta highlights, styled with a thick braid draped over one shoulder and loose windswept strands flowing to the right, decorated with blue flower hair ornaments and gold accessories near one side of the head. She wears an elegant lavender, lilac, and deep purple Raiden Shogun-style cosplay outfit: a low-cut kimono-inspired bodice, translucent flowing sleeves, layered sash and obi with ornate circular gold-and-purple emblem at the waist, a jeweled choker with a purple gem, dangling blue-and-gold earrings, a black armored-looking forearm piece, and sheer purple thigh-high stockings with garter straps and decorative patterns. The lighting is natural golden beach daylight with soft highlights on skin and fabric, shallow depth of field, and a luxurious editorial look. The background is a softly blurred shoreline with pale sand, shimmering water, sea mist, and a distant rocky island or cliff. Compose it as a full magazine cover with elegant fashion typography in dark royal purple. The masthead is huge across the top reading {argument name="magazine title" default="COSPLAY"}, with small top-left text "COSPLAY REALM MAGAZINE" and small top-right text "JANUARY 2024". Add left-side cover lines: "RAIDEN SHOGUN", "COSPLAY BY SAKURA", "BEHIND THE SCENES AT THE BEACH", and "EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW" followed by smaller text "Sakura talks about her love for Genshin Impact". Add right-side cover lines: "GENSHIN IMPACT" with smaller text "SPECIAL EDITION", and at lower right "TOP COSER OF 2024" with smaller text "Sakura’s rise to stardom". Place a realistic barcode with small pricing text in the bottom-left corner. Overall style: ultra-realistic cosplay photography, glossy magazine cover design, cinematic, sensual but tasteful, premium fashion editorial, high detail fabrics and accessories, sharp subject with softly blurred ocean background.

items.title: Anime Museum Poster with Kannon Statue
items.description: This prompt generates a fictional Japanese-style museum exhibition poster combining anime characters, a grand Thousand-Armed Kannon statue, and fully integrated promotional typography for editorial or advertising use.

author.name: 新清士@AIコンテンツ開発者

items.content: A polished Japanese museum exhibition poster in a contemporary anime illustration style, vertical layout, warm ivory and gold color palette with pastel confetti accents, designed like a high-end promotional ad for a spring holiday event. The composition features 4 school-age to young adult female characters in the foreground and one monumental Buddhist statue in the background. At center back is a towering gilded Thousand-Armed Kannon statue with a radiant halo, intricate carved details, many arms fanning outward symmetrically, and hands pressed together in prayer at the chest, glowing with sacred golden light. In the foreground on the right is the largest figure, a friendly young woman guide or older student reaching one hand dramatically toward the viewer in forced perspective; she has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length hair, a blue striped blouse, a cream sweater draped over her shoulders, and a light skirt, with a warm inviting expression. Across the lower middle are 3 younger schoolgirls in matching uniforms: short-sleeve pale blue shirts with navy ribbon ties and dark blue skirts. The left girl points upward excitedly with one arm raised and wears a small shoulder bag; the center girl holds an exhibition booklet upright; the right girl drinks from a clear water bottle while looking toward the scene. Give all 4 girls lively anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shading, and energetic museum-outing body language. Fill the poster with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphic shapes. Place a large bold main headline on the left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}, with oversized gold and black calligraphy-style characters and one red-highlighted character. Above it, add smaller text: "千手観音、祈りの宇宙". Add a red circular callout near the top left that says "はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!" and a white cloud-shaped speech bubble near the top right that says "いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!". Add a gold ribbon banner under the main headline reading "アスキー美術館 GW開催". Include a pale blue circular information box on the left with 5 lines of Japanese copy describing the statue: "国宝 千手観音立像", "千の手が、千年の祈りを", "伝える", "圧巻のスケールを、", "その目で感じてみて。". In the lower left, place a dark rectangular exhibition plaque with gold trim and 5 text lines: "アスキー美術館 GW特別展", the large title "国宝展", then "千手観音、祈りの宇宙", then the date line {argument name="event dates" default="2026.4.26 SAT - 6.15 SUN"}. Along the bottom center, add the museum name in large text: {argument name="museum name" default="アスキー美術館"}, followed by a smaller address line and nearest-station access text in Japanese. Add a red-and-black slogan along the bottom right: "心に残る体験が、きっとここに。". In the lower right, include 3 circular benefit icons with captions: one peach circle with a ticket icon and text "学生はお得! 学生証提示で当日券200円OFF!", one blue circle with a camera icon and text "撮影OK! 一部の作品は写真撮影OK!", and one gold circle with a gift icon and text "来場者プレゼント! オリジナルしおりをプレゼント!". Scatter subtle sparkles, halftone dots, abstract blobs, and confetti shapes around the page. Overall mood: inviting, educational, elegant, and exciting, combining sacred cultural grandeur with cheerful youthful discovery, like a fictional premium museum advertisement generated as a complete poster with integrated typography.

items.description: This generates a dramatic black-and-white manga double-page showing a high school band rehearsal and a boy becoming captivated by a girl's guitar performance, ideal for AI manga scenes or comic storytelling.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAI漫画イラストレーター

items.content: A two-page black-and-white manga spread set in a nighttime high school band rehearsal studio, drawn in polished modern shonen/seinen manga style with detailed screentones, dramatic lighting, expressive speed lines, and glossy instrument rendering. The scene shows 4 visible band members in school uniforms: a surprised teenage boy with messy short hair at guitar and vocal mic, a calm beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing light hair playing electric guitar in the foreground, a petite long-haired teenage girl at a keyboard, and a drummer in the back whose face is intentionally obscured by a soft blur. The studio has large windows revealing a city skyline at night, hanging ceiling lights, amps including a visible Marshall stack, a drum kit with a band logo on the bass drum, cables, and a wall sign reading “Beat Box.” Compose it as a printed manga spread with 7 panels total across 2 pages, including gutters, page borders, and page numbers 13 and 14 at the bottom. Left page: 3 panels — top panel with the shocked boy turning toward the girls and a large Japanese speech bubble saying “え!?”; middle panel is a close-up of the long-haired guitarist girl with a calm expression and a Japanese speech bubble saying “……別にいいよ”; bottom panel is a wider full-band rehearsal shot with all 4 members in the studio. Right page: 4 panels — top panel is an explosive performance shot with the boy singing and playing while the long-haired girl plays guitar, with large sound-effect text “ジャッ”; middle panel is a dynamic close-up of the long-haired guitarist playing intensely, with flowing hair, musical note symbols, radiant speed lines, and the keyboard girl visible in the back; bottom panel is a close-up of the boy’s stunned face with soft bokeh and a vertical Japanese speech bubble saying “……あれ”. Emphasize the emotional contrast: awkward surprise turning into admiration as the girl’s guitar performance changes the mood. Use monochrome only, no color, authentic manga lettering, cinematic framing, layered depth, and highly detailed hair and instrument strings.

items.title: Japanese Summer Sports Drink Poster
items.description: A realistic Japanese-style beverage advertising poster featuring a schoolgirl in a sailor uniform against a bright coastal sky, ideal for wallpaper or mock campaign visuals.
items.content:
A photorealistic Japanese summer beverage advertisement poster in a tall vertical layout, designed like an official sports drink campaign. Show a full-body teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors on a sunny hilltop road overlooking a coastal town and the ocean under a vivid blue sky with large white clouds. She is centered slightly left, posed confidently with one leg relaxed, looking off into the distance, holding a clear plastic bottle of {argument name="drink brand" default="POCARI SWEAT"} in her right hand near shoulder height. She wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: 1 white short-sleeve sailor blouse, 1 navy sailor collar with white stripes, 1 large navy neckerchief bow, 1 navy pleated skirt to the knees, 2 white knee-high socks, and 2 dark navy or black loafers. Her hair is long, straight, and black with a glossy sheen. Bright midday lighting, crisp shadows, fresh clean atmosphere, high realism, commercial poster finish.

Use a strong brand-forward composition. In the top left, place a large bold white logo reading "ION SUPPLY DRINK" above oversized {argument name="main logo text" default="POCARI SWEAT"} with a white wave shape beneath it. In the top right, add a small white corporate mark and the text {argument name="company name" default="Otsuka"}. On the right side, set a vertical Japanese headline in dark blue reading {argument name="headline text" default="渇いたからだに、水よりうれしい。"}. In the lower left, add a Japanese body copy block in blue, including a larger subheading and several smaller lines of explanatory text, styled like authentic ad copy. Near that text, include 1 white circular information badge with blue Japanese text and 2 small inner circles labeled "水分" and "イオン" joined by a plus sign. At the very bottom left, add small blue recycling-related fine print and iconography; at the bottom right, add the website URL {argument name="website" default="www.pocarisweat.jp"}. Make the overall design feel like a believable premium Japanese poster for a refreshing ion supply drink, suitable as a desktop wallpaper.

items.title: Manga Stand User Profile Page
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic manga-style character dossier page featuring a sporty female stand user, her liquid-themed stand, stat chart, and Japanese profile text for anime and comic concept art.
items.content: A manga-style character profile page in the dramatic visual language of a supernatural battle comic, printed on a slightly aged beige paper background with black ink outlines, dense hatching, and high-contrast cel shading. The composition features 3 main sections: a left information panel, a central full-body female character portrait, and a right-side humanoid stand figure with vertical Japanese dialogue text. In the center, depict a tall, athletic young Japanese woman, about {argument name="character age" default="22"} years old, with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, tan healthy skin, and a muscular sporty physique. Her face is completely obscured by a large rectangular mosaic censor blur. She wears 3 visible outfit pieces: a tight white sweat-soaked tank top, very short dark navy athletic shorts with a drawstring, and no visible accessories. Her skin and clothes glisten with sweat, emphasizing a humid, sensual, intense training vibe. She stands in a confident forward-facing pose with one arm lowered toward the viewer, creating a slightly foreshortened perspective. Behind and to her right, show a sleek humanoid stand entity made of glossy pale lavender liquid with splashing droplets around its head and shoulders, narrow eyes, smooth organic armor-like anatomy, and 3 round purple orb details down the chest and abdomen. Add 2 large stylized purple Japanese sound effects in a hand-drawn manga font: one near the top reading "ゴゴゴ…" and one near the lower body reading "ゴゴゴゴ……". On the far right, place a vertical Japanese exclamation in black text: "オラオララッ！汗の一滴まで見逃されェ！". The left panel is a boxed black-on-beige character dossier with multiple horizontal dividers and Japanese text. Include these profile fields exactly as visible: "スタンド使い名:" followed by "{argument name="character name" default="水沢 咲良"}（ミズサワ サクラ）", "性別:" followed by "女", "見た目:" followed by "黒髪ロング、健康的な体つき スポーティな服装が多い", "年齢:" followed by "22歳", "身長:" followed by "160cm", and "職業:" followed by "フリーター ジムトレーナー". Below that, include a boxed radar chart titled "スタンド能力パラメーター" with 6 labeled stats around the graph: "破壊力 B", "スピード A", "射程距離 C", "成長性 B", "精密動作性 A", and durability at the remaining axis, with a purple filled polygon. At the bottom left, include another boxed text section with the stand name and ability description. The stand section should read: "スタンド名:" then "『{argument name="stand name" default="SWEAT BLOOM"}』" and below it "（スウェット・ブルーム）". Under "スタンドの能力:" include a dense Japanese paragraph describing a close-range stand activated by sweat and bodily fluids, able to manipulate surrounding moisture and alter the pressure and viscosity of liquids, dull an opponent's movement through sweat, make surfaces slippery to disrupt balance, and launch sweat like bullets at high speed. Overall style: gritty serialized manga splash page, dynamic sensual action-character design, JoJo-inspired exaggeration, clean page layout, detailed anatomy, purple accent color for stand effects and chart fill, no modern UI elements, full-page illustration.

items.title: Cyberpunk Rainy Street Robot Repair
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic photorealistic cyberpunk scene of a rain-soaked street mechanic repairing a quadruped robot, ideal for sci-fi concept art and atmospheric city visuals.
items.content: A cinematic cyberpunk street scene at night in heavy rain, ultra-detailed and photorealistic. In the foreground, a young East Asian woman mechanic with messy dark hair tied in a loose bun sits at a wet metal worktable, leaning forward with intense concentration as she repairs a small spherical quadruped robot. Her face is obscured by a centered square censor blur. She wears a transparent plastic rain poncho over dark clothing, the glossy folds catching neon reflections. In one hand she holds a precision screwdriver and with the other she adjusts exposed wiring and circuitry inside the robot’s open shell. The robot is compact and worn, about the size of a small dog, with a white and gray rounded body, a blue camera-like lens for one eye, visible internal electronics, scratches, grime, and four articulated mechanical legs planted on the table. Scatter the tabletop with exact repair clutter: 2 screwdrivers, 2 batteries, 1 circuit board, 1 small camera or lens module, loose screws, wires, and a half-filled glass of amber liquid. Surround them with a dense neon-lit East Asian alley market full of rain-slick pavement, steam from food stalls, and pedestrians carrying umbrellas. Include at least 8 visible illuminated signs layered into the background, including a large red sign reading {argument name="main neon sign" default="修理"}, an orange sign reading "OPEN", a bright sign reading "24H", a vertical sign reading "ホテル", and additional mixed Chinese, Japanese, and Korean-style shop signs. Show several background figures in dark rainwear and translucent ponchos, some faces softly blurred by depth of field. Use moody blue-and-orange lighting, glossy reflections, mist, volumetric rain, shallow depth of field, dramatic bokeh, anamorphic highlights, high texture detail, gritty realism, and the feeling of a lone street technician fixing advanced hardware in a bustling futuristic city.

items.title: Papercut Wat Arun at Sunset
items.description: This prompt generates a richly layered paper-cut style illustration of Wat Arun at dusk, ideal for decorative travel art, posters, or stylized cultural landscape imagery.
items.content: A highly detailed layered papercut artwork of {argument name="scene" default="Wat Arun in Bangkok, Thailand at dusk"}, viewed from across the river in a centered, symmetrical composition. The image should look like handcrafted 3D paper sculpture and kirigami, with stacked cut-paper layers, visible paper edges, soft relief depth, delicate shadows between layers, and crisp ornamental architectural detail. Place the grand central prang of the temple rising dramatically in the middle, surrounded by 4 smaller prangs, dense dark green-black tree masses at the base, a riverside promenade with small pavilions, and multiple Thai flags lining the waterfront. In the foreground, show the Chao Phraya River as stylized rolling paper waves in deep navy and charcoal, with 1 long traditional river boat crossing from left to right near the bottom center. The sky is filled with many horizontally stretched layered clouds cut from paper, framing a low setting sun partially hidden behind the temple on the right side of center. Use a warm sunset palette of {argument name="color palette" default="golden yellow, amber, burnt orange, peach, terracotta, coral, and deep blue-black"}. Keep the style elegant, intricate, cinematic, and richly textured, with a handcrafted paper diorama feel, high contrast between glowing sky and dark foreground, and an overall refined Asian decorative art aesthetic.

items.title: Dark Creative Overload at Night
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic surreal scene of an exhausted creator at a desk while a storm of beautiful, dark imagination erupts from their computer, ideal for illustrating creative overwhelm or AI-inspired obsession.
items.content: A moody cinematic digital illustration of a tired young creator sitting alone at a cluttered desk in a dark room at night, seen in three-quarter side view, leaning forward with one elbow on the desk and one hand covering part of the face in an exhausted, overwhelmed pose. The face is intentionally obscured in shadow. The person wears dark casual clothes and a lanyard badge, suggesting a student, designer, or medical worker. The room feels realistic and slightly messy, with a desk lamp, papers, sketchbooks, mugs, stationery, and stacked books. On the left wall, include 2 illuminated X-ray films and a round wall clock, plus shelves and pinned notes in deep shadow. In front of the person is a glowing widescreen monitor showing an AI image generation or creative editing interface with a city-at-sunset artwork in the main preview and a row of thumbnail variations beneath it, modern dark UI, one purple action button. The monitor is the main light source, casting warm orange and cool blue highlights across the desk. Around the monitor and pouring out into the air, depict a vast surreal explosion of imagination and digital creativity: a swirling galaxy-like vortex with stars, nebula colors, spark particles, light trails, and cosmic dust in purple, blue, pink, and gold. Embed many floating dreamlike elements inside the swirl: a fantasy castle on a floating island with a tree, planets and moons, an astronaut, a film clapperboard, a video camera, musical notes, glowing silhouettes of people, a futuristic city skyline, a hot-air balloon, a car, birds, jellyfish-like luminous creatures, and multiple cats, including 1 giant sleeping orange tabby cat in the upper right and 1 cat in a space helmet near the lower right. The magical imagery should feel like thoughts escaping from the computer, beautiful but slightly dark and overwhelming, as if creativity, obsession, and emotional intensity are filling the room. Include a skeletal anatomy hand model standing beside the monitor on the right side of the desk, reinforcing an art-studio or study setting. Use dramatic low-key lighting, high contrast, intricate detail, volumetric glow, cinematic depth, and a balance of realism and fantastical surrealism. The overall mood is melancholic, imaginative, and darkly inspiring, visualizing the feeling of being consumed by ideas generated through {argument name="creative tool" default="AI image generation"}.

items.title: Xinjiang Road Trip Scrapbook Spread
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic overhead photo of a handmade Xinjiang travel journal spread, useful for scrapbook-style travel memories, editorial visuals, or lifestyle social posts.
items.content: A warm, handcrafted travel scrapbook spread photographed from directly above on a wooden tabletop, showing an open two-page journal with thick deckled paper edges and layered fabric tabs peeking out from the sides. The style is a realistic mixed-media travel diary with watercolor map art, handwritten Chinese titles, taped instant photos, doodles, and soft natural light. On the upper left page, write the date "2024.09.20." in small handwriting and a large black brush-style Chinese title reading {argument name="title text" default="新疆公路旅行手帐"}. Arrange 5 Polaroid-style instant photos across the spread, each slightly tilted and attached with beige or patterned washi tape: 1 photo at upper left showing two travelers by a blue alpine lake labeled "天山天池"; 1 tall photo near upper center-left showing three people on a green grassland labeled "那拉提草原"; 1 photo at lower left showing a couple by a deep blue lake labeled "赛里木湖"; 1 photo at upper center-right showing two travelers on a long empty road under a bright blue sky labeled "沙漠公路"; 1 photo at lower center showing two figures standing on dunes at sunset labeled "日落沙丘". Add small handwritten bilingual place annotations near the left-page photos: "天山天池 (Tianshan Tianchi)", "赛拉木草原 (Sayram Lake)", "沙漠公路 (Desert Highway)", and "日落沙丘 (Sunset Dunes)" in a casual notebook style. On the right page, paint a loose watercolor map of Xinjiang in beige, pale green, and blue, with a bold winding blue road route crossing the region and exactly 10 red location pins placed along the route. Include map doodles: a small mountain icon cluster near the top, a river and several blue lakes, a tiny compass in the upper right, 2 camel drawings, 2 yurt drawings, and thin gray roads branching around the main blue route. Along the bottom of the right page, place 3 more taped Polaroid photos: 1 at lower left showing people in colorful ethnic clothing labeled "大巴扎"; 1 at lower middle showing hands holding grilled meat skewers labeled "烤肉串"; 1 at lower right showing a couple inside a yurt labeled "蒙古包自拍". Scatter small hand-drawn doodles throughout both pages, including a sun, a tiny car, 2 horse drawings, 4 fish icons, a crescent moon, several stars, small arrows, flames near the food photo and along the lower map area, and tiny decorative swirls. Keep all text in Chinese where shown, with a lively hand-journal aesthetic, realistic paper texture, slight shadows under every photo, and an overall cozy memory-book feeling of a Xinjiang road trip.

items.title: Fake Couple Photo Dump Collage
items.description: This prompt turns a single personal reference photo into a believable 16-image smartphone collage of candid couple memories, useful for 'what if' lifestyle edits and fake relationship photo dumps.
items.content: Using the provided reference image as the base for the man, transform it into a realistic casual smartphone photo collage showing him as if he has a girlfriend. Keep his identity, hairstyle, age, white sweatshirt, and candid non-model look consistent, but place him together with a young woman across 16 square snapshots arranged in a 4x4 grid with thin white borders. Add exactly 1 recurring female companion with long dark hair, styled like a real person rather than a glam model, and vary her outfits subtly across the collage, including a cream knit cardigan, a dark top, and a muted blue top. Mix indoor home scenes, nighttime city scenes, one daytime outdoor scene, and one restaurant setting. Use imperfect framing, slight blur, flash, grain, and spontaneous candid composition so it feels like a real person's saved couple photo dump, not a polished campaign.

items.title: Ancient Chinese RPG Brothel Street UI
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic MMORPG-style gameplay screenshot of a lantern-lit ancient Chinese pleasure house street with full Chinese game interface, suitable for mock game demos and cinematic fantasy worldbuilding.
items.content: A cinematic third-person in-game screenshot from a realistic ancient Chinese open-world RPG set at night in a luxurious pleasure district. The camera is positioned behind a tall male protagonist with long black hair tied half-up, wearing a dark embroidered hanfu-style robe, standing in the middle of a wet stone street and facing the entrance of an ornate brothel pavilion. The central building is richly detailed with carved wooden columns, glowing red lanterns, gold calligraphy plaques, and warm amber interior lighting spilling onto the street. A large horizontal signboard above the entrance reads “春院”. On the two front columns are vertical calligraphy couplets. Around the doorway and street are exactly 16 visible NPCs: 1 player character in the foreground seen from behind, 7 courtesans in flowing translucent silk hanfu dresses posed near the entrance and seated on stools, 6 pedestrians and guests scattered on the right side street and bridge area, and 2 seated figures inside the entrance area. The women wear elegant Tang/Song-inspired gowns in pale peach, pink, ivory, mint, and light gold, with exposed shoulders, layered gauze, elaborate updos, and hair ornaments; the men wear darker long robes. The ground is glossy from recent rain, reflecting lantern light. In the background on the right is a canal-town night scene with a stone bridge, multi-story traditional buildings, more lanterns, and dense atmospheric depth. The image should feel like a high-budget game demo, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, dramatic, moody, and sensual but not explicit. Overlay a full Chinese MMORPG HUD interface: top left circular player portrait with level 35, red and blue health and mana bars, small status icons; left side quest tracker with exactly 4 quest lines in Chinese; bottom left chat box with multiple Chinese messages and channel tabs; top right a circular minimap with the location text “清河县·怡春院 (1123, 885)” and exactly 8 small menu icons around it; bottom center a thin experience bar; bottom right an action bar with exactly 8 circular skill buttons, including green martial-arts skills, golden highlighted abilities, and a larger movement/jump button. Use {argument name="game screenshot style" default="ultra-realistic cinematic MMORPG UI"}, {argument name="setting" default="ancient Chinese red-light district at night"}, {argument name="main building sign" default="春院"}, {argument name="player outfit color" default="dark charcoal black"}, and {argument name="lighting mood" default="warm lantern glow with cool night shadows"}.

items.title: Anime Folding Bike Event Poster
items.description: A colorful Japanese-style anime poster advertising a folding bicycle cycling event, ideal for recreating eye-catching promotional key visuals.
items.content:
A bright, cheerful anime-style promotional poster for a folding bike cycling event, designed like a polished Japanese advertisement with dense typography, stickers, callouts, and event info panels. The scene shows a sunny riverside promenade under a vivid blue sky with fluffy clouds, green tree branches framing the top right, flower beds, bunting, drifting petals, and a distant modern city skyline across the water. In the foreground, a cute teen/young adult anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="light chestnut brown"} shoulder-length wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and two colorful hairpins smiles directly at the viewer and winks with one eye. She is posed in dynamic perspective, reaching one hand toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to join her. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker, a white T-shirt printed with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black thigh-high stockings, and a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint-green compact folding bicycle labeled "FOLDY," shown unfolded and parked on the promenade with visible small wheels, frame hinge, handlebars, saddle, pedals, and kickstand, emphasizing portability and urban leisure cycling. Use a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic with clean linework, soft facial rendering, energetic lighting, and playful graphic decoration.

Fill the poster with Japanese ad-style layout elements. At the top left, a huge multicolored headline reads "Let’s FOLDING RIDE!" in oversized playful bubble and block lettering, with a smaller curved Japanese line above it reading "さあ、いっしょに出かけよう！" and a blue ribbon-like subtitle below reading "フォールディングバイクで、もっと自由に、もっと遠くへ！". At the upper right, place a yellow burst badge with a tiny flag icon containing the text "フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！". Add a white speech bubble near the girl’s face with pink outline and handwritten-feel Japanese text: "ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！". Near the bicycle, include a small angled sticker with text "コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪". Near the lower center-left, add a section label "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" followed by exactly 4 round icon features in pastel circles: 1) a pink bicycle icon with text "折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！" 2) a blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！" 3) a yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪" 4) a purple gift icon with text "オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！".

On the lower right, add a rounded white information card with green accents titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント" and large pink date text "6.15(日)". Inside the card, present exactly 4 event detail rows with colored circular icons: 1) calendar row: "開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延" 2) location row: "集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク" with smaller note "(神奈川県横浜市)" 3) course row: "コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります" with smaller note "(約20km、初心者安心！)" 4) fee row: "参加費 3,000円" with smaller note "(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）". At the bottom of this card, add a pink strip reading "初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！". Along the very bottom of the poster, create a wide pink banner with large Japanese copy "さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！" and smaller text on the left "お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！". In the center-bottom place a search-bar style box containing {argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"}. To its right, add a black-and-white QR code and a pink label reading "エントリーはこちらから！". In the bottom-right corner, include a small inset photo-style illustration of two cyclists riding together with a handwritten note "たのしいかも♡". Maintain a lively, magazine-quality event poster composition with exactly 1 main character, 1 folding bike, 1 large event info card, 1 speech bubble, 1 yellow burst badge, 1 angled portability sticker, 4 feature icons, 1 QR code, and 1 inset image.

items.title: Melancholy Night Street Manga Spread
items.description: This prompt generates a grayscale two-page manga spread of a schoolboy walking alone at night, ideal for dramatic emotional storytelling or AI manga scenes.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAI漫画イラストレーター

items.content: A black-and-white manga two-page spread with a cinematic, melancholic tone, drawn in highly detailed seinen style with realistic lighting, wet pavement reflections, dense overhead power lines, and a star-filled night sky over a quiet Japanese residential street. The composition is divided into 4 panels total across the spread. On the left page, the top panel is a wide establishing shot of an empty suburban street at night, lined with low houses, walls, utility poles, glowing streetlights, and a slightly reflective road stretching into the distance. The bottom panel on the left page shows 1 teenage boy from behind, walking alone down the same street, wearing a dark school blazer, white shirt, loosened striped necktie, slim trousers, and carrying 1 shoulder bag slung across his back; his posture is tired and conflicted. Include 1 vertical oval Japanese speech balloon in this panel with the text 「やっぱり俺には」. On the right page, the top panel is a close-up of the boy’s hand gripping the front of his blazer or shirt near the chest in a tense gesture, with 1 hand-drawn sound effect in Japanese reading 「ギュッ…」. The bottom panel on the right page is a chest-up frontal portrait of the same boy outdoors at night, messy short light-colored hair, school uniform slightly disheveled, emotional expression, shoulder bag strap visible, background filled with soft glowing night bokeh and stars. Place 1 vertical oval Japanese speech balloon beside him reading 「でも…悔しい」. Obscure the center of his face with a flat square gray censor block. At the bottom of the right page, add 1 rectangular narration box containing the Japanese text 「才能に出会ってしまったー」. Show printed manga page layout with white gutters, page numbers 17 and 18 centered at the bottoms of the left and right pages, and a clean book-spread presentation. Keep everything grayscale, dramatic, introspective, and polished like a published manga volume.

items.title: Monochrome Manga Guitar Studio Page
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed black-and-white manga page of a high school girl playing electric guitar in a night studio, ideal for dramatic AI manga storytelling scenes.

author.name: ユメ・アスタAI漫画イラストレーター

items.content: A black-and-white manga page spread with 5 panels on a clean white background and thin black gutters, drawn in highly detailed modern seinen/shoujo hybrid line art with soft screentones, reflective highlights, and a quiet melancholic mood. The setting is a nighttime music studio classroom with large windows showing a city skyline full of lit buildings against a dark sky. Main subject: a slender high school girl with very long straight light hair and blunt bangs, delicate features, and a serious introspective expression, wearing a Japanese school uniform consisting of a white button-up shirt, loosened striped ribbon tie, and plaid skirt, seated and playing a solid-body electric guitar that resembles a Stratocaster. In the large upper-left panel, show her in three-quarter view holding the guitar across her lap, left hand on the fretboard and right hand near the pickups, surrounded by studio equipment including 1 drum kit in the back left, 2 stacked guitar amplifiers on the right, and a wall sign reading "Beat Box" near the door. In the narrow upper-right panel, show a close-up of the guitar neck and her fretting hand, with the small vertical Japanese sound effect text "トン…". In the tall middle-right panel, show a close side-profile close-up of the girl looking down at the instrument with a pensive, almost disappointed expression, with the night city lights blurred through the window behind her. In the lower-left panel, show 1 teenage boy in a school blazer and loosened tie, seated indoors and turned slightly to the side; his face is obscured by a large soft gray rectangular censor block, and beside him is 1 vertical speech balloon containing the Japanese text "……やっぱり違う". In the lower-right panel, show a closer view of the same boy from the chest up against a soft bokeh screentone background; his face is again obscured by a large gray censor block. Add printed page numbers centered at the bottom margins: "5" under the left page and "6" under the right page. Emphasize a subtle narrative theme of realizing that the sound feels wrong, as if this is a continuation page from a dramatic school-band manga. Keep everything monochrome, polished, cinematic, and emotionally restrained.

items.title: Japanese Elephant Day Magazine Feature
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese editorial-style magazine page about Elephant Day, ideal for seasonal feature graphics, lifestyle spreads, or educational zoo-themed art.
items.content: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page in a warm botanical watercolor style, formatted as a full-page A4 portrait layout with a cream paper background, thin beige border, muted sage-green accents, and a refined nature-themed design. The page is a single cohesive magazine spread design with 6 distinct content sections: 1 large main illustration panel on the left, 1 tall title-and-article column on the upper right, 3 stacked informational point boxes on the mid-to-lower right, 2 small photo-card style image panels along the lower left, 1 circular quote badge near the lower left of the main panel, and 1 summary box at the lower right. The theme is elephant appreciation day in Japan. At the top left, place small editorial header text reading "LIFESTYLE / FEATURE / TOPIC" with a short Japanese subtitle beneath it. Across the upper right, add the large date heading "4.28 EVENT" and the main Japanese headline "象の日特集" in an elegant serif style, with a short subheading line beneath it and a tiny elephant icon. Below that, set 3 short Japanese body paragraphs in a clean magazine column, explaining elephant day. The main illustration panel shows a gentle elephant standing on the left, rendered in delicate watercolor with realistic wrinkles, large ears, soft ivory-gray skin, and a lowered trunk reaching toward a small child standing beside it. The child is an androgynous anime-style boy with messy wavy dark purple-black hair, pale skin, large eyes, a black graphic T-shirt with a purple emblem, loose brown knee-length cargo shorts, and bare feet, standing casually with one hand in a pocket while touching the elephant’s trunk with the other. Behind them is a sunny zoo walkway with a wooden fence, soft green trees, dappled light, and leafy branches hanging from above. Near the elephant, include a small wooden sign reading "Elephant 4.28". Add a circular text badge in Japanese near the lower left of the main image. On the lower left area, place exactly 2 small bordered snapshot-style panels with taped-corner scrapbook presentation: the first labeled "Feeding Time" showing the child in side profile offering leaves to the elephant’s trunk across a fence; the second labeled "Peaceful Time" showing the child seated on a wooden bench in profile with elephants in the background, in a calm reflective scene. Each small panel has a short Japanese caption underneath. On the right side, stack exactly 3 informational boxes labeled "POINT 01", "POINT 02", and "POINT 03" in olive green circles, each with a simple line icon and Japanese text: box 1 features an elephant icon and discusses memory, box 2 features a trunk or elephant-face icon and discusses delicacy despite size, box 3 features a zoo building icon and discusses what can be learned at the zoo. At the bottom right, add 1 bordered summary box with a ribbon-like header reading "まとめ", a small elephant silhouette, and 2 short Japanese summary paragraphs. Along the bottom margin, include the page number "068", the date "APRIL 2025", and a row of small walking elephant silhouettes. Add subtle botanical flourishes, leaves, and light decorative strokes throughout. Overall mood: gentle, educational, heartwarming, airy, natural, child-friendly, and sophisticated, like a premium seasonal magazine feature.

items.title: Retro Manga Love Guide Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a busy vintage-style Japanese manga cover illustration packed with romantic-comedy characters, ideal for nostalgic poster art or faux magazine covers.
items.content: A retro 1980s Japanese manga magazine cover illustration with a faded paper texture, slightly grainy print look, and warm vintage ink colors. The composition is crowded and playful, set against a deep blue-purple background filled with fluffy pink clouds and floating pink hearts. At the top left, a huge dramatic Japanese title in bold hand-drawn lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="危険な恋愛手引書"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it reading （ラブ・バイブル）. In the center, a tall delinquent-style teenage boy in a dark gakuran school uniform points toward the viewer with one hand, confident and charismatic. Beside him at center-right is a sweet shoujo-style teenage girl with a short dark-brown bob haircut, large sparkling eyes, and a cream sailor-style school uniform with a pink collar and bow, looking up in surprise and admiration. Place piles and angled stacks of Japanese yen banknotes in the lower left and lower right background, partially visible and glowing under the gold lighting. The mascot should overlap the right side of the main text area slightly and be outlined clearly so it stands out from the glittering background. Overall composition should be extremely high contrast, richly saturated gold, glossy, crowded, and optimized as a bold social media thumbnail that instantly communicates wealth, success, and AI image-generation income.

items.title: Romantic Cottage Window Garden Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a soft, floral, anime-inspired illustration of a girl at an open window with a clear indoor room and outdoor garden, ideal for showcasing complex spatial composition.
items.content: A dreamy romantic illustration of a young woman leaning out of an open cottage window, perfectly emphasizing the contrast between the sunny flower garden outside and the cozy room inside. She rests both elbows on the white-painted windowsill and cups her face in her hands, centered in the composition, with her face hidden by her pose and hair. She has very long wavy light brown hair with small white flowers tucked into it, and wears a soft vintage cream-beige floral dress with puffed sleeves and delicate lace trim. The window is a white wooden double casement window opened outward on both sides, framed by sheer lace curtains that billow gently inward and outward. The exterior wall is white painted brick or plaster, covered with climbing vines and many small white blossoms around the top and sides of the window. In the foreground outside, show a lush spring garden with an exact mix of 5 flower groups: pale pink tulips, cream-white tulips, small white daisies with yellow centers, soft lavender flower spikes, and layered pale pink garden roses or peonies, with a short white picket fence peeking up along the bottom edge. Through the window, clearly show the interior as a separate indoor space: a warm, softly lit shabby-chic room with muted beige tones, framed botanical prints on the wall, a wooden cabinet or shelf with vases and flowers, and a small delicate chandelier hanging in the background. Use gentle morning sunlight, soft shadows of vines across the wall and sill, airy pastel colors, highly detailed painterly anime-inspired realism, ethereal floral fantasy mood, serene and nostalgic atmosphere, vertical composition.

items.title: Tropical Beach Sandcastle Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic summer beach portrait of a woman in a blue sundress building sandcastles, ideal for vacation-themed lifestyle imagery.
items.content: A photorealistic vertical beach portrait of a young woman kneeling on pale sand while building sandcastles, shot in bright natural midday sunlight with a shallow depth of field. She has long dark brown hair tied in a high ponytail, a slim figure, and wears a short deep-blue sundress with thin spaghetti straps, a plunging neckline, and a softly flared skirt. She is leaning forward toward the camera in a playful candid pose, both hands shaping the sand in front of her. Add a delicate thin necklace with a tiny pendant and a subtle bracelet. Place exactly 5 sandcastle elements in the foreground: 2 taller turret-like sand towers on the right, 2 smaller rounded sand mounds near the center front, and 1 partially formed sand piece in her hands. The background is a tropical beach with smooth beige sand, turquoise water along the left side, a green tree-covered shoreline in the distance, and palm trees arching overhead, including 1 large palm trunk on the right edge. Use soft bokeh in the background, clean summer vacation fashion photography, realistic skin tones, natural shadows from palm leaves across her arms and dress, and a serene luxury resort atmosphere. Frame it as a full-body to three-quarter portrait in portrait orientation, centered subject, eye-level to slightly low camera angle.

items.title: Realistic Woman at Japanese Bus Stop
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic vertical street portrait of a stylish young woman seated at a sunlit Japanese bus stop, suitable for lifestyle, fashion, or urban commuting imagery.
items.content: A realistic candid street photo of a young East Asian woman sitting at a glass-walled bus stop on a bright sunny day in Japan, framed as a vertical portrait from mid-thigh up. She has dark brown hair tied back in a low ponytail with soft side bangs and wears small dangling earrings, a fitted white camisole or tank top under a white blazer, and a high-waisted dark navy or black pencil skirt. Her posture is relaxed, seated slightly angled toward the camera with one shoulder closer, giving a polished office-worker look. Behind her on the left is a bus route timetable board filled with Japanese text and route numbers, including visible numbers like 226, 609, 670, 632, and 合D32. On the right side in the background, a blue city bus with a yellow roof is approaching or stopped along the curb, softly out of focus. The bus shelter has reflective glass panels, metal framing, and a bench, with a sunlit sidewalk, tree shadows, and urban buildings in the distance. Use natural midday lighting with crisp highlights and soft shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric textures, clean commercial photography style, high detail, DSLR-like bokeh. Replace the obscured face area with a natural, fully visible face of an attractive adult woman, keeping the expression calm and neutral. Use {argument name="outfit color" default="white blazer with white top and dark skirt"}, {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}, {argument name="location" default="Japanese urban bus stop"}, and {argument name="bus color" default="blue with a yellow roof"}.

items.title: Anime Pokémon-Style Versus Screen
items.description: This prompt generates a bold anime battle-introduction splash image with two rival girls, their monster partners, and a dramatic VS layout for matchup art or social media posts.

author.name: ねずみ男(AIイラスト専用)

items.content: A dynamic anime versus screen styled like a Pokémon battle intro, split diagonally into 2 opposing horizontal panels with a large metallic gold “VS” emblem in the center. The top panel has a hot pink speed-line background with black brushstroke borders and shows {argument name="top character name" default="Rina Tennoji"} on the left, a teenage anime girl in a blue school uniform jacket, white shirt, and red ribbon tie, leaning in from the left with a confident expression, short layered pink hair with outward flips, and vivid yellow eyes. Beside her is 1 floating Porygon2-like creature, glossy red and blue with a rounded body, oval blue limbs, and a single circular yellow-and-black eye. On the right side of the top panel, large bold white text with a black outline reads “Rina Tennoji.” The bottom panel has a vivid purple speed-line background with black brushstroke borders and shows {argument name="bottom character name" default="Hime Anyoji"} on the right, a teenage anime girl in a soft pink hoodie over a school-style outfit, posed with one hand near her chin, pastel pink hair in twin braided buns tied with dark bows. Her face is obscured by a large solid censor block rectangle. Beside her is 1 floating Magnezone-like robot creature, metallic silver and blue-gray with a domed body, 1 central red eye, 1 smaller side eye, a yellow antenna on top, and 2 horseshoe magnets as arms with red and blue tips. On the left side of the bottom panel, large bold white text with a black outline reads “Hime Anyoji.” Use crisp anime line art, glossy cel shading, dramatic motion streaks, high contrast, and a competitive game splash-screen composition on a black outer background. Include 2 characters, 2 creature companions, 2 name labels, 1 central VS emblem, and a small stylized white artist signature in the lower-left corner.

items.title: Signed Marker Portrait on Shikishi
items.description: This generates a lively signed marker-style portrait on a square shikishi board, useful for fan-art autographs, commemorative illustration posts, and personalized thank-you visuals.
items.content: A lively hand-drawn fashion portrait in a changed illustration style, made to look like a signed fan-art sketch drawn with markers on a square white shikishi board with a thin gold border. Show a stylish young woman from about the waist up, leaning slightly forward with one elbow resting up near her face in a casual, friendly pose. Her face area is covered by a simple rectangular censor block in a muted beige tone. She has shoulder-length medium brown hair with warm highlights, soft volume, side-swept bangs, and flipped-out ends. Render the art with expressive black ink outlines, visible marker strokes, watercolor-like blending, sketchy hatching, and an energetic, vivid handmade feel. She wears a fitted dark gray ribbed long-sleeve knit top with subtle puffed shoulders, layered delicate gold necklaces, a dangling pearl earring, a beige crossbody bag strap running diagonally across her chest, and a light beige skirt or dress visible at the waist. Leave plenty of clean white background around the figure. Add 2 small sparkle doodles on the left side. Add handwritten Japanese thank-you messages and signature-style black ink writing around the portrait: at upper right write {argument name="top message" default="ありがとう！"} with an underline and a small heart, beneath it place a large stylized autograph reading {argument name="signature name" default="Yui"} with a smiling face mark and a heart, at lower left write {argument name="side message" default="いつも応援してくれてありがとう♡"}, and at lower right write the date {argument name="date" default="2024.5.20"} with another heart. The overall image should feel warm, personal, lively, and like a celebratory signed illustration on a square autograph board.

items.title: Oil Pastel Anime Catgirl
items.description: This prompt generates a cute full-body anime catgirl in a tiger-themed outfit rendered as a textured oil pastel crayon drawing, ideal for playful character art and stylized social posts.
items.content: A cute anime catgirl crouching low in a playful pose, drawn as a hand-made oil pastel illustration on textured off-white paper. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="deep purple with lighter lavender ends"} hair, large pointed orange cat ears on top of her head, and a striped orange-and-black cat tail curving in from the right side. Her outfit is a tiger-inspired bodysuit in vivid {argument name="outfit color" default="bright orange"} with bold black accents: long fitted sleeves, a dark black chest and torso panel, orange legs, orange gloves, and a soft pale pink patch on the hip and upper thigh area.
