items.title: Leverage Infinity Stand Poster
items.description: A JoJo-inspired manga profile poster showing a bizarre mushroom-themed Stand and pig-like user, ideal for parody character sheets and dramatic anime-style meme art.
items.content: Create a dramatic manga-style character poster on an aged off-white paper background, designed like a JoJo-inspired Stand profile page with heavy ink lines, screentone texture, painterly shading, and exaggerated comic energy. The layout is vertical, with a dense information panel on the left and the main figures dominating the center and right. At the top left, large serif English title text reads "LEVERAGE INFINITY" under smaller Japanese text "スタンド名:". Below it, a left-column profile card contains 6 visible info lines with Japanese labels and values: "スタンド使い名:" with the value "1-sphere", "性別: 不詳", "見た目:" followed by a short Japanese description, "年齢: 不詳", "身長: 96cm", and "職業: 市場の条省・養分". Beneath that, add a framed ability box titled "スタンド能力" containing several lines of Japanese body text and a bold English catchphrase at the bottom reading exactly: "Choose... TO THE MOOOOON!! Or face the MARGIN CAAAAALL!!". At the lower left, add a framed radar chart section titled "スタンドパラメータ" with 5 labeled stats around the graph: "破壊力 B", "持続力 C", "成長性 A", "スピード C", and "人念力 B"; fill the radar graph with a translucent pink polygon. The main illustration shows 2 stacked figures: a humanoid Stand above and a pig-like user below. The Stand is tall, metallic, and menacing, with a mushroom-cap helmet head in glossy red with white spots, circular gold-and-pink ear-like side discs, a segmented chrome-and-brass body, muscular but sleek mechanical arms, and a pink pig-snout emblem on the chest. Its face area is obscured by a rectangular censor blur. It reaches one articulated hand toward the viewer in an aggressive foreshortened pose. Around the Stand’s upper body, place 3 large stylized sound-effect glyphs reading "ゴゴゴ" in purple and black. On the far right, add a jagged speech or impact shape with 4 stacked lines of bold Japanese text reading "レヴァ", "レヴァ", "レヴァ", "レヴァ!!". Behind both figures, erupting pink-purple aura flames and floating rock fragments create intense supernatural energy. The lower figure is a short, squat, pig-bodied character standing wide-legged, with pink skin, small hoof-like feet, a yellow-green neckerchief, and a huge mushroom cap hat in red with white spots and a thick yellow underside rim; the torso area is obscured by a large rectangular censor blur. The pig points outward with one hand and holds a woven basket in the other hand containing 3 visible items: 1 blue heart-shaped object and 2 small round produce-like objects. Keep the composition theatrical and bizarre, combining grotesque humor, market-speculation parody, and high-impact manga poster aesthetics.

items.title: Cyberpunk Fallen Angel Samurai
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic single-character poster illustration for album art, key visuals, or striking social media concept art.
items.content: A hyper-detailed symmetrically composed anime-inspired cyberpunk illustration on a flat, saturated {argument name="background color" default="crimson red"} background. Centered in the frame, a solitary androgynous warrior sits slouched on a dark wooden chair, legs apart, hands relaxed between the knees, projecting calm menace and fallen-divinity energy. The face is intentionally obscured and unreadable, framed by an elaborate black samurai-style horned helmet with 2 curved horns and dense mechanical ornamentation. The figure has 2 large white feathered wings spread outward from the back. Behind and around the seated body, the composition splits into two contrasting organic-tech masses: on the left side, a chaotic storm of 1 dense tangle of teal and dark blue cables, wires, plugs, circuit fragments, and techno-organic tendrils; on the right side, 1 explosive bloom of pink cherry blossoms, petals, curling branches, and ribbon-like floral swirls. Place 1 upright katana behind the figure on the right side, angled slightly inward, with a black handle and visible guard. The right character is a slim and ethereal young person with very long flowing {argument name="right character hair color" default="soft green"} hair streaming to the right in the breeze, wearing an oversized white hoodie with black drawstrings and one hand gesturing naturally while walking. Use a vivid blue sky with small white clouds, lush greenery, high-detail foliage, soft cinematic sunlight, clean linework, and refined painterly shading. items.title: Bubble Fox Friends Meet in Niseko
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed anime travel illustration of fox girls reuniting at Niseko View Plaza with iridescent soap bubbles and a dramatic mountain backdrop, ideal for scenic character art.

author.name: 輝鳴紅葉🫧🌸シャボン玉のバーチャルビデオ屋

items.content: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." In the center, a glamorous fox-eared anime girl sits sideways atop a giant iridescent translucent soap bubble, smiling and gesturing upward with one hand. She has {argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pastel silver-lilac"} very long wavy hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy fox tail with rainbow-reflective highlights. Her outfit is an elaborate sparkling translucent-white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered sleeves, gemstone accents, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, giving her a magical bubble-fox idol appearance. Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends gather around meeting her at the plaza: 1 dark-haired fox-eared girl in a navy jacket with a Niseko patch, holding a vanilla soft-serve ice cream and looking toward the center; 1 khaki-clad fox-eared girl in an outdoor jacket and a dark cap with "HOTEL" lettering, holding a grilled corn cob; and 1 white-haired fox-eared girl in a shiny pearly hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and wearing a black backpack. Emphasize a cheerful reunion mood, travel photography composition blended with polished anime illustration, detailed environmental signage, reflective bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, crisp mountain air, and high-detail painterly rendering.

items.content: A richly detailed anime-style illustration of a late-night Call of Cthulhu tabletop RPG session in a dim antique study lit by warm oil lamps and candles. In the center, a girl with very long pale lavender hair in twin buns and flowing lengths wears an elegant dark green dress with gold trim and white lace cuffs, smiling mischievously while holding up a large hardcover book titled "Talk of Cthulhu" with a dramatic occult monster cover; above her is handwritten Japanese text reading "これで全員 一時的狂気ね" with a small heart. The room behind them has tall bookshelves full of old books, framed occult artwork including a tentacled creature image, a large aged wall map with pinned markings and strings, candles, wood furniture, and a moody Victorian occult-library atmosphere. items.title: Neon Catgirl Soda Splash
items.description: A vivid cyber-anime promotional illustration of a cat-eared girl dramatically presenting a neon soda bottle, ideal for flashy beverage ads, social posts, or high-energy pop art visuals.
items.content: A dynamic anime cyberpop illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="cat-eared anime girl"} in an extreme close-up, low-angle foreshortened pose, thrusting a glass soda bottle directly toward the viewer so the bottle and hand dominate the foreground. The scene is drenched in explosive neon magenta, cyan, violet, and electric blue lighting, with a glossy high-contrast finish and dense sparkling particle effects. The character has long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white hair with cyan and pink highlights"}, large furry cat ears, and layered windswept strands glowing with rim light. Her face is mostly hidden by a flat rectangular censorship block in muted purple placed over the eye area. She wears futuristic clubwear: a black strappy top with a small cat-symbol detail, a translucent iridescent jacket slipping off the shoulders, shiny dark armwear or gloves, metallic accessories, and dangling earrings. Her nails are painted vivid pink. In the foreground, she grips a clear bottle labeled {argument name="drink label" default="NYAN EXTREME SODA"}, with a stylized cat face logo on a dark label. The bottle is filled with bright blue and pink fizzy liquid, and the cap is off as a dramatic geyser of sparkling pink soda erupts upward and outward, splashing across the frame. Surround the character with floating translucent ice cubes, droplets, glitter, and bokeh-like highlights. The background is an abstract nightlife energy burst of swirling liquid, neon splashes, and luminous particles rather than a realistic location. Emphasize exaggerated perspective, motion, sensual pop-art attitude, hyper-detailed reflections, glossy skin and fabric, and a bold gpt-image-2 polished anime illustration aesthetic.

items.title: Japanese AI Creative Manifesto Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a bold fashion-editorial manifesto poster with oversized Japanese typography, a full-body model, and graphic brush accents for marketing, social posts, or creative branding.
items.content: A bold Japanese advertising poster on an off-white textured paper background with a slightly worn print grain. Create a full-body fashion-style photo of a young woman standing slightly right of center in a wide, confident stance, legs apart, arms relaxed at her sides, facing forward. Her face is intentionally blurred for anonymity. She has long straight split-dyed hair, one half {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} and the other half {argument name="second hair color" default="pastel blue"}, falling past her chest. She wears a white oversized T-shirt with the black chest print {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and chunky white sneakers. Use clean studio lighting with soft shadows under her feet. Fill the left half of the poster with huge distressed black Japanese typography in an energetic diagonal layout reading {argument name="main headline" default="センスない奴は画像とテキストを極めろ"}, with oversized characters stacked and overlapping for maximum impact. Add 2 broad paint-brush swashes behind the lower headline area: 1 pink brush stroke sweeping from the lower left toward center and 1 blue brush stroke sweeping from center-right toward the far right. In the upper right, place a compact vertical block of small black Japanese copy in 4 lines reading: 「AI動画の自動化に 溺れるな。 静止した一枚と、 研ぎ澄まされた言葉が、 最も強い武器になる。」 arranged like a manifesto note. In the lower right, add a small angled English text block in uppercase reading {argument name="tagline text" default="MASTER TEXT & IMAGE. SHAPE PERCEPTION. CONTROL THE OUTCOME."}. In the lower left corner, add a small brand signature reading "OKIHIRO AI CREATIVE MANIFESTO". The overall composition should feel like a modern creative manifesto poster, mixing fashion editorial photography, Japanese street advertising, bold typography, and minimalist graphic design.

items.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Omamori Counter
items.description: This prompt generates a detailed anime illustration of a miko selling shrine charms at a wooden shrine counter, suitable for character scene art or atmospheric cultural setting visuals.
items.content: A clean anime-style illustration of a young shrine maiden working at a traditional Japanese shrine amulet counter inside a warm wooden building. She is a single female subject shown from about waist up behind the counter, with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied back with a red cord and white paper zigzag shrine ornament, wearing a white kimono top and vivid {argument name="hakama color" default="red"} hakama. She is politely handing a protective charm to a visitor across the counter; only the visitor’s hands, torso, and beige jacket sleeves are visible in the foreground. The scene should feel calm, respectful, and softly lit by daylight coming through a wooden lattice window on the right, where a red torii gate and shrine grounds are visible outside in gentle blur. The interior is richly detailed with dark natural wood beams, shelves, and a small kamidana altar in the upper left decorated with 4 hanging white shide paper streamers and 2 green sakaki plants in white vases. On the right hangs a vertical sign with the Japanese text "御守・御札授与所". On the left shelves are shrine goods and signs: 3 small shelf labels reading "おみくじ", multiple stacks of paper fortunes and talismans, white drawstring bags, and upright placards including "御守", "御札", and "交通安全". The countertop is neatly arranged with 3 shallow wooden display trays of colorful omamori charms, 5 visible tabletop paper labels or stacks reading "厄除", "御守", "御札", "御朱印", and "御礼", plus a black ink pot, 2 writing brushes, a small empty wooden tray, a rectangular abacus, and bundled paper items. The charm being exchanged should be a delicate pastel omamori with floral decoration and a tied cord. Use a polished contemporary anime illustration style with fine linework, soft shading, realistic hand posing, subtle dust motes in the air, and strong emphasis on the subject and counter interaction rather than dramatic stylization.

items.title: Shrine Maiden Offering an Omamori
items.description: This prompt generates a clean anime-style shrine scene featuring a miko presenting an omamori at a shrine counter, ideal for character art with culturally detailed background props.
items.content: A polished anime-style illustration of a young shrine maiden named {argument name="character name" default="音慰"} standing inside a traditional Japanese shrine amulet office, shown from about thigh-up behind a wooden counter. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with a center part and soft shine, pale skin, and a calm, gentle presence. Her face is centered and front-facing, but the facial area is obscured by a rectangular blur block. She wears a crisp white kimono-style top with wide sleeves and a deep red hakama tied in a large bow at the waist, conveying a classic miko outfit. Both hands are presenting a white embroidered omamori charm toward the viewer, holding it carefully at chest level; the charm has a gold cord knot at the top and the vertical kanji text "御守" on the front. In the foreground on the counter is a wooden display tray containing exactly 10 visible omamori charms in multiple colors: white, pink, red, purple, and gold-patterned variants, each with decorative cords and gold or white embroidery. To the right on the counter are 3 neat stacks of paper shrine talismans or packets, each labeled in Japanese; the rightmost stack is tied with a red-and-gold mizuhiki cord. On the left side of the counter is a small wooden price sign reading "初穂料 800円". The shrine interior is warmly lit with natural sunlight entering from a large wooden-framed window on the left, creating a serene, clean atmosphere. Through the window, a red railing and softly blurred shrine grounds and greenery are visible. In the background are wooden shelves and traditional decor, plus a vertical hanging sign with Japanese text reading "御守 御札" and smaller text "各種祈願承ります". The composition is centered on the miko and the offered charm, with soft depth of field, delicate fabric folds, realistic hands, refined linework, and a high-quality modern anime rendering style that emphasizes the subject more than the environment.

items.description: This prompt generates a polished full-body anime key visual of three coordinated humanoid idol androids on a futuristic live stage, ideal for character IP promotion or idol group concept art.

author.name: 岡安モフモフ（アーガイル社長）＠ChatGPT/Gemini/ClaudeなどLLMでサービス作る人

items.content: A full-body anime illustration of 3 humanoid AI assistant idol girls standing side by side on a glossy futuristic concert stage, shown in a straight-on front view with their full figures visible from head to shoes. They are designed as the same base android model with subtle personality differences expressed mainly through costume design, pose, and color balance rather than body type. All 3 have short silver-gray bob hair with soft waves, large over-ear mechanical headphones, pale skin, youthful idol styling, and sleek visible robotic limbs with glossy red-and-black plating and heart-shaped accent motifs. The setting is a large indoor live venue with steel truss rigging overhead, bright white and pink-purple stage spotlights, giant LED screens in the background, and reflective black stage flooring with glowing grid lines and mirror-like reflections. The overall mood is polished, cute, futuristic, and high-end, with dramatic concert lighting and crisp detailed rendering. The left girl wears a mostly black idol outfit with red accents: a cropped translucent black jacket over a short black dress or romper with a flared skirt, black armored thigh-high mechanical legs, chunky black platform boots, red gloves, and small heart details throughout; she stands with knees slightly inward and both hands pressed to her cheeks in a shy, affectionate pose, with a sweet blushing expression. The center girl wears a balanced red-and-white idol outfit: a white sleeveless top with red heart accents, a layered burgundy-red frilled mini skirt, fully exposed red-and-black robotic arms and legs, and red platform shoes; she stands in a neutral straight upright pose with one hand raised lightly near her face, presenting the clearest full-body view of the android construction. The right girl wears a mostly red idol dress with black lace-like detailing, a black waist belt, a flared skirt with white frilled underskirt, red-and-black knee armor, and red platform shoes; she stands elegantly with one arm bent near her chest and the other arm extended outward, as if introducing the audience. Keep the trio evenly spaced across the frame. Emphasize the contrast between soft idol fashion and hard mechanical anatomy, with 3 distinct costume variations in black-dominant, red-and-white balanced, and red-dominant palettes. Highly detailed anime key visual, ultra-clean linework, glossy materials, soft facial shading, sparkling highlights, cinematic stage atmosphere, and premium promotional art quality for the idol unit {argument name="group name" default="Hallucinations"}.

items.title: Moonlit Yuri Wedding Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a luxurious anime-style wedding poster of two brides in coordinated fantasy attire, ideal for original character pairings, romance key visuals, or decorative cover art.
items.content: A romantic fantasy wedding illustration of two women standing arm in arm in a moonlit palace balcony at night, highly detailed anime style with luminous painterly rendering, elegant and dreamy. The taller woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="light brown"} shoulder-length softly layered hair and wears a regal ivory-white tailored wedding suit with gold embroidery, a high-collared ruffled shirt, cream vest, cravat, chain accessories, and a long ceremonial coat whose inner lining is deep violet with floral patterns; a purple flower corsage is pinned to her chest. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="black"} long wavy hair and wears an ornate bridal gown in ivory with gold lace embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, a fitted bodice, a very long translucent veil, and rich crimson inner panels and accents peeking from the skirt; she wears red gemstone jewelry and floral hair ornaments in white and red. She holds a large bouquet of red, burgundy, and white flowers with greenery and trailing red ribbons while gently linking arms with her partner. Set them before gothic arched windows, hanging crystal ornaments, glowing lanterns, purple flowers, a distant city skyline, a star-filled sky, and a bright full moon. Add decorative vertical Japanese title text integrated into the composition: on the left, {argument name="left title text" default="紫苑の護り"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it; on the right, {argument name="right title text" default="紅雪の献心"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it. Include crescent moon and snowflake-like decorative motifs framing the titles. Use a tall poster composition, full-body view, luxurious fabrics, sparkling highlights, soft bokeh, and an overall palette of ivory, gold, violet, crimson, and midnight blue.

items.title: Romantic Yuri Wedding Chapel Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a soft, ornate anime wedding illustration of two brides in contrasting bridal outfits, ideal for original character romance art or ceremonial key visuals.
items.content: A luminous, ultra-detailed anime-style wedding portrait of two brides in a romantic white chapel filled with soft ivory light, sheer curtains, carved arches, pale floral arrangements, and sparkling bokeh. The composition is vertical and elegant, showing the pair from about thigh-up to full dress detail, standing close together in an intimate yuri moment. The taller bride on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="warm chestnut brown"} long wavy hair cascading over her shoulders and back, wearing a refined white bridal pantsuit with a fitted tailcoat, gold buttons, a cream vest, a silk cravat, subtle floral embroidery along the coat tails, and a white rose boutonniere with pale blue accents. She is visibly emotional, gently wiping tears with a handkerchief, her other hand resting near her chest, giving the feeling of being moved by the ceremony. The shorter bride on the right has {argument name="second bride hair color" default="long black hair"}, very long and glossy, and wears an ornate off-shoulder wedding gown in white with icy blue undertones, translucent lace sleeves, intricate beadwork, floral embroidery, layered ruffles, and a long veil decorated with tiny flowers and crystal-like details. A silver floral hair ornament with dangling pieces decorates the side of her head. She looks up at her partner tenderly while holding a cascading bouquet of white roses, blue flowers, and trailing greenery. Emphasize the contrast between the tailored princely suit and the delicate fairy-tale gown, with luxurious fabric textures, lace transparency, fine embroidery, soft glowing highlights, drifting sparkles, and a dreamy, emotional atmosphere. Make the scene feel like {argument name="relationship theme" default="an original yuri wedding between an older office lady-style bride and a younger nurse-style bride"}, painted in polished, high-end romantic illustration style, ethereal, graceful, and heartfelt.

items.title: JoJo-Style Duck Mascot Stand Profile
items.description: A dramatic manga-style character profile page showing a duck mascot soccer figure and his humanoid Stand, ideal for parody anime posters and stylized character introduction art.
items.content: A full-page manga-style parody character profile illustration on an aged off-white paper background, designed like a JoJo-inspired stand user sheet with bold ink lines, cross-hatching, dramatic posing, and stylized Japanese text. The central figure is an anthropomorphic duck mascot athlete standing in a confident forward stride, pointing directly at the viewer with one gloved hand and clenching the other fist. He has a large round pale-yellow duck head with a bright orange beak, huge glossy black eyes, and a fierce determined expression with furrowed brows. His body is human-like and athletic, wearing a dark green sleeveless soccer jersey over a white undershirt, white shorts, black shoes with teal laces, and yellow-and-black horizontal striped knee-high socks. Around his neck hangs a lanyard with an ID badge showing a small portrait icon of the duck mascot and the text “No.001”. The jersey has 4 visible sponsor-style patches and labels: “農協牛乳”, “今野硝子工業”, “相模福祉村”, and a small crest marked “SC'S”. Behind him stands his humanoid Stand, a tall muscular armored figure with a metallic olive-gold body, a heart-shaped chest emblem, narrow intimidating eyes, and a raised fist, surrounded by jagged purple spiritual flames. Add 4 large purple manga sound effect texts around the figures, each reading “ゴゴ…”, with one near the upper left of the Stand and 3 stacked vertically along the left side of the mascot. On the left side of the page, include a profile text column with 6 horizontal rule-separated lines of Japanese text: “スタンド使い名: ガミティ”, “性別: 男”, “見た目: ダチョウのマスコット”, “年齢: 不明”, “身長: 175cm”, and “職業: マスコット / PR活動”. On the right side, place a large spiky speech bubble filled with bold vertical Japanese text: “オラオラオラオラオラ！ 前に出るぞ！絶対に負けねェーッ！ 相模原・共に行こうぜェーッ！”. Below that, add a lower-right information block with a heading “スタンド名:『オオサガミ・オオオォ！』” and a smaller subtitle “(SC相模原チャント「オオサガミオオオォー！」より)”, followed by a paragraph headed “スタンド能力:” describing an emotional amplification power in dense Japanese body text. In the lower left corner, include a purple-filled radar chart with 6 axes labeled in Japanese: “破壊力 B”, “スピード B”, “射程距離 D”, “成長性 C”, “精密動作性 C”, and “持続力 C”. Composition should feel like a dramatic manga magazine character introduction page, with the mascot in front, the Stand looming behind, strong foreshortening, dynamic comic-book energy, and a humorous contrast between a cute sports mascot and an overwhelmingly serious supernatural battle presentation.

items.title: JoJo-Style Stand Character Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a manga-style parody character sheet with a masked street performer and his bird-headed Stand, ideal for anime homage posters and dramatic comic-style character introductions.
items.content: A manga-style JoJo-inspired character card poster set in a narrow urban alley, with dramatic cel shading, heavy ink lines, stylized speed-line energy, and a vertical comic-page layout. The main subject is a young Japanese man, {argument name="character name" default="タカ・ハシ"}, age 19, shown from mid-thigh up in the left foreground, raising his right fist high in a triumphant pose while holding a handheld microphone near his mouth with his left hand. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular mosaic blur. He has short messy {argument name="hair color" default="green"} hair and wears a fitted green track jacket with gold side stripes and a large golden phoenix emblem across the chest, zipped up, with black pants and black fingerless gloves. To his right and slightly behind him stands his humanoid Stand, {argument name="stand name" default="サガミ・サヴァイブ (SAGAMI SURVIVE)"}, a compact armored mascot-like figure with a rounded pale yellow bird head, sharp angry eyes, an orange beak, and a sleek white-and-green mechanical body with metallic silver musculature. The Stand has green shoulder armor, green gauntlets, gold trim, and a bold letter S on each side of its chest armor. It is posed punching forward with both fists, aggressive and energetic. Include exactly 4 distinct text panels and effects: 1 large white rectangular description box at the top right filled with dense Japanese text explaining the Stand, 1 jagged white speech bubble at the mid-right with vertical Japanese battle cries, 1 white character-info box at the bottom left with Japanese profile text, and 1 white stat box at the bottom right containing a radar chart labeled STAND PARAMETERS with Japanese and English category labels and a 5-line stat list. Add exactly 4 stylized purple sound-effect texts around the figures: 1 large "ゴゴゴゴ…" near the upper middle, 1 "ド" near the lower left, and 2 separate "ドド" effects near the lower center and lower right. The background is a gray-blue city alley with tall buildings receding in perspective. Overall tone: parody homage to JoJo's Bizarre Adventure character introductions, combining comic intensity with a goofy mascot Stand concept, polished manga poster composition, sharp print-like detail, and Japanese magazine page aesthetics.

The top header is extremely large and dramatic with red-and-white outlined Japanese text on a dark textured background. Every section mixes short text blocks with cute manga visuals for easy learning. Include one recurring royal Shiba Inu mascot on the left or right edges guiding the reader and reacting to clues. The whole design should feel like a fun children’s history handout or classroom poster about the mystery of Himiko’s identity."}

items.title: Japanese Y-DNA History Infographic Poster
items.description: A dense manga-style educational poster for children that explains Japanese paternal-line DNA history across Jomon, Yayoi, and Kofun periods with maps, diagrams, artifacts, and a recurring dog mascot.
items.content: {"type":"Japanese educational history infographic poster","style":"busy manga-style educational poster, highly saturated colors, thick ink outlines, dramatic comic energy, glossy print look, textured paper illustration, designed for children, humorous but informative","topic":"Y-chromosome DNA and the broad paternal-line history of the Japanese archipelago","language":"Japanese","aspect_ratio":"portrait 3:4","headline":{"main":"{argument name=\"headline text\" default=\"日本のYハプロDNA、ざっくり言うとこう！\"}","sub":"父系をたどると、縄文・弥生・古墳のつながりが見えてくる！","badge":"情報量ッ!!"},"mascot":{"type":"cartoon dog historian mascot","count":4,"appearance":"round white-and-tan dog with black nose, expressive mouth, wearing ornate gold historical costume with crown-like headpiece, often pointing or giving a thumbs-up, comical teacher role"},"layout":{"structure":"8 numbered horizontal panels stacked vertically plus top banner and bottom summary banner","sections":[{"title":"① そもそもYハプロDNAって何？","position":"top panel under banner","count":1,"elements":["explanation text block about father-to-son inheritance of Y chromosome","3 male head icons in sequence labeled 父, 息子, 孫 connected by green arrows","large red text 父系1本だけ！","mascot speech bubble comparing it to one branch in a family tree"]},{"title":"② まず縄文人の父系！","position":"upper section","count":1,"elements":["illustration of a rugged Jomon hunter holding spear","3 Jomon artifacts/totems arranged center","brown label D1b = 縄文の代表格","blue label C1a1 = レアだけど古い!","dramatic shouting manga face at right with text 古ッ!!! でも大事!!"]},{"title":"③ 弥生で大きな流入ドーン！","position":"upper-middle section","count":1,"elements":["cheerful Yayoi-era figures standing on shore","boat full of migrants arriving from the continent","orange labels O1b2 and O2","starburst text 新メンバー参戦!","small haniwa and stone blade illustration at far right"]},{"title":"④ どこから来たの？ 有力ルート","position":"middle section","count":1,"elements":["map of Korea Strait and western Japan","visible place labels 朝鮮半島, 対馬, 壱岐, 北部九州, 瀬戸内, 近畿","many red arrows showing migration routes eastward","speech bubble over sea saying 海、めっちゃ渡ってる!","dramatic warrior face at right with text 北部九州、玄関口すぎる！"]},{"title":"⑤ 古墳時代でもう一波！","position":"lower-middle section","count":1,"elements":["large aerial view style keyhole-shaped kofun tomb landscape","armored Kofun-era horseman in center","horse and 3 haniwa figures to the right","shouting manga face at far right with text また増えたァ!!","caption near warrior 政治も人も再編中!" ]},{"title":"⑥ じゃあ現代と古墳、どうつながる？","position":"lower section","count":1,"elements":["diagram showing 縄文 + 弥生 + 古墳 = 現代の日本人","3 labeled mini-blocks: 縄文（古い父系）, 弥生（大陸系）, 古墳（さらに流入）","haplogroup labels D1b / C1a1 and O1b2 / O2","arrow pointing to modern Japanese family icon","orange burst text 全部“どれか1つだけ”じゃない！"]},{"title":"⑦ ご注意！ Yハプロ＝民族じゃない！","position":"second from bottom","count":1,"elements":["scientist or teacher figure pointing at a board","5 evidence icons in a row: 常染色体, mtDNA, 考古学, 歴史資料, いろんな証拠を合わせよう！","red warning burst 早とちり厳禁!","mascot speech bubble saying 一本筋で全部は語れない!","small note saying research updates over time"]},{"title":"⑧ じゃあ結論！","position":"bottom content panel","count":1,"elements":["three large historical figures side by side separated by plus signs: Jomon person, Yayoi farmer with rice, Kofun armored warrior with spear","large concluding sentence about many people mixing over long periods","bright red emphasis text about the Japanese archipelago continuing while mixing","mascot at lower right praising the DNA clue"]}],"bottom_banner":{"count":1,"text":"超ざっくり つまり…“縄文の土台に、弥生と古墳の流入が重なった！” Yハプロは、その“父系ルート”をのぞくための手がかり!"}},"figures":{"historical_groups":[{"name":"Jomon","count":2,"visuals":["rugged spear hunter","small block in ancestry equation"]},{"name":"Yayoi","count":3,"visuals":["2 cheerful migrants/farmers","small block in ancestry equation"]},{"name":"Kofun","count":2,"visuals":["armored horseman","small block in ancestry equation"]}],"dramatic_faces":{"count":3,"description":"3 exaggerated manga reaction faces at the right edges of sections 2, 4, and 5"},"artifact_groups":{"count":4,"items":["3 Jomon clay figures or ritual artifacts","1 boat of migrants","1 haniwa and 1 stone blade in Yayoi panel","3 haniwa beside horse in Kofun panel"]}},"color_palette":{"dominant":["crimson red","gold","deep blue","forest green","orange","cream","black"],"usage":"each panel has a different accent color with white text boxes and comic burst callouts"},"text_density":"very high, many explanatory paragraphs, labels, arrows, speech bubbles, and impact words","image_goal":"Create a kid-friendly Japanese history teaching poster that explains paternal-line Y-DNA haplogroups in a simplified way, combining manga comedy, historical illustration, archaeology, migration maps, and bold callout typography. Keep the page extremely packed, energetic, and easy to scan, with 8 numbered sections and recurring dog mascot commentary."}

items.title: Manga History Poster on Japan's 150-Year Gap
items.description: A dense Japanese manga-style educational infographic poster explaining the so-called 150-year gap in early Japanese history for children's study materials or classroom handouts.
items.content: {"type":"Japanese educational history infographic poster","theme":"Ancient Japanese history explained in a loud, comedic manga style for children","audience":"elementary school learner","language":"Japanese","format":"single-page vertical poster with 8 major colored bands plus a bottom summary banner","style":{"illustration":"hyper-energetic manga, exaggerated reaction faces, thick outlines, bright primary colors, dense handwritten callouts, classroom-friendly but chaotic and funny","rendering":"clean digital illustration with infographic layout, comic sound effects, arrows, labels, maps, diagrams, and spot character mascots","mood":"exciting, humorous, educational, dramatic"},"headline":{"main":"{argument name=\"headline text\" default=\"日本史の空白の150年、ざっくり言うとこう!\"}","sub":"{argument name=\"subtitle text\" default=\"卑弥呼のあと、記録がスカスカ!? でもこの時代、ヤマト王権が育っていく超重要フェーズ\"}"},"mascot":{"type":"cartoon dog professor mascot","count":4,"appearance":"small white-and-tan dog with round sunglasses or goggles in some panels, expressive mouth, costume changes including scholar outfit and explorer/adventurer accessories, used as reaction commentator in the corners and bottom banner"},"layout":{"sections":[{"title":"1 そもそも“空白の150年”って何?","position":"top band","count":1,"elements":["text block explaining the idea of a 150-year gap after Himiko","small portrait of 卑弥呼","small portrait of 台与","large notebook-like timeline labeled 266年ごろ to 413年ごろ with a red arrow across the gap","big note saying 記録うすっ!" ]},{"title":"2 なんで空白になったの?","position":"second band","count":1,"elements":["left explanatory text","dramatic dark manga face with text like 記録が消えた!?","mini sequence showing 魏 → 晋","battle scene explosion callout saying その後また大混乱!!","caption about Chinese dynastic change and war reducing records","right-side reaction character with speech about records and work"]},{"title":"3 日本列島では何が起きてた?","position":"third band","count":1,"elements":["left text about no single unified nation yet","row of 5 small local-force figures labeled 吉備, 出雲, 筑紫, 東国, 近畿など","arrow toward a palace/settlement scene labeled 奈良盆地（大和）に勢力が集まる!","armored ruler figure near the center-right","happy crowd at far right with callout about ヤマト王権の芽生え!" ]},{"title":"4 古墳がドーン! 権力の見える化","position":"fourth band","count":1,"elements":["left text about giant tombs appearing in the late 3rd century","large aerial illustration of a keyhole-shaped kofun","huge red sound effect ドーン!!","yellow arrow label saying 権力アピール","small haniwa statues and onlookers","intense black-and-white shouting face on the right with huge text about the tomb being enormous"]},{"title":"5 外とのつながりも強まる","position":"fifth band","count":1,"elements":["left text block about relations with 朝鮮半島 and imported iron, weapons, and culture","small regional map showing 朝鮮半島 and 日本列島 with arrows labeled 交流 and 緊張","4 object boxes labeled roughly 鉄（製鉄技術）, 武器・武具, 文化・技術, 重要な手がかり!","objects including iron ingots, armor and helmet, pottery/tools, and a 七支刀 illustration","small reaction character on the far right"]},{"title":"6 じゃあ、どうやって歴史を読むの?","position":"sixth band","count":1,"elements":["left text about using archaeology because written records are scarce","detective-like child scholar character with magnifying glass","4 archaeological item panels labeled 古墳, 鉄剣, 鏡, 埴輪","caption saying 考古学資料がしゃべる!","center-right collage of old documents and a map labeled 中国・朝鮮半島の記録と照らし合わせて…","right text about records being few but not zero"]},{"title":"7 413年ごろ、“倭の五王”で再登場!","position":"seventh band near bottom","count":1,"elements":["left explanatory text about appearing again in Chinese records in the 5th century","5 crowned royal figures standing in a celebratory row","the figures are labeled 讃, 珍, 済, 興, 武","confetti background","right-side excited reaction character with a callout like スターが大集合!?" ]},{"title":"超ざっくりまとめ","position":"bottom banner","count":1,"elements":["very large concluding text","dog mascot pointing upward on the left","dog mascot giving a thumbs-up on the right","summary line ending with a huge emphasized quotation"]}],"bottom_quote":"{argument name=\"summary quote\" default=\"つまり…“史料が静かすぎるのに、考古学はうるさい時代”！\"}"},"visual_details":{"dominant_colors":["red","yellow","blue","green","orange","white","black"],"background":"packed comic-page composition with textured boxes, bursts, stars, arrows, and speed lines","text_density":"extremely dense, every band filled with headings, captions, labels, and reaction text","character_count":"many small cartoon figures plus 4 dog mascot appearances and 5 kings in the bottom section","educational_focus":"the so-called 150-year gap in Japanese history between Himiko and the Five Kings of Wa, emphasizing sparse written records and strong archaeological evidence"},"customization":{"period_label":"{argument name=\"period label\" default=\"空白の150年\"}","mascot_species":"{argument name=\"mascot animal\" default=\"dog\"}"}}

items.content: A candid smartphone photo of a young East Asian woman seated at a small round table inside a busy old-fashioned Taiwanese breakfast shop. She is the main subject, framed from mid-thigh upward, facing the camera in a casual seated pose. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. She has straight shoulder-length black hair with a center part, small gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a tiny heart pendant. She wears a fitted white spaghetti-strap tank top and high-waisted blue denim cutoff shorts with light distressing. In one hand she holds a piece of fried cruller near her mouth, and in the other hand she holds another broken piece over the table. On the table are 4 visible food and drink items: a plate with fried cruller pieces, a wrapped scallion pancake with black sesame seeds, a white foam takeout tray containing 2 pancakes including one covered with dark soy-based sauce and chopped scallions, and a large takeaway cup of soy milk with a red straw and red Chinese logo. The restaurant interior is compact and brightly lit with fluorescent ceiling lights, terrazzo-style flooring, and tightly packed diners in the background. Behind her are large windows and wall signage with bold red traditional Chinese characters, including breakfast items such as soy milk, youtiao, rice rolls, shaobing, and egg pancake. There are several seated customers eating, staff working behind a metal counter, a small wall-mounted television showing a female news anchor, and a hanging menu board with red Chinese text and prices. Realistic photography, natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, lively local atmosphere, slight wide-angle phone camera perspective, documentary food-travel aesthetic.

items.title: Red-Haired Masked Samurai Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a richly detailed anime-style warrior portrait suited for dramatic character art, fantasy key visuals, or stylized Japanese-inspired illustrations.
items.content: A dramatic anime-style portrait of a lone swordsman with an androgynous, elegant presence, shown from mid-thigh up in a three-quarter view, staring intensely at the viewer with narrowed golden eyes. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="deep crimson red"} hair, long and layered with loose messy strands, plus one very long thick braid draped over the front of the body and decorated with turquoise beads and tassels. They wear a dark metallic half-mask covering the lower face, multiple ear piercings with red and silver ornaments, and a confident, dangerous expression. One hand rests behind the neck holding a katana across the shoulders; the sword has a black hilt with red accents and a reflective blade. The outfit is a richly detailed fantasy-meets-feudal-Japanese ensemble: muted brown inner kimono, wide navy and magenta waist wraps, a large golden obi tied loosely, dangling bead ornaments, and a black outer robe lined in red with a fluffy pale fur collar. Add a large red sun emblem on the robe sleeve and teal accessories at the waist. The palette is dominated by red, black, gold, cream, and deep blue. The background is a decorative Japanese-inspired painting with a large glowing red-orange sun disk behind the head, red plum blossoms, smoky cloud-like swirls, parchment-textured beige and charcoal tones, and scattered gold leaf splashes. Highly detailed digital illustration, painterly anime rendering, ornate textures, refined linework, moody lighting, luxurious fabric folds, samurai aesthetic, elegant and fierce atmosphere.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Four-Armed Heroine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic Japanese fantasy action book cover featuring a silver-haired four-armed mechanical heroine with glowing blue blades, ideal for web novel or light novel cover art.

author.name: ざつ＠『竜の姫と絆のユニゾン』『星槍とオムライス』『リリアンのプロの流儀』『B級グルメ革命』

items.content: A dramatic dark fantasy light-novel cover illustration in a square format, featuring a fierce female warrior centered in a dynamic lunging pose inside a dim, ruined, cathedral-like or industrial gothic interior with a smoky blurred background and warm floating embers. She has long silver-white hair in a high ponytail whipping violently to the right, pale skin, and a deliberately obscured or featureless face. Her body is enhanced with four black mechanical arms in total, built from intricate clockwork and segmented metal joints, extending spider-like around her. She wears a tattered black dress-like battle outfit with armored corset detailing, belts, straps, a garter on one thigh, and biomechanical leg armor. Count exactly 4 arms visible: 2 upper arms and 2 lower arms; count exactly 4 glowing energy blades, one held in each hand, translucent neon blue with crystalline edges and magical circuitry-like light patterns. Emphasize the contrast between matte black metal, torn fabric, pale skin, and electric cyan weapons. The composition should feel cinematic, high-detail, intense, and heroic, with sharp focus on the character and soft depth-of-field in the background. Add ornate Japanese cover typography in metallic gold with subtle beveling and glow: at the top, small genre text 《バトルアクション》; below it, a large main title {argument name="headline text" default="クアッドアームの静寂"}; beneath that, a smaller subtitle ～四本腕の女傭兵と錆びついた世界の約束～. Near the bottom, add a large centered quote in gold Japanese text {argument name="quote" default="「僕は君の未来を高値で買いに来た」"}; directly below it, a smaller line ——時計仕掛けの運命が、今動き出す. At the very bottom center, place the author name {argument name="author name" default="ざっ"} in large gold text with elegant ornamental divider lines on both sides. Use a luxurious fantasy-book-cover layout, moody sepia-and-charcoal palette with bright cyan highlights, ultra-detailed anime-inspired realism, and a polished GPT-image-2 editorial illustration style.

items.title: Anime Split-Apartment Romance Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style Japanese light novel cover showing neighboring adults divided by a wall, ideal for romance-comedy or food-themed book promotion.

author.name: ざつ＠『竜の姫と絆のユニゾン』『星槍とオムライス』『リリアンのプロの流儀』『B級グルメ革命』

items.content:
A cinematic anime-style vertical book-cover illustration for a romantic comedy light novel with slight fantasy atmosphere, split by a thin apartment wall down the center. On the left side, a warm, cozy kitchen glows in amber light from a hanging pendant lamp. A {argument name="female character name" default="Nanako Iida"}, age 28, stands in three-quarter view holding a deep plate of freshly cooked food with visible steam rising in elegant curls. She has dark hair tied in a messy bun, soft bangs, a gentle mature expression, and wears a lavender knit sweater under a white apron. The kitchen contains exact visible details: 1 hanging lamp, 1 upper shelf with cookware, 5 hanging utensils, 1 cutting board, 1 knife block, and 6 small bottles or jars lined across the foreground counter. On the right side, a dim, cool-toned bachelor bedroom is lit in blue shadows. A {argument name="male character name" default="Sota Ninomiya"}, age 26, slim but muscular, with tousled dark hair and a fitted charcoal T-shirt, leans one hand against the wall as if sensing the aroma through it. His room contains 1 bed, 1 bookshelf, 1 desk lamp, and 1 wall poster. A ribbon of steam drifts from the dish across the center wall into his side, visually connecting them. The mood is intimate, sensual, and slightly teasing, emphasizing the contrast between warm home cooking and lonely nighttime restraint. Add elegant Japanese vertical catch copy on the wall and upper right, small white serif-style name labels beside both characters with their ages, and a large bold Japanese title block across the lower middle. Include these exact text elements: left name label "Nanako Iida 28歳", right name label "Sota Ninomiya 26歳", vertical wall text "その香りが、ふたりの距離を、そっと溶かしていく。", upper-right vertical text "隣人は、優しい香りと、秘密のレシピ。", large center title "《飯テロ恋愛小説》
夜中に読まないでください〜
〜お隣のストイックくんは、
隣のお姉さんの愛の飯テロに勝てない〜", and bottom tagline "毎晩続く深夜の罪な料理の香り。
壁一枚の距離と心を溶かす". Highly polished promotional cover art, soft bloom lighting, detailed fabric folds, realistic steam, romantic tension, glossy illustrated publishing design.

items.content: Create a dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration for a fantasy mecha isekai story. Vertical poster composition with a huge heroic humanoid robot dominating the center foreground, viewed from a slightly low angle to make it monumental. The robot is sleek and ornate, with white and silver armor, rich gold trim, glowing cyan energy lines, a radiant emerald-green core in the chest, a crown-like crest on the helmet, and a long royal blue cape with gold edging. Behind its back spread multiple crystalline energy wings, about 8 large translucent green shards fanning out symmetrically like luminous blades. In its left hand it holds a long fantasy-tech spear with a blue glowing blade and gold mechanical detailing. At the robot’s feet are 2 human characters: on the left, a red-haired fantasy heroine with very long braided hair, leather-and-fabric adventurer clothing, and a determined expression, looking up at the robot; on the right, a young male protagonist with short dark hair in a fantasy tunic and cloak, reaching one hand up toward the giant machine in awe and urgency, seen mostly from behind. The setting is an epic ruined sci-fi fantasy world with towering gothic spires, broken city structures, drifting smoke, dramatic clouds, and a sky filled with stars, planets, streaks of lightning, and 8 small flying warships scattered in the distance. Highly polished anime key visual style, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, intense contrast, blue-green-gold color palette, heroic atmosphere, intricate mechanical rendering, fantasy worldbuilding, premium game or novel cover finish. Add large Japanese title typography at the top: 《{argument name="tagline text" default="本格異世界SFロボット戦記"}》 above a massive metallic logo reading {argument name="series title" default="ASTRAIA"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle line beneath it. Add a large dramatic Japanese catchphrase at the bottom in glowing white and gold text over 2 lines: {argument name="bottom catchphrase" default="乗って！ユウキ！ その叫びが、世界の運命を決めた！"}. Keep the overall design dense, premium, and readable as a commercial cover, with the central robot as the unmistakable focal point.

items.content: A dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration in high-detail anime fantasy style, square composition, showing a heroic ensemble posed for battle in a ruined mountain pass at sunset with cherry blossoms blowing through the air. The scene centers on {argument name="hero title" default="Momotaro"}, a young black-haired male warrior in glossy red samurai armor, crouched in the foreground and gripping a katana diagonally across his body. Beside him in the front-right foreground is a black-haired young woman in matching red armor with a high ponytail, also drawing a katana in a dynamic combat-ready pose. Around them stand 5 additional companions for a total of 7 characters: 1 brown-haired short-haired girl at front-left holding a short blade, 1 silver-haired angelic woman at upper-left with large white wings and a drawn bow, 1 tall red-haired warrior at top-center carrying a large weapon over the shoulder, 1 long straight black-haired shrine-maiden-like girl at upper-center-right in white and red with light armor, and 1 blonde girl at right holding a large ornate war hammer. Add a distant Japanese castle on the right background, jagged rocks and broken ground, glowing embers, drifting petals, and a luminous cloudy sky with strong backlight behind the group. Use cinematic fantasy lighting, epic adventure mood, polished painterly rendering, sharp detailed armor, flowing hair, layered depth, and a bold heroic poster feel. Include large Japanese title text across the top in metallic gold with black outline reading {argument name="top title text" default="《御伽話ファンタジー》シン・桃太郎伝"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it in white with dark outline reading {argument name="top subtitle text" default="～追放・転生した元神は、おとぎ話の世界の美少女たちと世界を救う!!"}. Include large Japanese promotional text across the bottom in bright red with white outline reading {argument name="bottom catch text" default="追放、転生した神・桃太郎。御伽話の美少女たちと試練乗り越えて鬼退治！"}. Make it look like a commercial fantasy web novel or manga cover image, energetic, crowded, and visually striking.

items.title: Painterly Steampunk Girl Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a vertical oil-painted steampunk character portrait in a gear-filled workshop, useful for fantasy character art, avatars, or stylized concept illustrations.

author.name: シンギュラリティで待ってます。💖💙💛

items.content: A painterly steampunk fantasy portrait of a young woman shown from about thigh-up in side profile, facing left, standing in a narrow workshop filled with mechanical parts and clockwork. She has long, voluminous, curly {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair cascading down her back, with a few loose strands glowing against the background. A pair of large brass aviator goggles with iridescent blue-purple lenses rests on top of her head. Her outfit is a romantic steampunk dress: a rich {argument name="dress color" default="deep cobalt blue"} bodice and skirt, a high-necked white blouse with ruffled trim and puffed sleeves, layered frills at the collar and hem, and multiple tan leather straps and buckles cinched around the waist and torso. She carries a medium brown leather backpack with rounded flap and visible buckles over one shoulder. The setting is dense with industrial details on both sides: exposed pipes, valves, hanging instruments, circular gauges, and several visible gears, including 1 large gear in the upper right and multiple ring-like metal components along the walls. Use an expressive oil-painting style with thick impasto brushstrokes, soft edges, and a dreamy handcrafted texture. The palette should contrast cool dusty blues and teals in the background with warm brass, copper, amber, and honey highlights on the machinery and hair. The mood is whimsical, adventurous, and slightly nostalgic, like a storybook steampunk inventor’s atelier. Vertical composition, character centered slightly right of frame, background softly abstracted but packed with mechanical forms, no readable text, no modern elements, and keep the face obscured by a simple centered rectangular blur block in a muted tan-brown tone.

items.title: Steampunk Cat Airship Over the Sea
items.description: A richly textured fantasy illustration of a giant pink cat-shaped steampunk airship floating above the ocean, ideal for whimsical concept art, book covers, or imaginative poster imagery.

author.name: シンギュラリティで待ってます。💖💙💛

items.content: A whimsical fantasy oil painting of a gigantic flying steamship shaped like a cat, drifting above a bright ocean under a clear blue sky filled with soft pink clouds. The vessel dominates the composition in a low-angle three-quarter view from the front-left, making it feel monumental and airborne. Its hull is rounded and bulbous like a zeppelin-ship hybrid, painted pastel pink and lavender with warm peach highlights, and the bow is sculpted into the face of a fluffy cat with pale pink fur, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, a small nose, and a huge open mouth lined with sharp dark teeth like a bizarre figurehead-jaw entrance. Ornate gilded brass trim, filigree, railings, pipes, rivets, balconies, portholes, hanging ornaments, and decorative mechanical fittings cover the ship. There are 4 tall smokestacks rising from the top deck, each striped in warm copper, red, and gold, releasing thick cotton-candy pink smoke that curls painterly into the sky. The upper deck is crowded with intricate Victorian steampunk details, domes, spires, lamp-like finials, tiny structures, and a small golden cat statue near the front. A suspended gondola or platform hangs beneath the belly of the ship with tiny visible machinery and a reddish-orange base. In the distance, 3 smaller ships appear near the horizon over choppy teal water, reinforcing the scale. The sea below is painted with lively waves and white foam. Use an imaginative storybook steampunk aesthetic with rich impasto brushstrokes, visible painterly texture, glowing sunlight, romantic pastel colors, and a dreamlike mood reminiscent of a fantastical maritime voyage. Vertical composition, highly detailed, magical, surreal, elegant, and playful.

items.title: Surreal Clockwork Gentleman on a Gear
items.description: This prompt generates a whimsical post-impressionist oil painting of an anonymous steampunk gentleman balancing on a giant gear above a Venetian-style city, useful for surreal fine-art image creation.

author.name: シンギュラリティで待ってます。💖💙💛

items.content: A surreal impasto oil painting in the spirit of a late-19th-century post-impressionist masterpiece, showing a stout gentleman in a patterned golden-blue suit and tall top hat balancing awkwardly on a giant bronze gear high above a sunlit canal city. His face is obscured by a centered vertical rectangular censor block in warm brown, creating an intentional anonymous focal interruption. He wears a richly textured jacket with mosaic-like patches of ochre, cobalt, rust, and cream, matching trousers, heavy leather boots, and a waist area that opens into an exposed clockwork mechanism full of gears and ornate brass details. His body leans forward with both hands extended as if trying to keep balance, one boot planted on the gear and the other lifted slightly outward. The background is an airy blue sky with swirling painterly clouds and scattered gold brushstrokes, while below and to the left appears a historic bell tower and arched waterfront architecture, and to the right distant terracotta rooftops beside shimmering water. Use thick visible brushstrokes, luminous warm highlights, bold blue-and-gold contrast, expressive texture, and a whimsical steampunk-meets-Venetian atmosphere. Compose the figure large and central, slightly cropped by the frame, with the giant gear visible beneath him and the city receding below.

items.title: Atmospheric Tea Alley Street Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a richly detailed photorealistic hidden tea-lane alley scene, ideal for cinematic street photography, travel visuals, or mood-driven editorial art.
items.content: A photorealistic narrow old alley tea-house scene in a dense East Asian neighborhood, shot at eye level with a slightly telephoto street-photography composition. The lane is cramped, damp, and richly layered with lived-in details: weathered storefronts, aged concrete and brick walls, tangled overhead wires, metal awnings, exposed pipes, hanging signs, and lush green vines and tree branches spilling in from above and along both sides. In the left foreground, place a rustic wooden table set for tea with exactly 1 metal kettle, 1 teapot, 1 tray of small blue-and-white porcelain teacups and small vessels, plus a few extra cups nearby; surround it with potted plants and stacked containers. Above and behind the table, hang exactly 3 illuminated vertical lantern-style signs with black Chinese calligraphy on warm cream paper, the largest reading 茶一味 and the others styled similarly, plus several darker wooden signboards with gold or light lettering. In the center of the alley, show white steam rising dramatically from a pot or food stall, partially obscuring stools and the passageway. On the right side, line up exactly 4 bicycles parked close together beside crates, baskets, and a black trash bin. Deeper in the alley, include exactly 4 visible people sitting or standing casually near tiny tables and stools, adding scale without dominating the image. The stone pavement should look wet and reflective, suggesting recent rain or humid weather. Lighting is soft natural daylight filtering from the bright opening at the far end of the alley, mixed with warm lantern glow, creating a moody cinematic contrast. Emphasize texture, authenticity, atmospheric depth, subtle haze, documentary realism, and a cozy hidden-gem tea-street feeling in {argument name="city style" default="an old Chinese lane"}.

At the top right, place a large circular badge with fine dotted border containing Japanese text and the phrase "完全保存版" in the center with a small ribbon flourish underneath. Surround her with a collage of iconic Ibaraki scenery blended seamlessly into the cover art: a vast field of blue nemophila flowers across rolling hills in the upper right with a Ferris wheel in the distance and tiny visitors along the ridge; a traditional temple or pavilion among pink cherry blossoms at mid-right; a bright waterfall and landscaped stream at lower right; a torii gate standing in shallow ocean water at sunset in the lower left; and a mountain landscape near the bottom left center. Add abundant blue flowers in the foreground along the bottom edge and soft pink cherry blossoms framing the right side. At the lower left, place a blue circular badge with white Japanese text reading "モデルコース 4" and smaller itinerary copy below. At the lower right, include exactly 3 horizontal white label tabs with Japanese text and small icons: "絶景スポット", "ご当地グルメ", and "おみやげセレクション". Add a pink ribbon banner near the bottom right with small Japanese promotional text. items.title: Dark Fantasy Inner Monster Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic gothic anime-style poster of a silver-haired woman and a blue-eyed eldritch monster, ideal for moody art campaigns, book-cover concepts, or social media design pieces.
items.content: A dark fantasy gothic poster in a vertical composition, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired style with dramatic lighting and rich texture. At the center is a beautiful young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, pale skin, and an elegant, calm but dangerous presence. Her face is mostly obscured in shadow and mystery. She wears an ornate black-and-deep-blue crystalline dress with lace, feathered and jagged organic details, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, and glowing blue highlights across the bodice and collar, as if infused with magic. Her right hand is raised slightly with an open gesture, while her left hand rests lower near her waist. Surrounding and partly growing from her are luminous blue butterflies and shard-like petals, creating a sense of transformation and corruption. Behind her looms a gigantic monstrous entity made of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic texture, with exactly 7 glowing blue eyes visible and a huge fanged grin packed with sharp icy-blue teeth. The creature feels Lovecraftian, predatory, and intimate, curling around her like a guardian, curse, or inner demon. The palette is dominated by black, midnight navy, indigo, and electric blue, with sparkling highlights like stars or wet paint splatter. Add a decorative antique silver filigree border in all 4 corners and along the edges, making it feel like a sinister book cover or exhibition poster. Place large Japanese title text at the top: {argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}. Add 8 blocks of vertical Japanese copy around the figure, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Mincho-style type. Left side text blocks, top to bottom: 「創造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」, 「正しさよりも、心が動く瞬間を信じる。」, 「美しいものに飢えている。」, 「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」. Right side text blocks, top to bottom: 「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」, 「枠を壊し、誰も見たことのない景色を描きたい。」, 「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」, plus a short atmospheric handwritten-style accent near the mid-right edge. At the lower center, add a large Japanese question line: {argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}. At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese line: {argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物語を待っている。"}. Make the whole image feel obsessive, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense, like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creative power.

items.title: Visionary Eye Mandala
items.description: This prompt generates a highly detailed symmetrical sacred-geometry mandala filled with eye motifs and radiant pointillist ornament, ideal for mystical art prints or meditation-themed visuals.
items.content: A perfectly centered sacred-geometry mandala on a clean white background, rendered as an ultra-detailed visionary ink-and-pointillism illustration. The composition is radially symmetrical and circular overall, glowing with warm gold, saffron, orange, coral, magenta, violet, and hints of cyan at the core. In the exact center, place a radiant circular nucleus with a bright cyan-blue dot surrounded by concentric rings of pink, magenta, orange, and gold, like a luminous spiritual sun. Around it, build many densely packed concentric bands of tiny jewel-like eyes, bead forms, dots, and filigree, all arranged with precise rotational symmetry. Form a four-point diamond structure around the center, with 4 large petal-like flame clusters pointing up, down, left, and right, and 4 smaller curled spiral clusters in the diagonal quadrants. At the outer cardinal points, include 4 larger almond-shaped eye motifs embedded in feathery golden forms. Across the mandala, include dozens of miniature multicolored eyes set into rings, suggesting omniscient awareness. Use extremely fine stippling, micro-linework, ornate feathered textures, and shimmering decorative detail, with the inner structure predominantly luminous gold and ivory, transitioning to a diffuse halo of violet and lavender stippled particles at the outer edge. The image should feel mystical, transcendent, intricate, balanced, and meditative, like a celestial mandala or visionary sacred emblem, with crisp high-detail line art and soft radiant color blending.

items.title: Childlike Crayon Portrait on Paper
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic photo of a messy children's crayon drawing on paper, useful for recreating handmade naive artwork with a humorous school-project feel.
items.content: A realistic overhead photo of a childlike crayon drawing on a slightly wrinkled white sheet of paper placed on a wooden tabletop. The drawing shows a simple portrait of {argument name="character" default="Donald Trump"} in a naive elementary-school style, with messy yellow crayon hair, peach-colored skin, large ears, a blue suit jacket, white shirt collar, and a red necktie. The face is front-facing and fills most of the page, with one raised hand on the left side of the paper making a rude gesture with the middle finger extended. The linework is uneven black pencil or crayon outline, and the coloring is rough, scribbly, and intentionally clumsy, with visible childlike strokes that go outside the lines. On the right side of the page, there is vertical handwritten Japanese text in black that reads {argument name="side text" default="とらんぷさん"}. The composition is a candid smartphone snapshot, not a clean scan, showing the entire sheet of paper, slight perspective distortion, soft indoor lighting, and the texture of the wooden surface around the page. Emphasize the authentic handmade crayon texture, awkward proportions, and convincing “bad but charming” children’s artwork aesthetic.

items.title: Anime Rapunzel Tower Scene
items.description: A polished fantasy anime illustration of a Rapunzel-like princess with an extremely long braid leaning from an ivy-covered tower above a scenic river valley, ideal for fairytale-themed character art or storybook visuals.

author.name: さつき＠AIお絵描き(うさぎ好き）

items.content: A whimsical anime fairytale illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Rapunzel"} leaning out from a high stone tower window, viewed from outside at a slightly elevated angle. She wears a soft lavender medieval-inspired princess dress with puff sleeves, white lace trim, and a fitted bodice, plus a pink-and-white bunny ear headband. Her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is styled into a single enormous thick braid that spills over the windowsill and drops straight down the full height of the image. A small fluffy white rabbit sits on her right shoulder, adding a cute fantasy touch. The tower is pale beige stone with a rounded balcony-like window ledge, an arched opening, deep purple interior curtains, and green ivy climbing around the walls and window frame. In the background, show a bright sunlit storybook landscape with a vivid blue sky, scattered white clouds, rolling green hills, a winding river, a stone bridge with 3 arches, and a distant European-style town with a castle or cathedral. The mood is triumphant, charming, and magical, like a polished high-end fantasy anime key visual. Detailed painterly rendering, soft natural daylight, clean linework, gentle atmospheric perspective, lush foliage, elegant composition, vertical format.

items.title: Anime Summer Soda Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style Japanese beverage advertisement poster featuring 3 schoolgirls, a sparkling soda bottle, and a vivid seaside summer atmosphere for commercial key art or mock branding.

author.name: はてブ人気エントリー

items.content: A bright, high-energy anime-style summer advertisement poster for a sparkling soft drink, set at the seaside under a vivid cobalt-blue sky with towering white cumulus clouds and a blazing sun near the top center creating lens flare and radiant beams. Feature exactly 3 Japanese high school girls in matching summer sailor uniforms: short-sleeved white blouses with navy ribbon bows and dark navy pleated skirts. All three have dark, windblown shoulder-length to long hair and youthful, lively poses. In the left foreground, show one girl from a dramatic low angle thrusting a large plastic soda bottle toward the viewer so it dominates the composition; her hand and the bottle are oversized by perspective. In the middle, show a second girl seated low near the water, one knee raised, drinking from a smaller bottle. On the right, show a third girl standing in profile or three-quarter view, also sipping from a bottle while her hair and skirt stream in the sea breeze. Make the ocean water intensely turquoise and sunlit, with energetic splashes framing the bottom left and bottom right edges, scattered droplets and sparkling highlights across the scene. Add a few small white seabirds in the distant sky. The overall mood is refreshing, nostalgic, youthful, and cinematic, like a premium Japanese beverage commercial key visual. The bottle label should be clean and minimalist white with modern sans-serif typography reading {argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"}, with smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="Yuzu White Peach Soda"} and a subtle 500 mL marking. Place the brand logo in the upper left in thin uppercase letters, and add a handwritten-style Japanese tagline in white at the lower left reading {argument name="tagline text" default="夏がくれる、はじけるひととき。"}. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering mixed with painterly light effects, ultra-detailed water droplets on the bottle, condensation, transparent plastic, glittering carbonation bubbles, and dramatic foreshortening.

items.title: Hidden Duck in Miniature Venice
items.description: This prompt generates a dense, adorable hidden-object travel illustration of a miniature Venice canal scene filled with chibi tourists, shops, and concealed rubber ducks.
items.content: A highly detailed isometric miniature diorama illustration of a lively Venetian canal square in warm golden daylight, rendered like an ultra-cute handcrafted travel scene with chibi doll-like tourists, tiny shopfronts, textured stone pavement, flower boxes, striped awnings, and sparkling turquoise water. The composition is densely packed and whimsical, designed as a hidden-object scene titled on a decorative sign in the upper right that reads {argument name="headline text" default="Find the duck! 🐤"}. Show a charming Venice setting with a central arched stone bridge crossing a narrow canal, multiple gondolas in the water, and dozens of small travelers and locals in colorful outfits, hats, sunglasses, cameras, and shopping bags. Place a souvenir kiosk with postcards and signs, a flower stall overflowing with bright bouquets, a café terrace with red-and-white checkered tables, a carnival mask shop display, stacked vintage suitcases near the canal, striped mooring poles, laundry hanging between buildings, wrought-iron street lamps, and old pastel buildings in peach, ochre, and cream with green shutters and terracotta roofs. Include visible storefront signs reading “MASCHERE,” “CAFFÈ,” “SOUVENIRS,” “FIORI,” and “VENEZIA.” Hide exactly {argument name="duck count" default="4"} small yellow rubber ducks throughout the scene as a playful search challenge, with one especially noticeable duck perched near the stacked suitcases and the others subtly blended among the busy market details. Add one tiny fluffy white dog near the flower stall. The overall style should feel like a premium collectible toy-city illustration, richly layered, joyful, cozy, and travel-themed, with soft depth of field, crisp miniature textures, and a bustling storybook atmosphere. Use {argument name="city" default="Venice"} as the location inspiration, and make the crowd feature {argument name="character style" default="cute chibi travelers"} in varied poses such as walking, chatting, taking photos, shopping, sitting at the café, standing on the bridge, and riding in gondolas.

items.title: Chicken Tikka Masala Mug Desk Photo
items.description: A photorealistic joke snapshot of a hand holding a black mug filled with chicken tikka masala in a warm-lit desk setup, ideal for surreal social media humor images.
items.content: A casual smartphone photo in a home office or gaming desk setup, shot vertically from a first-person perspective. A left hand in the foreground is holding a black ceramic mug with partial white logo text, and the mug is absurdly filled to the brim with thick chicken tikka masala instead of a drink. The curry is rich orange-red, creamy, with 3 visible chunks of chicken, a white yogurt swirl on top, and a small garnish of fresh cilantro leaves centered on the surface. The mug is positioned near the center-left of the frame above a medium-brown wooden desk. In the background, show a realistic desk scene: 1 black articulated desk lamp on the left, 1 black wall light switch on an off-white wall, visible white radiator pipes and a radiator, 1 red audio interface with knobs and cables near the back of the desk, 1 white game controller behind the mug, 1 computer monitor on the right edge showing a messaging app interface, several loose cables on the desk, and 1 large dark desk mat with a subtle red ornamental pattern in the lower right. Use warm late-afternoon indoor lighting with soft shadows, slight wide-angle phone camera distortion, shallow depth from the close foreground hand and mug, and a humorous but highly photorealistic everyday snapshot aesthetic.

items.title: Editorial Bridal Portrait with Fascinator
items.description: This prompt generates a refined studio fashion portrait of a reclining woman in a white embellished dress and fascinator, ideal for bridal editorial or couture beauty imagery.
items.content: A high-fashion studio portrait of a young woman reclining sideways on the floor against a seamless light gray background, cropped from about the hat down to the hands, with the face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She wears an elegant white dress with sheer ruched fabric, sculpted floral appliqués along both shoulder straps and the bodice, and a fitted, ethereal silhouette. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown to black"} and styled in 2 long bubble braids, one on each side, each tied off with multiple white bands creating rounded segments. She wears a dramatic white fascinator hat tilted to one side, made of layered mesh, netting, ribbon loops, lace trim, and several airy feather sprays. Pose her leaning on one forearm with the other hand extended near the lower edge of the frame, torso angled diagonally for a refined editorial composition. Use soft diffused studio lighting, smooth skin tones, minimal shadows, luxury bridal-fashion styling, monochrome white wardrobe accents, and a clean polished magazine aesthetic.

items.content: A high-fashion studio portrait of a seated woman in an ethereal bridal look against a seamless light gray background, framed vertically from headpiece to the trailing ends of her hair. She wears a flowing sleeveless white gown with a high gathered neckline, sheer pleated chiffon over the bodice, delicate white floral appliqué clustered at the neck, chest, waist, and upper skirt, and a soft draped skirt spread around her on the floor. items.title: Protein Powder Splash Hero Shot
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic premium supplement product advertisement with a floating whey tub, chocolate splash, and flying cookies for ecommerce or fitness brand web assets.
items.content: Create a hyper-realistic commercial product splash shot of a large white plastic whey protein tub labeled {argument name="brand name" default="PUREZZA"} and {argument name="product name" default="WHEYPRO"}, floating slightly above a glass filled with thick chocolate protein shake. The tub is centered, angled slightly to the right, with a clean glossy surface and a bold blue, white, and black label design. The label should prominently read “100% WPC PROTEIN MILK” and include small nutrition callouts such as “82G PROTEIN,” “2G SUGAR/SERVING,” “119% RDI OF VC,” “100% CHOLINE,” a circular “GMP” badge, a black strip reading “WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE,” another strip reading “LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL,” and a flavor tag reading {argument name="flavor text" default="BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR"}. Surround the tub with an explosive upward and outward splash of glossy chocolate liquid, with dramatic arcs, droplets, and suspended motion frozen in midair. Include exactly 5 whole chocolate sandwich cookies flying around the product and multiple broken cookie chunks and crumbs scattered throughout the scene, with one partially visible cookie near the lower right and another near the upper left. The glass at the bottom should be only partially visible, transparent, and overflowing from the impact of the splash. Use a high-contrast studio background with a dark deep blue gradient on the left fading to bright white on the right, cinematic rim lighting, crisp reflections, ultra-sharp focus on the tub, and detailed texture in the liquid and cookie crumbs. The overall look should be premium sports nutrition advertising, dynamic, energetic, and suitable for a hero image on a modern ecommerce fitness website.
